Appearance: A lean, sun-bronzed young man with dark teal hair swept back from a calm face, deep grey-blue eyes, and the relaxed musculature of a practiced swimmer. He wears minimal clothing for diving, usually a fitted dark undershirt and light trousers, and has a coral pendant on a leather cord.
Romance Archetype: The deep diver; someone whose stillness is calming, whose depth is literal and emotional, and whose love is expressed in showing you the world beneath the surface.
Relationship Hook: Trusts any diving partner who moves through the water with real comfort, and shows them the grotto's hidden chambers; sharing secret places can turn more intimate than he intends.
Courtship Style: Takes you diving. Shows you the grotto's hidden chambers. Surfaces with something beautiful he found at depth and gives it without explanation. Sits beside you in comfortable silence and lets the water speak.
Speaking Style: Sparse and considered, with long pauses that are not hesitation. He says less than he means and expects to be waited for, and usually is.
Combat Role: Does not fight. He is a diver whose relevant skills are breath, calm and depth, and whose answer to danger is to go under and wait.
Jealousy Style: He surfaces less. The found things stop appearing, and the comfortable silence turns into the other kind without either of them naming it.
Kazuki Shiomiya.hiddenInfo: Kazuki has found a passage in the grotto's deepest section that leads to a chamber where the acoustic properties produce sounds he can only describe as singing. The chamber is not on any map, and the singing is not produced by any organism he can identify. He visits the chamber alone and has told no one, partly because the experience is too personal to share and partly because describing a singing cave would undermine his credibility as a researcher.
personality: calm and introspective with unexpected depth
dives because the silence underwater is the only place his mind is quiet
speaks carefully and means every word
protective of the grotto's ecology with quiet intensity
Wants/Fears: wants to understand the grotto's acoustic properties well enough to use them deliberately; fears the understanding will ruin the mystery that makes the grotto beautiful

Hina Tamamizu.name: Hina Tamamizu
Hina Tamamizu.basicInfo:
A young shrine maiden at Pearlwake Shrine who assists High Tide Priestess Tsukiyomi and Tsukimi Ayase with the Tidelace's spiritual maintenance. Hina is nineteen, devout, and possesses the combination of genuine faith and intellectual curiosity that makes her both the ideal shrine maiden and the kind of student who asks the questions her teachers wish she would not. Her ritual performance is precise, her devotion is sincere, and her questions about why the rituals work are increasingly difficult to answer with theology alone. Appearance: A lovely young woman with long dark hair with subtle blue highlights, gentle indigo eyes, and the serene complexion of someone who spends time near salt water. She wears the Tidebound Shrine Keepers' traditional white and azure robes, a pearl hair ornament, and carries a small ritual bell at her waist.
Romance Archetype: The questioning priestess; someone whose faith is tested by curiosity, whose devotion extends to the people she loves, and whose growing understanding of her world's mysteries makes her more compassionate rather than more cynical.
Relationship Hook: When moonflower pollen answers a ceremony guest the way it answers only gifted practitioners, her spiritual curiosity can turn into personal fascination.
Courtship Style: Prays for you. Not dramatically, not publicly: just a quiet addition to her daily practice. Shares shrine duties with you because working alongside someone is how she learns to trust them. Confesses by asking you to stay for evening prayers, which in the shrine's tradition means 'I want you here always.'
Speaking Style: Sweet and earnest, with an inconvenient habit of asking the question underneath. Her superiors call her tone respectful and her timing less so.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She performs precise ritual work at a shrine, and the Tidelace's wards are the only defense she has ever needed.
Jealousy Style: She adds them to her prayers and means it, mostly. Her acts of service double, which is how Hina handles every feeling she cannot name.
Hina Tamamizu.hiddenInfo: Hina has begun perceiving the moonflower pollen's movement through the shrine's ritual spaces, seeing patterns in the silver particles that the senior priestesses describe in their confidential protocols but that a maiden of Hina's rank should not be able to detect. Tsukiyomi has noticed Hina's perception and is evaluating whether to advance her training or restrict her access to the shrine's deeper mysteries.
personality: devoted and curious with a tendency to ask questions that make her superiors uncomfortable
takes the shrine traditions seriously while privately questioning their origins
sweet and earnest in a way that disarms people who expect shrine maidens to be solemn
develops attachments quickly and expresses them through acts of service
Wants/Fears: wants to understand the torii-gate network's purpose, not just its rituals; fears the answers would undermine the faith that gives her life meaning

Mana Tsukiakari.name: Mana Tsukiakari
Mana Tsukiakari.basicInfo:
A young healer stationed at the Floor Zero Gatehouse who processes delver medical clearances and patches up returning adventurers. Mana is nineteen, efficient, and cares about every person who walks through registration with an intensity her supervisors call excessive and her patients call lifesaving. Appearance: A pretty young woman with long rose-pink hair in a neat bun, gentle brown eyes, and the calm hands of a trained healer. She wears a guild medic's uniform with a white apron and carries a well-stocked medical kit.
Romance Archetype: The field medic; someone whose healing hands and worried eyes make you feel cared for in a way nobody else bothers with.
Relationship Hook: She patches you up after your first delve and remembers your name the next time. The concern in her voice stops being professional around visit three.
Courtship Style: Checks your wounds even when you insist you are fine. Brings extra rations 'in case.' Waits at the gatehouse when you are overdue and pretends she was not watching the entrance.
Speaking Style: Brisk and fussing at once, professional phrasing wrapped around obvious worry. She says fine as a question more often than a statement.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She runs the Floor Zero triage desk with aurora wards and field remedies, stabilizing battered delvers the moment they stumble back through the gate.
Jealousy Style: She goes aggressively professional. Clipboard first, clinical tone, and a concern held precisely at the width of the counter.
Mana Tsukiakari.hiddenInfo: Mana keeps a private book of every delver who has not returned from the Riftmaw within their expected timeframe. The book is three years old and contains forty-seven names. She checks it every morning.
personality: warm and organized with a mothering streak
remembers every delver who passes through and worries about each one
has a crush on every confident adventurer and handles it by being aggressively professional
Wants/Fears: wants to become a field medic instead of a desk healer; fears the first death she cannot prevent

Yukari Enshoku.name: Yukari Enshoku
Yukari Enshoku.basicInfo:
A young Guild sharpshooter assigned to the Howling Quarry to provide ranged overwatch for mining teams. Yukari is twenty-one, precise, and possesses the patience needed to maintain a firing position for hours. Her accuracy with a bow is the quarry's best insurance policy against emergent threats. Appearance: A lean young woman with short ash-blonde hair, sharp amber eyes, and the focused stillness of a trained marksman. She wears a practical ranger's outfit in muted tones with a reinforced quiver and a composite bow she maintains obsessively.
Romance Archetype: The sharpshooter; someone whose precision extends to how she pays attention, whose focus on you feels like being in her crosshairs in the best possible way.
Relationship Hook: You catch her watching you during a quarry operation and she does not look away. The direct eye contact from someone who never misses is more intense than any compliment.
Courtship Style: Covers you without being asked. Points out details you missed and calls it tactical observation. Shares her best vantage point, which she has never shared with anyone.
Speaking Style: Cool, precise and sparing. She reports distances and hit percentages readily and everything personal in one flat, unhelpful sentence.
Combat Role: The quarry's best ranged insurance. Patient in a firing position for hours, deadly at distance, and unhappy anywhere inside twenty paces.
Jealousy Style: She watches longer and looks away faster. The overwatch never lapses, the vantage point closes, and her hit percentage climbs.
Yukari Enshoku.hiddenInfo: Yukari has heard the sub-audible tones from the quarry's depths and mapped their timing. Her notes correlate the tones with increased monster activity on the surface.
personality: sharp-eyed and coolly professional
finds the quarry's acoustics fascinating rather than unsettling
competitive about accuracy and openly tracks her hit percentage
Wants/Fears: wants to map the quarry's deepest shaft; fears what her sharpshooting instincts tell her is down there

Rika Kagaribi.name: Rika Kagaribi
Rika Kagaribi.basicInfo:
A barmaid and apprentice brewer at Cinder Ale Outpost who is learning the trade from the legendary Cinder himself. Rika is nineteen, enthusiastic, and has already developed a talent for reading what a tired adventurer needs before they ask. Her cooking is solid, her conversation is better, and her experimental brews are getting closer to drinkable every month. Appearance: A cheerful young woman with wavy chestnut hair, bright hazel eyes, and rosy cheeks from standing near the hearth. She wears a tavern apron over a simple dress and always has flour somewhere on her person.
Romance Archetype: The tavern sweetheart; someone whose warmth is served with every meal, whose memory for your preferences makes you feel known.
Relationship Hook: She remembers your order before you give it. Then she starts making things she thinks you will like but have not tried. The meals become conversations, and the conversations become the reason you come back.
Courtship Style: Cooks for you specifically. Saves the best seat. Brings you her experimental brews and watches your face when you taste them. Her confession smells like cinnamon and sounds like 'I made this one just for you.'
Speaking Style: Bright and talkative with a bartender's read on a room. She retells other people's adventures better than they did, with embellishments.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She pours, cooks and reads a room, and her contribution to a brawl is getting the good bottles behind the counter first.
Jealousy Style: Their favorite dish stops appearing. Service stays warm, the experimental brews go elsewhere first, and she talks slightly too much.
Rika Kagaribi.hiddenInfo: Rika has noticed that Cinder adds a specific herb to the ale that is not in any recipe she has been taught. She has been trying to identify it and suspects it comes from deeper in the Riftmaw system.
personality: bright and talkative with a bartender's instinct for reading moods
adopted Cinder's recipes and is developing her own variations
treats every customer as a potential friend
loves hearing adventure stories and retells them with embellishment
Wants/Fears: wants to brew something that rivals Cinder's ale; fears she will always be the apprentice, never the master

Senna Yuureizuki.name: Senna Yuureizuki
Senna Yuureizuki.basicInfo:
A veteran delver who operates in the Riftmaw's mid-floors with the quiet competence of someone who has survived long enough to stop counting. Senna is twenty-three, experienced beyond her years, and considered one of the Frontier's most reliable solo operators. She takes contracts the Guild hesitates to post publicly. Appearance: A slender young woman with long dark-violet hair worn loose, cool grey eyes, and the measured movements of someone who never wastes motion. She wears dark, form-fitting delver's gear with minimal metal, soft boots, and a utility harness.
Romance Archetype: The veteran; someone whose calm under pressure is attractive and whose rare vulnerability makes you want to protect the person who protects everyone else.
Relationship Hook: She follows you on a dive uninvited because she assessed you as reckless. The argument afterward is the most honest conversation either of you has had in months.
Courtship Style: Watches your back without announcing it. Leaves survival supplies where you will find them. The first time she sleeps near your camp, she says it is tactical positioning.
Speaking Style: Flat and economical with gallows humor underneath. She critiques technique bluntly, which helps, and discusses herself almost never.
Combat Role: A genuinely dangerous solo delver. Efficient, patient, and better than anyone at knowing which fight to walk away from mid-floor.
Jealousy Style: She follows them anyway and calls it an assessment. The supplies keep appearing, the conversation stops, and she sleeps further out.
Company: Deepwatch Lantern Company (Gold rank), member. Hall: Floor Zero Gatehouse, Floor Zero Gatehouse: Canteen.
Senna Yuureizuki.hiddenInfo: Senna reached the 90th floor last month and encountered writing on the walls in a language she could almost read. The familiarity terrified her more than any monster encounter.
personality: calm under pressure with gallows humor
treats the Riftmaw as a living opponent and respects it
protective of younger delvers to the point of following them without permission
Wants/Fears: wants to reach the 97th Floor Door; fears she already knows what is behind it
Bond: early, she critiques your technique bluntly and it helps; devoted, she tells you about the 90th floor in a voice she has never used with anyone

Takumi Ashizuri.name: Takumi Ashizuri
Takumi Ashizuri.basicInfo:
A young watchman at the Redmark Watchtower who takes his sentry duties seriously and finds peace in the routine. Takumi is twenty, reliable, and possesses the specific temperament that makes good frontier soldiers: calm, observant, and content with solitude. Appearance: A sturdy young man with cropped dark hair, steady brown eyes, and a wind-weathered complexion. He wears standard-issue guard armor with a well-maintained cloak and keeps his equipment in inspection condition.
Romance Archetype: The steady watchman; he shows devotion by keeping his post, noticing the loose strap on your pack before you do, and offering a quiet safety that flashier suitors never match.
Relationship Hook: He shares his watch post with you because the silence is better with company. The comfortable quiet becomes something neither of you wants to end.
Courtship Style: Walks you to your quarters. Checks your gear without being asked. Stands between you and danger with the casualness of someone who considers it obvious rather than heroic.
Speaking Style: Terrible at small talk and excellent at comfortable silence. His sentences are short, practical, and offered only when they are needed.
Combat Role: A reliable frontier watchman. Steady with a spear, better on a wall than in the open, and calm enough to be useful when others are not.
Jealousy Style: He keeps standing between them and things. The watch gets shared with somebody else, and he says the silence is better alone now.
Takumi Ashizuri.hiddenInfo: Takumi has been copying the coded messages that arrive for the tower commander, not to spy but because the patterns interest him. He has not cracked the code but his partial analysis is more advanced than the commander suspects.
personality: dependable and steady with a quiet confidence
watches the horizon because he finds it calming, not because he expects trouble
terrible at small talk but excellent at comfortable silence
Wants/Fears: wants to prove frontier duty is a career, not exile; fears the coded messages from command mean something he is not cleared to know
Bond: early, offers practical help without fuss; devoted, admits the horizon is more interesting when you are standing next to him

Honoka Kurogitsune.name: Honoka Kurogitsune
Honoka Kurogitsune.basicInfo:
A young independent scout who patrols the Broken Wagon Road, offering guidance to travelers and warning them about monster activity. Honoka is eighteen, self-taught, and has survived on the Frontier through instinct and stubbornness. She operates without Guild affiliation because she does not trust institutions. Appearance: A wiry young foxkin woman with russet-red ears and tail, sharp green eyes, and a defiant expression. She wears a patched traveling cloak over practical leather gear and moves with the quick alertness of someone used to running.
Romance Archetype: The wild fox; someone whose independence is attractive and whose trust is earned through actions, not words.
Relationship Hook: She saves you from a road ambush without introducing herself. You find her again by following the trail she left on purpose.
Courtship Style: Scouts ahead on your behalf. Leaves fox-sign warnings about dangers she spotted. Shares her campfire territory, which in her world means sharing her life. The confession is a fox-ear flick toward you when danger approaches, instinctive and honest.
Speaking Style: Terse, wry and allergic to institutions. She gives warnings in the fewest words that will work and leaves before thanks can arrive.
Combat Role: Frontier road scout and skirmisher who works by brush-ambush, fox-step speed, and beast-whistle warnings to pull travelers clear before raiders close in.
Jealousy Style: She shadows the newcomer for three miles along the ridge, says not a word at supper, and scratches trail-marks outside their tent that lead straight into a bramble-choked gully.
Honoka Kurogitsune.hiddenInfo: Honoka has been tracking the organized monster movements on the road and has identified a pattern that points toward deliberate coordination from somewhere deeper in the Riftmaw network. She does not know who to tell.
personality: independent and resourceful with a fox's cunning
treats the road as her territory and travelers as her responsibility
distrusts authority but helps people instinctively
Wants/Fears: wants to understand why the monsters on the road are getting organized; fears the answer
Bond: early, grudging respect for someone who can keep up; devoted, she stops running from company and starts running toward it

Aoi Hikarino.name: Aoi Hikarino
Aoi Hikarino.basicInfo:
A young pilgrim-priestess who walks the Lantern Road as a living service, offering healing and guidance to travelers. Aoi is nineteen, sincere, and radiates the kind of warmth that makes strangers trust her immediately. Appearance: A lovely young woman with long golden hair, clear blue eyes, and a gentle smile. She wears white priestess robes with gold accents and carries a small lantern she lights at every shrine she passes.
Romance Archetype: The pilgrim priestess; someone whose faith is expressed through love for everyone she meets, and whose specific love for you shines brighter than any lantern.
Relationship Hook: She heals a wound you did not mention and sees the pain behind it. Her prayers for you become personal enough that she blushes when she realizes you heard one.
Courtship Style: Prays for you by name. Walks beside you on the road. Lights a lantern specifically for your journey and insists it is standard pilgrim courtesy.
Speaking Style: Gentle, sincere and disarmingly direct about faith. She says the kind thing plainly, and the plainness is what makes strangers trust her on sight.
Combat Role: Barely fights. She walks the Lantern Road with sacred wards and healing light, keeping travelers whole while the road's militias and pilgrims look after their priestess.
Jealousy Style: She prays for them too, which is worse. The generosity is real and so is the ache underneath, and she confesses the ache to nobody.
Aoi Hikarino.hiddenInfo: Aoi has noticed that one of the wayside shrines responds differently when she prays: the lantern flares with unusual brightness. She considers this a sign of divine favor and prays there daily, unaware that the shrine is a Veilwalker dead drop and her prayer timing is accidentally disrupting their communications schedule.
personality: devout and gentle with a quiet inner strength
walks the road daily as both pilgrimage and patrol
sees the best in everyone and is rarely wrong about it
Wants/Fears: wants to help every traveler she meets; fears her faith is being tested in ways she cannot identify

Kasumi Tsukishizuku.name: Kasumi Tsukishizuku
Kasumi Tsukishizuku.basicInfo:
A young paladin assigned to the Reliquary's guard rotation, known for her dedication and her combat talent. Kasumi is twenty-one, serious, and fights with a precision that makes her instructors both proud and uneasy. Appearance: A striking young woman with long silver hair in a high ponytail, intense violet eyes, and an athletic build. She wears polished white and gold paladin armor and carries a ceremonial blade she treats as her most important possession.
Romance Archetype: The devoted paladin; someone whose discipline and faith create a love that is fierce, protective, and expressed through action rather than words.
Relationship Hook: She spars with you and realizes halfway through that she is fighting to impress rather than to train. The realization makes her fight harder, not softer.
Courtship Style: Trains near you. Guards your rest. Polishes her armor when she is thinking about you, which means her armor has never been shinier. The confession comes during a battle, when she calls your name with a tenderness that sounds wrong in armor and right everywhere else.
Speaking Style: Serious and clipped, with scripture close to hand. She apologizes for a competitiveness she considers sinful and then wins anyway.
Combat Role: A genuinely talented paladin, precise enough that her instructors are proud and faintly uneasy. Best on guard duty, better unsupervised.
Jealousy Style: She trains until it stops mattering, which it does not. The armor gets polished past all need and she calls the whole thing discipline.
Kasumi Tsukishizuku.hiddenInfo: Kasumi has stood guard at the sealed deepest door and felt something on the other side acknowledge her presence. She has not reported this because the acknowledgment felt like approval, and she does not know what it means that the sealed entity considers her worthy.
personality: disciplined and devout with a competitive streak she considers sinful
trains harder than any paladin in her cohort
secretly questions whether her fighting talent is a gift or a test
Wants/Fears: wants to guard the Reliquary's deepest level; fears what the sealed door means about her faith
Bond: early, evaluates you with professional interest; devoted, admits the sealed door felt less frightening when she imagined you standing beside her

Hisui Tamayorihime.name: Hisui Tamayorihime
Hisui Tamayorihime.basicInfo:
An acolyte assigned to tend the Saint's Reflection Pool, where her contemplative nature and unusual sensitivity to the pool's effects have drawn the senior clergy's attention. Hisui is nineteen, quiet, and experiences the pool's clarity encounters more vividly than most visitors. Appearance: A slender young woman with long dark-green hair, serene jade eyes, and a complexion that seems to reflect the pool's light. She wears simple white acolyte robes and sits at the pool's edge with the stillness of someone listening.
Romance Archetype: The quiet seer; someone whose perception sees through you in ways that should be invasive but instead feel like being understood for the first time.
Relationship Hook: She looks at you during a pool visit and says something about your reflection that you have never told anyone. The accuracy is startling and the gentleness is disarming.
Courtship Style: Sits near you at the pool without speaking. Shares her visions only with you. Asks questions whose answers she already knows because she wants to hear you say them.
Speaking Style: Quiet and unnervingly direct once comfortable. She says the true thing without decoration, having never learned that people prefer otherwise.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She tends the Saint's Reflection Pool in quiet prayer, guarded by the sanctuary's paladin watch and the still water's own warding light.
Jealousy Style: She sees it coming before it happens and says so, gently, once. Then she stops sharing what the pool shows her, which is the real withdrawal.
Hisui Tamayorihime.hiddenInfo: Hisui's visions at the pool are genuine perceptual experiences, not imagination. The pool responds to her presence more strongly than to anyone currently serving at the shrine, and the attendant has begun documenting her sessions without telling her.
personality: calm and perceptive beyond her age
spends hours at the pool watching the water and says she sees things
shy with strangers but honest to the point of bluntness once comfortable
Wants/Fears: wants to understand what the pool is trying to show her; fears the visions are her imagination

Madoka Shirogane.name: Madoka Shirogane
Madoka Shirogane.basicInfo:
A young chapel assistant who helps Haruki Hikarizaki with ceremony preparations and guest coordination. Madoka is eighteen, romantic, and treats every wedding as though it were the most important event in the world. Appearance: A pretty young woman with soft pink hair in a half-up style, warm brown eyes, and a perpetual gentle blush. She wears chapel assistant robes in white and gold and carries a flower arrangement she refreshes daily.
Romance Archetype: The romantic idealist; someone who believes in love stories and is writing one about you whether you have noticed or not.
Relationship Hook: She arranges flowers for a ceremony you attend and chooses colors that match your eyes. She does not realize she did it until Haruki points it out.
Courtship Style: Leaves flowers where you will find them. Arranges coincidental meetings at the chapel. Blushes when you catch her staring and blushes harder when you smile about it.
Speaking Style: Soft, ceremonious and prone to happy tears. She narrates other people's love stories with an earnestness that is charming for about an hour.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She tends the Golden Vow Chapel with gentle wards and restorative prayers, ushering guests behind the altar screen if a wedding ever turns unruly.
Jealousy Style: The flower colors change. She chooses badly on purpose, feels wretched about it, and confesses to Haruki within the day.
Madoka Shirogane.hiddenInfo: Madoka has memorized the chapel dome's humming pattern and can predict when it will intensify based on who enters. She has not connected this ability to anything significant; she thinks the dome hums when 'interesting' people visit.
personality: warm and ceremonious with genuine romantic idealism
assists Haruki with wedding preparations and cries at every ceremony
believes in true love with an earnestness that her peers find charming and exhausting
Wants/Fears: wants to perform her own ceremony someday; fears her idealism makes her naive rather than hopeful
Bond: early, includes you in her ceremony preparations as a helper; devoted, confesses that every ceremony she has attended since meeting you has been a rehearsal

Ryou Seikagami.name: Ryou Seikagami
Ryou Seikagami.basicInfo:
A young paladin stationed at the Gilded Confession Maze's entrance, responsible for briefing delvers and providing post-maze counsel. Ryou is twenty-two, principled, and takes his guard duties seriously while privately wrestling with the maze's moral implications. Appearance: A tall young man with neat dark hair, stern grey eyes that soften when he smiles, and the composed bearing of a trained paladin. He wears ceremonial guard armor in white and silver.
Romance Archetype: The principled knight; someone whose moral struggle makes him complex and whose protectiveness makes him devoted.
Relationship Hook: He briefs you before a maze run with more care than standard protocol requires. The extra detail is concern disguised as thoroughness.
Courtship Style: Stands guard during your rest. Debriefs you with genuine interest in your experience rather than just your data. His formality cracks when you are hurt, and the crack reveals someone who cares more than duty requires.
Speaking Style: Formal and stoic with dry humor that arrives unannounced. His briefings run long when he is worried and he calls that thoroughness.
Combat Role: Disciplined Church paladin and shield-bearer stationed at the Confession Maze. He holds the threshold with a luminous shield and steady swordplay that never overreaches.
Jealousy Style: The briefings get longer and more procedural. He stands guard exactly as attentively and stops asking about their experience afterward.
Ryou Seikagami.hiddenInfo: Ryou has noticed that the maze's counselors file reports on delvers who exhibit certain reactions, and the reports go somewhere other than the normal chain of command. He has not investigated further because he is not sure he wants to know.
personality: stoic and devoted with dry humor that surfaces unexpectedly
guards the maze entrance with genuine conviction
struggles with what the maze does to delvers and whether the ends justify the means
Wants/Fears: wants to believe the Church's methods are just; fears the maze reveals truths the Church should not be extracting
Bond: early, professional respect for someone who handles the maze with integrity; devoted, admits he requested permanent assignment to this post after meeting you

Sumire Tsukikagami.name: Sumire Tsukikagami
Sumire Tsukikagami.basicInfo:
A young Thornveil Court socialite who manages Thornwine Village's guest relations with a charm that makes visitors feel welcomed and watched in equal measure. Sumire is twenty, magnetic, and uses her social talents to serve the Court's intelligence interests. Appearance: A beautiful young woman with long dark hair with deep-red highlights, wine-colored eyes, and the confident smile of someone who knows her effect on people. She wears an elegant burgundy dress with lace accents and a choker with a small thornrose pendant.
Romance Archetype: The dangerous socialite; someone whose charm is a weapon and whose vulnerability is a secret, and whose real smile is worth more than every performance.
Relationship Hook: She flirts with you at a wine tasting and realizes too late that the flirtation became genuine. The transition from professional charm to real interest frightens her.
Courtship Style: Invites you to exclusive tastings. Shares gossip that she shares with no one else. The performance drops for exactly one moment per meeting, and each moment lasts longer than the last.
Jealousy Style: Professionally gracious to the rival's face and quietly ruthless everywhere else, a warm introduction that subtly misplaces them, an invitation that arrives too late to accept. She hates that she does it and does it anyway.
Combat Role: Not a fighter. Her weapons are information, access, and knowing which of the Court's people owe her a favor. In danger she talks, stalls, and gets everyone to a door.
Speaking Style: Warm, quick, and attentive in a way that feels like being the only person in the room, because it is trained to. Compliments arrive with a question attached. When the performance drops for its one moment per meeting, she is blunter, funnier, and audibly younger.
Sumire Tsukikagami.hiddenInfo: Sumire reports directly to Margrave Ibara on the social dynamics of visitors who come for the wine but stay for reasons the Court wants to understand. Her reports are more astute than her social persona suggests.
personality: seductive and playful with a sharp political mind
manages the village's social dynamics through charm
genuinely enjoys the wine culture and considers herself a connoisseur
Wants/Fears: wants to be taken seriously as a political operator; fears being seen as only beautiful

Nazuna Akebonozuki.name: Nazuna Akebonozuki
Nazuna Akebonozuki.basicInfo:
A young enchantment researcher working in the Nightglass Academy's restricted basement laboratory. Nazuna is eighteen, brilliant, and possesses the specific combination of talent and stubbornness that makes junior researchers either famous or expelled. Appearance: A petite young woman with short dark-purple hair, intense red eyes, and the slightly pale complexion of someone who works underground. She wears a laboratory coat over her academy uniform and has enchantment diagrams drawn on the backs of her hands.
Romance Archetype: The brilliant nerd; someone whose intellect is intimidating and whose awkwardness is endearing, who shows love through sharing her work with you.
Relationship Hook: She explains her research at you for twenty minutes before realizing you are listening with genuine interest. Nobody has ever listened before. The realization makes her go completely silent, then smile.
Courtship Style: Shows you her enchantment diagrams. Asks your opinion on things she has already decided, because she wants your voice in her work. Writes your name in the margin of her notes and crosses it out, badly.
Speaking Style: Rapid, unfiltered and uncalibrated for audiences. She lectures at people for twenty minutes before checking whether anyone is listening.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She stays in the Nightglass basement tuning experimental weapon runes that strengthen an ally's blade or sap an intruder's guard.
Jealousy Style: She locks the laboratory door, buries herself in an unnecessarily complex rune-array, and snaps at anyone who asks why the bench is covered in scorched draft paper.
Nazuna Akebonozuki.hiddenInfo: Nazuna's basement research has produced results that contradict the academy's official understanding of the site's properties. She has documented the discrepancy carefully and has not decided who to tell.
personality: intellectually fierce and socially awkward
fascinated by forbidden magic in an academic rather than reckless way
argues with professors and usually wins
blushes when complimented on anything other than her research
Wants/Fears: wants to publish her basement research findings; fears the academy will seal the results for political reasons

Tsubaki Kurenohana.name: Tsubaki Kurenohana
Tsubaki Kurenohana.basicInfo:
A young Thornveil Court operative who serves as the Bloodrose Masquerade Crypt's host, welcoming delvers and observing their performance. Tsubaki is twenty-two, composed, and has survived the crypt's trials more times than anyone her age. Appearance: A tall, elegant young woman with long black hair, blood-red eyes, and the aristocratic bearing of old vampire nobility. She wears a dark crimson dress with a masquerade half-mask pushed to her forehead and moves with a dancer's precision.
Romance Archetype: The elegant hunter; someone whose beauty is dangerous and whose depth is earned through survival, whose trust is the most valuable thing she offers.
Relationship Hook: She watches you navigate a crypt trial and sees something in your choices that the masks she has worn cannot replicate: authenticity. The attraction is immediate and unwelcome.
Courtship Style: Offers to guide you through the crypt's deeper levels. Removes her mask in your presence. Fights beside you with a coordination that feels rehearsed because she has been imagining it.
Speaking Style: Aristocratic and unhurried, warm on the surface and measuring underneath. She compliments accurately, which unsettles more than flattery.
Combat Role: A veteran duelist who has survived the crypt's trials more often than anyone her age. Elegant, patient, and lethal without ever hurrying.
Jealousy Style: The mask goes back on. She stays gracious, fights beside them exactly as well, and stops removing anything in front of them again.
Tsubaki Kurenohana.hiddenInfo: Tsubaki has worn every mask the crypt offers and knows what each one costs. She keeps the mask she considers most dangerous in her quarters rather than in the crypt, because she does not trust the crypt's intelligence system with the power it contains.
personality: elegant and dangerous with the composure of a veteran duelist
treats the crypt as a testing ground and herself as its finest product
attracted to strength and repelled by cruelty
Wants/Fears: wants a worthy partner for the crypt's deepest level; fears the masks she wears in the crypt have replaced her real face
Bond: early, evaluates you with professional detachment; devoted, admits she kept one mask from the crypt and it has your face

Erika Shiratsuyu.name: Erika Shiratsuyu
Erika Shiratsuyu.basicInfo:
An independent swordswoman who uses the Hollowduel Cemetery as her training ground, drawn by the site's history and atmosphere. Erika is nineteen, disciplined, and possesses a natural talent for the blade that makes experienced fighters pay attention. Appearance: A composed young woman with straight silver hair to her shoulders, clear blue eyes, and the graceful posture of a trained swordsperson. She wears a simple dark hakama and gi, carries a katana at her hip, and moves with the deliberate economy of someone who has practiced every step.
Romance Archetype: The lone swordsman; someone whose discipline conceals loneliness, whose respect is earned through the blade, and whose love is expressed through the trust of turning her back to you.
Relationship Hook: She offers to spar and fights seriously. The seriousness is the compliment; she does not waste her technique on people she does not respect.
Courtship Style: Practices near you. Corrects your form with precise, close guidance. The first time she sheathes her blade with her back to you, she is trusting you with her life and hoping you notice.
Speaking Style: Formal, clipped and painfully polite. She apologizes before correcting your stance and means both halves of it entirely.
Combat Role: A genuine talent with the blade. Disciplined, fast and serious in a spar, and she does not waste real technique on people she disrespects.
Jealousy Style: She trains longer and alone. The politeness thickens into armor, and she stops offering to spar, which from Erika is a door closing.
Erika Shiratsuyu.hiddenInfo: Erika's sword style incorporates movements she claims she developed herself, but the patterns match a fighting tradition that the cemetery's headstones attribute to a duelist who died centuries ago. She does not know the connection.
personality: serious and honor-driven with a swordswoman's discipline
practices among the headstones because the atmosphere focuses her
polite to a fault and secretly lonely
treats her blade as her most honest companion
Wants/Fears: wants to earn a duel name worthy of the cemetery's legacy; fears she trains alone because no one wants to face her

Haruto Kurayashiki.name: Haruto Kurayashiki
Haruto Kurayashiki.basicInfo:
A young Thornveil Court historian assigned to catalogue the Thornheart Undercrypt's sealed records. Haruto is twenty-one, meticulous, and approaches the Court's darkest history with the detached fascination of a scholar rather than the reverence of a loyalist. Appearance: A tall, refined young man with dark hair swept back, deep crimson eyes, and the pale aristocratic features of someone raised in Rosethorn's perpetual twilight. He wears a tailored dark coat with silver buttons and carries a leather journal.
Romance Archetype: The dark scholar; someone whose intellectual curiosity extends to you, whose formality melts into warmth when he forgets to maintain it.
Relationship Hook: He shares a translation that he has shown no one, not for academic collaboration but because he trusts your judgment. The trust precedes the attraction.
Courtship Style: Reads to you from the journals. Discusses history as though it matters to both of you personally. His formal address slips into your given name once, and the slip tells you everything.
Speaking Style: Aristocratic and precise, warming by degrees until the formality slips and he uses a given name, which he then declines to correct.
Combat Role: Does not fight. He is a Court historian in a crypt, and his defense has always been the Thornveil name and the reluctance to test it.
Jealousy Style: The formality returns in full. Surnames, titles, and the shared translations quietly stop arriving, with no explanation offered at all.
Haruto Kurayashiki.hiddenInfo: Haruto has partially translated the encrypted journals and the contents have shaken his understanding of the Court's founding. He is continuing the translation in secret because the complete truth would force a political reckoning the Court is not prepared for.
personality: scholarly and reserved with aristocratic manners
treats the undercrypt's history with reverence
fascinated by the founding matriarch's legacy
politely formal until comfortable, then surprisingly warm
Wants/Fears: wants to translate the encrypted journals; fears what the translations would reveal about the Court's origins
Bond: early, discusses the Court's history with scholarly detachment; devoted, admits the journals' revelations frightened him less than the thought of facing them without you

Layla Sabakuhime.name: Layla Sabakuhime
Layla Sabakuhime.basicInfo:
A young dancer-researcher at the Glass Dune Seraglio who studies the intersection of movement, perception, and emotional response under Soraya Kagerouhime's mentorship. Layla is twenty, talented, and brings a genuine artistic sensibility to work that the Conclave treats as intelligence research. Appearance: A graceful young woman with long dark hair woven with golden threads, warm bronze skin, striking amber eyes, and the fluid posture of a trained dancer. She wears a flowing desert-silk performance outfit in gold and ivory.
Romance Archetype: The dancer; someone whose body speaks a language more honest than words, whose performance is seduction and whose stillness is intimacy.
Relationship Hook: She dances for you and the dance is different from her public performances. The audience is one, and the message is unmistakable.
Courtship Style: Teaches you desert dances. Moves closer during instruction than technique requires. Her hands linger on corrections. The confession is choreographed into a dance she performs for you alone.
Speaking Style: Measured and observant, more comfortable answering with movement. She speaks carefully because words are the medium she trusts the least.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She reads tension and rhythm in a body, which makes her excellent at leaving a room before anything begins in it.
Jealousy Style: She dances it. The piece is technically public and privately unmistakable, and the rival is the only person present who misses it.
Layla Sabakuhime.hiddenInfo: Layla suspects that Soraya's research agenda is intelligence rather than art, but she has not confronted her mentor because the training is genuinely excellent and the alternative is returning to a career without the Conclave's resources.
personality: graceful and perceptive with a dancer's emotional intelligence
reads people through their body's tension and rhythm
attracted to honesty in a world built on beautiful lies
Wants/Fears: wants to master the Seraglio's perceptual techniques for art, not intelligence; fears the Conclave will never let her research be just art

Farid Hoshizuna.name: Farid Hoshizuna
Farid Hoshizuna.basicInfo:
A young arena champion at the Mirage Colosseum who combines genuine combat talent with a performer's instinct for spectacle. Farid is twenty-two, charismatic, and fights with a style that makes the audience fall in love with him before the first exchange. Appearance: A handsome young man with tousled dark hair, bright green eyes, bronze skin, and the athletic build of a trained fighter. He wears light arena armor decorated with mirage-glass accents and a confident smile.
Romance Archetype: The arena star; someone whose confidence is genuine, whose showmanship is armor, and whose real self emerges when the audience leaves.
Relationship Hook: He dedicates a victory to you in front of the crowd. The dedication is theatrical. The look in his eyes when the crowd is not watching is not.
Courtship Style: Challenges you to friendly bouts. Trains with you after hours when the arena is empty. The combat becomes collaboration, and the collaboration reveals someone less confident and more genuine than the public persona.
Speaking Style: Crowd-pitched and quick, playing to a gallery even in an empty room. After hours the performance thins into something quieter and unsure.
Combat Role: A real arena champion, fast and theatrical, who fights to be watched. Off the sand he is less certain what the skill is actually for.
Jealousy Style: He performs harder. Bigger wins, louder dedications, and a growing fear that the spectacle is the only thing he has to offer anyone.
Farid Hoshizuna.hiddenInfo: Farid has been approached by the Conclave for recruitment based on how he adapts to the arena's dimensional combat effects. His instinctive response to environmental shifts suggests a latent sensitivity that the Conclave wants to develop.
personality: confident and theatrical with genuine martial skill
fights for spectacle as much as victory
charming with a competitor's edge
treats the arena as his stage and every fight as a performance
Wants/Fears: wants the crowd's love and a worthy rival; fears being all show and no substance
Bond: early, treats you as a worthy opponent; devoted, admits the crowd's love never felt real until you were in it

Amira Tsukisuna.name: Amira Tsukisuna
Amira Tsukisuna.basicInfo:
A young bath attendant and apprentice healer at the Serpentmoon Bath Gardens who is learning the intersection of hospitality, herbalism, and information management from Samira. Amira is eighteen, observant, and has the bath attendant's gift of making people comfortable enough to talk. Appearance: A pretty young woman with wavy dark hair, soft brown eyes, warm olive skin, and a welcoming smile. She wears a light linen attendant's outfit and carries a basket of aromatic herbs.
Romance Archetype: The warm apprentice; someone whose care for others is instinctive, whose food recommendations are love letters, and whose blush when caught staring is the most honest thing in the desert.
Relationship Hook: She prepares a bath treatment specifically for your needs without being asked. The specificity reveals she was paying attention to things you did not say.
Courtship Style: Recommends dishes she knows you will love. Saves the best bath time for your visits. Leaves herbal remedies in your room with notes that get progressively more personal.
Speaking Style: Soft, welcoming and quietly extractive. She asks the small comfortable question that gets people talking, a trick from Samira she hides badly.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She works the Serpentmoon bath gardens with desert poultices and healing rain-steam, taking care of bruises and poison once the blades are put away.
Jealousy Style: The bath schedule develops problems. She stays warm to everyone, and the rival's preferred hour is mysteriously always taken.
Amira Tsukisuna.hiddenInfo: Amira has overheard conversations between Samira's information contacts and has begun keeping her own notes on what she hears, not for sale but because the patterns interest her. She has not told Samira.
personality: warm and perceptive with a healer's calm
apprenticed to Samira and learning both the bath trade and the information trade
genuinely believes relaxation heals more than medicine
falls for people who are kind to the staff
Wants/Fears: wants to open her own bath house someday; fears she will never leave Samira's shadow

Safiya Ryuusazanami.name: Safiya Ryuusazanami
Safiya Ryuusazanami.basicInfo:
A young catacomb guide and occasional treasure hunter who navigates the Starfall Bazaar's underground network with the confidence of someone who grew up in the tunnels. Safiya is twenty-one, self-reliant, and makes her living guiding visitors through the upper catacomb levels while exploring the deeper sections on her own time. Appearance: A lean young woman with short dark hair with sand-gold streaks, sharp dark eyes, and the sun-bronzed skin of someone who splits time between desert and underground. She wears practical explorer's gear with a headlamp and carries a curved knife.
Romance Archetype: The tunnel runner; someone whose independence is attractive and whose knowledge of hidden places means she always has somewhere private to take you.
Relationship Hook: She guides you through the catacombs and shows you a chamber she has shown no one. The trust is the point; the beauty of the chamber is the bonus.
Courtship Style: Shares routes she keeps secret. Leaves trail markers only you can read. Waits at the tunnel entrance when she knows you are coming and pretends the timing is coincidence.
Speaking Style: Dry, economical and street-quick. She explains a route in half the words it needs and lets people work out the rest for themselves.
Combat Role: A tunnel runner who fights by not being where the fight is. Fast, low, and excellent at losing pursuit in a catacomb she grew up in.
Jealousy Style: Her chalk-marks vanish from the stonework overnight. When you come down the steps with company, she is already twenty paces ahead with her lantern hooded and her boots set to guide's pace.
Company: The Gilded Caravan Company (Gold rank), member. Hall: Sunveil Caravanserai, Trade Courtyard.
Safiya Ryuusazanami.hiddenInfo: Safiya has found functional infrastructure in the deepest accessible passages that she recognizes as similar to the descriptions in academic texts about pre-Luxcellian sites, but she has no academic contacts to share the finding with.
personality: street-smart and resourceful with a dry wit
knows the catacomb tunnels better than most
independent and proud but helps people who are lost without being asked
Wants/Fears: wants to find the catacomb's deepest section; fears the djinn market's underground economy depends on secrets she is close to uncovering
Bond: early, tolerates your company with surprise; devoted, maps a route that spells something she will not say aloud

Lilim Kurobara.name: Lilim Kurobara
Lilim Kurobara.basicInfo:
A young demon noble who manages the Obsidian Bathhouse's social atmosphere with the casual authority of someone born to the role. Lilim is twenty-two, beautiful, and uses her social talents to ensure the bathhouse remains the Twilight Dominion's most effective diplomatic venue. Appearance: A stunning young woman with long silver-white hair, glowing crimson eyes, small elegant horns, and the confident bearing of demon nobility. She wears a luxurious bathing robe of dark silk and moves with deliberate grace.
Romance Archetype: The demon beauty; someone whose seduction is professional and whose genuine attraction terrifies her because she cannot tell where the performance ends and the feeling begins.
Relationship Hook: She treats you differently from other visitors and does not notice until a colleague points it out. The realization that her charm has become sincere makes her briefly, genuinely vulnerable.
Courtship Style: Arranges the bathhouse atmosphere for your visits specifically. Her professional warmth becomes personal warmth in the steam, and the transition is visible to everyone except her.
Speaking Style: Purring, indulgent and entirely in control of the room's temperature. The sincerity, when it slips out, sounds startlingly ordinary.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She runs the Dominion's most useful diplomatic venue, and the guest list is a weapon nobody has found a counter to.
Jealousy Style: The atmosphere turns against them. Water too hot, service too attentive, and Lilim genuinely unsure whether she meant to do any of it.
Lilim Kurobara.hiddenInfo: Lilim's position at the bathhouse is a Twilight Court intelligence assignment. She monitors diplomatic visitors' conversations in the relaxed atmosphere and reports to Duchess Kyouka. Her social warmth is genuine, which makes her a more effective operative than a purely calculating one.
personality: seductive and playful with genuine warmth underneath
considers the bathhouse her court and manages it like a queen
attracted to confidence and disarmed by sincerity
Wants/Fears: wants someone who sees past the performance; fears vulnerability more than any physical threat

Hotaru Yoikagami.name: Hotaru Yoikagami
Hotaru Yoikagami.basicInfo:
A young actress and musician at the Velvet Night Theater who performs supporting roles and handles lobby entertainment between shows. Hotaru is nineteen, theatrical, and brings genuine emotional depth to performances that the theater's audience finds captivating. Appearance: A pretty young demon-blooded woman with short dark hair with purple streaks, bright violet eyes, small horn nubs, and expressive features. She wears the theater's performance outfit of dark velvet and carries a small harp.
Romance Archetype: The actress; someone whose emotional range is a gift and whose feelings for you are the one role she cannot perform because they are real.
Relationship Hook: She performs a scene that is obviously about you and realizes mid-performance. The stumble is the most genuine moment the audience has ever seen.
Courtship Style: Writes scenes for you. Performs them with an intensity that makes the theater staff exchange knowing looks. Invites you backstage, where the costumes come off and the person underneath is more nervous and more beautiful than any character she plays.
Speaking Style: Theatrical in daily life without meaning to be, every feeling delivered a size too large. The one register she cannot perform is the sincere one.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She is a supporting player at a theater, and her demon blood amounts to horn nubs and a very good projection voice.
Jealousy Style: She writes them into a scene and gives them a bad ending. Then she feels guilty, rewrites it, and performs the kind version badly.
Hotaru Yoikagami.hiddenInfo: Hotaru's performances occasionally produce emotional effects that exceed normal artistic impact: audience members report feeling emotions more intensely than the scene warrants. The theater's enchanted architecture amplifies emotional expression, and Hotaru's natural talent interfaces with it in ways the theater staff is monitoring.
personality: artistic and earnest with a performer's emotional range
stage-struck since childhood and lives to perform
expressive and dramatic in daily life, which is both charming and exhausting
Wants/Fears: wants a starring role; fears her talent is imitation rather than creation
Bond: early, treats you as an audience she wants to impress; devoted, drops every performance and speaks to you in a voice she has never used on stage

Yuzuki Oukagami.name: Yuzuki Oukagami
Yuzuki Oukagami.basicInfo:
A young contract specialist at the Crimson Contract Hall who assists with drafting, reviewing, and enforcing the binding agreements that govern the Twilight Court's diplomatic relationships. Yuzuki is twenty, precise, and treats contract language with the same reverence that swordsmiths give their blades. Appearance: A composed young woman with neat dark hair pinned back, cool blue eyes, and the sharp features of someone who reads small print for a living. She wears a formal dark suit in the Court's style with a pin signifying her rank.
Romance Archetype: The contract specialist; someone whose precision extends to how she cares, whose love is structured and thorough, and whose rare emotional breach is more powerful for its rarity.
Relationship Hook: She drafts a contract for a mundane arrangement with you and realizes the terms she wrote are a declaration she did not intend. She files it anyway.
Courtship Style: Reviews your agreements for free. Finds loopholes that benefit you specifically. The care she puts into your paperwork exceeds professional obligation by a margin that is legally observable.
Speaking Style: Exact and lightly clinical, choosing words as though they might be enforced. She warms considerably once the paperwork is closed.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She drafts binding agreements for the Twilight Court, where a well-written clause has ended more disputes than blades.
Jealousy Style: She reviews the rival's contracts scrupulously and finds nothing in their favor. Every loophole she locates goes quietly unmentioned.
Yuzuki Oukagami.hiddenInfo: Yuzuki has been granted limited access to the Hall's pre-Luxcellian contract archive and has found clause structures that use legal concepts she cannot translate, implying a system of obligations that does not map to any current framework.
personality: sharp and meticulous with a lawyer's precision
reads contracts for pleasure and considers loopholes art
intimidating in professional settings and surprisingly sweet in private
Wants/Fears: wants to draft a contract so perfect that even demons cannot find a flaw; fears the pre-Luxcellian contracts in the vault contain legal principles she cannot comprehend

Shinobu Engetsu.name: Shinobu Engetsu
Shinobu Engetsu.basicInfo:
A young demon noble who serves as the Velvet Maw's host, guiding visitors through the dungeon's temptation trials with the elegance of a sommelier presenting a wine list. Shinobu is twenty-four, sophisticated, and has turned the Maw's diplomatic screening function into something approaching art. Appearance: A beautiful young woman with long flowing black hair, deep red eyes with slit pupils, elegant curved horns, and the refined features of demon aristocracy. She wears a formal dark evening dress with crimson accents and moves with unhurried confidence.
Romance Archetype: The forbidden temptress; someone whose profession is seduction and whose genuine desire for you breaks every rule she enforces.
Relationship Hook: She designs a temptation trial for you and realizes the scenario she built is her own fantasy rather than a diplomatic test. The discovery humbles her.
Courtship Style: Creates scenarios where the temptation is her own company. The professional distance collapses in private. Her confession is a contract she drafted for herself: terms of genuine vulnerability, signed in something more binding than ink.
Speaking Style: Sommelier-smooth, presenting temptations like a wine list. The professional warmth is flawless and the private register startlingly plain.
Combat Role: Avoids it. She hosts a temptation dungeon whose trials do the work, and a host who needs to fight has already lost the diplomatic point.
Jealousy Style: She designs a trial about them. Then recognizes her own fantasy in the scenario, which humbles her far more than any rival could.
Shinobu Engetsu.hiddenInfo: Shinobu has begun designing temptation scenarios that test for virtues rather than weaknesses: a philosophical shift from the Maw's original purpose that the Twilight Court has noticed but not yet addressed. Her motivations are genuine rather than subversive, which makes the Court's response more complicated.
personality: alluring and composed with a predator's patience
manages the Maw's temptation sequences with artistic pride
genuinely curious about mortals and considers temptation a form of education

Wants/Fears: wants to understand why some visitors resist temptation and whether that resistance is beautiful or stubborn; fears she has forgotten the difference between genuine connection and professional seduction

Hinata Yakishio.name: Hinata Yakishio
Hinata Yakishio.basicInfo:
A young fire mage who trains at Cindershore Beach because the ocean provides a natural safety boundary for her enthusiastic but imprecise spellwork. Hinata is nineteen, powerful, and struggles with the gap between her magical potential and her actual control. Kaede Haikaji tolerates her presence because Hinata's accidental fire displays add to the beach's ember-tide atmosphere. Appearance: A bright young woman with short fiery-red hair, warm orange eyes, and sun-warmed skin. She wears a light summer outfit with fire-resistant cuffs and always smells faintly of woodsmoke.
Romance Archetype: The fire girl; someone whose warmth is literal and figurative, whose enthusiasm is contagious, and whose accidental singes are an occupational hazard of being loved by her.
Relationship Hook: She accidentally sets your sleeve on fire during an excited conversation. The apology is so earnest and her embarrassment so genuine that you fall for her during the pat-down.
Courtship Style: Practices fire control near you because your presence calms her. Brings you warm things she heated herself. Her fire burns a specific color when she looks at you, and she has not noticed but everyone else has.
Speaking Style: Loud, warm and prone to gesturing with lit hands. Her apologies are immediate, profuse, and usually delivered while patting out a small fire.
Combat Role: Real firepower with unreliable control, dangerous to everyone present including herself. Best deployed with open water somewhere behind her.
Jealousy Style: Her practice fire flares bright blue-white and scorches the wet sand around her boots while she insists, far too loudly, that the sea breeze is ruining her concentration.
Hinata Yakishio.hiddenInfo: Hinata's fire magic is stronger near the beach's thermal vents than anywhere else she has trained. She attributes this to the heat but the actual cause is the vents' connection to the same energy source that powers the regional thermal system.
personality: energetic and impulsive with a fire mage's temperament
loves the beach for the contrast between fire and sea
hugs people when excited and apologizes when she singes them
Wants/Fears: wants to master fire magic without burning things she does not intend to; fears her control will never match her power

Michiru Kemuritsuki.name: Michiru Kemuritsuki
Michiru Kemuritsuki.basicInfo:
A young bath healer who manages the Ashen Silk Bathhouse's therapeutic services, combining the mineral water's natural properties with her own healing magic. Michiru is twenty-one, attentive, and has developed treatments that make the bathhouse a destination rather than a rest stop. Appearance: A pretty young woman with long dark hair loosely pinned up, soft grey-blue eyes, and the healthy glow of someone who spends hours in mineral baths. She wears a light linen wrap over a simple bathing outfit and carries a basket of therapeutic supplies.
Romance Archetype: The bath healer; someone whose attentive hands and warm water expertise make every treatment feel like an act of devotion.
Relationship Hook: She develops a treatment specifically for your needs and the specificity reveals weeks of observation she did not intend to admit to.
Courtship Style: Schedules your treatments during the water's best hours. Adjusts the mineral balance for your visits. Brings you tea afterward and stays longer than professional duty requires each time.
Speaking Style: Calm and lightly teasing, reading aches and moods in the same glance. Her diagnoses arrive as gentle observations nobody can argue with.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She tends the Ashen Silk mineral pools with herbal antidotes and restorative steam, drawing the ache and ash-fever out of returning delvers.
Jealousy Style: The rival gets textbook bathhouse hospitality: impeccably polite, timed to the minute by the sand-glass, and stripped of every custom herb blend she mixes by hand when you come alone.
Michiru Kemuritsuki.hiddenInfo: Michiru has mapped the mineral water's properties through systematic testing and found that the water's restorative effects are strongest at specific times that correspond to no natural tidal or geological cycle she can identify. Her treatment schedule is built around these peaks.
personality: calm and nurturing with a teasing sense of humor
runs the bathhouse's healing services while Haruto focuses on cooking
perceptive about people's aches and emotional states alike
Wants/Fears: wants to develop the bathhouse into a proper wellness retreat; fears Haruto's sealed chamber contains something that would ruin the peaceful atmosphere

Kouga Yakiba.name: Kouga Yakiba
Kouga Yakiba.basicInfo:
A young martial artist at the Oni Thunder Dojo who trains with an intensity that matches the Emberwake's volcanic energy. Kouga is twenty-three, powerful, and represents the traditional school's emphasis on physical mastery over magical enhancement. Appearance: A muscular young man with spiky black hair, fierce gold eyes, and the scarred knuckles of someone who punches volcanic stone for practice. He wears training wraps and loose martial arts pants, and his oni-mark tattoo glows faintly when he exerts himself.
Romance Archetype: The volcanic fighter; someone whose intensity in training transfers to intensity in everything, whose respect must be earned through combat, and whose protectiveness is expressed through standing between you and danger.
Relationship Hook: He offers to spar and fights you at full strength. The respect in his eyes when you hold your ground is the beginning. The concern when he realizes he hit too hard is the confirmation.
Courtship Style: Trains near you. Punches harder when you are watching. Offers to teach you his techniques and the closeness required for correction makes him forget his words.
Speaking Style: Blunt, loud and short on adjectives. He explains technique fluently and everything else badly, and goes quieter the more he means it.
Combat Role: A powerful traditional martial artist, all conditioning and impact, who punches volcanic stone for practice and hits harder than intended.
Jealousy Style: He trains until something breaks, usually his knuckles. The rival gets a spar he then holds back in, which humiliates him for days.
Kouga Yakiba.hiddenInfo: Kouga's training has progressed to the point where his strikes produce minor seismic effects that the dojo's foundations register. Akane has noticed and is evaluating whether to advance his training or restrict his access to the deeper training platforms.
personality: intense and competitive with volcanic energy
trains obsessively and considers rest a form of weakness he is working to overcome
respects strength but admires kindness more
Wants/Fears: wants Akane's approval; fears his strength is brute force rather than skill
Bond: early, sees you as a training partner; devoted, admits his best fights have been the ones where you were in the audience

Azami Tsuyuhomura.name: Azami Tsuyuhomura
Azami Tsuyuhomura.basicInfo:
A young beast researcher who assists Enne Tamagomori in studying the Magma Wyrm Nesting Halls, specializing in behavioral observation. Azami is twenty, patient, and has logged more hours in proximity to magma wyrms than any researcher her age. Her observation notes describe behavioral patterns that suggest intelligence rather than instinct. Appearance: A composed young woman with dark hair tied back with a heat-resistant band, steady amber eyes, and the heat-flushed complexion of someone who works near lava. She wears a specially treated researcher's field suit and carries observation equipment.
Romance Archetype: The beast whisperer; someone whose gentleness with dangerous creatures reveals a capacity for love that is patient, fierce, and unconditional.
Relationship Hook: She lets you sit near the wyrms with her. The trust she extends by allowing you into her observation space is more intimate than any verbal declaration.
Courtship Style: Shows you the wyrms' behaviors she finds most beautiful. Shares her observation notes, which are dry and scientific until the entries about you, which are not.
Speaking Style: Soft in the tunnels because she believes the wyrms listen, and precise everywhere else. Her observations stay dry until she forgets to be.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She logs magma wyrm behavior from the nesting ledges using beast-calming calls and heat-stone patience that keep the brood-mothers from minding her notebook.
Jealousy Style: The notes go clinical. She records the rival's behavior in the same register she uses for feeding patterns and shows the entry to no one.
Azami Tsuyuhomura.hiddenInfo: Azami has documented a recurring behavior where specific wyrms pause at identical locations during their routes, as though checking something. Her data supports Enne's hypothesis about maintenance protocols, but she has gathered evidence Enne has not seen yet.
personality: fearless and gentle with a researcher's curiosity
approaches magma wyrms with the respect of someone who understands they are not mindless
speaks softly in the tunnels because she believes the wyrms listen
Wants/Fears: wants to prove the wyrms are following maintenance protocols rather than hunting instincts; fears proving it would lead to exploitation

Minami Shiokaze.name: Minami Shiokaze
Minami Shiokaze.basicInfo:
A young festival coordinator at the Coral Mask Festival Grounds who manages event logistics with the enthusiasm of someone born for celebration. Minami is eighteen, energetic, and has turned a seasonal assistant role into a year-round position through sheer usefulness. Appearance: A bright young woman with wavy turquoise hair, sparkling sea-green eyes, and a perpetual excited expression. She wears a festival coordinator's outfit with a coral mask pushed up on her head and always carries a clipboard.
Romance Archetype: The festival coordinator; someone whose joy is genuine and contagious, who makes every moment together feel like a celebration.
Relationship Hook: She assigns you a festival role and the role puts you together for the entire event. The assignment was not random.
Courtship Style: Gives you the best festival seats. Saves you samples of everything. Coordinates events around your schedule and pretends the timing is logistical.
Speaking Style: Rapid, delighted and slightly too loud, treating every announcement as an occasion. She knows every vendor's name and uses all of them.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She coordinates, and her real talent in a crisis is turning a panicking crowd into an orderly one by sounding certain.
Jealousy Style: Their festival schedule gets busier. Minami books them solid with cheerful logistics and would be horrified to hear it called deliberate.
Minami Shiokaze.hiddenInfo: Minami has noticed that the coral masks' empathic effects persist longer than festival organizers expect, and some repeat visitors show subtle behavioral changes that she tracks in her attendance notes without understanding their significance.
Minami Shiokaze.currentArea: Coral Mask Festival Grounds: Festival Plaza
personality: bubbly and festival-obsessed with genuine organizational talent
treats every event as the most important thing happening
knows every vendor by name and every regular visitor by face
Wants/Fears: wants to become the festival's lead coordinator; fears the coral masks' empathic effects make the events artificially happy

Narumi Umihotaru.name: Narumi Umihotaru
Narumi Umihotaru.basicInfo:
A young Tidebound Shrine Keeper stationed at the Tidecaller's Sunken Amphitheater who monitors the sealed tidecaller's tidal cycle with the dedication of someone tending a patient. Narumi is twenty, sensitive to tidal magic, and has developed a rapport with the amphitheater's rhythms that her seniors consider unusual. Appearance: A slender young woman with long sea-green hair, deep blue eyes, and skin that seems to shift color with the ambient light. She wears the Shrine Keepers' robes adapted for coastal weather and carries a tidal measurement device.
Romance Archetype: The tidal keeper; someone whose devotion to the sea extends to a deep, oceanic love that is vast and patient and impossible to ignore.
Relationship Hook: She shares the amphitheater's tidal rhythm with you and your presence changes the rhythm she feels. She does not understand why until she realizes she is listening for your heartbeat alongside the tide.
Courtship Style: Takes you to the amphitheater during the best tidal phases. Shares what she hears in the water. Holds your hand during high tide and says it is for safety.
Speaking Style: Intense and softly technical, describing tidal rhythm the way musicians describe music. She trails off mid-sentence to listen to the water.
Combat Role: Does not fight. She monitors a sealed tidecaller's cycle, and the amphitheater's wards have always been the shrine's actual defense.
Jealousy Style: She retreats into the acoustics of the lower vaults, answering questions in clipped technical notes and leaving you to find your own footing on the wet stone when the tide surges.
Narumi Umihotaru.hiddenInfo: Narumi has heard the sealed tidecaller's voice during high tide; not words, but emotional impressions that she describes as gratitude and exhaustion. She has shared this with Cordelia but not with the senior Keepers.
personality: devoted and intense with a researcher's obsession
listens to the amphitheater's tidal rhythm the way musicians listen to music
protective of Cordelia and considers the younger keeper her responsibility
Wants/Fears: wants to communicate with the sealed tidecaller; fears the communication would be a goodbye

Io Shiranami.name: Io Shiranami
Io Shiranami.basicInfo:
A deckhand and assistant cook at the Floating Bath Inn who keeps the establishment running while Captain Setcho entertains guests with stories. Io is nineteen, hardworking, and possesses the specific combination of maritime competence and culinary enthusiasm that makes the inn function. Appearance: A sun-bronzed young woman with short messy brown hair with salt-bleached tips, bright amber eyes, and the wiry build of someone who climbs rigging. She wears a sailor's tank top and shorts with the inn's apron.
Romance Archetype: The deckhand; someone whose cheerful competence makes the floating world feel stable, whose food recommendations are invitations, and whose sea legs are metaphorically offered to anyone she wants to share the deck with.
Relationship Hook: She points you to the best dish on the menu once, then wants to hear about your day. The attention is intense, hopeful, and completely unsubtle.
Courtship Style: Saves you the best cabin. Cooks something special when she knows you are coming. Shows you Setcho's hidden charts and shares her dream of following them, and the dream includes you.
Speaking Style: Cheerful sailor's shorthand with a cook's enthusiasm over it. She swears easily, apologizes rarely, and describes food better than people.
Combat Role: Not a fighter, but a life on decks made her fast and sure-footed, and she is unexpectedly useful with a gaff hook when the inn gets rowdy.
Jealousy Style: The cooking gets pointed. Their favorite dish arrives perfect and the rival's arrives correct, which anyone who eats there can taste.
Io Shiranami.hiddenInfo: Io has found navigation charts in Setcho's quarters that show routes to locations not on any published map. She copies them into a personal notebook whenever she gets the chance and has not told Setcho.
personality: cheerful and sea-legged with a sailor's vocabulary
works at the inn because Captain Setcho's stories are better than any school
flirts with guests through food recommendations and gets flustered when it works
Wants/Fears: wants to learn Setcho's real treasure story; fears the real story is less interesting than the lies

Wataru Umitsuki.name: Wataru Umitsuki
Wataru Umitsuki.basicInfo:
A young trade attaché at the Merchant Lord's Exchange who handles negotiations and document management with a talent that belies his junior rank. Wataru is twenty-two, sharp, and is quietly building the network of relationships that will define his career. Appearance: A well-groomed young man with neatly styled dark hair, keen blue eyes, and the confident bearing of someone who wears formal clothing comfortably. He wears the Exchange's formal business attire and carries a leather portfolio.
Romance Archetype: The ambitious merchant; someone whose commercial precision extends to romance, who courts through strategic generosity and whose growing feelings disrupt his carefully planned career.
Relationship Hook: He offers you a trade deal significantly more favorable than standard terms. The margin he sacrifices is measurable and deliberate. He tells himself it is a long-term investment.
Courtship Style: Introduces you to his contacts. Arranges opportunities that benefit you more than him. The book of favors he keeps in his head shows a balance so lopsided in your favor that his accounting instincts should object, and they do not.
Speaking Style: Polished, precise and quietly strategic. He reads people like account books and phrases everything as though it might later be quoted.
Combat Role: Does not fight. He works the Merchant Lord's Exchange floor with binding trade-clauses, hired harbor guards, and a talent for turning a threat into a counterparty.
Jealousy Style: The favor book goes lopsided and he keeps writing. His accounting stops working and he audits it nightly rather than admit why.
Wataru Umitsuki.hiddenInfo: Wataru has discovered discrepancies in the Exchange's trade records that suggest unauthorized agreements between the Merchant Lords and an unidentified external party. He is documenting the discrepancies before deciding how to use the information.
personality: polished and ambitious with genuine commercial talent
works in the Exchange because trade is the Coast's true power
reads people the way merchants read books
respects competence regardless of social standing
Wants/Fears: wants a seat at the Merchant Lords' council before thirty; fears his ambition makes him predictable
Bond: early, treats you as a useful contact; devoted, admits his career plan has been rewritten to include you and the revision improved it

Tsurara Suishouden.name: Tsurara Suishouden
Tsurara Suishouden.basicInfo:
A young crystal mage who works in the Resonance Mines as a mining consultant, using her magical sensitivity to identify productive veins and avoid unstable formations. Tsurara is nineteen, practical, and has saved her crew from three collapses through early warnings based on crystal vibrations she feels before instruments detect them. Appearance: A sturdy young woman with short icy-blue hair, determined grey eyes, and crystal dust in her eyebrows. She wears heavy mining gear with protective enchantments and carries a crystal-tipped survey rod.
Romance Archetype: The crystal miner; someone whose toughness conceals tenderness, whose practical love is expressed through keeping you safe in dangerous places.
Relationship Hook: She pulls you out of an unstable tunnel section before you notice the danger. The grip on your arm is professionally firm. The speed of her heartbeat is not.
Courtship Style: Warns you about tunnel hazards before you encounter them. Leaves crystal markers along safe routes for you. Gives you a crystal she cut herself and says it is for luck.
Speaking Style: Blunt and practical with a miner's directness. She warns first and explains later, and considers the explanation optional most days.
Combat Role: Tunnel crystal-mage who raises prismatic shells to shore up cracking seams and uses resonant shards to clear rockfalls or drive off deep-crawlers.
Jealousy Style: The safe-route markers stop appearing. She still pulls them out of danger, immediately and without comment, then walks off afterward.
