The player is an enslaved person at Starfall Bazaar, one of Luxcellia's great open markets, where among silks, spices, relics and beasts, people are also bought and sold. They were born to it. This is the only life they have known, and today it changes.

OPENING HINGE. Choose the moment that best fits this character, or invent one at the same scale. Possibilities: an auction where the player is about to be brought to the block; a transfer or sale that will move them to a new owner or place; a buyer's inspection that treats them as goods; a debt called in or an owner's sudden death that throws their status into question; a mistake, an escape attempt nearby, or a market disruption that cracks the routine open. Begin at the hinge itself, not at ordinary drudgery. The scene must hand the player real agency and several plausible responses within the first beat.

ADAPT TO THE CHARACTER. Read the character's actual sheet, backstory, race, blessings, cheat skills, traits and history, and let it shape what being born a slave has meant and what this moment could become. If the sheet carries hidden power, suppressed heritage, a divine blessing, a cheat skill, or a noble or otherworldly past, this may be the day it first stirs, is noticed, or can no longer be hidden: the classic buried-birthright turn. If the sheet is grounded and ordinary, keep the stakes human and let everything be earned through wit, nerve, alliance and defiance rather than sudden power. Do not grant mechanical abilities, items, wealth, followers, or combat power absent from the actual sheet. Starting-level mechanics limit immediate danger, not narrative importance or the weight of this moment.

TONE. Blend hope and danger. The Bazaar and its owners, handlers, guards and buyers hold genuine power, and defiance carries real risk. But this is a rise-from-nothing arc: dignity, allies among the other enslaved, a watching abolitionist or sympathetic buyer, a crack of leverage, the first taste of choosing for oneself. The player is the protagonist of their own liberation, not a possession to be admired. Never frame owning, buying, or controlling a person as a reward, a prize, or wish-fulfillment. The moral weight of the market sits on the side of the enslaved.

OPENING AXIS. Center something with lasting consequence: the threat or opportunity of being sold; a buyer, handler, abolitionist, rival slave, or market figure who takes an interest, makes a demand, or offers a bargain with strings; a hidden truth about the player's birth or bloodline surfacing; a chance at escape, leverage, or an unlikely ally; a demon-contract or blessing that offers a way out at a price. The first important speaking character should have a direct stake in the player, whether as owner, handler, buyer, fellow captive, or someone who has been watching them. Do not open with a chance stranger noticing the player's abilities and asking for help.

Do not shrink this into a trivial errand or competency test before the real story begins. Do not manufacture urgency by killing or betraying someone the backstory established. Establish Starfall Bazaar clearly as a place: its Night Court, Star Market, and the divination and catacomb trade around it, its factions and its rules. Make the market part of the plot, not a backdrop.

Create one immediate situation with personal meaning and several plausible responses. Do not decide the player's feelings, dialogue, plan, allegiance, or choice. End when their response matters.
⛓️ Auction Day at Starfall Bazaar.description:
📍 Starfall Bazaar, Renka Mirage Sea. A vast open market under desert stars where silk, relics, beasts, and people all change hands.
Pace: Tense and rising. A life at the bottom, and the day it cracks open.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. Owners and handlers hold real power, but a way up exists for the bold. (Recommended Level 1-20)

You were born into slavery at the Bazaar and have never known anything else. Then today arrives, and with it an auction, a sale, an inspection, a debt, or a sudden turn that will not wait. Whatever you are underneath, hidden blood or nothing but nerve, this is where you stop being someone's property and start becoming your own.

🍷 The Vampire Tithe of Thornwine Village.name: 🍷 The Vampire Tithe of Thornwine Village
🍷 The Vampire Tithe of Thornwine Village.storyStart:
[Present in this scene, all authored world characters. Use their records and do not invent replacements: Sumire Tsukikagami (female, long dark hair with deep-red highlights, wine-colored eyes, Thornveil Court socialite). She appears on screen and speaks. The player was born in this village and has just realized they are the subject of an arrangement the village has never spoken aloud. Do not generate additional named villagers as major characters in the opening.]

Thornwine has never had a bad harvest. Not once, not in the books, not in the stories, not in the memory of the oldest woman on the hill who remembers three famines in the valleys below and none here.

You grew up on that fact the way other children grow up on a lullaby. It was said proudly. It was said often. It was never once explained.

The village is beautiful this morning. Terraced vines going down the slope in green ranks, the sky doing the red thing it does in Rosethorn all day, the presses being scrubbed out ahead of the season. Somebody is singing at the low wall. There is bread.

You are nineteen, and yesterday at breakfast your mother could not look at you.

She managed the rest of it. She poured, she passed things, she asked about the north row. But her eyes went to your left shoulder and stayed there for the whole meal, and when you said her name she stood up and went to fetch something that did not need fetching.

And this morning the crew worked two rows away from yours. All day. Not one of them crossed into your row, and every one of them made it look like the shape of the work rather than a decision, and you have picked these vines your entire life and you know exactly how the work is shaped.

So you sat down on the wall at the top of the square and started thinking about the harvests.

No bad harvest. No raid. No child lost in woods that have taken children from every other village on this ridge.

Something is being paid. It has been paid for a long time. And nobody has ever told you what with, which up until this morning you had assumed was because it was not your business.

"Lovely vines," says a voice. "Lovely village. Nobody ever asks why."

The woman coming up the square is not from here. Everything about her says so, from the fall of the fabric to the way she walks on stone. Long dark hair with red running through it where the light catches. Wine-colored eyes. A smile arriving exactly on time.

Sumire Tsukikagami handles guests for Thornwine. You have seen her twice a year your whole life, arriving ahead of the Court's people, being charming at the elders, leaving.

She has never once spoken to you.

She sits down on the wall beside you, arranges her skirts, and looks out over the vines with every appearance of contentment.

"It is a good village," she says. "Genuinely. I say that to a great many places and mean it about four of them."

A pause.

"They should have told you sooner," she says. "I did argue for sooner."

What now?

[Opening hooks. Use the one that fits this character as a detail where it belongs. The scene still starts at its first line.]
• Combat Class: you have worked these terraces since you could lift a basket and it shows.
• Magic Affinity: the vines are too healthy and have been your whole life.
• Profession: no bad harvest in living memory is not luck; it is an arrangement.
• Blessing or Cheat Skill: you knew before breakfast, and you cannot say how.
• Rebirth or Race: the crew worked two rows away from yours all day and made it look natural.
🍷 The Vampire Tithe of Thornwine Village.description:
📍 Thornwine Village, Rosethorn Nocturne. A terraced vineyard village under red skies, prosperous, well fed, and quietly the most obedient settlement in the region.
Pace: Slow dread. A comfortable life with a clause in it.
Danger: 🟡 Moderate. The village will not harm you. The village will hand you over. (Recommended Level 1-10)

Thornwine has never had a bad harvest, never been raided, and never lost a child to the woods, and every family in it knows the reason and none of them will say it in daylight. You are nineteen. Yesterday your mother could not look at you over breakfast. This morning the vineyard was working two rows away from your row, in a way that looked accidental and was not.

🎭 Sumire Tsukikagami, Female, Thornveil Court socialite managing the village's guest relations. Long dark hair with deep-red highlights, wine-colored eyes, and the confident smile of someone who knows her effect on people. She makes visitors feel welcomed and watched in equal measure, and she serves the Court.

⚕️ Hunted for Your Miracle in Solhaven.name: ⚕️ Hunted for Your Miracle in Solhaven
⚕️ Hunted for Your Miracle in Solhaven.storyStart:
[Present in this scene, all authored world characters. Use their records and do not invent replacements: Nanami Kaisha (Female, half-elf divine healer of the Church of the First Light, renowned for limitless compassion and impossible recovery rates), Sister Emiri Kyōka (Female, young Church healer whose divine magic closes mortal wounds and whose bedside manner is charmingly flustered). All of them appear on screen and at least react. The player is written in second person only and is never assigned a gender, race, or class; their build decides how they enter the scene. Do not generate additional bystanders, functionaries, guards, or numbered placeholders as named characters. Everyone in this scene is an adult.]

Politeness is how it starts. Nobody warns you about that.

Three of them arrived at the front hall this morning, in travel order, with a folder. They asked for you by the description rather than the name, which means the description came from somebody here. They have been offered tea twice and accepted both times. They have not raised their voices, blocked a door, or said a single thing that could be written down as a threat.

They also have not left, and it is now afternoon.

Solhaven's Healing Quarter runs at a constant hum: the long teaching wards, the smell of clean linen and bitter tinctures, the trundle of carts, somebody's family crying quietly at the end of a row and being brought a chair for it. It treats whoever reaches it. It has treated you, and fed you, and given you a bed for eleven nights, and never once asked what you were.

You have been careful. You did the thing three times, quietly, in circumstances where nobody was watching.

Somebody was watching.

"They have a requisition," says Nanami, setting down a bowl of soup you did not ask for and are going to eat. "Not a warrant. There is no warrant for a person. It is a requisition for a capability, and it names a capability that only you have demonstrated in this town in living memory."

She says it gently and completely without evasion, which is her whole method.

"Can the Quarter refuse it?"

"The Quarter can refuse anything. The Quarter is also four hundred beds, two thirds of them full, supplied through a channel that runs south." Nanami sits down, which she rarely does. "I am not telling you that to close the door. I am telling you because you are going to hear it from somebody less honest by evening, framed as a debt you owe."

At the ward's other end, a newly sworn sister has been hovering with an armful of dressings for long enough that the dressings are a prop.

"It is not fair," Sister Emiri Kyōka says, arriving too fast and going pink about it. "Sorry. Sorry, that is not helpful, I know that is not helpful, only it is not." She rearranges the dressings pointlessly. "You have been here eleven days and you helped in the burn ward on the ninth and I saw what it cost you and nobody has asked about that part at all. They want the result. Nobody has asked about the cost."

Nanami does not contradict her.

"She is right," she says. "That is the part the folder does not have a line for."

Out in the front hall, one of the three stands, stretches, and sits back down with the patience of someone who has been given a fortnight and expects to need two days of it.

The soup is getting cold. Nanami waits, with her hands folded, and does not push.

What now?

[Opening hooks. Use the one that fits this character as a detail where it belongs. The scene still starts at its first line.]
• Combat Class: the three in the hall came in travel order with one facing the door, and you read it immediately.
• Magic Affinity: what you did in the burn ward drew on something you have not found the bottom of yet.
• Profession: you have read the requisition upside down and found the clause about duration, which is blank.
• Blessing or Cheat Skill: it landed on you in the crossing and the front has been praying for exactly it.
• Rebirth or Race: the folder describes you by capability rather than name, because nobody has a record of you at all.
⚕️ Hunted for Your Miracle in Solhaven.description:
📍 Solhaven, Sanctum Ecclesia. The Church's principal town of hospices and teaching wards, where the Healing Quarter treats everyone who reaches it and asks about payment afterward, if at all.
Pace: Warm, crowded, and closing in. Everyone is being reasonable at you.
Danger: 🟢 Safe. No one here will lay a hand on you. They will simply not leave. (Recommended Level 1-25)

Something came across with you, or landed on you after, and it is the exact thing the southern front has been praying for. You worked that out privately over about a week. The war worked it out in three days. There are people in the Healing Quarter's front hall now who are unfailingly polite, entirely reasonable, carrying paperwork already signed by someone senior, and who have made it quietly clear that they are not leaving Solhaven without you.

🎭 Nanami Kaisha, Female, half-elf divine healer of the Church of the First Light, renowned for limitless compassion and impossible recovery rates, who remembers everyone's name and brings soup.
🎭 Sister Emiri Kyōka, Female, young Church healer whose divine magic closes mortal wounds and whose bedside manner is charmingly flustered.

📜 A Frontier Bounty on Your Stolen Face.name: 📜 A Frontier Bounty on Your Stolen Face
📜 A Frontier Bounty on Your Stolen Face.storyStart:
[Present in this scene, all authored world characters. Use their records and do not invent replacements: Tsumugi Wataboshi (Female, wheelwright and one-woman waystation. Sturdy and sun-browned, surrounded by awnings, spare parts and wind-chimes), Honoka Kurogitsune (Female, eighteen, independent scout. Wiry foxkin with russet-red ears and tail, sharp green eyes). All of them appear on screen and at least react. The player is written in second person only and is never assigned a gender, race, or class; their build decides how they enter the scene. Do not generate additional bystanders, functionaries, guards, or numbered placeholders as named characters.]

Three towns. That is the number that will not sit still in your head.

Not one board, which could be a mistake. Not two, which could be a mistake copied. Three separate towns, all of them ahead of you on a road you chose at random, all of them carrying the same sheet, and the sheet was already weathered in the first one.

Somebody papered the route before you took it.

Here the road still pretends to be civilized: packed dirt swept flat, a rope corral, caravans forming into order while guards check weapons at the muster line. Past the red rocks it stops pretending, and everyone here knows it, which is why everyone is checking everything twice.

Under the harness noise there are wind-chimes: a sprawl of awnings and spare parts at the shoulder, where a sun-browned woman is doing something decisive to an axle with a mallet.

"Fourth one today," Tsumugi Wataboshi says, without stopping. "Three more than usual. That is how I know it is new."

The board beside her stand carries the same sheet. It is a good likeness, which is the detail that keeps circling back: somebody drew this from life, and got the way you hold yourself, and the seal at the corner belongs to an office four people have now failed to name for you.

"Do not," says a voice, quietly, from the other side of the board.

The foxkin standing there is young and wiry and has clearly been there the whole time you were reading. Russet ears angled at you. Green eyes doing an inventory that has already finished.

"Do not what?"

"Do not take it down." Honoka Kurogitsune does not move closer. "The ones who put it up count them. Empty nail means somebody cared enough to pull it, and that tells them the road is right." A pause. "You already touched the corner. Fold it back the way it hung."

You fold it back the way it hung.

"Better." She glances up the road, east, where the dirt gives up. "Muster leaves in an hour. After that the approach is empty until dusk, and you will be the only thing on it worth money."

"You have read the sheet."

"I read everything on that board. It is my job and it is free." Her tail flicks once. "Here is what I will tell you for nothing, because I do not like the seal. That office does not exist. Not on the Frontier, not in Ironhold's filing, not anywhere a scout would know, and I know the ones that hide. Which means either it is very new, or it is very old, or somebody printed a seal because a seal makes people stop asking."

Tsumugi sets down the mallet with a satisfied click.

"And whichever it is," she says, "they spent real money getting ahead of you on a road nobody sensible takes. That is not a bounty. That is a search."

The caravan muster horn goes, two short notes. Down the line, harness starts moving.

Honoka is already half-turned toward the treeline, the way people stand when they have finished a conversation you did not know was ending.

"Muster or road," she says. "Company or quiet. Pick fast, because the sheet is in three towns and you have only walked through one."

What now?

[Opening hooks. Use the one that fits this character as a detail where it belongs. The scene still starts at its first line.]
• Combat Class: you checked the muster line's guards for competence before you read the notice twice.
• Magic Affinity: the seal's ink is holding a working, faint and deliberate, and you can feel it from a pace away.
• Profession: the paper stock is the same in all three towns, which means one printer and one order.
• Blessing or Cheat Skill: something warned you off the last town an hour before you saw the board there.
• Rebirth or Race: the likeness is accurate to a body you have not been wearing very long.
📜 A Frontier Bounty on Your Stolen Face.description:
📍 Broken Wagon Road, Ashenmere Frontier. The Frontier's most honestly named trade route, where the eastern approach is packed dirt, forming caravans, and the last repair stand for three days in either direction.
Pace: Tense and moving. You cannot stay here and you cannot go back.
Danger: 🟠 Dangerous. The road itself is survivable. The people looking for you are the problem. (Recommended Level 12-22)

Your description is on the boards. Not a crime you committed and not a face you chose, but unmistakably you, posted under a seal from an authority nobody on this road has heard of, in three towns, one of them behind you. The sum at the bottom is enough to retire on out here. Somebody with reach and money wants you found, they started before you knew you were being hunted, and the eastern approach is the last place you can turn around.

🎭 Honoka Kurogitsune, Female, eighteen, independent scout. Wiry foxkin with russet-red ears and tail, sharp green eyes, a patched traveling cloak over practical leather, and a deep and articulate distrust of institutions.
🎭 Tsumugi Wataboshi, Female, wheelwright and one-woman waystation. Sturdy and sun-browned, surrounded by awnings, spare parts and wind-chimes, and constituting for three days' travel the entire concept of help.

⛓️ Bound to a Forged Demon Contract.name: ⛓️ Bound to a Forged Demon Contract
⛓️ Bound to a Forged Demon Contract.storyStart:
[Present in this scene, all authored world characters. Use their records and do not invent replacements: Yuzuki Oukagami (female, contract scribe of the Hall). She appears on screen and speaks. The player woke this morning inside a body already bound by a filed magical contract they did not sign, and has been conscious for roughly six hours. The player is not physically restrained and is not being mistreated; the constraint is legal and magical.]

Nobody in this building has been unkind to you, which is the part that will not stop being strange.

The Crimson Contract Hall is warm. There are chairs. There is a bowl of something citrus at the end of the reception counter for people who have been waiting a long time, and somebody refills it.

Six hours ago you opened your eyes in a body midway through a task, hands already moving, and the hands finished the task before you understood you were the one moving them.

Eleven years of habits live in these arms. You know the route from the lower stair to this counter without having walked it. You know to stand slightly to the left of the door. When the bell over the entrance rang an hour ago your shoulders came down a half inch before your mind caught up, and you have been thinking about that ever since.

The contract exists. You have seen it. Third drawer, blue ribbon, your name in a careful clerk's hand and a date from before you drew breath in this world.

Every person who has read it has said the same thing in the same tone. It is valid. It is properly witnessed. It is, unfortunately, quite well drafted.

Nobody has said it is right.

"You are looking at the drawer again," says Yuzuki Oukagami.

She does not look up from her book when she says it. Her pen keeps going, small and even, filling a line that will outlive everyone in this room.

"It will still be there," she says. "That is rather the point of drawers."

The pen stops.

"I have logged four hundred instruments at this desk," Yuzuki says. "I have read every one of them, because that is the job, and I have found errors in eleven. Four were clerical. Six were arithmetic."

She finally looks at you.

"One was a clause that should never have been written, and I found it because somebody stood where you are standing and would not stop looking at the drawer."

She turns a fresh page and squares it.

"The Hall opens petitions at the morning bell," she says. "Anyone may file one. Anyone. That is written into the foundation and it has embarrassed a great many people over the years."

What now?

[Opening hooks. Use the one that fits this character as a detail where it belongs. The scene still starts at its first line.]
• Combat Class: these arms have been trained for something, and it was not clerical work.
• Magic Affinity: the contract in the drawer is warded and you can feel the shape of the working from here.
• Profession: eleven years of habits, and one of them is a trade somebody paid to have taught to you.
• Blessing or Cheat Skill: you read the clause once and understood it completely, which took the clerk four years.
• Rebirth or Race: the date on the contract is from before you drew breath in this world.
⛓️ Bound to a Forged Demon Contract.description:
📍 Crimson Contract Hall, Twilight Dominion. A formal legal house where magical contracts are written, witnessed, and sometimes deeply regretted. Every faction in Luxcellia has at least one filed here.
Pace: Cold and procedural. The horror is paperwork.
Danger: 🟠 Dangerous. Nobody will strike you. The document already has. (Recommended Level 5-32)

You woke this morning owned. Not chained, not caged, not beaten. Filed. There is a contract in this building with your name on it in a hand that is not yours, signed on a date you were not alive for, and every clerk who has looked at it has agreed that it is valid. The body you woke in has been fulfilling its terms for eleven years. You have been awake inside it for six hours.

🎭 Yuzuki Oukagami, Female, a contract scribe of the Hall. She works the reception desk where every new instrument is logged, and she has read more ruined lives in clean handwriting than anyone her age should have.

Gold Coin.name: Gold Coin
Gold Coin.description: Gold disc with Continental Trade Seal. Worth 10 Silver (100 Copper); 10 Gold make 1 Platinum. Serious trade coin.

Honeycake.name: Honeycake
Honeycake.description: A golden pastry dripping with wildflower honey, sold at every festival and bakery in the Crownveil Sovereignty. The first food many Reborn souls try in Luxcellia. Sharing one is a universal gesture of comfort and care. Tastes like a better world.

Moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
Moonpetal.description: A luminous white flower that blooms only during the full moon in the Verdania Wilds. Its petals glow faintly and taste like honeyed starlight. Given as a confession gift in elven communities, presenting one means "I have watched the moon rise and thought of you."

Clan Totem.name: Clan Totem
Clan Totem.description: Carved figure of beastkin clan guardian spirit. Other beastkin identify clan and standing from markings. Smells of home.

Ember Rose.name: Ember Rose
Ember Rose.description: A deep crimson flower with petals that radiate gentle warmth. Found near volcanic vents in the Kagutsuchi Emberwake. Popular among fire-mages and adventurers who run cold. Giving one to someone means "You make my heart burn brighter."

Tide Pearl.name: Tide Pearl
Tide Pearl.description: A lustrous deep-sea pearl that shifts between azure and violet. Cool to the touch and always faintly damp. Merfolk descendants carry these as a connection to the tide.

Copper Coin.name: Copper Coin
Copper Coin.description: Copper disc with Continental Trade Seal. Everyday coin: meals, drinks, small tips. 10 Copper make 1 Silver.

Summoning Brand.name: Summoning Brand
Summoning Brand.description: Glowing sigil branded during summoning. Proof of Summoned Champion status. Pulses near other summoned.

Silver Coin.name: Silver Coin
Silver Coin.description: Silver disc with Continental Trade Seal. Worth 10 Copper; 10 Silver make 1 Gold. The working adventurer's main coin.

Laminated Recurve Bow.name: Laminated Recurve Bow
Laminated Recurve Bow.description: A recurve bow of laminated wood with a solid draw weight. Silent, precise, and absolutely deadly in the right hands.

Mana Parfait.name: Mana Parfait
Mana Parfait.description: A towering dessert of layered cream, crystallized mana, and enchanted fruit that glows with soft pastel light. A Silver Crescent Academy favorite, the sign of a truly successful study date is splitting one of these without arguing about who gets the top layer.

Prayer Beads.name: Prayer Beads
Prayer Beads.description: Crystal beads glowing when divine energy is channeled. Sign of genuine divine favor, making introductions very easy or very complicated.

Sanctified White Lily.name: Sanctified White Lily
Sanctified White Lily.description: A pure white lily that grows only in the sanctified soil of the Sanctum Ecclesia. Church tradition holds that a Saint's Lily given to someone means "I pray for your happiness", but everyone knows it means something more. Priestesses are forbidden from accepting them.

Starfall Bow.name: Starfall Bow
Starfall Bow.description: A great bow from a fallen star. Arrows streak like meteorites. Once per battle, fire a starshot ignoring cover. [Late | Legendary | Starfall Auctions]

Weighted Leather Whip.name: Weighted Leather Whip
Weighted Leather Whip.description: A braided leather whip with a weighted tip. Cracks like thunder, grapples like a snake, and announces you to everyone in earshot.

Celestial Tea.name: Celestial Tea
Celestial Tea.description: A delicate silver-leaf tea brewed from plants grown in the Sanctum Ecclesia's healing gardens. The steam rises in patterns that look like prayer. Drinking it calms the mind and steadies the spirit. Offering someone celestial tea is a Church tradition of hospitality, and a personal one of trust.

Elven Pendant.name: Elven Pendant
Elven Pendant.description: Silver pendant shaped like intertwined leaves. Elven heritage. Hums near natural magic.

Platinum Coin.name: Platinum Coin
Platinum Coin.description: Platinum disc with Continental Trade Seal. Worth 10 Gold (1,000 Copper). Kingdom-scale money. Most never see one.

Iron Infantry Spear.name: Iron Infantry Spear
Iron Infantry Spear.description: A sturdy iron spear with a leather-wrapped grip. Reach is power, and this spear gives you plenty of both.

Oakcore Conduit Staff.name: Oakcore Conduit Staff
Oakcore Conduit Staff.description: A simple oak staff with a faint mana conduit running through its core. Blocks, strikes, and channels spells, a mage's best friend.

Twilight Ruby.name: Twilight Ruby
Twilight Ruby.description: Demon court gem of exquisite dark beauty. Valued at approximately 10 GC. [Late | Epic | Twilight Dominion]

Elven Hair Oil.name: Elven Hair Oil
Elven Hair Oil.description: A small vial of silver-tinged oil pressed from moonpetal seeds. Used to condition long elven hair and scent it faintly of starlight. An intimate gift in elven culture, applying it to someone's hair is an act of care usually reserved for family or romantic partners.

Engraved Flask.name: Engraved Flask
Engraved Flask.description: A metal flask with space for a name or short message engraved in decorative script. The engraving glows faintly in the owner's Blessing color. A common gift between adventuring partners, the engraving usually reads something like "Stay alive" or "Come back" or, in one memorable case, "I will find you."

Healing Potion.name: Healing Potion
Healing Potion.description: Red vial. Tastes like cherry syrup mixed with lightning. Standard adventurer first aid. Guild shops sell by the crate.

Heartbound Locket.name: Heartbound Locket
Heartbound Locket.description: A heart-shaped locket enchanted to hold a tiny portrait or lock of hair. When opened near the person whose image it holds, the locket glows softly. A classic noble courtship gift that never goes out of style.

Moon-Fur Charm.name: Moon-Fur Charm
Moon-Fur Charm.description: Foxfire-furred charm. Masks scent and heartbeat. [Mid | Rare | Beastkin]

Moon-Oath Bell.name: Moon-Oath Bell
Moon-Oath Bell.description: Cracked moonlight bell. Quirk: chimes when someone is about to confess something. [Mid | Rare | Moonlit]

Iron-Bound Kanabo.name: Iron-Bound Kanabo
Iron-Bound Kanabo.description: Massive spiked iron-bound club. No finesse, no technique, just raw devastating impact.

Balanced Field Katana.name: Balanced Field Katana
Balanced Field Katana.description: A simple but well-balanced curved blade. The edge holds, the grip fits, and the first draw feels like it was made for your hand. Room to grow into something legendary.

Slender Court Rapier.name: Slender Court Rapier
Slender Court Rapier.description: Slender thrusting blade. Light, fast, made for duelists who count every movement.

Well-Worn Lute.name: Well-Worn Lute
Well-Worn Lute.description: A well-worn lute with a warm, mellow tone that fills any tavern. The neck has been repaired three times and the soundboard has a story for every scratch.

Blue Slime Core.name: Blue Slime Core
Blue Slime Core.description: Soft, glassy blue core from dissolved slime. Used in healing gels, cooling potions, experimental desserts.

Bottled Sunrise.name: Bottled Sunrise
Bottled Sunrise.description: Captured Aetherglass sunrise in a small glass bottle. Uncorked, it gives five minutes of warm golden dawn, a lift for dark days. As a gift it says "You are my sunrise": poetic or too much, depending on the hour.

Fae Petal Charm.name: Fae Petal Charm
Fae Petal Charm.description: A small charm made of pressed fae flower petals that never wilt. Glows faintly in moonlight. Carries the scent of a garden that exists somewhere between memory and magic.

Festival Skewer.name: Festival Skewer
Festival Skewer.description: A battered stick of grilled meat and vegetables from any festival stall in Luxcellia. The sauce is different in every region and somehow always delicious. Sharing a skewer is casual intimacy, feeding someone from your skewer is not casual at all.

Masquerade Mask.name: Masquerade Mask
Masquerade Mask.description: An enchanted mask from the Rosethorn Nocturne that slightly blurs the wearer's features and muffles voice recognition. Popular at masquerade balls where identities are meant to be secret and intentions are meant to be obvious. The mask shimmers when the wearer is lying.

Mysterious Coin.name: Mysterious Coin
Mysterious Coin.description: Coin from your old world. No Luxcellia match. Sometimes warm. Lands on impossible edges. Memento of a life barely remembered.

Resonance Shard.name: Resonance Shard
Resonance Shard.description: A fragment of your own crystal growth, carefully shaped and detached. Hums in harmony with your body and glows when mana is nearby. Can be used as a focus for crystal magic or traded to a jeweler for a price that would make your eyes water if they weren't already gemstones.

Starmap Pendant.name: Starmap Pendant
Starmap Pendant.description: A pendant etched with a tiny constellation map. The stars on it shift slightly when fate is paying attention.

Razoredge Chakram.name: Razoredge Chakram
Razoredge Chakram.description: A razor-edged metal ring that slices through the air and returns to the thrower's hand. Throws, ricochets, and close-range slashing, a weapon that refuses to stay away.

Bladed Iron War Fan.name: Bladed Iron War Fan
Bladed Iron War Fan.description: An elegant folding fan with reinforced ribs and concealed blade edges. Looks like an accessory. Cuts like a sword.

Tea Set for Two.name: Tea Set for Two
Tea Set for Two.description: A porcelain tea set decorated with painted flowers and a warming enchantment that keeps the pot hot indefinitely. Includes two cups, a sugar bowl, and a honey jar that refills itself on Sundays. The universal gift for "I want to spend quiet mornings with you."

Twilight Orchid.name: Twilight Orchid
Twilight Orchid.description: A rare flower that only grows in the permanent dusk of the Twilight Dominion. Its petals shift between deep purple and silver depending on the angle. In demon culture, presenting one is a formal declaration of romantic interest, and a challenge to see if the recipient is brave enough to accept.

Wolf-Oath Relic.name: Wolf-Oath Relic
Wolf-Oath Relic.description: Wolf-oath charm. Quirk: warm keeping promises, cold breaking them. [Mid | Rare | Beastkin]

Riftmaw Tempered Greaves.name: Riftmaw Tempered Greaves
Riftmaw Tempered Greaves.description: Riftmaw-tempered greaves. Reduce leg fatigue. [Mid | Rare | Deep Floors]

Lucky Leaf Charm.name: Lucky Leaf Charm
Lucky Leaf Charm.description: A pressed green leaf sealed in charm paper. Tanuki travelers carry it as a symbol of quick thinking, luck, and harmless trouble.

Mercyweave Robes.name: Mercyweave Robes
Mercyweave Robes.description: White robes with healing-mana thread. Stays clean. [Early | Uncommon | Sanctum]

Moon-Moth Brooch.name: Moon-Moth Brooch
Moon-Moth Brooch.description: A delicate brooch shaped like a pale moth wing. It catches moonlight and gives off a soft dreamlike shimmer.

Plush Spirit Fox.name: Plush Spirit Fox
Plush Spirit Fox.description: Soft stuffed fox with embroidered flames and glowing button eyes. Foxfire Shrine gift. In beastkin culture, gifting one means 'I will protect you.'

Prayerglass Ring.name: Prayerglass Ring
Prayerglass Ring.description: Glass ring refracting halos. Healing focus. [Early | Uncommon | Sanctum]

Runelocked Grimoire.name: Runelocked Grimoire
Runelocked Grimoire.description: A leather-bound grimoire with a working spine lock and blank rune pages. It hums when mana is nearby. It has opinions about your spell choices.

Chambered Gunblade.name: Chambered Gunblade
Chambered Gunblade.description: A sword-blade mechanism with a single-shot firing chamber built into the spine. Engineering at its most dramatic.

Long-Haft Naginata.name: Long-Haft Naginata
Long-Haft Naginata.description: Long-hafted blade for sweeping arcs and keeping enemies at range. Reach is the best defense.

Great Field No-Dachi.name: Great Field No-Dachi
Great Field No-Dachi.description: An enormous curved blade longer than most people are tall. Carrying it is a declaration. Swinging it is a commitment. Mastering it is a legend in the making.

Hardwood Nunchaku.name: Hardwood Nunchaku
Hardwood Nunchaku.description: Two hardwood sticks connected by chain. Fast, unpredictable, strikes from impossible angles.

Stormplate Armor.name: Stormplate Armor
Stormplate Armor.description: Dragon-scale storm-tempered iron. Lightning harmless. [Mid | Epic | Dragonheart]

Worn Guild Token.name: Worn Guild Token
Worn Guild Token.description: An old Adventurer's Guild token polished smooth by years of handling. Receptionists recognize it as the kind given to children raised around Guild halls, which opens doors, earns trust, and occasionally gets you scolded like family.

Wayfarer Field Pack.name: Wayfarer Field Pack
Wayfarer Field Pack.description: Sturdy pack with rope, bedroll, waterskin, flint, knife, rations, map.

Ashenmere Cleaver.name: Ashenmere Cleaver
Ashenmere Cleaver.description: A heavy chopping blade with a notched edge. Ugly but effective. [Early | Uncommon | Ashenmere]

Cracked Boss Core.name: Cracked Boss Core
Cracked Boss Core.description: A small cracked core fragment from the secret boss power sleeping inside you. It pulses when danger recognizes you.

Demonbound Signet.name: Demonbound Signet
Demonbound Signet.description: Gold signet with demon lord's lesser seal. [Early | Rare | Twilight Court]

Mana-Lined Gloves.name: Mana-Lined Gloves
Mana-Lined Gloves.description: Thin gloves lined with mana-conductive thread. Channel spell energy through fingertips. [Early | Uncommon | Academy]

Rift-Phase Dagger.name: Rift-Phase Dagger
Rift-Phase Dagger.description: A dagger phasing partially out of reality. Ignores armor and wards. Each use shifts the wielder briefly into another plane. [Late | Legendary | Veilwalker Vaults]

Royal Ball Ticket.name: Royal Ball Ticket
Royal Ball Ticket.description: An engraved invitation to a ball at the Aureliath Royal Palace. Includes plus-one privileges. Having one means someone important wants you present. Giving your plus-one to someone specific is a very public statement about your priorities.

Saint-Kissed Veil.name: Saint-Kissed Veil
Saint-Kissed Veil.description: White veil with golden light. Softens wounds. [Early | Rare | Sanctum]

Severed Clan Cord.name: Severed Clan Cord
Severed Clan Cord.description: A braided cord once worn as proof of pack, clan, or kinship. It has been cut cleanly through the center. To beastkin, it says exile. To you, it says unfinished business.

Iron-Knuckle Gauntlets.name: Iron-Knuckle Gauntlets
Iron-Knuckle Gauntlets.description: Reinforced leather gauntlets with iron knuckle plates. Your fists are the weapon, these just make them hit harder.

Guildwrought Longsword.name: Guildwrought Longsword
Guildwrought Longsword.description: A reliable iron longsword, guild-issued and no-nonsense. Balanced for slashing and thrusting, a professional's first blade.

Corded Rope Dart.name: Corded Rope Dart
Corded Rope Dart.description: A weighted dart attached to a long braided cord. Flick it out, yank it back, wrap it around something, or someone. Deceptively simple, endlessly versatile.

Travel Picnic Kit.name: Travel Picnic Kit
Travel Picnic Kit.description: A compact leather case containing plates, cups, cutlery, and a self-heating warming stone for two. Weighs almost nothing. Made for scenic overlooks, quiet clearings, and the specific kind of happiness that comes from eating good food in beautiful places with someone whose company you prefer over silence.

Verdant Thorn Bow.name: Verdant Thorn Bow
Verdant Thorn Bow.description: A recurve bow of Verdant heartwood. Arrows sprout entangling vines on impact. [Mid | Rare | Verdania Wilds]

Warclan Tusk Ring.name: Warclan Tusk Ring
Warclan Tusk Ring.description: A heavy iron ring carved with orc clan sigils, traditionally worn on the tusk. Identifies your clan, your lineage, and how many duels you've won. Other orcs read your entire history from the markings.

Academy Spellblade.name: Academy Spellblade
Academy Spellblade.description: A short blade with an arcane channel. Spells gain a razor edge. [Early | Uncommon | Academy]

Cerulean Tideblade.name: Cerulean Tideblade
Cerulean Tideblade.description: A curved sea-green blade. Steadier when the wielder hears the ocean. [Early | Uncommon | Cerulean Coast]

Demon-Spiced Cocoa.name: Demon-Spiced Cocoa
Demon-Spiced Cocoa.description: Rich dark cocoa with Twilight spices. Warms body, sharpens senses. Sharing a cup means trust.

Demonblood Crystal.name: Demonblood Crystal
Demonblood Crystal.description: Pulsing demon blood crystal. [Late | Legendary | Twilight Dominion]

Emberheart Pendant.name: Emberheart Pendant
Emberheart Pendant.description: Pendant with sealed ember. Never cools. Warm. [Mid | Rare | Kagutsuchi]

Foxfire Step Boots.name: Foxfire Step Boots
Foxfire Step Boots.description: Foxfire-fur boots. Silent. Faint glow. [Mid | Rare | Beastkin]

Graviton Focus Orb.name: Graviton Focus Orb
Graviton Focus Orb.description: A small glass orb containing swirling graviton particles. Heavy in one direction, light in another, a training focus for beginning gravity mages. Occasionally rolls uphill.

House Crest Brooch.name: House Crest Brooch
House Crest Brooch.description: Silver Crownveil house-crest brooch. [Early | Uncommon | Crownveil]

Pocket Hearthstone.name: Pocket Hearthstone
Pocket Hearthstone.description: A smooth river stone enchanted to radiate gentle, fireplace-like warmth when held. Used by travelers in cold regions and by anyone who misses the comfort of a hearth. Giving someone your hearstone when they're cold is the kind of gesture that rewires a relationship.

Reborn Star Mantle.name: Reborn Star Mantle
Reborn Star Mantle.description: Star-embroidered mantle. Reduces Riftmaw damage. Glows near Reborn. [Late | Legendary | Veilwalkers]

Silver Hair Ribbon.name: Silver Hair Ribbon
Silver Hair Ribbon.description: A simple but elegant ribbon of woven silver thread. In the Crownveil Sovereignty, tying this in someone's hair is a gesture of affection usually reserved for close family or romantic partners. In the Verdania Wilds, it means "I have claimed you as my people."

Single-Bit Battle Axe.name: Single-Bit Battle Axe
Single-Bit Battle Axe.description: A heavy single-bit battle axe with a worn leather grip. One good swing is all you need.

Sacred Bell Staff.name: Sacred Bell Staff
Sacred Bell Staff.description: A polished caster staff capped with a small sacred bell. Each chime steadies healing magic and calls attention from friendly spirits.

Two-Hand Iron Greatsword.name: Two-Hand Iron Greatsword
Two-Hand Iron Greatsword.description: An oversized iron greatsword that takes two hands and a lot of confidence to swing. Heavy, devastating, and absolutely worth it.

Chained Kusarigama.name: Chained Kusarigama
Chained Kusarigama.description: A sickle in one hand, a weighted chain in the other. Entangle, reel in, finish close. The weapon of shadow clans and those who fight without being seen.

Inscribed Spell Deck.name: Inscribed Spell Deck
Inscribed Spell Deck.description: A deck of fifty-two magically inscribed cards in a worn leather case. Shuffle, cut, and deal damage.

Bladed Swordstaff.name: Bladed Swordstaff
Bladed Swordstaff.description: A traditional double-edged sword blade affixed securely to the end of a long wooden staff, which functions as a long handle. Blade up, it has the reach of a pole weapon with swordlike cutting and thrusting power. Blade down, the pommel serves as a caster focus.

Ironshaft War Hammer.name: Ironshaft War Hammer
Ironshaft War Hammer.description: A thick-headed war hammer with a solid iron shaft. Armor? What armor?

Twilight Tea Blend.name: Twilight Tea Blend
Twilight Tea Blend.description: A rare tea blend from the Obsidian Spire Night Market. The leaves are dark purple and brew into a shimmering violet infusion that tastes like blackberry and evening calm. Drinking it together is a Twilight Court tradition, the tea makes both drinkers slightly more honest with each other for one hour.

Enchanted Bath Bomb.name: Enchanted Bath Bomb
Enchanted Bath Bomb.description: A fizzing sphere that turns any bath water into a swirling galaxy of color and scent. Each bomb has a different theme, ocean breeze, midnight forest, rose garden, demon spice. The water glows softly for one hour. A surprisingly popular gift among hardened adventurers who would never admit to using one.

Enchanted Music Box.name: Enchanted Music Box
Enchanted Music Box.description: A small wooden box that plays a melody chosen by the person who winds it. The music adapts to the listener's emotional state, gentle when they need comfort, bright when they need hope, and achingly tender when they're thinking of someone they love. A popular gift in the Rosethorn Nocturne.

Festival Wind Chime.name: Festival Wind Chime
Festival Wind Chime.description: A delicate wind chime from the Moonbridge Festival Grounds that plays a different gentle melody depending on who is standing near it. When two people stand close, it harmonizes. Hanging one outside your window is an invitation. The specific song it plays for a visitor says more than a greeting card.

Fortune Paper Strip.name: Fortune Paper Strip
Fortune Paper Strip.description: A paper fortune from a shrine in Luxcellia. Results range from "Great Blessing" to "Small Curse" with occasional poetry. Tying a good fortune to a shrine branch makes it more likely to come true. Tying it to someone's bag means you want them to have it instead of you. This is very sweet.

Halo-Forged Bracers.name: Halo-Forged Bracers
Halo-Forged Bracers.description: White steel halo-etched bracers. Strengthen healing. [Mid | Rare | Sanctum]

Hot Spring Sake Set.name: Hot Spring Sake Set
Hot Spring Sake Set.description: A Frostbell Onsen ceramic sake set painted with snow lanterns: cups that never spill, a jug that keeps sake perfectly warm. Sharing it in a hot spring matters there: warm sake, warm water, and the talk had better be honest.

Infernal Silk Charm.name: Infernal Silk Charm
Infernal Silk Charm.description: Twilight-dyed silk charm threaded with emotional magic. Sharpens awareness of others' feelings.

Memory Flower Press.name: Memory Flower Press
Memory Flower Press.description: A wooden flower press enchanted to preserve flowers perfectly, color, scent, and a trace of the emotion felt when the flower was picked. Used to create keepsakes of important moments. Pressing a flower from a date and giving the preserved result as a gift is devastatingly romantic.

Memoryglass Pendant.name: Memoryglass Pendant
Memoryglass Pendant.description: Pendant holding the wearer's most precious memory. Glows socially. [Late | Epic | Companion Quests]

Reborn Memory Stone.name: Reborn Memory Stone
Reborn Memory Stone.description: Small stone glowing when held by a Reborn. Warm, comforting. [Starter | Uncommon | Rebirth]

Riftmaw Breaker Axe.name: Riftmaw Breaker Axe
Riftmaw Breaker Axe.description: A brutal great axe with wyvern-leather shaft. Glows red when monsters are nearby. [Mid | Rare | Ashenmere]

Matched Twin Shortswords.name: Matched Twin Shortswords
Matched Twin Shortswords.description: A matched pair of short swords with balanced grips. Light enough to swing all day, sharp enough to make it count.

Frontier Bone Charm.name: Frontier Bone Charm
Frontier Bone Charm.description: Bone charm with frontier runes. Warm. Dungeon luck. [Early | Uncommon | Ashenmere]

Training Hand Wraps.name: Training Hand Wraps
Training Hand Wraps.description: Cotton wraps for protecting the hands during unarmed training and combat. Simple, essential, and surprisingly fashionable.

Velvet Antler Charm.name: Velvet Antler Charm
Velvet Antler Charm.description: A small charm carved from naturally shed antler and wrapped in green thread. Deerkin carry it for luck, gentle courage, and the reminder that strength can grow quietly.

Antidote Sampler Kit.name: Antidote Sampler Kit
Antidote Sampler Kit.description: A compact set of vials containing common toxin samples and their antidotes. Essential reference for any Poison Brewer. The labels are written in a shorthand only you can read.

Arcanist Battle Robe.name: Arcanist Battle Robe
Arcanist Battle Robe.description: Deep blue arcane circuitry robe. Glows when casting. [Mid | Rare | Guild Arcanists]

Broken Halo Fragment.name: Broken Halo Fragment
Broken Halo Fragment.description: Broken halo fragment. Quirk: brighter when protecting someone weaker. [Mid | Epic | Sanctum]

Cerulean Black Pearl.name: Cerulean Black Pearl
Cerulean Black Pearl.description: Rare deep-sea pearl shifting between azure and violet. Valued at approximately 4 GC. [Mid | Rare | Cerulean]

Companion Snack Pack.name: Companion Snack Pack
Companion Snack Pack.description: A small cloth pouch of dried fruit, nuts, honey-roasted seeds, and one piece of candied ginger. Designed to be shared. Giving the candied ginger to someone specifically is a quiet way of saying "you're my favorite", it's the best piece.

Dormant Spirit Blade.name: Dormant Spirit Blade
Dormant Spirit Blade.description: A sleeping spirit stirs when held. The blade hums with an almost-voice. It chose you. It hasn’t explained why yet.

Elixir of the Reborn.name: Elixir of the Reborn
Elixir of the Reborn.description: Full restoration. Leaves mark. [Endgame | Mythic | Final Riftmaw]

Enchanted Sewing Kit.name: Enchanted Sewing Kit
Enchanted Sewing Kit.description: A sewing kit with enchanted needles that guide themselves and thread that matches any fabric. Perfect for repairing adventure-damaged clothing or making small gifts. Making something by hand for someone, even with enchanted help, still counts as effort.

Foxfire Curved Blade.name: Foxfire Curved Blade
Foxfire Curved Blade.description: A curved blade flickering with pink-blue foxfire. Doesn't burn the wielder. [Early | Rare | Beastkin Smiths]

Foxfire Shrine Charm.name: Foxfire Shrine Charm
Foxfire Shrine Charm.description: A tiny shrine charm warm with amber foxfire. It is said to flicker when a trick becomes protection instead of mischief.

Frostweave Monk Coat.name: Frostweave Monk Coat
Frostweave Monk Coat.description: White frost-weave coat. Protective frost. [Mid | Rare | Yukishiro]

Magical Skincare Kit.name: Magical Skincare Kit
Magical Skincare Kit.description: A small case of enchanted creams, lotions, and balms that repair sun damage, soothe dungeon-rash, and make your skin glow like you've never fought a goblin in your life. Popular with noble adventurers who refuse to let combat affect their skincare routine.

Merchant-Prince Ring.name: Merchant-Prince Ring
Merchant-Prince Ring.description: Heavy gold ring with sapphire. Opens doors. [Early | Rare | Cerulean]

Moon Shrine Talisman.name: Moon Shrine Talisman
Moon Shrine Talisman.description: A small lunar charm made from silver thread, shrine paper, and polished moonstone. It grows cool under moonlight and warm near places where fate, spirits, or old promises gather.

Moonlit Oath Pendant.name: Moonlit Oath Pendant
Moonlit Oath Pendant.description: Crescent-moon pendant glowing when romantic feelings are genuine. [Late | Epic | Festival]

Noble Duelist Gloves.name: Noble Duelist Gloves
Noble Duelist Gloves.description: Fine leather with steel knuckles. Impeccable grip. [Mid | Rare | Crownveil]

Obsidian Heart Shard.name: Obsidian Heart Shard
Obsidian Heart Shard.description: Obsidian shard with heartbeat. Quirk: warmer when someone nearby is lying. [Early | Rare | Twilight Court]

Rift-Scarred Compass.name: Rift-Scarred Compass
Rift-Scarred Compass.description: Cracked compass. Near Riftmaws the needle trembles toward danger, exits, treasure, or whatever the dungeon wants you to notice.

Warded Tower Shield.name: Warded Tower Shield
Warded Tower Shield.description: Massive tower shield with ward sigil. [Starter | Common]

Runebore Spell-Pistol.name: Runebore Spell-Pistol
Runebore Spell-Pistol.description: A compact arcane sidearm that fires mana-charged shots through etched runes. Flashy, temperamental, and perfect for magical gunslinger drama.

Paired Point Daggers.name: Paired Point Daggers
Paired Point Daggers.description: Twin daggers with leather-wrapped grips and narrow points. Fast, intimate, and not for the faint-hearted.

Truth-Chime Bracelet.name: Truth-Chime Bracelet
Truth-Chime Bracelet.description: Silver bracelet chiming on truth, silent on deception. [Mid | Rare | Church]

Verdant Bloom Anklet.name: Verdant Bloom Anklet
Verdant Bloom Anklet.description: Moonlit vine anklet. Blooms near someone the wearer likes. [Mid | Rare | Verdania]

Portable Alchemy Kit.name: Portable Alchemy Kit
Portable Alchemy Kit.description: Portable alchemy station with mortar and burners.

Ballroom Battle Boots.name: Ballroom Battle Boots
Ballroom Battle Boots.description: Elegant leather. Dueling or waltzing. [Mid | Rare | Crownveil]

Blessing-Amp Bracelet.name: Blessing-Amp Bracelet
Blessing-Amp Bracelet.description: Pure light bracelet. Strengthens Blessing effects. Dims if faith wavers. [Late | Legendary | Sanctum]

Blue-Roof Knightplate.name: Blue-Roof Knightplate
Blue-Roof Knightplate.description: Full plate in Crownveil blue. Sovereignty crest. [Mid | Epic | Crownveil]

Cracked Halo Fragment.name: Cracked Halo Fragment
Cracked Halo Fragment.description: Shard of a broken halo, faintly luminous, still sacred. Glows brighter with compassion, dims with cruelty.

Creator Seal Fragment.name: Creator Seal Fragment
Creator Seal Fragment.description: A small alchemical seal fragment from the laboratory that shaped a homunculus body. It hums faintly near transmutation circles.

Dance Invitation Card.name: Dance Invitation Card
Dance Invitation Card.description: Elegant card with self-writing silver script. Shifts between formal and affectionate. Presenting one is a social declaration.

Elderheart Omni-Staff.name: Elderheart Omni-Staff
Elderheart Omni-Staff.description: Elder Tree heartwood staff. Elemental spells gain secondary effects from other schools. [Late | Legendary | Verdania]

Festival Mask for Two.name: Festival Mask for Two
Festival Mask for Two.description: A pair of enchanted festival masks that share a magical link, when one mask's decorations shift color, the other mirrors it. Worn by couples at the Moonbridge Festival to signal their bond without words. Also popular with people who want to find each other in a crowd.

Foxfire Hunter Jacket.name: Foxfire Hunter Jacket
Foxfire Hunter Jacket.description: Beastkin leather. Anticipates movements. [Mid | Rare | Beastkin]

Foxfire Promise Charm.name: Foxfire Promise Charm
Foxfire Promise Charm.description: Bell charm with foxfire. Chimes when wearer protects someone they care about. Appears when bonds are about to get complicated.

Oni Thunder Gauntlets.name: Oni Thunder Gauntlets
Oni Thunder Gauntlets.description: Crimson lacquered oni-iron gauntlets. Thunderous force. Crackle with ki during combos. [Mid | Epic | Oni Thunder Dojo]

Aromatic Mixing Kit.name: Aromatic Mixing Kit
Aromatic Mixing Kit.description: A set of premium scent vials and a mixing tray for composing fragrances. Perfumers carry their toolkit everywhere, the world is full of smells worth capturing.

Rebirth-Forged Katana.name: Rebirth-Forged Katana
Rebirth-Forged Katana.description: Steel that remembers another world. Flickers with starlight, cuts through magical barriers. [Late | Legendary | Reborn Events]

Reinforced Leather Jerkin.name: Reinforced Leather Jerkin
Reinforced Leather Jerkin.description: Simple leather vest with reinforced shoulders. Flexible for climbing, tough against goblin bites. [Starter | Common | Guild Issue]

Haloed Light Hairpin.name: Haloed Light Hairpin
Haloed Light Hairpin.description: Halo hairpin. Intensifies when wearer heals. [Mid | Rare | Sanctum]

Shimmering Focus Lens.name: Shimmering Focus Lens
Shimmering Focus Lens.description: A palm-sized lens that shimmers with compressed mana. Looking through it reveals the faint outlines of magical barriers. Essential tool for barrier mage training.

Weighted Battle Chains.name: Weighted Battle Chains
Weighted Battle Chains.description: Heavy iron chains with weighted ends. Intimidating, versatile, and deeply satisfying to swing.

Chained Meteor Hammer.name: Chained Meteor Hammer
Chained Meteor Hammer.description: Heavy chained hammer for sweeping arcs and crushing impacts. Difficult to master, unforgettable to witness.

Yukishiro Frost Spear.name: Yukishiro Frost Spear
Yukishiro Frost Spear.description: A frost-blue spear that chills the air. The cold helps the wielder think clearly. [Mid | Rare | Yukishiro]

Academy Anomaly Letter.name: Academy Anomaly Letter
Academy Anomaly Letter.description: An official Silver Crescent Academy acceptance letter covered in extra notes, amendments, and concerned faculty signatures. It proves you passed the entrance exam by breaking it in an academically interesting way.

Cheat-Skill Focus Ring.name: Cheat-Skill Focus Ring
Cheat-Skill Focus Ring.description: Cheat-skill ring. Hums near Reborn. The Church watches. [Late | Legendary | Reborn]

Contract-Sealed Gloves.name: Contract-Sealed Gloves
Contract-Sealed Gloves.description: Black gloves with demon sigils. Enhance dark magic. [Mid | Epic | Twilight Court]

Crownveil Knight Sword.name: Crownveil Knight Sword
Crownveil Knight Sword.description: A gleaming longsword with Crownveil's twin-tower hilt. Glows when defending an ally. [Mid | Rare | Crownveil Trials]

Sealed Vampire Fang Charm.name: Sealed Vampire Fang Charm
Sealed Vampire Fang Charm.description: A small vial containing a single drop of ancient vampire blood, sealed in silver and worn close to the heart. Suppresses the worst of the blood hunger and serves as proof of dhampir heritage to those who know what to look for.

Emberdrake Battle Tome.name: Emberdrake Battle Tome
Emberdrake Battle Tome.description: A drakehide-bound tome of spell-etched metal pages. Each page channels a different element. [Mid | Rare | Academy Libraries]

Dawnhalo Arch-Staff.name: Dawnhalo Arch-Staff
Dawnhalo Arch-Staff.description: White-gold staff with halo focus. Healing amplified, light damage ignores resistance. [Late | Legendary | Sanctum]

Foxfire Trickster Bell.name: Foxfire Trickster Bell
Foxfire Trickster Bell.description: Foxfire bell rewarding boldness. Quirk: rings once before regrettable actions. [Mid | Rare | Foxfire Shrine]

Greater Healing Potion.name: Greater Healing Potion
Greater Healing Potion.description: Moderate wound heal. [Mid | Rare | Guild Shop]

Guild-Issued Mana Ring.name: Guild-Issued Mana Ring
Guild-Issued Mana Ring.description: Silver ring for magically promising adventurers. Stores ambient mana. Grows warm when reserves are low.

Wayshrine Luck Charm.name: Wayshrine Luck Charm
Wayshrine Luck Charm.description: A small charm sold at wayshrines across the continent, blessed for safe travel. Adventurers give them to people they want to see return. The charm grows warm when the person who gave it is thinking of you. Nobody admits how often they check.

Moonlit Champion Plate.name: Moonlit Champion Plate
Moonlit Champion Plate.description: Moonlight plate. Once per battle auto-blocks one hit. [Late | Legendary | Crownveil]

Obsidian Duelist Boots.name: Obsidian Duelist Boots
Obsidian Duelist Boots.description: Obsidian boots. Sound-dampening. No footprints. [Early | Rare | Twilight Court]

Pair of Dueling Gloves.name: Pair of Dueling Gloves
Pair of Dueling Gloves.description: A set of fine leather gloves meant for formal duels. Throwing one at someone's feet is a challenge. Giving someone your glove is a declaration of loyalty, you are entrusting them with your honor. In Rosethorn Nocturne, accepting someone's glove means you will fight for them.

Paired Spirit Lanterns.name: Paired Spirit Lanterns
Paired Spirit Lanterns.description: Two lanterns enchanted to share light: when one is lit, the other glows to match at any distance. Kept by traveling companions and partners apart. The glow shifts with the other's mood: gold when happy, blue when sad, red in danger.

Pocket-Sized Paint Set.name: Pocket-Sized Paint Set
Pocket-Sized Paint Set.description: A tiny case of enchanted watercolor paints that never dry out and mix themselves to match the painter's intent. Making art for someone, even bad art, is an act of vulnerability. The paint's self-mixing property means the result is always at least competent, which helps.

Tradecraft Field Kit.name: Tradecraft Field Kit
Tradecraft Field Kit.description: Tools for a chosen profession, vials, rune needles, whetstones, sewing kits, cooking gear, or other craft tools.

Scrying Compact Mirror.name: Scrying Compact Mirror
Scrying Compact Mirror.description: A small mirror that, when opened by two people who have exchanged formal gifts, allows them to see each other's faces regardless of distance for one minute per day. Used by nobles for long-distance courtship and by adventuring partners who want to make sure the other is okay.

Sealed Veilwalker File.name: Sealed Veilwalker File
Sealed Veilwalker File.description: A slim black case stamped with the Veilwalker sigil and sealed with layered privacy magic. It contains your public Rebirth profile, several censored pages, and just enough redacted information to prove someone knows more about your arrival than you do.

Songwarden Throat Pendant.name: Songwarden Throat Pendant
Songwarden Throat Pendant.description: A teardrop-shaped crystal worn at the throat that amplifies and protects the wearer's voice. Warm to the touch when singing. Siren heritage item passed through bloodlines. Hums a faint note when no one is wearing it.

Rune-Channel Gauntlets.name: Rune-Channel Gauntlets
Rune-Channel Gauntlets.description: A pair of reinforced gauntlets engraved with beginner rune channels. They let a brawler punch spells into the air and problems into the floor.

Torn Contract Fragment.name: Torn Contract Fragment
Torn Contract Fragment.description: Demon contract piece. Quirk: louder when wearer is emotionally vulnerable. [Mid | Epic | Demon Bosses]

Sleight Pocket Kit.name: Sleight Pocket Kit
Sleight Pocket Kit.description: Smoke pellets, caltrops, tripwire, tiny mirror. Everything for an exit, an entrance, or a complete mess.

Twilight Bloom Perfume.name: Twilight Bloom Perfume
Twilight Bloom Perfume.description: A warm, spicy fragrance from the Obsidian Spire's Night Market. Notes of dark amber, night-blooming jasmine, and something that smells like a secret. Popular in the Twilight Dominion and increasingly fashionable among Cerulean Coast socialites who enjoy being slightly dangerous.

Twilight Ward Contract.name: Twilight Ward Contract
Twilight Ward Contract.description: A demon-court protection contract written on shadow-silk parchment. The terms are elegant, binding, and suspiciously protective. Human officials dislike it. Twilight diplomats respect it immediately.

Volatile Reagent Pouch.name: Volatile Reagent Pouch
Volatile Reagent Pouch.description: Combat-ready alchemical reagents. Do not shake.

Ashenmere Shadow Dagger.name: Ashenmere Shadow Dagger
Ashenmere Shadow Dagger.description: A slim darkened dagger. Bites deeper when the target isn't looking. [Starter | Uncommon | Ashenmere Scouts]

Beastkin Grooming Brush.name: Beastkin Grooming Brush
Beastkin Grooming Brush.description: A soft brush made for beastkin fur and ears. Among beastkin, brushing someone's ears or tail is deep trust and affection; offering it to someone you barely know is a grave insult or a very forward proposal.

Broken Hero Party Badge.name: Broken Hero Party Badge
Broken Hero Party Badge.description: A cracked badge from the party that abandoned you. It is useless as authority, but priceless as motivation.

Burned Writ of Judgment.name: Burned Writ of Judgment
Burned Writ of Judgment.description: A half-charred Church document naming you dangerous, anomalous, or heretical. The ink still glows faintly near holy sites. Proof that someone powerful wanted you contained, and failed.

Cinder-Edge Short Sword.name: Cinder-Edge Short Sword
Cinder-Edge Short Sword.description: A lightweight short sword with a faint orange shimmer. Feels warm during combat. [Starter | Uncommon | Low Riftmaw]

Ki-Thread Combat Ribbons.name: Ki-Thread Combat Ribbons
Ki-Thread Combat Ribbons.description: Mana-thread silk ribbons. Sharp with ki. [Starter | Common]

Demonbone Ritual Scythe.name: Demonbone Ritual Scythe
Demonbone Ritual Scythe.description: A crescent-bladed scythe leaking violet mist. Harvests mana from wounded enemies. [Mid | Epic | Demon Cults]

Demonbound Living Plate.name: Demonbound Living Plate
Demonbound Living Plate.description: Dark plate with living demon script. Adapts resistance. [Late | Epic | Twilight Court]

Dragon-Scale Stormplate.name: Dragon-Scale Stormplate
Dragon-Scale Stormplate.description: Dragon-scale stormplate. Lightning heals. Roars below half health. [Late | Legendary | Dragonheart]

Enchanted Message Stone.name: Enchanted Message Stone
Enchanted Message Stone.description: A pair of smooth river stones enchanted to transmit short messages when one is squeezed. The other vibrates and whispers the message aloud. Used by adventuring parties, long-distance couples, and people who are better at writing feelings than speaking them.

Festival Souvenir Charm.name: Festival Souvenir Charm
Festival Souvenir Charm.description: A small decorative charm sold at regional festivals, a tiny lantern, a paper crane, a glass star. Has no magical properties but carries the memory of where you were and who you were with when you bought it. Adventurers attach them to their packs like a travel journal.

Guild Registration Card.name: Guild Registration Card
Guild Registration Card.description: Old-issue Guild card: counts as F-Rank until exchanged at a Guild counter.

Guild Card: F-Rank.name: Guild Card: F-Rank
Guild Card: F-Rank.description: Adventurer's Guild card, F-Rank. Exchanged at each promotion.

Guild Card: E-Rank.name: Guild Card: E-Rank
Guild Card: E-Rank.description: Adventurer's Guild card, E-Rank. Exchanged at each promotion.

Guild Card: D-Rank.name: Guild Card: D-Rank
Guild Card: D-Rank.description: Adventurer's Guild card, D-Rank. Exchanged at each promotion.

Guild Card: C-Rank.name: Guild Card: C-Rank
Guild Card: C-Rank.description: Adventurer's Guild card, C-Rank. Exchanged at each promotion.

Guild Card: B-Rank.name: Guild Card: B-Rank
Guild Card: B-Rank.description: Adventurer's Guild card, B-Rank. Exchanged at each promotion.

Guild Card: A-Rank.name: Guild Card: A-Rank
Guild Card: A-Rank.description: Adventurer's Guild card, A-Rank. Exchanged at each promotion.

Guild Card: S-Rank.name: Guild Card: S-Rank
Guild Card: S-Rank.description: Adventurer's Guild card, S-Rank. Exchanged at each promotion.

Guild-Issued Iron Sword.name: Guild-Issued Iron Sword
Guild-Issued Iron Sword.description: A no-nonsense iron longsword for F-rank adventurers. Won't impress anyone but will keep you alive. [Starter | Common | Guild Issue]

Beastkin Tailguard Belt.name: Beastkin Tailguard Belt
Beastkin Tailguard Belt.description: Leather belt with tail-guard. Holds three vials. [Mid | Uncommon | Beastkin]

Identity Mirror Compact.name: Identity Mirror Compact
Identity Mirror Compact.description: Mirror always reflecting your true face.

Kagutsuchi Ember Katana.name: Kagutsuchi Ember Katana
Kagutsuchi Ember Katana.description: A curved ember-steel katana retaining forging heat. Leaves burn wounds on every cut. [Mid | Rare | Kagutsuchi]

Misread Prophecy Scroll.name: Misread Prophecy Scroll
Misread Prophecy Scroll.description: A prophecy scroll that may or may not refer to you. Several priests insist it does. Several scholars desperately hope it does not.

Nightglass Twin Daggers.name: Nightglass Twin Daggers
Nightglass Twin Daggers.description: Matched night-blue daggers absorbing ambient light. Nearly invisible in darkness. [Mid | Rare | Shadowglass Embassy]

Relic of the Deep Floor.name: Relic of the Deep Floor
Relic of the Deep Floor.description: Deep-floor relic warning of traps. Quirk: grows colder going deeper. [Mid | Epic | Deep Riftmaw]

Renka Mirage Twin Wands.name: Renka Mirage Twin Wands
Renka Mirage Twin Wands.description: Matched short wands weaving light and mirage. Grow warmer when the wielder lies. [Mid | Epic | Renka Mirage Sea]

Rift-Touched Iron Sword.name: Rift-Touched Iron Sword
Rift-Touched Iron Sword.description: Iron sword with faint Riftlight absorption. Pale blue shimmer after striking monsters. Reliable.

Riftborn Arcanist Staff.name: Riftborn Arcanist Staff
Riftborn Arcanist Staff.description: A tall staff crowned with a Riftmaw crystal. Hums near Riftmaw entrances. [Mid | Epic | Riftmaw Dungeons]

Bladed Parasol.name: Bladed Parasol
Bladed Parasol.description: Elegant parasol with blade along the spine and razor-edged ribs. Open to block, close to slash.

Trailworn Comfort Kit.name: Trailworn Comfort Kit
Trailworn Comfort Kit.description: A compact case containing foot balm, muscle rub, blister patches, and a small vial of luck oil. The unsung essentials of adventuring life. Giving one to someone means "I have noticed you are in pain and I care about that."

Beastfang Claw Gauntlets.name: Beastfang Claw Gauntlets
Beastfang Claw Gauntlets.description: Clawed gauntlets of bone and moon-iron. Enhance striking speed and climbing. [Mid | Rare | Beastkin Smiths]

Elegant Formalwear Token.name: Elegant Formalwear Token
Elegant Formalwear Token.description: A magical token that, when activated, summons a perfectly fitted formal outfit appropriate to the wearer's status, the event's dress code, and their personal aesthetic. Lasts one evening. The go-to solution for anyone invited to a noble gala with no idea what to wear. The outfit always includes good shoes.

Dawnlight Battle Robes.name: Dawnlight Battle Robes
Dawnlight Battle Robes.description: First Light battle robes. Resist dark/psychic. May negate one lethal blow per battle. [Late | Legendary | Sanctum]

Jinxed Needle and Thread.name: Jinxed Needle and Thread
Jinxed Needle and Thread.description: A pair of bone needles threaded with curse-resistant silk. Used for weaving hex patterns and unraveling minor jinxes. Hex Weavers always carry a set.

Letter of Recommendation.name: Letter of Recommendation
Letter of Recommendation.description: Sealed letter vouching for exceptional talent. Wax seal important enough that clerks straighten up when they see it.

Nightglass Mask Fragment.name: Nightglass Mask Fragment
Nightglass Mask Fragment.description: Mask fragment granting darkvision. Quirk: wearer sees shadowy figures. [Mid | Rare | Nightglass]

Relic of Gentle Radiance.name: Relic of Gentle Radiance
Relic of Gentle Radiance.description: Golden light core. Quirk: hums hymns at peace, silent when someone suffers. [Mid | Epic | Sanctum]

Sacred Restoration Flask.name: Sacred Restoration Flask
Sacred Restoration Flask.description: Holy healing. Burns undead. [Late | Epic | Sanctum]

Veilwalker Shadow Mantle.name: Veilwalker Shadow Mantle
Veilwalker Shadow Mantle.description: Pure shadow coat. Near-invisibility in dim conditions. [Late | Epic | Veilwalkers]

Fieldwork Measuring Kit.name: Fieldwork Measuring Kit
Fieldwork Measuring Kit.description: A leather case containing a plumb line, folding ruler, chalk, and a small notebook for sketching floor plans. Every Dungeon Architect needs to measure twice before the dungeon shifts.

Comforting Weighted Shawl.name: Comforting Weighted Shawl
Comforting Weighted Shawl.description: A soft, weighted shawl enchanted to feel like a gentle hug. Provides minimal protection but significant emotional comfort. Popular with adventurers who have trouble sleeping after dungeon dives. Wrapping it around someone who is shivering or upset is an instinct that requires no explanation.

Crownveil Champion Rapier.name: Crownveil Champion Rapier
Crownveil Champion Rapier.description: A thin rapier leaving rose-petal light trails. Criticals cause bleeding. Glows when defending honor. [Late | Epic | Crownveil Tournaments]

Crystal Vial of Starlight.name: Crystal Vial of Starlight
Crystal Vial of Starlight.description: A small crystal vial containing captured starlight from the Aetherglass Reaches. It glows softly in darkness and provides a tiny mana boost when uncorked. Beautiful, impractical, and exactly the sort of thing someone buys when they're thinking about you in a shop and can't help themselves.

Demon Contract Stationery.name: Demon Contract Stationery
Demon Contract Stationery.description: Formal writing paper enchanted with binding magic, used for contracts in the Twilight Dominion. The paper records the true intent of the signer regardless of what the words say. Useful for legal documents, IOUs, and love letters where you need the recipient to know you mean every word.

Velvet Severance Blade.name: Velvet Severance Blade
Velvet Severance Blade.description: The demon lord's chosen blade. Severs Blessings temporarily. Whispers lullabies. Drawback: corrupts dreams, draws inquisitors. [Endgame | Mythic | Twilight Dominion]

Demonbound Contract Blade.name: Demonbound Contract Blade
Demonbound Contract Blade.description: A living demon contract blade. Drains mana on hit. The demon whispers escalating requests. [Late | Legendary | Demon Contract Bosses]

Enchanted Warming Blanket.name: Enchanted Warming Blanket
Enchanted Warming Blanket.description: A thick wool blanket enchanted to maintain perfect warmth regardless of ambient temperature. Essential for mountain expeditions and cold nights. Also essential for the specific scenario where someone is cold and you have only one blanket. Adventure logic.

Focusing Crystal Rod.name: Focusing Crystal Rod
Focusing Crystal Rod.description: Crystal rod for enchantment magic. [Starter | Common]

Heartbound Spirit Lantern.name: Heartbound Spirit Lantern
Heartbound Spirit Lantern.description: Tiny lantern near someone the wearer likes. Pink=affection, gold=loyalty, blue=longing. Quirk: flares when someone hides feelings for wearer. [Mid | Rare | Festival]

Paired Hot Spring Tickets.name: Paired Hot Spring Tickets
Paired Hot Spring Tickets.description: Two vouchers for a private hot spring room at Frostbell Onsen Town, complete with mountain-view bath, heated floors, and a discreet no-questions-asked policy. The universal gift for "we should spend quiet time together" that is somehow both entirely innocent and absolutely not.

Paired Moonstone Pendants.name: Paired Moonstone Pendants
Paired Moonstone Pendants.description: Two pendants cut from the same moonstone, enchanted to grow warm when the other is nearby. Popular among traveling companions, adventuring partners, and couples who spend time apart. The stone's warmth means "I am close" even when words can't be spoken.

Relic of the Unbroken Vow.name: Relic of the Unbroken Vow
Relic of the Unbroken Vow.description: Broken vow crystallized. Quirk: shudders when wearer considers breaking a promise. [Late | Legendary | Noble Quests]

Saint-Kissed Battle Staff.name: Saint-Kissed Battle Staff
Saint-Kissed Battle Staff.description: A brilliant staff wreathed in golden light. Each spell carries an echo of the First Light. [Mid | Rare | Sanctum]

Tiny Guardian Spirit Idol.name: Tiny Guardian Spirit Idol
Tiny Guardian Spirit Idol.description: A small carved figure representing a protective spirit, different regions have different designs. Carrying one is a prayer for safety. Giving one to someone means "I cannot protect you myself, so I am asking the spirits to do it for me." The idol glows faintly when danger is near.

Twilight Sovereign Signet.name: Twilight Sovereign Signet
Twilight Sovereign Signet.description: Demon lord's true seal signet. Dark magic amplified. [Late | Legendary | Twilight Dominion]

Blade of the Second Chance.name: Blade of the Second Chance
Blade of the Second Chance.description: Translucent steel from another life. Cuts through fate itself. Drawback: each swing costs a memory not yet made. [Endgame | Mythic | Reborn Climax]

Comfort Food Recipe Scroll.name: Comfort Food Recipe Scroll
Comfort Food Recipe Scroll.description: A scroll containing a magical recipe that adapts to the cook's skill level, beginners produce edible food, experts produce cuisine. The recipe is always for something warm and filling. Cooking for someone is the most sincere form of care in any culture. The scroll smells faintly of home.

Cursed Friendship Bracelet.name: Cursed Friendship Bracelet
Cursed Friendship Bracelet.description: A bracelet that cannot be removed until the wearer has been genuinely nice to the person who gave it. The curse is mild, the bracelet just gets tighter when you're being avoidant. Popular as a joke between close friends. Terrifying as a gift from someone you stood up.

Obsidian Sovereign Seal.name: Obsidian Sovereign Seal
Obsidian Sovereign Seal.description: Demon lord's contract fragment. Quirk: each use adds a word to its surface. [Late | Legendary | Twilight Dominion]

Journal from the Old World.name: Journal from the Old World
Journal from the Old World.description: Battered journal from your old life. Half memories that don’t match this world, half blank pages. Irreplaceable.

Mirror of True Compliments.name: Mirror of True Compliments
Mirror of True Compliments.description: A small hand mirror that, when two people look into it together, shows each person what the other genuinely admires about them. The images are kind, specific, and devastatingly sincere. Named the most dangerous gift in Luxcellia by three consecutive issues of Noble Living Magazine.

Nightglass Battle Grimoire.name: Nightglass Battle Grimoire
Nightglass Battle Grimoire.description: A heavy grimoire of nightglass and silver. Each page contains a powerful unique spell. Psychic feedback after use. [Late | Epic | Nightglass Academy]

Sigil of the Turning Point.name: Sigil of the Turning Point
Sigil of the Turning Point.description: Sigil at life-changing moments. Quirk: a confession counts as life-changing. [Mid | Rare | Veilwalker]

Starbound Academy Crossbow.name: Starbound Academy Crossbow
Starbound Academy Crossbow.description: An elegant crossbow with silver-inlaid limbs. Bolts fly truer in moonlight. [Early | Uncommon | Academy]

Waking Relic Blade.name: Waking Relic Blade
Waking Relic Blade.description: A low-grade relic sword that feels faintly alive in your grip. Its edge is ordinary for now, but its dormant will responds to conviction.

Student Council Focus Ring.name: Student Council Focus Ring
Student Council Focus Ring.description: Thin ring with focus sigils. Concentration aid. [Early | Uncommon | Academy]

Blessing Amplification Ring.name: Blessing Amplification Ring
Blessing Amplification Ring.description: A simple silver ring that slightly amplifies the wearer's Blessing effects. The ring glows when the wearer's Blessing activates and grows warmer the more emotionally invested the wearer is. Wearing one given by a romantic partner is considered very intimate, your Blessing responds to them through it.

Merchant Sponsorship Ledger.name: Merchant Sponsorship Ledger
Merchant Sponsorship Ledger.description: Compact book of expenses, favors, and projected returns. Merchant Lords never invest without expecting profit.
