Perfume of the Winter Court.name: Perfume of the Winter Court
Perfume of the Winter Court.description: A delicate fragrance of frost roses and mountain air, bottled in crystal. Worn by northern nobles and those who wish to project cold elegance. The scent adapts to the wearer's mood, icy when composed, floral when happy, warm when flustered. A dangerous gift for someone who doesn't want their feelings known.

Soul Gem of Dawnlight.name: Soul Gem of Dawnlight
Soul Gem of Dawnlight.description: Soul gem with First Light fragment. Restores Blessings. Drawback: each use costs a fraction of wielder's Blessing. [Endgame | Mythic | Church]

Constellation Charm Bracelet.name: Constellation Charm Bracelet
Constellation Charm Bracelet.description: A silver bracelet with tiny charms shaped like stars, each one enchanted to represent a shared memory. New charms appear when a significant moment occurs between the bracelet's owner and the person they care about most. A romantic gift that literally keeps track of your story together.

Dream Mask of the 97th Floor.name: Dream Mask of the 97th Floor
Dream Mask of the 97th Floor.description: Dream mask revealing Riftmaw layouts in sleep. Quirk: dreams always set in dungeons. [Late | Epic | Deep Riftmaw]

Guild-Certified Apology Cake.name: Guild-Certified Apology Cake
Guild-Certified Apology Cake.description: A small cake purchased from the guild tavern with a card that reads "I'M SORRY" in enchanted frosting that changes to match what you're apologizing for. Does not actually fix the problem. Does make it harder to stay mad.

Lucky Charm from a Companion.name: Lucky Charm from a Companion
Lucky Charm from a Companion.description: A small handmade charm, a braided cord, a carved bead, a pressed flower in resin, given by someone who cares about you. No magical properties. The luck is entirely emotional. You will defend this charm with your life.

Vestments of the Final Light.name: Vestments of the Final Light
Vestments of the Final Light.description: Pure light vestments. Near-immunity to dark/demonic. Purges corruption once per arc. Drawback: weakens against core convictions. [Endgame | Mythic | Sanctum]

Artisan Chocolate Truffle Box.name: Artisan Chocolate Truffle Box
Artisan Chocolate Truffle Box.description: Twelve handcrafted truffles from Portmaris’s finest. Different enchanted fillings, caramel for nostalgia, mint that makes you see colors, one mystery truffle different every time.

Guild Cantrip Staff.name: Guild Cantrip Staff
Guild Cantrip Staff.description: A plain wooden staff with a faintly glowing mana crystal. Channels cantrips and thumps goblins. [Starter | Common | Guild Issue]

Ribbon of the Fanged Covenant.name: Ribbon of the Fanged Covenant
Ribbon of the Fanged Covenant.description: A red cord woven by beastkin elders, blessed by the clan's spirit animal. Tied around the wrist of someone the clan has accepted as kin. In romantic contexts, tying it yourself means "You are my pack." It is not removed until the bond is broken.

Crown of the Rift-Touched Hero.name: Crown of the Rift-Touched Hero
Crown of the Rift-Touched Hero.description: Riftmaw crystal crown. Mind control/corruption immunity. Drawback: cannot be removed once bonded. [Endgame | Mythic | Final Riftmaw]

Demon Princess Contract Ribbon.name: Demon Princess Contract Ribbon
Demon Princess Contract Ribbon.description: A black-and-crimson ribbon sealing a personal contract with a dangerous royal demon. The clauses are magically tiny and suspiciously affectionate.

Silver Crescent Duelist Rapier.name: Silver Crescent Duelist Rapier
Silver Crescent Duelist Rapier.description: A slender rapier tracing faint blue arcs. Seems to anticipate parries. [Early | Rare | Academy Exams]

Guild-Certified Healing Draught.name: Guild-Certified Healing Draught
Guild-Certified Healing Draught.description: Guild healing potion. Tastes like cherry, metal, and regret. Works reliably.

Hair Ornament of the Moon Court.name: Hair Ornament of the Moon Court
Hair Ornament of the Moon Court.description: An elegant silver hair pin shaped like a crescent moon with trailing chains of tiny stars. Worn by noble women of the Crownveil court. A man giving one to a woman is a formal declaration of interest. A woman wearing one given by a specific person is a quiet announcement.

Dawnblessed Promise Ring.name: Dawnblessed Promise Ring
Dawnblessed Promise Ring.description: A simple gold ring blessed by the Church of the First Light. Given during commitment ceremonies at the Golden Vow Chapel, it marks a sacred promise between two people. The ring grows warm when the promise is kept and cold when it is in danger of being broken.

Truthlight Confession Earrings.name: Truthlight Confession Earrings
Truthlight Confession Earrings.description: Starlight earrings. Once per arc: speak irrefutable truth. Drawback: compelled to speak truth when silence is wiser. [Endgame | Mythic | Reborn]

Fate Card of Unwritten Tomorrows.name: Fate Card of Unwritten Tomorrows
Fate Card of Unwritten Tomorrows.description: Fate card showing different futures. Quirk: sometimes shows a future the wearer doesn't want. [Late | Legendary | Festival]

Guild Desk Recommendation Letter.name: Guild Desk Recommendation Letter
Guild Desk Recommendation Letter.description: A neat letter from a guild receptionist recommending you for provisional work. The handwriting is warm, precise, and slightly protective.

Halo Fragment of Forbidden Mercy.name: Halo Fragment of Forbidden Mercy
Halo Fragment of Forbidden Mercy.description: Halo fragment from angel who chose mercy. Heals any wound. Drawback: each use erases a memory. [Late | Legendary | Divine]

Reborn Coin of Unfinished Wishes.name: Reborn Coin of Unfinished Wishes
Reborn Coin of Unfinished Wishes.description: Reborn coin granting one second chance per arc. Drawback: reversed timelines create ripples. Cannot save same person twice. [Endgame | Mythic | Reborn]

Starfall Greatsword of Luxcellia.name: Starfall Greatsword of Luxcellia
Starfall Greatsword of Luxcellia.description: Star-metal greatsword. Damage scales with bonds. Cannot strike allies. Once per arc: Starfall Cleave. Drawback: wielder feels every life taken. [Endgame | Mythic | Final Arc Bosses]

Twilight Shadowweave Coat.name: Twilight Shadowweave Coat
Twilight Shadowweave Coat.description: Living shadow coat. Invisible except bright light. Converts light to dark. Drawback: feeds on positive emotions. [Endgame | Mythic | Twilight Dominion]

Heartbound Relic of the Final Confession.name: Heartbound Relic of the Final Confession
Heartbound Relic of the Final Confession.description: Born from honest feelings at worst time. Speak to someone's heart, once, truth only. Quirk: dissolves after one use, leaving a petal. [Endgame | Mythic | Romance]

Battle-Ready Body Pillow.name: Battle-Ready Body Pillow
Battle-Ready Body Pillow.description: A sturdy waifu-print body pillow. Soft, dense, and somehow battle-ready.

Oak-and-Iron Tower Shield.name: Oak-and-Iron Tower Shield
Oak-and-Iron Tower Shield.description: A full-height slab of reinforced oak and iron banding that turns its bearer into a walking wall. Heavy, uncomplicated, and absolutely committed to the idea that nothing gets past you.

Mana-Thread Needles.name: Mana-Thread Needles
Mana-Thread Needles.description: A roll of gleaming enchanter's needles trailing spools of mana-conductive thread. In skilled hands they stitch wards mid-air, bind wounds, snag weapons, and sew a hem, sometimes in the same fight.

Caged Everflame Staff.name: Caged Everflame Staff
Caged Everflame Staff.description: A tall staff crowned with a caged everflame lantern that brightens with its bearer's resolve. Equal parts walking light, focus for radiant magic, and surprisingly persuasive club.

Consecrated Flanged Mace.name: Consecrated Flanged Mace
Consecrated Flanged Mace.description: A flanged mace of consecrated steel, its head engraved with the First Light's sunburst. Blessed for use against the unholy and blunt enough to make no theological distinctions.

Blank Contract Tome.name: Blank Contract Tome
Blank Contract Tome.description: A heavy grimoire bound in violet leather, its pages filled with blank contract seals awaiting terms. Words written in it want to become binding, the tome hums faintly whenever a bargain is near.

Segmented Chainblade.name: Segmented Chainblade
Segmented Chainblade.description: A segmented blade on a mana-linked chain that coils, lashes, and snaps back to its wielder's grip. Unpredictable to face, unforgiving to learn, and spectacular in motion.

Honed Kitchen Roll.name: Honed Kitchen Roll
Honed Kitchen Roll.description: A leather roll of professional kitchen blades, honed past reason. Officially for mise en place; unofficially, the line between chef and knife-fighter has always been thinner than people think.

Moonstone Charm.name: Moonstone Charm
Moonstone Charm.description: A pale moonstone on a silver cord that glows softly under moonlight, traditional among Moon Elves as a keepsake of home. It brightens near moonlit water and dims in windowless rooms, as if homesick.

Ever-Simmer Alembic.name: Ever-Simmer Alembic
Ever-Simmer Alembic.description: A dented copper alembic that never quite stops simmering, gifted to every apprentice on their first day. It hums when a brew is about to turn. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Market Sample Tray.name: Market Sample Tray
Market Sample Tray.description: A velvet-lined tray with a dozen tiny stoppered vials, worn on a strap for working a market crowd. Customers always try the free sample. [Start | Signature | Merchant]

Antivenom Signet Vial.name: Antivenom Signet Vial
Antivenom Signet Vial.description: A ring whose hidden chamber holds a single dose of self-brewed antitoxin. A poisoner who survives long enough learns to carry the cure. [Start | Signature | Underground]

Guiding Sigil Chalk.name: Guiding Sigil Chalk
Guiding Sigil Chalk.description: A stub of rune-chalk that glows faintly where a sigil should go, guiding an unsteady hand through its first enchantments. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Folding Multi-Tool.name: Folding Multi-Tool
Folding Multi-Tool.description: A folding cluster of drivers, coils, and lenses held together with more enthusiasm than engineering. It has never once had the exact tool needed, yet always improvises. [Start | Signature | Aetherglass]

Notched Graving Chisels.name: Notched Graving Chisels
Notched Graving Chisels.description: A roll of fine graving chisels, each notched from a first shaky attempt at a rune that almost held. The notches are a record of every lesson learned. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Everfull Reed Pen.name: Everfull Reed Pen
Everfull Reed Pen.description: A reed pen enchanted to never run dry, its ink shifting color with the writer's mood. Scribes swear the sad letters come out bluer. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Forge-Worn Hammer.name: Forge-Worn Hammer
Forge-Worn Hammer.description: A worn smithing hammer passed down through the forge, its haft polished smooth by three generations of hands. It knows the work better than its holder does. [Start | Signature | Emberwake]

Fitting Caliper.name: Fitting Caliper
Fitting Caliper.description: A brass caliper for measuring a client's frame to the millimeter. Armor that fits wrong gets someone killed, and this tool never lies about the numbers. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Worn Awl and Thread.name: Worn Awl and Thread
Worn Awl and Thread.description: A hooked awl and a spool of waxed sinew, the everyday companions of anyone who works hide. The awl's grip is molded to one hand alone. [Start | Signature | Frontier]

Curved Draw-Knife.name: Curved Draw-Knife
Curved Draw-Knife.description: A two-handled blade for shaping bows and hafts from raw stave-wood, worn bright along its edge. It finds the grain the way water finds downhill. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Loupe of True Sight.name: Loupe of True Sight
Loupe of True Sight.description: A jeweler's loupe ground to reveal the flaw in any stone. Quirk: it faintly clouds over when held to something magically counterfeit. [Start | Signature | Cartel]

Enchanted Measuring Tape.name: Enchanted Measuring Tape
Enchanted Measuring Tape.description: A measuring tape that adjusts its own markings to the truest fit and never tangles. It has strong opinions, expressed in gentle tugs. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Thread-of-Living-Light.name: Thread-of-Living-Light
Thread-of-Living-Light.description: A spool of luminous thread that holds a minor enchantment in every stitch. A garment sewn with it remembers the shape of the one who wears it. [Start | Signature | Mirage]

Precision Shear Set.name: Precision Shear Set
Precision Shear Set.description: A set of impossibly sharp shears and a comb that tames any hair, mane, or fur. The right cut can change how a room treats you. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Sentiment Ribbon Spool.name: Sentiment Ribbon Spool
Sentiment Ribbon Spool.description: A spool of ribbon that faintly warms when tied around a gift made with genuine feeling. It stays cold for anything given out of obligation. [Start | Signature | Moonlit]

Well-Seasoned Skillet.name: Well-Seasoned Skillet
Well-Seasoned Skillet.description: A cast-iron skillet blackened by a thousand meals, its surface so seasoned nothing sticks and everything tastes of home. [Start | Signature | Tavern]

Combat Ladle.name: Combat Ladle
Combat Ladle.description: A heavy serving ladle that doubles as a startlingly effective bludgeon. Feeds an army, then defends it. [Start | Signature | Frontier]

Portable Camp Stove.name: Portable Camp Stove
Portable Camp Stove.description: A compact folding stove that lights in any conditions, even the damp dark of a dungeon's third floor. A hot meal between fights is its own kind of magic. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Traveling Cask Tap.name: Traveling Cask Tap
Traveling Cask Tap.description: A brass tap that fits any barrel and, some swear, improves whatever pours through it. The centerpiece of every good tavern night. [Start | Signature | Tavern]

Aromatic Blending Case.name: Aromatic Blending Case
Aromatic Blending Case.description: A lacquered case of tiny essence vials for composing perfumes on the spot. The right scent opens doors that words cannot. [Start | Signature | Renka]

Pressed Herb Codex.name: Pressed Herb Codex
Pressed Herb Codex.description: A field journal thick with pressed leaves and margin notes, identifying every useful and deadly plant in the region. Worth more than its weight in gold to anyone in the wild. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Woven Gathering Basket.name: Woven Gathering Basket
Woven Gathering Basket.description: A deep basket of river-reed, charmed to keep its contents fresh through a long day's walk. It always seems to hold a little more than it should. [Start | Signature | Wilds]

Trusty Hand Scythe.name: Trusty Hand Scythe
Trusty Hand Scythe.description: A well-balanced reaping scythe, its edge kept keen through countless harvests. Humble, honest, and surprisingly persuasive in a tight spot. [Start | Signature | Frontier]

Charmed Fishing Line.name: Charmed Fishing Line
Charmed Fishing Line.description: A length of line said to hum when something worth catching takes interest below. Patience is the real bait; this only helps. [Start | Signature | Cerulean]

Everlit Pick Lantern.name: Everlit Pick Lantern
Everlit Pick Lantern.description: A miner's pick with a mana-lantern set into the head, casting steady light exactly where the next swing lands. Darkness is the enemy underground. [Start | Signature | Deephollow]

Resonance Tuning Fork.name: Resonance Tuning Fork
Resonance Tuning Fork.description: A slender fork that sings when struck near a crystal vein, its pitch rising as the deposit grows richer. The prospector's truest friend. [Start | Signature | Deephollow]

Precision Flensing Knife.name: Precision Flensing Knife
Precision Flensing Knife.description: A curved, wickedly sharp knife shaped for recovering intact materials from a fallen beast. A clean cut doubles the yield. [Start | Signature | Frontier]

Bonded Whistle.name: Bonded Whistle
Bonded Whistle.description: A carved bone whistle pitched below human hearing, tuned to call and calm the creatures in one's care. Beasts trust the hand that carries it. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Spirit-Tether Charm.name: Spirit-Tether Charm
Spirit-Tether Charm.description: A braided charm that gently binds a spirit-beast to its keeper without caging it. The tether is trust made visible. [Start | Signature | Spiritfen]

Ledger of Fair Dealing.name: Ledger of Fair Dealing
Ledger of Fair Dealing.description: A trade book whose figures are famously honest, its reputation worth more than any coin inside. A merchant is only as good as their book. [Start | Signature | Cerulean]

Appraisal Monocle.name: Appraisal Monocle
Appraisal Monocle.description: A monocle that reveals the faint residue of age and enchantment in old artifacts. Quirk: it fogs at the touch of a forgery. [Start | Signature | Cartel]

Dowsing Compass.name: Dowsing Compass
Dowsing Compass.description: A compass whose needle ignores north and drifts, ever so faintly, toward the richest thing nearby. It has been wrong exactly often enough to stay exciting. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Self-Inking Map Case.name: Self-Inking Map Case
Self-Inking Map Case.description: A leather case whose blank vellum draws itself as its bearer walks, mapping every corridor and hidden turn. Getting lost is the first way delvers die. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Structural Plumb-Bob.name: Structural Plumb-Bob
Structural Plumb-Bob.description: A weighted plumb-line for reading the true bones of a dungeon's construction, revealing where it was built and where it was broken. [Start | Signature | Riftmaw]

Etiquette Bell.name: Etiquette Bell
Etiquette Bell.description: A small brass counter-bell whose clear tone can silence a rowdy guild hall or summon help in a heartbeat. The receptionist's scepter of office. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Immaculate Service Gloves.name: Immaculate Service Gloves
Immaculate Service Gloves.description: A pair of white gloves that never stain, worn by those who serve a great house with flawless discretion. What they see, they keep. [Start | Signature | Noble]

Warm-Water Ladle.name: Warm-Water Ladle
Warm-Water Ladle.description: A long bamboo ladle for tending the springs, kept warm to the touch. Hospitality is the host's whole art, and it begins with comfort. [Start | Signature | Tidelace]

Whispering Prayer Beads.name: Whispering Prayer Beads
Whispering Prayer Beads.description: A string of beads that grows cold when a spirit draws near and warm when one departs. The medium reads them like a second heartbeat. [Start | Signature | Spiritfen]

Faithful Traveling Instrument.name: Faithful Traveling Instrument
Faithful Traveling Instrument.description: A well-loved instrument, scuffed from the road and perfectly in tune despite it. Its player could pick it out blindfolded among a hundred others. [Start | Signature | Tavern]

Trunk of a Thousand Faces.name: Trunk of a Thousand Faces
Trunk of a Thousand Faces.description: A traveling trunk of wigs, paints, and half-masks, enough to become anyone the scene requires. On stage or off, the right face opens the right door. [Start | Signature | Rosethorn]

Ribboned Tumbling Sash.name: Ribboned Tumbling Sash
Ribboned Tumbling Sash.description: A long silk sash used in acrobatic routines, weighted just so for spins and aerial catches. Flashy, functional, and faintly ridiculous at rest. [Start | Signature | Festival]

Resonant Throat Lozenge Tin.name: Resonant Throat Lozenge Tin
Resonant Throat Lozenge Tin.description: A silver tin of honeyed lozenges that keep a singer's voice clear through the longest aria. Empty it, and the high notes go with it. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Unfinished Masterwork Manuscript.name: Unfinished Masterwork Manuscript
Unfinished Masterwork Manuscript.description: A dog-eared play that is always one scene from done, its margins crammed with better ideas. The writer's whole heart lives in the parts nobody has read yet. [Start | Signature | Rosethorn]

Oath-Worn Sword Knot.name: Oath-Worn Sword Knot
Oath-Worn Sword Knot.description: A braided cord tied to a swordsman's first blade, knotted anew after every duel survived. It records a career in loops of frayed silk. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Firstblood Dueling Glove.name: Firstblood Dueling Glove
Firstblood Dueling Glove.description: A single fingerless glove worn on the sword hand, its leather darkened at exactly one knuckle. A duelist never forgets their first real match. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Thorned Rose Brooch.name: Thorned Rose Brooch
Thorned Rose Brooch.description: A silver brooch shaped as a rose whose thorns are honestly sharp. Worn over the heart, it marks a knight sworn to beauty and blade alike. [Start | Signature | Roseveil]

Lacquered War Fan Charm.name: Lacquered War Fan Charm
Lacquered War Fan Charm.description: A miniature folding fan worn at the belt, twin to the tessen the duelist fights with. Snapping it open is a challenge no one misreads. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Reinforced Parasol Rib.name: Reinforced Parasol Rib
Reinforced Parasol Rib.description: A single steel rib salvaged from a fighting parasol that took one blow too many. Kept as a promise to swing the next one harder. [Start | Signature | Rosethorn]

Spent Opening Cartridge.name: Spent Opening Cartridge
Spent Opening Cartridge.description: The empty casing of a gunblade's first fired round, drilled and hung on a cord. It fires nothing now; it reminds of everything. [Start | Signature | Aetherglass]

Ancestral Menuki.name: Ancestral Menuki
Ancestral Menuki.description: A small ornamental fitting from a family sword, passed down with the name that goes on it. Honor rendered in a thumb of worn bronze. [Start | Signature | Emberwake]

Masterless Sword Tag.name: Masterless Sword Tag
Masterless Sword Tag.description: A wooden tag that once bore a lord's crest, now scraped blank. A ronin serves no house, and carries the proof deliberately. [Start | Signature | Wandering]

Ribboned Blade Weight.name: Ribboned Blade Weight
Ribboned Blade Weight.description: A silk-wrapped counterweight that trails from the pommel mid-dance, turning every cut into choreography. [Start | Signature | Festival]

Shimmerglass Sword Bead.name: Shimmerglass Sword Bead
Shimmerglass Sword Bead.description: A glass bead that splits light into a dozen false edges. Fitting for a style built on the strike the enemy never sees coming. [Start | Signature | Mirage]

Mana-Etched Crossguard Rune.name: Mana-Etched Crossguard Rune
Mana-Etched Crossguard Rune.description: A rune-inlaid guard fitting that lets a blade drink and channel a caster's spell. Steel and sorcery, argued into one grip. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Meditation Sword Stand.name: Meditation Sword Stand
Meditation Sword Stand.description: A small folding stand for resting a blade during the long stillness that sharpens the mind more than the edge. Enlightenment, one breath at a time. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Spirit-Bound Tsuba.name: Spirit-Bound Tsuba
Spirit-Bound Tsuba.description: A sword guard humming with a bound fragment of spirit. It grows warm in the hand of the one it has chosen, cold to all others. [Start | Signature | Spiritfen]

Tuning-Fork Pommel.name: Tuning-Fork Pommel
Tuning-Fork Pommel.description: A pommel cap that rings a clear note when struck, setting the rhythm a songblade fights to. The blade keeps time with the heart. [Start | Signature | Tavern]

Sliver of Rift-Glass.name: Sliver of Rift-Glass
Sliver of Rift-Glass.description: A shard of crystallized dimensional tear, cool and faintly wrong to hold. The riftblade learned to cut with the space between spaces from studying it. [Start | Signature | Riftmaw]

Fragment of a Sacred Blade.name: Fragment of a Sacred Blade
Fragment of a Sacred Blade.description: A broken tip of an ancient holy sword, still humming with the vow it was forged to keep. The knight carries it until they are worthy of the whole. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Well-Thumbed Spellbook.name: Well-Thumbed Spellbook
Well-Thumbed Spellbook.description: A first spellbook, its most-used pages soft as cloth and its margins a graveyard of failed theories. Every mage's true beginning. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Annotated Grimoire of Firsts.name: Annotated Grimoire of Firsts
Annotated Grimoire of Firsts.description: A grimoire recording every spell the sage first understood, and the exact moment each one clicked. Wisdom is a diary, kept in symbols. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Cracked Training Ward Stone.name: Cracked Training Ward Stone
Cracked Training Ward Stone.description: A palm-sized ward stone webbed with hairline cracks from absorbing blows during training. Proof that the barrier held, mostly. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Pocket of Home Soil.name: Pocket of Home Soil
Pocket of Home Soil.description: A pouch of earth from where the geomancer first felt the ground answer them. They fight better standing on a little piece of home. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Fractured Golem Core.name: Fractured Golem Core
Fractured Golem Core.description: A chip of the animating core from a golemancer's very first construct, which fell apart within the hour. They kept the piece that mattered. [Start | Signature | Deephollow]

Weathervane Pendant.name: Weathervane Pendant
Weathervane Pendant.description: A tiny spinning weathervane on a chain that turns toward gathering storms before any cloud shows. The sky tells its callers first. [Start | Signature | Duskfields]

Never-Melting Ice Shard.name: Never-Melting Ice Shard
Never-Melting Ice Shard.description: A sliver of conjured ice that has refused to melt since the day it formed. The cold does not chase; it waits, and so does this. [Start | Signature | Veilpeak]

Impossibly Heavy Marble.name: Impossibly Heavy Marble
Impossibly Heavy Marble.description: A glass marble that weighs as much as a millstone, or nothing at all, depending on the mage's mood. A first lesson in bending weight. [Start | Signature | Aetherglass]

Stopped Pocket Watch.name: Stopped Pocket Watch
Stopped Pocket Watch.description: A watch frozen at the precise second its owner first slowed time. It has never ticked since, and the chronomancer likes it that way. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Star-Chart Astrolabe.name: Star-Chart Astrolabe
Star-Chart Astrolabe.description: A brass astrolabe worn smooth from tracing the heavens. The astrologer reads fate and firepower in the same night sky. [Start | Signature | Aetherglass]

Moon-Phase Locket.name: Moon-Phase Locket
Moon-Phase Locket.description: A locket whose inner disc turns with the true phase of the moon, waxing the oracle's power as it waxes overhead. [Start | Signature | Tidelace]

Palm Mirror of Misdirection.name: Palm Mirror of Misdirection
Palm Mirror of Misdirection.description: A small mirror that shows a face a half-second out of step with the real one. The illusionist's first lesson: nothing shown can be trusted. [Start | Signature | Mirage]

Dreamwoven Catcher.name: Dreamwoven Catcher
Dreamwoven Catcher.description: A woven dreamcatcher that hums with the first dream its maker ever walked into on purpose. It filters nightmares, mostly. [Start | Signature | Spiritfen]

Resonant Voice Crystal.name: Resonant Voice Crystal
Resonant Voice Crystal.description: A crystal that rings in harmony with its singer's true voice, amplifying song into something that shivers stone. [Start | Signature | Deephollow]

Bottomless Reagent Pouch.name: Bottomless Reagent Pouch
Bottomless Reagent Pouch.description: A charmed pouch that always holds one more pinch of the reagent an enchantment needs. It has never, ever been organized. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Whispering Pact Coin.name: Whispering Pact Coin
Whispering Pact Coin.description: A blackened coin from the warlock's first bargain, warm with a voice only they can hear. It advises, tempts, and never quite lies. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Battered Cauldron Ladle.name: Battered Cauldron Ladle
Battered Cauldron Ladle.description: A ladle stained past cleaning by a hundred brews, the witch's wand and stirring-stick in one. Nature and dark magic, simmered together. [Start | Signature | Wilds]

Knotted Curse-Cord.name: Knotted Curse-Cord
Knotted Curse-Cord.description: A cord tied with hexes waiting to be pulled loose. Each knot is a small ruin the weaver has prepared in advance. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Ritual Lancet Ring.name: Ritual Lancet Ring
Ritual Lancet Ring.description: A ring with a tiny hidden blade for the blood a blood mage's craft demands. Power at a price, worn on the finger as a reminder. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Risen Finger-Bone.name: Risen Finger-Bone
Risen Finger-Bone.description: The finger-bone of the necromancer's very first summon, kept as a grim graduation token. It still twitches when the dead are near. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Herb-Packed Beak Mask.name: Herb-Packed Beak Mask
Herb-Packed Beak Mask.description: A long-beaked mask stuffed with warding herbs, equal parts protection and intimidation. The doctor sees sickness the way others see color. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Sundered Shadow Fragment.name: Sundered Shadow Fragment
Sundered Shadow Fragment.description: A curl of solid darkness peeled from the monarch's own shadow when it first obeyed them. It moves when no light should move it. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Knighting Oath Token.name: Knighting Oath Token
Knighting Oath Token.description: A plain iron token given on the day of knighthood, engraved with a single word: the oath the knight chose. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Blessed Prayer Cord.name: Blessed Prayer Cord
Blessed Prayer Cord.description: A cord blessed at a knight's vigil, worn beneath the armor against the heart. It warms faintly in the presence of true evil. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Tarnished Fallen Crest.name: Tarnished Fallen Crest
Tarnished Fallen Crest.description: The crest of an order the dark knight once served, deliberately left to tarnish. Some vows are kept by breaking them. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Grave-Cold Signet.name: Grave-Cold Signet
Grave-Cold Signet.description: A signet ring that never warms to the touch, bound to the death knight's undying oath. The cold is the promise. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Dragon-Scale Fragment.name: Dragon-Scale Fragment
Dragon-Scale Fragment.description: A single shed scale from the dragon a knight is sworn to. It thrums when its dragon is near, and aches when it is far. [Start | Signature | Emberwake]

Etched Oath-Plate.name: Etched Oath-Plate
Etched Oath-Plate.description: A small steel plate carved with the runes of a knight's binding vow, worn where a blow might land. Faith and function, hammered flat. [Start | Signature | Deephollow]

Cursed Gauntlet Rivet.name: Cursed Gauntlet Rivet
Cursed Gauntlet Rivet.description: A single rivet from a hexed gauntlet, carrying just enough curse to sting an enemy and unsettle a friend. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Ever-Warm Ember Locket.name: Ever-Warm Ember Locket
Ever-Warm Ember Locket.description: A locket holding a coal that has not gone cold since the forge that made the knight's blade. Duty, kept lit. [Start | Signature | Emberwake]

Rage-Scarred Tooth Necklace.name: Rage-Scarred Tooth Necklace
Rage-Scarred Tooth Necklace.description: A cord of teeth taken from things the berserker outlasted. Each one is a fight they should not have won. [Start | Signature | Frontier]

Arena Laurel Token.name: Arena Laurel Token
Arena Laurel Token.description: A bronze token thrown from the stands after a crowd-winning bout. The gladiator fights for many things; the roar is the truest. [Start | Signature | Ashenmere]

Cracked Oni Horn Cup.name: Cracked Oni Horn Cup
Cracked Oni Horn Cup.description: A drinking cup carved from a broken oni horn, worn at the hip. It has settled more arguments as a bludgeon than as a cup. [Start | Signature | Emberwake]

Wind-Notched Lance Pennant.name: Wind-Notched Lance Pennant
Wind-Notched Lance Pennant.description: A tattered pennant from a dragoon's first high leap, its edge shredded by the speed of the fall. They keep it frayed on purpose. [Start | Signature | Duskfields]

Prayer-Bead Polearm Wrap.name: Prayer-Bead Polearm Wrap
Prayer-Bead Polearm Wrap.description: A wrap of warrior-monk prayer beads bound around a polearm's haft. Devotion and discipline, gripped together. [Start | Signature | Veilpeak]

Conch of the Rising Tide.name: Conch of the Rising Tide
Conch of the Rising Tide.description: A spiral conch that murmurs with the sound of a tide only its caller can hear. Blow it, and the water listens. [Start | Signature | Tidelace]

Vanguard Banner Scrap.name: Vanguard Banner Scrap
Vanguard Banner Scrap.description: A strip torn from a banner the vanguard carried into a hopeless charge, and somehow carried back out. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Notched Aegis Boss.name: Notched Aegis Boss
Notched Aegis Boss.description: The central boss of a shield that has stopped more blows than anyone counted, notched once for each life it saved. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Living Acorn Charm.name: Living Acorn Charm
Living Acorn Charm.description: An acorn that never sprouts and never rots, gifted by the wild the warden protects. It is warm in a healthy forest and cold in a sick one. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Prism of Dawnlight.name: Prism of Dawnlight
Prism of Dawnlight.description: A prism that catches even the faintest light and returns it as a soft banner of aurora. The sentinel's vigil begins where the dark ends. [Start | Signature | Veilpeak]

Concealed-Blade Apron Pin.name: Concealed-Blade Apron Pin
Concealed-Blade Apron Pin.description: A demure apron pin that unfolds into a startlingly capable dagger. Impeccable service, discreetly armed. [Start | Signature | Noble]

Frontline Command Sigil.name: Frontline Command Sigil
Frontline Command Sigil.description: A campaign sigil worn by one who leads from the front and expects to be obeyed. Authority, made portable. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Truesight Fletching Feather.name: Truesight Fletching Feather
Truesight Fletching Feather.description: The feather from a ranger's first true shot, kept to fletch nothing and remind of everything. [Start | Signature | Wilds]

Mana-Nock Ring.name: Mana-Nock Ring
Mana-Nock Ring.description: A ring that conjures a faint arrow of light at the nock when drawn empty. The arcane archer never truly runs out. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Vial of Meteor Dust.name: Vial of Meteor Dust
Vial of Meteor Dust.description: A vial of glittering dust from a fallen star, dusted onto arrowheads for shots that streak like the sky is falling. [Start | Signature | Starfall]

Notched Speed-Loader.name: Notched Speed-Loader
Notched Speed-Loader.description: A worn speed-loader notched once for every duel won at dawn. It reloads a heartbeat faster than it has any right to. [Start | Signature | Frontier]

Consecrated Final Round.name: Consecrated Final Round
Consecrated Final Round.description: A single consecrated bullet the holy gunner has never fired, saved for the one shot that will truly matter. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Dog-Eared Wanted Ledger.name: Dog-Eared Wanted Ledger
Dog-Eared Wanted Ledger.description: A book of every bounty claimed and every one that got away, the latter pages more thumbed than the former. [Start | Signature | Guild]

Silent-Step Sole Charm.name: Silent-Step Sole Charm
Silent-Step Sole Charm.description: A charm sewn into a boot that muffles every footfall to nothing. The last thing many enemies never heard. [Start | Signature | Underground]

Folded Shinobi Kerchief.name: Folded Shinobi Kerchief
Folded Shinobi Kerchief.description: A black kerchief that folds a dozen ways into mask, sling, tourniquet, or garrote. The ninja's most honest tool is deception. [Start | Signature | Veilpeak]

Calling Card Deck.name: Calling Card Deck
Calling Card Deck.description: A deck of exquisite calling cards, left behind after a heist as both signature and taunt. Style is half the crime. [Start | Signature | Rosethorn]

Loaded Trick Coin.name: Loaded Trick Coin
Loaded Trick Coin.description: A coin that lands however the trickster needs it to. It has started more fights and ended more than anyone would believe. [Start | Signature | Festival]

Salt-Crusted Spyglass.name: Salt-Crusted Spyglass
Salt-Crusted Spyglass.description: A spyglass fogged with sea-salt that somehow always spots the richest ship on the horizon first. [Start | Signature | Cerulean]

Silvered Stake Pendant.name: Silvered Stake Pendant
Silvered Stake Pendant.description: A miniature silver stake worn openly as a warning to a certain kind of noble. The hunter believes in advertising. [Start | Signature | Rosethorn]

Warding Talisman Bundle.name: Warding Talisman Bundle
Warding Talisman Bundle.description: A fistful of paper talismans against the things that hide in the dark of Luxcellia. The hunter reads the night by which ones burn. [Start | Signature | Spiritfen]

Hourglass of a Borrowed Hour.name: Hourglass of a Borrowed Hour
Hourglass of a Borrowed Hour.description: A tiny hourglass whose sand never quite runs out, marking time the reaper has taken back from death. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Worn Meditation Beads.name: Worn Meditation Beads
Worn Meditation Beads.description: A loop of prayer beads polished by ten thousand repetitions. Stillness is a martial art, and this is its weapon. [Start | Signature | Veilpeak]

Static-Charged Hand Wraps.name: Static-Charged Hand Wraps
Static-Charged Hand Wraps.description: Hand wraps that crackle faintly with stored charge, releasing it on impact. Every punch lands with a little thunder. [Start | Signature | Duskfields]

Fanged Knuckle Charm.name: Fanged Knuckle Charm
Fanged Knuckle Charm.description: A knuckle-charm carved from a great beast's fang, lending its wearer a predator's certainty. The fist remembers the hunt. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Rune-Inked Fist Tattoo Ink.name: Rune-Inked Fist Tattoo Ink
Rune-Inked Fist Tattoo Ink.description: A vial of enchanted ink for the runes an arcane brawler inks across their knuckles, each punch a struck spell. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Wornleaf Scripture.name: Wornleaf Scripture
Wornleaf Scripture.description: A slim book of scripture worn soft at the pages of a priest's first-ever sermon. Faith, dog-eared. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Battle-Blessed Censer.name: Battle-Blessed Censer
Battle-Blessed Censer.description: A censer swung before battle to bless the ranks, heavy enough to crack a helm in a pinch. Mercy and force, on one chain. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Veil of Held Dawn.name: Veil of Held Dawn
Veil of Held Dawn.description: A gossamer veil that catches dawn-light and holds it, worn by one whose very presence is meant to comfort. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Purifying Paper Streamer.name: Purifying Paper Streamer
Purifying Paper Streamer.description: A staff-wand hung with sacred paper streamers that rustle when unclean spirits draw near. The shrine's warning bell in cloth. [Start | Signature | Tidelace]

Sealed Spirit Jar.name: Sealed Spirit Jar
Sealed Spirit Jar.description: A small jar holding the first malevolent spirit the exorcist ever bound. It rattles when it senses its own kind. [Start | Signature | Spiritfen]

Truth-Weighing Scale Charm.name: Truth-Weighing Scale Charm
Truth-Weighing Scale Charm.description: A tiny balance-scale charm said to tip toward a lie. The inquisitor trusts it more than most confessions. [Start | Signature | Ecclesia]

Shikigami Paper Doll.name: Shikigami Paper Doll
Shikigami Paper Doll.description: A folded paper doll that houses a bound minor spirit, ready to unfold into a servant at its master's word. [Start | Signature | Veilpeak]

Ancestor-Voice Rattle.name: Ancestor-Voice Rattle
Ancestor-Voice Rattle.description: A rattle of bone and seed that carries an ancestor's whisper to those who know how to listen. The shaman always does. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Threshold-Step Anklet.name: Threshold-Step Anklet
Threshold-Step Anklet.description: An anklet of woven spirit-silk that lets its wearer feel the thin places between the living world and the next. [Start | Signature | Spiritfen]

Bitter Warding Lozenge.name: Bitter Warding Lozenge
Bitter Warding Lozenge.description: A foul-tasting lozenge the curse eater holds under the tongue while drawing a curse into themselves. It never gets less bitter. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Bound Pact Scroll.name: Bound Pact Scroll
Bound Pact Scroll.description: The signed pact-scroll of a summoner's first bound ally, its ink faded but its binding intact. A friendship written in power. [Start | Signature | Academy]

Well-Chewed Training Whistle.name: Well-Chewed Training Whistle
Well-Chewed Training Whistle.description: A whistle bearing the honest teeth-marks of the first beast that ever refused to obey it, and eventually did. [Start | Signature | Verdania]

Tangle-Free Control Strings.name: Tangle-Free Control Strings
Tangle-Free Control Strings.description: A spool of enchanted strings that never knot, animating puppets or, at need, unwilling limbs. They obey the puppeteer alone. [Start | Signature | Mirage]

Crowd-Won Coin Purse.name: Crowd-Won Coin Purse
Crowd-Won Coin Purse.description: A purse jingling with the coins of a bard's first paying crowd. Kept full or empty, it is proof someone stopped to listen. [Start | Signature | Tavern]

Ovation Ankle Bells.name: Ovation Ankle Bells
Ovation Ankle Bells.description: A string of ankle bells from a dancer's debut, tuned to the exact chime that once earned a standing ovation. [Start | Signature | Festival]

Cherished Fan Ribbon.name: Cherished Fan Ribbon
Cherished Fan Ribbon.description: A ribbon thrown by an idol's very first fan, kept as a talisman. Adoration is a kind of power, and it started here. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Belled Jester Bauble.name: Belled Jester Bauble
Belled Jester Bauble.description: A jester's bauble whose bells laugh even when no one else does. A fool speaks the truths a court will not. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Marked Lucky Die.name: Marked Lucky Die
Marked Lucky Die.description: A single die that rolls a little too well when the stakes are high. The gambler swears it is skill, and dares you to prove otherwise. [Start | Signature | Underground]

Bandolier of Throwing Vials.name: Bandolier of Throwing Vials
Bandolier of Throwing Vials.description: A bandolier of quick-draw alchemical vials, meant to be hurled rather than sipped. Chemistry, weaponized and worn across the chest. [Start | Signature | Ashenmere]

Cracked Boss-Door Key.name: Cracked Boss-Door Key
Cracked Boss-Door Key.description: A key snapped in the lock of a dungeon's final door, kept as proof the breaker got in anyway. They never do it the intended way. [Start | Signature | Riftmaw]

Weighted End-Link.name: Weighted End-Link
Weighted End-Link.description: The heavy final link of a warden's chain-weapon, notched from catching blades and worse. Range is its own kind of armor. [Start | Signature | Deephollow]

Crest of the Called.name: Crest of the Called
Crest of the Called.description: A faintly glowing crest that marks a soul called to save Luxcellia, whether it asked to be or not. Destiny, worn like a target. [Start | Signature | Crownveil]

Shard of a Broken Throne.name: Shard of a Broken Throne
Shard of a Broken Throne.description: A jagged fragment of obsidian from a demon throne, cold with old sovereignty. Whoever holds it is remembering, or planning, a reign. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Dungeon Command Blueprint.name: Dungeon Command Blueprint
Dungeon Command Blueprint.description: A sprawling, ever-updating blueprint of a dungeon the lord commands, every trap and turn drawn in their own hand. [Start | Signature | Riftmaw]

Ever-Ember Focus.name: Ever-Ember Focus
Ever-Ember Focus.description: A palm-sized coal caged in blackened silver that never cools, feeding a pyromancer's fire when the world runs cold. [Start | Signature | Emberwake]

Tideglass Focus Vial.name: Tideglass Focus Vial
Tideglass Focus Vial.description: A vial of water drawn from seven tides that never stills, sloshing gently in answer to its hydromancer's will. [Start | Signature | Tidelace]

Windcaught Feather Focus.name: Windcaught Feather Focus
Windcaught Feather Focus.description: A feather that hangs forever adrift on a breeze no one else feels, marking the aeromancer's bond with the restless air. [Start | Signature | Duskfields]

Stormglass Charge Focus.name: Stormglass Charge Focus
Stormglass Charge Focus.description: A rod of fused sand struck by lightning, still humming with a captured charge that leaps to its electromancer's hand. [Start | Signature | Duskfields]

Verdigris Toxin Focus.name: Verdigris Toxin Focus
Verdigris Toxin Focus.description: A corroded green orb that weeps a harmless mist, focusing a toxomancer's craft the way a lens focuses light. [Start | Signature | Wilds]

Hollow Null Focus.name: Hollow Null Focus
Hollow Null Focus.description: A sphere of perfect black that seems to swallow the light around it, a small silence a voidmancer speaks their absence through. [Start | Signature | Twilight]

Folded-Space Focus Cube.name: Folded-Space Focus Cube
Folded-Space Focus Cube.description: A cube whose inner corners meet in ways corners should not, letting a spatiomancer hold a fold of distance in one hand. [Start | Signature | Aetherglass]

Kagutsuchi Emberwake.name: Kagutsuchi Emberwake
Kagutsuchi Emberwake.description: An oni-forged katana that breathes heat along its edge, leaving embers in the air of every swing. Once per battle, its cut ignites. [Late | Legendary | Emberwake]

Tidecleaver Ryusui.name: Tidecleaver Ryusui
Tidecleaver Ryusui.description: A flowing blue blade said to hold a captured wave. Its strikes carry the shove of deep water. [Late | Legendary | Tidelace]

Verdant Heartbow.name: Verdant Heartbow
Verdant Heartbow.description: A living-wood longbow grown, not carved, by the Verdant Throne. It draws smoother the more its wielder respects the wild. [Late | Legendary | Verdania]

Cerulean Corsair Pistol.name: Cerulean Corsair Pistol
Cerulean Corsair Pistol.description: An ornate flintlock chased with coral silver, favored by the merchant-pirates of the Cerulean coast. Never misfires in salt air. [Late | Epic | Cerulean]

Duskfields Thunderlance.name: Duskfields Thunderlance
Duskfields Thunderlance.description: A cavalry lance that hums before a charge and cracks like lightning on impact. Longer the run, harder the strike. [Late | Epic | Duskfields]

Deephollow Maul.name: Deephollow Maul
Deephollow Maul.description: A crystal-headed warhammer quarried from the deep veins, its heft absurd and its blows seismic. [Mid | Epic | Deephollow]

Rosethorn Rapier.name: Rosethorn Rapier
Rosethorn Rapier.description: A duelist's rapier with a rose-worked guard, elegant and merciless. Beloved of the nocturne's masked champions. [Mid | Rare | Rosethorn]

Whisperfang Daggers.name: Whisperfang Daggers
Whisperfang Daggers.description: A pair of matched daggers that make no sound leaving their sheaths. The underground's preferred introduction. [Mid | Epic | Underground]

Crownsteel Greatsword.name: Crownsteel Greatsword
Crownsteel Greatsword.description: A knight's greatsword bearing the Crown of Luxcellia's seal, forged to be seen as much as swung. [Mid | Rare | Crownveil]

Stormcaller Tessen.name: Stormcaller Tessen
Stormcaller Tessen.description: An iron war-fan that gathers wind with each sweep, turning a courtly gesture into a gale-edged cut. [Mid | Epic | Crownveil]

Frostreaver Scythe.name: Frostreaver Scythe
Frostreaver Scythe.description: A curved scythe rimed in permanent frost, its harvest measured in more than grain. [Late | Epic | Veilpeak]

Emberforge Battleaxe.name: Emberforge Battleaxe
Emberforge Battleaxe.description: A broad axe quenched in dragon-flame, its edge glowing sullen red even cold. [Mid | Epic | Emberwake]

Ashenmere Arena Trident.name: Ashenmere Arena Trident
Ashenmere Arena Trident.description: A gladiator's trident that has tasted the sand of a hundred bouts. The crowd remembers its name. [Mid | Rare | Ashenmere]

Silverlight Warbow.name: Silverlight Warbow
Silverlight Warbow.description: A blessed bow of the Ecclesia, its arrows carrying a mote of holy light against the unclean. [Late | Epic | Ecclesia]

Twinfang Chainblade.name: Twinfang Chainblade
Twinfang Chainblade.description: A chain-linked double blade that whirls in impossible arcs. Range is its whole argument. [Late | Epic | Deephollow]

Mirage Shortblade.name: Mirage Shortblade
Mirage Shortblade.description: A blade that seems to be in two places, courtesy of Mirage-glass inlay. The false edge cuts nearly as true. [Mid | Rare | Mirage]

Riftmaw Voidcleaver.name: Riftmaw Voidcleaver
Riftmaw Voidcleaver.description: A jagged blade quenched in a dungeon's dimensional tear. It cuts a hair's breadth into the space beside its target. [Late | Legendary | Riftmaw]

Aetherglass Repeater.name: Aetherglass Repeater
Aetherglass Repeater.description: A clockwork crossbow of the Aetherglass artificers, cranking bolts faster than any hand could nock them. [Mid | Epic | Aetherglass]

Thornblood Warscythe.name: Thornblood Warscythe
Thornblood Warscythe.description: A reclaimed farm scythe reforged for revolution, its haft wound with red cord. Every reaping is a statement. [Mid | Rare | Thornblood]

Windrunner Saber.name: Windrunner Saber
Windrunner Saber.description: A light curved saber of the plains confederacy, balanced for striking from a full gallop. [Mid | Rare | Windrunner]

Foxfire Kunai Set.name: Foxfire Kunai Set
Foxfire Kunai Set.description: A fan of throwing knives that trail pale foxfire in flight, unnerving to face in the dark. [Mid | Rare | Spiritfen]

Prizefighter Ironfist.name: Prizefighter Ironfist
Prizefighter Ironfist.description: A set of reinforced knuckles awarded to the guild's champion brawler. Plain, heavy, and undefeated. [Mid | Rare | Guild]

Gilded Dress Pistol.name: Gilded Dress Pistol
Gilded Dress Pistol.description: A jeweled sidearm meant for show that shoots straighter than any soldier's. Nobility, armed. [Mid | Epic | Crownveil]

Bulwark Wargreatshield.name: Bulwark Wargreatshield
Bulwark Wargreatshield.description: A tower shield so vast it is wielded as a weapon in its own right, flattening whatever it charges. [Mid | Epic | Crownveil]

Serpentcoil Whip.name: Serpentcoil Whip
Serpentcoil Whip.description: A flexible barbed whip that strikes like a viper and returns before the eye can follow. [Late | Epic | Thornblood]

Crownguard Helm.name: Crownguard Helm
Crownguard Helm.description: A knight's helm crested with the royal wing, worn by the Crown's chosen defenders. [Mid | Rare | Crownveil]

Emberplate Cuirass.name: Emberplate Cuirass
Emberplate Cuirass.description: A breastplate of heat-treated dragonsteel that shrugs off flame. Warm to the touch, always. [Late | Epic | Emberwake]

Tideweave Robe.name: Tideweave Robe
Tideweave Robe.description: A flowing robe woven with water-silk that turns aside blades as if they met a current. [Late | Epic | Tidelace]

Verdant Bark Mantle.name: Verdant Bark Mantle
Verdant Bark Mantle.description: Living bark-armor grown to the wearer's shoulders, hardening at a threat and softening at rest. [Late | Epic | Verdania]

Deephollow Greaves.name: Deephollow Greaves
Deephollow Greaves.description: Crystal-plated leg armor from the deep forges, heavy but unyielding against the mountain's hazards. [Mid | Rare | Deephollow]

Windrunner Riding Boots.name: Windrunner Riding Boots
Windrunner Riding Boots.description: Supple plains-leather boots that never tire the foot or spook the mount. [Mid | Rare | Windrunner]

Silverlight Gauntlets.name: Silverlight Gauntlets
Silverlight Gauntlets.description: Blessed gauntlets of the Ecclesia that glow faintly when guarding the innocent. [Mid | Rare | Ecclesia]

Rosethorn Masquerade Gown.name: Rosethorn Masquerade Gown
Rosethorn Masquerade Gown.description: A nocturne ballgown reinforced with hidden boning and charmed thread. Deadly and dazzling. [Mid | Epic | Rosethorn]

Ashenmere Champion Pauldrons.name: Ashenmere Champion Pauldrons
Ashenmere Champion Pauldrons.description: Arena shoulder-guards scarred by every bout their wearer survived. The crowd knows them by sight. [Mid | Rare | Ashenmere]

Veilpeak Frostcloak Hood.name: Veilpeak Frostcloak Hood
Veilpeak Frostcloak Hood.description: A fur-lined hood that keeps the killing cold of the high peaks at bay. [Mid | Rare | Veilpeak]

Twilight Court Regalia.name: Twilight Court Regalia
Twilight Court Regalia.description: Obsidian-threaded finery worn to the demon court, warding minor curses and colder stares. [Late | Epic | Twilight]

Aetherglass Cog-Bracers.name: Aetherglass Cog-Bracers
Aetherglass Cog-Bracers.description: Clockwork forearm guards that click and whir, catching blades in their gears. [Mid | Rare | Aetherglass]

Spiritfen Warding Robe.name: Spiritfen Warding Robe
Spiritfen Warding Robe.description: A robe hung with paper charms that turn aside malevolent spirits and the occasional dagger. [Mid | Rare | Spiritfen]

Cerulean Storm-Slicker.name: Cerulean Storm-Slicker
Cerulean Storm-Slicker.description: An oilskin coat of the coastal traders that sheds rain, spray, and light blows alike. [Mid | Rare | Cerulean]

Crownveil Parade Sabatons.name: Crownveil Parade Sabatons
Crownveil Parade Sabatons.description: Ceremonial steel boots polished to a mirror, sturdier than their shine suggests. [Mid | Rare | Crownveil]

Thornblood Rebel Wraps.name: Thornblood Rebel Wraps
Thornblood Rebel Wraps.description: Layered cloth-and-scrap armor of the reclamation, humble and stubbornly protective. [Low | Uncommon | Thornblood]

Golemheart Plate.name: Golemheart Plate
Golemheart Plate.description: Plate armor set with a fragment of golem-core, lending its wearer the patience of stone. [Late | Epic | Deephollow]

Duskfields Cavalry Helm.name: Duskfields Cavalry Helm
Duskfields Cavalry Helm.description: A plumed riding helm built to take a lance's graze and keep its wearer in the saddle. [Mid | Rare | Duskfields]

Moonwatch Vigil Mantle.name: Moonwatch Vigil Mantle
Moonwatch Vigil Mantle.description: A dawn-grey mantle of the Moonwatch, worn through countless night vigils against the dark. [Mid | Rare | Moonwatch]

Mirage Silk Veil-Hood.name: Mirage Silk Veil-Hood
Mirage Silk Veil-Hood.description: A shimmering hood that blurs the wearer's features to any but a trusted eye. [Mid | Epic | Mirage]

Beastkin Huntleather Vest.name: Beastkin Huntleather Vest
Beastkin Huntleather Vest.description: Supple hide armor scented to blend with the wild, prized by the beast-kin trackers. [Mid | Rare | Verdania]

Ecclesia Cathedral Plate.name: Ecclesia Cathedral Plate
Ecclesia Cathedral Plate.description: Gleaming ceremonial plate of the high church, as much sermon as armor. [Late | Epic | Ecclesia]

Crystalvein Prospector Boots.name: Crystalvein Prospector Boots
Crystalvein Prospector Boots.description: Reinforced boots with crystal-shod soles that grip any mine-slick stone. [Mid | Uncommon | Deephollow]

Lanternkeep Warden Gloves.name: Lanternkeep Warden Gloves
Lanternkeep Warden Gloves.description: Heat-resistant gloves of the covenant that tends the eternal flames. [Mid | Rare | Lanternkeep]

Warcrown Aegis.name: Warcrown Aegis
Warcrown Aegis.description: A war-crown worn into battle by rulers who lead from the front, warding blows meant for the head of state. [Late | Legendary | Crownveil]

Heart of the Dawnfire.name: Heart of the Dawnfire
Heart of the Dawnfire.description: A warm golden ember said to be a spark of Luxcellia's first sunrise, kept by the Ecclesia's highest. It steadies the faithful. [Endgame | Legendary | Ecclesia]

The Drowned Crown.name: The Drowned Crown
The Drowned Crown.description: A coral-crusted crown pulled from a sunken palace, whispering of a tide-kingdom that was. [Endgame | Legendary | Tidelace]

Obsidian Contract Seal.name: Obsidian Contract Seal
Obsidian Contract Seal.description: The demon court's binding seal, cold enough to frost bare skin. It makes a promise very hard to break. [Endgame | Legendary | Twilight]

Worldroot Seed.name: Worldroot Seed
Worldroot Seed.description: A seed from the tree that legend says holds Verdania together. It quickens life wherever its bearer treads gently. [Endgame | Legendary | Verdania]

Shard of the Broken Moon.name: Shard of the Broken Moon
Shard of the Broken Moon.description: A sliver of pale stone said to have fallen when the moon first cracked. It waxes with the tide of battle. [Endgame | Legendary | Tidelace]

Everstorm Core.name: Everstorm Core
Everstorm Core.description: A caged ball of perpetual lightning taken from the Duskfields' worst tempest. It never fully stills. [Late | Epic | Duskfields]

Codex of a Hundred Spells.name: Codex of a Hundred Spells
Codex of a Hundred Spells.description: A grimoire whose pages rearrange to show the spell its reader most needs. Its index is a mystery even to it. [Late | Epic | Academy]

Reliquary of the Kind Saint.name: Reliquary of the Kind Saint
Reliquary of the Kind Saint.description: A silver reliquary holding the finger-bone of a saint remembered only for mercy. It mends more than wounds. [Late | Epic | Ecclesia]

Crystalsong Geode.name: Crystalsong Geode
Crystalsong Geode.description: A hollow crystal that hums a chord no two people hear alike. The Crystalvein guard it jealously. [Late | Epic | Deephollow]

Ember of the Sleeping Wyrm.name: Ember of the Sleeping Wyrm
Ember of the Sleeping Wyrm.description: A single dragon-scale that holds a banked fire, warm with a slumbering beast's dream. [Late | Epic | Emberwake]

Veil Between Worlds.name: Veil Between Worlds
Veil Between Worlds.description: A tattered scrap of grey silk that thins the wall between the living and the spirit realm when unfolded. [Late | Epic | Spiritfen]

Timeless Hourglass.name: Timeless Hourglass
Timeless Hourglass.description: An hourglass whose sand runs in whichever direction its keeper wills, within limits the wise do not test. [Endgame | Legendary | Academy]

Everburning Vigil Lantern.name: Everburning Vigil Lantern
Everburning Vigil Lantern.description: A lantern from Lanternkeep whose flame has not died in a thousand years. Darkness simply refuses it. [Late | Epic | Lanternkeep]

Crown of Fallen Antlers.name: Crown of Fallen Antlers
Crown of Fallen Antlers.description: A shed antler-crown of the great forest-beast, worn by whoever the wild deems worthy to lead. [Late | Epic | Verdania]

Cerulean Trade Compact.name: Cerulean Trade Compact
Cerulean Trade Compact.description: The founding charter of the Merchant Lords, its signatures still binding centuries on. Deals struck under it hold. [Late | Epic | Cerulean]

Silver Crescent Diploma Sigil.name: Silver Crescent Diploma Sigil
Silver Crescent Diploma Sigil.description: The graduating sigil of the Silver Crescent Academy, marking a mage the world takes seriously. [Mid | Rare | Silver Crescent]

Thornblood Fallen Banner.name: Thornblood Fallen Banner
Thornblood Fallen Banner.description: A bloodstained banner carried by a fallen hero of the reclamation. It stiffens the spine of all who follow it. [Late | Epic | Thornblood]

Windrunner Ancestor Totem.name: Windrunner Ancestor Totem
Windrunner Ancestor Totem.description: A carved totem holding the guiding whispers of the confederacy's ancestors. It never lets its bearer lose the way. [Late | Epic | Windrunner]

Depthwarden Twin-Lamp.name: Depthwarden Twin-Lamp
Depthwarden Twin-Lamp.description: Paired glowstones that only shine when both halves are near, so no delver is ever lost alone. [Late | Epic | Deephollow]

The Unbroken Vow.name: The Unbroken Vow
The Unbroken Vow.description: A ring of two metals fused seamlessly, symbol of a promise no force has ever managed to sunder. [Endgame | Legendary | Ecclesia]

Ring of the Ninth Tide.name: Ring of the Ninth Tide
Ring of the Ninth Tide.description: A pearl ring that pulses with the sea's rhythm, granting calm under any pressure. [Mid | Rare | Tidelace]

Duskfields Windrider Charm.name: Duskfields Windrider Charm
Duskfields Windrider Charm.description: A feather charm that lightens the step and quickens the pulse before a charge. [Mid | Rare | Windrunner]

Moonwatch Insight Monocle.name: Moonwatch Insight Monocle
Moonwatch Insight Monocle.description: A lens ground by the Moonwatch that reveals the small tells others miss. [Mid | Rare | Moonwatch]

Rosethorn Charm Locket.name: Rosethorn Charm Locket
Rosethorn Charm Locket.description: A heart-shaped locket that warms when its wearer speaks true feeling. Popular and dangerous at court. [Mid | Rare | Rosethorn]

Crystalvein Focus Ring.name: Crystalvein Focus Ring
Crystalvein Focus Ring.description: A ring set with a resonant shard that sharpens any spell drawn through it. [Mid | Epic | Deephollow]

Guild Tenure Signet.name: Guild Tenure Signet
Guild Tenure Signet.description: A worn signet marking decades of guild service. Doors open for the hand that wears it. [Mid | Rare | Guild]

Spiritfen Ward-Bead Bracelet.name: Spiritfen Ward-Bead Bracelet
Spiritfen Ward-Bead Bracelet.description: A bracelet of carved beads that cool in warning when a spirit means harm. [Mid | Rare | Spiritfen]

Aetherglass Precision Goggles.name: Aetherglass Precision Goggles
Aetherglass Precision Goggles.description: Brass goggles with swappable lenses that steady the aim and reveal fine detail. [Mid | Rare | Aetherglass]

Twilight Pact Choker.name: Twilight Pact Choker
Twilight Pact Choker.description: An obsidian choker worn by those in the demon court's favor, lending an unsettling poise. [Mid | Epic | Twilight]

Verdant Bloom Circlet.name: Verdant Bloom Circlet
Verdant Bloom Circlet.description: A circlet of flowers that never wilt, calming beasts and people alike. [Mid | Rare | Verdania]

Cerulean Abacus Ring.name: Cerulean Abacus Ring
Cerulean Abacus Ring.description: A ring with a tiny working abacus, beloved of traders who never lose a sum. [Mid | Rare | Cerulean]

Silver Crescent Study Pin.name: Silver Crescent Study Pin
Silver Crescent Study Pin.description: An academy pin that faintly warms when its wearer is close to solving a problem. [Mid | Rare | Silver Crescent]

Ashenmere Crowd-Favor Band.name: Ashenmere Crowd-Favor Band
Ashenmere Crowd-Favor Band.description: An armband dyed in the colors a roaring crowd chose. Confidence, worn on the sleeve. [Mid | Rare | Ashenmere]

Lanternkeep Ember-Ward Ring.name: Lanternkeep Ember-Ward Ring
Lanternkeep Ember-Ward Ring.description: A ring that keeps a small flame lit against any wind, a covenant token of guidance. [Mid | Rare | Lanternkeep]

Festival Moon-Dumpling.name: Festival Moon-Dumpling
Festival Moon-Dumpling.description: A sweet rice dumpling shaped like the full moon, sold at every Luxcellia festival. Warmth and luck in one bite. [Any | Common | Festival]

Tidelace Sea-Broth.name: Tidelace Sea-Broth
Tidelace Sea-Broth.description: A restorative broth of coastal shellfish and kelp, said to clear the head and steady the hands. [Any | Common | Tidelace]

Emberwake Fire-Wine.name: Emberwake Fire-Wine
Emberwake Fire-Wine.description: A spiced wine that burns pleasantly going down and rekindles a flagging spirit. [Any | Uncommon | Emberwake]

Academy Focus Tonic.name: Academy Focus Tonic
Academy Focus Tonic.description: A bitter blue tonic brewed for exam season that sharpens the mind and refills the mana. [Any | Uncommon | Academy]

Verdant Honey-Draught.name: Verdant Honey-Draught
Verdant Honey-Draught.description: Wild honey mead from the forest hives, mending small hurts and soothing frayed nerves. [Any | Common | Verdania]

Duskfields Trail Jerky.name: Duskfields Trail Jerky
Duskfields Trail Jerky.description: Wind-dried spiced meat that keeps a rider going through a long hard ride. [Any | Common | Windrunner]

Rosethorn Nightcap Cordial.name: Rosethorn Nightcap Cordial
Rosethorn Nightcap Cordial.description: A velvet cordial served at the nocturne's end, restful and quietly restorative. [Any | Uncommon | Rosethorn]

Veilpeak Warmroot Stew.name: Veilpeak Warmroot Stew
Veilpeak Warmroot Stew.description: A thick mountain stew that drives out the deepest cold and the deepest exhaustion. [Any | Uncommon | Veilpeak]

Spiritfen Cleansing Tea.name: Spiritfen Cleansing Tea
Spiritfen Cleansing Tea.description: A pale tea that steadies the soul and eases the touch of malevolent spirits. [Any | Uncommon | Spiritfen]

Elixir of Second Wind.name: Elixir of Second Wind
Elixir of Second Wind.description: A rare tonic that surges through tired limbs like a fresh morning. Adventurers ration it carefully. [Late | Epic | Guild]

Cerulean Spiced Grog.name: Cerulean Spiced Grog
Cerulean Spiced Grog.description: A sailor's warming grog, rough and honest, that puts fight back into the weary. [Any | Common | Cerulean]

Crownveil Royal Confection.name: Crownveil Royal Confection
Crownveil Royal Confection.description: A delicate court sweet almost too pretty to eat. Almost. It lifts the spirits wonderfully. [Any | Uncommon | Crownveil]

Antidote Draught.name: Antidote Draught
Antidote Draught.description: A sharp green remedy that neutralizes most poisons and toxins in a single swallow. [Mid | Uncommon | Guild]

Zenith, the World-Severing Edge.name: Zenith, the World-Severing Edge
Zenith, the World-Severing Edge.description: The blade legend says cut the first horizon into land and sky. In a master's hand it ends arguments, armies, and eras. [Endgame | Mythic | Emberwake]

Duelist's Final Answer.name: Duelist's Final Answer
Duelist's Final Answer.description: A rapier so perfectly balanced it seems to move a heartbeat before its wielder decides to. No second exchange has ever been needed. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Skyfall Deadeye Bow.name: Skyfall Deadeye Bow
Skyfall Deadeye Bow.description: A greatbow that looses arrows which do not arc, refusing to fall until they reach what the archer named. [Endgame | Legendary | Verdania]

Ashenmere Executioner's Maul.name: Ashenmere Executioner's Maul
Ashenmere Executioner's Maul.description: A colossal maul that has ended more legends than it has owners. Whatever it strikes stays struck. [Endgame | Legendary | Ashenmere]

Stormpiercer Dragoon Lance.name: Stormpiercer Dragoon Lance
Stormpiercer Dragoon Lance.description: A lance that gathers the whole sky behind a descending blow. Its landing is mistaken, always, for thunder. [Endgame | Legendary | Duskfields]

Nightwhisper Twin Fangs.name: Nightwhisper Twin Fangs
Nightwhisper Twin Fangs.description: Paired daggers that make no sound, cast no shadow, and leave no warning. The dark's own opinion, delivered. [Endgame | Legendary | Underground]

Aegisbreaker Tower Shield.name: Aegisbreaker Tower Shield
Aegisbreaker Tower Shield.description: A shield-wall in one slab, so absolute that armies have reformed behind a single bearer. Nothing has gone through it. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Reaper's Last Harvest Scythe.name: Reaper's Last Harvest Scythe
Reaper's Last Harvest Scythe.description: A scythe that reaps more than the living, its edge humming with the tally of everything it has taken. [Endgame | Legendary | Twilight]

Worldrender Waraxe.name: Worldrender Waraxe
Worldrender Waraxe.description: A two-bit axe of dragon-iron that splits shields, gates, and the occasional hillside with equal indifference. [Endgame | Legendary | Emberwake]

Tempest Grand Tessen.name: Tempest Grand Tessen
Tempest Grand Tessen.description: An iron war-fan that unfolds a gale with each sweep, courtly and catastrophic in the same motion. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Serpent Sovereign Whip.name: Serpent Sovereign Whip
Serpent Sovereign Whip.description: A living-metal whip that strikes from angles geometry forbids and returns before the eye admits it left. [Endgame | Legendary | Thornblood]

Endless Coil Chainblade.name: Endless Coil Chainblade
Endless Coil Chainblade.description: A chain-blade with no measurable length, always reaching exactly as far as the wielder wills. [Endgame | Legendary | Deephollow]

Kingslayer Repeater.name: Kingslayer Repeater
Kingslayer Repeater.description: A clockwork firearm of impossible cadence, its report the last sound many crowned heads ever heard. [Endgame | Legendary | Aetherglass]

Sky-Fist of the Ascended Monk.name: Sky-Fist of the Ascended Monk
Sky-Fist of the Ascended Monk.description: Wraps blessed at the mountain's peak that turn a bare strike into a thunderclap. The body, made final argument. [Endgame | Legendary | Veilpeak]

Grave-Warden Kusarigama.name: Grave-Warden Kusarigama
Grave-Warden Kusarigama.description: A sickle-and-chain that binds a foe to their own shadow before the killing pull. Escape is a courtesy it does not extend. [Endgame | Legendary | Spiritfen]

Grand Arcanum Codex.name: Grand Arcanum Codex
Grand Arcanum Codex.description: A grimoire holding every theorem the Academy dared not teach at once. Its reader thinks in spells. [Endgame | Legendary | Academy]

Prime Element Scepter.name: Prime Element Scepter
Prime Element Scepter.description: A scepter through which fire, water, wind, and stone answer a single will without argument. [Endgame | Legendary | Academy]

Sunforge Grand Staff.name: Sunforge Grand Staff
Sunforge Grand Staff.description: A staff crowned with a captive sunrise, its light both blessing and blade. [Endgame | Legendary | Ecclesia]

Abyssal Choir Rod.name: Abyssal Choir Rod
Abyssal Choir Rod.description: A rod that hums with the dark between stars, speaking spells in a voice older than fear. [Endgame | Legendary | Twilight]

Everburning Wyrmheart Focus.name: Everburning Wyrmheart Focus
Everburning Wyrmheart Focus.description: A caged dragon-heart ember that turns a pyromancer's intent into a firestorm on command. [Endgame | Legendary | Emberwake]

Deeptide Sovereign Trident.name: Deeptide Sovereign Trident
Deeptide Sovereign Trident.description: A trident that commands the sea itself, its every thrust backed by a phantom tide. [Endgame | Legendary | Tidelace]

Eternal Winter Scepter.name: Eternal Winter Scepter
Eternal Winter Scepter.description: A scepter that carries the stillness of a world under ice. What it touches simply stops. [Endgame | Legendary | Veilpeak]

Skysunder Stormrod.name: Skysunder Stormrod
Skysunder Stormrod.description: A rod that pulls the storm down on a whim, thunder and ruin braided into one strike. [Endgame | Legendary | Duskfields]

Worldroot Living Stave.name: Worldroot Living Stave
Worldroot Living Stave.description: A stave still growing, rooted in the wielder's own resolve. Nature answers it as kin. [Endgame | Legendary | Verdania]

Tectonic Grand Warhammer.name: Tectonic Grand Warhammer
Tectonic Grand Warhammer.description: A hammer whose blows wake the sleeping strength of the earth beneath any battlefield. [Endgame | Legendary | Deephollow]

Verdigris Plaguecrown Focus.name: Verdigris Plaguecrown Focus
Verdigris Plaguecrown Focus.description: A corroded crown-focus that turns a toxomancer's will into a slow, inevitable verdict. [Endgame | Legendary | Wilds]

Crownfall Gravitic Orb.name: Crownfall Gravitic Orb
Crownfall Gravitic Orb.description: An orb of collapsed weight that bends the field, the fight, and the horizon toward its holder. [Endgame | Legendary | Aetherglass]

Hourless Chronoscepter.name: Hourless Chronoscepter
Hourless Chronoscepter.description: A scepter that spends borrowed seconds, letting its wielder act in the gaps between everyone else's heartbeats. [Endgame | Legendary | Academy]

Constellation Grand Astrolabe.name: Constellation Grand Astrolabe
Constellation Grand Astrolabe.description: A star-focus that calls down the specific fury of a named constellation. The sky obeys the chart. [Endgame | Legendary | Starfall]

Mirage Sovereign Prism.name: Mirage Sovereign Prism
Mirage Sovereign Prism.description: A prism-focus that layers a dozen convincing lies over one lethal truth. [Endgame | Legendary | Mirage]

Deepdream Weaver's Loom-Rod.name: Deepdream Weaver's Loom-Rod
Deepdream Weaver's Loom-Rod.description: A rod that reaches into sleep itself, reshaping the dreams of the many and the one. [Endgame | Legendary | Spiritfen]

Heartcrystal Resonant Blade.name: Heartcrystal Resonant Blade
Heartcrystal Resonant Blade.description: A singing crystal blade whose chord shatters stone, ward, and resolve alike. [Endgame | Legendary | Deephollow]

Umbral Throne Regalia-Blade.name: Umbral Throne Regalia-Blade
Umbral Throne Regalia-Blade.description: A blade of woven shadow that rises from the wielder's own darkness, a monarch's will made edge. [Endgame | Legendary | Twilight]

Voidmaw Nullstaff.name: Voidmaw Nullstaff
Voidmaw Nullstaff.description: A staff crowned with a small perfect nothing that unmakes whatever it is aimed to erase. [Endgame | Legendary | Twilight]

Foldspace Sovereign Cube.name: Foldspace Sovereign Cube
Foldspace Sovereign Cube.description: A cube-focus that holds a fold of the world, letting a spatiomancer rewrite where things are. [Endgame | Legendary | Aetherglass]

Everstorm Grand Focus.name: Everstorm Grand Focus
Everstorm Grand Focus.description: A focus holding a storm that never breaks, only waits for the storm-caller's word. [Endgame | Legendary | Duskfields]

Grand Enchanter's Sovereign Loom.name: Grand Enchanter's Sovereign Loom
Grand Enchanter's Sovereign Loom.description: An enchanting loom that binds power into anything its wielder deems worthy. Craft raised to command. [Endgame | Legendary | Academy]

Kingmaker's Silver Tongue Fan.name: Kingmaker's Silver Tongue Fan
Kingmaker's Silver Tongue Fan.description: A courtly fan whose bearer's every word lands like law. Battles end before they begin. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Grand Deceiver's Marked Deck.name: Grand Deceiver's Marked Deck
Grand Deceiver's Marked Deck.description: A card-deck that always holds the winning hand and the perfect lie in the same cut. [Endgame | Legendary | Underground]

Apex Predator's Huntblade.name: Apex Predator's Huntblade
Apex Predator's Huntblade.description: A survival blade that has bested every beast the wilds could offer. The wild now steps aside. [Endgame | Legendary | Wilds]

Grandmaster's Aerial Silks.name: Grandmaster's Aerial Silks
Grandmaster's Aerial Silks.description: Weighted combat silks that turn a battlefield into a stage where only the dancer can keep up. [Endgame | Legendary | Festival]

Titan's Stride Battle-Vaulter.name: Titan's Stride Battle-Vaulter
Titan's Stride Battle-Vaulter.description: A vaulting polearm built for warriors who cross a battlefield in a single leap and land like a siege. [Endgame | Legendary | Duskfields]

Truthfinder's Master Case.name: Truthfinder's Master Case
Truthfinder's Master Case.description: An investigator's kit so complete that no scheme survives its scrutiny. Knowledge, weaponized. [Endgame | Legendary | Guild]

Worldstage Sovereign Instrument.name: Worldstage Sovereign Instrument
Worldstage Sovereign Instrument.description: A performer's instrument that bends a whole crowd, a whole battle, to its melody. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Deepmaze Sovereign Compass.name: Deepmaze Sovereign Compass
Deepmaze Sovereign Compass.description: A dungeon-focus that reads the bones of any labyrinth and turns its traps against it. [Endgame | Legendary | Riftmaw]

Aegis of the Eternal Dawn.name: Aegis of the Eternal Dawn
Aegis of the Eternal Dawn.description: Radiant plate said to have never let its wearer fall while the sun still rose. The last line, made metal. [Endgame | Mythic | Ecclesia]

Wyrmscale Sovereign Cuirass.name: Wyrmscale Sovereign Cuirass
Wyrmscale Sovereign Cuirass.description: A cuirass of true dragonscale that shrugs off flame, blade, and doubt alike. [Endgame | Legendary | Emberwake]

Voidweave Shadowmantle.name: Voidweave Shadowmantle
Voidweave Shadowmantle.description: A mantle woven from captured darkness, turning the wearer half-unreal to those who would strike them. [Endgame | Legendary | Twilight]

Worldtree Living Aegis.name: Worldtree Living Aegis
Worldtree Living Aegis.description: Grown bark-plate that hardens against harm and knits its wearer's wounds between blows. [Endgame | Legendary | Verdania]

Crown of the Undethroned.name: Crown of the Undethroned
Crown of the Undethroned.description: A war-crown worn by rulers who never once knelt. Blows meant for the head of state simply miss. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Helm of the Sleepless Vigil.name: Helm of the Sleepless Vigil
Helm of the Sleepless Vigil.description: A helm from the Moonwatch's founder, said to see the strike before it is thrown. [Endgame | Legendary | Moonwatch]

Greaves of the Unmoved Mountain.name: Greaves of the Unmoved Mountain
Greaves of the Unmoved Mountain.description: Leg-plates so grounded that no force has ever shifted the one who stood in them. [Endgame | Legendary | Deephollow]

Stormstep Sovereign Boots.name: Stormstep Sovereign Boots
Stormstep Sovereign Boots.description: Boots that let their wearer cross a battlefield between one breath and the next. [Endgame | Legendary | Duskfields]

Gauntlets of the First Guard.name: Gauntlets of the First Guard
Gauntlets of the First Guard.description: Gauntlets that catch blades bare-handed and give them back broken. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Tidewoven Sovereign Robe.name: Tidewoven Sovereign Robe
Tidewoven Sovereign Robe.description: A caster's robe that flows like deep water, turning aside steel and spell with the same current. [Endgame | Legendary | Tidelace]

Archmagus Regalia of the Nine.name: Archmagus Regalia of the Nine
Archmagus Regalia of the Nine.description: The layered regalia of a master caster, every thread a reservoir of power. [Endgame | Legendary | Academy]

Ashen Champion's Full Plate.name: Ashen Champion's Full Plate
Ashen Champion's Full Plate.description: Arena plate worn by the only fighter to leave the Ashenmere sands undefeated. [Endgame | Legendary | Ashenmere]

Ring of Boundless Mana.name: Ring of Boundless Mana
Ring of Boundless Mana.description: A ring humming with a bottomless well of power. Casters weep when they first wear it. [Endgame | Legendary | Academy]

Amulet of the Unbroken Heart.name: Amulet of the Unbroken Heart
Amulet of the Unbroken Heart.description: An amulet that has kept its wearer standing through wounds that should have ended them. [Endgame | Legendary | Ecclesia]

Sovereign's Signet of Command.name: Sovereign's Signet of Command
Sovereign's Signet of Command.description: A ruler's signet whose word armies obey and enemies hesitate before. [Endgame | Legendary | Crownveil]

Eye of the All-Seeing Oracle.name: Eye of the All-Seeing Oracle
Eye of the All-Seeing Oracle.description: A lens that reveals the truth of any person, trap, or lie laid before it. [Endgame | Legendary | Moonwatch]

Bloodpact Sovereign Band.name: Bloodpact Sovereign Band
Bloodpact Sovereign Band.description: A dark ring that trades a sliver of vitality for overwhelming power. Temptation, worn on the hand. [Endgame | Legendary | Twilight]

Heartstone of the World's First Dawn.name: Heartstone of the World's First Dawn
Heartstone of the World's First Dawn.description: A relic holding a spark of Luxcellia's very beginning. In worthy hands it steadies every ally near. [Endgame | Mythic | Ecclesia]
