The monarch's shadow ripples, and soldiers of living darkness answer: assaulting, shielding, flanking, or scattering at a gesture. They fight without fear because they have nothing left to lose. The shadows obey best in dim light and falter in blazing sun or consecrated ground, and each fresh command draws on the monarch's presence; issue too many too fast and the darkness starts moving sluggishly, like a tide asked to turn twice in an hour.
[Shadow Magic: 1]

Shadow Network.name: Shadow Network
Shadow Network.description:
Activate a pre-planted network of hidden information nodes, disguised listeners, enchanted marks, bribed contacts, and surveillance magic, that feed real-time intelligence during combat and infiltration. Know enemy positions, incoming reinforcements, escape routes, and who is lying before anyone else does. Out of combat, know who is following you, what they want, and how much they are being paid.
[Stealth: 15]

Shield Reflect.name: Shield Reflect
Shield Reflect.description:
The shield angled at the precise instant of magical impact: the spell bounced, returning to its caster with all its original conviction. The window is a heartbeat's width: a fact the technique's masters mention often and its students' families mention at funerals. Mages struck by their own fireball undergo combat's purest theater.
[Shield Combat: 21]

Solar Blessing.name: Solar Blessing
Solar Blessing.description:
Sunlight, routed through a person on its way to someone who needs it: wounds mending, status effects burning off like morning fog, capabilities lifted while the light holds. Mend, cleanse, empower: the discipline's full breakfast. The blessed report the same detail: for a moment, they cast no shadow, and it felt like approval.
[Light Magic: 7]

Spatial Anchor.name: Spatial Anchor
Spatial Anchor.description:
Mark a location in space. For the next several minutes, you can instantly teleport back to that exact point regardless of distance. One anchor at a time. The anchor appears as a faint geometric shimmer visible only to you.
[Space Magic: 3]

Spectral Grasp.name: Spectral Grasp
Spectral Grasp.description:
Ghostly hands breach the ground like the earth remembering its tenants: translucent, skeletal, grabbing at enemies' legs: rooting them in place while necrotic cold seeps up through the grip. Held, by the departed, for reasons the departed keep private. The grasp roots those it catches while dealing its patient damage, it reaches from the ground and only the ground (fliers watch the hands wave, unbothered), and the sight of the earth reaching has its own second effect: enemies who tear free step differently for the rest of the fight.
[Dark Magic: 23]

Spirit Binding.name: Spirit Binding
Spirit Binding.description:
Chains of consecrated light close around the evil spirit and hold: no drifting through walls, no possession, no vanishing into the floorboards: pinned, furious, and finally required to listen. The binding demands the exorcist's sustained will; it holds until the spirit tears free or the exorcist chooses release, and stronger entities test the chains constantly. Binding something ancient is less a technique than a staring contest with stakes.
[Spirit Channeling: 14]

Spirit Conduit.name: Spirit Conduit
Spirit Conduit.description:
The walker stops visiting the spirit realm and becomes its doorway: spiritual energy pouring through their body: every attack landing with devastating spirit damage, every healing doubled, a person functioning briefly as infrastructure between worlds. The conduit runs while the walker's frame can host the current (channeling a realm is not a metaphor; the exhaustion afterward is structural), and standing that close to the other side has a famous side effect: for the duration, the dead can see the conduit clearly, and some of them wave.
[Spirit Channeling: 89]

Spirit Whisper.name: Spirit Whisper
Spirit Whisper.description:
Hear the last words or lingering thoughts of the dead at a location where someone perished. The spirit echoes are fragmentary but genuine: a name, a warning, a confession, or the location of something they hid before the end.
[Spirit Channeling: 2]

Stone Fortress.name: Stone Fortress
Stone Fortress.description:
The earth stands up on request: walls of stone rising around the caster or an ally: instant cover, durable enough to shrug off arrows, monster charges, and moderate spells with geological indifference. Architecture at conversation speed. The fortress rises where called and stays as honest stone (it can be climbed, flanked, and eventually battered; it buys time, not immortality), it needs true ground to rise from, and geomancers measure their art by how casually they can wall a friend mid-sentence.
[Earth Magic: 4]

Summon Network.name: Summon Network
Summon Network.description:
The summoner draws a stable gate into the air and the battlefield stops having distances: every summon gains instant teleportation to any point in the fight: the tank appearing at the collapsing flank, the striker materializing behind the caster, the entire army repositioning like a thought. Logistics become a superpower. The network moves summons only (the summoner still walks), holds while the gate is maintained, and a visible standing gate is the kind of strategic object enemies prioritize with flattering violence.
[persuasion: 39]

Temporal Clone.name: Temporal Clone
Temporal Clone.description:
The rift opens between present and past, and the caster's own past self steps through to fight beside them: two of you, both real, both dangerous, paradox headache included at no extra charge. Coordination is perfect, because both of you already agreed. The clone attends briefly before the timeline reels it home, harm to the past self is a philosophical problem the caster gets to experience personally, and casting it twice in a day is how chronomancers earn the sanatorium discount.
[Time Magic: 34]

Thread Control.name: Thread Control
Thread Control.description:
Extend invisible threads of mana from your fingertips to control constructs, puppets, and animated weapons with perfect precision. You can coordinate multiple constructs simultaneously, channel your senses through them, and manipulate objects at range. The strings are unbreakable. The performance is flawless.
[Enchanting: 5]

Timeline Sight.name: Timeline Sight
Timeline Sight.description:
The chronomancer watches several futures at once: branching timelines running like parallel plays, each choice's outcome legible before it's made: for the duration, every tactical decision is supernaturally informed, hindsight arriving early. The sight shows outcomes of the viewer's own choices rather than scripting the enemy's (free wills stay stubbornly unwritten), holding multiple timelines open is a migraine wearing a crown, and chronomancers emerge from the sight briefly unsure which present they kept.
[Time Magic: 27]

Tracking Sense.name: Tracking Sense
Tracking Sense.description:
Your wilderness training gives you the ability to read tracks, identify monster types by their prints, estimate numbers, and determine how recently they passed. Essential for avoiding ambushes and finding prey.
[survival: 2]

Treasure Sense.name: Treasure Sense
Treasure Sense.description:
Sense the presence of hidden loot, secret chambers, or concealed objects nearby. You feel the pull of things that want to be found: a faint warmth, a subtle tug, or the gut certainty that there is something valuable just out of sight.
[Treasure Seeking: 2]

Umbral Eclipse.name: Umbral Eclipse
Umbral Eclipse.description:
The crown of sovereign dark: curses empowered past their station, dread pressure that arrives before the caster does, hostile light suppressed like an interrupted argument: all without the corruption lesser dark magic charges as interest. Darkness, governed rather than fed. Rooms notice it as a change in gravity nobody can point to.
[Shadow Magic: 10]

Wings of Light.name: Wings of Light
Wings of Light.description:
Manifest wings of divine radiance from your back, granting temporary flight and increased movement speed. While airborne, your healing and smite abilities have increased range. The visual is angelic and very anime.
[Light Magic: 53]

Winter's Touch.name: Winter's Touch
Winter's Touch.description: Chill a target with a touch or gesture, slowing their movement and weakening their next physical action. The cold settles into muscle and bone like a winter night; not lethal, but deeply debilitating.

Adamantine Body.name: Adamantine Body
Adamantine Body.description:
Your body transcends mere iron: your skin becomes true adamantine, impervious to all but the most legendary weapons. Physical attacks shatter against you. Magical projectiles deflect. For a brief, terrifying moment, you are not a warrior; you are a wall with intentions. The ground cracks beneath your feet from the density shift.
[athletics: 15]

Ancestral Chief.name: Ancestral Chief
Ancestral Chief.description:
The call goes to the head of the table: a great ancestral chief answering: a spirit that commands other spirits, arriving with the presence of someone who has been obeyed for four hundred years and sees no reason to stop. The whole party stands taller under massive ancestral blessings; lesser spirits snap to order. The chief attends briefly and by profound respect (this is an audience granted, never a summons served), expects the battle to be worthy of the interruption, and the shaman who calls frivolously will be told so, in front of everyone, at ancestral volume.
[Spirit Channeling: 74]

Anomalous Spark.name: Anomalous Spark
Anomalous Spark.description: Your magic does not behave the way entrance exams say it should. Once per scene, you can produce a small impossible-looking magical effect: a spell bending sideways, a rune lighting without fuel, or a harmless burst of power that proves the rules are more flexible around you.

Arcane Analysis.name: Arcane Analysis
Arcane Analysis.description:
The sage reads a thing until it confesses permanently: enchantments cataloged, curses identified, blessings verified, hidden magical signatures, invisible to everyone else, rendered in clear annotation that never fades from the sage's understanding. Knowledge, notarized. The analysis studies one item, creature, or effect per working and takes focused time in its company, it reveals what is rather than what could be, and sages who have analyzed a courtly gift in front of its giver know the technique's true danger: some signatures identify their author.
[Enchanting: 34]

Arcane Overload.name: Arcane Overload
Arcane Overload.description:
The mage force-feeds mana past capacity: excess power crammed into an enemy or construct until the vessel destabilizes and detonates: living targets taking massive arcane damage from the inside. Destruction by donation. The sturdier the vessel, the longer the pour and the louder the conclusion.
[Arcane Magic: 21]

Army of Spirits.name: Army of Spirits
Army of Spirits.description:
The fallen answer a solemn roll call: spectral soldiers rising in ranks, each one thin as memory, all of them together an overwhelming tide of grasping hands and half-remembered war cries. No single spirit matters. All of them do. The army holds while the summoner's concentration and reverence hold (the dead serve respect, not commands) and raising a legion of the departed in view of the Church is a conversation waiting to happen.
[Spirit Channeling: 79]

Beast Companion.name: Beast Companion
Beast Companion.description:
Form a bond with a wild creature that becomes your permanent companion. The beast fights alongside you, scouts ahead, and provides comfort during long wilderness journeys. The bond deepens with time and trust.
[Beast Keeping: 8]

Blade Resonance.name: Blade Resonance
Blade Resonance.description:
Harmonize your mana with your weapon so completely that the sword becomes an extension of your body. For the duration, all sword techniques deal increased damage and cost less stamina. The blade hums with your intent.
[Spirit Channeling: 25]

Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning.description:
The bolt leaves the caller's hand hunting: it takes the first target, then arcs, one, two, three, leaping between anyone standing close enough to share the lesson, leaving muscles locked and hair smoking. Clustered enemies are an invitation. The chain weakens with each jump, refuses to arc across true insulation, and the caller's fingertips need time to stop buzzing before the sky lends them another.
[Lightning Magic: 2]

Cleansing Light.name: Cleansing Light
Cleansing Light.description:
Radiance in a single indignant burst: poisons neutralized, curses unhooked, afflictions and dark magic scoured off the target like grime under a waterfall of noon. It works on people, on corrupted ground, on tainted relics: anything wearing darkness it was not born with. The light purges afflictions rather than wounds (the poison ends; the damage it did remains honest), and each cleansing spends the caster's gathered sanctity, which returns at prayer's pace, not battle's.
[Light Magic: 8]

Crystal Barrage.name: Crystal Barrage
Crystal Barrage.description:
Razor crystal, fired in the plural: a volley of shards embedding in flesh and armor, then the patient cruelty: the crystals crack and splinter where they sit, dealing ongoing damage inside the wound. Ammunition with a payment plan. Field medics facing crystal wounds develop a specific weary expression the casters recognize and, privately, enjoy.
[Crystal Magic: 3]

Dance of Blades.name: Dance of Blades
Dance of Blades.description:
The bard turns percussion into command: a driving melody that synchronizes the party's attacks: every ally striking in tempo, a brawl reorganized into choreography with casualties. Silencing the drummer is the counter every enemy attempts by the second verse. Parties describe fighting inside it identically: knowing, somehow, exactly when.
[performance: 59]

Demon's Whisper.name: Demon's Whisper
Demon's Whisper.description:
Channel a demonic whisper into a target's mind, disrupting their concentration and causing psychic damage. Spellcasters lose focus and martial fighters hesitate. The target hears something deeply personal and deeply wrong.
[Dark Magic: 3]

Diamond Bastion.name: Diamond Bastion
Diamond Bastion.description:
Earth, compressed past stubbornness into certainty: diamond-hard crystal formed into a fortress around the caster and allies: withstanding siege-level attacks with mineral serenity while energy spells reflect off the facets, returned with lapidary spite. Armies that watch their barrage bounce describe the light show with reluctant honesty: it was beautiful, and it was theirs.
[Earth Magic: 10]

Discordant Note.name: Discordant Note
Discordant Note.description:
Strike a deliberately jarring, dissonant note that damages enemies' concentration and causes brief disorientation. The sound is weaponized ugly: a frequency that makes teeth ache and thoughts scatter.
[performance: 2]

Divine Blessing.name: Divine Blessing
Divine Blessing.description:
A celestial entity has marked you with their favor. Holy magic responds to your will with unusual ease: healing, purification, barriers, and smiting all come naturally. The blessing also provides passive protection against curses and corruption, and occasionally manifests as a soft golden glow at dramatically appropriate moments. You didn't ask for divine attention, but you got it, and whatever is watching you seems invested in your success.
[Divinity: 3]

Divine Guardian.name: Divine Guardian
Divine Guardian.description:
The summons goes up, and an angelic warrior answers: a celestial guardian descending in armor of dawn, fighting evil entities with particular, personal ferocity: dark magic sliding off it like night off a sunrise. Against the unholy it is not a summon; it is a sentence. The guardian cannot be harmed by dark magic but remains honest against mundane force, attends for a finite grace, and answers only calls with genuine righteousness in them: the divine does not staff mercenary work.
[Divinity: 31]

Divine Judgment.name: Divine Judgment
Divine Judgment.description:
The ultimate Exorcist technique. Channel the full authority of the divine and pronounce Judgment: an irrevocable verdict upon all evil in range. Undead disintegrate, demons are banished, possessing spirits are torn from their hosts, dark portals slam shut, and curses shatter like glass. Let there be light.
[Light Magic: 65]

Earthquake Slam.name: Earthquake Slam
Earthquake Slam.description:
Leap into the air and crash down with world-shattering force. The impact creates actual fault lines in the ground, damages structures, and devastates everything in a massive radius. Environmental destruction as a combat strategy.
[athletics: 63]

Enchanted Slash.name: Enchanted Slash
Enchanted Slash.description:
The signature Spellblade technique, first page of the school's book: elemental energy laid along the blade, one slash delivering physical and magical damage in a single motion. Deliberately fundamental; everything the school builds later conjugates from this. Veterans identify a spellblade's attunement from across a field by the color their opening slash leaves in the air.
[Elemental Magic: 3]

Explosive Arrow.name: Explosive Arrow
Explosive Arrow.description:
The arrow lands and the argument expands: an elemental detonation on impact (fire, ice, or lightning by the archer's attunement) turning a precision weapon into area damage with a signature flavor. One shot, everyone's problem. The blast radius is honest and impartial (allies in melee with the target will have feedback), each explosive head is fletched in advance from real supplies, and the boom that clears a corridor also announces the archer's position to the entire floor plan.
[Archery: 4]

Familiar Fusion.name: Familiar Fusion
Familiar Fusion.description:
The witch and the familiar pour into one shape: a hybrid form carrying her cunning and its instincts: sharper senses, borrowed abilities, physical traits worn like a well-argued compromise. The result unsettles everyone including, briefly, both participants. The fusion holds for its window before unwinding into two slightly embarrassed individuals, it demands a familiar's deep trust (a bond of treats and years, not contract clauses), and the merged form thinks in a plural the witch describes afterward as 'crowded, but useful.'
[Spirit Channeling: 65]

Flurry of Blows.name: Flurry of Blows
Flurry of Blows.description:
The monk stops being visible in useful detail: a chain of punches and kicks faster than tracking, each individually light, the accumulation devastating: dozens of strikes arriving as one sustained argument. Death by arithmetic. The flurry spends stamina like a waterfall spends water (when it ends, the monk breathes like the bill arrived), it wants a target held in range for the full sequence, and armored enemies discover the technique's quiet truth: nothing is armored everywhere, and the flurry is checking.
[acrobatics: 3]

Fortress Stance.name: Fortress Stance
Fortress Stance.description:
Plant yourself and become immovable: you cannot be pushed, pulled, knocked down, displaced, or moved by any force short of divine intervention, and allies within your shadow take drastically reduced damage. Your heartbeat sounds like a war drum. The stance protects on the turn you take it; holding it takes your action again each turn.
[athletics: 12]

Fortune's Favor.name: Fortune's Favor
Fortune's Favor.description:
Bend probability in your favor for a brief window: enemy attacks miss by impossible margins, your wild swings connect perfectly, and unlikely events cascade in your favor. You can feel the luck draining as you use it. Push too hard and the universe will collect its debt.
[persuasion: 5]

Foxfire Barrage.name: Foxfire Barrage
Foxfire Barrage.description:
Summon a swarm of foxfire wisps that orbit your position and launch at targets as homing projectiles. The fire is spiritual, not physical; it burns the soul rather than the body, making it devastating against corrupted enemies, spirits, and undead. Living targets feel a deep chill rather than heat.
[Illusion Magic: 5]

Full Marionette.name: Full Marionette
Full Marionette.description:
Threads to every joint: the puppeteer takes full control of a target's body: walking them, turning them, raising their weapon with their own reluctant arm. The target becomes a puppet in truth, a passenger behind their own eyes. Strong wills can resist, and do: full control of a person is a continuous war the puppeteer fights with every string at once, brief by necessity and exhausting by design. And the freed remember the feeling of being worn; it is the single most personal grudge the profession generates.
[Artifice: 30]

Glacial Barrier.name: Glacial Barrier
Glacial Barrier.description:
Raise a thick wall of solid ice that blocks attacks and chills anything that touches it. The barrier is transparent, letting you see through, and refracts light in ways that can obscure exact positions. It guards those behind it on the turn you raise it; keeping it whole takes your action again each turn.
[Ice Magic: 7]

Golden Leverage.name: Golden Leverage
Golden Leverage.description:
Throw expensive items, coin pouches, jewelry, trade goods, or weighted ingots, with pinpoint accuracy to distract, blind, or redirect enemy attention. The impact is surprisingly painful for something so valuable. The user keeps a running tally of costs and bills the party afterward.
[persuasion: 3]

Guardian Spirit.name: Guardian Spirit
Guardian Spirit.description:
A protective spirit takes up orbit around the summoner: a soft presence circling like a patient moon, interposing itself to soften incoming blows. The comfort is real. So is the protection: it dilutes killing blows rather than deleting them, and spirits who guard well are owed gratitude: walkers who forget find their next guardian arrives slower. It guards you on the turn you call it; keeping it close takes your action again each turn.
[Spirit Channeling: 4]

Guardian's Oath.name: Guardian's Oath
Guardian's Oath.description:
One ally, sworn: a visible thread of light runs between guardian and charge: their damage arrives reduced, and lethal attacks are intercepted, the guardian's body moving before the decision finishes. Choosing who is the ability's entire weight, and the guardian pays the intercepted blow's full price. It guards your sworn ally on the turn you invoke it; keeping the oath active takes your action again each turn.
[Swordsmanship: 56]

Healing Draught.name: Healing Draught
Healing Draught.description:
Throw a prepared healing potion with surprising accuracy, restoring an ally's health mid-combat. The potions taste terrible and occasionally turn the recipient's hair a temporary color, but they work reliably. Brewing under pressure produces stronger results.
[Alchemy: 4]

Heartfelt Token.name: Heartfelt Token
Heartfelt Token.description:
Craft a small gift that resonates deeply with its intended recipient: a charm that matches their element, a trinket that echoes a shared memory, or a sweet made from their favorite flavor. The gift carries emotional weight that strengthens bonds.
[Gift Crafting: 2]

Herbal Antidote.name: Herbal Antidote
Herbal Antidote.description:
Identify and prepare an herbal antidote for poisons, venoms, or toxins affecting an ally. You know which root counteracts snake venom, which flower neutralizes alchemical poison, and which mushroom absolutely does not help no matter what the old stories say.
[Herbalism: 3]

Iron Will Parry.name: Iron Will Parry
Iron Will Parry.description:
The parry that technique cannot explain: fueled by pure refusal, the blade moving to block attacks the swordsman should never have been able to react to: the ambush from behind, the feint that worked, the blow already past the guard. When you refuse to be hit, the steel agrees. The parry draws on willpower as a resource (a rattled or doubting heart parries at merely human speed), it answers one impossible moment per gathering of resolve, and masters teach it last, because students must first survive long enough to want something that badly.
[Swordsmanship: 35]

Ironbark Shield.name: Ironbark Shield
Ironbark Shield.description:
Living bark flows over the warden's shield and hardens into something between wood and stubbornness: blows sink in and are swallowed, and thorns push out through the grain to answer anyone who strikes it. The bark is grown, not conjured: it needs a real shield beneath it and drinks a little of the warden's vitality as sap. It guards you on the turn you grow it; keeping it grown takes your action again each turn.
[Nature Magic: 2]

Leviathan's Maw.name: Leviathan's Maw
Leviathan's Maw.description:
Water shaped into the head of something the ocean would recognize: a massive sea-serpent maw clamping on the target for immense damage, followed by the signature indignity of being dragged briefly underwater, on land, in front of everyone. Renka's sailors insist the technique is either homage or extremely bad manners.
[Water Magic: 9]

Living Fortress.name: Living Fortress
Living Fortress.description:
The warden asks the local vegetation for architecture: trees and undergrowth surging into a protective enclosure around the party: living walls, thick and self-repairing, bristling outward with thorns that hold opinions. Shelter that photosynthesizes. The fortress grows from what grows there (deserts and stone halls offer thin lumber), and enemies who hack through find its last argument: the walls remember, and the forest they came from is right there. It guards the party on the turn you raise it; mending it takes your action again each turn.
[Nature Magic: 20]

Lord of Shadows.name: Lord of Shadows
Lord of Shadows.description:
The ultimate Dark Knight transformation. Shadows converge on your body, forming living armor of pure darkness. Your attacks drain life on every hit, your speed and power are massively enhanced, and the battlefield dims as light itself retreats from your presence.
[Shadow Magic: 62]

Luminous Shield.name: Luminous Shield
Luminous Shield.description:
Solid light, standing guard: a golden-white shield warm to the touch, blocking physical and magical attacks with radiant patience while dark magic splashes off it harmlessly, offended. Protection you can read by: against darkness it is nearly absolute, against honest steel merely excellent, and its glow is a lighthouse in every sense: allies rally to it instinctively, and enemies know exactly where the light-caster stands. It guards you or one ally on the turn you raise it; keeping it up takes your action again each turn.
[Light Magic: 3]

Medicinal Salve.name: Medicinal Salve
Medicinal Salve.description:
The healer's own recipe, smelling of crushed herbs and competence: applied to a wound, it works steadily over time: flesh closing in patient increments, pain retreating like a tide with somewhere to be. It works best when the patient holds still, which is the eternal war of field medicine. The salve heals over duration rather than instantly (emergencies want other tools), each jar is real inventory brewed in real downtime, and patients who tear the dressing off to keep fighting will be lectured. At length.
[Herbalism: 45]

Monster Harvest.name: Monster Harvest
Monster Harvest.description:
Extract edible and empowering components from a freshly defeated monster before the Riftlight fades. You know exactly which parts are safe, which are valuable, and which will make a dish that turns a rough fight into a victory feast.
[Battle Cooking: 2]

Moonlit Flutter.name: Moonlit Flutter
Moonlit Flutter.description: In dim light the Mothkin simply becomes suggestion: a silent step, a brief glide, a scatter of moonlit dust where a person was standing. Guards blink at empty corridors; pursuers chase glitter. The flutter wants shadow and soft light to work with (noon sun and blazing torchlight pin the wings) and the dust must settle before the moth can vanish again.

Mountain Stance.name: Mountain Stance
Mountain Stance.description:
The survivalist plants and becomes geography: incoming damage reduced, knockback refused, stagger declined, push attempts filed and ignored: immovable as stone, because the stance is a decision the mountain agrees with. The stance trades all repositioning for absolute position (mountains do not chase; they outlast), it holds for its duration against everything short of the earth itself moving, and monsters that spend a full rage against one unmoved person undergo a visible crisis of doctrine the party is encouraged to exploit.
[survival: 47]

Nature's Pantry.name: Nature's Pantry
Nature's Pantry.description:
Identify a natural food source in the immediate environment that restores health and stamina when consumed. The find is small but reliable: a cluster of berries, a clean spring, a patch of edible roots that nature left for exactly this moment.
[Foraging: 3]

Nightmare Slash.name: Nightmare Slash
Nightmare Slash.description:
The strike lands twice on two different anatomies: dark damage in the flesh, and a split second of hallucinatory terror in the mind: the target seeing their worst fear, briefly, personally, mid-parry. The wound heals on schedule; the flinch develops a career. The terror is a flash rather than a haunting (a stolen beat of composure, weaponized: the follow-up is where the beat gets spent), minds of iron shake it faster, and the slash's cruelest feature is its intimacy: the blade does not choose the fear. The target does.
[Dark Magic: 10]

Nightmare Weave.name: Nightmare Weave
Nightmare Weave.description:
Weave shadows into a target's mind, trapping them in a waking nightmare. The target hallucinates their worst fears while standing frozen in reality. The nightmare deals psychic damage and can break concentration on spells.
[Dream Magic: 35]

One Last Bullet.name: One Last Bullet
One Last Bullet.description:
The ultimate Gunslinger technique. Draw your weapon and fire a single shot that carries the weight of every duel you've ever fought and every bullet you've ever spent. The round moves faster than sound, hits harder than a siege weapon, and cannot be blocked, dodged, or survived by anything in its path. One bullet. One chance. No second takes.
[Firearms: 48]

Piercing Thrust.name: Piercing Thrust
Piercing Thrust.description:
Everything the dragoon has, delivered through a point the width of intention: a lunging thrust that treats armor as an itemized list of gaps and heavy plate as a personal insult to be corrected. One point, one target, one truth, and a sidestep leaves the dragoon extended and honest.
[Polearm Combat: 2]

Primal Dominion.name: Primal Dominion
Primal Dominion.description:
Assert absolute dominance over every beast and creature in range. Wild animals bow. Tamed beasts break their bonds to serve you. Even monsters hesitate, their instincts screaming that you are the apex predator and resistance is evolutionary suicide. Your voice carries a subsonic resonance that bypasses thought and speaks directly to the animal brain. The pack recognizes its king.
[intimidation: 15]

Prismatic Shell.name: Prismatic Shell
Prismatic Shell.description:
Crystallize a protective shell of gemstone over your body, or a targeted ally, that takes the force of incoming blows and refracts energy-based attacks into scattered, harmless light. While it holds, you shimmer like a walking diamond, and when it shatters it explodes outward in a burst of crystal shrapnel that damages nearby enemies. It guards you or one ally on the turn you raise it; keeping it up takes your action again each turn.
[Crystal Magic: 1]

Reflect Barrier.name: Reflect Barrier
Reflect Barrier.description:
Create a barrier that doesn't just block incoming attacks; it sends them back. Reflect Barrier is a high-skill defensive spell that requires precise timing: the barrier must be raised at the moment of impact to reverse the attack's trajectory. Against magical attacks, the reflected spell maintains its full power. Against physical attacks, the barrier creates a concussive rebound. Nothing demoralizes an enemy mage faster than eating their own fireball.
[Arcane Magic: 3]

Rune Blade Wave.name: Rune Blade Wave
Rune Blade Wave.description:
The swordsman carves a rune into empty air and cuts through it: stored energy releasing along the blade's arc as a projectile that carries the rune's full force across the field. Range for a sword, weight of a sigil. The wave spends whatever the rune held (carving a worthy rune mid-combat is its own discipline) and a wave loosed carelessly announces the swordsman's style to every rune-literate enemy watching.
[Rune Carving: 7]

Sacred Exorcism.name: Sacred Exorcism
Sacred Exorcism.description:
Channel the full authority of a sacred shrine to burn away corruption, banish possessing spirits, and purify cursed magic. The foxfire turns white and ancient. The playful trickster becomes a divine instrument, and the transition is terrifying. Corrupted entities, dark spirits, and cursed objects are unmade by the cleansing flame.
[Illusion Magic: 14]

Shadow Dominion.name: Shadow Dominion
Shadow Dominion.description:
Create a zone of absolute darkness around you where shadows become physical extensions of your will. Shadow tendrils strike from every direction, the light dims to nothing, and enemies within the domain fight a battle they cannot see against an enemy they cannot predict. Inside your domain, darkness is not absence; it is power.
[Shadow Magic: 26]

Shamanic Trance.name: Shamanic Trance
Shamanic Trance.description:
The shaman stops choosing a world: dual existence, standing partially in both: spirits visible and conversable, possession impossible (there is no vacancy in an occupied threshold), every working amplified through the open connection. Spirits treat an entranced shaman with visible courtesy: colleagues, briefly, rather than callers.
[Nature Magic: 43]

Shield of Faith.name: Shield of Faith
Shield of Faith.description:
The priest projects conviction onto an ally and conviction takes: a barrier of divine light settling over them as a soft golden shimmer, incoming damage arriving reduced through a filter of borrowed certainty. Armor made of being believed in. It dampens harm rather than refusing it (faith mitigates; it does not exempt), and fighters who can see they are protected fight like it, which the priest counts as the second effect. It guards one ally on the turn you cast it; keeping it on them takes your action again each turn.
[Divinity: 16]

Siren's Shatter.name: Siren's Shatter
Siren's Shatter.description:
Weaponize the voice into a focused sonic attack that cracks stone, shatters ice, and ruptures magical barriers. The sound is less singing and more the ocean during a storm: a wall of pressure that hits harder than most physical attacks. Devastating against constructs, barriers, and anything brittle.
[performance: 20]

Snowbound Heart.name: Snowbound Heart
Snowbound Heart.description: Create a calm zone of cold air that steadies allies and unsettles enemies. Panic quiets, lies feel harder to sustain, and hostile magic becomes less stable. Strengthens with genuine calm, falters with turmoil.

Song of Rebirth.name: Song of Rebirth
Song of Rebirth.description:
The bard plays across the boundary of consciousness itself: a melody reaching where medicine cannot, pulling a fallen ally back with pure emotional resonance: the song remembering them out loud until they remember themselves. A rebirth played rote is a lullaby; the sincerity is the magic. Those revived report the same detail: they came back because something was worth hearing.
[performance: 9]

Spellfire Arrow.name: Spellfire Arrow
Spellfire Arrow.description:
One arrow, everything: every spell the archer can channel loaded into a single perfect shot: a streak of blazing multicolored light detonating with catastrophic force as the entire repertoire arrives at once. The quiver's thesis statement. The channeling is long, visible, and interruptible. No one who witnesses the rainbow detonation ever refers to 'just an archer' again.
[Archery: 31]

Summon Champion.name: Summon Champion
Summon Champion.description:
The contract at champion rank: a celestial lion arriving like a verdict with a mane, an infernal hound trailing negotiable smoke, a starborn hawk whose stoop bends light: significantly stronger than standard summons, and keeping its own combat judgment. Point it at a battle, not at a task; champions improvise, gloriously. It takes weeks to stop giving orders it was always going to exceed.
[Spirit Channeling: 51]

Summon Familiar.name: Summon Familiar
Summon Familiar.description:
Call forth a small demonic familiar, an imp, shadow cat, or spectral raven, bound to your pact. The familiar scouts, harasses enemies, and delivers minor hexes on your behalf. It has personality and opinions about your life choices.
[Spirit Channeling: 9 · persuasion: 3]

Summon Guardian.name: Summon Guardian
Summon Guardian.description:
The caster sketches the need and the arcane answers with a defender: a shield construct planting itself before an ally, a wall of conjured teeth facing the charge, a spectral barrier leaning into the arrows. The guardian exists to intercept, with single-minded devotion, and one battered apart returns to the arcane politely offended. It guards you or one ally on the turn you summon it; keeping it there takes your action again each turn.
[Spirit Channeling: 43]

Summon Revenant.name: Summon Revenant
Summon Revenant.description:
Raise a revenant: an intelligent undead with its memories and combat skills partially intact. The revenant speaks, strategizes, and fights with the skill it had in life. It also has opinions about being dead.
[Dark Magic: 56 · Arcane Magic: 5]

Underworld Rift.name: Underworld Rift
Underworld Rift.description:
The field where the living and dead overlap: enemies inside slowed by grave-cold, gnawed by continuous shadow, and (the technique's true cruelty) able to see the ghosts of the fallen standing at the edges, watching them with patient interest. Morale does not survive an audience of the dead. The rift claims its area while the walker holds the overlap open, the ghosts observe rather than act (their menace is honest but theatrical), and opening the underworld for effect is precisely the spell the Church means when it says 'we should talk.'
[Rift Magic: 18]

Vanguard's Oath.name: Vanguard's Oath
Vanguard's Oath.description:
The vanguard plants the shield and swears it aloud: every enemy provoked into attacking them, and for the oath's duration, damage arrives reduced and death is refused entry. Cannot be killed; will absolutely be hurt. The vow is a loan with an exact due date. Vanguards who survive their own oath are bought drinks by strangers for years.
[Polearm Combat: 7]

Vicious Mockery.name: Vicious Mockery
Vicious Mockery.description:
The insult, weaponized past metaphor: a magically-enhanced barb targeting the enemy's deepest insecurities: actual psychic damage delivered by sentence, landing somewhere armor was never designed to cover. Words hurt. Yours literally. Confidence is literal armor here. Its finest work is documented: duels lost to a stammer, sieges to a nickname.
[performance: 3]

Weakness Expose.name: Weakness Expose
Weakness Expose.description: For a short window, the target's most relevant flaw stops hiding: the seam in the armor catches light, the tell before the big swing becomes obvious, the pride that can be baited practically introduces itself. Allies see it too, that is the gift. The exposure names one weakness, the most useful one, and creatures exposed once grow paranoid about it, guarding the flaw so obviously that they open two more.

Weightless Zone.name: Weightless Zone
Weightless Zone.description:
Reduce gravity to near-zero in a targeted area. Everything inside begins to float: enemies lose their footing, projectiles drift harmlessly, and your allies can leap and maneuver in three dimensions. Ideal for disrupting enemy formations, crossing obstacles, or creating the kind of aerial combat arena that makes every fight look like a movie.
[Gravity Magic: 1]

Wrath Incarnate.name: Wrath Incarnate
Wrath Incarnate.description:
The ultimate Berserker transformation. Your body surges with so much rage-fueled power that you visually transform: muscles expand, eyes blaze, and mana pours from your body like fire. All physical abilities are massively enhanced. The downside is that when it ends, you collapse. But the things you break while it lasts are unforgettable.
[athletics: 81]

Absolute Defense.name: Absolute Defense
Absolute Defense.description:
For one held breath, the swordsman is simply not available for harm: complete immunity, the enemy's finest assault landing on a person who has momentarily stepped outside the concept. The invulnerability lasts exactly long enough to absorb the worst of it: perfect timing required, and 'perfect' is the technique's entire tuition. Mistimed, it wastes its miracle on empty air; timed truly, it turns an enemy's committed everything into their exposed nothing, and the counterstroke writes itself.
[Focus: 12]

Absolute Stealth.name: Absolute Stealth
Absolute Stealth.description:
The disappearance with no asterisks: gone from sight, sound, smell, and magical detection alike: functionally nonexistent, a person the world has no record of. Attacking ends it in the same instant. Its perfect completeness is the terror: enemies cannot even confirm the assassin is present, which means they must behave, always, as if one is.
[Stealth: 44]

Altitude Control.name: Altitude Control
Altitude Control.description:
Fine control over your aerial position during jumps. Adjust trajectory mid-air, hover briefly, or change targets before descending. Turns jump attacks from committed strikes into flexible aerial combat.
[acrobatics: 49]

Anti-Magic Field.name: Anti-Magic Field
Anti-Magic Field.description:
Project a field of absolute magical negation around you. Spells fizzle, enchantments flicker and die, and magical effects simply cease to function within the zone. The field affects all magic indiscriminately: including your own. You are the silence in a room full of noise.
[Arcane Magic: 7]

Arcane Ascension.name: Arcane Ascension
Arcane Ascension.description:
The ultimate Spellblade technique. Channel every element through your body and weapon simultaneously, becoming a living conduit of magical warfare. Your blade transforms into a shifting weapon of pure elemental force, every strike casts a spell, every spell becomes a strike, and the boundary between warrior and mage dissolves entirely.
[Arcane Magic: 55]

Arrow of Genesis.name: Arrow of Genesis
Arrow of Genesis.description:
The ultimate Arcane Archer technique. Every arrow in your quiver becomes a living spell: seeking, phasing, and detonating with elemental fury. For the duration, you fire arrows that bend reality, and the battlefield transforms into a gallery of magical devastation with you at its center.
[Archery: 43]

Binding Contract.name: Binding Contract
Binding Contract.description:
Draft a magically binding contract that compels both parties to uphold their agreement. Violating the contract triggers a penalty agreed upon at signing: pain, bad luck, or the kind of misfortune that makes breaking your word seem like a very bad idea.
[Scribal Arts: 4]

Blood Detonation.name: Blood Detonation
Blood Detonation.description:
Every drop of blood in the area receives one instruction: detonate. Wound-spill, battlefield puddles, and, catastrophically, the blood still inside enemies, erupting at once. The mage's final argument. It needs blood present; clean fields rob it entirely. Witnesses do not discuss it casually, or ever stand near the mage's bleeding enemies again.
[Blood Magic: 25]

Body Replacement.name: Body Replacement
Body Replacement.description:
The blow lands: on a log. The ninja is elsewhere in the immediate area, unbothered, while the enemy stares at lumber they have decisively defeated. The substitution is so fast it reads as teleportation; it is actually preparation wearing speed's clothes. The replacement needs an object to swap with and a fraction of warning (true surprises still land on flesh), it answers one attack per working, and the log itself has become the school's mascot: nothing in the world has absorbed more killing blows with less complaint.
[Stealth: 3]

Calming Presence.name: Calming Presence
Calming Presence.description:
The tamer exhales and the violence loses its appetite: hostile creatures settling, aggressive monsters gone thoughtful, enemy beasts hesitating mid-lunge as something old and calm addresses something old and scared. It pacifies instinct, not intention; the mindless hear nothing. Shattering someone's calm aura, by, say, an arrow, has consequences the arrow's owner rarely enjoys.
[persuasion: 7]

Cane of Judgment.name: Cane of Judgment
Cane of Judgment.description:
Channel concentrated light magic through a walking cane with surgical precision. The cane was never for walking. Each strike is a controlled detonation of divination-guided light that hits exactly where it will do the most damage. The user grades the enemy's performance while fighting.
[Light Magic: 18]

Crown of Command.name: Crown of Command
Crown of Command.description:
The Phantom Crown blazes to full manifestation: a crown of spectral light visible to everyone, radiating the undeniable authority of a true sovereign. Allies fight harder, move faster, and resist fear. Enemies must actively resist the compulsion to kneel. Your commands carry supernatural weight: tactical orders become instinctive knowledge in your allies' minds. For a brief, glorious moment, you are the king the world has been waiting for.
[intimidation: 18]

Death Flag Alarm.name: Death Flag Alarm
Death Flag Alarm.description: A cold prickle at the base of the skull when the story turns dangerous: this door, this promise, this innocent line of dialogue is about to matter. The alarm names the moment, never the reason (the bearer knows a flag was raised, not which way it points) and following the warnings faithfully produces a survival record so unlikely that companions start checking the bearer's face before opening anything.

Deflect Missiles.name: Deflect Missiles
Deflect Missiles.description:
Bare hands versus ballistics, and the hands are winning: arrows caught mid-flight, thrown weapons slapped aside, and at the discipline's height, incoming fire redirected back at the sender with the monk's compliments. Archers who watch their arrow returned develop the school's intended condition: a lasting crisis about their entire profession.
[acrobatics: 60]

Dimensional Rift.name: Dimensional Rift
Dimensional Rift.description:
Tear open a passage between dimensional layers. Step into the space between spaces, where distance is meaningless and physical barriers don't exist. You can traverse entire battlefields in a single step, pull allies through with you, or open a rift beneath an enemy's feet and drop them into a pocket dimension for a disorienting, terrifying interval.
[Space Magic: 15]

Disarming Strike.name: Disarming Strike
Disarming Strike.description:
Target the enemy's weapon hand with a precise strike that forces them to drop their weapon. Against armed humanoids, this effectively ends the fight. Against monsters, targets claws or natural weapons.
[Swordsmanship: 14]

Disenchant Field.name: Disenchant Field
Disenchant Field.description:
The enchantress inverts her art: a field where magic goes to be audited: enemy spellcasting suddenly costing more mana than budgeted, the glowing sword becoming an ordinary sword with pretensions. Magical superiority, suspended pending review. Running a suppression field is a duel of reserves: her focus against everything inside it.
[Enchanting: 5]

Distortion Field.name: Distortion Field
Distortion Field.description:
Space around the caster develops a polite curvature: incoming attacks bending past: subtly, deniably, the attackers convinced they aimed true and missing by margins that feel like their own error. Its cruelest feature is psychological: enemies rarely realize the field exists, and spend the fight blaming their own hands, which the caster considers the second effect.
[Space Magic: 3]

Domain Expansion.name: Domain Expansion
Domain Expansion.description:
Create a bounded domain where the laws of physics follow your will. Inside your Absolute Territory, you control distance, direction, and dimension: compressing space to trap enemies, expanding corridors to escape, redirecting attacks, and reshaping the battlefield entirely. The bigger the domain, the greater the cost. While active, you are effectively omnipotent within its borders.
[Space Magic: 9]

Dragon Fire Aura.name: Dragon Fire Aura
Dragon Fire Aura.description:
Dragon fire wraps the caster in a corona that considers melee attackers volunteers: anyone who lands a strike takes the flame's reply; not merely hot, but the wrath of an ancient breed, fire with lineage. Fighting them costs admission. The aura punishes contact rather than reaching out (archers watch from a safe, smug distance), burns for its duration on a serious draw of mana, and standing inside dragon's wrath all evening leaves even the caster's own gear smelling permanently of legend.
[Fire Magic: 15]

Dragon Firestorm.name: Dragon Firestorm
Dragon Firestorm.description:
Dragon fire beyond weaponry: a torrent so intense stone melts, the target area becoming a river of molten rock that burns anything entering for as long as the glow holds. Terrain, rewritten in the dragon's oldest handwriting. The firestorm claims its area and renders it impassable to friend and foe alike (the caster is sculpting the battlefield, not clearing it), summoning heat that argues with geology draws the vein nearly dry, and the cooled black scar remains afterward as a signature nobody misattributes.
[Fire Magic: 24]

Elegant Footwork.name: Elegant Footwork
Elegant Footwork.description:
The dancer's warfare: side steps, pivots, and retreats refined into art: always at perfect striking distance, never presenting a clean target. You fight like water, and water is winning. It denies rather than damages; the dancer's blades arrive from angles the footwork purchased. Enemies describe the experience as fencing with a rumor.
[acrobatics: 4]

Enchanted Thread.name: Enchanted Thread
Enchanted Thread.description:
Sew with mana-infused thread that enhances the resulting garment with magical properties: temperature regulation, minor damage resistance, or a subtle social charm. The thread is expensive and the stitching must be flawless, but the result is clothing that does more than look good.
[Tailoring: 3]

Execution Strike.name: Execution Strike
Execution Strike.description:
The overhead swing that exists for endings: dramatically increased damage against enemies below half health, scaling crueler as their vitality falls: the lower they are, the harder it lands. The finisher, named honestly. Against healthy targets it is merely a strong committed swing (the magic is in the mathematics of mercy withheld), its huge windup is readable by anyone still capable of reading, and landing one is a battlefield punctuation mark that both sides feel: sentence, complete.
[Swordsmanship: 51]

Glacial Colossus.name: Glacial Colossus
Glacial Colossus.description:
Shape ice into a massive humanoid construct: a colossus of blue-white crystal that towers over the battlefield. The colossus fights with crushing blows and freezing breath, and regenerates by absorbing moisture from the air.
[Ice Magic: 29]

Inspiring Melody.name: Inspiring Melody
Inspiring Melody.description:
Play an uplifting melody that boosts the morale and combat effectiveness of all nearby allies. Their attacks hit a little harder, their reflexes sharpen, and they feel like the protagonist of their own story.
[performance: 2]

Legendary Encore.name: Legendary Encore
Legendary Encore.description:
All inspiring enhancements and blessings you've applied to allies in the current battle are instantly refreshed and doubled in effectiveness. The ultimate utility move: every melody, anthem, and ballad echoes back at peak power simultaneously.
[performance: 10]

Lightning Shroud.name: Lightning Shroud
Lightning Shroud.description:
Electricity worn as athletic equipment: crackling current wrapping the caster: speed rising, reactions sharpening past nature's draft, and anyone who touches them receiving the shroud's standing opinion. Speed, with a security deposit. The wearer's hair spends the duration making decisions of its own, which the discipline has given up apologizing for.
[Lightning Magic: 7]

Lightning Strike.name: Lightning Strike
Lightning Strike.description:
The sky, addressed by name: a bolt of lightning called down onto a single target with devastating precision: wet enemies and the metal-armored receiving the strike's special attention, conductivity billed as a character flaw. The strike lands where called with a heartbeat's channeling (indoor work is a different spell's job; this one needs sky), its damage is focused rather than shared, and the thunderclap announces your presence to everything nearby: a cost the discipline reframed as advertising generations ago and never looked back.
[Lightning Magic: 6]

Mass Enchantment.name: Mass Enchantment
Mass Enchantment.description:
The enchanter exhales across the whole party's kit at once: every weapon waking with an edge-gleam, every shield thickening its opinion, every piece of armor humming with stored intent. A supply run's worth of upgrades in one working. The enchantment lifts the entire party for the duration and then politely expires (it is a tide, not a purchase) and enchanting that many objects simultaneously is the mental equivalent of holding twelve conversations: brilliant, brief, and headache-flavored.
[Enchanting: 14]

Musashi's Heaven.name: Musashi's Heaven
Musashi's Heaven.description:
The ultimate Samurai technique. Draw both blades in perfect synchronization and unleash a cross-dimensional cut that severs the boundary between the mundane and the divine. The strike is visible as a pillar of light and cannot be blocked, parried, or survived by anything in its path. A single perfect moment that legends are built around.
[Swordsmanship: 69]

Nature's Clarity.name: Nature's Clarity
Nature's Clarity.description:
Prepare herbs that sharpen an ally's senses and reflexes for a short duration. The mixture clears the mind, enhances perception, and makes the world feel crisp and vivid. Side effects may include an intense appreciation for the smell of rain.
[Herbalism: 9]

Perfect Disguise.name: Perfect Disguise
Perfect Disguise.description:
Transform your appearance, voice, mannerisms, and even your magical signature to perfectly mimic another person. The disguise fools magical detection, divine sight, and even people who know the original intimately. It lasts until you choose to drop it. The Veilwalkers would kill to know how you do this.
[Illusion Magic: 5]

Permafrost Crown.name: Permafrost Crown
Permafrost Crown.description:
Crown yourself in absolute cold and claim dominion over winter itself. Temperature plummets to lethal levels. Enemies are frozen in place; not just their bodies but their mana, their movements, their very momentum. A crown of crystalline ice materializes above your head, and from it radiates an aura of frost so profound that time itself seems to slow within its reach.
[Ice Magic: 18]

Precision Thrust.name: Precision Thrust
Precision Thrust.description:
The duelist's answer to armor is disagreement: a perfectly aimed thrust into the gap between plates, the joint of a limb, the one soft seam in a monster's hide. Accuracy over power, and accuracy wins. The thrust demands a visible or known weak point to address (against a flawless guard it waits, patient as etiquette) and its quick recovery is the style's whole tempo: touch, withdraw, touch again, until the opponent runs out of seams.
[Dueling: 2]

Radiant Presence.name: Radiant Presence
Radiant Presence.description: The Celestial simply is, gently, at everyone: a soft aura steadying allies, loosening fear's grip: undead and demons finding the vicinity uncomfortable in the way of a headache with a conscience. It is a lamp, not a sun. Near a Celestial, the dark simply works a little worse, always, and everyone can feel which side the room is on.

Resonance Shield.name: Resonance Shield
Resonance Shield.description:
A crystalline barrier grown around the caster or an ally: taking the force of incoming blows into its lattice while hostile magic refracts: spells scattering through prismatic angles into harmless light, the shield humming at a pitch that rises under pressure. Defense that sings. Growing crystal at speed draws deep on the caster, and the hum is an honest instrument: everyone nearby can hear exactly how the argument is going. It guards you or one ally on the turn you raise it; keeping it up takes your action again each turn.
[Crystal Magic: 12]

Resonance Strike.name: Resonance Strike
Resonance Strike.description:
Channel your bond with your weapon into a single devastating attack. The blade glows with shared mana as wielder and weapon synchronize perfectly: the strike hits with force far beyond what either could produce alone. At higher bond levels, Resonance Strike can change elemental properties based on the weapon spirit's nature.
[Soul Magic: 3]

Riposte Flourish.name: Riposte Flourish
Riposte Flourish.description:
After a successful parry, deliver an immediate counter-thrust with added flair. The riposte deals bonus damage and looks beautiful: tournament judges award style points. Monsters don't, but they feel it.
[Dueling: 3]

Shadow Construct.name: Shadow Construct
Shadow Construct.description:
Manifest solid objects from pure shadow: weapons, shields, walls, restraints, or grasping hands. The constructs look like living darkness and move according to the caster's will. Shadow magic responds to emotion: calm focus produces precise tools, anger produces something more primal and dangerous. The constructs dissolve in strong light.
[Shadow Magic: 9]

Shadow Sovereign.name: Shadow Sovereign
Shadow Sovereign.description:
The ultimate Ninja technique. Become one with the shadows themselves; you exist in every shadow simultaneously, can strike from any darkness, and your clones are indistinguishable from your real body. For the duration, you are everywhere and nowhere, and the battlefield becomes a nightmare of blades emerging from impossible angles.
[Stealth: 83]

Spirit Awakening.name: Spirit Awakening
Spirit Awakening.description:
Temporarily awaken your weapon's full consciousness: releasing it from its dormant state into active partnership. The weapon's spirit manifests visibly around you: a spectral figure, a burning aura, or a transformation of the blade itself into its true form. During Spirit Awakening, your attacks are guided by two minds, your defense benefits from the spirit's foresight, and the weapon may independently act to protect you.
[Soul Magic: 4]

Summon Elemental.name: Summon Elemental
Summon Elemental.description:
The caster opens a door for a piece of weather with a personality: a guardian of fire, water, earth, or air stepping through to fight at their side: enthusiastic, powerful, and constitutionally temporary. The element chosen should suit the battlefield; summoning fire into a library is technically legal. The guardian serves until its time runs out or its form is broken, and each summoning is a real negotiation with the arcane: repeat calls come slower and cost more courtesy.
[Spirit Channeling: 4]

Summon Evolution.name: Summon Evolution
Summon Evolution.description:
The summoner's covenant, escalated: an active summon temporarily upgraded to its mythic form: the wolf becoming a fenris that remembers hunting gods, the serpent becoming a leviathan the room barely accommodates. The mythic form fights at legend's scale with the original's loyalty. Creatures who have tasted their apex form are, afterward, subtly prouder, and so is the summoner.
[persuasion: 60]

Summon Sacrifice.name: Summon Sacrifice
Summon Sacrifice.description:
The summoner makes the hard trade: an active summon unmade in an instant, its essence converted into one powerful effect: an elemental detonation in its own flavor, a healing burst shaped like its loyalty, an enhancement carrying its strength forward. The creature's end, spent with purpose. The sacrifice requires an actual living summon on the field, the effect scales with what was given, and summons are not fuel to the ones who love them: a summoner who spends companions casually finds the next contract negotiations notably colder.
[persuasion: 21]

Sympathetic Link.name: Sympathetic Link
Sympathetic Link.description:
The witch takes a personal item or a drop of blood and closes a circuit: a sympathetic link through which spells arrive ignoring distance and line of sight entirely: cast in the tower, delivered in the target's kitchen. The Witch always finds you. The link demands a genuine personal focus (the fresher and dearer, the truer the connection), it channels the witch's magic rather than amplifying it, and its existence rewrites the target's whole life: people who learn a witch holds their blood begin negotiating immediately, which is generally the point.
[Occult Lore: 29]

Tactical Insight.name: Tactical Insight
Tactical Insight.description:
The battlefield goes quiet in the sovereign's mind and resolves into lines, who will lunge, who is guarding a wound, which flank is one push from folding. Sharing the read takes a breath and a shouted word, and allies who hear it fight like they rehearsed this. The insight is a snapshot, not a stream: a battle that changes shape must be read again, and reading it demands the sovereign's full attention at exactly the moments attention is expensive.
[Command: 1]

Temporal Stutter.name: Temporal Stutter
Temporal Stutter.description:
The chronomancer steps out of the moment entirely: paused in time, invulnerable, existing between two ticks of the world's clock while attacks pass through the space they technically still occupy. They return at the exact position they left, one held breath later. The stutter is a perfect defense with a fixed address (enemies who understand it simply aim where the return is scheduled) and stepping outside time twice in quick succession is how chronomancers earn the profession's signature nosebleed.
[Time Magic: 5]

Void Consumption.name: Void Consumption
Void Consumption.description:
Open a rift to the void and let it feed. Enemy spells are devoured mid-cast. Magical barriers dissolve. Enchantments unravel. The void doesn't destroy magic; it eats it, and what it eats, it gives to you. Each consumed spell restores your mana and briefly enhances your next attack. The more powerful the magic consumed, the more devastating your response.
[Void Magic: 15]

Water Wall Jutsu.name: Water Wall Jutsu
Water Wall Jutsu.description:
Water chakra rises and takes the ninja's side: a swirling defensive wall flowing around them like a living moat: projectiles deflected off the current, fire arriving and leaving as steam and apology. Defense that moves, which archers take personally. The wall guards while chakra feeds it and answers ranged and elemental insult best (a committed greatsword still argues through), it wants moisture in the world to draw from (deserts make the technique expensive) and the steam of a defeated fireball is the school's favorite punctuation.
[acrobatics: 11]

Wind Blade Jutsu.name: Wind Blade Jutsu
Wind Blade Jutsu.description:
Chakra shapes the air into edges: an invisible gale of cutting wind loosed at range, arriving without gleam or warning and leaving wounds that look like they came from nowhere. Enemies bleed before they believe. The blades are honest wind, solid cover breaks them, armor blunts them, and range thins them, and the jutsu's invisibility is its whole terror and its whole tell: veterans who feel one unexplained cut immediately start watching the air's grain.
[acrobatics: 28]

World Map Reveal.name: World Map Reveal
World Map Reveal.description: The region unfolds behind the eyes: exits, hazards, routes, water, the village two valleys over, the thing on the map that is drawn as forest and is not forest. Orientation becomes a decision rather than a struggle. The reveal maps terrain and standing features (it does not track people, and it does not update itself; the world can change behind the map's back) and guides who watch the bearer navigate a region sight-unseen tend to quietly re-price their services.

Ancestral Warrior.name: Ancestral Warrior
Ancestral Warrior.description:
The call goes back generations and a warrior answers: an ancestral spirit in the armor of their era, fighting alongside the summoner with combat skills death never confiscated, and opinions about modern fighting techniques, offered mid-battle, unsolicited, frequently correct. The ancestor attends for a finite visit and serves respect rather than command, expects the summoner to fight in a manner worth witnessing, and departing ancestors have been known to leave one piece of advice that turns out, weeks later, to be the whole point.
[Spirit Channeling: 11]

Bountiful Harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
Bountiful Harvest.description:
Gather an enhanced harvest from your crops or a nearby mana-rich patch of soil, yielding materials of unusually high quality. The result is a cut above standard goods: herbs with stronger potency, grain with richer mana content, fruit that glows faintly in the dark.
[Farming: 4]

Celestial Barrage.name: Celestial Barrage
Celestial Barrage.description:
Call down a rain of starlight: dozens of burning celestial projectiles that streak from the sky and hammer an area with concentrated astral energy. Each impact detonates with blinding white-gold light. The barrage is beautiful, overwhelming, and indiscriminate in its devastation. The sky cracks open above you like a window into the cosmos, and what falls through is judgment.
[Star Magic: 18]

Chemical Analysis.name: Chemical Analysis
Chemical Analysis.description:
The alchemist reads matter's confession: a brief analysis identifying poisons, alchemical agents, magical compounds, and material weaknesses: the substance's whole biography in a glance, a sniff, a careful touch. Knowledge that lets you exploit what you know. The analysis studies one substance per examination and reports what is (the antidote must still be brewed; the weakness must still be struck), and alchemists who casually identify the poison at dinner, aloud, by vintage, have ended more intrigues than most inquisitors.
[Alchemy: 13]

Continental Crush.name: Continental Crush
Continental Crush.description:
The ultimate earth spell. Rip a massive slab of stone from deep underground (the size of a building) levitate it overhead, and drop it on the target area with tectonic force. The impact creates a crater, sends shockwaves in every direction, and redefines the landscape.
[Earth Magic: 18]

Corrupting Strike.name: Corrupting Strike
Corrupting Strike.description:
The blade delivers its cargo along with the cut: dark energy seeded in the wound, corruption spreading through flesh with a rot's patience: damage compounding over time while healing arrives muffled, bandages and blessings alike working through interference. A wound that argues with treatment. The corruption rides one wound per strike and runs its course unless cleansed by sufficient light, and healers who meet it mid-battle develop a personal animosity toward the sword that seeded it, which dark knights collect like reviews.
[Dark Magic: 14]

Crimson Sovereign.name: Crimson Sovereign
Crimson Sovereign.description:
The ancient blood magic ultimate. Stop holding back and unleash centuries of accumulated vampire power. Blood crystallizes into crimson barriers and blades, the air thickens with pressure, wounds on enemies reopen, and the room goes dark except for glowing red eyes. The one time per century the restraint breaks, everyone within a mile remembers. Brief, devastating, and deeply sad.
[Blood Magic: 43]

Crusader's Charge.name: Crusader's Charge
Crusader's Charge.description:
Charge forward with divine light trailing behind you. Your movement speed doubles and your first attack at the end of the charge deals bonus holy damage. The trail of light lingers briefly, healing allies who pass through it.
[Divinity: 10]

Curse of Weakness.name: Curse of Weakness
Curse of Weakness.description:
The curse settles onto the target like wet wool: muscles turning heavy, grip softening, every swing arriving late and apologetic. Strength becomes a memory with a duration. The weakness debilitates without wounding (a cursed champion is embarrassing, not dying) and it clings only as long as the magic holds: cleansing light strips it, stubborn vitality shortens it, and cursing someone's strength to their face is a declaration the strong historically answer.
[Dark Magic: 3]

Defiant Challenge.name: Defiant Challenge
Defiant Challenge.description:
The taunt lands with magical compulsion behind it: every enemy in range turns from the healer, the mage, the wounded, and attacks the challenger instead, because refusing is not on the menu. The party's soft targets get a whole fight's vacation. The challenge redirects attention, not damage (everything now arriving must still be survived, which is the challenger's entire job description) and compulsion this loud cannot be whispered again quickly.
[athletics: 9]

Dimensional Dance.name: Dimensional Dance
Dimensional Dance.description:
The mage stops respecting the space between enemies: teleporting target to target in rapid succession, one strike each, vanishing before the reprisal and reappearing at the next: a pattern too fast to track, violence delivered as choreography. The dance visits each enemy once and follows its committed sequence (the pattern is chosen at the first step; improvisation mid-dance is how mages arrive inside walls), and dimension-stepping that many times in one breath bills the body all at once at the final bow.
[Space Magic: 27]

Dragon's Presence.name: Dragon's Presence
Dragon's Presence.description:
The battlefield reorganizes around one fact: something draconic is standing in it. Lesser enemies hesitate at the edge of striking distance, finding urgent reasons to be elsewhere; allies straighten under an aura that feels like fighting beside a fortress with opinions. Presence, weaponized. The pressure works on those who can feel fear (constructs and the mindless are immune to theater) and commanding a battlefield's attention means having all of it: archers included.
[intimidation: 4]

Foresight Barrier.name: Foresight Barrier
Foresight Barrier.description:
Place a magical barrier exactly where an attack will land: before it is launched. Divination makes defensive support almost unfair: the barrier appears a half-second before impact, and the caster never explains how they knew. Allies stop questioning it after the third time it saves their life. It guards one ally on the turn you cast it; foreseeing the next blow takes your action again the next turn.
[Arcane Magic: 6]

Four Totem Circle.name: Four Totem Circle
Four Totem Circle.description:
The full ceremony: all four elemental totems planted, the circle closing into a ritual engine: enemies inside taking the elements' displeasure, allies healed and heightened. Geometry is theology here. Its power lives between the posts and dies with any one of them: enemies learn to attack the corners.
[Nature Magic: 31]

Grand Enchantment.name: Grand Enchantment
Grand Enchantment.description:
The ultimate Enchanter technique. Rewrite the magical foundation of reality within a large area. Every enchantment you've ever cast activates simultaneously. Every item glows with your power. Every enemy's magic is suppressed. Every ally's equipment becomes legendary. For a few breathtaking moments, you are not merely enhancing the world; you are rewriting its rules.
[Enchanting: 68]

Greater Evil Ward.name: Greater Evil Ward
Greater Evil Ward.description:
The exorcist's masterwork: a massive ward raised over an entire area: no dark entity may enter, no curse takes hold, no possession occurs within its bounds. A district's worth of no, inscribed and burning. Sanctuary, industrial grade. The great ward demands lengthy inscription, real materials, and the exorcist's deep reserves to raise; it defends its area rather than pursuing anything, and truly ancient evils treat its border as an insult worth studying: the ward keeps them out, and it also shows them exactly where the line is.
[Occult Lore: 73]

Hex of Unraveling.name: Hex of Unraveling
Hex of Unraveling.description:
Place a hex on a target that destabilizes their magical defenses. Shields crack, enchantments flicker, and empowering spells degrade. The hex eats magic: the more magical protection the target has, the more satisfying the unraveling.
[Dark Magic: 8]

Phase Enchantment.name: Phase Enchantment
Phase Enchantment.description:
The enchanter whispers to a weapon about the theory of armor, and the weapon stops believing in it: strikes passing through plate, scale, and shield as though the defense were a rumor: the ultimate armor penetration, delivered as philosophy. Flesh, unfortunately for someone, remains entirely real. The enchantment rides one weapon for its duration, it bypasses physical defense only (wards and barriers still argue), and warriors watching their armor become decorative undergo a visible crisis the enchanter finds professionally satisfying.
[Enchanting: 27]

Precision Harvest.name: Precision Harvest
Precision Harvest.description:
Extract rare and high-quality materials from a monster corpse with surgical precision: targeting the gland, scale pattern, or organ that an untrained harvester would never find. The yield is significantly better than brute-force looting.
[Monster Harvesting: 2]

Probability Storm.name: Probability Storm
Probability Storm.description:
Warp probability in a localized area, making the unlikely inevitable and the certain unreliable. Enemy attacks miss at statistically impossible rates. Your wild strikes connect perfectly. Dropped items land in useful places. Environmental effects coincidentally favor you. The effect is subtle, insidious, and leaves enemies questioning their own competence rather than suspecting magic.
[persuasion: 15]

Purification Wave.name: Purification Wave
Purification Wave.description:
Cleansing light rolls outward like a bell being rung: evil entities burn where it touches, stolen blessings and dark empowerments strip away mid-stride, and the air itself comes back tasting clean. The wave judges nature, not allegiance (anything genuinely unholy in range answers for it) and pouring out that much sanctity leaves the exorcist hollowed and hungry, the divine equivalent of shouting until the voice gives.
[Light Magic: 31]

Reading the Blade.name: Reading the Blade
Reading the Blade.description:
Study an opponent's fighting style mid-combat. After observing for a few exchanges, you can predict their attack patterns, identify habits, and exploit weaknesses. The longer you watch, the more you understand.
[Swordsmanship: 6]

Reaper's Dominion.name: Reaper's Dominion
Reaper's Dominion.description:
The ultimate Reaper technique. Assume the mantle of Death itself: your scythe becomes an extension of the boundary between life and oblivion. Every swing severs the soul from the body, every step creates a grave, and the battlefield becomes your domain. For a few eternal moments, you are not a warrior who wields death; you are death, and every living thing in your presence feels the cold certainty of the end.
[Soul Magic: 21]

Resonance Mastery.name: Resonance Mastery
Resonance Mastery.description:
After copying a skill or ability, resonate with it so deeply that you temporarily surpass the original user. The copied technique crystallizes in your muscle memory, refined and amplified by your Blessing. You don't just echo; you harmonize, finding frequencies in the copied ability that even its creator never discovered. The result is the same technique performed at a level that shouldn't be possible.
[acrobatics: 12]

Sanctified Strike.name: Sanctified Strike
Sanctified Strike.description:
The inquisitor's weapon takes the light the way a wick takes flame: a clean white edge that parts dark magic like cobweb. Wards unravel where it lands, hexes gutter out, and against the unholy the blow lands twice: once in the flesh, once in whatever passes for a soul. The sanctification is a prayer, not a coating; it must be renewed with genuine conviction, and a doubting heart produces only ordinary steel.
[Divinity: 3]

Sanguine Covenant.name: Sanguine Covenant
Sanguine Covenant.description:
Forge a blood bond with willing allies that links your life forces. Damage is distributed across all bonded members instead of concentrated on one. Healing applied to any bonded member heals all of them partially. The bond also grants shared combat awareness; you feel what they feel, see what they see, and fight with unified instinct. The cost: your blood glows permanently afterward.
[Blood Magic: 15]

Secret Route Ping.name: Secret Route Ping
Secret Route Ping.description: The world's hidden hinges hum quietly for the bearer: the wall that is a door, the NPC whose problem is a questline, the offhand comment that is a romance flag waving, the background detail placed too deliberately to be background. Content reveals itself. The ping points at hooks, not solutions (the secret room still has its guardian, the rare condition still wants meeting) and companions traveling with the bearer come to accept that they will never, ever have an uneventful walk again.

Shield Bash Throw.name: Shield Bash Throw
Shield Bash Throw.description:
The shield leaves the vanguard's arm spinning like a thrown millstone, caroms through the enemy line, one, two, three staggering impacts, enough force to rock a giant back on its heels, and returns to the waiting arm with a slap. Everyone in the arc has a worse day. The throw commits the vanguard's only shield to the journey; while it flies, they stand uncovered, which is the entire price of the trick and every drop of its drama.
[Shield Combat: 2]

Song of Shielding.name: Song of Shielding
Song of Shielding.description:
The bard plays defense: a melody weaving a barrier of sound waves around an ally: blows softened into harmonic resonance, the shield humming its work aloud and shattering musically when broken. The genius disguised as flourish: the party hears exactly when their friend just lost cover, from anywhere on the field. It guards one ally on the turn you play it; keeping the song going takes your action again each turn.
[performance: 34]

Spotlight Command.name: Spotlight Command
Spotlight Command.description: For one scene, the bearer cannot be ignored: the entrance lands, the speech carries, the duel draws every eye, the power reveal gets the silence it deserves. Rooms reorganize around the moment. The spotlight illuminates without persuading (what the audience does with their undivided attention is still earned by the performance) and light that bright casts long shadows: every rival, spy, and scandal-writer present now has a very clear view. Once claimed, the stage must be given back for a good while.

Survival Instinct.name: Survival Instinct
Survival Instinct.description:
