When in danger, your wilderness instincts take over: dodging attacks reflexively, finding cover instinctively, and identifying escape routes without conscious thought. You survive because the wild trained you to.
[survival: 18]

Tempest Awakening.name: Tempest Awakening
Tempest Awakening.description:
Become the storm. Lightning arcs from your body in all directions. Wind screams around you in a vortex. Thunder follows every movement. You don't cast storm magic; you are storm magic, walking devastation with a heartbeat, each step accompanied by crackling discharge and howling gales. Enemies caught in your tempest are battered, electrocuted, and scattered.
[Storm Magic: 50]

Warrior's Resolve.name: Warrior's Resolve
Warrior's Resolve.description:
The punishment becomes the pantry: the warrior draws on every hit absorbed this battle and converts the accumulated damage into recovery: the more they have endured, the more flows back. Pain becomes fuel, scars become arithmetic. The resolve pays out on damage genuinely taken (untouched warriors recover nothing, which they find philosophically acceptable), and it can be invoked only when the body has something banked: it is a comeback, not a fountain.
[survival: 53]

Wrath of the Wild.name: Wrath of the Wild
Wrath of the Wild.description:
The ultimate nature spell. The natural world itself rises against your enemies. Trees uproot and swing their trunks like battering rams. Vines erupt from every surface. The earth splits to swallow. Animals attack in coordinated fury. For one overwhelming minute, every living thing in range obeys your command.
[Nature Magic: 50]

Absolute Authority.name: Absolute Authority
Absolute Authority.description:
The ultimate Sage technique. Assert total control over the mana within a large area. All enemy spells are suppressed. All allied spells are enhanced. Magical constructs obey your will. You don't cast magic; you are the magic system in this space.
[Arcane Magic: 48]

Adaptive Apex Form.name: Adaptive Apex Form
Adaptive Apex Form.description: For a while, the body becomes the answer: gills before the flooded floor demands them, heat-shed plating in the Emberwake's throat, joints that reverse for the dungeon's impossible geometry: the perfect specialized adaptation, worn like a borrowed shape. The form answers one hostile condition at a time and unravels when the pressure lifts, and each transformation is public, unforgettable, and exactly the kind of thing the Church files reports about.

Aura of Protection.name: Aura of Protection
Aura of Protection.description:
The priest becomes the shelter: divine protection radiating outward: allies within taking reduced dark, necrotic, and psychic damage, the halo visible like a lamp that took a side. Walking sanctuary. Honest steel remains the shield-line's job; the priest handles the metaphysical weather, and where the priest walks, the line is: both the blessing and the target painted on them. It guards allies near you on the turn you raise it; sustaining it takes your action again each turn.
[Divinity: 27]

Blood Manipulation.name: Blood Manipulation
Blood Manipulation.description:
The mage borrows a whisper of the enemy's own blood: a stagger at the crucial step, a sword arm nudged a hand's width off its promise: manipulation subtle enough to deny and sufficient to turn a lethal blow into a graze. The smallest spell that saves the most lives. The manipulation moves small amounts briefly (this is a thumb on the scale, not puppetry), requires focus at the exact moment it matters, and enemies who realize their own blood is unreliable develop a hesitation worth more than the spell itself.
[Blood Magic: 4]

Blood Resurrection.name: Blood Resurrection
Blood Resurrection.description:
The mage opens their own veins to argue with death: a significant portion of their health poured across the gap, and the fallen ally rises: breathing, partial, and alive on borrowed blood. The exchange is real and stays real: the mage's sacrificed vitality returns only by natural healing, no shortcuts, no refunds. It is the most honest spell in dark magic, life for life, paid up front, and allies who wake owing that particular debt do not forget the arithmetic.
[Blood Magic: 7]

Celestial Judgment.name: Celestial Judgment
Celestial Judgment.description: Call down a focused flash of divine light against a corrupted, undead, demonic, or oath-breaking target. Severe against the impure, painful against the merely guilty. The light refuses to fall on the innocent.

Champion's Resolve.name: Champion's Resolve
Champion's Resolve.description: The summoning ritual branded you with divine purpose, and the brand remembers: when defeat seems certain, something ignites: power surging past your limits, scaling with exactly how hopeless the moment is. It answers genuine desperation only; the brand reads the situation, not the request. Every ignition is visible, and enemies learn what the glow means.

Consecrated Ground.name: Consecrated Ground
Consecrated Ground.description:
The priest blesses the ground underfoot and the ground takes the job seriously: allies standing on it regenerating steadily and shrugging dark magic, while undead and demons take damage simply for standing there: existence itself billed hourly. The consecration claims its blessed patch and no more (the fight develops a very literal high ground), it endures while the sanctity lasts, and clever unholy things simply refuse to step on it, which shapes battles into sieges around a priest's patch of conviction.
[Divinity: 7]

Constellation Bind.name: Constellation Bind
Constellation Bind.description:
Pin a target in place with chains of starlight that bind their limbs and suppress their movement. The constellations used determine the binding's strength: minor chains for quick restraints, major constellations for targets that refuse to stay put.
[Star Magic: 5]

Constellation Step.name: Constellation Step
Constellation Step.description: The Star Elf steps onto a thread of starlight only they can see and arrives somewhere better (behind the guard, atop the ledge, out of the sword's story entirely) with timing so elegant it looks choreographed. The thread is short and must exist: starlight steps want open sightlines and a sliver of night in the air, deep windowless dark refuses politely, and each thread must be woven fresh once walked.

Crystal Extraction.name: Crystal Extraction
Crystal Extraction.description:
Safely harvest a crystal or mineral deposit without shattering it, losing resonance, or triggering the structural instability that lesser prospectors discover only after the floor caves in. The extracted crystal retains maximum value and magical potency.
[Crystal Prospecting: 3]

Dimensional Pocket.name: Dimensional Pocket
Dimensional Pocket.description:
A modest fold in space, personally owned: storage that persists between uses, a quick step of shelter when the corridor turns hostile, an escape hatch the size of a held breath. Your personal extradimensional closet: climate controlled by indifference. The pocket is small and honest (a satchel's soul, not a warehouse's: the vault-scale versions belong to another tier of mastery), slipping inside is momentary refuge rather than residence, and people who watch someone step into nothing and back out develop lasting questions about what else is folded where.
[Space Magic: 5]

Draconic Awakening.name: Draconic Awakening
Draconic Awakening.description:
Rouse the ancient blood sleeping in your marrow for a few fierce turns. Metallic scales ripple across your skin, your pupils narrow to burning slits, and a surge of raw Mana floods your channels. While the awakening holds, your dragonfire and flame spells hit with crushing force, and the apex pressure rolling off you shakes the nerve of lesser foes before a blow is struck.
[Fire Magic: 18]

Fallen Star Strike.name: Fallen Star Strike
Fallen Star Strike.description:
Call down a focused beam of celestial light corrupted by shadow: a hybrid attack that should not be possible, dealing both radiant and dark damage simultaneously. The Church would burn the caster alive for this technique. It is devastating, beautiful, and wrong, and used without hesitation to protect the people who matter.
[Star Magic: 7]

Frost Fang Command.name: Frost Fang Command
Frost Fang Command.description:
Direct a bonded spirit beast to attack with concentrated ice magic, the creature growing temporarily larger and unleashing a frozen bite that leaves frostburn on the target. The cuter the beast looks before the attack, the worse it is going to hurt. Requires an active beast companion with ice affinity.
[Beast Keeping: 4]

Marionette Strings.name: Marionette Strings
Marionette Strings.description:
Invisible threads settle onto a target's limbs; not control, interference: a stumble at the crucial step, fingers that open around a weapon's grip, a hesitation inserted mid-lunge like a stage direction. Sabotage, not possession. Targets who finally spot the threads respond with the special fury of someone who has been tripped for ten minutes.
[performance: 2]

Martyr's Sacrifice.name: Martyr's Sacrifice
Martyr's Sacrifice.description:
The transfer, performed without anesthesia: an ally's injuries taken onto the priest's own body: their wounds closing as identical ones open on the volunteer. The priest's body pays the honest total; there is no discount for virtue. Allies who watch their wounds bloom on someone else's skin carry the sight permanently, which the order privately considers the second sacrament.
[Focus: 8]

Mechanism Analysis.name: Mechanism Analysis
Mechanism Analysis.description:
Quickly assess a mechanical device, relic mechanism, or dungeon apparatus and understand what it does, what powers it, and what is likely to go wrong. You can identify a device's function, its weak points, and whether touching the big glowing lever is a good idea or the last idea.
[Engineering: 2]

Philosopher's Bomb.name: Philosopher's Bomb
Philosopher's Bomb.description:
The ultimate Alchemist technique. Throw the Philosopher's Bomb: a concoction so perfect it defies natural law. The explosion transmutes everything it touches, heals every ally, damages every enemy, and leaves the battlefield permanently changed. One bomb. Every formula you've ever learned, detonated at once. The aftertaste is victory.
[Alchemy: 70]

Primal Empowerment.name: Primal Empowerment
Primal Empowerment.description:
The tamer pours power down the bond and the beast rises: visibly larger, muscles cabling, eyes lit with borrowed ferocity, every attack landing like the wild remembered its own strength. For the duration, the companion is the monster other monsters warn about. The empowerment runs on the tamer's gift and the bond's depth, fades on schedule, and leaves the beast ravenous, affectionate, and extremely pleased with itself: feed accordingly.
[Beast Keeping: 36]

Regeneration Surge.name: Regeneration Surge
Regeneration Surge.description:
Overdrive your regeneration to monstrous levels. Wounds close in seconds. Broken bones snap back into place. Severed flesh reconnects. For a brief window, you are functionally unkillable, but the metabolic cost is extreme, burning through your energy reserves at a terrifying rate. You'll need to eat everything in sight afterward.
[survival: 12]

Reward Flag Hijack.name: Reward Flag Hijack
Reward Flag Hijack.description: Completed quests turn out to have been more generous all along: a bonus objective everyone technically fulfilled, a hidden reward clause, an alternate clear condition the client forgot to mention and now must honor. The fine print always breaks the bearer's way. The hijack improves outcomes of work genuinely done, failure stays failure, and quartermasters who process this party's returns develop a haunted, recalculating look.

Shadow Step Strike.name: Shadow Step Strike
Shadow Step Strike.description:
The reaper phases through a shadow and the strike arrives with them: instantaneous relocation behind the target, the blow landing before the turn completes. Death comes from the dark, punctually. The whole counterplay is lighting, and the school's veterans measure mastery by how small a shadow they can use: the best need only the target's own.
[Scythe Combat: 3]

Sovereign Presence.name: Sovereign Presence
Sovereign Presence.description:
Manifest the spectral crown above your head and project an aura of absolute authority. Everyone within range is compelled to listen when you speak. Hostile intent wavers. Negotiation stalls break in your favor. Enemies with weaker wills find themselves hesitating, lowering their weapons, or reconsidering whether fighting you is worth the consequence of defying a crown.
[persuasion: 15]

Sovereign's Decree.name: Sovereign's Decree
Sovereign's Decree.description:
Speak a command that reality itself enforces. Your voice carries absolute authority; not through magic in the traditional sense, but through a Blessing so attuned to the concept of command that the universe treats your words as law. Enemies freeze mid-attack. Doors open. Flames extinguish. The decree lasts only a moment, but in that moment, your word is literally the final word.
[persuasion: 20]

Spirit Sight Totem.name: Spirit Sight Totem
Spirit Sight Totem.description:
The totem opens the party's eyes to the world beneath the world: a spirit guide perched atop it, lending sight that strips illusions like paint, drags the hidden into outline, and marks every trap with patient spectral clarity. Nothing sneaks; nothing lies visually. The sight flows while the totem stands and the spirit is honored (knock down one or insult the other and the veil drops back) and the guide sees what is concealed, not what is merely far away.
[Spirit Channeling: 39]

Summoner's Command.name: Summoner's Command
Summoner's Command.description:
One word and every active summon converges on a single name: fangs from the left, claws from above, elemental weight through the middle: a coordinated assault from more angles than any defense has attention. Action economy, weaponized. The command spends the whole roster's positioning on one target (everything else on the field enjoys a momentary vacation), and summons executing an all-in expect the summoner to have chosen correctly: wasted convergence is noted, and discussed.
[persuasion: 13]

Thunderclap Strike.name: Thunderclap Strike
Thunderclap Strike.description:
Ki gathers in both palms and the monk claps: a concussive shockwave detonating outward in a cone: enemies stunned, staggered, and comprehensively re-informed, the sound alone a weapon that argues with inner ears. Applause, weaponized. The clap spends a deep draw of ki in one release (the cone is honest about its shape; stand behind the monk or contribute), the stun rewards enemies packed close, and the technique's report carries through a dungeon like a rumor: everything below now knows a monk is visiting.
[acrobatics: 40]

Transmutation Bomb.name: Transmutation Bomb
Transmutation Bomb.description:
The alchemist throws chaos with a chemistry degree: a bomb birthing a zone of transmutation where the terrain itself forgets its commitments: stone slumping to mud, metal blooming rust, honest ground glassing into ice. The battlefield stops being a fact. Chaos as a tactical weapon, footnoted. The zone alters terrain rather than flesh (its violence is entirely logistical), the transmutations land randomly from the reagent's menu (the alchemist aims the zone, never the outcome) and everyone's footing, friend and foe, becomes a live negotiation.
[Alchemy: 45]

Twilight Execution.name: Twilight Execution
Twilight Execution.description:
The mark that ends in punctuation: an enemy marked for death: attacks against them ignoring a portion of defense, dark damage escalating with each landed strike. When the mark completes: a final burst of shadow, the sentence delivered in full, scaling with what was invested. Marked enemies who understand the mechanism fight the rest of the duel against the arithmetic as much as the swordsman.
[Dark Magic: 53]

Twin Beast Assault.name: Twin Beast Assault
Twin Beast Assault.description:
Two bonded creatures, one thought: a synchronized strike from opposite sides, timed to the same heartbeat, arriving where no single guard can face both. Defending it is a geometry problem with no good answer. The assault requires two beasts who genuinely trust the tamer and each other, jealous partners sync poorly, and asking for perfect coordination spends the pair's focus; they will want praise, and possibly snacks, before the next one.
[Beast Keeping: 22]

Unbreakable Stance.name: Unbreakable Stance
Unbreakable Stance.description:
Feet plant, and the argument is over: no force moves the swordsman; not the charge, not the blast wave, not the tail-swipe that scattered everyone else. They are the anchor, and around an anchor a line can hold. The stance trades all mobility for all stability; while rooted they advance nowhere, and the world's cleverer monsters eventually stop pushing the immovable object and start aiming around it.
[Dungeon Surveying: 4]

Unstoppable Charge.name: Unstoppable Charge
Unstoppable Charge.description:
Full sprint, one destination, zero exceptions: the fighter plows through everything between themselves and the target: smaller enemies trampled as terrain, the target receiving accumulated momentum as devastating impact. Nothing between you and your target matters, a sentence the technique enforces literally. The charge commits to its line at launch (steering was traded for velocity; choose the target like a vow), obstacles slow it in proportion to their sincerity, and formations facing one learn the correct response is the humiliating one: opening a lane.
[athletics: 18]

Veil of Many Faces.name: Veil of Many Faces
Veil of Many Faces.description:
Become anyone. Your disguise transcends illusion; you don't just look like someone else, you feel, smell, and register as them to every form of detection. Mana signature, voice, heartbeat, even spiritual aura shifts to match. You can become a person who exists, a person who doesn't, or a concept wearing a face. The veil is so perfect that sometimes you forget which face is the original.
[Illusion Magic: 15]

Ward of Protection.name: Ward of Protection
Ward of Protection.description:
A defensive ward thrown up in the instant of danger: a barrier blooming between flesh and consequence, exactly on time. Parties with a good ward-enchanter develop the correct habit: standing slightly closer to them. It guards one ally on the turn you place it; it cannot be left waiting for a later blow, so guarding them again takes your action again the next turn.
[Divinity: 3]

Water Purification.name: Water Purification
Water Purification.description:
Water's cleansing nature, taken to its logical extreme: a washing surge that purges every poison, disease, and debuff from allies in range, while the same purity lands on the corrupted and undead as heavy damage, hygiene arriving as judgment. One element, two verdicts. The purification claims its range in one working, it cleanses conditions rather than closing wounds, and channeling water at doctrinal intensity leaves the caster wrung to the last drop: clean, complete, and briefly useless, in the discipline's proud tradition.
[Water Magic: 15]

Wrath of the Wilds.name: Wrath of the Wilds
Wrath of the Wilds.description:
Stop being gentle and let the forest fight through your body. Roots erupt from the ground, thorns lash from every surface, and the trees themselves lean toward the threat. Eyes glow green and the voice harmonizes with ancient wood. This is not gentle nature magic. This is an ecosystem deciding something needs to die.
[Nature Magic: 37]

Battle Precognition.name: Battle Precognition
Battle Precognition.description:
See the next three seconds of combat before they happen. Enemy movements trace themselves in ghostly predictive lines. Openings illuminate like cracks in glass. The optimal strike path burns itself into your vision. For a brief, crystalline window, you fight from the future: every counter perfect, every dodge effortless, every strike landing exactly where it needs to.
[Insight: 15]

requirements.variable: Blessing of the War God's Eye

Breath of the World.name: Breath of the World
Breath of the World.description:
The caster steals the air itself: a suffocating vacuum blooming as every breath in the area is confiscated, then the second cruelty: the stolen air compressed into a pressure bomb, returned at hostile velocity. Two catastrophes, one theft. The name is exact: for one moment, the world holds its breath, and then it shouts.
[Wind Magic: 10]

Celestial Alignment.name: Celestial Alignment
Celestial Alignment.description:
Align your Blessing with the celestial bodies above, channeling their combined gravitational and magical influence through your body. Your power multiplies based on the current night sky: more stars visible means more power available. Under a clear sky, you can channel enough astral energy to reshape terrain, empower entire armies, or unleash a focused beam of concentrated starlight.
[Star Magic: 18]

Contract of Binding.name: Contract of Binding
Contract of Binding.description:
Force a powerful enemy into a demonic contract mid-battle. If the target fails to resist, they are bound by a single rule you dictate for a limited duration. The contract manifests as burning sigils on the target's skin.
[Occult Lore: 60 · persuasion: 7]

Crescent Moon Slash.name: Crescent Moon Slash
Crescent Moon Slash.description:
The base form of a legend: a wide arcing slash releasing a crescent wave of cutting energy, named for the shape of mana it leaves hanging like a signature the sky would recognize. Every school has a first page; this one has a future. Swordsmen who dismiss it as basic have described the technique's ceiling, not its floor.
[Swordsmanship: 28]

Designed Perfection.name: Designed Perfection
Designed Perfection.description: For a short protocol window, the homunculus becomes exactly what its designer promised: movements resolving to clean geometry, tolerances tightening past humanoid limits, calculations running in cool alchemical silence. Its perfect stillness mid-activation is the one moment the homunculus looks least like a person: a fact they are aware of, and quiet about.

Dragon's Breath Cut.name: Dragon's Breath Cut
Dragon's Breath Cut.description:
Fire ki poured down the blade until the slash exhales: a wave of flame along the cut's arc, burning through armor and leaving a trail of fire in its wake. Armor's melting point becomes tactically relevant. The burning trail is both area denial and signature: this swordsman's cuts are still visible an hour later.
[Swordsmanship: 8]

Dream Training Loop.name: Dream Training Loop
Dream Training Loop.description: Sleep stops being downtime: the dreaming mind runs drills (the duel replayed until the counter lands, the incantation rehearsed syllable by syllable, the difficult conversation practiced against a dream that argues back) and the body wakes carrying real progress. The loop rehearses only what the waking mind has genuinely encountered, and bearers develop a reputation for improving overnight that is entirely, suspiciously literal.

Enchanting Presence.name: Enchanting Presence
Enchanting Presence.description: Temporarily heighten your supernatural social presence, making your words harder to ignore and your persuasion more effective. Does not override free will; it makes you radiantly compelling for a few crucial moments.

Exile's Benediction.name: Exile's Benediction
Exile's Benediction.description: Bless an ally with imperfect divine protection that shields them from the next harmful effect. Leaves a visible mark of pale gold and ash: a sign that something holy but fractured interceded on their behalf.

Experimental Elixir.name: Experimental Elixir
Experimental Elixir.description:
The alchemist drinks their own research: one random powerful enhancement: strength that bends bars, speed that blurs, resilience that shrugs axes, or magical potency that alarms nearby mages. The menu is the alchemist's own; the selection is chance's. The ritual: the pause, the effect, and the professional assessment, 'interesting,' delivered at whatever new volume applies.
[Alchemy: 37]

Gunslinger's Trance.name: Gunslinger's Trance
Gunslinger's Trance.description:
The world slows to the width of a gunsight: absolute focus where every shot is perfect, every reload instant, every dodge pre-calculated: for the duration, untouchable and lethal, a person operating at the theoretical maximum of the discipline. The trance runs briefly at the nervous system's expense (what focus borrows, exhaustion collects: the shakes afterward are famous), entering it cannot be rushed or faked, and witnesses describe watching one the way people describe weather: something happening above argument.
[Firearms: 40]

Infinite Reflection.name: Infinite Reflection
Infinite Reflection.description:
Shatter reality into a hall of infinite mirrors. Dozens of perfect copies of yourself step out of reflective surfaces: each one real enough to fight, speak, and bleed. Enemies cannot distinguish the original from the copies. Every mirror, puddle, and polished surface in the area becomes a doorway. You are everywhere at once, and every direction an enemy turns, you're already there.
[Illusion Magic: 18]

Lullaby of the Deep.name: Lullaby of the Deep
Lullaby of the Deep.description:
A haunting melody that induces drowsiness and disorientation in enemies. Stronger targets feel heavy and sluggish; weak-willed targets simply fall asleep where they stand. The song is beautiful, which makes it worse: the last thing targets hear before losing consciousness is the most lovely sound of their lives.
[performance: 5]

Masterwork Shortcut.name: Masterwork Shortcut
Masterwork Shortcut.description: Deadlines lose their power: with the forge lit and the hours impossible, the hands simply know the sequence that skips every bottleneck: the quench that should take a day happening in an hour, the enchantment settling on the first attempt. The shortcut still needs real materials, real tools, and a maker who genuinely knows the craft; it compresses labor, not knowledge. Masterworks born this way are flawless and slightly uncanny, and master crafters can always tell.

Nature's Camouflage.name: Nature's Camouflage
Nature's Camouflage.description:
The ranger stops being separate from the scenery: blended so completely into natural surroundings (forest, grassland, snow, anywhere nature provides cover) that eyes slide past. Breathing slows. Scent dampens. The wilderness closes over them like water over a stone. The camouflage holds while the ranger holds still or moves with the landscape's own rhythm (sprinting shatters it; drifting like weather does not), it needs genuine nature to borrow (ballrooms decline), and prey-turned-predators describe the reveal identically: the forest stood up.
[survival: 3]

Phantom Echo Strike.name: Phantom Echo Strike
Phantom Echo Strike.description:
A fraction of a second behind every attack, its phantom lands: identical force, identical point, a double-tap the target's guard already spent itself on. Blocking the first blow buys precisely nothing. The echo is faithful to a fault: a poor strike echoes poorly, a miss echoes a miss, and duelists who study the bearer long enough learn to fear not the sword but the pause after it.
[Swordsmanship: 2]

Puppet Army Assault.name: Puppet Army Assault
Puppet Army Assault.description:
Every active puppet converges on a single name: blades from the flanks, needles from above, the heavy chassis through the front door: a coordinated assault from more angles than a defense has hands. Overwhelm is the entire philosophy. The assault spends the whole troupe's positioning in one command; afterward the puppets stand scattered and the puppeteer must reposition the board, thread by thread, before the next performance.
[Artifice: 10]

Rare Material Radar.name: Rare Material Radar
Rare Material Radar.description: A quiet pull at the edge of attention: rare ore humming behind that wall, a relic fragment sleeping under that floor, the herb that should not grow here growing here anyway. Dungeons become treasure maps that annotate themselves. The sense points but does not price the getting (the guardian, the trap, and the climb remain honest work) and prospectors who watch the bearer walk straight to a vein twice stop believing in luck and start following them.

Spatial Sovereignty.name: Spatial Sovereignty
Spatial Sovereignty.description:
Rewrite the geometry of space within your domain. Compress distance to make an enemy's sword arm too short to reach you. Expand corridors into labyrinthine mazes. Fold space to teleport allies to safety. Within your sphere of influence, three-dimensional space is a suggestion, and you are making revisions. The visual effect is nauseating for anyone who isn't you.
[Space Magic: 18]

Spell Transcription.name: Spell Transcription
Spell Transcription.description:
Transcribe a witnessed spell into scroll form, creating a permanent record that can be studied, taught, or activated later. The transcription captures the spell's structure but not the caster's power: the scroll produces a weaker version of the original. Still, a spell library built this way is worth more than gold.
[Inscription: 45]

Steal the Technique.name: Steal the Technique
Steal the Technique.description: Watch it once, truly watch it, and the principle comes loose: the footwork's logic, the incantation's spine, the trick inside the technique. What follows is the bearer's own attempt: personal, imperfect, and improving. Theft this elegant still requires practice to polish. The extraction needs a genuine demonstration to study, and practitioners who recognize their life's work being test-driven by a stranger react along a spectrum from mentorship to bloodfeud.

Summon Great Spirit.name: Summon Great Spirit
Summon Great Spirit.description:
The walker calls upward and something great answers: a revered ancestor in half-remembered armor, a nature kami trailing seasons, a guardian entity old enough to find the battle quaint. It fights with power and, more dangerously, with wisdom, offering opinions the summoner is expected to hear. Great spirits attend by consent, not command: the call requires standing with the other side, the visit is finite, and a great spirit dismissed rudely does not answer twice.
[Spirit Channeling: 69]

Summon Spirit Beast.name: Summon Spirit Beast
Summon Spirit Beast.description:
The summoner's first true contract: a spirit beast stepping through, fighting until dismissed or destroyed. The first time you call it you name its shape and element (a wolf of pure mana, a hawk of crackling energy, a serpent of flowing water, or one of your own), and that choice is the contract: the same beast answers every call after. It harasses, guards, and finishes rather than duels champions; destruction returns it mildly offended rather than dead. First beasts are remembered the way knights remember first swords.
[Spirit Channeling: 3]

Terrifying Presence.name: Terrifying Presence
Terrifying Presence.description:
Killing intent, made visible: dark pressure thickening the air: weaker enemies simply fleeing, stronger enemies hesitating at the threshold of their own courage. This is what a predator's gaze feels like, distributed. Constructs and the mindless attend no theater. Its truest cost is social: allies remember the chill, and the fighter knows they remember.
[intimidation: 15]

Worldtree's Embrace.name: Worldtree's Embrace
Worldtree's Embrace.description:
Call upon the deep roots of the world itself. Massive vines, roots, and living wood erupt from the ground: seizing enemies, forming barriers, creating bridges, healing allies through contact with living nature. The forest responds to your will as if you were its sovereign. Flowers bloom in your wake. The air fills with pollen and life force. The very ground beneath your feet chooses your side.
[Nature Magic: 18]

Archmage's Cataclysm.name: Archmage's Cataclysm
Archmage's Cataclysm.description:
The ultimate Mage spell. Command all elements simultaneously, fire, ice, lightning, earth, wind, and water, and unleash them in a coordinated cataclysm that reshapes the battlefield. Nothing within the blast zone is left unchanged.
[Elemental Magic: 40]

Awaken Dormant Power.name: Awaken Dormant Power
Awaken Dormant Power.description:
Safely coax a dormant power out of a relic, activating its ancient ability for a limited time. The relic responds to your understanding of its nature, granting a fraction of its former glory. Handle with care: some relics remember why they were sealed.
[Relic Appraisal: 5]

Botanical Extraction.name: Botanical Extraction
Botanical Extraction.description:
Extract concentrated essence from a rare plant, creating a potent reagent that amplifies the next potion or remedy it is used in. The essence captures the plant's full magical potency: far beyond what dried herbs retain. Alchemists pay handsomely for quality extractions.
[Herbalism: 24]

Buff Cuisine Miracle.name: Buff Cuisine Miracle
Buff Cuisine Miracle.description: A meal leaves the kitchen carrying more than flavor: the stew that steadies sword arms, the tea that refills mana like a tide, the festival dessert that makes an entire party fight like they slept for a week. The miracle needs real cooking with real ingredients and real care, rations perked up in a hurry give rations' results, and word of a cook whose food does that travels through guilds, courts, and armies at the speed of hunger.

Celestial Revelation.name: Celestial Revelation
Celestial Revelation.description:
Illuminate all hidden things in an area: invisible enemies, concealed traps, disguised identities, suppressed curses, and hidden emotions. The light is warm, golden, and impossibly gentle for something that strips away every secret in range. Nothing remains hidden. Nothing gets to pretend.
[Light Magic: 5]

Demon Severing Blade.name: Demon Severing Blade
Demon Severing Blade.description:
The cut that severs evil's root: a holy-infused slash aimed not at the dark entity, but at the bond between the entity and its power, dealing massive damage to undead, demons, and the corrupted while leaving a deeper wound underneath: the sensation of their strength being severed at the root. Demons who survive one describe it with theological precision: the blade did not hate them. It CORRECTED them.
[Divinity: 51]

Dimensional Collapse.name: Dimensional Collapse
Dimensional Collapse.description:
The ultimate space spell. Collapse a section of three-dimensional space into a two-dimensional plane, crushing everything within into a flat geometric imprint before the universe snaps back to normal. The affected area folds like paper, compresses to nothing, and then violently re-expands. Reality was not designed to do this. You make it do this anyway.
[Space Magic: 48]

Dragon God's Descent.name: Dragon God's Descent
Dragon God's Descent.description:
The ultimate Dragon Knight technique. Channel the essence of the Dragon God (the first and greatest of all dragonkind) and become an avatar of primordial fire and fury. Your body transforms completely, your breath levels mountains, your roar shatters spells, and every strike carries the weight of the ancient world. For a few transcendent moments, you are not merely a knight who rides dragons. You are the dragon, and the world remembers why it feared them.
[Fire Magic: 51]

Elemental Attunement.name: Elemental Attunement
Elemental Attunement.description:
The mage picks a side for a while: one element attuned, every spell of that type amplified: fire burning hotter, ice freezing deeper, the chosen discipline performing above its station. A fire-attuned mage's ice arrives apologetic. Choosing which is the whole tactical read of the coming fight.
[Elemental Magic: 2]

Fatal Scene Reversal.name: Fatal Scene Reversal
Fatal Scene Reversal.description: The scene that should have been an ending finds a seam instead: the blade turns on a buckle, the fall finds the one ledge, the poison meets a stomach that ate the right thing at lunch. Survival, narrow and dramatic, with every consequence intact: the wound, the loss, the debt of it all still land. The reversal buys the ending back, never the cost, and it does not announce how many times it will work. Nobody has ever wanted to find out.

Gravitational Vortex.name: Gravitational Vortex
Gravitational Vortex.description:
Create a swirling vortex of intensified gravity that drags everything in a radius toward its center. Enemies caught in the vortex are pulled to the ground, their movements slowed to a crawl, their weapons too heavy to lift. The vortex lasts several seconds: long enough for your party to reposition, escape, or unleash ranged attacks on immobilized targets.
[Gravity Magic: 2]

Guaranteed Rare Drop.name: Guaranteed Rare Drop
Guaranteed Rare Drop.description: Major victories refuse to be stingy: the elite falls and something worth keeping is simply there: in the hoard, in the chest, in the Riftlight's parting gift. The guarantee answers only genuine triumphs (trash mobs stay honest work), and its consistency is its own tell: hunters who party with this one come home rich, come home talking, and eventually come home followed.

Ice Miracle Dominion.name: Ice Miracle Dominion
Ice Miracle Dominion.description:
The winter-court at royal scale: terrain frozen into a domain that acknowledges its monarch, allies preserved in gentle stasis-frost, enemies locked in crystal prisons with individual sentencing. The court, in session. One great working per miracle. Ice that saves is the court's secret, and fields it has ruled thaw last every spring thereafter, respectfully.
[Ice Magic: 15]

Mana Ocean Overdrive.name: Mana Ocean Overdrive
Mana Ocean Overdrive.description: The reserves stop pretending to have a floor: mana regenerates in tides, pools in reserves that embarrass archmages, and enormous spells fire back to back without the collapse that arithmetic demands. The ocean supplies fuel, not finesse (a clumsy spell fired from an ocean is a clumsy flood) and mana-sensitives within a mile can feel the bearer like weather, which makes anonymity a fond memory.

Mid-Battle Evolution.name: Mid-Battle Evolution
Mid-Battle Evolution.description: The fight itself becomes the forge: mid-combat, the body answers the current threat with exactly the adaptation it demands: reflexes retuning to the enemy's rhythm, skin thickening against their element, instincts rewriting mid-exchange. Enemies watch their advantage evaporate in real time. Each evolution answers the threat at hand and fades when the pressure does, and evolving in front of witnesses is unforgettable in precisely the way careful people avoid.

No-Pain Combat Focus.name: No-Pain Combat Focus
No-Pain Combat Focus.description: Agony arrives and is politely declined: pain feedback dims to information, leaving hands steady enough for spellwork and footwork clean enough for form, no matter what the body is currently enduring. The focus suppresses the noise, not the damage, wounds still bleed, bones still count, and fighters who never flinch unnerve everyone watching, allies included. The bill for all that ignored pain is paid later, in full, alone.

Reactive Enchantment.name: Reactive Enchantment
Reactive Enchantment.description:
The enchanter applies the volatile masterpiece: an enchantment that drinks the force of the blows aimed at its bearer and, as the exchange ends, explodes: the stored force returned to every nearby enemy in one educational detonation. Hitting it is contributing, and the bearer stands at ground zero of their own investment: the blast spares its owner and precisely no one else's positioning. It guards you or one ally on the turn you lay it; laying it again takes your action again each turn.
[Enchanting: 59]

Side-Effect Surprise.name: Side-Effect Surprise
Side-Effect Surprise.description:
Administer a potion mid-combat that heals the target reliably but causes a random cosmetic or behavioral side effect: temporary hair color change, uncontrollable humming, brief height increase, or aggressive confidence. The healing is genuine. The side effects are legendary.
[Alchemy: 3]

Soul String Dominion.name: Soul String Dominion
Soul String Dominion.description:
Extend invisible threads of mana that attach to anything: creatures, objects, enchantments, even other spells. What's connected to your strings moves at your command. Enemies find their limbs jerking in directions they didn't choose. Weapons turn against their wielders. Defensive spells redirect themselves. You conduct the battlefield like an orchestra, and every player dances to your tune.
[Enchanting: 15]

Spirit Barrier Weave.name: Spirit Barrier Weave
Spirit Barrier Weave.description:
Weave a barrier between the material and spirit worlds that blocks passage for corrupted entities, demons, and summoned creatures. The barrier looks like woven moonlight and smells like deep forest. Allies inside feel calmer and more focused. Enemies inside feel watched by ancient eyes.
[Nature Magic: 15]

Spirit Interrogation.name: Spirit Interrogation
Spirit Interrogation.description:
The exorcist compels a spirit into deposition: everything it knows about a target surrendered: weaknesses, hidden abilities, secret vulnerabilities, the fears it witnessed when no one living was watching. The spirit's knowledge becomes your weapon. The interrogation requires a spirit that plausibly knows (the dead observe much, not everything), compelling testimony from the unwilling departed is heavy divinity spent in one sitting, and spirits interrogated remember the experience: the next one may need convincing of a different kind.
[Insight: 24]

Spirit Veil Illusion.name: Spirit Veil Illusion
Spirit Veil Illusion.description:
Create illusory duplicates and environmental distortions using foxfire and shrine magic. Enemies fight shadows and phantoms while the real threats reposition. The illusions are playful by default, grinning foxes, floating lanterns, disappearing paths, but become terrifying when the caster stops playing.
[Illusion Magic: 3]

Summon Greater Beast.name: Summon Greater Beast
Summon Greater Beast.description:
The contract's next chapter: a dire wolf with strategy in its eyes, a young wyvern practicing menace, a stone golem with a foundation's patience: intelligent enough to follow complex tactics. Flank, delay, protect, retrieve: spoken once. Summoners grow so accustomed to the partnership that fighting without it feels like missing a hand.
[Spirit Channeling: 19]

Temporal Sovereignty.name: Temporal Sovereignty
Temporal Sovereignty.description:
Seize control of time within a localized area. You can slow enemies to a crawl, accelerate allies to blinding speed, or briefly rewind a few seconds to undo a critical mistake. Your perception of time fractures; you see past, present, and immediate future simultaneously, choosing the timeline where you win. Your eye transforms into a spiraling clock face while active.
[Time Magic: 20]

Total Recall Archive.name: Total Recall Archive
Total Recall Archive.description: Nothing leaves: the overheard sentence from three towns back, the exact wording of the contract, the smell in the corridor before the ambush, the fourth guard's face. Everything seen, heard, read, tasted, or felt is shelved, indexed, and retrievable in perfect detail. The archive stores what the senses actually caught (it cannot recall what was never noticed) and people who realize the bearer forgets nothing begin choosing their words with lawyerly care.

Volatile Potion Toss.name: Volatile Potion Toss
Volatile Potion Toss.description:
Throw an unstable potion that detonates on impact with a random elemental effect: fire, ice, lightning, acid, or healing mist. The effect is unpredictable, but the damage is real. Roll the dice and throw the bottle.
[Alchemy: 3]

Wound Reversal Surge.name: Wound Reversal Surge
Wound Reversal Surge.description: The hit that should have ended the exchange feeds it instead: pain transmutes mid-impact into a flood of vitality and mana, wounds paying out as power, the enemy's best blow becoming the bearer's comeback bell. Pressure makes them stronger, which is a terrible thing for pressure to learn. The surge answers dangerous hits only, chip damage converts nothing, and fighters who visibly benefit from being struck cause a very specific kind of enemy despair.

Ancient Dragon Summon.name: Ancient Dragon Summon
Ancient Dragon Summon.description:
The call goes down through centuries and something answers with a sigh: the spirit of an ancient dragon coalescing in spectral scale and smoke, intelligent, immensely powerful, and deeply unimpressed by modern threats. It fights like a professor grading. The great spirit attends briefly and by its own dignity (it is summoned, never commanded) and it expects the summoner's respect and a worthy occasion: dragons called for trivialities have been known to critique instead of fight.
[intimidation: 45]

Bushido's Final Stand.name: Bushido's Final Stand
Bushido's Final Stand.description:
When all seems lost, the code speaks last: for the duration, the samurai cannot be reduced below 1 HP: attacks landing with increased force, will radiating as visible spiritual fire, a person burning their honor as fuel because everything else is spent. The stand holds for its window and not one breath past it (the code buys the moment; the party buys the outcome), it can be invoked only when the situation genuinely warrants the name, and enemies who watch a dying samurai ignite understand, correctly, that the fight's terms just changed authorship.
[survival: 72]

Dragon Lord's Command.name: Dragon Lord's Command
Dragon Lord's Command.description:
The Dragon Knight speaks and the breed listens: wyverns banking mid-dive, drakes breaking formation, wyrms turning their heads: every dragon-kin on the battlefield answering to the banner of the voice, because the voice carries the blood's authority. The command sways dragon-kin only and holds while the presence dominates (truly ancient or truly bonded creatures weigh the voice against their own loyalties: the command is authority, not puppetry), and using it publicly settles every rumor about the knight's lineage at once.
[intimidation: 57]

Fire Miracle Dominion.name: Fire Miracle Dominion
Fire Miracle Dominion.description:
Royal fire: purifying infernos that burn the corruption and spare the corrupted, phoenix flames arriving where a heartbeat was ending, and the crown jewel: divine combustion that destroys enemies while sparing chosen allies. Fire with a guest list. One great working per miracle. Any fire burns; this one chooses, and armies that stand unburned inside an inferno aimed at their enemies convert on the spot.
[Fire Magic: 15]

Material Preservation.name: Material Preservation
Material Preservation.description:
Treat and preserve monster materials immediately after harvest, preventing the degradation that causes most looted parts to lose potency within hours. Your harvested cores stay bright, your scales stay supple, and your extracts stay viable.
[Monster Harvesting: 3]

Monster Leather Craft.name: Monster Leather Craft
Monster Leather Craft.description:
Work monster leather into functional armor or accessories that carry the creature's properties. Drakehide becomes flame-resistant plate, basilisk leather turns into flexible but impenetrable armor, and kraken-skin becomes a cloak that breathes underwater. The result is armor that money cannot buy.
[Leatherworking: 4]

No-Sell Perfect Guard.name: No-Sell Perfect Guard
No-Sell Perfect Guard.description: The blow that should have mattered simply doesn't: a parry with cinematic timing, the impact shed like rain off slate, and the attacker suddenly overextended in front of someone completely unharmed and visibly deciding what to do about it. The guard answers major hits at dramatic moments (it is a statement, not a stance) and the statement is expensive to repeat: perfection like that must be re-earned before it speaks again.

One-Hour Full Restore.name: One-Hour Full Restore
One-Hour Full Restore.description: One hour of sleep, anywhere, and the body simply decides the night happened: wounds knit their day's worth, fatigue drains out, mana refills to the brim. Watch rotations become a formality; dungeons lose their war of attrition. It looks wrong to anyone paying attention, nobody wakes that rested on stone, and companions notice, quartermasters notice, and enemies who learn of it start planning around a target that never tires. The hour itself is real sleep: defenseless, and worth guarding.

Pain-to-Power Reactor.name: Pain-to-Power Reactor
Pain-to-Power Reactor.description: Every hit taken is a deposit: incoming force pours into a reservoir and comes back out as the next attack's edge, the next spell's surge, the next guard's stubbornness. Enemies learn, horribly, that hurting them is a loan with interest. The reactor stores what actually lands (untouched, it idles) and a body that banks too much punishment glows faintly at the seams, which sharp opponents read as exactly what it is: a countdown.

Perfect Counter Equip.name: Perfect Counter Equip
Perfect Counter Equip.description: The right tool is already in hand: the moment the enemy declares itself, the environment shifts, or the social trap springs, the ideal answer from the bearer's own gear is simply equipped: the silvered blade for the wraith, the diplomat's coat for the ambush of etiquette. The counter draws only from what the bearer actually owns and has ready, and opponents who watch them meet every situation pre-armed start assuming, correctly, that surprise is off the table.

Philosopher's Draught.name: Philosopher's Draught
Philosopher's Draught.description:
The finest work of an Alchemist's career, consumed in one glorious gulp: regeneration flooding the body, every debuff purified mid-swallow, all attributes temporarily enhanced. The alchemist carries one, maybe two, guarded like heirlooms. The empty bottle is traditionally kept: proof, on a shelf, that perfection happened once and was drunk.
[Alchemy: 61]

Prayer of Restoration.name: Prayer of Restoration
Prayer of Restoration.description:
The sustained prayer: healing flowing to an ally over time along a golden thread of light strung between priest and patient: regeneration continuing as long as concentration holds, mending delivered in a steady voice rather than a shout. Recovery, on retainer. The prayer restores while maintained (the thread is honest: it snaps when the priest's focus does, and everyone can see it snap), it tends one ally per thread, and its bedside pace is the point: the burst heals are for the moment of crisis; this is for carrying someone through the whole storm.
[Divinity: 3]

Primal Rune Awakening.name: Primal Rune Awakening
Primal Rune Awakening.description:
The ultimate Rune Knight technique. Carve the Primal Rune (the first and greatest symbol of power) into reality itself. Your entire body becomes covered in living runes that pulse with elemental fury. Every strike casts a spell, every step leaves a rune trap, and your weapon becomes a conduit for the fundamental forces of the world. You are not a warrior who uses runes. You are the rune.
[Rune Carving: 63]

Rift Miracle Dominion.name: Rift Miracle Dominion
Rift Miracle Dominion.description:
Exercised where the world is already wounded: a collapsing Riftmaw room stabilized mid-groan, broken space crossed like a hallway, hazards redirected toward the dungeon's own occupants: the Riftmaw's wound instructed to obey, and obeying. The dungeon's landlord, visiting. One great working per miracle. Delvers afterward report the rooms behaving oddly politely.
[Rift Magic: 15]

Soul Miracle Dominion.name: Soul Miracle Dominion
Soul Miracle Dominion.description:
Spoken at the register only souls hear: allies warded against possession entirely, restless spirits laid to genuine peace, an unraveling identity anchored, or a promise made to shine across the veil itself, visible to living and dead alike. One great working per miracle, paid in the currency souls respect: meaning. Both sides of the veil treat the sovereign afterward as mutually vouched for.
[Soul Magic: 15]

Star Miracle Dominion.name: Star Miracle Dominion
Star Miracle Dominion.description:
The constellation miracle across a whole battlefield: every enemy marked beneath a living star-map, allies guided through darkness by lights only they can read, astral light raining down along the lines of fate itself. For one miracle's span, the night sky takes a side. Every witness understands they have seen a blessing at full authority: the kind of sight that reorganizes faiths.
[Star Magic: 15]

Time Miracle Dominion.name: Time Miracle Dominion
Time Miracle Dominion.description:
Invoked when moments matter most: a lethal barrage slowed to a survivable crawl, one impossible opening granted where none was scheduled, a mortal wound delayed long enough for hands to reach it, or the battlefield made to hold its breath for one decisive second. Time, petitioned successfully. Borrowed moments are repaid with interest, personally. Witnesses describe it identically: the silence, and what got decided inside it.
[Time Magic: 15]

Treasure Table Reroll.name: Treasure Table Reroll
Treasure Table Reroll.description: Disappointment is negotiable: the chest of moldy rope becomes a chest with a false bottom, the pittance of coin turns out to have a rare coin in it, the junk drop conceals suspiciously useful gear. Fortune gets one second draft per poor outcome. The reroll improves what the world already offered (it cannot conjure a hoard from a beggar's pocket) and gamblers, merchants, and gods of luck all eventually notice whose odds keep bending.

Void Miracle Dominion.name: Void Miracle Dominion
Void Miracle Dominion.description:
The absence miracle, opened where something used to insist: a hostile field simply nullified, an enemy caster zone rendered silent as a sealed room, a dangerous magical effect instructed to fail to remain, and failing accordingly. Not destruction. Absence. One great unmaking per miracle. Witnesses describe the aftermath identically: the quiet, and how loud it was.
[Void Magic: 15]

Wind Miracle Dominion.name: Wind Miracle Dominion
Wind Miracle Dominion.description:
The gale-domain at battlefield scale: allies lifted over the impossible gap, formations scattered, arrow volleys redirected mid-flight, the battlefield's air reorganized into one chosen path. The sky's currents, commanded. One great working per miracle. Every witness leaves with the same conclusion: the weather has a master.
[Wind Magic: 15]

Blade of the Ancestors.name: Blade of the Ancestors
Blade of the Ancestors.description:
Call upon the spirits of fallen swordsmen to guide your blade. For the duration, your swordsmanship transcends mortal limits: every technique is enhanced by ancestral wisdom. The blade carries the weight of generations.
[Enchanting: 8]

Blood Miracle Dominion.name: Blood Miracle Dominion
Blood Miracle Dominion.description:
The crimson-oath miracle, invoked at the price the name implies: dying allies stabilized by decree, enemies bound through their own spilled blood as if it signed for them, the party empowered through shared vitality, or a personal cost paid, openly, for a battle-turning surge. One great working per miracle, and it always states its price in the same breath. Witnesses trust or fear the sovereign in exact proportion to having watched them pay.
[Blood Magic: 15]

Charm Miracle Dominion.name: Charm Miracle Dominion
Charm Miracle Dominion.description:
The heart-court miracle: a party steadied in one warm decree, a hostile crowd softened from mob to audience, fear transmuted into courage without denying its cause, or every hidden feeling in the room made briefly, mutually, impossible to ignore. One great working per miracle. It persuades, never puppets, that distinction is the sovereignty.
[Charm Magic: 15]

Dream Miracle Dominion.name: Dream Miracle Dominion
Dream Miracle Dominion.description:
Where sleep and story overlap: a nightmare field calmed like a fever breaking, guardians manifested from the party's own better memories, a boss's dream logic translated into something the party can overcome. One great working per miracle. Parties who have fought inside a managed dream wake changed: braver, and slightly better rested.
[Dream Magic: 15]

Earth Miracle Dominion.name: Earth Miracle Dominion
Earth Miracle Dominion.description:
The earth-kingdom miracle at sovereign scale: open ground reorganizing into a fortress in one groaning breath, an enemy charge swallowed to the waist in suddenly personal terrain, a sanctuary raised that simply refuses to break. The land, briefly, has a monarch. One great working per miracle. Every witness recalibrates what the word 'geomancy' was supposed to mean.
[Earth Magic: 15]

Flame Emperor's Domain.name: Flame Emperor's Domain
Flame Emperor's Domain.description:
Transform the battlefield into your domain of fire. The air ignites. The ground becomes molten. Enemies burn from the inside out while you stand at the center, untouched, your body wreathed in flames that move with your will. Everything within the domain answers to you: fire is not your weapon, fire is your kingdom, and you have just expanded its borders.
[Fire Magic: 20]

Harvest Critical Point.name: Harvest Critical Point
Harvest Critical Point.description: The eye simply knows: the exact seam where the ore wants to part, the one cut that takes the hide whole, the stem-point that keeps the herb potent, the joint that yields the fang unchipped. Yields climb; quality climbs further; master crafters start asking uncomfortable questions about who taught the technique. The knowing works only up close with tools in hand, and it makes its bearer very popular with guild suppliers and very interesting to their competitors.

Infinite Mana Overflow.name: Infinite Mana Overflow
Infinite Mana Overflow.description: The well has no visible bottom: mana pours in faster than casting pours it out, letting the bearer sling spells a full tier above their station without scraping empty. Duels of attrition become jokes told at their opponent's expense. Overflow supplies quantity, not quality (control and technique are still the caster's own problem) and mana senses read the bearer like a bonfire in a dark field, which is exactly as noticeable as it sounds.

Ingredient Truth Taste.name: Ingredient Truth Taste
Ingredient Truth Taste.description: One taste and the ingredient confesses everything: origin, freshness, hidden toxin, buried enchantment, the rare property the merchant did not know they were selling, and, unsettlingly, the emotional state of whoever cooked it. Poisoners despise the bearer on principle. The truth requires an actual taste, which is occasionally an act of courage, and the palate reads what is there, never what a recipe could make of it.

Instant Loadout Change.name: Instant Loadout Change
Instant Loadout Change.description: Between one heartbeat and the next, the entire kit swaps: heavy plate to duelist's leathers, warhammer to throwing knives, dungeon rig to dinner-party elegance, without breaking stride or drama. Momentum never pays the price of preparation. The swap draws only from gear the bearer owns and stowed, and watching a person change entire loadouts mid-lunge does things to enemy morale that no single weapon could.

Light Miracle Dominion.name: Light Miracle Dominion
Light Miracle Dominion.description:
The field flooded with sacred radiance: every illusion exposed mid-lie, corruption cleansed, allies sheltered behind golden barriers raised like scripture, darkness burned back by divine proof. One great working per miracle. Everything unholy that survives leaves with an amended worldview: the light has a monarch, and the monarch was here.
[Light Magic: 15]

Main Character Gravity.name: Main Character Gravity
Main Character Gravity.description: The world leans in. Important strangers strike up conversations; opportunities schedule themselves; dramatic timing bends so the door opens at the line's exact end. It is wonderful and it is not free: gravity pulls everything closer, patrons and assassins, romances and rivals, quests and consequences, and life around the bearer simply refuses to stay quiet. Companions standing in the gravitational field get pulled into the story too, whether they asked to be or not.

Perfect Recipe Insight.name: Perfect Recipe Insight
Perfect Recipe Insight.description: The craft simply opens: hold the goal in mind and the best path to it assembles: this ingredient pairing, that fold of the metal, the enchantment route nobody teaches because nobody found it. Weeks of trial and error compress into one clear knowing. The insight illuminates method, not skill: hands that cannot execute the vision still cannot, and crafters shown a technique that took a guild forty years to develop ask questions the bearer cannot answer honestly.

Sound Miracle Dominion.name: Sound Miracle Dominion
Sound Miracle Dominion.description:
The resonance miracle: defenses shattered at their resonant frequency, casters silenced mid-syllable, allies steadied through rhythm their heartbeats agree to follow, or one command made to carry over an entire battlefield, no exceptions filed. One great working per miracle. Armies describe it identically: there was nowhere the voice was not.
[Sound Magic: 15]

Space Miracle Dominion.name: Space Miracle Dominion
Space Miracle Dominion.description:
The geometry miracle: allies relocated mid-thought, enemies locked into their coordinates like appointments, distance folded so the far flank is suddenly adjacent, emergency gates torn open where no door was budgeted. Distance, repealed. One great working per miracle: space folded carelessly unfolds with opinions. Witnesses stop trusting maps for a week, which is the correct response.
[Space Magic: 15]

Spell Sustain Override.name: Spell Sustain Override
Spell Sustain Override.description: Effects that should gutter simply keep burning: the barrier holds through the third assault, the summon fights past its farewell hour, the flight lasts the whole mountain. Upkeep costs that bankrupt normal casters are paid from a purse that never seems to lighten. The override extends duration, not power (a weak ward held forever is still weak) and mages who watch a spell outlive its arithmetic start asking questions with academic intensity.

Storm Miracle Dominion.name: Storm Miracle Dominion
Storm Miracle Dominion.description:
The tempest opened overhead: stormclouds that answer to a name, morale broken under thunderclaps timed like arguments, flight disrupted mid-wingbeat, flames drowned in commanded rain. One great working per miracle. Any storm can rage; this one aims, and battles fought under a commanded sky are retold with the same opening line: the clouds picked a side.
[Storm Magic: 15]

Water Miracle Dominion.name: Water Miracle Dominion
Water Miracle Dominion.description:
A battlefield flooded with currents that flow where told: corruption purified from water, soil, and wounded alike, allies sheathed in barriers that part for friends and wall against foes, formations overturned by divine pressure waves. The tide, employed. One great working per miracle. Fields it has flooded stay fertile for a generation: the miracle tips.
[Water Magic: 15]

Wind Blade Calligraphy.name: Wind Blade Calligraphy
Wind Blade Calligraphy.description:
Trace wind-infused sword patterns in the air that persist as suspended cutting barriers. Each stroke is precise, beautiful, and lethal: enemies who step through the lingering calligraphy are sliced by invisible wind blades. The only Spellblade technique that turns battlefield control into art.
[Swordsmanship: 9]

Absolute Counter Stance.name: Absolute Counter Stance
Absolute Counter Stance.description: For one exchange, defense stops being reactive: every incoming attack vector (the ambush, the projectile, the feint inside the feint) read automatically and answered with a perfect counter, as if the character studied the assault last week. The exchange ends with attackers overextended and re-evaluating their careers. The stance perfects one exchange, not one battle, and its impossibility is public: veterans who watch someone counter an ambush they couldn'T have seen file the memory under a growing, uncomfortable pattern with the character's name on it.

Archdevil's Incarnation.name: Archdevil's Incarnation
Archdevil's Incarnation.description:
The ultimate Warlock ability. Temporarily channel your patron's full power through your body: your eyes become burning violet, demonic horns of dark energy crown your head, and your magic becomes overwhelming. Your patron speaks through you, and the battlefield bends to infernal law. Brief, terrifying, and the reason the Church keeps a list of Warlock names.
[Dark Magic: 60]

Emergency Gear Manifest.name: Emergency Gear Manifest
Emergency Gear Manifest.description: A hand reaches into nowhere and comes back holding exactly the thing: the antidote for this venom, the formal wear for this gala, the ten feet of rope the plan died without. The manifest supplies only what was actually stored at some point (it is retrieval with perfect timing, not creation) and companions who watch the right tool appear four scenes running stop asking how and start writing shopping lists.

Emergency Reagent Burst.name: Emergency Reagent Burst
Emergency Reagent Burst.description:
Throw volatile alchemical reagents that detonate on impact, creating a blinding flash and noxious cloud that forces enemies to reposition. The burst provides cover for allies to retreat, regroup, or set up a counterattack. The alchemist apologizes the entire time.
[Alchemy: 3]

Enthralling Performance.name: Enthralling Performance
Enthralling Performance.description:
The Dancer's occupation of attention: a performance so captivating that non-hostile creatures simply stop (conversations dying, the room reorganizing around the spectacle) while even hostile targets hesitate. Strong wills shake free early. The technique's finest use is never witnessed by its audience: whatever the party did during the show.
[performance: 6 · acrobatics: 5]

Familiar Transformation.name: Familiar Transformation
Familiar Transformation.description:
The familiar stretches, and keeps stretching: transformed into a combat-capable form: a great cat with the same knowing eyes, a dire bat wearing the old smugness at scale, a serpent whose coils remember being lap-sized. The bond, weaponized without being changed. The transformation holds until dismissed or the familiar is defeated (it reverts, indignant but intact, to be consoled with treats), the greater form fights with the familiar's own cleverness enlarged, and enemies who mocked the witch's little companion revise their comedy under a quarter ton of it.
[Spirit Channeling: 28]

Ice Crown Manifestation.name: Ice Crown Manifestation
Ice Crown Manifestation.description:
The crown of sovereign ice settles and winter acquires an architect: ice spells turning cleaner, structural, deliberate: restraints fitted like shackles a jeweler made, mirrors angled to purpose, blades and platforms raised plumb, seal-frost laid in precise borders, cold barriers with load calculations. Frost, drafted. The crown elevates the wearer's ice magic while manifested, sustaining worn winter is steady chilling work, and the crowned carry the blessing's tell everywhere: their breath is always visible, in every season, and always perfectly still.
[Ice Magic: 5]

Impossible Dodge Window.name: Impossible Dodge Window
Impossible Dodge Window.description: Time does not slow; it opens: in the heart of an unavoidable moment, one narrow, real gap appears, and a body that commits fully can thread it. The dragon's breath parts around them. The trap's teeth close on where they were. The window is exactly as wide as total commitment and not a hair wider (hesitation wastes it entirely) and every impossible survival is witnessed, retold, and added to a growing rumor about the one death keeps missing.

Instant Pattern Library.name: Instant Pattern Library
Instant Pattern Library.description: The present is constantly cross-referenced: this puzzle rhymes with a lock from a ruin two arcs ago, this duelist's rhythm matches a style already studied, this diplomat's smile is the same smile a liar wore in a memory the bearer can replay at will. Patterns surface as fast as events do. The library compares only against what memory actually holds (the truly novel arrives unannounced) and opponents eventually realize the bearer is never solving anything for the first time.

Nature Miracle Dominion.name: Nature Miracle Dominion
Nature Miracle Dominion.description:
The forest-throne at the wild's own scale: a battlefield overgrown in one green breath, allies restored through blooming life, hostile beasts gentled mid-charge by something their instincts recognize as senior: the wild standing up to shield the party like a forest taking sides. Which it is. One great working per miracle. Groves grown by miracle do not ungrow.
[Nature Magic: 15]

Poison Miracle Dominion.name: Poison Miracle Dominion
Poison Miracle Dominion.description:
The venom-court, administered with discretion: miasma that obeys borders like a courtier, enemy armor corroded to lace mid-formation, every poison purged from allies in one royal pardon, or a single perfect toxin composed for one target, delivered with a stiletto's economy. One great working per miracle. This poison goes exactly where invited, and commanders who watch armor dissolve by rank develop lasting protocol changes.
[Poison Magic: 15]

Shadow Miracle Dominion.name: Shadow Miracle Dominion
Shadow Miracle Dominion.description:
The veil-domain spread like nightfall with intent: the party cloaked from sight, an enemy army bound in place by their own shadows, darkness converted into a protected road only the sovereign's people may walk. One great working per miracle. Armies that have been held by their shadows tell the story for the rest of their lives, which is the point.
[Shadow Magic: 15]

Shock Immunity Override.name: Shock Immunity Override
Shock Immunity Override.description: Fear does not land. Pain does not stagger. The ambush springs, the horror reveals itself, the wound opens, and the next decisive action happens anyway, clean and on time, as if the nervous system filed the interruption for later. The override protects one crucial beat, not the whole fight, and the filed sensations do arrive afterward, all at once, in private, where nobody gets to see what it actually cost.

Summon Skeleton Warrior.name: Summon Skeleton Warrior
Summon Skeleton Warrior.description:
The skeleton, done properly: raised with spectral armor and a weapon of condensed dark energy: fighting with genuine martial skill, following complex orders, lasting until destroyed rather than until inconvenient. Not a shambler. A soldier, formerly. It flanks, holds doors, and covers retreats like it remembers doing it alive, because it does. Some get names, and the names get used.
[Dark Magic: 22]

Wrath of the Storm King.name: Wrath of the Storm King
Wrath of the Storm King.description:
The ultimate lightning spell. Summon a localized superstorm above the battlefield: black clouds, howling wind, and continuous lightning strikes that rain down on every enemy in range. You float at the storm's center, eyes crackling with white light, conducting destruction with outstretched hands.
[Lightning Magic: 38]

Crystal Miracle Dominion.name: Crystal Miracle Dominion
Crystal Miracle Dominion.description:
The prism-domain in singing facets: incoming magic refracted into harmless spectra, enemies caged in crystal that hums their own resonance back at them, broken terrain bridged in hard-light spans. Geometry in court dress. One great working per miracle. Battlefields it has touched glitter for years: pilgrims visit, which the blessing appears to enjoy.
[Crystal Magic: 15]

Dimensional Vault Access.name: Dimensional Vault Access
Dimensional Vault Access.description: Somewhere that is nowhere, the bearer keeps everything: gear, treasure, provisions, crafting stock, formalwear, and the emergency supplies for emergencies nobody else planned for: all retrievable with a reach into empty air. Caravans become unnecessary; customs officers become confused. The vault holds what was placed there and nothing living, and companions who watch a full banquet emerge from nothing develop a permanent, reasonable curiosity about what else is in there.

Emergency Recovery Pulse.name: Emergency Recovery Pulse
Emergency Recovery Pulse.description: At the exact moment the body would fold (the wound too deep, the pain too loud) warmth detonates outward from the heart instead: flesh closing just enough, breath returning just enough, one more chance to act arriving precisely on time. It is the difference between a death scene and a comeback. The pulse fires on genuine emergencies only and never twice in quick succession, and each rescue leaves the bearer visibly spent: saved, standing, and running on borrowed fire.

Fire Crown Manifestation.name: Fire Crown Manifestation
Fire Crown Manifestation.description:
Manifest a crown of sovereign flame. Fire spells become sharper, hotter, and easier to sculpt into controlled shapes such as wings, blades, barriers, brands, and phoenix-like bursts without losing precision.
[Fire Magic: 5]

Grand Marionette Theater.name: Grand Marionette Theater
Grand Marionette Theater.description:
The ultimate Puppeteer technique. Every creature on the battlefield, ally, enemy, and bystander alike, feels your strings. Your puppets number in the dozens, your threads span the entire field, and for a few terrifying moments, you are the only one truly acting of your own free will. The battlefield becomes a grand theater with you as the sole director.
[Artifice: 77]

Gravity Miracle Dominion.name: Gravity Miracle Dominion
Gravity Miracle Dominion.description:
The gravity-well miracle: enemy formations pinned mid-charge, allies lifted serenely beyond reach, a boss's armor crushed under its own suddenly unreasonable weight: the battlefield taught to orbit the sovereign's command. Down, renegotiated. One great working per miracle; precision is the mastery, enthusiasm is the danger. Witnesses spend the next week distrusting the floor.
[Gravity Magic: 15]

Rift Crown Manifestation.name: Rift Crown Manifestation
Rift Crown Manifestation.description:
The crown of sovereign rift settles and the thresholds acquire a master: instability sensed like a draft under a door, hidden seams exposed in walls that feigned solidity, jagged portals cut where travel was refused, dungeon hazards redirected toward more deserving tenants. Boundaries, weighed and opened. The crowned's tell: doors open for them a half-second before they knock.
[Rift Magic: 5]

Soul Crown Manifestation.name: Soul Crown Manifestation
Soul Crown Manifestation.description:
The crown of sovereign soul settles and identity acquires a keeper: the wearer's core reinforced against everything that erodes, spirits calmed by being correctly named, vows bound with witness across the veil, possession refused at the front desk. The self, curated. The crowned carry the tell: people feel more like themselves standing near them, and keep finding reasons to.
[Soul Magic: 5]

Star Crown Manifestation.name: Star Crown Manifestation
Star Crown Manifestation.description:
The crown of sovereign stars settles: constellation marks blooming over targets, omen lines threading the air, navigation lights for allies in darkness, fate-map patterns legible to the crowned alone. The night sky, worn as regalia. The sight of it ends all ambiguity: the stars do not crown practitioners. They crown sovereigns.
[Star Magic: 5]

Terms of Reality Rewrite.name: Terms of Reality Rewrite
Terms of Reality Rewrite.description: For one breath, the fine print blinks: a magical contract reinterprets its own clause in the bearer's favor, a curse reads its conditions more generously, a binding decides that technically the terms were met. The rewrite bends existing language (it cannot void a bargain, only re-read it) and every rewritten agreement leaves the other party aware that something impossible just happened to their covenant. Demons take that personally. The Twilight Court takes notes.

Thousand Cherry Blossoms.name: Thousand Cherry Blossoms
Thousand Cherry Blossoms.description:
The storm of slashes at the school's summit: cuts so fast the air fills with cherry-blossom arcs of light: every enemy within reach cut multiple times in what appears to be a single breath. Petals, made of edges. Spring, weaponized. Survivors describe the same impossible thing; it was beautiful, and then everyone was down.
[Dueling: 8]

Time Crown Manifestation.name: Time Crown Manifestation
Time Crown Manifestation.description:
The crown of sovereign time settles and the clock acquires a jeweler: haste fitted to a single ally's tempo, slow fields with exact borders, impacts delayed to the perfect beat, one-breath preservations holding a moment safe until hands can reach it. Chronomancy, in fine print. The crowned are never early, never late, and visibly annoyed by everyone who is either.
[Time Magic: 5]

True Name Interpretation.name: True Name Interpretation
True Name Interpretation.description: Names stop being labels: the Omniglot reads what a name is for: the obligation folded into a title, the trap folded into a contract clause, the loyalty (or the lie) folded into an oath, the true function of a magical inscription written to mislead. Documents confess. Introductions overshare. It is always on and impossible to unknow, and it draws exactly the kind of attention careful people fear: the Twilight Court has opinions about anyone who reads fine print they were never meant to parse.

Void Crown Manifestation.name: Void Crown Manifestation
Void Crown Manifestation.description:
The crown of sovereign void settles and absence acquires portion control: silence fields with exact borders, minor spell erasure performed like line-editing, anti-magic pockets placed where magic was being rude, construct banishment with a receipt. Nothing, administered carefully. The crowned carry the tell: rooms are always slightly quieter where they stand, and nobody can say why.
[Void Magic: 5]

Wind Crown Manifestation.name: Wind Crown Manifestation
Wind Crown Manifestation.description:
The crown of sovereign wind settles and the air acquires a choreographer: air steps placed like stairs that were always there, falls softened into arrivals, projectiles turned mid-flight toward better opinions, breath kept casting-clean under pressure. Motion, administered. The crowned carry the blessing's tell: their hair moves on a breeze that is not, strictly speaking, present.
[Wind Magic: 5]

Automatic Vitality Repair.name: Automatic Vitality Repair
Automatic Vitality Repair.description: The body simply refuses to stay damaged: cuts seal as they open, bruises fade mid-fight, and the shaking exhaustion after danger drains away like water finding a level. It runs constantly, without thought or cost the bearer can feel. Grievous wounds still demand real healing and real time (the repair maintains, it does not resurrect) and healers who examine the bearer come away quietly unsettled by flesh that keeps its own counsel.
