Entangled targets take a turn to cut free and suffer accuracy penalties while restrained. The web covers a small area and requires thirty seconds of preparation, making it a trap technique rather than a reactive one. Fire destroys the web instantly. Extremely strong targets can tear through without slowing. Multiple webs can be layered for cumulative restriction, but each additional layer increases the total setup time.
[Thread Arts: 14]

Marionette Bind.name: Marionette Bind
Marionette Bind.description:
An advanced technique where the user attaches threads to an opponent's limbs and joints during close combat, gradually restricting their range of motion. Each turn of sustained contact adds another thread, progressively reducing the target's attack speed and mobility. After three turns of accumulation, the target's movement is severely impaired. The threads can be severed by allies, burned away, or broken by a burst of sufficient physical force. The user must stay within thread range and maintain tension, limiting their own mobility.
[Thread Arts: 25]

Thread Cage.name: Thread Cage
Thread Cage.description:
The user rapidly deploys threads in a three-dimensional cage pattern around a target, creating a prison of cutting wire that damages anything that tries to pass through it. The cage holds for several turns and deals slashing damage to the target each time they move or attempt to escape. Flying or teleporting targets can escape upward or through spatial displacement. The cage cannot be deployed around targets significantly larger than the user. Allies must avoid the cage as well, as the threads cut indiscriminately.
[Thread Arts: 40]

Puppeteer's Grasp.name: Puppeteer's Grasp
Puppeteer's Grasp.description:
The user attaches spiritual-energy-infused threads to a target's major muscle groups and temporarily overrides their motor control. For one to two turns, the user can force the target to perform simple physical actions against their will: drop a weapon, step in a specific direction, or strike an ally. Targets with strong willpower or magical resistance can fight the control, reducing it to muscle spasms rather than full override. The user cannot act independently while maintaining control. The spiritual threads are visible to magic-sensitive observers and can be severed by dispel effects.
[Thread Arts: 56]

Crimson Web.name: Crimson Web
Crimson Web.description:
A master technique that saturates an entire room or clearing with hundreds of intersecting razor threads, creating a killing field that shreds anything that moves within it. The threads are anchored to every available surface and vibrate at a frequency that makes them nearly invisible even to enhanced perception. Moving through the web at any speed results in dozens of simultaneous cuts. Only the user knows the safe paths through their own web. Setting up the full web requires significant preparation time. Fire, area-effect ice, or spatial distortion collapses the entire structure.
[Thread Arts: 75]

Fate Weaver.name: Fate Weaver
Fate Weaver.description:
The ultimate thread technique, said to have been developed by a legendary seamstress who wove battlefields the way others wove silk. The user deploys threads that connect to every combatant in the area, reading their movements, intentions, and vital signs through vibration feedback. For the duration, the user gains near-perfect awareness of all enemy positions, incoming attacks, and health status, sharing this information with allies through subtle thread signals. Offensively, any thread can be converted to a cutting wire with a flick. The technique requires calm focus; taking significant damage severs the user's concentration and collapses the network. In a world full of monstrous power, this technique wins through information rather than force.
[Thread Arts: 96]

Pillow Bash.name: Pillow Bash
Pillow Bash.description:
A surprisingly forceful swing of a body pillow that uses the weapon's unexpected weight and density to catch opponents completely off guard. The attack deals light physical damage but the sheer absurdity of being struck by a pillow causes a morale penalty to dignified opponents such as knights, nobles, and proud monsters. Targets with no sense of shame or social awareness are immune to the morale effect. The pillow's soft exterior means it cannot deal critical wounds, but the humiliation lingers far longer than any bruise.
[Body Pillow Combat: 1]

Comfort Shield.name: Comfort Shield
Comfort Shield.description:
The user holds the body pillow as an improvised shield, using its bulk to absorb incoming projectiles and light melee strikes. The pillow's stuffing disperses impact force across a wide area, making it surprisingly effective against blunt attacks. Edged weapons and fire cut or ignite the pillow, rapidly degrading its defensive value. While using the pillow defensively, the user projects an aura of domestic absurdity that reduces enemy aggression toward them slightly, as most combatants instinctively hesitate to attack someone hugging a pillow in a combat zone.
[Body Pillow Combat: 5]

Waifu's Embrace.name: Waifu's Embrace
Waifu's Embrace.description:
The user wraps the body pillow around a target's head and upper body, blinding and smothering them temporarily. The target spends their next action struggling free from the surprisingly clingy fabric. While smothered, the target cannot cast verbal-component spells, use breath attacks, or see incoming attacks. Physically powerful targets tear free faster. The technique requires closing to grapple range and landing the wrap cleanly, which is difficult against alert opponents. The pillow takes damage from the struggle and may need repair afterward.
[Body Pillow Combat: 14]

Feather Burst.name: Feather Burst
Feather Burst.description:
A technique that ruptures the pillow's outer casing in a controlled burst, launching a cloud of stuffing material into the air. The cloud obscures vision in a wide area for two turns, functioning as a smoke screen. Opponents caught in the cloud suffer reduced accuracy and may inhale feathers or filling, causing coughing fits that interrupt spellcasting. The user must repair or replace the pillow afterward. Wind magic disperses the cloud instantly. The technique works with any pillow, not just combat-grade ones, though cheaper pillows produce smaller clouds.
[Body Pillow Combat: 25]

Dreamland Suplex.name: Dreamland Suplex
Dreamland Suplex.description:
A grappling technique where the user catches an opponent in a pillow-assisted hold and slams them to the ground with theatrical force. The pillow cushions the user's arms during the throw, allowing them to generate more rotational force without injuring themselves. The slammed target takes significant impact damage and is stunned for one turn. The visual spectacle of the move draws attention from all nearby combatants, which can be either an advantage or a liability depending on the situation. Requires the target to be roughly the user's size or smaller.
[Body Pillow Combat: 40]

Eternal Body Pillow.name: Eternal Body Pillow
Eternal Body Pillow.description:
The user channels their devotion and charisma into the pillow, causing it to become temporarily indestructible and glow with the light of pure dedication. For several turns, the pillow cannot be cut, burned, or destroyed, and strikes with it deal force damage that scales with the user's charisma rather than strength. The glow is warm and oddly comforting, causing conflicted feelings in opponents who question whether fighting someone this sincere is really worth it. Enemies with strong conviction or those immune to emotional influence resist the hesitation effect.
[Body Pillow Combat: 56]

Pillow Dimension.name: Pillow Dimension
Pillow Dimension.description:
An advanced technique that temporarily transforms the immediate battlefield into a space governed by pillow-fort physics. Surfaces become soft, falls deal no damage, thrown objects bounce harmlessly, and all non-pillow weapons lose their edge. The user's pillow attacks deal full damage within this altered space while conventional weapons are severely weakened. The dimension lasts for three turns and covers a room-sized area. Opponents who escape the area boundary return to normal physics. Spatial magic or reality-anchoring abilities can resist the transformation entirely.
[Body Pillow Combat: 75]

Dakimakura Requiem.name: Dakimakura Requiem
Dakimakura Requiem.description:
The ultimate body pillow technique and possibly the most bewildering combat art in Luxcellia. The user's pillow manifests a spiritual projection of the character printed on its cover, which fights alongside the user as an autonomous combatant for several turns. The projection's combat ability scales with the user's charisma and the emotional bond they share with the pillow. It can attack, defend, and even use basic abilities. The spiritual drain is enormous and the user is left in a daze afterward. If the pillow has no printed character, the projection takes the form of a generic but enthusiastic pillow spirit. Opponents who have witnessed this technique universally describe it as deeply unsettling.
[Body Pillow Combat: 96]

Scene Reading.name: Scene Reading
Scene Reading.description:
A quick visual sweep of an area that identifies the most obvious points of interest: disturbed objects, fresh marks, out-of-place items, and signs of recent activity. Does not reveal hidden or magically concealed clues but catches anything a careful observer would notice on a second look. The assessment takes only a few seconds and can be performed passively when entering a new room or area. More useful in contained spaces; outdoor scenes with large areas require focused searching instead.
[investigation: 1]

Evidence Analysis.name: Evidence Analysis
Evidence Analysis.description:
A focused examination of a specific object, substance, or mark to determine its origin, age, and significance. The user can identify common materials by sight and touch, estimate how long ago a stain was made, determine what kind of weapon caused a mark, and recognize signs of tampering on locks and seals. Requires direct physical access to the evidence. Magically altered or fabricated evidence may pass analysis unless the user also has arcane detection abilities. Results improve with time spent examining.
[investigation: 5]

Witness Interview.name: Witness Interview
Witness Interview.description:
A structured questioning technique that draws accurate information from reluctant, frightened, or confused witnesses without resorting to intimidation. The user reads verbal hesitation, eye movement, and body language to identify which questions provoke discomfort and which details the witness is omitting or embellishing. Works best in calm, one-on-one settings. Hostile or magically compelled witnesses resist the technique. Crowds and public settings reduce effectiveness because witnesses perform for their audience rather than answering honestly.
[investigation: 14]

Pattern Recognition.name: Pattern Recognition
Pattern Recognition.description:
The user cross-references multiple pieces of evidence, testimony, and observed behavior to identify connections that are not obvious individually. Can reveal that seemingly unrelated events share a common cause, that multiple witnesses describe the same person differently, or that a series of thefts follows a geographic pattern. Requires at least three distinct pieces of information to work with. The technique surfaces correlations but does not prove causation; the user must still verify their conclusions. More data produces better results; insufficient information yields false patterns.
[investigation: 25]

Forensic Reconstruction.name: Forensic Reconstruction
Forensic Reconstruction.description:
An advanced technique where the user mentally reconstructs a past event from physical evidence alone. By reading the positions of objects, the pattern of damage, the distribution of residue, and the geometry of the space, the user builds a detailed mental model of what happened and in what sequence. The reconstruction is a best-fit interpretation, not perfect recall, and can be wrong when evidence has been deliberately staged or magically altered. Requires uncontaminated evidence and at least ten minutes of focused examination. The mental strain limits this to once per scene.
[investigation: 40]

Deductive Chain.name: Deductive Chain
Deductive Chain.description:
The user constructs a logical chain of reasoning that connects a known starting fact to an unknown conclusion through intermediate inferences. Each link in the chain must be supported by evidence or reliable testimony. When executed cleanly, the technique can identify a culprit, predict a target's next move, or uncover a hidden motive from seemingly insufficient information. The chain is only as strong as its weakest link; a single incorrect premise collapses the entire deduction. Other investigators can challenge individual links to stress-test the reasoning.
[investigation: 56]

Truth Resonance.name: Truth Resonance
Truth Resonance.description:
A near-supernatural investigative instinct developed through years of casework. When the user is in the presence of a critical piece of hidden evidence or standing in the location where a key event occurred, they experience a visceral sense of significance that draws their attention to the right spot. Does not reveal the evidence directly but dramatically narrows the search area and ensures the user does not overlook it. Fails in areas saturated with magical interference or where multiple significant events overlap, creating too much noise. Cannot be forced; the resonance occurs passively or not at all.
[investigation: 75]

Absolute Deduction.name: Absolute Deduction
Absolute Deduction.description:
The pinnacle of investigative mastery. The user enters a state of hyperfocused cognition where every sensory input is processed for investigative relevance simultaneously. In this state, the user can walk through a complex crime scene and reconstruct the complete sequence of events, identify all parties involved, determine their motives, and predict their current location, all within minutes. The mental load is crushing: the user suffers severe headaches, nosebleeds, and temporary cognitive impairment afterward. Usable only once per day and only on cases where sufficient physical evidence exists. Fabricated scenes with no real evidence behind them produce convincing but completely wrong conclusions.
[investigation: 96]

Proper Introduction.name: Proper Introduction
Proper Introduction.description:
The user introduces themselves according to the social customs appropriate to the setting: correct titles, proper bowing depth, appropriate eye contact, and the right sequence of pleasantries. A successful proper introduction provides a small but meaningful first-impression bonus with NPCs who value social form, including nobles, clergy, academics, and guild officials. Has no effect on individuals who disregard social convention. The user must have some prior knowledge of the relevant culture's customs; attempting formal etiquette from the wrong tradition causes embarrassment instead.
[Etiquette: 1]

Social Navigation.name: Social Navigation
Social Navigation.description:
The user reads the social dynamics of a gathering, identifying who holds real authority, who is allied with whom, who is being excluded, and where the unspoken tensions lie. This information is gathered through observation of seating positions, conversational groupings, body language, and who defers to whom. The reading takes a few minutes of attentive observation and provides a social map of the room. Large gatherings with many factions are harder to read completely. Deliberately staged social arrangements can mislead the assessment.
[Etiquette: 5]

Graceful Recovery.name: Graceful Recovery
Graceful Recovery.description:
When the user commits a social error, breach of protocol, or embarrassing blunder, this technique allows them to recover with enough poise that the damage is minimized. The recovery might take the form of a self-deprecating joke, a smooth redirect, a plausible excuse, or a gesture of humility that earns sympathy. Reduces reputation loss from social mistakes by a significant margin. Does not work for deliberate insults, violent outbursts, or offenses so severe that no amount of grace can salvage them. More effective in cultures that value composure over directness.
[Etiquette: 14]

Court Whisper.name: Court Whisper
Court Whisper.description:
The user communicates sensitive information to a specific person at a social gathering without anyone else noticing. This is accomplished through coded language layered into normal conversation, meaningful glances timed to moments of distraction, or subtle gestures disguised as natural movement. The target must be socially aware enough to recognize that a message is being sent. Targets unfamiliar with court communication miss the signal entirely. Observers with high perception or their own etiquette training may detect that a covert exchange occurred, though not its content.
[Etiquette: 25]

Diplomatic Immunity.name: Diplomatic Immunity
Diplomatic Immunity.description:
The user projects such an authoritative command of protocol and social standing that hostile parties hesitate to act against them in formal or semi-formal settings. Guards question whether they have the authority to detain someone this composed. Nobles wonder if the user outranks them in some hierarchy they are not aware of. The effect is psychological, not magical, and breaks immediately if the user does anything that contradicts their projected status. Useless against enemies who do not recognize or care about social hierarchies. Most effective in bureaucratic, aristocratic, and institutional environments.
[Etiquette: 40]

Social Architecture.name: Social Architecture
Social Architecture.description:
The user deliberately engineers the social dynamics of a gathering by controlling introductions, seating arrangements, conversation topics, and the timing of key disclosures. Over the course of an event, the user can steer alliances, create rifts between previously friendly parties, elevate an unknown guest to prominence, or isolate a target from their support network. The manipulation is subtle enough that no individual action appears suspicious, but the cumulative effect reshapes the room's politics. Requires the user to have host-level access or influence over the event's logistics. Other skilled social operators may notice the pattern.
[Etiquette: 56]

Royal Presence.name: Royal Presence
Royal Presence.description:
The user projects an aura of absolute social authority that causes everyone in the room to instinctively treat them as the highest-ranking person present. Conversations pause, attention shifts, and even genuinely powerful individuals feel a momentary urge to defer. The effect is not magical compulsion but refined social mastery pushed to its extreme, and strong-willed individuals can shake it off after a moment of recognition. While the presence is active, the user's social actions carry significantly more weight and their requests are taken more seriously. Maintaining the presence requires flawless composure; a single visible crack ends it.
[Etiquette: 75]

Sovereign Protocol.name: Sovereign Protocol
Sovereign Protocol.description:
The ultimate expression of social mastery. The user becomes the de facto arbiter of social rules in any gathering they attend, capable of establishing new customs, redefining hierarchies, and settling disputes with a word that all parties accept as final. This is not mind control; it is the culmination of such deep understanding of social mechanics that the user can reshape the rules of engagement in real time and make the new rules feel natural to everyone present. Cultures with deeply rigid traditions resist the reshaping more than flexible ones. The technique demands the user's full attention; they cannot pursue personal agendas while serving as the social anchor. Attempting to abuse the position for naked self-interest breaks the effect permanently for that gathering.
[Etiquette: 96]

Basic Toxin.name: Basic Toxin
Basic Toxin.description:
The user crafts a simple contact or ingestion poison from common ingredients: certain mushrooms, plant saps, insect venom extracts, or mineral compounds. The resulting toxin deals light damage over several turns when it enters the target's system. Requires basic crafting materials and a few minutes of preparation. The poison is unstable and loses potency after a day. Targets with poison resistance or antidote access shrug off the effects quickly. The user can also identify common poisons by sight and smell at this skill level.
[Poison Craft: 1]

Blade Coating.name: Blade Coating
Blade Coating.description:
The user applies a prepared poison to a weapon's edge or point, causing the next one to three successful hits with that weapon to deliver the toxin directly into the target's bloodstream. The coating lasts for one encounter or until the strikes connect, whichever comes first. Rain, submersion, and heavy friction degrade the coating prematurely. The user must have a prepared poison on hand; this technique is the application method, not the poison itself. Coating a weapon takes thirty seconds of careful work and cannot be rushed in active combat.
[Poison Craft: 5]

Antidote Brewing.name: Antidote Brewing
Antidote Brewing.description:
The user crafts an antidote targeted at a specific poison they have identified or possess a sample of. The antidote neutralizes the poison's effects over one to two turns when administered. General-purpose antidotes are possible but less effective, reducing poison damage rather than eliminating it. Crafting requires appropriate reagents and several minutes of preparation. Antidotes for magical or divine poisons require proportionally rare ingredients. The user can also stabilize a poisoned ally to prevent their condition from worsening while a proper antidote is prepared.
[Poison Craft: 14]

Paralytic Compound.name: Paralytic Compound
Paralytic Compound.description:
The user crafts a specialized toxin that attacks the target's nervous system, causing progressive muscle lock that begins with the extremities and works inward. Within two turns of exposure, the target's movement speed is halved; within four turns, they are fully paralyzed for the duration. Targets with high constitution or poison resistance delay the onset proportionally. The paralysis is temporary and wears off naturally after several minutes. Constructs, undead, and slime-type creatures are immune. Requires rare neural-reactive ingredients that must be harvested fresh.
[Poison Craft: 25]

Miasma Bomb.name: Miasma Bomb
Miasma Bomb.description:
The user prepares a sealed container of volatile toxic gas that can be thrown to create a poison cloud covering a small area. Anyone breathing within the cloud takes poison damage each turn and suffers accuracy penalties from burning eyes and throat. The cloud persists for three turns before dispersing naturally. Wind magic or strong natural winds disperse it faster. The user is not immune to their own miasma unless they have separate protection. Sealed helmets, cloth masks treated with antidote solution, and holding one's breath all provide partial or full protection.
[Poison Craft: 40]

Neurotoxin Synthesis.name: Neurotoxin Synthesis
Neurotoxin Synthesis.description:
The user crafts a potent neurotoxin that disrupts magical channeling in addition to causing physical symptoms. Spellcasters affected by the toxin find their mana costs doubled and their casting accuracy reduced for the duration. The toxin is difficult to identify because its physical symptoms are mild compared to its magical disruption, often leading mages to believe they are experiencing burnout rather than poisoning. Crafting requires exotic neural-reactive components, typically harvested from magical creatures. Targets with innate magic resistance reduce the disruption proportionally.
[Poison Craft: 56]

Chimeric Venom.name: Chimeric Venom
Chimeric Venom.description:
An advanced poison that combines multiple toxin profiles into a single compound, attacking the target's body through several pathways simultaneously. The venom deals direct damage, applies a slowing effect, reduces natural regeneration, and interferes with healing magic received from external sources. No single antidote neutralizes all components; treating the poison requires either an expert poisoner who can identify and counter each component separately, or universal purification magic of significant power. Crafting requires ingredients from at least three different toxic creature types and a full hour of careful synthesis.
[Poison Craft: 75]

Sovereign Poison.name: Sovereign Poison
Sovereign Poison.description:
The masterwork of poison craft: a toxin so refined and lethal that a single drop can threaten even legendary-tier creatures. The poison bypasses conventional resistances and immunities, affecting targets that normally shrug off lesser toxins. Its effects are customizable during synthesis; the crafter chooses the primary symptom profile from lethal, paralytic, hallucinogenic, or corrosive, with secondary effects layered on top. Crafting requires a week of dedicated work, ingredients of extraordinary rarity, and a workspace that most field alchemists cannot replicate. The finished product is stable for months and nearly undetectable by mundane means. Even divine healing takes several applications to fully purge it. The user's own hands must be treated with a specific counteragent during synthesis or the crafting process poisons the crafter.
[Poison Craft: 96]

Flattering Remark.name: Flattering Remark
Flattering Remark.description:
The user delivers a genuine, well-observed compliment that makes the target feel seen and appreciated. Unlike generic flattery, this technique requires reading the target to identify what they are actually proud of and praising that specific thing. The target's disposition toward the user improves for the duration of the conversation. Targets who are actively hostile, deeply suspicious, or immune to social influence are unaffected. Overuse on the same target within a short period reverses the effect as the flattery becomes transparent.
[Charm: 3]

Disarming Smile.name: Disarming Smile
Disarming Smile.description:
The user projects genuine warmth and non-threatening intent through expression and body language, lowering the target's defensive posture in conversation. Guards relax, merchants offer friendlier prices, and suspicious individuals give the user the benefit of the doubt for a moment longer than they otherwise would. The effect is subtle and works on a subconscious level; the target does not feel manipulated, just unexpectedly comfortable. Completely ineffective against targets who cannot see the user's face or who are immune to emotional influence. Undead, constructs, and most non-humanoid creatures are unaffected.
[Charm: 6]

Magnetic Presence.name: Magnetic Presence
Magnetic Presence.description:
The user projects a personal magnetism that draws attention and positive regard from everyone in a small area. Conversations naturally gravitate toward the user, strangers feel inclined to approach, and the general mood of a gathering shifts slightly warmer. Provides a passive bonus to all social interactions for the duration. The presence is tiring to maintain and fades after several minutes if not reinforced by genuinely engaging behavior. Other charismatic individuals in the same space create competing draws that diminish the effect.
[Charm: 15]

Heartstring Tug.name: Heartstring Tug
Heartstring Tug.description:
The user tells a personal story or makes an emotional appeal calibrated precisely to the target's values and vulnerabilities. The appeal creates a genuine emotional connection that goes deeper than surface-level friendliness. Targets who respond positively develop a lasting warm regard for the user that persists beyond the immediate conversation. The technique requires knowledge of the target's emotional landscape; blind attempts without understanding the target often backfire. Manipulative use that is later discovered causes severe and permanent reputation damage with the target.
[Charm: 28]

Gilded Words.name: Gilded Words
Gilded Words.description:
The user speaks with such natural eloquence and sincerity that even unreasonable requests sound perfectly logical in the moment. Targets find themselves agreeing to things they would normally refuse, not because they are compelled but because the user's framing makes the request feel fair and natural. The effect persists only as long as the user is present and actively conversing; once the user leaves, targets reassess and may feel buyer's remorse. Strong-willed individuals and those trained in rhetoric recognize the technique and resist it. Cannot override deeply-held convictions or survival instincts.
[Charm: 44]

Idol's Aura.name: Idol's Aura
Idol's Aura.description:
The user radiates such intense personal charisma that they become the focal point of any space they occupy. Crowds part, conversations stop, and every eye turns toward them with a mixture of admiration and fascination. While the aura is active, the user's social actions are dramatically amplified: requests become near-commands, suggestions become convictions, and emotional displays ripple through the audience. The aura does not compel obedience but creates an overwhelming social pressure to comply. Individuals with personal grudges against the user or those under opposing magical influence can resist. The user is unable to blend in or act subtly while the aura is active.
[Charm: 63]

Soulbound Rapport.name: Soulbound Rapport
Soulbound Rapport.description:
The ultimate charm technique: the user establishes a connection with a target so profound that it permanently shifts the relationship dynamic. After a meaningful one-on-one conversation of at least ten minutes, the target develops a deep, lasting trust and affection for the user that persists indefinitely unless betrayed. The rapport is not mind control; the target retains their personality, free will, and independent judgment, but their baseline disposition toward the user is fundamentally and permanently warm. The user can maintain only a handful of these deep connections at once. Attempting to establish rapport with someone who has been hurt or betrayed by the user automatically fails. Cannot be used on targets currently in combat with the user.
[Charm: 84]

Chain Sweep.name: Chain Sweep
Chain Sweep.description:
A low sweeping attack with a weighted chain aimed at the target's legs, designed to trip or stagger them. The chain's reach extends well beyond sword distance, catching opponents who thought they were safely out of melee range. Tripped targets lose their next action standing up. Heavier targets resist the trip but are still staggered. The sweep telegraphs enough that alert opponents can jump over the chain, and the recovery swing leaves the user momentarily open on the high line.
[Flexible Weapons: 6]

Spiked Orbit.name: Spiked Orbit
Spiked Orbit.description:
The user swings a spiked chain or flail in a continuous elliptical orbit that creates a persistent danger zone around them. Any enemy that enters the orbit takes automatic piercing damage from the weighted end. The orbit can be sustained for several turns but restricts the user's movement to a slow walk. The user cannot attack specific targets outside the orbit path while maintaining the spin. Interrupted by grapples, entanglement, or attacks that strike the chain mid-rotation and arrest its momentum.
[Flexible Weapons: 22]

Anchor Slam.name: Anchor Slam
Anchor Slam.description:
The user hurls the weighted end of their chain at a distant anchor point then uses the tension to slingshot themselves toward the target at high speed, delivering a devastating flying strike on arrival. The technique covers significant distance and delivers tremendous impact, but the user is committed to the trajectory once launched and cannot adjust mid-flight. The anchor point must support the user's weight. If the anchor breaks or the chain is severed during transit, the user crashes uncontrollably. Works as both a gap-closer and an escape route when aimed at terrain above.
[Flexible Weapons: 30]

Stranglehold.name: Stranglehold
Stranglehold.description:
An advanced grappling technique that loops the chain around a target's neck or core body and cinches it tight. The target is immobilized and takes sustained crushing damage each turn they remain bound. Breaking free requires a contested strength check against the user, and the chain's mechanical advantage gives the user a significant bonus. While maintaining the stranglehold, the user cannot attack other targets or dodge freely. Targets without necks, with slippery bodies, or significantly larger than the user cannot be effectively strangled.
[Flexible Weapons: 56]

Meteor Chain.name: Meteor Chain
Meteor Chain.description:
The user whirls the chain overhead with such force that the weighted end ignites from friction with the air, creating a blazing arc of fire and steel. The burning end is hurled at a target up to thirty meters away, dealing massive combined impact and fire damage on contact. The chain retracts after the strike, pulling the still-burning weight back for a potential second strike at reduced accuracy. The fire effect is physical, not magical, so it bypasses anti-magic defenses but can be resisted by fireproofing. The extreme rotational speed required strains the user's shoulders and limits follow-up chain techniques.
[Flexible Weapons: 77]

Ragnarok Chain.name: Ragnarok Chain
Ragnarok Chain.description:
The ultimate chain weapon technique. The user unleashes a sustained storm of chain strikes where the weapon moves with seemingly impossible speed and reach, attacking every enemy within a wide radius simultaneously. The chain appears to multiply, striking from angles that a single length of metal should not be able to reach. Each strike carries the full force of the user's strength and fighting spirit. The technique lasts for two turns during which the user becomes the center of a steel tornado. Afterward, the physical toll renders the user unable to swing the chain for an extended recovery period. The chain itself may warp or crack under the stress and requires repair or replacement.
[Flexible Weapons: 100]

Vein Sense.name: Vein Sense
Vein Sense.description:
The miner develops an instinct for reading stone faces and tunnel walls, identifying likely locations of ore veins by subtle discoloration, crystal inclusions, and mineral dust patterns. Reduces the time spent searching for mineable deposits by half and increases the chance of finding higher-grade ore in any given location. Does not detect magically concealed deposits or veins deeper than the user can physically reach. More effective underground than on surface outcrops.
[Mining: 5]

Precision Extraction.name: Precision Extraction
Precision Extraction.description:
A careful mining technique that preserves the structural integrity of extracted ore and crystals, yielding higher-quality raw materials. Standard mining shatters fragile crystal formations and contaminates pure ore with surrounding rock; this technique avoids both. The extracted materials sell for more, craft into better items, and retain any ambient magical charge the deposit held. Takes twice as long as rough extraction. Requires quality tools; a worn or damaged pickaxe cannot achieve the necessary precision.
[Mining: 8]

Deep Resonance.name: Deep Resonance
Deep Resonance.description:
The miner taps the stone and listens to the vibration pattern, reading the subsurface composition through sound alone. Can detect hollow cavities, water tables, ore deposits, and structural weaknesses up to twenty meters into solid rock. Experienced users can distinguish between different metal types by resonance pitch. The technique requires silence to work; active combat, running water, or heavy machinery drowns out the subtle vibrations. Also reveals dungeon passages hidden behind thin walls.
[Mining: 17]

Mythril Touch.name: Mythril Touch
Mythril Touch.description:
An advanced extraction technique specifically developed for magical ores and spirit-infused minerals that shatter or lose their properties under conventional mining. The user regulates the force and angle of each strike to work with the material's magical grain rather than against it. Yields intact samples of magical ore that would otherwise be reduced to inert dust. Required for extracting adamantine, mythril, starmetal, and other high-tier crafting materials. Mundane ores gain no special benefit from this technique.
[Mining: 32]

Earthblood Harvest.name: Earthblood Harvest
Earthblood Harvest.description:
The miner can extract liquid mineral concentrates directly from deep veins, tapping into the pressurized mineral-rich fluid that flows through certain geological formations. The resulting earthblood is a potent crafting catalyst that enhances any smithing, alchemy, or enchanting process it is added to. Each extraction yields enough for a handful of uses. The process requires specialized containment vessels and takes several hours. Deposits of earthblood are rare and typically found only in dungeon depths, volcanic regions, or ancient mountain roots.
[Mining: 51]

Core Tap.name: Core Tap
Core Tap.description:
The pinnacle of mining mastery. The user can locate and safely extract primordial mineral formations that exist at the boundary between the physical world and the elemental substrata. These core minerals are the rarest crafting materials in existence, used in legendary-tier equipment and world-class enchantments. The extraction process takes a full day of painstaking work and requires both exceptional physical skill and an intuitive understanding of geological magic. A failed extraction can trigger localized earthquakes, volcanic venting, or elemental surges. Only one core deposit can be safely tapped per region before the geological balance needs time to recover.
[Mining: 72]

Infusion Blend.name: Infusion Blend
Infusion Blend.description:
The brewer creates enhanced beverages by infusing standard drinks with herbs, monster extracts, or minor alchemical agents. The resulting infusions bolster a single attribute or resistance for a short duration when consumed. The effects are pleasant enough that NPCs enjoy receiving them as gifts. Each batch produces three to five servings. The infusion must be consumed within a day before the active ingredients degrade. Stronger reagents produce stronger effects but also introduce a bitter taste that reduces the social value.
[Brewing: 5]

Fermentation Mastery.name: Fermentation Mastery
Fermentation Mastery.description:
The brewer controls fermentation with enough precision to produce drinks of consistent quality and reliable potency. Ales, wines, meads, and fermented tonics all benefit. Consistent quality means the brewer can build a reputation and sell their products at premium prices. The technique also allows the brewer to rescue batches that have started to go wrong, adjusting temperature, acidity, and yeast activity to salvage what would otherwise be waste. Requires a proper brewing workspace with temperature control.
[Brewing: 8]

Spirit Distillation.name: Spirit Distillation
Spirit Distillation.description:
The brewer can produce high-proof spirits and concentrated elixirs through precise distillation. The concentrated output serves as both a trade commodity and a crafting ingredient for alchemy and enchanting. Distilled spirits also function as wound disinfectant, fire accelerant, and solvent in the field. The process requires distillation equipment and several hours of careful monitoring. Over-distillation produces dangerously strong spirits that cause harm rather than benefit when consumed without dilution.
[Brewing: 17]

Elixir Craft.name: Elixir Craft
Elixir Craft.description:
The brewer creates elixirs that bolster attributes with significant, medium-duration blessings comparable to mid-tier potions, using cheaper and more common ingredients. The tradeoff is preparation time; elixirs require hours of brewing compared to alchemy's faster turnaround. The blessings stack with potion effects unless they target the same attribute. A skilled elixir crafter can supply an entire party with pre-combat enhancements at a fraction of the cost of equivalent potions. Each elixir recipe must be developed through experimentation.
[Brewing: 32]

Ambrosia Brewing.name: Ambrosia Brewing
Ambrosia Brewing.description:
The brewer creates a legendary-quality drink that provides powerful, long-lasting effects rivaling high-tier alchemical products. The specific effect depends on the recipe and ingredients: vitality restoration, attribute enhancement, resistance granting, or temporary ability unlocking are all possible. Each batch yields only a single serving due to the concentration of rare ingredients required. The brewing process takes a full day and demands the brewer's complete attention. The resulting ambrosia is a luxury item worth a small fortune in trade.
[Brewing: 51]

Sage's Draught.name: Sage's Draught
Sage's Draught.description:
The ultimate brewing achievement: a drink that temporarily elevates the consumer's fundamental capabilities beyond their normal limits. For several hours after consumption, one chosen attribute is boosted significantly, skill checks in a chosen discipline receive a large bonus, and the consumer's natural regeneration rate doubles. The draught requires ingredients so rare that producing more than one per season is practically impossible. The aftereffects include a full day of exhaustion as the body recovers from operating above its natural ceiling. Only one draught can be active at a time; consuming a second while the first is still active causes severe internal damage.
[Brewing: 72]

Flavor Mastery.name: Flavor Mastery
Flavor Mastery.description:
The cook produces meals of consistently excellent taste using whatever ingredients are available, even in field conditions. Well-prepared meals bolster morale with a small blessing for all companions who eat them and improve NPC disposition when offered as hospitality. The cook can also identify ingredient quality by taste and smell, avoiding spoiled or contaminated food. Requires at least basic cooking equipment; truly exceptional results need a proper kitchen.
[Cooking: 5]

Nutritional Balancing.name: Nutritional Balancing
Nutritional Balancing.description:
The cook prepares meals optimized for physical recovery, providing enhanced healing and stamina restoration when consumed during rest periods. A properly balanced meal doubles the effectiveness of short rests and adds a small health regeneration bonus for several hours afterward. The technique requires understanding which ingredient combinations promote recovery versus those that merely taste good. Field rations can be elevated into recovery meals with the right supplementary ingredients. Less effective when ingredients are limited to a single food group.
[Cooking: 8]

Feast Preparation.name: Feast Preparation
Feast Preparation.description:
The cook prepares a multi-course meal for a large group, providing morale and stat bonuses to everyone who eats. A feast requires at least two hours of preparation and quality ingredients, but the resulting blessings bolster everyone who eats for a full day and affect up to twenty people. The social impact is significant: hosting a feast builds reputation, strengthens alliances, and creates opportunities for conversation with NPCs who attend. The quality of ingredients directly affects the strength of the blessings. Requires a full kitchen or equivalent outdoor cooking setup.
[Cooking: 17]

Spirit Cuisine.name: Spirit Cuisine
Spirit Cuisine.description:
The cook incorporates magical ingredients, monster parts, and spirit-infused produce into their recipes, creating meals that grant temporary magical effects to those who eat them. Effects range from elemental resistance to enhanced perception to temporary night vision, depending on the ingredients used. The cook must understand how magical ingredients interact with heat, seasoning, and digestion; improperly prepared magical food can cause unpredictable side effects. Each recipe must be discovered through experimentation or learned from other spirit cooks.
[Cooking: 32]

Divine Banquet.name: Divine Banquet
Divine Banquet.description:
The cook creates a transcendent meal that temporarily elevates every diner's physical and mental state to their personal peak. All attributes receive a moderate boost, health and mana are fully restored, and negative status effects are cleansed through the sheer vitality the food provides. The meal requires legendary-tier ingredients, a full day of preparation, and serves no more than eight people. The experience is so memorable that NPCs who share the meal develop a lasting positive bond with the host. Only one divine banquet can be prepared per week due to the spiritual investment required.
[Cooking: 51]

Cuisine of Miracles.name: Cuisine of Miracles
Cuisine of Miracles.description:
The absolute pinnacle of culinary arts. The cook produces a single dish so perfect that consuming it triggers a permanent, if minor, improvement to one of the eater's attributes or resistances. The specific benefit depends on the ingredients and the eater's nature. Each person can only benefit from one miracle dish in their lifetime; subsequent servings are merely delicious. The ingredients required are so rare and the preparation so demanding that producing even one dish per month pushes the limits of what is achievable. The cook themselves is exempt from the once-per-lifetime limit, as continuous exposure to miracle-grade ingredients during preparation provides gradual benefits over their career.
[Cooking: 72]

Crop Rotation.name: Crop Rotation
Crop Rotation.description:
The farmer implements systematic crop rotation that maintains soil health and increases yield across growing seasons. Fields managed with this technique produce twenty to thirty percent more harvest per cycle and resist common plant diseases. The technique requires planning several seasons ahead and tracking which crops were planted where. Immediate results are modest; the full benefit emerges after two to three complete rotations. Also reduces the need for expensive fertilizers and soil treatments.
[Farming: 5]

Monster Compost.name: Monster Compost
Monster Compost.description:
The farmer processes defeated monster remains into potent fertilizer that supercharges plant growth. Crops grown with monster compost mature faster, grow larger, and occasionally develop minor magical properties depending on what type of monster provided the material. Slime residue produces moisture-resistant crops; fire creature ash yields spice-enhanced herbs; beast remains create nutrient-dense vegetables. The composting process requires a week and proper containment to prevent attracting scavengers. Over-application burns plants rather than feeding them.
[Farming: 8]

Spirit Grafting.name: Spirit Grafting
Spirit Grafting.description:
The farmer grafts cuttings from spirit-touched wild plants onto cultivated stock, producing hybrid crops with reliable magical properties. Spirit-grafted herbs are more potent for alchemy, spirit-grafted fruit provides minor attribute blessings when eaten, and spirit-grafted flowers produce ingredients valued by enchanters. The grafting process requires live cuttings from wild spirit plants, which are found in areas of high ambient mana. Each graft has a moderate failure rate; failed grafts kill the host plant. Success rates improve with experience.
[Farming: 17]

Seasonal Mastery.name: Seasonal Mastery
Seasonal Mastery.description:
The farmer can grow crops outside their natural season by manipulating microclimate conditions through practical techniques: cold frames, shade structures, irrigation timing, and soil temperature management. Summer crops in winter, winter roots in summer, and tropical plants in temperate climates all become possible. The yield is lower than natural-season growing and requires more labor, but the ability to produce out-of-season ingredients commands premium prices and keeps rare recipe components available year-round.
[Farming: 32]

Verdant Bloom.name: Verdant Bloom
Verdant Bloom.description:
The farmer channels accumulated agricultural knowledge and connection to the land into an accelerated growth burst that brings an entire field from planting to harvest in a single day. The resulting crop is healthy and full-sized but has a slightly reduced shelf life compared to naturally grown produce. The technique can only be used on land the farmer has personally cultivated for at least one full season; unfamiliar soil does not respond. The effort exhausts the farmer for several days afterward and depletes the soil's vitality, requiring a fallow period before the next planting.
[Farming: 51]

Garden of Eden.name: Garden of Eden
Garden of Eden.description:
The ultimate farming technique: the user establishes a permanent plot of land where growing conditions are supernaturally perfect. Plants grown in the garden reach their maximum possible quality, resist all disease and pests, and occasionally develop unique properties not found in any wild or cultivated variety. The garden covers a small area and requires the farmer's regular attention to maintain. Establishing the garden requires a month of continuous work and materials of extraordinary quality. Once established, the garden produces ingredients that are among the finest crafting materials available for alchemy, cooking, brewing, and perfumery. Only one such garden can be maintained at a time.
[Farming: 72]

Patient Cast.name: Patient Cast
Patient Cast.description:
The fisher reads water currents, light conditions, and surface activity to choose the optimal moment and location for each cast. Increases the chance of catching something on each attempt and reduces the number of empty casts. The technique requires several minutes of observation before the first cast and adjustments throughout the session. More effective in natural water bodies than stocked ponds. Also allows the fisher to identify which species are likely present based on environmental cues.
[Fishing: 5]

Trophy Technique.name: Trophy Technique
Trophy Technique.description:
A specialized method for landing large and powerful fish that would snap standard line and drag standard equipment under. The fisher manages line tension, rod angle, and retrieval speed to tire the fish gradually without losing it. Enables the catch of trophy-sized specimens that other fishers cannot land. The process takes significantly longer than standard fishing and requires quality equipment rated for large catches. Also applicable to hooking aquatic monsters, though landing something truly dangerous requires combat ability in addition to fishing skill.
[Fishing: 8]

Lure Crafting.name: Lure Crafting
Lure Crafting.description:
The fisher creates specialized lures designed to attract specific species, including rare and magical fish that ignore conventional bait. Each lure is hand-crafted using materials that mimic the target species' preferred prey in appearance, movement, and scent. A well-crafted lure dramatically increases the chance of catching a specific type of fish while filtering out unwanted catches. Requires knowledge of the target species' diet and behavior. Lures for magical fish may require enchanted materials or monster-derived components.
[Fishing: 17]

Deepwater Angling.name: Deepwater Angling
Deepwater Angling.description:
The fisher can reach depths and underwater zones inaccessible to standard techniques, targeting deep-dwelling species that never approach the surface. Deep catches include rare alchemical fish, ancient specimens with unusual properties, and creatures whose scales and bones serve as high-tier crafting materials. Requires specialized weighted lines and pressure-resistant tackle. The deep zones carry risks: some deep-dwelling creatures are predatory enough to pull an unprepared fisher into the water. Reading the line's vibrations to distinguish a catch from a predator is part of the skill.
[Fishing: 32]

Spirit Fishing.name: Spirit Fishing
Spirit Fishing.description:
The fisher casts their line into bodies of water infused with ambient magic, using enchanted tackle to catch spirit fish that exist partially in the material world and partially in the spiritual one. Spirit fish provide extraordinary alchemical and crafting ingredients and are among the most valuable catches possible. The technique requires enchanted line and hooks, water with high magical saturation, and extreme patience. Each spirit fish resists capture with both physical strength and spiritual evasion. Landing one is a genuine achievement.
[Fishing: 51]

Leviathan Hook.name: Leviathan Hook
Leviathan Hook.description:
The legendary fishing technique capable of hooking creatures of mythic size and power. The fisher uses a combination of reinforced legendary-grade tackle, spiritual anchoring, and an intuitive understanding of aquatic creature behavior to hook and land things that should not be catchable by a single person on a line. Sea serpents, lake guardians, abyssal krakens, and divine fish are all theoretically within range. The battle between fisher and catch can last hours and pushes both to their absolute limits. Success yields materials of unparalleled rarity. Failure means losing the tackle and potentially being dragged under.
[Fishing: 72]

Keen Eye.name: Keen Eye
Keen Eye.description:
The forager spots edible plants, useful fungi, and harvestable materials that untrained eyes walk right past. Roots hidden under leaf litter, edible bark, medicinal mosses, and seasonal berries at their peak ripeness are all identified quickly and accurately. The technique works in any natural environment but is most productive in forests and wetlands. The forager can also distinguish safe specimens from toxic look-alikes with high reliability. Does not detect magically hidden or artificially cultivated plants.
[Foraging: 5]

Seasonal Tracking.name: Seasonal Tracking
Seasonal Tracking.description:
The forager knows exactly when and where specific plants reach their peak potency based on season, weather patterns, and local conditions. Herbs harvested at their peak are significantly more effective in alchemy and cooking than those picked at random times. The technique also identifies microclimates where rare plants grow out of their normal range. Requires familiarity with the local region; a forager in unfamiliar territory takes several days to calibrate their seasonal sense.
[Foraging: 8]

Understory Reading.name: Understory Reading
Understory Reading.description:
The forager reads the relationships between plants in a natural ecosystem to locate rare specimens. Certain rare herbs only grow near specific tree species, some fungi appear only where particular soil bacteria thrive, and valuable mosses cluster around underground water sources. By identifying the common indicator species, the forager can predict where the rare ones hide. The technique turns a random search into a directed one, dramatically reducing the time needed to find specific ingredients.
[Foraging: 17]

Mana Bloom Detection.name: Mana Bloom Detection
Mana Bloom Detection.description:
The forager can identify plants that have absorbed ambient magical energy from ley lines, spirit residue, or enchanted soil. These mana-infused specimens are visually similar to their mundane cousins but glow faintly to a trained eye and carry potent magical properties. The detection range covers a wide area and works passively while the forager travels. Mana blooms are the primary source of magical ingredients for enchanters and alchemists who cannot access dungeon resources. They are seasonal, location-dependent, and highly valuable.
[Foraging: 32]

Worldroot Harvest.name: Worldroot Harvest
Worldroot Harvest.description:
The forager can locate and safely harvest from worldroot networks: ancient underground root systems that connect distant ecosystems and channel primordial life energy. Worldroot sap, bark, and fungal symbiotes that grow along the network are among the rarest and most potent natural ingredients in existence. Harvesting requires understanding which sections can be tapped without damaging the network and which are critical nodes that must be left undisturbed. Over-harvesting collapses local sections of the network, destroying the resource permanently.
[Foraging: 51]

Primeval Communion.name: Primeval Communion
Primeval Communion.description:
The pinnacle of foraging mastery. The forager develops a near-mystical connection with the natural world that allows them to sense the location of any natural ingredient within a wide radius, as though the forest itself is pointing them toward what they need. The communion reveals not just location but optimal harvest timing, hidden dangers near the specimen, and whether the plant is the last of its kind in the area. The awareness lasts for several hours but leaves the forager disoriented in urban and constructed environments for a day afterward. Cannot detect cultivated, synthetic, or magically created ingredients.
[Foraging: 72]

Signature Scent.name: Signature Scent
Signature Scent.description:
The perfumer creates a distinctive personal fragrance tailored to the wearer's personality and social goals. The scent provides a small but meaningful charisma bonus in social interactions and makes the wearer more memorable to NPCs. Each signature scent is unique; duplicating another perfumer's work is considered both difficult and gauche. The scent lasts for a full day and can be refreshed without reapplying. Requires quality base oils and at least two accent ingredients.
[Perfumery: 5]

Mood Essence.name: Mood Essence
Mood Essence.description:
The perfumer crafts fragrances that subtly influence the emotional state of those who smell them. Calming blends ease tension in negotiations, invigorating scents boost party morale during travel, and romantic compositions enhance intimate moments. The influence is gentle and not mind control; individuals who are actively resistant or emotionally volatile may not be affected. Each mood essence targets a single emotional register. The effects are strongest in enclosed spaces and fade quickly outdoors.
[Perfumery: 8]

Beast Repellent.name: Beast Repellent
Beast Repellent.description:
The perfumer creates a scent compound that mimics the territorial markers of apex predators, deterring lower-tier beasts and monsters from approaching the wearer or a treated area. Reduces random encounter rates with beast-type enemies while traveling through wilderness areas. The repellent is species-targeted: the perfumer must know which apex predator the local wildlife fears and have access to its scent markers. Intelligent monsters and boss-tier creatures are unaffected. The scent also deters friendly beast companions unless they are specifically acclimatized.
[Perfumery: 17]

Enchanted Attar.name: Enchanted Attar
Enchanted Attar.description:
The perfumer infuses fragrances with magical properties, creating scents that provide actual magical effects rather than merely social ones. Protective attars grant minor elemental resistance, perception attars enhance a specific sense, and vitality attars provide slow passive health regeneration. The magical component requires spirit-infused botanical ingredients and careful distillation. Each attar provides a single effect and lasts for several hours. Only one enchanted attar can be worn at a time; layering them causes the magical components to cancel each other out.
[Perfumery: 32]

Pheromone Synthesis.name: Pheromone Synthesis
Pheromone Synthesis.description:
The perfumer creates synthetic pheromone compounds that produce strong, targeted biological responses in specific creature types. Monster-attraction pheromones lure targets into ambushes, humanoid-calming pheromones defuse violent confrontations before they start, and beast-bonding pheromones accelerate the taming process. The compounds are potent and must be handled carefully; accidental exposure affects the user and allies as readily as targets. Each compound targets a narrow biological category and is useless against creatures outside that range.
[Perfumery: 51]

Ambrosia Absolute.name: Ambrosia Absolute
Ambrosia Absolute.description:
The ultimate perfumery creation: a fragrance so perfectly composed that it transcends normal olfactory experience and produces a state of euphoric clarity in everyone who smells it. For several hours, all social interactions within the scented area receive massive bonuses, hostility is suppressed, and even bitter enemies find themselves willing to talk. The effect is not mind control but a profound sensory experience that makes aggression feel pointless and connection feel natural. Crafting the absolute requires ingredients of legendary rarity and a week of dedicated work. The emotional openness it creates cuts both ways; secrets are harder to keep, and hidden resentments may surface alongside the goodwill.
[Perfumery: 72]

Reinforced Stitching.name: Reinforced Stitching
Reinforced Stitching.description:
The tailor uses specialized stitching patterns that increase the durability and tear resistance of fabric items. Clothing and light armor repaired or crafted with reinforced stitching lasts significantly longer under field conditions and resists minor damage that would ruin standard garments. The technique adds minimal weight and does not alter the garment's appearance. Requires quality thread; cheap thread unravels under the stress patterns the stitching creates.
[Tailoring: 5]

Custom Fit.name: Custom Fit
Custom Fit.description:
The tailor creates garments precisely fitted to the wearer's body, providing better mobility, comfort, and protection than off-the-rack clothing. Custom-fitted armor linings improve defense ratings, custom social attire provides charisma bonuses, and custom travel gear reduces fatigue on long journeys. Each fitting requires measurements and at least an hour of adjustment work. The garment's benefits apply only to the measured wearer; others wearing it receive no bonus.
[Tailoring: 8]

Enchantment Weaving.name: Enchantment Weaving
Enchantment Weaving.description:
The tailor incorporates enchanted threads and treated fabrics into garments, creating clothing with minor magical properties. Warmth-enchanted cloaks resist cold damage, shadow-woven fabric provides stealth bonuses, and mana-conductive robes reduce spell costs. The enchantment is woven directly into the fabric structure rather than applied as a surface layer, making it more durable and harder to dispel than standard enchantments. Requires access to enchanted thread, which is either purchased from enchanters or crafted from monster silk.
[Tailoring: 17]

Masterwork Garment.name: Masterwork Garment
Masterwork Garment.description:
The tailor creates a garment of exceptional quality that serves as both a functional piece of equipment and a work of art. Masterwork garments provide significant bonuses to the wearer's social standing, charisma-based checks, and the specific function the garment was designed for. A masterwork cloak provides superior environmental protection, a masterwork formal outfit commands respect in any court, and masterwork combat padding rivals light armor for protection. Each masterwork garment requires several days of work and premium materials.
[Tailoring: 32]

Mythweave.name: Mythweave
Mythweave.description:
The tailor works with legendary textile materials: spider silk from ancient arachnids, woven moonlight fiber, thread spun from elemental essence, or fabric cut from the clothing of mythic beings. Garments made from mythweave materials carry powerful inherent properties and count as magical equipment. The resulting items are virtually indestructible under normal conditions and provide bonuses comparable to enchanted armor while remaining as light as cloth. Only one mythweave project can be pursued at a time due to the intense focus required.
[Tailoring: 51]

Tapestry of Fates.name: Tapestry of Fates
Tapestry of Fates.description:
The pinnacle of tailoring mastery. The tailor creates a garment that resonates with the wearer's destiny, amplifying their strengths and subtly deflecting misfortune. While wearing a fate-touched garment, the wearer experiences slightly improved luck in all endeavors, receives premonitory warnings of immediate danger through the garment's subtle vibrations, and finds that critical moments tend to break in their favor more often than chance would suggest. The garment must be crafted specifically for one person using materials gathered from significant moments in their life. Only one fate-touched garment can exist per person at a time.
[Tailoring: 72]

Structural Joinery.name: Structural Joinery
Structural Joinery.description:
The woodworker uses precise joint-cutting techniques that create strong connections without nails or metal fasteners. Items crafted with structural joinery are more durable, lighter, and resistant to environmental damage than nailed construction. The technique is essential for quality bows, staves, instrument bodies, and furniture. Each joint type suits different stress patterns; the woodworker selects the appropriate joint for each application. Requires sharp tools in good condition; dull tools produce loose joints.
[Woodworking: 5]

Wood Reading.name: Wood Reading
Wood Reading.description:
The woodworker reads the grain pattern, moisture content, density, and internal stress of a piece of wood before working it, predicting how it will respond to carving, bending, and finishing. This prevents cracking, warping, and structural failure in the finished product. Also identifies wood species and their properties by sight and touch, revealing whether a timber is suitable for its intended purpose. Exotic and magical woods have unusual grain patterns that require more experience to read accurately.
[Woodworking: 8]

Spirit Wood Shaping.name: Spirit Wood Shaping
Spirit Wood Shaping.description:
The woodworker can shape spirit-infused timber that resists conventional tools. Spirit wood is harvested from ancient trees growing in high-mana areas and retains ambient magical energy that makes it ideal for staves, wands, enchanted bows, and magical instrument bodies. Standard tools bounce off or shatter; the woodworker uses specialized techniques involving careful heating, mana-resonant tool edges, and patience. Items crafted from spirit wood accept enchantments more readily and hold them longer than mundane wood.
[Woodworking: 17]

Living Craft.name: Living Craft
Living Craft.description:
The woodworker shapes wood while preserving its living connection to nature, creating items that continue to grow slowly and repair minor damage over time. A living-crafted bow gradually strengthens with use, a living staff puts out new leaves in spring, and living furniture adapts to its owner's posture over months. The technique requires freshly-cut green wood and knowledge of how to maintain the wood's vitality through the crafting process. Items crafted this way need occasional watering and sunlight or they revert to dead wood.
[Woodworking: 32]

Worldtree Carving.name: Worldtree Carving
Worldtree Carving.description:
The woodworker can work with timber from legendary trees: worldtrees, divine groves, petrified elders, and trees that have stood for millennia. These materials carry immense natural power and resist all but the most skilled woodworking. Items carved from worldtree timber are among the most powerful natural-material equipment in existence, rivaling enchanted metal weapons and armor in effectiveness while carrying unique properties tied to the source tree's nature. Only a small amount of material can be harvested from any legendary tree without killing it.
[Woodworking: 51]

Vessel of Ages.name: Vessel of Ages
Vessel of Ages.description:
The ultimate woodworking achievement: crafting an object that serves as a permanent vessel for natural or spiritual energy. The vessel can take any form and continuously draws ambient mana from its environment, storing it for later release by the wielder. A staff carved as a vessel provides passive mana regeneration. A box serves as an infinite-duration preservation container. A throne projects an aura of authority over its surroundings. Creating a vessel requires rare heartwood from a tree at least five centuries old, a month of continuous work, and the woodworker's complete dedication. Only one vessel can be maintained at a time; the spiritual bond between maker and creation does not support multiples.
[Woodworking: 72]

Clean Transcription.name: Clean Transcription
Clean Transcription.description:
The scribe produces documents of consistent, professional quality: clean handwriting, proper formatting, accurate spelling, and precise reproduction of source material. Documents produced with clean transcription are taken more seriously by officials, merchants, and academics. The technique also enables the scribe to copy magical texts without introducing errors that would corrupt the encoded spells, though copying does not teach the scribe the magic contained within. Requires quality ink and writing surfaces.
[Scribal Arts: 5]

Cipher Script.name: Cipher Script
Cipher Script.description:
The scribe creates and decodes encrypted documents using systematic cipher techniques. Messages encoded with cipher script require a matching key to decode and resist casual reading, eavesdropping, and standard translation magic. The complexity of the cipher scales with skill level; simple substitutions at lower levels give way to polyalphabetic systems that challenge even dedicated codebreakers. Also enables the scribe to attempt decoding unfamiliar ciphers found in the world, with success depending on the cipher's complexity relative to the scribe's skill.
[Scribal Arts: 8]

Scroll Crafting.name: Scroll Crafting
Scroll Crafting.description:
The scribe creates single-use spell scrolls that store a magical effect for later activation by anyone who reads the scroll aloud. The scribe does not need to be a caster; they transcribe the spell formula provided by a cooperating mage using specialized magical ink and treated parchment. The scroll captures the spell exactly as provided and releases it on reading. Failed transcription wastes the materials and may produce unpredictable magical effects. Scroll quality determines maximum spell complexity that can be stored.
[Scribal Arts: 17]

Contract Binding.name: Contract Binding
Contract Binding.description:
The scribe drafts contracts and agreements that carry genuine magical weight. Parties who sign a bound contract are unable to violate its terms without suffering a penalty specified in the contract itself: loss of voice, physical pain, temporary stat reduction, or other consequences scaled to the breach. Both parties must sign willingly and with full understanding. The binding is not absolute; sufficiently powerful dispel magic or divine intervention can void the contract. The scribe's skill determines the maximum severity of enforceable penalties and the contract's resistance to magical nullification.
[Scribal Arts: 32]

Living Document.name: Living Document
Living Document.description:
The scribe creates a document that updates itself based on changing conditions. A living book tracks inventory in real time, a living map reveals areas as they are explored, and a living report compiles information from multiple sources automatically. The document must be bound to a specific subject at creation and draws on ambient magical energy to maintain its updates. Range and update frequency depend on the scribe's skill and the quality of materials used. The document stops updating if removed too far from its subject or if its magical energy source is disrupted.
[Scribal Arts: 51]

Eternal Record.name: Eternal Record
Eternal Record.description:
The pinnacle of scribal mastery: the scribe creates a document that is indestructible, self-repairing, and immune to all forms of alteration, forgery, and magical tampering. The text cannot be changed, erased, or overwritten once set. Fire, water, acid, and disintegration magic leave no mark. Eternal records are used for treaties between nations, divine contracts, historical records of absolute importance, and any document that must survive the passage of centuries without degradation. Creating an eternal record requires materials of extraordinary rarity, a week of focused work, and the scribe must sacrifice a portion of their own vitality to anchor the document's permanence. Only a handful of scribes in any generation achieve this level of mastery.
[Scribal Arts: 72]

Patch Repair.name: Patch Repair
Patch Repair.description:
The armorsmith repairs damaged armor in field conditions using available materials and portable tools. The repair restores a significant portion of the armor's protective value without access to a full forge. Quality of repair depends on available materials; matching metal produces better results than mismatched patches. The repair is functional but visually obvious. Magical armor requires additional skill to repair without disrupting its enchantments. The technique also allows the armorsmith to assess armor condition and estimate remaining durability at a glance.
[Armorsmithing: 5]

Fitted Plating.name: Fitted Plating
Fitted Plating.description:
The armorsmith custom-fits armor plates to the wearer's body, reducing weight, improving mobility, and increasing the armor's effective protection. Standard armor provides a base defense value; fitted armor adds a meaningful bonus on top of that base. The fitting process takes several hours and requires the wearer to be present for measurements and adjustments. Each fitting is unique; the armor loses its fitted bonus if worn by someone else. Refitting for a new wearer is possible but requires the full fitting process again.
[Armorsmithing: 8]

Alloy Tempering.name: Alloy Tempering
Alloy Tempering.description:
The armorsmith heat-treats armor using precise temperature control and specialized quenching techniques to maximize the metal's hardness and flexibility. Properly tempered armor absorbs more impact before deforming and returns to shape after hits that would permanently dent untreated metal. The technique requires a proper forge and knowledge of the specific alloy's tempering curve. Different metals and alloys require different temperatures and cooling rates; applying the wrong process ruins the piece. Also applicable to repairing battle damage by re-tempering dented sections.
[Armorsmithing: 17]

Resistance Layering.name: Resistance Layering
Resistance Layering.description:
The armorsmith constructs armor using multiple material layers that each contribute a different type of resistance. A fire-resistant ceramic liner beneath steel plates beneath a magic-dampening outer coating creates armor that protects against physical, fire, and magical damage simultaneously. Each layer adds weight, so the armorsmith must balance protection breadth against mobility. The technique requires access to multiple specialized materials and deep understanding of how they interact under stress. Poorly matched layers can interfere with each other, reducing overall protection.
[Armorsmithing: 32]

Mythril Forging.name: Mythril Forging
Mythril Forging.description:
The armorsmith can work with mythril, adamantine, starmetal, and other legendary-tier materials that cannot be shaped by conventional smithing techniques. Each material requires unique forging conditions: mythril demands moonlight exposure during cooling, adamantine requires temperatures only magical forges can reach, and starmetal must be worked during specific celestial alignments. Armor crafted from these materials provides extraordinary protection while remaining lighter than equivalent steel. Only experienced armorsmiths can prevent the materials from shattering or losing their inherent properties during the forging process.
[Armorsmithing: 51]

Aegis Absolute.name: Aegis Absolute
Aegis Absolute.description:
The ultimate armorsmithing achievement: creating a suit of armor that is a legendary artifact in its own right. An aegis absolute is crafted from the finest materials, fitted to perfection, layered for comprehensive resistance, and imbued with the armorsmith's accumulated knowledge and fighting spirit. The armor adapts to its wearer over time, gradually improving its protection and developing unique properties that complement the wearer's fighting style. Creating an aegis absolute requires months of dedicated work, materials of extraordinary rarity, and a forge of exceptional quality. Only one can be in progress at a time, and the armorsmith pours enough of themselves into the work that they cannot begin another for at least a year.
[Armorsmithing: 72]

Keen Edge.name: Keen Edge
Keen Edge.description:
The smith grinds and hones a blade to a superior edge that cuts more cleanly and holds sharpness longer than standard work. Weapons finished with this technique deal slightly more damage and resist dulling through extended use. The edge geometry must match the weapon's intended purpose: a fine slicing edge for a katana, a durable chopping edge for an axe. Requires quality whetstones and a steady hand. The improvement is modest on its own but stacks with material and enchantment quality.
[Blacksmithing: 5]

Balanced Forging.name: Balanced Forging
Balanced Forging.description:
The smith forges a weapon with precise weight distribution, moving the balance point to suit the wielder's fighting style. A well-balanced weapon is faster to swing, less fatiguing to carry, and more accurate in the hands of a trained user. The technique requires understanding both metallurgy and combat mechanics. Balance is customized to the intended wielder; a weapon balanced for a heavy hitter feels wrong to a speed fighter. Adds a meaningful handling bonus to the finished weapon.
[Blacksmithing: 8]

Folded Steel.name: Folded Steel
Folded Steel.description:
The smith repeatedly folds and hammers the metal during forging, working out impurities and creating a layered internal structure that combines hardness with flexibility. Folded-steel weapons resist chipping and shattering while holding a keen edge, and they carry a distinctive grain pattern that marks them as master-crafted. The process takes many hours and demands precise temperature control across dozens of heating and folding cycles. A single mistake in the folding ruins the entire billet.
[Blacksmithing: 17]

Elemental Quenching.name: Elemental Quenching
Elemental Quenching.description:
The smith quenches a hot blade in an elementally-charged medium, imparting a natural affinity to the finished weapon. Quenching in flame oil produces a blade that deals bonus fire damage; quenching in glacial water yields cold; quenching in stormcloud vapor gives lightning. The affinity is inherent to the metal rather than an applied enchantment, making it permanent and undispellable. The quenching medium must be prepared from genuine elemental sources, and the timing of the quench determines the strength of the affinity.
[Blacksmithing: 32]

Runeforged Blade.name: Runeforged Blade
