The caster blasts a high-pressure jet of water strong enough to knock foes off their feet and carve through soft cover. The force staggers and pushes targets, controlling the battlefield. Larger and heavier targets resist the knockback, and the jet loses power at range as it disperses.
[Water Magic: 34]

Healing Waters.name: Healing Waters
Healing Waters.description:
The caster conjures restorative water that mends the wounds of allies bathed in it, washing away injury and minor afflictions over several turns. Gentle and mana-efficient for sustained healing. The waters must reach the wounded; a distant or sealed-away ally cannot benefit, and the healing is gradual rather than instant.
[Water Magic: 45]

Tidal Wave.name: Tidal Wave
Tidal Wave.description:
The caster raises a great wave that crashes across the battlefield, sweeping enemies away, dousing flames, and reshaping the terrain into flooded ground. Devastating against grouped foes and fire-based threats. Requires a source of water or significant mana to conjure the volume; in arid environments the wave is diminished.
[Water Magic: 57]

Water Prison.name: Water Prison
Water Prison.description:
The caster traps a target within a sphere of dense, inescapable water, immobilizing them and cutting off their air. Drowning targets weaken each turn. Aquatic and non-breathing creatures are immune to the suffocation but still restrained. The prison requires concentration to maintain; if the caster is disrupted, it collapses.
[Water Magic: 70]

Ocean's Domain.name: Ocean's Domain
Ocean's Domain.description:
The caster floods the battlefield and claims dominion over the water, moving through it effortlessly, striking from any pool, and drowning foes who cannot keep their footing. Within the flooded domain, the caster's water magic reaches its peak and enemies struggle against the current. The domain requires vast mana and disperses on dry, absorbent ground.
[Water Magic: 85]

Drowning Abyss.name: Drowning Abyss
Drowning Abyss.description:
The drowning of the world. The caster calls forth the weight and darkness of the deepest ocean, burying a vast region beneath a crushing deluge that drowns armies and pulls even mighty foes into lightless depths. The pressure alone can crush what water cannot drown. Summoning the abyss draws on the caster's own vitality to the breaking point, and such a flood can be called only in the direst extremity.
[Water Magic: 100]

Stone Spear.name: Stone Spear
Stone Spear.description:
The caster erupts a spear of rock from the ground beneath a target, impaling them from an unexpected angle. The sudden strike is hard to anticipate and can pin a target in place. Flying targets and those on non-earthen surfaces are safe, and very hard flooring resists the eruption.
[Earth Magic: 28]

Earthen Bulwark.name: Earthen Bulwark
Earthen Bulwark.description:
The caster raises walls and barriers of stone to block attacks, funnel enemies, and reshape the battlefield to their advantage. Building them takes a moment and requires earth or stone to draw from; on wooden floors or over water, the technique falters. It guards those behind the stone on the turn you raise it; reshaping it for the next assault takes your action again each turn.
[Earth Magic: 40]

Seismic Slam.name: Seismic Slam
Seismic Slam.description:
The caster strikes the ground and sends a shockwave rippling outward, knocking down all grounded enemies and cracking the terrain into difficult ground. Devastating against foes who rely on footing. Flying and levitating targets are unaffected, and the technique needs solid ground to transmit the force.
[Earth Magic: 53]

Stone Titan.name: Stone Titan
Stone Titan.description:
The caster encases themselves in a towering shell of animated rock, becoming a hulking earthen giant with immense strength and durability. In titan form, the caster hits like a landslide and shrugs off blows. The form is slow and heavy, vulnerable to being toppled or to magic that erodes stone, and it drains mana steadily.
[Earth Magic: 67]

Tectonic Upheaval.name: Tectonic Upheaval
Tectonic Upheaval.description:
The caster wrenches the earth itself, raising and collapsing terrain across a wide area: opening chasms, thrusting up ridges, and burying foes under cascading stone. The upheaval reshapes the entire battlefield to the caster's design. It demands tremendous mana and a solid earthen foundation; over water or artificial platforms, its power is broken.
[Earth Magic: 83]

World-Shaper's Wrath.name: World-Shaper's Wrath
World-Shaper's Wrath.description:
The mountain's judgment. The caster commands the deep bones of the world to rise, calling forth an apocalypse of stone and shattering earth that can swallow a fortress, level a battlefield, and remake the landscape in a single working. The land answers as though alive. Channeling such primordial force hollows the caster utterly, and the earth can be roused to this degree only when nothing lesser will serve.
[Earth Magic: 100]

Cutting Gale.name: Cutting Gale
Cutting Gale.description:
The caster fires blades of compressed wind that slice at range, striking multiple targets and bypassing the friction that slows physical projectiles. Effective at range and against light armor. Heavy armor blunts the cuts, and the blades lose coherence in enclosed spaces with no room for the wind to move.
[Wind Magic: 28]

Wind Walk.name: Wind Walk
Wind Walk.description:
The caster wraps themselves in currents of air, gaining greatly enhanced speed, leaping ability, and even brief flight. Excellent for repositioning, escaping, and reaching high ground. The winds must have space to work; enclosed corridors and anti-magic zones ground the caster mid-stride.
[Wind Magic: 40]

Tempest.name: Tempest
Tempest.description:
The caster conjures a raging cyclone that flings enemies about, deflects projectiles, and dominates an area with howling wind. Foes within struggle to stand, aim, or cast. The tempest is indiscriminate and drains mana to sustain; allies caught inside suffer the same buffeting.
[Wind Magic: 53]

Vacuum Slash.name: Vacuum Slash
Vacuum Slash.description:
The caster carves a blade of near-vacuum that slices through nearly anything by tearing matter apart at the pressure boundary. The cut ignores most armor and physical resistance. Creating the vacuum requires precise control; a lapse causes the blade to implode harmlessly, and it functions only where there is air to displace.
[Wind Magic: 67]

Storm Sovereign.name: Storm Sovereign
Storm Sovereign.description:
The caster becomes the eye of a perpetual gale, commanding wind absolutely: flying freely, hurling foes, and shredding the field with blades of air. Within their domain of wind, projectiles cannot reach the caster and enemies are held at the storm's mercy. The sovereignty drains mana continuously and weakens in dead, still air.
[Wind Magic: 83]

Heaven's Cyclone.name: Heaven's Cyclone
Heaven's Cyclone.description:
The sky's fury unbound. The caster summons a colossal cyclone that reaches from earth to cloud, tearing apart everything within its vast radius, flinging armies like leaves, and stripping the land bare. Even the mighty are helpless against winds that can flense stone. Raising such a storm draws the breath from the caster's own body, and it can be called only once when the world itself hangs in the balance.
[Wind Magic: 100]

Entangling Growth.name: Entangling Growth
Entangling Growth.description:
The caster commands roots and vines to erupt and seize enemies, immobilizing them and dealing crushing damage as the growth constricts. Effective for controlling the battlefield and pinning dangerous foes. Requires soil or vegetation to draw from; on barren stone or metal, nothing answers the call. Fire clears the growth quickly.
[Nature Magic: 58]

Beast Bond.name: Beast Bond
Beast Bond.description:
The caster forms a temporary bond with nearby wildlife, calling beasts to fight alongside them and lending the caster the senses and instincts of the wild. The summoned creatures fight for a time before returning to the wild. The bond depends on suitable creatures being nearby; in lifeless or urban settings, few or none answer.
[Nature Magic: 65]

Verdant Renewal.name: Verdant Renewal
Verdant Renewal.description:
The caster channels the vitality of living growth to heal allies and restore the land, mending wounds and cleansing corruption over a wide area. Nature reclaims what was damaged. The renewal is potent but slow, working over several turns, and it is strongest in fertile environments where life is abundant.
[Nature Magic: 74]

Thornmaw Grove.name: Thornmaw Grove
Thornmaw Grove.description:
The caster raises a grove of predatory plants that snap, lash, and ensnare all enemies within, forming a living hazard that persists on the battlefield. Foes must fight the grove as well as the caster. The grove is stationary and vulnerable to fire; it thrives in natural settings and struggles to take root on hard artificial ground.
[Nature Magic: 82]

Fury of the Wild.name: Fury of the Wild
Fury of the Wild.description:
The caster rouses the fury of nature itself across a wide area: the ground heaves with roots, beasts converge, and the very plants turn hostile to intruders. For the duration, the natural world fights as the caster's ally. The working demands a living environment; in a place stripped of nature, the wrath has nothing to answer it.
[Nature Magic: 91]

Genesis Bloom.name: Genesis Bloom
Genesis Bloom.description:
Life's own resurgence. The caster becomes a conduit for the primal force of growth, causing an explosion of life that can restore a blighted land to lushness, resurrect a fallen forest in moments, and overwhelm a battlefield with an unstoppable tide of thorn, root, and beast. The bloom can even coax life back into the freshly fallen. Channeling creation's vitality burns the caster to their core, and such a genesis can be called only once in a long age.
[Nature Magic: 100]

Sanguine Lance.name: Sanguine Lance
Sanguine Lance.description:
The caster shapes their own or a victim's blood into a hardened lance and hurls it with piercing force. The lance is difficult to defend against magically since it is not a conventional element. Using the caster's own blood costs them vitality; using a wounded enemy's blood requires an open wound to draw from.
[Blood Magic: 58]

Hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage
Hemorrhage.description:
The caster commands the blood already within a target to rebel, causing internal bleeding and agonizing pain that worsens each turn. Devastating against living creatures with circulating blood. Constructs, undead, elementals, and creatures without blood are wholly immune. Strong vitality slows but does not stop the effect.
[Blood Magic: 65]

Crimson Pact.name: Crimson Pact
Crimson Pact.description:
The caster spends their own vitality to dramatically empower their next several spells or strikes, trading health for raw power. The pact allows feats beyond the caster's normal limits at a steep personal cost. Overuse is lethal; a caster who spends too much blood collapses. Healing magic can offset the drain if applied in time.
[Blood Magic: 74]

Blood Puppetry.name: Blood Puppetry
Blood Puppetry.description:
The caster seizes control of the blood within a living target, forcing their body to move against their will for a short time: dropping a weapon, taking a step, striking an ally. Strong-willed and high-vitality targets resist, reducing the control to painful spasms. Bloodless creatures are immune. The manipulation costs the caster vitality to maintain.
[Blood Magic: 82]

Sanguine Ascension.name: Sanguine Ascension
Sanguine Ascension.description:
The caster enters a heightened state fueled by blood, their wounds closing as they draw power from the vitality around them: their own, their enemies', the blood spilled on the field. For the duration, the caster is empowered and self-healing so long as blood flows nearby. On a battlefield the state is nearly unstoppable; in a bloodless setting it starves. The Church names it heresy.
[Blood Magic: 91]

Ocean of Blood.name: Ocean of Blood
Ocean of Blood.description:
The forbidden zenith of blood magic. The caster reaches out to every drop of blood within a vast radius, friend, foe, and their own, and commands it absolutely, drowning enemies in their own vitality, healing themselves from a sea of spilled life, and puppeteering the fallen. Living beings within the radius weaken as their blood answers another's will. The magic exacts a fragment of the caster's soul with each use, and its practice invites the direst consequences from Church and Crown alike.
[Blood Magic: 100]

Phantasmal Double.name: Phantasmal Double
Phantasmal Double.description:
The caster creates a convincing illusory copy of themselves that mimics their movements, drawing attacks and confusing foes about the real target's position. The double dissipates when struck by a solid hit. Perceptive enemies, true-sight, and area attacks that catch both copies can expose the ruse.
[Illusion Magic: 27]

Sensory Deception.name: Sensory Deception
Sensory Deception.description:
The caster alters what a target perceives, hiding real threats, conjuring false ones, or masking sounds and smells. A deceived enemy may swing at empty air or fail to notice a real danger. Strong-willed targets and those who catch a contradiction between senses can shake off the illusion. It affects minds, so mindless constructs are immune.
[Illusion Magic: 41]

Mirror Maze.name: Mirror Maze
Mirror Maze.description:
The caster fills an area with a shifting labyrinth of illusory duplicates, false walls, and misdirected paths, disorienting all enemies within and hiding the true positions of the caster and allies. Foes struggle to find real targets. The maze is a construct of the mind; those who realize it is illusion can begin to see through it, and it does not stop physical area attacks.
[Illusion Magic: 59]

Waking Nightmare.name: Waking Nightmare
Waking Nightmare.description:
The caster reaches into a target's mind and conjures their deepest fears made manifest, paralyzing them with terror and dealing psychic damage as the nightmare plays out. Fearless, mindless, and mentally-shielded targets resist. The intrusion is intimate and taxing; the caster experiences an echo of the nightmare they inflict.
[Dream Magic: 65]

Grand Illusion.name: Grand Illusion
Grand Illusion.description:
The caster weaves an illusion so complete and seamless that it convinces every sense of an entire false reality across a wide area: a battlefield that seems to shift, an army that isn't there, a landscape rewritten. Enemies act on false information until something breaks the spell. Sustaining an illusion of this scale demands immense concentration; a single disruption can unravel the whole working.
[Illusion Magic: 80]

World of Mirrors.name: World of Mirrors
World of Mirrors.description:
The ultimate deception. The caster ensnares all minds within a vast area in a shared false reality of the caster's design, where the trapped perceive, feel, and believe whatever the caster wills: fighting phantoms, wandering lost, or frozen in fabricated moments. For as long as it holds, the caster authors their victims' entire experience. Maintaining a world of this scale consumes the caster utterly, and any mind strong enough to declare 'this is false' begins to crack the whole illusion from within.
[Illusion Magic: 100]

Greater Haste.name: Greater Haste
Greater Haste.description:
The caster accelerates an ally's personal time, granting them greatly increased speed of movement and action for several turns. A hastened ally acts more often and moves faster than foes can track. The acceleration is disorienting if overused, and dispelling magic or time-anchoring effects can strip it away.
[Time Magic: 55]

Time Snare.name: Time Snare
Time Snare.description:
The caster slows the local flow of time around a target, dramatically reducing their speed and reaction while the rest of the world moves normally. A snared enemy becomes an easy target. Powerful beings and those with temporal resistance shrug off or shorten the effect. The snare demands precise focus to place.
[Time Magic: 63]

Rewind.name: Rewind
Rewind.description:
The caster reverses a few seconds of time for themselves or an ally, undoing recent wounds and repositioning them to where they were moments before. A well-timed rewind can undo a fatal blow. The magic is costly and cannot reach far into the past; it recovers only the last few moments, and repeated use within a short span destabilizes the caster's own timeline.
[Time Magic: 72]

Accelerated World.name: Accelerated World
Accelerated World.description:
The caster steps their own time far ahead of the world's, moving and acting many times for each moment that passes for everyone else. For a short span, the caster is untouchable and unstoppable to those left behind in normal time. The acceleration ages the caster's body and burns mana ferociously; when it ends, the accumulated strain drops them into exhaustion.
[Time Magic: 90]

Eternity's Edge.name: Eternity's Edge
Eternity's Edge.description:
The forbidden mastery of the fourth dimension. The caster seizes the flow of time across a wide area, stopping it entirely for all but themselves, rewinding damage as though it never occurred, or hurling an enemy forward or backward out of the moment. For a few heartbeats the caster stands outside time's authority. The paradox strains reality and the caster's own existence to the breaking point; wielding it risks unmaking the caster's place in the timeline, and it can be dared only once in a very long while.
[Time Magic: 100]

Blink.name: Blink
Blink.description:
The caster instantly teleports a short distance, bypassing obstacles and repositioning to safety or advantage. Useful for escaping grabs, crossing hazards, and flanking. The blink requires the caster to perceive or know the destination; blinking blindly into an unknown or occupied space risks a dangerous misplacement, and anchoring fields prevent it.
[Space Magic: 55]

Space Tear.name: Space Tear
Space Tear.description:
The caster tears a rift in space that slices whatever it passes through, dealing damage that ignores physical armor by cutting the space the target occupies. The rend is precise and hard to defend against conventionally. Spatial-warding magic and beings anchored against displacement resist it, and creating the rift demands careful control.
[Space Magic: 63]

Spatial Cache.name: Spatial Cache
Spatial Cache.description:
The caster opens a fold in space to store objects, redirect attacks into a void, or pull hidden items and weapons from nowhere. Attacks sent into the pocket may be flung back out elsewhere. The pocket is small and requires concentration to hold open; a disrupted caster may lose whatever is inside or have it emerge unpredictably.
[Space Magic: 72]

Banishment.name: Banishment
Banishment.description:
The caster forcibly displaces a target to a distant location or briefly into an empty pocket dimension, removing them from the fight for a time. A banished foe must find their way back. Powerful and spatially-anchored beings resist banishment, and the caster cannot send a target somewhere they cannot themselves perceive or define.
[Space Magic: 81]

Warp Field.name: Warp Field
Warp Field.description:
The caster warps the space of a wide area, distorting distances so that enemies' attacks fall short, their movement carries them astray, and the caster's own strikes reach impossibly far. Within the field, geometry itself favors the caster. The distortion is mentally taxing to maintain and can be resisted by beings with their own command of space.
[Space Magic: 90]

Sunder the World.name: Sunder the World
Sunder the World.description:
The ultimate command of space. The caster tears open a great rift in the fabric of reality, unmaking the space within a vast region: swallowing what falls in, severing anything the rift crosses, and folding distant points together or wrenching them apart. Nothing within the rift's reach is safe from being cut out of existence. Opening a wound in space of this magnitude threatens to consume the caster along with everything else, and it can be dared only when the alternative is worse than the risk.
[Space Magic: 100]

Holy Smite.name: Holy Smite
Holy Smite.description:
The caster calls down divine force upon a target, dealing damage amplified against the corrupt, the undead, and the demonic. The smite carries the weight of judgment. Pure and innocent targets take little from it, and heavily faithless casters find the divine slow to answer their call.
[Divinity: 62]

Divine Favor.name: Divine Favor
Divine Favor.description:
The caster invokes a god's favor upon allies, granting protection, courage, and enhanced ability. Blessed allies fight with renewed strength and resist fear and corruption. The blessing's strength reflects the caster's standing with their deity; a wavering or fallen faith weakens what the divine grants. It blesses allies near you on the turn you invoke it; invoking it again takes your action again each turn.
[Divinity: 68]

Hallowed Ground.name: Hallowed Ground
Hallowed Ground.description:
The caster sanctifies an area, making it holy ground where allies are healed and strengthened, undead and demons are weakened and repelled, and dark magic falters. The consecration holds for the duration and turns the battlefield against corrupt foes. It is stationary and can be defiled by a sufficiently powerful dark presence.
[Divinity: 74]

Divine Intervention.name: Divine Intervention
Divine Intervention.description:
The caster beseeches their god to act directly, calling a moment of miraculous aid: a fatal blow turned aside, a grievous wound closed, an ally snatched from death's edge. The intervention is powerful but not guaranteed; the god answers according to the caster's faith and the worthiness of the moment. It cannot be demanded lightly or often.
[Divinity: 87]

Avatar of the Divine.name: Avatar of the Divine
Avatar of the Divine.description:
The caster becomes a temporary vessel for their deity's power, radiant with holy might, their attacks carrying divine judgment and their presence healing allies and searing the corrupt. For the duration, the caster fights with borrowed divinity. Housing a god's power strains a mortal frame to its limit; when it ends, the caster is left utterly spent and must not call upon it again too soon.
[Divinity: 93]

Descent of the God.name: Descent of the God
Descent of the God.description:
The ultimate act of faith. The caster opens themselves fully as a conduit and, for a few sacred heartbeats, a fragment of their god manifests through them into the world: a presence that can smite legions, raise the fallen, purify a corrupted land, and cast down beings of nightmare with a word. No corruption endures the god's regard. Bearing even a fragment of true divinity nearly unmakes the mortal vessel, and such a descent is granted only once in a lifetime, if ever, and only in a moment of supreme need.
[Divinity: 100]

Soul Sight.name: Soul Sight
Soul Sight.description:
The caster perceives the souls of those around them, reading emotional truth, life force, and the presence of hidden spirits, possession, or soul-based corruption. Cuts through disguise and deception to the essence beneath. Beings that shield their souls or possess no conventional soul resist the reading. The sight strains the caster's own spirit with prolonged use.
[Soul Magic: 29]

Spirit Bolt.name: Spirit Bolt
Spirit Bolt.description:
The caster hurls a bolt of pure spiritual energy that bypasses physical armor entirely, striking directly at the target's life force and vitality. Effective against heavily armored foes and incorporeal spirits alike. Beings with strong spiritual defenses or warded souls take reduced damage. Overuse frays the caster's own spirit.
[Soul Magic: 39]

Soul Bind.name: Soul Bind
Soul Bind.description:
The caster tethers their soul to an ally's or an enemy's, sharing strength and sensation with a willing ally or draining the will and vitality of an unwilling foe. A bound ally fights in perfect coordination; a bound enemy is slowly worn down. The bond is intimate and taxing, and a much stronger unwilling soul can resist or turn it back.
[Soul Magic: 50]

Spirit Ward.name: Spirit Ward
Spirit Ward.description:
The caster erects a barrier that protects against soul-based attacks, possession, fear, mental intrusion, and the touch of the undead. Allies within are shielded in spirit as well as body. The ward is potent against spiritual threats but offers no protection from physical harm, and sustaining it drains the caster's own soul-force.
[Soul Magic: 73]

Soul Severance.name: Soul Severance
Soul Severance.description:
The caster strikes directly at the bond between body and soul, threatening to sever a target's spirit from their flesh: banishing possessing entities, unmaking the undead, and dealing grievous harm to the living. Powerful and firmly-anchored souls resist the severance. The act is spiritually violent and recoils on the caster, taxing their own soul heavily.
[Soul Magic: 86]

Judgment of Souls.name: Judgment of Souls
Judgment of Souls.description:
The ultimate soul working. The caster reaches into the spiritual essence of all within a vast area and weighs them, empowering allied souls to their peak while shattering the spirits of enemies, banishing every undead and possessing entity, and threatening to sever the unworthy from their flesh entirely. Souls of tremendous power may endure; all others are laid bare and judged. Wielding authority over the soul on this scale wounds the caster's own spirit deeply, and it can be dared only rarely, at grave cost.
[Soul Magic: 100]

Starfall.name: Starfall
Starfall.description:
The caster calls down a shower of celestial motes that rain upon an area, each striking with radiant force. Effective against groups and things that dwell in darkness. The falling stars need open sky or a high ceiling to descend; deep underground, the caster cannot draw them down. Fades against beings aligned with the void.
[Star Magic: 25]

Constellation Ward.name: Constellation Ward
Constellation Ward.description:
The caster traces a protective pattern of starlight around allies, guarding them and granting guidance that improves their aim and awareness under its light. It shines brightest at night and beneath open sky; in enclosed or star-veiled places, its protection dims. It guards allies near you on the turn you trace it; retracing it takes your action again each turn.
[Star Magic: 35]

Stellar Alignment.name: Stellar Alignment
Stellar Alignment.description:
The caster draws on the positions of the stars to empower their magic, granting a burst of enhanced power, foresight, and fortune for several turns. Under alignment, the caster's spells strike truer and their timing seems blessed. The alignment depends on the caster's connection to the night sky and cannot be forced under a shrouded or sunlit heaven.
[Star Magic: 50]

Meteor.name: Meteor
Meteor.description:
The caster calls a single burning star down from the heavens to smash into a target area with cataclysmic force, dealing massive damage and cratering the ground. The meteor takes a moment to descend, giving swift foes a chance to flee the impact zone. It requires open sky to call and cannot be summoned beneath heavy cover or underground.
[Star Magic: 65]

Cosmic Dominion.name: Cosmic Dominion
Cosmic Dominion.description:
The caster pulls the power of the night sky down around themselves, wreathed in starlight, calling stars to strike and bending celestial fortune to their will across the battlefield. For the duration, the heavens fight alongside the caster. The dominion is strongest under open night sky and falters where the stars cannot be seen; it drains the caster's mana steadily.
[Star Magic: 81]

Fall of the Firmament.name: Fall of the Firmament
Fall of the Firmament.description:
The heavens brought to earth. The caster reaches to the vault of stars and calls down a cataclysm of celestial fire: a rain of meteors and star-force that can annihilate an army, level a stronghold, and scar the land with craters of glowing slag. Beneath the falling firmament, few things of this world endure. Drawing the sky down burns the caster hollow, and such a working requires open heaven above and can be dared only when nothing lesser will turn the tide.
[Star Magic: 100]

Null Bolt.name: Null Bolt
Null Bolt.description:
The caster fires a bolt of nothingness that negates and erodes whatever it touches, dealing damage that ignores most resistances by simply unmaking a portion of the target. Difficult to defend against by conventional means. Beings attuned to the void resist it, and channeling nothingness leaves an unsettling residue that void-sensitive creatures can track.
[Void Magic: 25]

Nullify.name: Nullify
Nullify.description:
The caster snuffs out magic in a targeted area or object, dispelling enchantments, collapsing conjurations, and silencing active spells by erasing the magic that sustains them. Potent against spellcasters and magical constructs. Extremely powerful or deeply-anchored magic resists, requiring repeated effort, and the nullification affects the caster's own magic within the zone as well.
[Void Magic: 35]

Null Step.name: Null Step
Null Step.description:
The caster slips partway into the void, becoming intangible and able to pass through matter and attacks for a brief span before returning. While void-stepped, the caster cannot be struck by physical or most magical means but also cannot affect the material world. The step is disorienting and cannot be held long; lingering in the void risks not returning fully.
[Void Magic: 50]

Devouring Maw.name: Devouring Maw
Devouring Maw.description:
The caster opens a hungry rent to the void that pulls in and consumes nearby matter and energy, damaging and drawing foes toward oblivion. Things pulled into the maw are eroded away. The maw is indiscriminate, endangering allies who stray too close, and its pull can be resisted by sufficient strength or anchoring; it demands concentration to hold open.
[Void Magic: 65]

Entropy Field.name: Entropy Field
Entropy Field.description:
The caster saturates an area with the void's decay, causing everything within to erode, weaken, and unmake over time: armor crumbles, spells falter, wounds refuse to close. Enemies within are worn down turn by turn. The field is exhausting to maintain and its decay is agnostic; the caster and allies within suffer the same erosion.
[Void Magic: 80]

Unmaking.name: Unmaking
Unmaking.description:
The void's final word. The caster channels the nothingness that preceded creation and turns it upon a vast area, unmaking whatever cannot resist: matter, magic, and being alike simply ceasing to exist within the void's reach. Only the most powerful or void-attuned endure it. Wielding true nothingness threatens to unmake the caster along with their targets, and calling upon the Unmaking is an act of desperation that scars the world and the mage both.
[Void Magic: 100]

Crushing Weight.name: Crushing Weight
Crushing Weight.description:
The caster increases the gravity upon a target, pinning them down, slowing their movement, and buckling their stance under sudden weight. Heavy pressure can bring a foe to their knees. Extremely strong and low-mass targets resist the effect, and flying creatures are dragged toward the ground rather than crushed.
[Gravity Magic: 25]

Gravity Well.name: Gravity Well
Gravity Well.description:
The caster creates a point of intense gravity that draws in nearby foes, projectiles, and loose objects, clustering enemies and redirecting attacks. Useful for grouping foes for an area strike or pulling ranged attackers into reach. Sufficiently strong or anchored targets resist the pull, and the well requires focus to sustain.
[Gravity Magic: 35]

Reverse Gravity.name: Reverse Gravity
Reverse Gravity.description:
The caster inverts gravity in an area, sending everything not anchored tumbling upward before releasing them to fall. Disorients and damages foes caught in the reversal and can hurl them into hazards. The effect is dramatic but brief; grounded, gripping, and flying creatures resist being flung, and the caster must time the release.
[Gravity Magic: 50]

Collapsing Point.name: Collapsing Point
Collapsing Point.description:
The caster conjures a collapsing point of gravity that crushes everything drawn into it with immense force, dealing heavy damage and pulling foes inexorably inward. Escaping the singularity's pull requires overwhelming strength. The spell is mana-intensive and indiscriminate; allies caught in its reach suffer the same crushing draw, and it demands sustained concentration.
[Gravity Magic: 65]

Gravitational Dominion.name: Gravitational Dominion
Gravitational Dominion.description:
The caster claims command over gravity across a wide area, pinning enemies, lifting allies, redirecting every projectile, and altering the weight of the battlefield at will. Within the domain, the caster dictates which way is down. The dominion is mentally demanding and drains mana continuously; beings with their own mastery of force can contest it.
[Gravity Magic: 80]

Gravity Collapse.name: Gravity Collapse
Gravity Collapse.description:
The ultimate command of gravity. The caster collapses a point of space into a devouring singularity of such intensity that it draws in and crushes everything within a vast radius: armies, structures, even light bending toward its heart. Nothing short of the mightiest power escapes the pull once the horizon forms. Creating a wound in space-time of this magnitude threatens to consume the caster and the surrounding world alike, and it can be dared only in the most desperate extremity.
[Gravity Magic: 100]

Enthrall.name: Enthrall
Enthrall.description:
The caster weaves an enchantment that captivates a target's attention and softens their hostility, making them hesitant to attack and more receptive to the caster's words. Strong-willed targets and those forewarned resist. The charm is subtle and non-violent; the moment the caster acts against the enthralled target's interests, the spell shatters and resentment follows.
[Charm Magic: 25]

Calm Emotions.name: Calm Emotions
Calm Emotions.description:
The caster soothes the emotions of those in an area, quelling rage, fear, and aggression to defuse a volatile situation or end a fight before it begins. Effective for de-escalation and keeping volatile crowds in check. Targets committed to violence or under external compulsion resist, and the calm lifts if a fresh provocation breaks through it.
[Charm Magic: 35]

Suggestion.name: Suggestion
Suggestion.description:
The caster plants a plausible suggestion in a target's mind that they carry out believing it their own idea, so long as it does not directly endanger them or violate their core nature. Overtly harmful or out-of-character suggestions are rejected. Strong-willed targets sense the intrusion. Discovery of the manipulation causes lasting enmity.
[Charm Magic: 50]

Crowd Charm.name: Crowd Charm
Crowd Charm.description:
The caster extends their enchantment over a group, swaying a crowd's mood and disposition toward favor, hesitation, or calm. Useful for turning a hostile assembly or quieting a mob. The larger the crowd, the shallower the effect on each individual, and strong-willed or forewarned members can resist and rally others against the spell.
[Charm Magic: 65]

Heart's Dominion.name: Heart's Dominion
Heart's Dominion.description:
The caster reaches deep into a target's emotions, binding their affection, loyalty, or devotion to the caster for a time. The effect is powerful but perilous; it is not true feeling, and when it fades (or is discovered) the reaction can be volatile. Strong-willed and emotionally-guarded targets resist entirely. The Church and most decent folk consider such coercion a grave violation.
[Charm Magic: 81]

Siren's Absolute.name: Siren's Absolute
Siren's Absolute.description:
The zenith of enchantment, and among the most feared. The caster projects an overwhelming aura of allure and command that bends the will of nearly all within a wide area toward the caster's desire: hostility forgotten, devotion compelled, resistance crumbling. Only the mightiest wills and the specifically warded stand against it. Such domination of the heart and mind exacts a spiritual toll on the caster and invites terrible retribution should it be discovered, and it can be wielded only rarely, at great cost to conscience and safety alike.
[Charm Magic: 100]

Crystal Shards.name: Crystal Shards
Crystal Shards.description:
The caster conjures and launches a spray of razor-sharp crystal fragments that pierce and embed in targets, dealing damage and leaving shards that continue to cut with movement. Effective against light armor. Heavy plate deflects the shards, and the embedded fragments can be removed to stop the residual damage.
[Crystal Magic: 25]

Crystalline Armor.name: Crystalline Armor
Crystalline Armor.description:
The caster sheathes themselves or an ally in growing crystal that hardens into protective armor, catching blows and reflecting a portion of energy attacks. The armor is heavy and slows the wearer, and sufficient blunt force shatters sections of it. It guards you or one ally on the turn you grow it; regrowing it takes your action again each turn.
[Crystal Magic: 35]

Prism Beam.name: Prism Beam
Prism Beam.description:
The caster channels magic through a conjured crystal to split and refract it into multiple beams that strike several targets or converge for concentrated damage. Versatile and precise. The refraction can be disrupted by shattering the focusing crystal or by fields that scatter light and energy, and aligning the beams requires a moment of focus.
[Crystal Magic: 50]

Crystal Prison.name: Crystal Prison
Crystal Prison.description:
The caster entombs a target in rapidly-growing crystal, immobilizing them completely as the crystal encases them. Trapped targets are helpless until they shatter free or the crystal is broken. Powerful targets crack the prison faster, and shattering it deals bonus damage to the one inside. The growth requires an unobstructed moment to complete.
[Crystal Magic: 65]

Resonant Cataclysm.name: Resonant Cataclysm
Resonant Cataclysm.description:
The caster attunes crystals throughout an area to a shattering frequency, then triggers them to detonate in a cascade of crystalline force and razor shards that shreds everything within. The resonance builds over a turn before release. Allies caught in the field suffer the same barrage, and sound-dampening or the destruction of the seed crystals can disrupt the cascade.
[Crystal Magic: 81]

World Crystal.name: World Crystal
World Crystal.description:
The apex of crystal mastery. The caster grows an immense, perfect crystal that resonates with the deep magic of the world, unleashing waves of crystalline force that can entomb an army, shatter a fortress, and reshape the terrain into a lethal crystalline expanse. The crystal focuses and amplifies the caster's power to world-altering scale. Growing and channeling it drains the caster to their limit, and it can be attempted only rarely, when the situation demands overwhelming force.
[Crystal Magic: 100]

Sonic Burst.name: Sonic Burst
Sonic Burst.description:
The caster projects a focused blast of concussive sound that damages and staggers a target, disrupting concentration and interrupting spellcasting. Effective against casters and delicate mechanisms. Deaf creatures and those in sound-dampening fields resist, and the blast loses focus in wide-open spaces where the sound disperses.
[Sound Magic: 25]

Dissonant Chord.name: Dissonant Chord
Dissonant Chord.description:
The caster produces a jarring chord that assaults the minds and balance of all enemies in an area, disorienting them and reducing their accuracy and coordination. The dissonance grates on the will as much as the ears. Deaf, mindless, and sound-warded targets resist, and allies within the area suffer the discord unless shielded.
[Sound Magic: 35]

Song of Courage.name: Song of Courage
Song of Courage.description:
The caster performs a rousing melody that emboldens allies, granting them resistance to fear, enhanced resolve, and improved combat ability for several turns. The song must be sustained; if the caster is silenced or slain, the effect ends. Its power scales with the caster's artistry, and it does nothing for allies who cannot hear it.
[Sound Magic: 50]

Shattering Frequency.name: Shattering Frequency
Shattering Frequency.description:
The caster finds the resonant frequency of a target object or creature and amplifies it until it cracks and breaks: shattering armor, weapons, crystalline foes, and rigid structures. Devastating against brittle and crystalline targets. Flexible, organic, and sound-warded targets resist, and finding the exact frequency requires a moment of focused attunement.
[Sound Magic: 65]

Symphony of War.name: Symphony of War
Symphony of War.description:
The caster conducts an overwhelming symphony that empowers allies and assaults enemies across a wide area simultaneously: courage and speed for friends, disorientation and pain for foes. The symphony dominates the battlefield's soundscape. It demands unbroken performance; interruption ends it, and its reach is bounded by what can be heard over the din.
[Sound Magic: 80]

The Unmaking Note.name: The Unmaking Note
The Unmaking Note.description:
The final sound. The caster sounds a single perfect note pitched to the resonance of existence itself, a frequency that shakes matter apart and can shatter fortresses, ranks of foes, and creatures of legend across a vast area. Nothing rigid endures the note's full force, and even the resilient are staggered to their core. Producing a sound of such power tears at the caster's own body, bleeding ears and burning throat, and it can be sounded only once when all else has failed.
[Sound Magic: 100]

Impossible Evasion.name: Impossible Evasion
Impossible Evasion.description:
The acrobat contorts, rolls, and redirects with such fluid grace that attacks meant to land find only empty air. For several turns, evasion against physical attacks is dramatically heightened as the acrobat flows around every strike. The state demands space to move; pinned in a corner or grappled, the acrobat cannot flow. Sustained evasion is exhausting.
[acrobatics: 94]

Gravity-Defying Mastery.name: Gravity-Defying Mastery
Gravity-Defying Mastery.description:
The pinnacle of acrobatic art. The acrobat moves as though gravity is a suggestion: running on ceilings, hanging in the air between bounds, twisting through impossible angles, and turning any surface into a path. For the duration, terrain and elevation impose no limit on the acrobat's movement, and few attacks can pin something so untethered. The mastery burns stamina fiercely and cannot defy true flight or ranged saturation.
[acrobatics: 100]

Rally.name: Rally
Rally.description:
The athlete pushes through exhaustion to recover a burst of stamina and shake off fatigue, returning to peak performance when their body wanted to quit. Restores stamina and clears minor fatigue effects. The recovery draws on reserves; relying on it too often leaves the athlete deeper in debt, with a harder crash when those reserves finally empty.
[athletics: 87]

Herculean Effort.name: Herculean Effort
Herculean Effort.description:
The athlete summons a surge of raw physical power for a single tremendous feat: lifting a portcullis, holding back a collapse, hurling a boulder, breaking a chain. The effort accomplishes what normal strength cannot, but it strains muscle and sinew to the edge of injury. Overreaching risks pulling something; the athlete pays for the feat with soreness and reduced strength afterward.
[athletics: 93]

Peak Human Conditioning.name: Peak Human Conditioning
Peak Human Conditioning.description:
The athlete's body operates at the absolute ceiling of mortal physical capability: strength, speed, endurance, and resilience all pushed to the limit a human frame can bear. For the duration, the athlete performs feats at the outer edge of possibility and shrugs off fatigue and strain that would fell others. Operating at this peak burns the body's reserves to the bone, and when it ends, the athlete collapses into deep exhaustion.
[athletics: 100]

Silent Passage.name: Silent Passage
Silent Passage.description:
The rogue moves in perfect silence, footfalls, breath, and gear all soundless, slipping past guards and sleeping foes undetected. Greatly enhances stealth against hearing-based detection. Sharp-eyed watchers in good light, tremor-sense, and magical detection can still perceive the rogue; the passage masks sound alone, not sight or scent.
[Stealth: 89]

Ghost.name: Ghost
Ghost.description:
The apex of stealth. The rogue erases their presence so utterly (sound, shadow, scent, heat, even the subtle sense of being watched) that they become effectively undetectable by mundane means for a span, passing through the most heavily guarded places as though they were never there. Only powerful magical detection or a specific ward can catch a true ghost. Maintaining such total erasure is deeply taxing and shatters the instant the rogue commits an overt, hostile act.
[Stealth: 100]

Wilderness Mastery.name: Wilderness Mastery
Wilderness Mastery.description:
The survivor thrives in any hostile environment, finding food, water, shelter, and safe paths where others would perish. Reduces the dangers of travel through wilds, wastes, and extremes, and reveals resources and hazards a novice would miss. The mastery is knowledge and instinct, not magic; truly supernatural environments may present dangers that mundane survival skill cannot fully answer.
[survival: 85]

Apex Predator.name: Apex Predator
Apex Predator.description:
The survivor reads the wild with a hunter's total awareness: tracking prey and foes across any terrain, sensing ambushes before they spring, and turning the environment itself into a weapon and ally. Grants strong bonuses to tracking, ambush avoidance, and environmental combat in natural settings. The edge is dulled in wholly artificial or arcane environments where the wild's rules no longer apply.
[survival: 93]

One With the Wild.name: One With the Wild
One With the Wild.description:
The survivor achieves a near-mystical unity with the natural world, moving through any wilderness as though it were home, sensing every living thing within a wide radius, and drawing on the land's own resilience to endure hardship that would kill anyone else. For the duration, the wild shelters and warns the survivor, hiding them from foes and revealing every path and peril. The communion falters utterly in dead, blighted, or purely constructed places.
[survival: 100]

Captivating Performance.name: Captivating Performance
Captivating Performance.description:
The performer commands the full attention of an audience, holding a crowd spellbound and swaying its mood toward the performer's intent: awe, mirth, sorrow, or fervor. Useful for distraction, holding a room still, and winning favor. Hostile, distracted, or performance-wary audiences resist, and the effect lasts only as long as the performance holds their attention.
[performance: 78]

Rousing Anthem.name: Rousing Anthem
Rousing Anthem.description:
The performer delivers a stirring piece that emboldens allies and turns a crowd's sentiment, granting resolve and courage to friends and swaying bystanders toward the performer's cause. The anthem can rally the wavering and shame the reluctant into action. Its power depends on the performer's artistry and the audience's ability to hear and understand it; a foreign or hostile crowd is harder to move.
[performance: 89]

Legend in the Making.name: Legend in the Making
Legend in the Making.description:
The performer delivers a performance so transcendent it becomes the stuff of story, moving an entire audience to their core, cementing the performer's fame, and shifting the emotional current of a whole gathering or town. Such a performance can turn public opinion, inspire a movement, or immortalize a moment in song and memory. It demands the performer's full artistry and heart, and cannot be conjured on demand; it arrives only when the performer gives everything.
[performance: 100]

Menacing Aura.name: Menacing Aura
Menacing Aura.description:
The character projects an aura of danger that unsettles those around them, making foes hesitant, cowing the weak-willed, and extracting compliance through implied threat. Effective against lesser opponents and in interrogation. The strong-willed, the fearless, and those who outmatch the character shrug it off, and overt aggression may provoke rather than cow a proud foe.
[intimidation: 70]

Killing Intent.name: Killing Intent
Killing Intent.description:
The character focuses their will into a palpable pressure of lethal intent that freezes lesser foes in place, staggers the resolve of stronger ones, and warns everyone present that the character is fully prepared to kill. Weaker enemies may be too paralyzed to act; stronger ones feel the weight but push through. The intent is a double-edged declaration; it can end a fight before it starts or guarantee one begins.
[intimidation: 85]

Overwhelming Presence.name: Overwhelming Presence
Overwhelming Presence.description:
The character radiates such overwhelming force of personality and threat that all but the mightiest are cowed into submission, hesitation, or flight without a blow struck. In a confrontation, lesser foes surrender or flee and even the strong are given pause. The presence bends a room to the character's will through sheer dominance. Those of comparable power or iron resolve stand against it, and turning such intensity on allies or innocents carries its own social cost.
[intimidation: 100]

Compelling Argument.name: Compelling Argument
Compelling Argument.description:
The character marshals reason, rhetoric, and timing into an argument difficult to refuse, swaying opinions, closing deals, and talking their way past obstacles. Effective against the reasonable and the undecided. The committed, the hostile, and those with a strong stake against the character resist, and an argument built on a lie can unravel if the listener catches the flaw.
[persuasion: 73]

Masterful Negotiation.name: Masterful Negotiation
Masterful Negotiation.description:
The character navigates a negotiation with such skill that they consistently secure favorable terms, find leverage others miss, and leave the other party feeling they got a fair deal. Applies to bargains, treaties, disputes, and any contest of interests. The negotiation cannot conjure agreement where interests are truly irreconcilable, but it extracts the best possible outcome from any workable situation.
[persuasion: 86]

Silver-Tongued Legend.name: Silver-Tongued Legend
Silver-Tongued Legend.description:
The character's command of persuasion reaches near-mythical heights, able to talk enemies into alliance, defuse wars with words, and convince the immovable to reconsider. In a decisive exchange, the character can shift the course of events through speech alone, finding the exact words that move a heart or change a mind. Even this cannot override survival instinct or absolute conviction, and a persuasion later revealed as manipulation breeds lasting enmity.
[persuasion: 100]

Potent Brewing.name: Potent Brewing
Potent Brewing.description:
The alchemist refines their craft to produce potions of superior strength and purity, their effects stronger and longer-lasting than standard work, with fewer wasted materials. Applies to healing draughts, empowering potions, and utility elixirs alike. The improvement requires quality ingredients and a proper workspace; field brewing yields lesser results even in a master's hands.
[Alchemy: 80]

Grand Transmutation.name: Grand Transmutation
Grand Transmutation.description:
The alchemist transforms one substance into another, converting base materials into more valuable ones, neutralizing poisons and hazards, and creating compounds not found in nature. The transmutation follows alchemical principles and has limits; it cannot create something from nothing or produce truly legendary materials from common stock, but it turns the ordinary into the useful with remarkable versatility.
[Alchemy: 90]

Grand Elixir.name: Grand Elixir
Grand Elixir.description:
The pinnacle of alchemy. The alchemist brews a legendary elixir of extraordinary potency: a panacea that cures any affliction, a draught that grants a lasting surge of power, or a philosopher's remedy that mends what should be beyond mending. Each grand elixir requires the rarest ingredients and flawless technique, yields but a single dose, and cannot be rushed; producing one is the achievement of a season, not an afternoon.
[Alchemy: 100]

Potent Enchantment.name: Potent Enchantment
Potent Enchantment.description:
The enchanter imbues items with stronger, more stable enchantments than standard work, their effects more powerful and less prone to fading or failure. Applies to weapons, armor, and utility items. The enchantment's strength is bounded by the quality of the item and the materials used; a masterful enchantment on a poor vessel still cracks under strain.
[Enchanting: 78]

Layered Enchantment.name: Layered Enchantment
Layered Enchantment.description:
The enchanter layers multiple enchantments into a single item without them interfering, creating gear with combined properties that lesser enchanters cannot stack. A weapon that burns and drains, armor that wards and mends. The weaving demands deep skill and a vessel capable of holding the load; overloading a weak item causes the enchantments to unravel or the item to shatter.
[Enchanting: 89]

Artifact Creation.name: Artifact Creation
Artifact Creation.description:
The apex of the enchanter's art. The enchanter creates a true artifact: an item bearing enchantments of legendary power and stability, capable of feats that ordinary enchanted gear cannot approach and enduring for ages. An artifact may grow with its wielder, house a bound power, or manifest abilities shaped by its purpose. Creating one requires the finest vessel, the rarest reagents, and often a fragment of the enchanter's own spirit; it is the work of months and the crown of a career.
[Enchanting: 100]

Automaton Construction.name: Automaton Construction
Automaton Construction.description:
The artificer builds a functional mechanical construct, a servant, a guardian, or a laborer, that follows instructions and operates independently for a time. The automaton's capability scales with the artificer's skill and the quality of components. Building one takes time and materials, and the construct requires maintenance and a power source; neglected or damaged, it grinds to a halt.
[Artifice: 88]

Masterwork Mechanism.name: Masterwork Mechanism
Masterwork Mechanism.description:
The pinnacle of artifice. The artificer creates a mechanical marvel of legendary complexity: an autonomous guardian rivaling a living warrior, a device that reshapes a battlefield, or a mechanism that performs feats thought to require magic. The masterwork operates with uncanny sophistication and endures where lesser machines fail. Constructing one demands the rarest components, flawless craftsmanship, and months of labor; it is the defining work of a master artificer.
[Artifice: 100]

Runic Array.name: Runic Array
Runic Array.description:
The carver inscribes a coordinated array of runes that work together to produce an effect greater than any single rune: a warded threshold, a trap, a sustained barrier, or an empowering circle. The array holds as long as its runes remain intact. Carving it requires time, a suitable surface, and precision; a single flawed rune weakens or corrupts the whole array's function.
[Rune Carving: 81]

Grand Seal.name: Grand Seal
Grand Seal.description:
The master carver inscribes a seal of legendary power capable of binding a great force, warding an entire stronghold, or containing something that must never be released. A grand seal endures for ages and resists all but the most determined effort to break it. Carving one demands perfect mastery, rare materials, and often days of unbroken work; a flaw in a grand seal can be catastrophic, so only a true master should attempt it.
[Rune Carving: 100]

Master Cartographer.name: Master Cartographer
Master Cartographer.description:
The surveyor reads and maps the structure of a dungeon or ruin with uncanny accuracy, revealing its full layout, hidden passages, likely trap and treasure locations, and safe routes through. Greatly reduces the danger and wasted effort of delving. The survey covers physical structure; shifting, illusory, or magically reconfiguring dungeons defy even a master's mapping until their tricks are understood.
[Dungeon Surveying: 50]

Labyrinth Master.name: Labyrinth Master
Labyrinth Master.description:
The pinnacle of the delver's craft. The surveyor perceives the deep logic of even the most complex or malevolent dungeon: reading its shifting architecture, anticipating its defenses, locating its heart and its treasures, and finding the path through where others are lost forever. For the greatest labyrinths, this understanding is the difference between conquest and vanishing. Even this mastery must adapt to dungeons that actively rewrite themselves, learning their rules before it can master them.
[Dungeon Surveying: 100]

Forbidden Knowledge.name: Forbidden Knowledge
Forbidden Knowledge.description:
The scholar draws upon deep occult learning to identify supernatural threats, understand dark rituals, recognize the signs of curses and possession, and know the weaknesses of eldritch and demonic beings. This knowledge is invaluable against enemies that mundane learning cannot explain. Some knowledge carries a price; delving too deep into certain lore leaves a mark that dark things can sense.
[Occult Lore: 86]

Keeper of Secrets.name: Keeper of Secrets
Keeper of Secrets.description:
The scholar becomes a master of the world's hidden and forbidden lore, understanding the deep workings of magic, the true nature of eldritch powers, the histories that others have buried, and the rituals that shape fate itself. This knowledge grants insight and leverage against the greatest supernatural threats and mysteries. But such understanding sits heavily on the mind, and the deepest secrets are guarded by things that resent being known; a keeper of secrets is never entirely safe from what they have learned.
[Occult Lore: 100]

Master Herbalist.name: Master Herbalist
Master Herbalist.description:
The herbalist identifies, cultivates, and prepares plants with expert skill, drawing out their full medicinal and magical potential and recognizing rare specimens others overlook. Preparations made with this skill are more potent and reliable, and the herbalist can safely handle plants that would poison a novice. The mastery is grounded in the natural; truly magical flora may require additional lore to handle safely.
[Herbalism: 70]

Green Sage.name: Green Sage
Green Sage.description:
The pinnacle of herbal lore. The herbalist possesses near-legendary command of the plant world: coaxing miraculous remedies from humble herbs, cultivating specimens thought impossible to grow, and understanding the deep properties of even the rarest and most magical flora. A green sage's preparations can achieve what ordinary medicine and alchemy cannot. Such mastery is the work of a lifetime, and the rarest ingredients still demand patience and reverence that no skill can shortcut.
[Herbalism: 100]

Steady Breath.name: Steady Breath
Steady Breath.description:
Settle the breath and let circulation even out. Pain dulls, tremors stop, and the body remembers it has been through worse.
[Qi Cultivation: 2]

Iron Body Sheath.name: Iron Body Sheath
Iron Body Sheath.description:
Harden the surface of the body against a coming blow. Blades bite shallow and blunt force spreads instead of breaking.
[Qi Cultivation: 5]

Meridian Opening.name: Meridian Opening
Meridian Opening.description:
Force a closed channel open. Circulation improves permanently, and the body carries more force than it did yesterday.
[Qi Cultivation: 14]

Circulating Recovery.name: Circulating Recovery
Circulating Recovery.description:
Move qi through a wound mid-fight, closing what can be closed and numbing what cannot.
[Qi Cultivation: 27]

Golden Bell Ward.name: Golden Bell Ward
Golden Bell Ward.description:
Ring the body like a struck bell. For a few breaths, incoming force scatters instead of landing.
[Qi Cultivation: 41]

Tempering Breakthrough.name: Tempering Breakthrough
Tempering Breakthrough.description:
Break through a plateau under pressure. The body reforges itself around the strain and comes back denser.
[Qi Cultivation: 59]

Immovable Foundation.name: Immovable Foundation
Immovable Foundation.description:
Root so completely that force simply refuses to move you. Charges break, spells wash past, and the ground cracks first.
[Qi Cultivation: 78]

Body of the Unmarked.name: Body of the Unmarked
Body of the Unmarked.description:
The final tempering. The body has been refined past the point where the world can leave a mark on it.
[Qi Cultivation: 100]

Shake It Off.name: Shake It Off
Shake It Off.description:
Absorb a hit and keep the rhythm. The wound is real; the interruption is not.
[Endurance Combat: 2]

Deliberate Trade.name: Deliberate Trade
Deliberate Trade.description:
Accept a strike on purpose to land a better one. Pain now, opening now, advantage after.
[Endurance Combat: 5]

Second Breath.name: Second Breath
Second Breath.description:
Find air where there was none. Fatigue resets and the fight starts over from your side.
[Endurance Combat: 14]

Fight Through It.name: Fight Through It
Fight Through It.description:
Injury stops mattering for a while. The body will send the bill later.
[Endurance Combat: 27]

Attrition Read.name: Attrition Read
Attrition Read.description:
Read an opponent's stamina and pace the fight to break it. Let them spend; you have more.
[Endurance Combat: 41]

Refuse to Fall.name: Refuse to Fall
Refuse to Fall.description:
A blow that should end the fight does not. You are still upright, and everyone saw it.
[Endurance Combat: 59]

Last One Standing.name: Last One Standing
Last One Standing.description:
The longer a fight runs, the stronger you get. Every exchange survived feeds the next one.
[Endurance Combat: 78]

The One Who Endured.name: The One Who Endured
The One Who Endured.description:
Whatever the world brought, it was not enough. You are still here, and that is the whole technique.
[Endurance Combat: 100]

Break the Grab.name: Break the Grab
Break the Grab.description:
Slip a hold before it closes. Wrists turn, weight shifts, and the grip finds nothing.
[Grappling: 2]

Clinch Control.name: Clinch Control
Clinch Control.description:
Close distance and take the collar and elbow. From here, the fight goes where you decide.
[Grappling: 5]

Hip Throw.name: Hip Throw
Hip Throw.description:
Load an opponent across the hip and put them on the ground hard enough to end their turn.
[Grappling: 14]

Joint Lock.name: Joint Lock
Joint Lock.description:
Isolate a limb and apply pressure the joint was not built for. Submit, or the arm does.
[Grappling: 27]

Ground Command.name: Ground Command
Ground Command.description:
Take top position and keep it. Every escape attempt costs them more than it costs you.
[Grappling: 41]

Suplex the Impossible.name: Suplex the Impossible
Suplex the Impossible.description:
Lift something that has no business being lifted and put it down somewhere worse.
[Grappling: 59]

Inescapable Hold.name: Inescapable Hold
Inescapable Hold.description:
A lock nothing has broken. Size stops mattering; leverage is leverage.
[Grappling: 78]

Nothing Gets Away.name: Nothing Gets Away
Nothing Gets Away.description:
The final grappling art. What you have decided to hold does not leave, no matter what it is.
[Grappling: 100]

Siege Arc.name: Siege Arc
Siege Arc.description:
The greatsword described as a weather event: a full-body rotation that carries every ounce of the wielder and the weapon through an arc wide enough to catch a formation. Nobody in the swing's path keeps their footing, and the wielder needs a full breath afterward to remember which way they were facing.
[Heavy Weapons: 25]

The Weight of the Answer.name: The Weight of the Answer
The Weight of the Answer.description:
No technique remains, only mass and intention. The heavy weapon comes down with the accumulated authority of every blow the wielder has ever landed, and the ground beneath the target stops being a reliable surface. Armor is a suggestion. Stances are a memory.
[Heavy Weapons: 53]

Mountainfall.name: Mountainfall
Mountainfall.description:
The final art of the great weapon. The wielder swings once, and whatever the blow lands on is reclassified from obstacle to terrain feature. Nothing about it is elegant. Nothing about it needs to be.
[Heavy Weapons: 100]

Unbroken Concentration.name: Unbroken Concentration
Unbroken Concentration.description:
The technique does not slip. Whatever is being held together, whether a spell mid-cast, a barrier under load, or a promise made through gritted teeth, stays held. Pain becomes information rather than interruption, and the world's attempts at distraction arrive as noise against glass.
[Focus: 63]

The Still Point.name: The Still Point
The Still Point.description:
The final discipline of the mind. In the eye of any storm the practitioner chooses, there is one place where nothing moves, nothing lands, and nothing changes until they decide otherwise. Chaos continues everywhere else. It simply does not apply here.
[Focus: 100]

Bonded Instinct.name: Bonded Instinct
Bonded Instinct.description:
The companion stops waiting for commands. Handler and beast share a single read of the battlefield, moving as one animal with two bodies, and the gap between intention and action closes to nothing. Outsiders describe watching it as slightly unnerving.
[Beast Keeping: 25]

Sovereign of Beasts.name: Sovereign of Beasts
Sovereign of Beasts.description:
The final art of the keeper. Every creature within sight recognizes an authority older than training and newer than fear, and chooses, of its own will, to stand on this side of the fight. The wild does not obey. It agrees.
[Beast Keeping: 100]

Field Fabrication.name: Field Fabrication
Field Fabrication.description:
The engineer builds the answer on site from whatever the battlefield left lying around: a brace, a lever, a pressure valve, a thing with a name nobody has invented yet. It works exactly as long as it needs to and usually no longer.
[Engineering: 63]

The Machine That Ends Arguments.name: The Machine That Ends Arguments
The Machine That Ends Arguments.description:
The engineer's final work. A construct assembled from principles that should not cooperate, deployed once, and remembered for a generation by everyone who saw what it did to the problem it was pointed at.
[Engineering: 100]

Living Script.name: Living Script
Living Script.description:
The inscription stops being a record and becomes a participant. Runes shift on the page to match the situation, wards rewrite their own conditions mid-defense, and a contract sealed this way argues its own case.
[Inscription: 70]

The Grand Seal.name: The Grand Seal
The Grand Seal.description:
The highest expression of the written art. A working carved once, correctly, that binds what should never be released and holds for as long as the stone holds. The world has several. Their locations are famous. Their carvers are not.
[Inscription: 100]

The Perfect Lie.name: The Perfect Lie
The Perfect Lie.description:
The final art of deception. Not a story told well but a truth constructed from nothing, internally consistent, independently verifiable, and load-bearing enough that the deceiver occasionally forgets it was never real.
[Deception: 100]

Seam Reading.name: Seam Reading
Seam Reading.description:
The rift mage stops guessing where space is thin and starts reading it: distortion patterns resolve into a map of stress lines, weak points, and the exact spot where a wall stops being load-bearing reality. Useful for finding a way through, and considerably more useful for finding the way out. Reading a seam takes a held breath of concentration, which is a long time in a collapsing room.
[Rift Magic: 53]

The Door That Was Not There.name: The Door That Was Not There
The Door That Was Not There.description:
The final rift art. A threshold opened where the world never built one, held exactly as long as the mage can stand the strain, leading exactly where they intended and not one step further. Every rift scholar who has seen it performed describes the same detail: the silence on the other side arrives before the door does.
[Rift Magic: 100]

Compounding Dose.name: Compounding Dose
Compounding Dose.description:
The toxin is built to be patient. Each application layers onto the last rather than replacing it, so a target who shrugged off the first dose finds the third arriving on ground the first two already prepared. Works on anything with a circulatory system and disappoints considerably against anything without one.
[Poison Magic: 40]

The Last Cup.name: The Last Cup
The Last Cup.description:
The venom-master's final work: a toxin refined past the point where antidotes have anything to grip. It is slow, it is certain, and it gives the target enough time to understand both of those facts. The Church lists it among the arts it does not discuss, which is how everyone learned it has a name.
[Poison Magic: 100]

Reach Discipline.name: Reach Discipline
Reach Discipline.description:
The polearm's whole argument, made properly: the wielder holds a circle nobody crosses without paying for it, stepping back exactly as fast as the enemy steps in, and turning the fight into a geometry problem the enemy keeps losing. Devastating in open ground. Considerably less clever in a corridor.
[Polearm Combat: 25]

The Line Nobody Crosses.name: The Line Nobody Crosses
The Line Nobody Crosses.description:
The final art of the spear. The wielder plants once and the ground behind them stops being available to the enemy, no matter how many arrive or how badly they want it. Sieges have been decided by one person deciding where a line was.
[Polearm Combat: 100]

Breaking Point.name: Breaking Point
Breaking Point.description: The moment Limit Break ignites, the first strike carries every ounce of the surge: one blow thrown past the body's honest ceiling that lands like a siege engine. Witnesses remember the sound.

Overclocked Finisher.name: Overclocked Finisher
Overclocked Finisher.description: In the last breath of a Limit Break, everything left goes into one finishing technique that ends the fight or ends the surge trying.

Divine Nudge.name: Divine Nudge
Divine Nudge.description: A warm, invisible hand on the shoulder: the goddess points the bearer at the one detail worth noticing in a scene, the exit, the tell, the loose stone. It shows only what the bearer could have seen, a little sooner.

Favored Child.name: Favored Child
Favored Child.description: For one action the goddess is watching and very pleased: everything the bearer tries goes just slightly better than it should, and they can feel her cheering.

Single Pull Prayer.name: Single Pull Prayer
Single Pull Prayer.description: A quick prayer to the god of capsules before a gamble, a search or a game of chance: luck tilts toward the bearer for one roll.

Pity Breaker.name: Pity Breaker
Pity Breaker.description: After a long run of bad luck the bearer cashes in the gacha god's guilt: one action where fortune pays back everything it owes, all at once.

Cornered Fang.name: Cornered Fang
Cornered Fang.description: A counterattack thrown from the floor, the wall or a pinned position: the worse the footing, the cleaner the strike.

Last Light Finisher.name: Last Light Finisher
Last Light Finisher.description: With almost nothing left, the bearer puts all of it into one blow. Thrown from Last Light, it is the hardest thing they will ever throw.

Predator's Devour.name: Predator's Devour
Predator's Devour.description: Bite, tear or drain a defeated or helpless monster for a mouthful of its power: a rush of stolen vitality and a taste of what it was.

Apex Instinct.name: Apex Instinct
Apex Instinct.description: The predator in the blood reads another predator: the bearer senses a monster's hunger, fear and next lunge a heartbeat before it comes.

Express Delivery.name: Express Delivery
Express Delivery.description: Next-instant shipping: the box lands exactly where the bearer needs it, mid-fight, mid-negotiation or mid-fall, already open. The item still has to be bought.

Mayonnaise Diplomacy.name: Mayonnaise Diplomacy
Mayonnaise Diplomacy.description: Share a taste of home with someone important: old-world food opens doors, softens hard bargains, and makes friends of people who were rivals a meal ago.

I Know This Scene.name: I Know This Scene
I Know This Scene.description: The bearer remembers how this moment went last time and steps around the mistake: the coming ambush, the wrong word, the trap in the floor.

Speedrun Route.name: Speedrun Route
Speedrun Route.description: A remembered shortcut through a place, a fight or a conversation: the bearer skips the part that went badly last playthrough.

Wyrmfire Breath.name: Wyrmfire Breath
Wyrmfire Breath.description: A dragon's first and oldest answer: a cone of breath in the element of your blood that scours whatever stands in front of you. It empties the lungs and the furnace both, so it cannot be spammed, and everything nearby that can burn has an opinion about it.

Skyshaking Roar.name: Skyshaking Roar
Skyshaking Roar.description: The roar that predates language. Lesser creatures break and run, trained soldiers lose a step, and anything with dragon in its blood answers. It announces you to everything within a mile, which is the point and the problem.

Stooping Dive.name: Stooping Dive
Stooping Dive.description: Fold the wings and fall on a target from above: the fastest thing in the fight for one terrible second. It needs height and open air, and it commits you completely.

Barbed Tail Lash.name: Barbed Tail Lash
Barbed Tail Lash.description: The tail strike nobody is watching for: a whip-crack blow with a barb on the end that can pin, trip, or simply ruin someone's footing.

Undertow Coil.name: Undertow Coil
Undertow Coil.description: Wrap a target and drag: in water it is nearly unbreakable, on land it is merely very bad. Whatever is caught has to deal with you before anything else.

Riptide Rush.name: Riptide Rush
Riptide Rush.description: A surge of pressure-driven speed that crosses water faster than a ship and land faster than anyone expects from something without legs.

Many-Headed Assault.name: Many-Headed Assault
Many-Headed Assault.description: Every head strikes at once from a different angle. One target cannot watch them all, and a crowd cannot find a safe side.

Regrowing Fury.name: Regrowing Fury
Regrowing Fury.description: Take a terrible wound on purpose and come back with more of you than before: the answer to anyone who thought cutting was a plan.

Cloudstride.name: Cloudstride
Cloudstride.description: Run up the air itself: a burst of flight that ignores walls, moats and the usual rules about where you can stand.

Rainbringer's Breath.name: Rainbringer's Breath
Rainbringer's Breath.description: Call weather in a breath: a squall, a mist, a cooling rain. Small at first, and exactly as useful as the person choosing where it falls.

Glamour Dust.name: Glamour Dust
Glamour Dust.description: A shake of the wings and the air fills with shimmering dust that dazzles, distracts and makes one small lie look perfectly true for a moment.

Mirror Flight.name: Mirror Flight
Mirror Flight.description: Leave an image of yourself where you were and be somewhere else: three of you in the air, and only one that can be hit.

Ember Wings.name: Ember Wings
Ember Wings.description: Spread burning wings and sweep: a wave of flame that scorches foes and warms friends, cauterizing small wounds on the way past.

Rekindle.name: Rekindle
Rekindle.description: Pour your own fire into someone who is fading and bring them back from the edge. It costs you heat you will feel for a while.

Throat of Winter.name: Throat of Winter
Throat of Winter.description: A lunge for the kill-spot with jaws that close like a gate. If it lands, the fight has a new shape.

Howl of the Long Night.name: Howl of the Long Night
Howl of the Long Night.description: A howl that carries for miles: allies stand straighter, prey forgets how to run, and every wolf in hearing answers.

Talon Strike.name: Talon Strike
Talon Strike.description: A raking blow from above with eagle talons and a lion's weight behind it. It hits hardest on the first pass.

Eagle Eye.name: Eagle Eye
Eagle Eye.description: See what distance and darkness hide: a face in a far window, a tripwire, the one soldier out of place in a line.

Step Without Harm.name: Step Without Harm
Step Without Harm.description: Cross water, flowers or a battlefield without breaking the surface, and without anything on it being able to hold you.

Horn of Judgment.name: Horn of Judgment
Horn of Judgment.description: Lower the horn at someone and the truth of them shows: guilt, intent, the lie they are standing on. What you do about it is up to you.

Foxfire.name: Foxfire
Foxfire.description: Call blue-white flames that dance where you point: a light, a lure, or a burn, and never quite where the eye expects.

Borrowed Shape.name: Borrowed Shape
Borrowed Shape.description: Wear an illusion so complete it has a shadow: another creature, another person, a lantern on a wall. It holds until you are struck or laugh.

Thunderclap Wings.name: Thunderclap Wings
Thunderclap Wings.description: A single wingbeat that lands like a cannon shot: it flattens the unready and deafens everyone else.

Skyfire.name: Skyfire
Skyfire.description: Call a bolt down the line of your gaze. It goes where you look, so look carefully.

Three-Fold Bite.name: Three-Fold Bite
Three-Fold Bite.description: Three jaws, three targets, or one very unlucky one. Whatever is bitten is also held.

Gatekeeper's Stand.name: Gatekeeper's Stand
Gatekeeper's Stand.description: Plant yourself in a doorway, a bridge or a breach and it is closed. Things that try to pass learn why.

Earthshaker Stomp.name: Earthshaker Stomp
Earthshaker Stomp.description: Bring a foot down and the ground answers: everyone nearby loses their footing, and anything fragile loses more.

Landslide Charge.name: Landslide Charge
Landslide Charge.description: Lower the horns and go. Walls, lines and bad ideas give way, and stopping is the hard part.

Engulf.name: Engulf
Engulf.description: Flow over a target and hold it inside yourself: it cannot swing, cast or breathe well, and you can feel every move it makes.

Dissolve.name: Dissolve
Dissolve.description: Turn acidic for a moment and eat through a rope, a lock, a blade edge or a grip on you.

Dirty Trick.name: Dirty Trick
Dirty Trick.description: Sand in the eyes, a kicked stool, a cut purse string: one cheap move that turns a fair fight into yours.

Warren Ambush.name: Warren Ambush
