Warren Ambush.description: Set a trap or a hiding place in moments and spring it at the right time. Bigger enemies rarely look down.

Quick Trap.name: Quick Trap
Quick Trap.description: Rig a snare, a deadfall or a noisemaker from whatever is lying around, in the time it takes someone to round a corner.

Tunnel Sense.name: Tunnel Sense
Tunnel Sense.description: Read stone like a page: where it is thin, where it is hollow, where it will come down, and where the way out is.

Silk Snare.name: Silk Snare
Silk Snare.description: Throw a line or a net of silk stronger than rope: it binds, trips, hauls, or holds a door shut.

Venom Bite.name: Venom Bite
Venom Bite.description: A bite that keeps working after you have let go: weakness, numbness, or sleep, depending on what you intended.

Flawless Imitation.name: Flawless Imitation
Flawless Imitation.description: Become a chest, a door, a barrel, a statue: indistinguishable until you move. Good for waiting, hiding, and being carried past guards.

Snapping Lid.name: Snapping Lid
Snapping Lid.description: The lid comes down like a bear trap and stays down. Whatever is inside is not getting out without help.

Bone Rattle.name: Bone Rattle
Bone Rattle.description: A clatter of loose bones that unnerves the living and scatters lesser undead. It is hard to keep a formation when your teeth are on edge.

Fearless March.name: Fearless March
Fearless March.description: Walk into arrows, fire or bad odds without flinching. There is nothing left in you that knows how.

Gore.name: Gore
Gore.description: Lower the horns and drive: a blow that lifts a grown fighter off the ground and puts them somewhere else.

Labyrinth Sense.name: Labyrinth Sense
Labyrinth Sense.description: Never lost. Feel the shape of a building, a dungeon or a street plan, and where the thing you are hunting has gone in it.

Boulder Throw.name: Boulder Throw
Boulder Throw.description: Pick up something that should not be thrown and throw it. Range, accuracy and what counts as a boulder all improve with practice.

Thick Hide.name: Thick Hide
Thick Hide.description: Take a blow on purpose and barely feel it, then answer while your attacker is still surprised.

Stone Sleep.name: Stone Sleep
Stone Sleep.description: Become a statue: unmoving, nearly unbreakable, and easy to overlook. Wounds close slowly while you hold it.

Rooftop Pounce.name: Rooftop Pounce
Rooftop Pounce.description: Drop from above with the full weight of masonry. It is very difficult to be ready for architecture.

Spirit Flame Tails.name: Spirit Flame Tails
Spirit Flame Tails.description: Flick both tails and pale flames leap where you point: light, lure, or a burn that clings to the guilty.

Nine Shadows Step.name: Nine Shadows Step
Nine Shadows Step.description: Slip through a shadow and out of another close by. It looks like a cat simply deciding to be elsewhere.

Wind-Cutter.name: Wind-Cutter
Wind-Cutter.description: A sword stroke that keeps going after the blade stops: a blade of wind that cuts at range.

Feather Step.name: Feather Step
Feather Step.description: Kick off the air once, mid-leap. Enough to change direction, clear a wall, or be behind someone.

River Throw.name: River Throw
River Throw.description: A wrestler's throw with a river's weight behind it. Size matters much less than people expect.

Bone-Setter's Touch.name: Bone-Setter's Touch
Bone-Setter's Touch.description: Set a break, ease a sprain, pop a joint back: old kappa medicine that works faster than it has any right to.

Golden Thread.name: Golden Thread
Golden Thread.description: A single strand, nearly invisible, that binds a wrist, a weapon, or a promise. Cutting it takes more than a knife.

Lure Song.name: Lure Song
Lure Song.description: Pluck your silk and the sound draws listeners closer, calmer and less careful than they meant to be.

Black Cloud.name: Black Cloud
Black Cloud.description: Wrap yourself and the ground around you in rolling dark cloud: no one sees in, and you see out fine.

Night Cry.name: Night Cry
Night Cry.description: A thin birdlike cry that turns stomachs and sours courage. Those who hear it sleep badly for days.

Elemental Surge.name: Elemental Surge
Elemental Surge.description: Become more of what you are for a moment: a gout of flame, a crashing wave, a cutting gale, a wall of stone. Whatever your element does, it does it hard.

Unbound Form.name: Unbound Form
Unbound Form.description: Let go of your shape and pour through a crack, under a door, along a wire or across a gap, then gather again.

Rootgrasp.name: Rootgrasp
Rootgrasp.description: Roots burst from the ground where you point and hold whatever they catch: ankles, wheels, a charging horse.

Sap Mend.name: Sap Mend
Sap Mend.description: Press golden sap into a wound and it seals. It smells of spring and stings like antiseptic.

Guiding Light.name: Guiding Light
Guiding Light.description: Burn bright and steady: darkness, fog and illusions thin around you, and those who follow you do not get lost.

Ghost Flicker.name: Ghost Flicker
Ghost Flicker.description: Wink out and reappear a short way off. Nothing can hold a light.

Stone Fist.name: Stone Fist
Stone Fist.description: A blow with the weight of a wall behind it. It does not need to be fast.

Hold the Line.name: Hold the Line
Hold the Line.description: Stand in one place and be immovable: nothing gets past, nothing pushes you back, and allies behind you are covered.

Hollow Guard.name: Hollow Guard
Hollow Guard.description: A blade that should have found flesh finds empty steel instead. Some blows simply have nothing to hurt.

Oathbound Strike.name: Oathbound Strike
Oathbound Strike.description: Call on the oath still stamped into your plate and strike with a dead knight's certainty.

Unstrung Grace.name: Unstrung Grace
Unstrung Grace.description: Move in ways joints should not allow: bend backward under a blade, turn your head all the way round, fold through a gap.

Borrowed Strings.name: Borrowed Strings
Borrowed Strings.description: Loop a thread of will around someone's wrist or weapon for a moment and tug. One motion of theirs becomes yours.

Remembered Hands.name: Remembered Hands
Remembered Hands.description: Recall the skill of someone who once held you and lend it to yourself or whoever carries you, for one task.

Purpose Fulfilled.name: Purpose Fulfilled
Purpose Fulfilled.description: Do the thing you were made for, perfectly, once: the cut, the light, the shelter, the note. Objects that do this glow for a moment.

Overwind.name: Overwind
Overwind.description: Let the mainspring run past its mark: a burst of speed and force that no muscle could match, paid for in heat.

Precision Mechanism.name: Precision Mechanism
Precision Mechanism.description: Do one fine thing perfectly: pick the lock, thread the needle, catch the arrow, measure the distance.

Ward Glyph.name: Ward Glyph
Ward Glyph.description: Flash a rune into the air and it holds as a barrier for a moment: against a blade, a spell, or a falling ceiling.

Rune Lance.name: Rune Lance
Rune Lance.description: Line the stones up and loose the core's light down them in a single bright bolt.

Built For This.name: Built For This
Built For This.description: Use the thing your body was made to do, flawlessly, once. Name it when you describe yourself, and the world will remember.

Self-Maintenance.name: Self-Maintenance
Self-Maintenance.description: Tighten, patch, re-seat and re-ink yourself: field repairs that close damage a healer could not treat.

Unnoticed.name: Unnoticed
Unnoticed.description: Be a cat: walk through a guarded room, sit on a table during a secret meeting, and be shooed out at worst.

Sharp Tongue.name: Sharp Tongue
Sharp Tongue.description: One perfectly aimed remark that rattles, distracts, or persuades. Nobody expects to be read that well by a cat.

Fox Lantern.name: Fox Lantern
Fox Lantern.description: A small foxfire that shows true paths and hidden things, and cannot be seen by those you do not want to see it.

Messenger's Dash.name: Messenger's Dash
Messenger's Dash.description: Run a message, a key or a warning to someone faster than any horse, by roads that are not on maps.

Bird's-Eye Recall.name: Bird's-Eye Recall
Bird's-Eye Recall.description: Remember a place exactly as you saw it from above: every guard, every gap, every face in the crowd.

Ill Omen.name: Ill Omen
Ill Omen.description: Land where someone can see you and say one true, unwelcome thing. Courage and concentration both suffer.

Ruby Ward.name: Ruby Ward
Ruby Ward.description: The gem flares and a pane of red light turns aside one blow or one spell aimed at you or someone near you.

Jewel's Luck.name: Jewel's Luck
Jewel's Luck.description: Bless one roll of the dice, one leap, one desperate guess. Luck leans, visibly, for a moment.

Silent Wings.name: Silent Wings
Silent Wings.description: Fly without a sound and see perfectly in the dark. Whatever you are watching does not know it is being watched.

Recalled Passage.name: Recalled Passage
Recalled Passage.description: Remember the exact page: a spell's weakness, a creature's habit, a clause in an old treaty, just when it is needed.

Claw Swipe.name: Claw Swipe
Claw Swipe.description:
A fast raking strike with claw, talon or pincer. The honest opening move of anything born armed.
[Fang and Claw: 1]

Bite.name: Bite
Bite.description:
Close the jaws on whatever is nearest and make it regret being there. Fangs, beak or mandibles.
[Fang and Claw: 2]

Rend.name: Rend
Rend.description:
Hook in and pull. A wound opened by a claw is made worse by the same claw leaving.
[Fang and Claw: 6]

Lockjaw.name: Lockjaw
Lockjaw.description:
Bite down and do not let go. The target fights with you attached until it breaks your grip or you choose to release.
[Fang and Claw: 15]

Savage Flurry.name: Savage Flurry
Savage Flurry.description:
Claws, fangs and tail in one overlapping rush. Whatever is in front of you is struck from three directions by one animal.
[Fang and Claw: 30]

Throat Seeker.name: Throat Seeker
Throat Seeker.description:
One strike at the place every living thing guards. Against anything that bleeds, the fight changes when this lands.
[Fang and Claw: 50]

Apex Kill.name: Apex Kill
Apex Kill.description:
The finishing strike of something at the top of the food chain. Everything nearby that hunts for a living stops to watch.
[Fang and Claw: 75]

Tackle.name: Tackle
Tackle.description:
Throw your whole body into something. Unsubtle, open to every creature with weight, and it works.
[Charge and Crush: 1]

Charge.name: Charge
Charge.description:
Build speed over open ground and arrive all at once. The longer the run, the worse the landing for whoever is at the end of it.
[Charge and Crush: 2]

Trample.name: Trample
Trample.description:
Keep going. Whatever was standing in your path is now under it.
[Charge and Crush: 6]

Pin Down.name: Pin Down
Pin Down.description:
Drop your weight on a target and hold it there. It does nothing useful until it gets out from under you.
[Charge and Crush: 15]

Unstoppable Rush.name: Unstoppable Rush
Unstoppable Rush.description:
A charge that does not turn aside for shields, lines or furniture. Things in the way are moved or broken.
[Charge and Crush: 30]

Bonebreaker Slam.name: Bonebreaker Slam
Bonebreaker Slam.description:
Rear, drop, and bring everything you weigh down on one point. At this weight armor is a suggestion.
[Charge and Crush: 50]

Living Avalanche.name: Living Avalanche
Living Avalanche.description:
You stop being a creature and become terrain in motion. A battle line that meets this is not a line afterward.
[Charge and Crush: 75]

Wing Buffet.name: Wing Buffet
Wing Buffet.description:
A hard slap of wing or a burst of displaced air at close range. It staggers, blinds with dust, and buys room.
[Wing and Dive: 1]

Swoop.name: Swoop
Swoop.description:
Drop out of the air, strike once in passing, and be gone before the answer arrives.
[Wing and Dive: 2]

Downdraft.name: Downdraft
Downdraft.description:
Beat the air down onto a target. Loose things fly, footing goes, and small foes are flattened.
[Wing and Dive: 6]

Snatch.name: Snatch
Snatch.description:
Take something off the ground on the way past: a weapon, a satchel, or a foe light enough to carry.
[Wing and Dive: 15]

Death From Above.name: Death From Above
Death From Above.description:
A full dive from height with your whole weight behind the strike. What it hits is driven into the ground.
[Wing and Dive: 30]

Sky Dance.name: Sky Dance
Sky Dance.description:
Fight in three dimensions at speed: roll, stall, turn inside the attack and strike from where nothing was a moment ago.
[Wing and Dive: 50]

Hurricane Pass.name: Hurricane Pass
Hurricane Pass.description:
One pass so fast the air itself does the damage. Everything along the line is struck, thrown or deafened.
[Wing and Dive: 75]

Slam.name: Slam
Slam.description:
Hit something with yourself. Pseudopod, stone fist, armored shoulder or thrown lid: mass is mass.
[Uncanny Body: 1]

Harden.name: Harden
Harden.description:
Set your surface like stone, shell or cooled metal against the blows of this turn. Holding it is your action; it guards this turn only.
[Uncanny Body: 2]

Reshape.name: Reshape
Reshape.description:
Change your outline for a purpose: flatten under a door, stretch across a gap, grow a hook or an edge out of yourself.
[Uncanny Body: 6]

Swallow the Blow.name: Swallow the Blow
Swallow the Blow.description:
Let a strike sink into you and close around it. The weapon, limb or fang is caught until its owner pulls free.
[Uncanny Body: 15]

Come Apart.name: Come Apart
Come Apart.description:
Scatter on purpose: split, spill or unstring so the attack passes through the place you were.
[Uncanny Body: 30]

Past the Limit.name: Past the Limit
Past the Limit.description:
Do what a body with joints could not: strike from every angle at once, bend backwards, reach twice your length.
[Uncanny Body: 50]

Reassemble.name: Reassemble
Reassemble.description:
Pull every scattered piece back into one shape, ready to fight. Any hold, pin, web or binding on you ends as you re-form. It does not close wounds.
[Uncanny Body: 75]

Mind Speech.name: Mind Speech
Mind Speech.description:
Send words or an image straight into one willing mind within sight, and hear what they send back. No sound and no shared language needed. It carries speech, never commands.
[Psionics: 1]

Force Push.name: Force Push
Force Push.description:
Shove a person or an object away with a thought. It lands like a strong two-handed push.
[Psionics: 2]

Surface Read.name: Surface Read
Surface Read.description:
Catch what sits on top of a nearby mind: the feeling, the word about to be said, the thing they are trying not to think about. Deep memories and secrets stay shut, and a guarded mind feels the touch.
[Psionics: 6]

Kinetic Grip.name: Kinetic Grip
Kinetic Grip.description:
Take hold of something at a distance and move it as if by hand: lift a key, hold a door, drag a weapon from a grip, or pin one foe in place for as long as holding it stays your action.
[Psionics: 15]

Psychic Lance.name: Psychic Lance
Psychic Lance.description:
A spike of pure thought driven into one mind. Psychic damage that armor does not see.
[Psionics: 30]

Scatter Storm.name: Scatter Storm
Scatter Storm.description:
Everything loose in the room becomes a weapon at once. Blades, stones and furniture turn on your foes in a whirl you conduct.
[Psionics: 50]

Crushing Will.name: Crushing Will
Crushing Will.description:
Close your mind around a target like a fist. Things are held, bent or broken by thought alone, and a living foe must fight simply to move.
[Psionics: 75]

Wild Shape.name: Wild Shape
Wild Shape.description:
Become a beast you have seen with your own eyes: a hound, a wildcat, a hawk, a goat, a river otter, nothing bigger than a pony while your Nature Magic is under 35. It is honest flesh: you see, smell, run and bite as that beast does, you keep your own mind, and you speak only if its throat can shape words. What you wear and carry melds into the shape and comes back when you do; you cannot use it meanwhile. You can shift as part of a dash or a leap. In beast shape, moving, hiding, climbing and tracking the way that beast does are a step easier. The shape holds until you change back, sleep or fall to 0 health. Say that you wild shape, and say when you change back.
[Nature Magic: 1]

Thornbind.name: Thornbind
Thornbind.description:
Roots and thorn-vines burst from the floor around one foe and hold it fast. It is a hold, not an attack: a Hard check against any foe whatever its level, never a long shot. It wounds nothing; the bigger the foe, the sooner it tears free, and fire burns the hold away.
[Nature Magic: 1]

Beast Parts.name: Beast Parts
Beast Parts.description:
Let the wild into one part of your body for a scene: claws that climb and cut, a hound's nose, an owl's night eyes, gills, horns for a charge, or a cat's balance. One part at a time; it fades when the scene does or when you let it go.
[Nature Magic: 15]

Great Beast Shape.name: Great Beast Shape
Great Beast Shape.description:
Take the shape of a great beast: a bear, a stag, a dire wolf, a great cat, or an eagle broad enough to fly. The strength, speed or wings are real, and so is the size, which does not fit through every door. Your gear melds in as with any wild shape. Your mind, its body, until you change back, sleep or fall.
[Nature Magic: 35]

Swarm Shape.name: Swarm Shape
Swarm Shape.description:
Come apart into a swarm of bees, bats, moths or crows. Blades and arrows find little to hit, you pour through cracks and keyholes, and you can sting or blind. Fire, wind and smoke are ruinous to a swarm, and if it scatters too far you come back together hurt.
[Nature Magic: 50]

Primal Shape.name: Primal Shape
Primal Shape.description:
Take the shape of one of the wild's monsters: an owlbear, a dire boar, a giant constrictor, a roc-winged hawk. It is a monster's strength for about a scene, and it pulls at your mind: on a bad roll the beast's hunger leads for a turn.
[Nature Magic: 60]

Heart of the Wild.name: Heart of the Wild
Heart of the Wild.description:
Wear a shadow of a mythic beast you have faced or bonded with: a griffin's wings, a kirin's lightning step, a fenrir's jaws. It is an echo, not the real thing, and it lasts one fight. Mythic beasts know when someone wears their shape, and they remember it.
[Nature Magic: 80]

Captivating Glamour.name: Captivating Glamour
Captivating Glamour.description:
The enchantress lets her glamour off its leash for one breath: every foe who looks her way loses the thread of the fight (a swing arriving late, a spell's words forgotten halfway), and her allies strike through the opening she made, steadier and surer for it. Nobody remembers deciding to look. The glamour breaks the moment someone lands a blow on her.
[Charm Magic: 2]

Called Flank.name: Called Flank
Called Flank.description:
The commander reads the line a breath before it moves and calls the flank: one named ally's next attack lands where the foe is not guarding, and the opening stays open until that ally takes it. Orders this clean are rare enough that seasoned fighters obey before they think.
[Command: 15]

Steady the Ranks.name: Steady the Ranks
Steady the Ranks.description:
One order, said like a fact: the party holds. Allies within earshot shrug off fear, stagger and the urge to break, and every guard they raise this turn and the next comes up harder and faster. A breaking line becomes a wall that has decided to stay.
[Command: 35]

Battle Plan.name: Battle Plan
Battle Plan.description:
Laid out before the fight or snapped together mid-chaos: who goes where, who covers whom, and what happens when it goes wrong. For a few rounds every ally who follows the plan acts as if they rehearsed it, and the enemy keeps finding someone already waiting where it meant to strike.
[Command: 60]

Grand Stratagem.name: Grand Stratagem
Grand Stratagem.description:
The whole field becomes a board the commander reads in one look. For one decisive exchange every ally moves as a single plan, each order lands before the enemy finishes deciding, and a rout becomes a rally or a rally becomes a rout, whichever the commander chooses. The kind of plan armies still study a century later.
[Command: 100]

acrobatics.name: acrobatics
acrobatics.description:
Improves the player's agility and balance, enabling them to perform acrobatic maneuvers.

Covers: flips, balance, tumbling, falls, squeezing through gaps, escaping grabs. Not: raw running, lifting, and swimming power, which is athletics. Easy: vault a fence. Medium: run a rooftop line. Hard: fight on a tightrope. Very hard: land a three-story fall clean. Extremely hard: dance across falling debris.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

athletics.name: athletics
athletics.description:
Improves overall physical performance, enhancing running, jumping, climbing, and other physical feats.

Covers: running, jumping, climbing, swimming, lifting, grappling force. Not: tumbling, balance, and escaping grabs, which is acrobatics. Easy: climb a knotted rope. Medium: leap a wide gap. Hard: scale a sheer wall. Very hard: swim a storm current. Extremely hard: hold a portcullis open alone.

Primary Attribute: Strength

intimidation.name: intimidation
intimidation.description:
Allows the player to use fear as a tool, potentially allowing them to scare off enemies or influence confrontations.

Covers: threats, menacing presence, interrogation pressure, forcing retreats. Not: winning someone over by reason, which is persuasion. Easy: cow a drunk. Medium: silence a rowdy room. Hard: make a soldier stand down. Very hard: back down a noble in their own hall. Extremely hard: give a monster pause.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

investigation.name: investigation
investigation.description:
Enables careful examination and analysis of surroundings, helping the player uncover clues and secrets.

Covers: searching scenes, spotting clues, analyzing evidence, connecting facts. Not: reading a person’s feelings or intent, which is Insight. Easy: find the obvious clue. Medium: notice what's missing. Hard: reconstruct events from traces. Very hard: catch a professional's cover-up. Extremely hard: unravel a conspiracy from a single thread.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

performance.name: performance
performance.description:
Enables the player to entertain others through acts such as dancing, singing, or acting.

Covers: singing, dancing, acting, oratory, stagecraft, holding a crowd. Not: sound shaped by magic, which is Sound Magic. Easy: entertain a tavern. Medium: earn real applause. Hard: move an audience to tears. Very hard: command a royal court's attention. Extremely hard: a performance they retell for a generation.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

persuasion.name: persuasion
persuasion.description:
Enhances the player's ability to influence others through dialogue.

Covers: convincing, negotiating, appealing, diplomatic argument. Not: leverage through fear, which is intimidation, or correct protocol and face-saving, which is Etiquette. Easy: sway the friendly. Medium: win over the neutral. Hard: move the reluctant. Very hard: turn an opponent to your side. Extremely hard: talk down someone with everything to lose.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

survival.name: survival
survival.description:
Improves the player's ability to endure harsh environments, find food and water, and build shelters.

Covers: enduring weather, finding food and water, shelter, navigation, tracking. Not: identifying edible plants, which is Foraging. Easy: camp safely in mild wilds. Medium: forage through scarcity. Hard: endure a mountain storm. Very hard: cross a hostile region unsupplied. Extremely hard: survive where nothing should.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Charm.name: Charm
Charm.description:
The art of being appealing; not through magic or manipulation, but through the genuine skill of making people want to be around you. Charm covers flirting, social grace, making others feel valued, reading romantic interest, creating memorable first impressions, and the nuanced craft of expressing attraction in ways that are welcome rather than unwelcome. In a world where romance and relationships shape adventurer life as deeply as combat, charm is the skill that determines whether you are the protagonist or the comic relief. It is not coercion: bending a will is a different art, and an outlawed one. It is the difference between a smile that lingers and a smile that is forgotten.

Covers: likability, warmth, flirtation, first impressions, easing tension. Not: magically induced attraction, which is Charm Magic. Easy: charm a shopkeeper. Medium: win a stranger's trust. Hard: melt open hostility. Very hard: charm someone warned about you. Extremely hard: leave an enemy defending you to their own allies.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Mining.name: Mining
Mining.description:
The extraction of ores, gemstones, and magical minerals from the earth, and the survival skills needed to do it without the cave collapsing. Mining covers ore identification, excavation techniques, tunnel assessment, and the specialized knowledge required to safely extract volatile materials like riftglass, mana crystals, and the reactive mineral deposits found near Riftmaw entrances. Miners develop an instinct for unstable ground that makes them surprisingly good at navigating dungeon floors.

Covers: ore extraction, tunnel safety, vein reading, cave hazards. Not: mana crystal and Riftlight veins specifically, which is Crystal Prospecting. Easy: work a surface vein. Medium: read where the seam runs. Hard: extract fragile crystal intact. Very hard: mine safely through unstable deep rock. Extremely hard: pull a flawless core from a collapsing shaft.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Alchemy.name: Alchemy
Alchemy.description:
The art and science of brewing potions, crafting elixirs, transmuting materials, and creating magical consumables. Alchemists turn raw ingredients into healing draughts, enhancement potions, poison antidotes, and the occasional unstable compound that makes the laboratory very exciting for about five seconds. Every adventuring party appreciates someone who can refill their potion supply.

Covers: potion brewing, transmutation, reagent handling, elixirs. Not: fermented and distilled drinks, which is Brewing, or dosed toxins, which is Poison Craft. Easy: brew a standard healing draught. Medium: a reliable buff potion. Hard: a rare multi-effect elixir. Very hard: transmute base materials cleanly. Extremely hard: a masterwork the guilds would study.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Swordsmanship.name: Swordsmanship
Swordsmanship.description:
Mastery of bladed weapons: from longswords to rapiers to greatswords. Swordsmanship covers offensive techniques, defensive parries, footwork, and the dramatic flourishes that make tournament crowds go wild. In a world where adventurers fight monsters for a living, a skilled swordsman is never short of work, or admirers.

Covers: swords of every length, cuts, thrusts, parries, blade techniques. Not: the protocol and footwork of a formal match, which is Dueling, or hooked pull-cuts, which is Scythe Combat. Easy: routine strike. Medium: beat a trained guard's defense. Hard: duel a veteran evenly. Very hard: defeat a master's guard. Extremely hard: a cut spoken of in schools.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Archery.name: Archery
Archery.description:
Precision ranged combat with bows, crossbows, and other projectile weapons. Archery covers accuracy, rapid fire, trick shots, and the ability to pick off monsters before they close to melee range. Every adventuring party needs someone who can hit a goblin between the eyes at fifty paces.

Covers: bows, crossbows, aimed shots, moving targets, trick shots. Not: guns and spell-pistols, which is Firearms. Easy: hit a still target. Medium: hit a runner. Hard: thread a gap in melee. Very hard: split an incoming arrow. Extremely hard: the impossible shot at the impossible range.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Unarmed Combat.name: Unarmed Combat
Unarmed Combat.description:
Fighting without weapons: fists, kicks, elbows, knees, throws, grapples, and the pure audacity of punching things that other people need swords for. Unarmed Combat covers martial arts techniques, close-quarters brawling, and the philosophy that the body itself is the weapon. In a world of enchanted blades and divine armaments, the unarmed fighter is either the most confident or the most foolish, and the answer depends on how hard they can hit.

Covers: punches, kicks, throws, grapples, disarms, brawling. Not: internal energy work and body tempering, which is Qi Cultivation. Easy: routine strike or hold. Medium: take down a trained fighter. Hard: disarm an armed opponent barehanded. Very hard: stagger an armored knight. Extremely hard: fell what swords could not.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Dueling.name: Dueling
Dueling.description:
Formal one-on-one combat mastery built around footwork, timing, reading an opponent, and winning with precision instead of brute force. Dueling covers rapiers, refined blades, tournament etiquette, first-blood exchanges, and romantic rival fights in the rain.

Covers: one-on-one fencing, footwork, reads, ripostes, formal duels. Not: blade technique outside a formal match, which is Swordsmanship. Easy: hold your ground. Medium: outfence a soldier. Hard: read and punish a feint. Very hard: defeat a champion cleanly. Extremely hard: win before the crowd sees the exchange.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Heavy Weapons.name: Heavy Weapons
Heavy Weapons.description:
Combat mastery with oversized swords, massive clubs, great hammers, heavy blades, and weapons that turn commitment into devastation. Heavy Weapons covers wind-up timing, stance discipline, armor-cracking blows, clearing space through a press of foes, and making one swing matter enough to end the argument.

Covers: greatswords, great hammers, oversized blades, momentum fighting. Not: chains, flails, whips, and rope, which is Flexible Weapons. Easy: a clean heavy swing. Medium: break a braced shield. Hard: cleave through a guard mid-swing. Very hard: stop a charge with one blow. Extremely hard: split what armies hide behind.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Polearm Combat.name: Polearm Combat
Polearm Combat.description:
Combat mastery with spears, naginata, halberds, swordstaffs, and other reach weapons. Polearm Combat covers spacing, thrusts, sweeps, bracing against charges, keeping monsters outside claw range, and turning reach into battlefield control.

Covers: spears, naginata, halberds, reach control, sweeps, braces. Not: hooked sweeping pull-cuts, which is Scythe Combat. Easy: keep a foe at reach. Medium: control two attackers' spacing. Hard: pin a champion at spear-length. Very hard: hold a corridor alone. Extremely hard: a wall of one.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Axe Fighting.name: Axe Fighting
Axe Fighting.description:
Combat mastery with axes, hatchets, greataxes, and brutal chopping weapons. Axe Fighting covers committed cuts, shield-breaking angles, hooked pulls, armor-cracking impacts, and the raw momentum of ending a fight before finesse becomes necessary.

Covers: axes, hatchets, greataxes, chopping power, hooking shields. Not: two-handed hammers and mauls, which is Heavy Weapons. Easy: a solid chop. Medium: hook a shield aside. Hard: split a guard stance open. Very hard: fell an armored foe in two swings. Extremely hard: one swing, one verdict.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Blunt Weapons.name: Blunt Weapons
Blunt Weapons.description:
Combat mastery with maces, clubs, hammers, kanabo, and other crushing weapons. Blunt Weapons covers impact timing, armor denting, bone-rattling pressure, shield punishment, and the very practical art of making plate armor regret existing.

Covers: maces, hammers, clubs, kanabo, crushing through armor. Not: oversized two-handed weapons, which is Heavy Weapons, or shield offense, which is Shield Combat. Easy: a ringing blow. Medium: dent plate meaningfully. Hard: stagger a braced defender. Very hard: crush a shield arm through the shield. Extremely hard: the blow folklore warns about.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Shield Combat.name: Shield Combat
Shield Combat.description:
Combat mastery with shields as active weapons instead of passive cover. Shield Combat covers guarding allies, shield bashes, formation anchors, body-blocking, intercepting attacks, and the heroic fantasy of becoming the wall everyone else survives behind.

Covers: shield bashes, walls, covers, active shield offense. Not: mace and hammer offense, which is Blunt Weapons. Easy: block a clean hit. Medium: bash an attacker off balance. Hard: cover two allies under volley. Very hard: hold a line alone. Extremely hard: the wall that outlasted the siege.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Dagger Fighting.name: Dagger Fighting
Dagger Fighting.description:
Close-quarters combat mastery with daggers, stilettos, twin knives, concealed blades, and practical utility knives. Dagger Fighting covers quick draws, angles, feints, weak-point attacks, off-hand pressure, grip changes, improvised edges, and surviving inside an enemy's guard where longer weapons become awkward.

Covers: daggers, twin knives, concealed blades, utility and improvised knives, close-quarters precision. Not: knives thrown rather than kept in hand, which is Thrown Weapons. Easy: a quick clean cut. Medium: slip inside a longer weapon's reach. Hard: find the armor gap mid-fight. Very hard: dismantle a swordsman up close. Extremely hard: the blade they never saw draw.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Scythe Combat.name: Scythe Combat
Scythe Combat.description:
Combat mastery with war scythes and hooked battlefield weapons. Scythe Combat covers sweeping cuts, pulls, reaping arcs, tripping motions, intimidating reach, and the dramatic silhouette of a weapon that looks like it came with boss music.

Covers: war scythes, hooked weapons, sweeping arcs, pull-cuts. Not: straight cuts and thrusts, which is Swordsmanship, or braced reach control, which is Polearm Combat. Easy: a clean sweeping cut. Medium: hook a leg from under a foe. Hard: control a crowd's spacing with arcs. Very hard: reap through a shield line. Extremely hard: the harvest they name winters after.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Fan Combat.name: Fan Combat
Fan Combat.description:
Combat mastery with war fans, bladed fans, ceremonial fans, and deceptively elegant folding weapons. Fan Combat covers misdirection, slashing arcs, guard-breaking snaps, courtly dueling, hidden blades, and fighting with the energy of a noble who never stopped smiling.

Covers: war fans, bladed fans, deflections, elegant misdirection. Not: verbal misdirection, which is Deception. Easy: a snapping strike. Medium: deflect a sword with the ribs. Hard: blind, cut, and reposition in one motion. Very hard: defeat a duelist without losing composure. Extremely hard: a fatal dance mistaken for courtesy.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Flexible Weapons.name: Flexible Weapons
Flexible Weapons.description:
Combat mastery with whips, rope darts, nunchaku, chains, kusarigama, meteor hammers, chainblades, and every flexible or linked weapon that turns reach into a trap. Flexible Weapons covers wraps, binding, sweeping arcs, weighted strikes, disarms, unpredictable angles, and flashy anime movement that looks impossible until it lands.

Covers: whips, rope darts, nunchaku, chains, kusarigama, meteor hammers, chainblades, momentum and entangling weapons. Not: rigid hafted weapons, which is Heavy Weapons. Easy: a cracking strike. Medium: disarm at range. Hard: bind and yank a foe off their feet. Very hard: control several foes at spinning reach. Extremely hard: a cage made of one cord.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Thrown Weapons.name: Thrown Weapons
Thrown Weapons.description:
Combat mastery with chakrams, throwing knives, darts, hand axes, and other hurled weapons. Thrown Weapons covers quick releases, trick throws, returning arcs, weak-point targeting, and turning distance into a series of very rude surprises.

Covers: chakrams, knives, darts, hand axes, ricochets. Not: knives kept in hand, which is Dagger Fighting. Easy: hit at short range. Medium: hit a mover at distance. Hard: bank a ricochet to a hidden target. Very hard: pin a hand mid-spellcast. Extremely hard: the throw that curved on purpose.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Firearms.name: Firearms
Firearms.description:
Combat mastery with spell-pistols, mundane guns, gunblades, and other trigger-based ranged weapons. Firearms covers aim, recoil control, quick draws, reload rhythm, trick shots, and the stylish unfairness of bringing a bullet to a sword fight.

Covers: spell-pistols, guns, gunblades, aimed fire, quick draws. Not: bows and crossbows, which is Archery. Easy: hit at close range. Medium: a clean shot under pressure. Hard: draw and fire before a swing lands. Very hard: shoot the weapon from a hand mid-duel. Extremely hard: one shot, one legend.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Exotic Weapons.name: Exotic Weapons
Exotic Weapons.description:
Combat mastery with unusual fantasy weapons that do not fit cleanly into normal categories: bladed umbrellas, spell cards, trick tools, parasols, hidden mechanisms, and strange relics. Exotic Weapons rewards creativity, misdirection, and style over conventional training.

Covers: unusual and improvised weapon mastery, unorthodox fighting. Not: improvised edges in scrappy close work, which is Dagger Fighting. Easy: a competent strike. Medium: exploit the weapon's surprise factor. Hard: defeat a conventional fighter confused by it. Very hard: master-tier work with a novelty. Extremely hard: they now train against it.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Body Pillow Combat.name: Body Pillow Combat
Body Pillow Combat.description:
A completely ridiculous but strangely effective combat style built around using a full-size body pillow as a soft shield, improvised bludgeon, morale banner, feinting tool, and emergency cushion. Body Pillow Combat covers slap-strikes, plush parries, dramatic spins, impact absorption, distraction tactics, protecting allies from falls, and the absolute conviction required to win a real fight while wielding your favorite kawaii waifu pillow with heroic seriousness.

Covers: pillow strikes that deal real blunt damage like any weapon, smothers, absurd blocks. Not: genuinely absorbing punishment, which is Endurance Combat. Easy: a satisfying bonk. Medium: knock a weapon askew. Hard: fell a soldier who cannot process events. Very hard: defeat a duelist without ever being taken seriously. Extremely hard: the softest legend in Luxcellia.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Thread Arts.name: Thread Arts
Thread Arts.description:
Combat and utility mastery with magical threads, needles, silk lines, bindings, puppet strings, and stitched wards. Thread Arts covers binding enemies, sewing charms, cutting with near-invisible lines, repairing gear mid-scene, and making tailoring look dangerous.

Covers: magical threads, needle work, bindings, puppet strings, silk lines. Not: ordinary garment making, which is Tailoring. Easy: a razor line strike. Medium: bind a wrist mid-swing. Hard: web a corridor unseen. Very hard: puppet a foe's weapon arm. Extremely hard: the battlefield rearranged by invisible thread.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Brewing.name: Brewing
Brewing.description:
The craft of fermenting alcohol, distilling restorative tonics, and brewing liquid courage: from grain-beer stamina potions to monster-extract combat stimulants to the famous Emberglass Firewine that adventurers swear by and sometimes swear at. Brewing covers fermentation, distillation, barrel aging, herbal infusion, and the art of creating drinks that blur the line between medicine and morale. A well-timed round of Brewmaster ale has saved more adventuring parties than any healing spell.

Covers: fermenting, distilling, tonics, morale drinks. Not: potions and elixirs, which is Alchemy. Easy: a decent ale. Medium: a tonic that steadies nerves. Hard: a brew with real restorative kick. Very hard: a cask nobles bid over. Extremely hard: the bottle they break treaties over.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Cooking.name: Cooking
Cooking.description:
The art and craft of preparing food: from campfire stews that keep a party alive to festival dishes that win hearts. Cooking covers ingredient selection, flavor pairing, preservation techniques, and the deeply underestimated skill of making something delicious from whatever the dungeon left behind. A party that eats well fights better, recovers faster, and argues less. A cook who can turn monster meat into a meal worth eating is worth more than a second swordsman.

Covers: meal preparation, camp cooking, feast craft, flavor mastery. Not: buff meals from monster ingredients, which is Battle Cooking. Easy: a solid camp stew. Medium: a meal that lifts spirits. Hard: a dish with a minor buff's worth of morale. Very hard: a feast that turns a negotiation. Extremely hard: the meal they measure homesickness against.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Farming.name: Farming
Farming.description:
The agricultural art of growing crops, herbs, magical fruit, potion plants, and cozy life-sim dreams in a world that keeps trying to drag you into adventure. Farming covers soil preparation, planting cycles, mana-rich cultivation, irrigation, harvest timing, and the specialized knowledge of growing ingredients that alchemists and cooks cannot find in the wild. A farmer who can grow starwheat in Riftlight-infused soil is the quiet backbone of every potion supply chain in Luxcellia.

Covers: crops, magical plants, soil craft, harvest timing. Not: identifying and preparing wild herbs, which is Herbalism. Easy: keep a garden thriving. Medium: coax a stubborn magical crop. Hard: grow potion-grade herbs to standard. Very hard: revive blighted fields. Extremely hard: harvest what only legends grew.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Fishing.name: Fishing
Fishing.description:
The patient craft of catching fish and aquatic creatures: from river trout to the magical tide-serpents that lurk in Tsukihana's deeper waters. Fishing covers water reading, bait selection, tackle crafting, and the meditative patience that makes fishers some of the calmest people in any adventuring party. A good catch provides food, trade goods, and occasionally a rare aquatic ingredient that alchemists will pay handsomely for.

Covers: angling, nets, aquatic creatures, reading water. Not: general wilderness sustenance, which is survival. Easy: catch dinner. Medium: land a strong fighter. Hard: hook something rare and keep it. Very hard: land what breaks other lines. Extremely hard: the catch taverns argue about for decades.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Insight.name: Insight
Insight.description:
The ability to read people: their emotions, intentions, truths, and lies. Insight covers detecting deception, interpreting body language, sensing hidden motivations, and understanding what someone means versus what they say. In a world where beastkin ears betray emotions, demon contracts hide clauses, and every faction has an agenda, the ability to see through pretense to the person underneath is survival. Insight also governs reading the room in romantic situations: knowing when interest is genuine, when jealousy is brewing, and when someone's silence means more than their words.

Covers: reading emotions, spotting lies, judging intent. Not: searching a place for physical evidence, which is investigation. Easy: read an open face. Medium: catch a casual lie. Hard: see through a practiced liar. Very hard: read a courtier trained to be unreadable. Extremely hard: see the truth someone hid from themselves.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Stealth.name: Stealth
Stealth.description:
Moving unseen, unheard, and unnoticed through dangerous territory. Stealth covers infiltration, pickpocketing, lockpicking, disguise, and the art of being in places you technically shouldn't be. Essential for dungeon scouts, information brokers, and anyone who'd rather avoid a fight than win one.

Covers: sneaking, hiding, infiltration, shadowing, silent movement. Not: striking from concealment, which is Dagger Fighting. Easy: slip past the distracted. Medium: cross a patrolled yard. Hard: shadow a wary target through crowds. Very hard: walk a guarded hall unseen. Extremely hard: leave no proof you ever existed there.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Artifice.name: Artifice
Artifice.description:
The craft of designing, building, and activating magical devices: from personal gadgets and dungeon tools to mana lamps, trap triggers, and inventions that the Aetherglass Reaches would either patent or ban. Artifice blends mechanical intuition with magical theory, producing devices that do things nature never intended. An artificer who can jury-rig a broken relic mid-dungeon or deploy a tactical gadget at the perfect moment is worth more than a scroll library.

Covers: magical devices, gadgets, mechanisms, activation work. Not: imbuement with no mechanism to it, which is Enchanting. Easy: assemble a simple device. Medium: repair a delicate mechanism. Hard: build a reliable magical gadget. Very hard: reverse-engineer ancient artifice. Extremely hard: a device the academies would license.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Divinity.name: Divinity
Divinity.description:
Channeling divine power to heal, purify, protect, and smite. Divine magic draws from the First Light and the celestial pantheon, granting miraculous abilities that range from closing wounds to banishing undead to creating barriers of sacred light. The Church trains paladins and priests in this tradition, but the truly blessed often exceed what any seminary can teach.

Covers: healing, purification, blessing, smiting, divine channel. Not: plain radiance and illumination, which is Light Magic. Easy: mend minor wounds. Medium: cleanse a common affliction. Hard: heal grave injuries. Very hard: break a potent curse. Extremely hard: a miracle witnesses convert over.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Foraging.name: Foraging
Foraging.description:
The survival art of finding food and useful plants in any terrain: mushrooms in damp caves, fruit in tropical canopy, wild vegetables along roadsides, edible flowers in meadow ruins, and strange things that are probably food if you know which ones to trust. Foraging covers plant identification, seasonal availability, terrain reading, and the critical ability to distinguish a delicious mana mushroom from one that will make you see sounds for three days. A skilled forager keeps the party fed when rations run out and finds potion ingredients that no shop stocks.

Covers: finding food and useful plants, terrain knowledge. Not: shelter, navigation, or enduring weather, which is survival. Easy: gather in generous terrain. Medium: forage through scarcity. Hard: find the rare herb in the right season. Very hard: provision a party in hostile wilds. Extremely hard: find what the field guides call extinct.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Deception.name: Deception
Deception.description:
The art of making people believe things that aren't true: from innocent misdirections to elaborate deceptions to the particular skill of looking calm when you are absolutely not. Deception covers lying, bluffing, disguising intent, creating diversions, maintaining cover stories, and the delicate craft of telling a truth that leads someone to a wrong conclusion without technically lying. Essential for infiltration, negotiation, and the kind of social situations where admitting what you actually think would be strategically unwise.

Covers: lies, misdirection, cover stories, false identities. Not: magically fabricated senses, which is Illusion Magic. Easy: a small smooth lie. Medium: hold a cover story under questions. Hard: fool a suspicious professional. Very hard: maintain a false identity among experts. Extremely hard: a lie history records as fact.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Etiquette.name: Etiquette
Etiquette.description:
The knowledge of how to behave: from which fork to use at a Crownveil state dinner to the correct greeting for a beastkin clan elder to the precise way to decline a demon's contract without giving offense or accidentally agreeing to something eternal. Etiquette covers formal protocol, cultural customs, rank recognition, and the ability to navigate social situations where saying the wrong thing has consequences worse than a sword fight. In a continent where noble houses, demon courts, and ancient traditions all have different rules, knowing the rules is the difference between guest and prisoner.

Covers: courtly manners, protocol, social navigation, face-saving. Not: arguing someone into a position, which is persuasion. Easy: dine without offense. Medium: navigate a formal function smoothly. Hard: recover a social disaster gracefully. Very hard: outmaneuver a hostile court. Extremely hard: rewrite the room's rules mid-evening.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Herbalism.name: Herbalism
Herbalism.description:
The study and harvest of plants for their medicinal, alchemical, and magical properties. Herbalism covers plant identification, sustainable harvesting, preparation techniques, and the knowledge of which forest flower cures a fever, which swamp root induces sleep, and which meadow blossom will make you see colors that don't exist for three hours. Essential support for alchemists, healers, and anyone who spends time far from a pharmacy.

Covers: medicinal plants, harvesting, preparations, plant lore. Not: gathering wild food in the field, which is Foraging. Easy: identify common herbs. Medium: prepare an effective poultice. Hard: harvest a delicate specimen intact. Very hard: compound a rare remedy. Extremely hard: brew what the sick were told didn't exist.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Ice Magic.name: Ice Magic
Ice Magic.description:
The study and mastery of ice as a magical discipline. Covers freezing, crystalline constructs, temperature reduction, and cryogenic preservation. Ice mages are precise, calculating, and always slightly cold to the touch.

Covers: freezing, ice constructs, cold fields, crystalline work. Not: grown lattice and shard projection, which is Crystal Magic. Easy: frost a surface. Medium: an ice bolt or small wall. Hard: freeze a foe's footing mid-fight. Very hard: raise a fortress wall of ice. Extremely hard: winter, delivered on command.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Perfumery.name: Perfumery
Perfumery.description:
The art of creating magical and mundane fragrances that influence mood, memory, attraction, and atmosphere. Perfumery covers essence extraction from Riftlight-touched flowers, monster glands, and elemental springs; scent composition; and the strategic application of fragrance to calm nerves, sharpen focus, make the wearer unforgettable at a ball, or mask the smell of a very recent dungeon delve. In Luxcellia's romance-heavy culture, a skilled perfumer is part chemist, part matchmaker, and part spy.

Covers: fragrances, mood influence, memory scents, subtle craft. Not: ingestible brews, which is Alchemy. Easy: a pleasant blend. Medium: a scent that calms a room. Hard: a fragrance that turns a first impression. Very hard: a signature that opens doors. Extremely hard: the scent they remember the decade by.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Tailoring.name: Tailoring
Tailoring.description:
The art of creating and repairing clothing: from reinforced adventuring gear to the formal wear required at noble functions where showing up in bloodstained leather is considered a faux pas. Tailoring covers fabric selection, cutting, stitching, embroidery, and the specialized craft of weaving enchantment threads into garments that are beautiful, functional, and occasionally both. Every great romance in Luxcellia's history involved someone wearing something tailored for the occasion.

Covers: clothing creation, repairs, reinforced gear, formal wear. Not: hide and leather gear, which is Leatherworking, or magically threaded work, which is Thread Arts. Easy: a clean repair. Medium: a well-made garment. Hard: reinforced adventuring wear that holds. Very hard: gala attire that turns the room. Extremely hard: the gown the ballad describes first.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Dark Magic.name: Dark Magic
Dark Magic.description:
Manipulation of shadow, curses, necrotic energy, and the forbidden arts practiced in the Twilight Dominion. Dark magic is powerful, seductive, and viewed with deep suspicion by the Church, which only makes it more appealing to certain people. Demon-touched individuals have a natural affinity for it, but anyone with the willpower and the willingness to be watched can learn.

Covers: shadow, curses, necrotic energy, forbidden arts, and necromancy: raising and commanding the dead. What a necromancer raises is undead (a skeleton, a zombie, a thrall), never a spirit beast. Not: darkness as a medium, shadow travel, or umbral constructs, which is Shadow Magic. Easy: a minor hex. Medium: a draining strike. Hard: a binding curse that holds. Very hard: a working that bends a scene dark. Extremely hard: the curse spoken of in warnings.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Enchanting.name: Enchanting
Enchanting.description:
The craft of imbuing items with magical properties: from flaming swords to self-repairing armor to rings that make the wearer slightly more interesting at parties. Enchanting requires both magical talent and artisan skill, making enchanters rare, valuable, and frequently asked for favors they really don't have time to fulfill.

Covers: imbuing items, magical properties, enchantment layering. A quick enchant cast on gear or an ally in the field lasts the scene; a permanent enchantment is crafting work on an item. Not: runes cut into gear (Rune Carving), scrolls and seals (Inscription), or built mechanisms (Artifice). Easy: a minor charm on an item. Medium: a reliable single enchantment. Hard: a strong effect that lasts. Very hard: layered enchantments in harmony. Extremely hard: an heirloom the ages will fight over.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Fire Magic.name: Fire Magic
Fire Magic.description:
The study and mastery of fire as a magical discipline. Covers combustion, heat manipulation, explosions, and flame shaping. The most popular offensive element and the one most likely to set your own belongings on fire during training.

Covers: combustion, heat, flame shaping, ignition. Not: blended multi-element work, which is Elemental Magic. Easy: light and control small flame. Medium: a firebolt or burning line. Hard: shaped flame that spares allies. Very hard: an inferno under full control. Extremely hard: fire with a guest list.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Rift Magic.name: Rift Magic
Rift Magic.description:
The unstable magical discipline of dimensional cracks, dungeon tears, spatial anomalies, portal scars, and reality-stress. Rift mages read distortions in the world, seal dangerous breaches, and weaponize controlled fractures at great personal risk.

Covers: dimensional cracks, spatial anomalies, dungeon tears, phase work. Not: a momentary jump that closes behind you, which is Space Magic. Easy: sense nearby instability. Medium: a short controlled slip. Hard: seal a minor tear. Very hard: redirect a dungeon hazard. Extremely hard: negotiate with broken space and win.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Soul Magic.name: Soul Magic
Soul Magic.description:
The study and mastery of spiritual essence as a magical discipline. Covers aura reading, soul projection, emotional resonance, spiritual reinforcement, and the perception of life-death boundaries. Soul mages see the truth of people, which is either a gift or a curse depending on what the truth is.

Covers: aura reading, spirit work, soul anchoring, essence. Not: summoning or hosting an outside spirit, which is Spirit Channeling. Easy: read a surface aura. Medium: calm a restless spirit. Hard: anchor a shaken soul. Very hard: ward against possession outright. Extremely hard: a working both sides of the veil respect.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Star Magic.name: Star Magic
Star Magic.description:
The magic of the celestial sphere: drawing power from starlight, stellar alignments, and the ancient constellations that have watched Luxcellia since before it had a name. Star magic is luminous, precise, and quietly devastating: stellar beams that burn through shadow, gravitational pulls that pin enemies in place, navigational instincts that border on prophecy, and a connection to the cosmos that makes Astrologers very interested in your blood work. Star-attuned mages are revered in Sanctum Ecclesia and viewed with suspicion in the Twilight Dominion.

Covers: starlight, alignments, celestial guidance, astral light. Not: ordinary illumination or barriers, which is Light Magic. Easy: a guiding gleam. Medium: starlight strikes or marks. Hard: read a working omen. Very hard: call astral light in daylight. Extremely hard: the night sky takes a side.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Time Magic.name: Time Magic
Time Magic.description:
The study and mastery of temporal flow as a magical discipline. Covers localized time acceleration, deceleration, brief reversal, temporal perception, and chronal anchoring. The rarest and most theoretically complex magical discipline in Luxcellia. Time mages are either geniuses or dangerously unstable. Frequently both.

Covers: acceleration, slowing, delays, temporal perception. Not: moving something elsewhere rather than elsewhen, which is Space Magic. Easy: quicken a small motion. Medium: slow a falling object. Hard: haste an ally cleanly. Very hard: hold a lethal moment still. Extremely hard: a borrowed second that changes everything.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Void Magic.name: Void Magic
Void Magic.description:
The magic of negation and absence: drawing power from the Void, the nothing that existed before creation and sits outside the edges of reality. Void magic erases, nullifies, and unmakes: it annihilates barriers, consumes enchantments, deletes distance between two points, and in its most extreme applications removes things from existence entirely. Practitioners are rare because the Void does not teach; it takes, and the student must be comfortable with loss as a fundamental operating principle. The Church considers it dangerous. The Veilwalkers consider it fascinating. The Void considers you borrowed.

Covers: negation, nullification, absence, unmaking. Not: darkness used to hide, travel, or build with, which is Shadow Magic. Easy: dim a minor effect. Medium: mute a small spell. Hard: nullify a working mid-cast. Very hard: erase an active field. Extremely hard: absence, delivered with borders.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Wind Magic.name: Wind Magic
Wind Magic.description:
The study and mastery of wind as a magical discipline. Covers air pressure, cutting gusts, flight enhancement, and weather influence. Wind mages move faster than anyone else and never stop reminding everyone about it.

Covers: air pressure, cutting gusts, flight aid, weather influence. Not: calling a whole weather system, which is Storm Magic. Easy: a directed gust. Medium: a cutting air blade. Hard: deflect a volley mid-flight. Very hard: lift an ally across a chasm. Extremely hard: the sky, administered.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Blood Magic.name: Blood Magic
Blood Magic.description:
The study and mastery of blood as a magical medium. Covers vitality manipulation, blood weaponization, life force transfer, self-enhancement through biological overdrive, and hemomantic constructs. The most personal form of magic: every spell is paid for in the caster's own currency.

Covers: vitality manipulation, blood weapons, sanguine bindings. Not: restoring vitality as a granted blessing, which is Divinity, or acting on the spirit itself, which is Soul Magic. Easy: sense a pulse's truth. Medium: a blood-edge strike. Hard: bind a foe through spilled blood. Very hard: a battle-turning surge, paid openly. Extremely hard: the working that names its price and is worth it.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Charm Magic.name: Charm Magic
Charm Magic.description:
The magical discipline of emotional resonance, glamour, attraction, aura pressure, and social enchantment. Charm Magic influences mood, presence, confidence, and bonds and stops short of bending a will. The form that does not stop is outlawed by every civilized faction, and they hunt its users.

Covers: emotional resonance, glamour, aura pressure, attraction, only when the caster deliberately uses magic. Plain likability and flirting are Charm. Not: false images or fabricated senses, which is Illusion Magic. Easy: a warm glamour. Medium: soften a hostile mood. Hard: sway a resistant heart's tone. Very hard: quiet a mob into an audience. Extremely hard: a room that forgets it was ever against you.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Dream Magic.name: Dream Magic
Dream Magic.description:
The discipline of entering, shaping, reading, and communicating through dreams. Practitioners can send impressions into sleeping minds, walk the boundary between waking and dream, and interpret dream-symbolism as divination. Rare, intimate, and valued in the Twilight Dominion.

Covers: entering, shaping, and reading dreams, dream messages. Not: false senses shown to a waking mind, which is Illusion Magic. Easy: read a sleeping mood. Medium: send a simple dream message. Hard: calm a nightmare from inside. Very hard: shape a shared dream stable. Extremely hard: an answer carried out of someone's deepest sleep.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Earth Magic.name: Earth Magic
Earth Magic.description:
The study and mastery of earth as a magical discipline. Covers stone shaping, terrain manipulation, mineral control, and seismic force. The most defensive element. Earth mages are patient, immovable, and very difficult to impress.

Covers: stone shaping, terrain control, barriers, tremors. Not: living growth, which is Nature Magic, or grown lattice and shard work, which is Crystal Magic. Easy: shift loose earth. Medium: raise a stone wall. Hard: reshape footing mid-battle. Very hard: raise a fortress from open ground. Extremely hard: the land, briefly, has a monarch.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Engineering.name: Engineering
Engineering.description:
The application of mechanical principles and magical theory to create devices that do things nature never intended: from the Aetherglass Imperium's partially understood relic mechanisms to personal gadgets that might work exactly as designed or might explode in a surprising new direction. Engineering covers mechanism design, cogwork assembly, trap disarming, siege equipment operation, airship component maintenance, and the creative application of force, leverage, and magical amplification through physical constructs. The Aetherglass Reaches produce more engineers than the rest of the continent combined, and their devices are either revolutionary or catastrophic with very little middle ground.

Covers: mechanisms, structures, magical-mechanical systems. Not: devices that run on magic, which is Artifice. Easy: fix a simple machine. Medium: build a working mechanism. Hard: design under constraints that hold. Very hard: improvise a solution mid-crisis. Extremely hard: the bridge that shouldn't stand, standing.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Inscription.name: Inscription
Inscription.description:
The craft of writing magic into form: scroll scribing, rune carving, seal stamping, and the creation of written magical constructs that hold power in their patterns. Inscription covers magical ink preparation, scroll creation, ward inscription, contract writing, and the specialized discipline of encoding spells into physical media for later activation. Inscribers produce the scrolls that save lives in dungeons, the wards that protect camps at night, and the contracts that the Twilight Dominion considers sacred.

Covers: scrolls, runes, seals, written magic. Not: runes cut into gear or surfaces, which is Rune Carving. Easy: scribe a minor scroll. Medium: a clean working seal. Hard: a scroll of a potent spell. Very hard: layered seal-work that holds under attack. Extremely hard: script the academies will teach from.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Light Magic.name: Light Magic
Light Magic.description:
The study and mastery of light as a magical discipline. Covers illumination, purification, laser-focused beams, and illusion. Closely associated with the Church of the First Light but not exclusive to it: light responds to clarity of purpose, not prayer.

Covers: illumination, purification, barriers, revealing. Not: granted blessing, smiting, or divine channel, which is Divinity. Easy: summon steady light. Medium: a searing bolt or small ward. Hard: purify corruption on contact. Very hard: a sanctum darkness cannot enter. Extremely hard: light with a monarch.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Sound Magic.name: Sound Magic
Sound Magic.description:
The study and mastery of vibration and frequency as a magical discipline. Covers shockwave projection, silence fields, sonic blades, resonance disruption, and acoustic illusions. Sound mages hear everything and can make everything hear them, whether it wants to or not.

Covers: shockwaves, silence, resonance, acoustic control. Not: crystal resonance, which is Crystal Magic, or stage artistry, which is performance. Easy: throw a sound. Medium: a concussive note. Hard: silence a caster mid-syllable. Very hard: shatter a barrier at resonance. Extremely hard: nowhere the voice is not.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Space Magic.name: Space Magic
Space Magic.description:
The study and mastery of spatial magic. Covers teleportation, dimensional barriers, gravity manipulation, and spatial distortion. The rarest and most academically demanding element. Space mages understand geometry that makes mathematicians cry.

Covers: teleportation, barriers, gravity wells, spatial folds. Not: holding a seam open with somewhere on the far side, which is Rift Magic. Easy: a short blink. Medium: a clean tactical teleport. Hard: relocate an ally mid-danger. Very hard: fold distance for the party. Extremely hard: distance, repealed.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Storm Magic.name: Storm Magic
Storm Magic.description:
The study and mastery of atmospheric fury as a magical discipline. Covers cyclone generation, thunderbolt calling, torrential manipulation, pressure control, and weather weaponization. Storm magic combines wind, water, and lightning into something that makes each element individually jealous.

Covers: cyclones, storm calling, atmospheric fury. Not: a single bolt or chained discharge, which is Lightning Magic. Easy: stir the wind. Medium: a thunderclap strike. Hard: a directed squall. Very hard: a commanded storm overhead. Extremely hard: the clouds pick a side.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Water Magic.name: Water Magic
Water Magic.description:
The study and mastery of water as a magical discipline. Covers flow manipulation, pressure, tidal forces, and water-based healing. Versatile and adaptive: water mages are equally comfortable drowning enemies and purifying wounds.

Covers: flow control, pressure, tides, purification. Not: cleansing corruption with holy radiance, which is Light Magic, or a granted blessing, which is Divinity. Easy: move standing water. Medium: a pressure jet or shield. Hard: redirect a current mid-fight. Very hard: a flood that flows where told. Extremely hard: the tide, employed.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Woodworking.name: Woodworking
Woodworking.description:
The craft of carving, shaping, and assembling wood, bone, horn, and organic materials into functional and beautiful objects: bows, staves, shields, furniture, instruments, charms, and the cozy handmade gifts companions pretend not to treasure. Woodworking covers green woodworking, joinery, finishing, and the specialized knowledge of working with mana-infused timbers and dungeon-grown fungal wood. A woodworker who can carve a replacement wand mid-expedition is every mage's best friend.

Covers: carving, joinery, bows, furniture, organic materials. Not: metal work at a forge, which is Blacksmithing. Easy: a sound repair. Medium: a well-made piece. Hard: a bow or instrument of real quality. Very hard: masterwork joinery without a nail. Extremely hard: the piece apprentices pilgrimage to see.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Arcane Magic.name: Arcane Magic
Arcane Magic.description:
The study and manipulation of pure magical energy: mana constructs, wards, dispelling, counterspelling, and the theoretical framework underpinning every other magical tradition. Arcane mages are scholars and architects of magic itself, bending raw power to their will with precision and intellect.

Covers: raw mana itself, mana constructs, wards and barriers, dispelling and counterspelling. NOT a catch-all. Arcane is NEVER the school for work a named school already covers: fire, ice, lightning, storm, wind, water, earth, light, dark, shadow, illusion, space, gravity, time, soul, blood, nature, crystal, sound, star, void, poison, dream, charm or rift effects each belong to their own school, and imbuing an item is Enchanting. If a caster with Arcane Magic performs any of those, resolve it on that school untrained rather than crediting Arcane. Easy: a mana bolt. Medium: a simple construct or shield. Hard: dispel an active working. Very hard: a construct with moving parts and judgment. Extremely hard: raw magic, argued into architecture.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Nature Magic.name: Nature Magic
Nature Magic.description:
The study and mastery of nature as a magical discipline. Covers plant growth, beast communication, natural toxins, and ecosystem manipulation. Nature mages hear the forest breathe, feel the seasons turn, and always seem to have pollen on their robes.

Covers: plant growth, beast communication, natural harmony, beast parts and beast shapes (wild shape). Not: shaping bare stone or terrain, which is Earth Magic. Easy: coax a bloom. Medium: speak simply with a beast. Hard: grow cover mid-battle. Very hard: gentle a hostile predator. Extremely hard: the forest takes your side, visibly.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Poison Craft.name: Poison Craft
Poison Craft.description:
The specialized knowledge of toxins, venoms, antidotes, paralytic agents, hallucinogens, and corrosive compounds. Poison Craft covers identification, extraction, preparation, application, and neutralization of every category of poison found in Luxcellia: from common snake venom to rare dungeon-spawned necrotic agents. A skilled Poison Crafter can coat weapons, spike drinks, create delayed-release capsules, and brew the antidotes that keep their own party alive when enemies use the same tricks.

Covers: toxins, antidotes, paralytics, dosage control. Not: cast venom, corrosion, or miasma fields, which is Poison Magic. Easy: identify a common toxin. Medium: brew a working antidote. Hard: a precise paralytic dose. Very hard: a poison that defeats a taster. Extremely hard: the toxin textbooks refuse to print.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Poison Magic.name: Poison Magic
Poison Magic.description:
The study and mastery of toxins, venoms, and corrosive substances as a magical discipline. Covers poison generation, acid manipulation, toxin neutralization, venomous enhancement, and biological warfare. Poison mages understand that destruction doesn't require explosions: sometimes it just requires patience.

Covers: magical venoms, corrosion, miasma, toxic fields. Not: brewed toxins, antidotes, and dosage, which is Poison Craft. Easy: a venomous touch. Medium: a corrosive bolt. Hard: a miasma that obeys borders. Very hard: purge every poison in a party at once. Extremely hard: a toxin composed for one name only.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Rune Carving.name: Rune Carving
Rune Carving.description:
The discipline of etching magical runes onto weapons, armor, tools, and surfaces: flame runes on blades, ward runes on shields, light runes on dungeon walls. Rune Carving bridges Enchanting and Blacksmithing but is its own craft: the rune is the language, the surface is the page, and a skilled carver can read ancient dungeon inscriptions and write new ones the ancients never imagined. In combat, a rune carver triggers prepared runes to devastating effect.

Covers: etched runes on gear and surfaces, activation logic. Not: loose scrolls and seals, which is Inscription, or binding a property into an item core, which is Enchanting. Easy: a stable minor rune. Medium: a reliable weapon rune. Hard: linked runes that trigger in order. Very hard: a rune array that guards a building. Extremely hard: script that outlives its language.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Scribal Arts.name: Scribal Arts
Scribal Arts.description:
The craft of writing, copying, recording, and documenting: from spell scrolls and dungeon maps to noble correspondence, legal contracts, and official-looking invitations that may or may not be forged. Scribal Arts covers penmanship, ink preparation, parchment treatment, wax sealing, calligraphy, and the art of making words look important enough that people believe them. A skilled scribe can duplicate a scroll under fire, draft a binding contract that holds up in any court, and copy a dungeon map before the ink fades.

Covers: writing, copying, records, documentation, forgery detection. Not: seals and written magic that carry an effect, which is Inscription. Easy: clean fair-hand copy. Medium: flawless legal documentation. Hard: spot a professional forgery. Very hard: reconstruct a damaged archive. Extremely hard: the document that settles the succession.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Shadow Magic.name: Shadow Magic
Shadow Magic.description:
The study and mastery of shadow as a magical discipline. Covers darkness manipulation, stealth enhancement, void pockets, and fear projection. Shadow responds to force of personality: the shadows obey because you command them to, not because you understand them.

Covers: darkness control, shadow travel, concealment, shadow constructs. Not: curses, necrotic energy, or forbidden rites, which is Dark Magic. Easy: deepen a shadow. Medium: cloak an ally in dimness. Hard: a short slip between shadows. Very hard: bind a foe by their own outline. Extremely hard: darkness, at a whisper, everywhere you need it.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Armorsmithing.name: Armorsmithing
Armorsmithing.description:
The specialized forge craft of shaping metal into protective gear: plate, chain, scale, brigandine, and the fitted articulation that lets an adventurer survive a dragon claw to the chest. Armorsmithing covers fitting, reinforcing, field-repairing, and modifying armor to work with Blessings, enchantments, and the bizarre body proportions of some beastkin. An armorsmith who can patch a cracked breastplate mid-dungeon is the reason the party tank is still standing.

Covers: plate, chain, scale, protective gear forging. Not: blades and general forge work, which is Blacksmithing. Easy: honest repairs. Medium: a solid set of scale. Hard: fitted plate that turns real blows. Very hard: masterwork armor light as rumor. Extremely hard: the suit that names its wearer.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Beast Keeping.name: Beast Keeping
Beast Keeping.description:
The care and training of mounts, familiars, spirit beasts, monster companions, and the adorable creature the party was definitely not supposed to adopt. Beast Keeping covers animal husbandry, feeding, medical care, behavioral training, bonding rituals, and the particular courage required to give a dire wolf a belly rub and survive. A skilled beast keeper can calm an agitated monster, direct a companion creature in combat, and tell the difference between a happy purr and the sound something makes right before it bites.

Covers: mounts, familiars, monster companions, animal care. Not: butchering monster parts, which is Monster Harvesting. Easy: calm a nervous mount. Medium: train a reliable behavior. Hard: bond a wary wild creature. Very hard: rehabilitate a dangerous beast. Extremely hard: the companion legends say chose YOU.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Blacksmithing.name: Blacksmithing
Blacksmithing.description:
The forge craft: shaping metal through heat, hammer, and the kind of patient fury that only someone who has ruined a blade at the quenching stage truly understands. Blacksmithing covers weapon forging, armor repair, tool making, and the specialized knowledge of working with magical metals like cold iron, starsteel, and the dragon-reactive alloys found only in Kagutsuchi's volcanic forges. A skilled smith can keep a party equipped, repair field damage mid-expedition, and forge weapons that outlast their wielder.

Covers: forging weapons and tools, metalwork, tempering. Not: plate and mail specifically, which is Armorsmithing. Easy: a sound repair. Medium: a dependable blade. Hard: a weapon of real quality. Very hard: masterwork steel with a signature temper. Extremely hard: the blade the forge is remembered for.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Crystal Magic.name: Crystal Magic
Crystal Magic.description:
The study and mastery of crystalline magic: growing barriers from living crystal, firing prismatic shards, refracting spells through crystalline lenses, and manipulating the raw lattice of compressed mana. Crystal mages shape the mineral infrastructure that enchanters rely on, grow defensive formations that dwarven holds consider sacred, and wield a discipline that sits at the intersection of offense, defense, and artifice. The Academy admits it is under-researched. Enchanters admit it is indispensable.

Covers: crystal growth, barriers, shard projection, resonance. Not: ordinary stone and tremors, which is Earth Magic. Easy: grow a small crystal. Medium: a shard volley or pane barrier. Hard: a singing wall that holds. Very hard: refract a spell into harmless light. Extremely hard: geometry, gala edition.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Gift Crafting.name: Gift Crafting
Gift Crafting.description:
The craft of making small, meaningful objects: charms, keepsakes, paired bracelets, handmade sweets, flower arrangements, carved tokens, and festival souvenirs that carry emotional weight far beyond their materials. Gift Crafting combines fine handwork with social intuition: reading what someone would treasure, embedding that insight into a physical object, and presenting it at the moment that matters most. A well-crafted gift in Luxcellia can shift a relationship, seal a promise, or become a treasured possession carried into every dungeon.

Covers: charms, keepsakes, paired tokens, meaningful small objects. Not: cut gems and fine metal settings, which is Jewelcrafting. Easy: a sweet trinket. Medium: a keepsake that clearly took thought. Hard: a paired set with real craft. Very hard: the gift that says what words couldn't. Extremely hard: the token still worn decades later.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Gravity Magic.name: Gravity Magic
Gravity Magic.description:
The study and mastery of gravitational force as a magical discipline. Covers weight manipulation, gravity wells, mass negation, directional gravity shifts, and orbital force projection. Gravity mages reshape battlefields by changing what 'down' means.

Covers: weight control, pinning fields, lift, orbital force. Not: folding or shortening space itself, which is Space Magic. Easy: lighten a load. Medium: stagger a foe with sudden weight. Hard: pin a charge mid-stride. Very hard: lift an ally beyond reach serenely. Extremely hard: down, renegotiated.
