Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Jewelcrafting.name: Jewelcrafting
Jewelcrafting.description:
The precision craft of cutting, setting, and enchanting gemstones and precious metals into accessories worth more than most adventurers earn in a year. Jewelcrafting covers gem appraisal, stone cutting, metal filigree, enchantment channeling through crystalline structures, and the creation of rings, amulets, and decorative pieces that carry both aesthetic beauty and magical function. A well-placed piece of jewelry can open noble doors, seal a romantic promise, or store an emergency spell.

Covers: gem cutting, setting, enchant-ready mounts, fine metal. Not: raw gem extraction from a vein, which is Mining. Easy: a clean cut stone. Medium: a well-set ring. Hard: an enchant-grade mount. Very hard: a piece nobles bid over. Extremely hard: the crown jewel, literally.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Battle Cooking.name: Battle Cooking
Battle Cooking.description:
The combat culinary art of turning monster parts into meals that heal, buff, and impress: fighting with cleavers and frying pans, harvesting ingredients mid-combat, and creating dishes so extraordinary that eating them is a magical experience. Battle Cooking combines kitchen skill with field improvisation: deboning a drake while it is still cooling, tempura-frying dungeon mushrooms over a campfire, and serving a five-course meal in a Riftmaw safe room that makes the whole party forget they are underground. The isekai trope is real: the party that eats together, wins together.

Covers: combat cuisine, monster ingredients, buff meals. Not: ordinary meals with no combat benefit, which is Cooking. Easy: a hearty field meal. Medium: a dish with a real morale kick. Hard: monster parts into a delicacy. Very hard: a mid-battle meal that turns the fight. Extremely hard: the dish that made the monster worth it.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Illusion Magic.name: Illusion Magic
Illusion Magic.description:
The study and mastery of perception manipulation as a magical discipline. Covers visual illusions, auditory phantasms, sensory overloads, disguise weaving, and reality suggestion. Illusion mages win fights that never happened against enemies who were never there.

Covers: visual illusions, decoys, disguises (looking like another person: an illusion a touch or a hard look can break), sensory deception. Not: real emotional pull or genuine attraction, which is Charm Magic. Easy: a flicker or false sound. Medium: a convincing static image. Hard: a decoy that survives scrutiny. Very hard: a scene-wide deception in motion. Extremely hard: reality's understudy, given the lead.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Leatherworking.name: Leatherworking
Leatherworking.description:
The craft of turning hides into armor, bags, belts, and the hundred small leather goods that keep an adventuring party functional. Leatherworking covers tanning, curing, stitching, tooling, and the specialized techniques for working with monster hides, basilisk leather, dire wolf fur, drakescale, that retain magical properties after processing. Leather armor won't stop a greatsword, but it's quiet, flexible, and doesn't rust when you fall in a dungeon puddle.

Covers: hides to armor, bags, belts, travel gear. Not: cloth garments, which is Tailoring. Easy: sturdy repairs. Medium: a well-made harness. Hard: fitted leather armor of quality. Very hard: masterwork gear from a monster's hide. Extremely hard: the coat that outlives its third owner.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Merchant Trade.name: Merchant Trade
Merchant Trade.description:
The commercial art of buying low, selling high, reading customers, haggling with nobles, spotting fake relics, and knowing that romance, dungeon loot, and desperation all have market value. Merchant Trade covers appraisal, negotiation, supply-chain logistics, and the particular brand of social manipulation that turns a profit without starting a war. A skilled merchant can fund an expedition through trade, talk a Blacksmith's price down by half, and identify a cursed item by the fact that no legitimate dealer would touch it.

Covers: haggling, appraisal of markets, supply chains, reading customers. Not: judging an artifact and its provenance, which is Relic Appraisal. Easy: a fair price. Medium: a clearly good deal. Hard: out-negotiate a professional. Very hard: corner a small market quietly. Extremely hard: the trade they teach at the exchange.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Elemental Magic.name: Elemental Magic
Elemental Magic.description:
The art of braiding elements together rather than mastering one. Elemental mages weave fire into wind, ground lightning through water, and improvise across boundaries a specialist would not cross. Versatile, dramatic, and the tradition most likely to produce spectacular explosions at inconvenient moments.

Covers: blending two or more elements in one working, and untrained elemental improvisation where no single school fits. NOT a substitute for a specialist school. A single element always belongs to its own school: fire is Fire Magic, ice is Ice Magic, lightning is Lightning Magic, and so on. Elemental Magic applies only when the effect is genuinely multi-element, never because the caster lacks the specialist. Easy: a single clean element. Medium: a two-element combination. Hard: rotate elements mid-fight fluently. Very hard: a fused working of three. Extremely hard: all four, one breath, one intent.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Fashion Styling.name: Fashion Styling
Fashion Styling.description:
The art of creating and coordinating outfits that convey power, status, romance, or intent before a single word is spoken. Fashion Styling covers outfit selection, accessorizing, cultural dress codes, and the strategic deployment of appearance at galas, dates, duels, and negotiations. In Luxcellia's appearance-obsessed culture, the right outfit opens doors that gold cannot, and the wrong one closes them permanently.

Covers: outfits, coordination, status signaling, image craft. Not: making or repairing the garment itself, which is Tailoring. Easy: put-together. Medium: dressed to intent. Hard: an entrance the room notices. Very hard: an image that rewrites your standing. Extremely hard: the look the season is named after.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Lightning Magic.name: Lightning Magic
Lightning Magic.description:
The study and mastery of lightning as a magical discipline. Covers electrical discharge, paralysis, chain reactions, and magnetic manipulation. Fast, flashy, and the element most likely to make your hair permanently stand up.

Covers: electrical discharge, chains, stuns, speed. Not: the surrounding storm itself, which is Storm Magic. Easy: a static jolt. Medium: a clean bolt. Hard: a chain through chosen targets. Very hard: a battlefield stunned into an opening. Extremely hard: lightning with a monarch.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Relic Appraisal.name: Relic Appraisal
Relic Appraisal.description:
The study and evaluation of ancient artifacts, dungeon relics, cursed items, Reborn anomalies, and objects that clearly should not exist. Relic Appraisal covers identification, provenance research, danger assessment, activation theory, and the delicate art of figuring out what a mysterious object does before it does it to you. A skilled appraiser can distinguish a holy relic from a cursed imitation, estimate an artifact's age and origin, and safely coax dormant powers back to life. An appraisal is read in the appraiser's head: nobody learns its result unless told.

Covers: artifacts, cursed items, Reborn anomalies, provenance. Not: market value and haggling, which is Merchant Trade. Easy: date a common relic. Medium: spot a curse before it's touched. Hard: identify an artifact's true function. Very hard: read a relic's full history. Extremely hard: name what the museums mislabeled for centuries.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Treasure Seeking.name: Treasure Seeking
Treasure Seeking.description:
The treasure-hunting art of finding hidden chests, secret rooms, old caches, lost heirlooms, and shiny distractions that other adventurers walked right past. Treasure Seeking covers detection intuition, trap awareness, hidden compartment identification, and the particular sixth sense that makes you visibly perk up when someone says "probably nothing." A skilled treasure seeker finds loot that funds entire expeditions and can bypass the protections that keep lesser adventurers from the best prizes.

Covers: hidden caches, secret rooms, lost heirlooms, buried finds. Not: reading a dungeon layout and its hazards, which is Dungeon Surveying. Easy: spot the obvious stash. Medium: find the concealed compartment. Hard: locate the sealed room by its silence. Very hard: follow a cold trail to a lost hoard. Extremely hard: find what the map was drawn to hide.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Dungeon Surveying.name: Dungeon Surveying
Dungeon Surveying.description:
The mapping and analysis craft of reading dungeon layouts, marking safe paths, identifying trap logic, predicting architectural patterns, and figuring out why the building hates everyone inside it. Dungeon Surveying covers cartography, environmental analysis, trap identification, hazard assessment, and the invaluable ability to produce a functional map when everyone else is lost. A skilled surveyor can navigate a shifting Riftmaw floor, identify a trap's trigger before it activates, and draw a map on a napkin that saves the party's life.

Covers: layout reading, safe paths, trap patterns, structural risk. Not: examining a single object or questioning a person, which is investigation. Easy: map a cleared floor. Medium: read a floor's trap logic. Hard: predict the layout past the next door. Very hard: chart a shifting dungeon reliably. Extremely hard: read the Riftmaw's intent from its walls.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Spirit Channeling.name: Spirit Channeling
Spirit Channeling.description:
The spirit art of communing with ghosts, residual entities, and the echoes the dead leave behind in haunted locations, ancient ruins, and Riftmaw dungeons. Spirit Channeling covers séance technique, spectral negotiation, last-word interpretation, and the delicate craft of getting information from spirits without becoming their next obsession. A trained medium can hear what the dead have to say, and in a world full of ancient ruins and forgotten battlefields, the dead have a lot to say.

Covers: communing with ghosts, echoes, residual entities, and calling and binding summoned spirits and creatures. Not: acting on a soul directly, which is Soul Magic. Easy: sense a presence. Medium: a simple exchange with the recently passed. Hard: draw a clear account from an echo. Very hard: negotiate with an old, angry haunt. Extremely hard: an answer from something the veil respects.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Monster Harvesting.name: Monster Harvesting
Monster Harvesting.description:
The harvesting craft of collecting usable parts from defeated monsters before the Riftlight fully fades: cores, scales, claws, hides, glands, feathers, fangs, and stranger things that only a trained eye would think to take. Monster Harvesting covers anatomical knowledge, extraction technique, material preservation, and the delicate art of getting maximum value from a kill without ruining the loot or your fingers. A skilled harvester gets three times the materials from a monster that an untrained looter would miss entirely.

Covers: collecting parts before Riftlight dissolution, field dressing. Not: crystal and shard recovery, which is Crystal Prospecting. Easy: take the common drop. Medium: harvest a delicate organ intact. Hard: beat the dissolution on a rare part. Very hard: full-yield a dangerous carcass. Extremely hard: the harvest guilds write procedures from.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Crystal Prospecting.name: Crystal Prospecting
Crystal Prospecting.description:
The prospecting art of locating mana crystals, Riftlight shards, elemental gems, resonance stones, and dungeon crystal growths before anyone else notices them. Crystal Prospecting covers resonance detection, mineral surveying, safe extraction, and the specialized intuition that tells you whether that glowing deposit is a valuable resource or about to destabilize the floor you are standing on. A skilled prospector can fund an expedition with a single find and identify the crystalline composition of a monster's lair by the shimmer in the air.

Covers: mana crystals, Riftlight shards, resonance stones, veins. Not: ordinary ore and tunnel work, which is Mining. Easy: spot surface shards. Medium: read a resonance trail. Hard: locate a buried vein precisely. Very hard: find gem-grade crystal in spent ground. Extremely hard: the strike that founds a town.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Occult Lore.name: Occult Lore
Occult Lore.description:
Knowledge of pacts, seals, curses, demon contracts, forbidden names, ritual clauses, and the paperwork-shaped disasters of dark magic. Occult Lore helps interpret cursed tomes, bargain safely, recognize dangerous bindings, and avoid signing away something important.

Covers: pacts, seals, demon contracts, forbidden names, ritual clauses. Not: casting the working itself, which is Dark Magic. Easy: recognize a standard seal. Medium: read a contract's real terms. Hard: spot the trap clause before signing. Very hard: unpick a binding's logic safely. Extremely hard: know the name they scratched from every record.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Focus.name: Focus
Focus.description:
Mental discipline under pressure: steady breathing, concentration, resisting panic, holding a technique together, and doing one difficult thing while everything around you is trying to become a disaster.

Covers: concentration, panic resistance, holding spells under pressure. Not: internal energy circulation and body tempering, which is Qi Cultivation. Easy: steady through noise. Medium: hold concentration while hurt. Hard: keep casting through chaos. Very hard: unshaken at the edge of disaster. Extremely hard: stillness the crisis breaks against.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom

Qi Cultivation.name: Qi Cultivation
Qi Cultivation.description:
The internal art of refining the body into a vessel for circulating force. Qi Cultivation covers breath control, meridian opening, body tempering, iron-body conditioning, and the long patient work of turning flesh into something that does not break. Where other magic reaches outward, this one is built inward, one breakthrough at a time.

Covers: circulation, body tempering, iron body, breath control, breakthroughs. Not: the striking technique itself, which is Unarmed Combat, or enduring punishment, which is Endurance Combat. Easy: steady your breathing under strain. Medium: harden the body against a blow. Hard: circulate through a wound and keep moving. Very hard: take a killing strike and remain standing. Extremely hard: a body the world cannot mark.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Endurance Combat.name: Endurance Combat
Endurance Combat.description:
The attrition art of winning fights by still being there at the end. Endurance Combat covers absorbing punishment, trading hits deliberately to create openings, fighting through injury, pacing a long engagement, and the specific discipline of refusing to fall over when falling over is reasonable.

Covers: damage absorption, deliberate trades, fighting wounded, attrition pacing. Not: internal circulation and breakthroughs, which is Qi Cultivation. Easy: shrug off a solid hit. Medium: keep fighting past first blood. Hard: outlast a stronger opponent. Very hard: win a fight you should have lost. Extremely hard: the one who was still standing.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Grappling.name: Grappling
Grappling.description:
The close art of controlling another body with your own. Grappling covers clinches, throws, joint locks, pins, escapes, and the deeply unglamorous business of deciding where a fight happens and refusing to let go once you have decided.

Covers: clinches, throws, locks, pins, escapes, ground control. A choke or a break the player means to kill with kills. Not: raw lifting and hauling power, which is athletics. Easy: break a grab. Medium: throw an equal opponent. Hard: pin someone stronger. Very hard: control a monster twice your size. Extremely hard: nothing you hold gets away.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Fang and Claw.name: Fang and Claw
Fang and Claw.description:
Fighting with the weapons a body grows. Fang and Claw is the art of anything born armed: claws, talons, fangs, beaks, pincers, stingers and barbed tails, used the way the creature that owns them was built to use them. It is the oldest fighting style in Luxcellia and the only one nobody had to invent.

Covers: claw and talon strikes, bites, rending, tail and stinger attacks, holding on with the jaws. Not: punches, kicks and trained martial arts, which are Unarmed Combat; whole-body rams and tramples, which are Charge and Crush. Easy: rake an unarmored foe. Medium: bite through a guard. Hard: bring down prey larger than you. Very hard: open armor with claws alone. Extremely hard: kill what was built not to die.

Primary Attribute: Strength

Charge and Crush.name: Charge and Crush
Charge and Crush.description:
Fighting with mass and momentum. Charge and Crush covers the tackle, the ram, the stomp and the long run-up: every way a body can be turned into a thrown object and aimed at something. Horns, hooves, shoulders and sheer weight all count. It rewards being hard to stop more than being hard to hit.

Covers: tackles, charges, rams, gores, stomps, tramples, body slams, pinning with weight. Not: holds, locks and throws, which are Grappling; claws and bites, which are Fang and Claw. Easy: knock down something your size. Medium: break a braced guard. Hard: scatter a line of foes. Very hard: bowl over something twice your weight. Extremely hard: go through a gate.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Wing and Dive.name: Wing and Dive
Wing and Dive.description:
Fighting from the air. Wing and Dive is the craft of anything that leaves the ground and uses the sky as a weapon: the buffet, the swoop, the stoop from height, the snatch in passing. Wings help, but a serpent that swims through cloud or a spirit that drifts on nothing uses the same angles and the same patience.

Covers: wing strikes, swoops, dives, aerial snatches, fighting while flying, using height and speed. Not: getting somewhere by air with nobody to fight, which is acrobatics; wind spells, which are Wind Magic. Easy: buffet something at arm's length. Medium: strike in passing and stay out of reach. Hard: snatch a moving target. Very hard: fight in the air against archers. Extremely hard: win a duel in a storm.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity

Uncanny Body.name: Uncanny Body
Uncanny Body.description:
Fighting with a body that is not built like a body. Slime, stone, living wood, loose bone, clockwork, hollow armor, flame and light all break the rules that flesh obeys, and Uncanny Body is the skill of using that on purpose: hardening, flattening, stretching, splitting apart and pulling back together.

Covers: slams with an unusual body, hardening, reshaping, engulfing, splitting and re-forming, strikes no jointed body could make. Not: turning into another creature or a person, which no body does without an ability that says so; elemental spells, which are their own schools. Easy: squeeze through a gap. Medium: catch a blade in yourself. Hard: come apart around a blow. Very hard: fight in several pieces at once. Extremely hard: re-form from almost nothing.

Primary Attribute: Constitution

Psionics.name: Psionics
Psionics.description:
The trained mind acting directly on the world. Psionics is thought used as a hand and a voice: words sent without sound, the top of another mind read like a face, a cup lifted across a room, a door held shut by will. The Academy files it under magic because it spends Mana. Psions say it is the only school that needs no chant, circle or element, and they are correct.

Covers: telepathy, sensing surface thoughts, telekinesis, mental shoves, psychic strikes. Not: charm and compulsion, which are Charm Magic; false images, which are Illusion Magic; sleep and dreams, which are Dream Magic; the dead and the soul, which are Soul Magic. Easy: speak mind to mind with a willing friend. Medium: lift and throw something you could carry. Hard: read the surface of a guarded mind. Very hard: hold a struggling foe in place. Extremely hard: move what a team of oxen could not.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence

Command.name: Command
Command.description:
Leading people in the moment: giving orders that are heard over the noise, reading a fight and calling the play, steadying a frightened line, and turning a party of individuals into one plan.

Covers: battlefield orders, tactical calls, rallying, coordinating a party, and the sharp tactical edge of a good plan. Not: persuading someone to agree, which is persuasion, or frightening them, which is intimidation. Easy: a clear order followed. Medium: a called flank that lands. Hard: hold a breaking line together. Very hard: turn a rout into a fighting retreat. Extremely hard: the plan an army still studies.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Bow.name: Bow
Bow.description:
Patience made lethal. Every shot folds wind, distance, timing, and nerve into a single calculation, and a good archer sets the pace of a fight from ground nobody else can reach. One well-placed arrow can close an encounter before it opens. It runs on discipline, awareness, and the quiet confidence of someone who already knows how this ends.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Bow.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a bow. Describe combat with precise aimed shots, tactical positioning, ranged superiority, and the patient marksman's philosophy. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Archery.

Bun.name: Bun
Bun.description: Hair gathered into a simple bun, neat, contained, and the kind of style that says you have better things to do than fix your hair every five minutes.
Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair gathered into a bun at the back of the head.

Afro.name: Afro
Afro.description: Afro styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Afro.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use afro as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.description:
You weaponized art, and art is winning. Bards fight with music, melodies that inspire allies, discordant notes that unravel enemies, and insults sharp enough to draw blood. Your presence turns a losing fight into a montage with a soundtrack. You bolster allies, unravel foes, and narrate the fray, and someday the song about this battle will mention, prominently, who made it survivable.

Primary Attribute: Charisma

Instrument choice: choose any instrument under Signature Weapon (Lute, Guitar, Stormstring Guitar, Violin, Flute, Harp, Lyre, Zither, Shamisen, Piano, War Drum, Taiko Drum, Tambourine, Maracas or Suzu Bells) to give your bard a matching starting instrument. Inspiring Melody and Discordant Note work through your chosen instrument; their existing requirements and cooldowns still apply.
Bard.traitNarrativeEffects: You compose songs about your party's adventures in real time and have been threatened with violence over the accuracy of the romantic subplot verses. Honor the instrument explicitly chosen under Signature Weapon when describing bard performances. The default Well-Worn Lute is a spare if a different signature instrument was selected, not an override of that choice.

Cook.name: Cook
Cook.description:
A comfort-focused food maker who feeds people well, builds community, and quietly solves more problems than anyone admits through excellent meals. This is wholesome fantasy domestic power.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Cook.traitNarrativeEffects: You remember everyone's favorite food and weaponize that knowledge emotionally.

Fair.name: Fair
Fair.description: Light skin with neutral undertones, the most common complexion in the Sunken Crown's inner cities. Clear and even.
Fair.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. Your face flushes visibly when you are embarrassed or angry, and everyone notices.

Locs.name: Locs
Locs.description: Locs styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Locs.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use locs as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Mage.name: Mage
Mage.description:
The nuclear option, in human form. Mages command the raw elements with academic precision and dramatic results, Mana Bolts on demand, Elemental Attunement that makes fire burn hotter and ice bite deeper on request. You are the party's artillery, its problem-solver, and its property damage, in that order. Every fight has a moment where they point at something. You are what happens next.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Mage.traitNarrativeEffects: You solve an unreasonable number of problems with fire and consider 'more mana' a valid answer to every question.

Monk.name: Monk
Monk.description:
Your body is the weapon, your breath is the technique. Monks channel ki into fists that hit like warhammers and reflexes that border on precognition, Palm Strikes with a mountain behind them, a Flow State where the world slows down and you simply don't. No steel, no armor, no wasted motion. Enemies describe it as fencing water that has read their diary.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Dexterity
Monk.traitNarrativeEffects: You meditate at dawn regardless of circumstance and have punched through at least one thing everyone else considered unbreakable.

Sage.name: Sage
Sage.description:
If Mages are the artillery, Sages are the architects. You command pure arcane structure, Mana Constructs shaped at thought-speed, Dispels that edit the enemy's plans out of the air. Barriers, counterspells, spatial control: you don't overpower the enemy's magic, you REORGANIZE it. The party points at chaos. You return order, invoiced.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Sage.traitNarrativeEffects: You correct people's magical terminology mid-crisis, you build small mana constructs while thinking the way others drum fingers, and you've said 'technically, that's impossible' while watching yourself do it.

Whip.name: Whip
Whip.description:
A flexible weapon with startling range and a flair for the theatrical. It strikes, grapples, disarms, swings from fixtures, hooks objects, and cracks loud enough to announce you to everyone within earshot. Whips are rare on a battlefield because they are genuinely hard to use, so anyone carrying one is a master or a fool, and the difference becomes obvious very fast.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Whip.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a whip. Describe combat with cracking strikes, grappling pulls, disarming lashes, acrobatic swinging, and the dramatic flair of a weapon that is as much performance as combat. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Ahoge.name: Ahoge
Ahoge.description: The iconic antenna strand, a single defiant lock of hair that stands straight up from the crown, wobbling with emotion and refusing to be tamed. It's the universal mark of the protagonist, the clueless genius, and anyone whose heart is bigger than their brain. The ahoge reacts to feelings, points toward trouble, and somehow makes the rest of the hair look better by comparison. It is, against all logic, attractive.
Ahoge.traitNarrativeEffects: Your ahoge wiggles when you're emotional, points toward plot-relevant locations, and has been mistaken for an antenna by at least three different people.

Human.name: Human
Human.description:
No special bloodline, no ancient heritage, no mystical ancestry. Just human. In most worlds that would make you ordinary, but in Luxcellia, humans have the highest growth potential of any race. Where elves plateau and demons specialize, humans just keep getting stronger. The other races find this deeply unsettling. You start with nothing special and end up breaking the level cap. Classic isekai protagonist energy.

RACE REFERENCE: Human is the visual baseline for Luxcellia: fully human face, skin, ears, hands, posture, and body plan. Use adaptability, social range, and growth potential as the background hook rather than visible fantasy anatomy.
Human.traitNarrativeEffects: You get asked 'what's your Blessing?' more often than is polite, and you've started making up increasingly absurd answers. RACE REFERENCE: Human is the visual baseline for Luxcellia: fully human face, skin, ears, hands, posture, and body plan.

Miner.name: Miner
Miner.description:
A delver into ore, tunnels, and stone. Miners understand the earth from the inside and are very hard to impress with dark cramped spaces.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Miner.traitNarrativeEffects: You tap walls to hear what they are made of and refuse to apologize for it.

Ninja.name: Ninja
Ninja.description:
The shadow arts, practiced until the supernatural got jealous. Ninjas blend stealth, technique, and deception into something that shouldn't be possible without magic and mostly isn't magic, Shadow Clones that take the hit, Kunai Barrages from angles that require explanation. You are wherever the enemy checked last. That is not a coincidence. That is the curriculum.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Ninja.traitNarrativeEffects: You enter rooms through the second-most-obvious route on principle, you count exits before sitting down, and party members have learned to say your name BEFORE turning around, as a courtesy to their own hearts.

Spear.name: Spear
Spear.description:
Reach, versatility, and the oldest good idea in the history of weapons. A spear keeps trouble at distance, throws in a pinch, fights in formation or alone, and pairs with a shield better than any sword. Soldiers, dragoons, and monster-hunters all keep coming back to the same conclusion: the fight usually belongs to whoever controls the distance.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Spear.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a spear or polearm. Describe combat with thrusts, sweeps, reach control, and the disciplined power of a trained lancer. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Staff.name: Staff
Staff.description:
A length of wood, crystal, metal, or bone that serves as the classic focus for magic and a surprisingly effective club when the spells run dry. A staff channels mana more efficiently than any other focus, sharpens a caster's output, and blocks a sword when it has to. It tells everyone watching that you're a mage, and everyone who underestimates that you can also crack a skull.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Staff.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a magical staff. Describe combat with spell channeling, mana blasts, staff strikes, and the image of a mage wielding their focus as both conduit and weapon. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Arcane Magic.

Witch.name: Witch
Witch.description:
Less arcane textbook, more village rumor with receipts. Witches stack folk magic until it becomes terrifying, Hexes sewn into last Tuesday, a Familiar's Aid from the judgmental little colleague in the rafters. The fight was decided by the charm in your enemy's cloak and the brew in their rations. Underestimating a Witch is traditional. So is regretting it. The cackle is earned. Every time.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Witch.traitNarrativeEffects: You cackle at dramatically appropriate moments, your familiar judges everyone you meet and is usually right, and you keep saying 'that'll be useful later' about items that are, infuriatingly, always useful later.

Catkin.name: Catkin
Catkin.description:
Cat ears that flatten when annoyed. A tail that twitches with every mood shift. Reflexes so sharp that assassins study catkin movement patterns out of professional jealousy. Catkin are agile, independent, and selectively affectionate, warm and purring one moment, aloof and untouchable the next, with a grace that makes every movement look intentional even when it isn't. You land on your feet, fit through spaces you shouldn't, and nap in sunbeams at dramatically inappropriate moments. Your companions find this infuriating. You find their frustration entertaining.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Catkin have human skin, cat ears, and a cat tail; no fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no whisker pads, no full cat face.

RACE REFERENCE: Catkin is a humanoid person with cat ears, one cat tail, slit or bright eyes if selected, and graceful feline movement. Use curiosity, independence, balance, and ears/tail giving away emotion as background hooks.
Catkin.traitNarrativeEffects: You get distracted by moving objects, you refuse to admit you were napping when caught, and warm laps are an ongoing weakness you will never acknowledge. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Catkin have human skin, cat ears, and a cat tail; no fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no whisker pads, no full cat face. RACE REFERENCE: Catkin is a humanoid person with cat ears, one cat tail, slit or bright eyes if selected, and graceful feline movement.

Chains.name: Chains
Chains.description:
Heavy links with weighted ends, made for binding, pulling, entangling, and delivering crushing blows from angles nobody watches for. A chain grapples at range, wraps limbs, catches a weapon to tear it away, and slams with momentum that builds every spin. Jailers, chain-dancers, and control fighters love it for the same reason: it manages where the enemy can go, not just how much they hurt.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Chains.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with chains. Describe combat with binding wraps, sweeping weighted strikes, grappling pulls, momentum-building spins, and the raw industrial menace of turning restraints into weapons. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Dancer.name: Dancer
Dancer.description:
You fight like water, and water is winning. Dancers weaponize grace itself, every dodge is a step, every strike is a flourish, and Elegant Footwork keeps you at perfect range while denying the enemy a clean target. Your Enthralling Performance stops rooms mid-sentence. Enemies describe fighting you as fencing a rumor. The rumor is armed.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Dancer.traitNarrativeEffects: You stretch before every fight and critique your own form afterward. Combat is art and you refuse to make ugly art.

Farmer.name: Farmer
Farmer.description:
A cultivator of crops, orchards, soil, seasons, and honest routine. Farmers embody the indulgent cozy side of isekai life while quietly holding civilization together.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Farmer.traitNarrativeEffects: You judge every settlement by soil quality before politics.

Fisher.name: Fisher
Fisher.description:
A livelihood built on nets, lines, rivers, lakes, and practical patience. Fishers know weather, water, and the kind of stories only told before dawn on a dock.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Fisher.traitNarrativeEffects: You treat fishing like a sacred duel between souls.

Foxkin.name: Foxkin
Foxkin.description:
Fox ears that swivel toward interesting conversations. A tail so luxuriously fluffy it has been described as a 'tactical distraction.' An inherited talent for illusion magic that your ancestors definitely used for noble purposes and not elaborate pranks. Foxkin are the charmers of the beastkin clans, quick-witted, silver-tongued, and dangerously beautiful in a way that makes other races forget they're being manipulated. You are aware of this effect. You use it. You feel only slightly guilty about it.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Foxkin have human skin, fox ears, and a fox tail; no fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no full fox face.

RACE REFERENCE: Foxkin is a humanoid person with fox ears, one fluffy fox tail, clever expression, and nimble posture. Use sly humor, sharp hearing, scent memory, and social misdirection as background hooks.
Foxkin.traitNarrativeEffects: Your tail wags when you're scheming and you can't stop it, which somewhat undermines the scheming. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Foxkin have human skin, fox ears, and a fox tail; no fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no full fox face. RACE REFERENCE: Foxkin is a humanoid person with fox ears, one fluffy fox tail, clever expression, and nimble posture.

Goatee.name: Goatee
Goatee.description: Chin beard with or without a connected mustache, the classic villain look, the scholar look, and the 'I'm the cool mentor' look all in one.
Goatee.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a goatee on the chin.

Kanabo.name: Kanabo
Kanabo.description:
A massive spiked iron club with no edge, no finesse, and no interest in either. Oni carry it, enforcers carry it, and so does anyone who looked at a sword and thought it lacked crushing. Every swing is a shockwave; every hit is a short argument between the target's durability and the kanabo's total lack of respect for it. Shields break, armor dents, the ground cracks.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Kanabo.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a kanabo. Describe combat with thunderous overhead smashes, ground-cratering impacts, armor-shattering strikes, and the primal satisfaction of hitting something so hard it stops being a problem. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

Katana.name: Katana
Katana.description:
A single curved blade built for the kind of precise cut that ends a fight before the other person is sure it started. The katana suits disciplined swordsmen, wandering ronin, and anyone who loves the drama of a clean draw-and-strike. It runs on patience and timing rather than muscle, and it quietly insists that one perfect cut beats ten frantic ones.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Katana.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a katana. Describe combat with emphasis on precise slashes, draw techniques, single decisive cuts, and the elegant minimalism of Japanese-inspired swordsmanship. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Swordsmanship.

Knight.name: Knight
Knight.description:
Where the Swordsman cuts, the Knight holds. You are the shield wall between your party and death, Shield Bashes that reset the enemy's plans, a Guard Stance that turns you into policy. Heavy armor, unwavering resolve, and the quiet arithmetic of the front line: every second you refuse to fall is a second your party spends winning. The wall holds. You're why.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: You stand between people and things by pure reflex, doorways, drafts, bad news, you polish your shield during downtime like a meditation, and you say 'stay behind me' so often the party has it embroidered somewhere.

Mohawk.name: Mohawk
Mohawk.description: Mohawk styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Mohawk.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use mohawk as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Priest.name: Priest
Priest.description:
You are the reason adventuring parties survive long enough to become famous. Priests channel the First Light into the field, Healing Light that everyone on the continent can recognize with their eyes closed, Sacred Wards that catch the blow nobody saw. You are the party's margin for error. They spend it constantly. You keep making more.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Priest.traitNarrativeEffects: You heal people while lecturing them about the injury that required healing, and your disapproving sigh has become a party inside joke.

Ranger.name: Ranger
Ranger.description:
You are the reason the party didn't walk into the ambush. Rangers master the bow and the wild in equal measure, Aimed Shots that end problems at distances problems don't expect, a Tracking Sense that reads the ground like a confession. You see first, you shoot first, and the wilderness is a colleague, not an obstacle. Nobody surprises a Ranger's party twice. Nobody surprises it once, usually.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Ranger.traitNarrativeEffects: You walk without sound even indoors, which has startled every party member at least twice, you can't pass a trail without reading it aloud, and you've named every hawk in the region. They come when called. All of them.

Rapier.name: Rapier
Rapier.description:
Thin, elegant, and surgically precise. The rapier is the duelist's answer to a fight, all economical motion and thrusts aimed at the one gap in the guard. It favors speed and read over strength, and in the right hands a swordfight turns into a fast conversation where every exchange gives something away. Beautiful to watch, unpleasant to be on the wrong end of.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Rapier.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a rapier. Describe combat with precise thrusts, elegant parries, footwork-intensive dueling, and the refined style of a fencer or aristocratic swordsman. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dueling.

Reaper.name: Reaper
Reaper.description:
Death is a discipline, and you majored in it. Reapers wield the scythe as philosophy, Soul Reaps that harvest what the cut releases, Shadow Step Strikes arriving on the exhale. Your silhouette does half the work before the blade does the rest. Enemies facing a Reaper report the same instinct, every time: the sudden, specific certainty that they are being COLLECTED.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Reaper.traitNarrativeEffects: You appear beside people without approaching, you absentmindedly sharpen the scythe during conversations about the future, and you say 'not yet' to no one in particular at odd moments. Nobody asks. Everyone wonders.

Scribe.name: Scribe
Scribe.description:
A writer, copier, record-keeper, and document specialist. Scribes handle letters, contracts, books, spell notes, and the paper trail that secretly keeps fantasy worlds running.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Scribe.traitNarrativeEffects: You silently correct grammar on wanted posters.

Shaman.name: Shaman
Shaman.description:
You stand where the worlds overlap, and both sides take your calls. Shamans channel spirits, ancestors, and the raw voice of nature, Spirit Bonds that lend strength across the veil, Totem Wards that make ground sacred on short notice. You are the party's connection to everything older than the map. The spirits are enthusiastic about helping. Occasionally alarmingly so.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Shaman.traitNarrativeEffects: You hold up one finger mid-conversation to listen to someone nobody else can see, you leave the best portion of every meal 'for the grandmothers,' and your advice is suspiciously good on matters you weren't present for.

Tailor.name: Tailor
Tailor.description:
A garment maker concerned with fit, structure, fabric, and wearable fantasy. Tailors build clothes people actually live in, from noble dresses to travel layers.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Tailor.traitNarrativeEffects: You can identify someone's social class, faction, and recent emotional crisis by the state of their outfit.

Warden.name: Warden
Warden.description:
A living fortress that nature agreed to reinforce. Wardens wrap defense in green, Nature's Grasp holding the enemy where you want them, Ironbark Shields that grow back mid-siege. Where Paladins protect through faith and Shield Saints through stubbornness, you protect through ROOTS: patient, renewable, and impossible to remove without upsetting the entire forest. The forest upsets easily.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Warden.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively position yourself between danger and everyone else, even in conversations. Doorways feel like defensive chokepoints and you've ranked every tavern by sightlines.

Bob Cut.name: Bob Cut
Bob Cut.description: A clean, chin-length bob that frames the face sharply, neat, modern, and stylish. The bob is the hairstyle of confident characters who don't need length to make a statement. It accentuates the jawline and makes eye contact feel twice as intense.
Bob Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Your bob swings when you turn your head and it hypnotizes people. This is not an exaggeration.

Chakram.name: Chakram
Chakram.description:
A razor-edged steel ring that carves through the air and comes back to your hand, a weapon that flatly refuses to stay thrown. It ricochets off walls, cuts through several targets in one pass, and slashes at close range when an enemy makes the mistake of relaxing. Precision throwers treat the whole room as one lethal geometry problem and solve it mid-fight.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Chakram.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with chakram. Describe combat with razor-ring throwing, ricocheting returns, close-range slash-and-release techniques, and the stylish lethality of a weapon that always comes back. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Deerkin.name: Deerkin
Deerkin.description:
Graceful cervine beastkin with soft deer ears, small tails, luminous eyes, and either delicate antlers or elegant antler-like markings depending on lineage. Deerkin are associated with forest paths, shrine groves, quiet courage, and the kind of beauty that feels gentle until danger appears. Their movements are light and precise, their instincts are sharp, and their social presence often calms tense rooms. In Luxcellia, Deerkin are valued as scouts, shrine attendants, healers, archers, herbalists, and diplomats between wild places and settled roads. They look fragile to fools. They survive because they notice everything.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Deerkin have human skin, deer ears, optional small antlers, and a subtle tail; no full deer body, no muzzle, no fur-covered skin.

RACE REFERENCE: Deerkin is a humanoid person with deer ears, optional small antlers, gentle eyes, woodland grace, and normal humanoid hands and legs. Use forest etiquette, calm presence, cautious instincts, and antler/ear tells as background hooks.
Deerkin.traitNarrativeEffects: Your ears turn toward every sudden sound before you do, your steps are almost silent when you're calm, and people keep assuming your gentleness means you are easy to corner. They are wrong. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Deerkin have human skin, deer ears, optional small antlers, and a subtle tail; no full deer body, no muzzle, no fur-covered skin. RACE REFERENCE: Deerkin is a humanoid person with deer ears, optional small antlers, gentle eyes, woodland grace, and normal humanoid hands and legs.

Dhampir.name: Dhampir
Dhampir.description:
Born of a vampire and a mortal, you inherited the beauty, the speed, the supernatural senses, and the predatory instincts, but not the fatal weakness to sunlight. Dhampir are pale, sharp-featured, and attractive in the way that only things standing near death can be: dark-ringed eyes that see in perfect black, canines just slightly too long, a stillness that makes people's survival instincts whisper warnings their conscious minds ignore. You can feel the undead nearby, smell blood from a hundred paces, and move fast enough to make trained assassins look sluggish. Vampire covens fear you, because you have their strengths and none of their chains. The living fear you too, but they can't look away.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Dhampirs look humanlike with pale beauty, fangs, and subtle undead elegance; no corpse body, no bat monster anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Dhampir is a humanoid half-vampire with pale elegance, fangs, sharp senses, predatory stillness, and living warmth. Use sunlight tolerance, blood hunger restraint, undead sense, and social unease as background hooks.
Dhampir.traitNarrativeEffects: Your reflection is slightly delayed, just enough for observant people to notice, and you instinctively avoid garlic without knowing why. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Dhampirs look humanlike with pale beauty, fangs, and subtle undead elegance; no corpse body, no bat monster anatomy. RACE REFERENCE: Dhampir is a humanoid half-vampire with pale elegance, fangs, sharp senses, predatory stillness, and living warmth.

Dimples.name: Dimples
Dimples.description: Visible dimples when smiling, small creases in the cheeks that make every grin approximately forty percent more disarming.
Dimples.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render visible dimples on the cheeks.

Dragoon.name: Dragoon
Dragoon.description:
Airborne death on a spear. Dragoons trade the ancient dragons for magically enhanced legs and lose nothing in the exchange, Jump Strikes that fall out of the sky, Piercing Thrusts with a full sprint of physics behind them. The battlefield is three-dimensional and you are the only one using the third axis. Enemies learn to check the sky. By then it's scheduling.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Dragoon.traitNarrativeEffects: You look up before you look around, and your knees are in suspiciously good condition for someone who falls from great heights regularly.

Duelist.name: Duelist
Duelist.description:
The aristocrat of single combat. Where the Swordsman overwhelms, the Duelist dismantles, Precision Thrusts through the exact gap, Parries that read as punctuation, and a rapier that treats every exchange as a conversation you're winning. You fight one opponent at a time, beautifully, and the formal challenge is your natural habitat. Come alone. You always do.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Duelist.traitNarrativeEffects: You issue formal challenges over minor disagreements, including board games, you polish your rapier during conversations you find tedious, and you have never once run from a fight, you withdraw, with footnotes.

Forager.name: Forager
Forager.description:
A gatherer of wild ingredients, mushrooms, roots, berries, and whatever useful thing the average person walked past without noticing. Foragers excel at making the land pay attention.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Forager.traitNarrativeEffects: You say "this is edible" with terrifying confidence.

Jeweler.name: Jeweler
Jeweler.description:
A maker of rings, necklaces, brooches, and precious accessories. Jewelers deal in beauty, symbolism, gifts, and small luxuries that can start very large stories.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Jeweler.traitNarrativeEffects: You notice jewelry before faces and can tell when a noble is lying about being broke.

Lob Cut.name: Lob Cut
Lob Cut.description: A long bob (lob) cut, shoulder-grazing, versatile, and the kind of length that's short enough to manage but long enough to style. The practical sophisticate's choice.
Lob Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render a long bob cut reaching to the shoulders.

Low Bun.name: Low Bun
Low Bun.description: Low Bun styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Low Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use low bun as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Man Bun.name: Man Bun
Man Bun.description: A man bun, hair gathered at the top or back of the head in a casually masculine style. Practical, slightly rebellious, and the official hairstyle of people who have given up on combs.
Man Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair gathered into a bun at the top or back of the head in a casual masculine style.

Mothkin.name: Mothkin
Mothkin.description:
A nocturnal humanoid demi-human touched by moonlit wings, dust-soft magic, dream lanterns, and quiet night shrines. Mothkin are drawn to light, dreams, secrets, and soft-spoken rituals; they often feel gentle at first glance but become eerie when the moon rises or illusions begin to move. They suit dream mages, shrine attendants, night-market guides, and companions who know which beautiful things are dangerous after dark. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: humanoid person with human skin, delicate antennae, moth-wing accents or cloak-like wing silhouette; no insect body, no chitin torso, no extra arms, no bug face.

RACE REFERENCE: Mothkin is a nocturnal humanoid with humanlike face, delicate antennae, soft wing accents, powdery light motes, and moonlit coloration. Use lantern attraction, dreams, quiet perception, and night-shrine instincts as background hooks.
Mothkin.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Mention moonlight, powder-soft wing motes, dream instincts, lantern attraction, and quiet nocturnal perception. Portraits must stay humanoid and attractive anime fantasy, with antennae/wing accents only.

Paladin.name: Paladin
Paladin.description:
The Church handed a Knight divine magic and said go be righteous. That's you. Paladins smite the unholy AND heal the wounded, Holy Strikes that flash gold at impact, Lay on Hands for whoever the strike was protecting. You are armor, faith, and follow-through in one package. Insufferably admirable, dependably first in, and the undead's least favorite scheduling conflict.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Paladin.traitNarrativeEffects: Your armor literally glows when you're being particularly righteous, which makes sneaking and morally questionable decisions equally difficult.

Samurai.name: Samurai
Samurai.description:
The blade is a philosophy, and you live by the argument. Samurai turn combat into code, Iaido Draws faster than sight, the Steel Blossom opening cuts like petals leaving a branch. Every duel is conducted with total presence and closed with total finality. Your stillness is not hesitation. It is the sentence being composed. The draw is just the signature.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Samurai.traitNarrativeEffects: You maintain your blade in complete silence each evening and consider it a conversation, you bow to worthy opponents before ruining their week, and you finish exactly one cup of tea before any duel. Exactly one.

War Fan.name: War Fan
War Fan.description:
A reinforced folding fan, beautiful and deceptive, hiding bladed edges behind an elegant exterior. It blocks, slashes, steers wind magic, and throws as a projectile. Closed it's a baton, open it's a blade, held loosely it's an accessory. Courtly warriors and dancer-fighters carry it on the principle that looking graceful while winning is basically an obligation. Nobody ever expects the fan.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
War Fan.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a war fan. Describe combat with sweeping slashes, wind-redirecting blocks, fan-throwing techniques, and the deceptive elegance of a weapon disguised as an accessory. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Fan Combat.

Warlock.name: Warlock
Warlock.description:
You read the contract twice and signed anyway. Warlocks borrow terrifyingly useful power from a patron with excellent penmanship, Hex Bolts on credit, a Demon's Whisper that always knows something. The magic arrives instantly, works beautifully, and is never free. Your true art is staying on the profitable side of your own book. So far, so good. Probably.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Warlock.traitNarrativeEffects: You read every contract twice, your shadow occasionally moves independently, and you always know when someone is lying about the terms.

Wolfkin.name: Wolfkin
Wolfkin.description:
Sharp instincts, a nose that can track a scent across a rainstorm, and pack loyalty so fierce it borders on terrifying. Wolfkin are the warriors and protectors of the beastkin clans, tall, powerful, and intensely devoted to anyone they consider family. Your ears pin back when you sense danger. Your growl ends most arguments before they start. You can smell lies, fear, and attraction on people, which makes social situations either much easier or deeply uncomfortable depending on the context. Other races find wolfkin magnetic, intimidating, and unreasonably attractive when angry.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Wolfkin have human skin, wolf ears, and a wolf tail; no fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no full wolf face.

RACE REFERENCE: Wolfkin is a humanoid person with wolf ears, one wolf tail, athletic posture, and pack-aware body language. Use loyalty, territory sense, scent tracking, and protective instincts as background hooks.
Wolfkin.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively position yourself between companions and doors, and your tail thumps against furniture when someone you like enters the room. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Wolfkin have human skin, wolf ears, and a wolf tail; no fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no full wolf face. RACE REFERENCE: Wolfkin is a humanoid person with wolf ears, one wolf tail, athletic posture, and pack-aware body language.

Assassin.name: Assassin
Assassin.description:
The fight was over before it started, they just don't know yet. Assassins specialize in stealth, positioning, and the single perfect strike: you Vanish, you flank, you Backstab, and the target's bodyguards spend the next hour explaining to someone important what they were doing instead. You are not built for fair fights. You are built to make sure there isn't one.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Assassin.traitNarrativeEffects: You enter rooms by finding the exit first, and people have stopped being startled when you appear behind them. Almost.

Beastkin.name: Beastkin
Beastkin.description:
Animal ears. Enhanced senses. Clan loyalty that borders on ferocity. Beastkin come in every variety, wolf, fox, cat, rabbit, hawk, and dozens more, and carry the physical traits of their beast lineage. Stronger, faster, and tougher than baseline humans, with instincts that border on supernatural. Beastkin society values strength, honesty, and pack bonds. They're also distractingly fluffy, which the other races pretend not to notice.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Beastkin have human skin and a normal humanoid body with animal ears and one tail only unless the player specifies otherwise. No fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no digitigrade legs, no full animal head.

RACE REFERENCE: Beastkin is a broad humanoid demi-human ancestry. Render a humanlike face and normal humanoid body with mammal-like ears, one expressive tail, and subtle animal tells. Use clan instincts, enhanced senses, and involuntary ear/tail reactions as background hooks.
Beastkin.traitNarrativeEffects: Your ears and tail react to your emotions before you can control them, which makes bluffing at cards basically impossible. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Beastkin have human skin and a normal humanoid body with animal ears and one tail only unless the player specifies otherwise. No fur-covered body, no muzzle, no paws, no digitigrade legs, no full animal head. RACE REFERENCE: Beastkin is a broad humanoid demi-human ancestry. Render a humanlike face and normal humanoid body with mammal-like ears, one expressive tail, and subtle animal tells.

Buzz Cut.name: Buzz Cut
Buzz Cut.description: Hair trimmed to near-uniform shortness across the scalp, military-clean, low-maintenance, and sharp. The buzz cut is the hairstyle of someone who has better things to do than style hair, and still looks good doing them.
Buzz Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Morning prep time: twelve seconds. You have used the saved time to become unreasonably competent at something.

Cornrows.name: Cornrows
Cornrows.description: Cornrows styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Cornrows.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use cornrows as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Crew Cut.name: Crew Cut
Crew Cut.description: Short, clean, and practical with slightly more length on top, a disciplined cut that splits the difference between military precision and personal style. The default look of academy cadets, off-duty knights, and anyone who values looking sharp without effort.
Crew Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Your barber is a quartermaster who uses the same blade for haircuts and combat. This explains both the precision and the occasional nick.

Dark Elf.name: Dark Elf
Dark Elf.description:
Twilight-skinned, silver-haired, and carrying the weight of a reputation the surface world built without asking your opinion. Dark elves, the Duskborn, the Twilight Kin, were driven underground generations ago by politics, war, or divine punishment depending on who tells the story. You have the elven grace, the magical talent, and the sharp senses, along with darkvision that makes you lethal in the places other races fear. Whether the surface world's distrust is earned or propaganda, you've learned to be twice as capable just to be taken half as seriously.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid elf with pointed ears and a natural skin tone selected by the player; do not force unnatural full-body monster skin unless a skin tone trait says so.

RACE REFERENCE: Dark Elf is a humanoid elf with pointed ears, twilight elegance, sharp senses, and skin tone controlled by the selected Skin Tone trait. Use underground/surface politics, darkvision, and guarded pride as background hooks.
Dark Elf.traitNarrativeEffects: You squint dramatically in bright sunlight and have strong opinions about surface-world architecture being 'wastefully open.' IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid elf with pointed ears and a natural skin tone selected by the player; do not force unnatural full-body monster skin unless a skin tone trait says so. RACE REFERENCE: Dark Elf is a humanoid elf with pointed ears, twilight elegance, sharp senses, and skin tone controlled by the selected Skin Tone trait.

Exorcist.name: Exorcist
Exorcist.description:
You fight the things the dark sends, and you win on purpose. Exorcists specialize in supernatural evil, Sacred Strikes that land like personal correspondence to demons, Evil Wards that make the unholy stand outside. Where Paladins are holy warriors who happen to meet monsters, you are the specialist they call when the monster has a NAME. You always ask for the name first.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Exorcist.traitNarrativeEffects: You can sense supernatural corruption like a bad smell and your expression when you detect it has made more than one demon sweat.

Freckles.name: Freckles
Freckles.description: A scatter of freckles across the nose and cheeks, sun-kissed, natural, and endlessly charming. They make intimidating characters approachable and cute characters devastating.
Freckles.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render visible freckles across the nose and cheeks.

Grimoire.name: Grimoire
Grimoire.description:
A magical book that works as weapon, focus, and library at once. It floats, turns to the right page on command, and channels spells straight through its text. The advanced ones grow their own indexes, lock their contents behind wards, and occasionally refuse to cooperate when they disapprove of the spell. Somewhere between a weapon and the wizard's most trusted, most opinionated companion.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Grimoire.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist channels magic through a floating grimoire. Describe combat with pages turning on their own, runic text glowing as spells activate, and the dramatic image of a book that fights alongside its reader. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Arcane Magic.

Gunblade.name: Gunblade
Gunblade.description:
Both sword and firearm, a blade with a firing mechanism built into the spine so you can put a shot between slashes. Gunblades are rare, expensive, mechanically fussy, and absurdly cool. Trigger it mid-swing to add a bang to a cut, or fire it clean for range. Maintaining one takes swordsmanship and engineering; using one well takes a very specific kind of reckless confidence.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Gunblade.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist wields a gunblade. Describe combat with sword-slash-to-gunshot combos, trigger-pulls timed to impact, ranged shots between melee exchanges, and the dramatic over-engineering of a weapon that does everything at once. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Firearms.

Half-Elf.name: Half-Elf
Half-Elf.description:
One parent from the ancient elven bloodlines, one human. You inherited the graceful features, the sharp senses, and the natural magic affinity, along with the social complications. Too human for the elven courts, too elvish for human society, and too attractive for anyone to ignore. Your mixed heritage gives you versatility that purebloods lack, and a chip on your shoulder that makes you interesting at parties.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fantasy person with human skin and subtly pointed elf ears only; no animal traits, no nonhuman body plan.

RACE REFERENCE: Half-Elf is a humanoid person with refined mixed-heritage features, subtly pointed elf ears, graceful posture, and humanlike skin. Use two-culture tension, sharper senses, and flexible magic as background hooks.
Half-Elf.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively check exits and elevated positions in any room you enter, a habit from navigating two cultures that never quite felt like home. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fantasy person with human skin and subtly pointed elf ears only; no animal traits, no nonhuman body plan. RACE REFERENCE: Half-Elf is a humanoid person with refined mixed-heritage features, subtly pointed elf ears, graceful posture, and humanlike skin.

High Bun.name: High Bun
High Bun.description: High Bun styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
High Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use high bun as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Hime Cut.name: Hime Cut
Hime Cut.description: The classic princess cut, straight across bangs, cheek-length sidelocks, and long hair in the back. Formal, sharp, and unmistakably deliberate.
Hime Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: People assume you are from a noble house based on your haircut alone.

Map Hack.name: Map Hack
Map Hack.description: You have an innate sense of spatial awareness that borders on cartographic omniscience. Map Hack means you always know where you are, where you've been, and the general layout of any area you've entered, dungeons, buildings, underground passages, interdimensional spaces included. Fog of war doesn't apply to you. Hidden rooms feel wrong until you find them. Secret passages itch at the edge of your perception. Dungeon parties fight over who gets to bring you because you've never been lost in your life.
Map Hack.traitNarrativeEffects: You draw flawless maps from memory on napkins and once gave a cartographer an existential crisis.

Merchant.name: Merchant
Merchant.description:
A trader who knows how to buy, sell, negotiate, source, and profit. Merchants read value quickly and turn roads, rumors, and relationships into opportunity.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Merchant.traitNarrativeEffects: You calculate the resale value of objects during dramatic scenes.

Mousekin.name: Mousekin
Mousekin.description:
Round ears that twitch at the slightest sound. Large, bright eyes that see everything and judge nothing. Small, nimble hands that can pick locks, sew stitches, disarm traps, and prepare food with equal dexterity. Mousekin are the smallest of the beastkin, compact, lightweight, and built for speed, stealth, and survival in a world that constantly underestimates them. Their features are soft, youthful, and disarmingly cute: round cheeks, a small pointed nose, and an expressiveness that makes every emotion enormous and immediate. Their tails are long, thin, and surprisingly useful for balance. What Mousekin lack in size they make up for in resourcefulness, courage, and the quiet certainty that the smallest person in the room is often the one who saves everyone.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Mousekin have human skin, small mouse ears, and a thin tail; no fur-covered body, no rodent face, no paws.

RACE REFERENCE: Mousekin is a small or slight humanoid person with mouse ears, one thin tail, delicate features, and alert posture. Use quiet movement, keen hearing, clever scavenging, and underestimated courage as background hooks.
Mousekin.traitNarrativeEffects: You hoard snacks in your pockets, you can sleep anywhere, and you instinctively freeze when you hear a cat. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Mousekin have human skin, small mouse ears, and a thin tail; no fur-covered body, no rodent face, no paws. RACE REFERENCE: Mousekin is a small or slight humanoid person with mouse ears, one thin tail, delicate features, and alert posture.

Musician.name: Musician
Musician.description:
A performer whose songs shape mood, memory, romance, and atmosphere. Musicians are social catalysts in taverns, festivals, noble halls, and sad late-night confession scenes.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Musician.traitNarrativeEffects: You tap rhythms on every flat surface, hear music in natural sounds, and physically cannot walk past a quality instrument without touching it.

Mustache.name: Mustache
Mustache.description: A standalone mustache, distinguished, slightly eccentric, and projecting the confidence of someone who made a deliberate grooming choice and stands by it.
Mustache.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a visible mustache.

Naginata.name: Naginata
Naginata.description:
A curved blade on a long haft, built for sweeping arcs that own the space around you. The naginata keeps enemies at arm's length and beyond, punishing anyone who tries to close and turning a single spin into a moving wall of steel. It rewards grace over force, which is why it tends to attract fighters who never planned on letting the fight get close.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Naginata.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a naginata. Describe combat with wide sweeping slashes, long-range thrusts, spinning deflections, and the graceful authority of a blade that commands distance. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

No-Dachi.name: No-Dachi
No-Dachi.description:
An oversized great katana, long enough to carve through a formation, a doorway, and the patience of anyone standing nearby. There is no half-committing to it: every swing is all-in, every cut rearranges the terrain, and sheathing it means the fight is genuinely over. Raw strength helps. So does the conviction that one overwhelming strike is worth a hundred careful ones.

Primary Attribute: Strength
No-Dachi.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a no-dachi. Describe combat with massive sweeping cuts, earth-splitting power slashes, dramatic sheathing finishes, and the overwhelming presence of a blade that is almost too large to exist. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Heavy Weapons.

Nunchaku.name: Nunchaku
Nunchaku.description:
Two sticks joined by a short chain, fast and chaotic and able to strike from angles that shouldn't exist. Nunchaku flow around a guard like water, building speed with every pass until the wielder is a blur of hardwood and links. They belong to martial artists who fight on rhythm and misdirection, at a tempo that leaves opponents swinging at afterimages.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Nunchaku.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with nunchaku. Describe combat with rapid chain-whipping strikes, unpredictable angle changes, spinning deflections, and the fluid martial rhythm of a weapon that moves faster than the eye can track. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Omniglot.name: Omniglot
Omniglot.description: You instantly understand every language in Luxcellia: spoken, written, signed, magical, runic, ancient, beastkin dialect, demon formal, elvish poetic, and the obscure whistling trade-language used by Cerulean Coast sailors. Omniglot means you never hit a language barrier. You read ancient dungeon inscriptions that took scholars decades to decode. You follow the demon lord's private correspondence. You catch the insult a foreign noble muttered under their breath in a dead language. The implications are politically terrifying and socially hilarious.
Omniglot.traitNarrativeEffects: You occasionally respond to things people said in languages you shouldn't know, causing panic among diplomats and delight among eavesdroppers.

Perfumer.name: Perfumer
Perfumer.description:
A scent artisan who works with oils, flowers, rare essences, and emotional atmosphere. Perfumers influence memory, attraction, and first impressions through fragrance.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Perfumer.traitNarrativeEffects: You can identify someone's emotional state by their scent before they say a word.

Ponytail.name: Ponytail
Ponytail.description: The classic pulled-back ponytail, practical, athletic, and universally flattering. A no-nonsense style that keeps hair controlled while still looking effortlessly attractive. The ponytail swings during action scenes with cinematic timing.
Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: Your ponytail has its own wind physics. It swishes at dramatically appropriate moments regardless of actual air currents.

Red Eyes.name: Red Eyes
Red Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: striking crimson red eyes that immediately mark the character as extraordinary. Red eyes in anime signal power, danger, passion, or divine heritage, and they make every glance feel like a challenge or a promise.
Red Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Red Eyes. Exact color reference: vivid crimson #E74C3C with deeper #C0392B depth. Render intense red irises.

Red Hair.name: Red Hair
Red Hair.description: Red Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Red Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Red Hair. Exact hex color reference: #B22222. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Shag Cut.name: Shag Cut
Shag Cut.description: Shag Cut styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Shag Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use shag cut as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Star Elf.name: Star Elf
Star Elf.description:
A celestial elven lineage whose blood remembers constellations, fallen observatories, starlit prophecies, and the old maps between worlds. Star Elves look like refined humanoid elves touched by astronomy: pointed ears, luminous eyes, starlight hair accents, or faint constellation markings. They carry the usual elven elegance but with more prophecy, more cosmic mystery, and a higher chance of being involved in something that should have stayed sealed above the clouds. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: humanoid elf with humanlike skin, pointed ears, celestial eyes/markings, and starlight accents; no alien body, no abstract star creature, no nonhuman body plan.

RACE REFERENCE: Star Elf is a humanoid elf with pointed ears, luminous eyes, constellation markings, starlight hair accents, and refined cosmic elegance. Use star charts, prophecy, celestial ruins, and old elven dignity as background hooks.
Star Elf.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Use star charts, constellations, fate omens, celestial ruins, and old elven dignity. Portraits should read as an elegant humanoid elf with cosmic accents, not an alien or living nebula.

Succubus.name: Succubus
Succubus.description:
A true Succubus is not merely charming, they are born from the emotional magic of the demon realm itself. Graceful horns, smooth tails, luminous eyes, and an aura that feels almost magnetic. Some bear small bat-like wings, heart-shaped pupils, faintly glowing markings, or a voice that lingers in the air. In the Twilight Dominion, Succubi are respected as diplomats, artists, spies, and dangerous negotiators. In human lands, they are mistrusted by the Church and fetishized by fools. A Succubus adventurer walks through Luxcellia as both temptation and threat, constantly deciding whether to be what others expect or something far more complicated.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Succubus characters remain humanlike with elegant horns, tail, wings, or glamour accents; no monster body, no explicit nudity, no exaggerated anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Succubus is a humanoid demon-blooded person with graceful horns, tail, small wings, glamour markings, and magnetic anime beauty. Use charm pressure, emotional reading, and choosing consent over manipulation as background hooks.
Succubus.traitNarrativeEffects: Your eyes flicker with faint luminance when someone nearby is hiding strong emotion, and your tail moves independently when you're distracted, which makes lying about your feelings roughly as feasible as hiding a candle in a dark room. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Succubus characters remain humanlike with elegant horns, tail, wings, or glamour accents; no monster body, no explicit nudity, no exaggerated anatomy. RACE REFERENCE: Succubus is a humanoid demon-blooded person with graceful horns, tail, small wings, glamour markings, and magnetic anime beauty.

Summoner.name: Summoner
Summoner.description:
You never fight alone, and your friends are from OUT of town. Summoners contract entities across realms, Spirit Beasts of living mana, Pact Bolts fired on the contract's authority. Your power is a roster: the right ally called at the right moment, fighting with otherworldly enthusiasm on your behalf. The enemy prepared for one of you. There were never going to be only one of you.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
