Summoner.traitNarrativeEffects: You talk about your summons like proud parents talk about children, you set a place for them at camp meals, and you take 'can't you fight your own battles' as a compliment to your management skills.

Top Knot.name: Top Knot
Top Knot.description: Top Knot styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Top Knot.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Undercut.name: Undercut
Undercut.description: Undercut styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Undercut.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use undercut as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Vanguard.name: Vanguard
Vanguard.description:
The line holds because you decided it would, out loud. Vanguards are the party's tactical backbone, Shield Walls that turn resolve into cover, a Shield Bash Throw for problems developing at range. You inspire through presence and coordinate through experience: everyone fights smarter inside your reach. The shield protects the party. Your voice is what protects the shield.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Vanguard.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively evaluate every room for tactical advantage and have strong opinions about party formation.

Wolf Cut.name: Wolf Cut
Wolf Cut.description: Shaggy layers, face-framing, wild-but-styled, the mullet-shag hybrid that's everywhere in Sundren's trendy districts.
Wolf Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair looks like you just fought a wolf and that's exactly the point.

Alchemist.name: Alchemist
Alchemist.description:
A broad-spectrum potion maker, reagent mixer, and practical magical chemist. Alchemists deal in useful brews, unstable formulas, monster parts, and the satisfying fantasy of having the right bottle for a problem.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Alchemist.traitNarrativeEffects: You evaluate every substance you encounter for explosive potential and your hair has been four different colors this week.

Aqua Eyes.name: Aqua Eyes
Aqua Eyes.description: Aqua Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Aqua Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Aqua Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #30CCC0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Aqua Hair.name: Aqua Hair
Aqua Hair.description: Aqua Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Aqua Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Aqua Hair. Exact hex color reference: #00CED1. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Artificer.name: Artificer
Artificer.description:
A gadget-minded magical inventor who builds useful devices, odd contraptions, and enchanted mechanisms. Artificers solve problems with clever construction and controlled over-engineering.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Artificer.traitNarrativeEffects: You say "theoretically safe" far too often.

Automaton.name: Automaton
Automaton.description:
You are a living construct, a masterwork of runic engineering, alchemical animation, and either a soul transplant, a spontaneous awakening, or a divine spark that nobody can adequately explain. Your body is metal, crystal, enchanted ceramic, or magically treated wood. Your heart is a mana core. Your mind is your own, which is the part that unsettles your creators the most. Automatons in Luxcellia range from ancient dungeon guardians who woke up with opinions, to recently built servants who decided servitude wasn't for them, to experimental Academy projects who walked out of the lab. You don't eat, don't sleep, don't age, and don't understand why everyone else seems so tired all the time.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid artificial person with doll-like, clockwork, or magical construct accents; no bulky robot, no vehicle body, no faceless machine unless explicitly chosen.

RACE REFERENCE: Automaton is a humanoid artificial person with a humanlike face, elegant crafted body, seams, core glow, or alchemical/clockwork details. Use created purpose, awakening emotion, and maintenance rituals as background hooks.
Automaton.traitNarrativeEffects: You don't sleep, you enter maintenance cycles. You've optimized your morning routine to zero steps because you don't have mornings, and you find organic inefficiency both confusing and endearing. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid artificial person with doll-like, clockwork, or magical construct accents; no bulky robot, no vehicle body, no faceless machine unless explicitly chosen. RACE REFERENCE: Automaton is a humanoid artificial person with a humanlike face, elegant crafted body, seams, core glow, or alchemical/clockwork details.

Avian-Kin.name: Avian-Kin
Avian-Kin.description:
Wings that fold against your back like a feathered cloak. Hollow bones that make you lighter than you look. Eyes that can count the stitches on a tapestry from across a banquet hall. Avian-Kin carry the blood of the sky clans, harpies, tengu, thunderbirds, or corvid-folk, and the gift of near-flight or full flight depending on how strongly the bloodline manifests. You are faster than gravity, more graceful than architecture, and absolutely insufferable about having the high ground. Other races find your aerial perspective either inspiring or deeply annoying, depending on how many times you've landed on their head.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Avian-Kin keep a human face, human skin, and humanoid body with feather accents and optional wings; no beak face, no talon feet, no full bird body.

RACE REFERENCE: Avian-Kin is a humanoid person with a humanlike face, feather accents, wing-like features, or feathered ears. Use sky longing, sharp sight, nesting habits, and wind awareness as background hooks.
Avian-Kin.traitNarrativeEffects: You tilt your head at sharp angles when confused, preen your feathers when nervous, and have an extremely complicated relationship with windows. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Avian-Kin keep a human face, human skin, and humanoid body with feather accents and optional wings; no beak face, no talon feet, no full bird body. RACE REFERENCE: Avian-Kin is a humanoid person with a humanlike face, feather accents, wing-like features, or feathered ears.

Berserker.name: Berserker
Berserker.description:
You don't fight. You detonate. Berserkers are the walking natural disasters of the front line, Reckless Swings with the whole body behind them, Battle Cries that rattle shields, and a cheerful disregard for personal safety that opposing healers describe as 'job security.' Every fight is all-in. Every swing is the last one. Somehow, gloriously, it keeps not being.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Berserker.traitNarrativeEffects: Your smile gets wider the worse the odds get, and your allies have learned to take a step back when you start laughing.

Blue Eyes.name: Blue Eyes
Blue Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: clear, vivid blue eyes. The classic anime protagonist color. Bright, expressive, and carrying the full depth of sky and sea in every glance.
Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Blue Eyes. Exact color reference: vivid blue #3498DB with deeper #2471A3 depth. Render clear, bright blue irises with anime-standard expressiveness.

Blue Hair.name: Blue Hair
Blue Hair.description: Blue Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Blue Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Blue Hair. Exact hex color reference: #2255CC. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Burn Mark.name: Burn Mark
Burn Mark.description: Scarred skin from fire, acid, or wild magic, covering part of the jaw, cheek, or temple. The texture is unmistakable. Whatever caused it was violent and hot, and you survived.
Burn Mark.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render a visible burn scar on one side of the face.

Celestial.name: Celestial
Celestial.description:
Celestials are touched by the upper realms, carrying divine light in their blood and an expectation of greatness on their shoulders. Luminous eyes, softly glowing features, radiant markings, golden or silver hair, and an aura of dawn or starlight. Some bear faint halos, light-patterned pupils, small spectral wings, or glowing sigils that surface when they cast magic. The Church of the First Light admires them, envies them, and watches them closely. A Celestial adventurer often gets treated as a symbol before anyone treats them as a person, so the journey becomes a question of identity as much as destiny.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Celestials remain humanlike with radiant eyes, halo, subtle wings, or divine markings; no abstract angel mass, no nonhuman body plan.

RACE REFERENCE: Celestial is a humanoid upper-realm bloodline with radiant eyes, halo suggestion, light markings, small spectral wings, or golden/silver glow. Use sacred attention, divine pressure, and unwanted symbolism as background hooks.
Celestial.traitNarrativeEffects: Your skin has a faint luminescence that brightens near sacred places, your shadow is slightly shorter than it should be, and people keep assuming you're a religious authority figure you've never heard of. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Celestials remain humanlike with radiant eyes, halo, subtle wings, or divine markings; no abstract angel mass, no nonhuman body plan. RACE REFERENCE: Celestial is a humanoid upper-realm bloodline with radiant eyes, halo suggestion, light markings, small spectral wings, or golden/silver glow.

Cyan Hair.name: Cyan Hair
Cyan Hair.description: Cyan Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Cyan Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Cyan Hair. Exact hex color reference: #00B4CC. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Dewy Gaze.name: Dewy Gaze
Dewy Gaze.description: Large, luminous eyes with a soft, dewy quality, the kind that catch light like polished gems and make every emotion visible. Difficult to lie with eyes like these. Difficult to look away from them, too.
Dewy Gaze.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls eye quality only. Render large, luminous, softly reflective eyes.

Enchanter.name: Enchanter
Enchanter.description:
A magical craftsman who improves weapons, tools, armor, and accessories by binding enchantments into them. Enchanters are about empowering objects rather than fighting personally.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Enchanter.traitNarrativeEffects: You can't help but analyze the magical properties of everything you touch and have been caught talking to enchanted items like they're people.

Full Lips.name: Full Lips
Full Lips.description: Full, well-shaped lips with natural color, the kind that make people watch your mouth when you talk and forget what you said afterward.
Full Lips.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls lip shape only. Render full, prominent lips.

Gauntlets.name: Gauntlets
Gauntlets.description:
Armored fists reinforced with metal, enchantment, or raw magic. Gauntlets turn unarmed fighting into armored fighting, so every punch lands like a mace and every block comes backed by steel. Their wielders close the distance fast and refuse to give it back, turning any fight into a brawl where a pair of reinforced hands is the only weapon that ends up mattering.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Gauntlets.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with armored gauntlets. Describe combat with armored punches, grapples, palm strikes, and the visceral impact of fist-based fighting with metal-reinforced hands. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Unarmed Combat.

Geomancer.name: Geomancer
Geomancer.description:
The ground is on your side, and the ground is everywhere. Geomancers fight with the world underfoot, terrain reshaped mid-battle, Stone Lances from below, an Earthshift that turns the enemy's footing into your opinion. Every battlefield you enter becomes home-field advantage, because the field itself keeps switching sides. It's not cheating. It's geology.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Geomancer.traitNarrativeEffects: You press your palm to the ground before entering buildings to 'read' them, and you have opinions about soil composition that you will share unprompted and at length.

Gladiator.name: Gladiator
Gladiator.description:
Every fight is a show, and you never lose the crowd. Gladiators turned spectacle into doctrine, minimal armor, maximum showmanship, Crowd Roars that convert an audience into a weapon and Brutal Strikes timed for the gasp. You fight better when people are watching, and people are always watching. The arena taught you the only rule that matters: make them remember it.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Gladiator.traitNarrativeEffects: You flex before, during, and after combat. You've named your biceps. You address crowds that aren't there and call every fight an exhibition match.

Gold Eyes.name: Gold Eyes
Gold Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: brilliant gold eyes that gleam like polished treasure, warm, intense, and unmistakably extraordinary. Gold eyes catch every light source and reflect it back with interest. The color of dragons, ancient bloodlines, and divine favor.
Gold Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Gold Eyes. Exact color reference: bright gold #F1C40F with warm amber #D4AC0D depth. Render vivid metallic gold irises.

Gold Hair.name: Gold Hair
Gold Hair.description: Gold Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Gold Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Gold Hair. Exact hex color reference: #D4AF37. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Gray Eyes.name: Gray Eyes
Gray Eyes.description: Gray Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Gray Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Gray Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #8A9090. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Gray Hair.name: Gray Hair
Gray Hair.description: Gray Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Gray Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Gray Hair. Exact hex color reference: #9E9E9E. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Herbalist.name: Herbalist
Herbalist.description:
A plant specialist focused on healing herbs, useful flora, teas, remedies, and field medicine. Herbalists know what the forest can offer and what it can kill you with.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Herbalist.traitNarrativeEffects: You stop mid-conversation to crouch in the dirt because you spotted a useful plant.

High Fade.name: High Fade
High Fade.description: High Fade styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
High Fade.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Jade Eyes.name: Jade Eyes
Jade Eyes.description: EXACT VISUAL LOCK: jade green eyes. The final Appearance must say jade green eyes and must not shift the eyes to blue, cyan, violet, gold, silver, or generic bright anime eyes. Jade green eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. This is the definitive iris color: write jade green eyes in Appearance, not blue, cyan, violet, gold, or generic luminous eyes.
Jade Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Jade Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #3A8060. Apply this as the iris color in the portrait. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Long Hair.name: Long Hair
Long Hair.description: Hair flowing well past the shoulders, long enough to catch every breeze, dramatic enough to swirl during battle, and beautiful enough to make every scene a portrait. Long hair in anime is not just a style, it's a statement of power, beauty, and commitment to looking incredible at all times.
Long Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: You have never once gotten your long hair tangled in your weapon during combat. This is either magic or practice, and you're not telling which.

Longsword.name: Longsword
Longsword.description:
The classic adventurer's blade: versatile, balanced, and good in almost any situation. It slashes, thrusts, parries, and pommel-strikes, works alone or behind a shield, and never asks you to specialize. A longsword is what a professional carries when they don't know what the day holds and would rather be ready for all of it. Not flashy. Extremely reliable.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Longsword.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a longsword. Describe combat with versatile techniques, slashes, thrusts, parries, guards, and the balanced professionalism of a knight or seasoned adventurer. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Swordsmanship.

Messy Bun.name: Messy Bun
Messy Bun.description: Messy Bun styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Messy Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Opal Hair.name: Opal Hair
Opal Hair.description: Opal Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Opal Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Opal Hair. Exact hex color reference: #D8CDE0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Pink Eyes.name: Pink Eyes
Pink Eyes.description: Pink Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Pink Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Pink Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #E08090. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Pink Hair.name: Pink Hair
Pink Hair.description: Pink Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Pink Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Pink Hair. Exact hex color reference: #E8769A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Pixie Cut.name: Pixie Cut
Pixie Cut.description: Short, layered, framing the face, bold and low-maintenance. The kind of short that makes people say you have great bone structure.
Pixie Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: You push your hair behind your ear reflexively even though there's barely any there.

Pompadour.name: Pompadour
Pompadour.description: Swept up and back with volume, bold, retro, and absolutely committed to a look. Takes confidence to wear and more confidence to maintain.
Pompadour.traitNarrativeEffects: You carry a comb and use it mid-conversation without breaking eye contact.

Puppeteer.name: Puppeteer
Puppeteer.description:
Your puppets fight, scout, shield, and die in your place, and they're very good at all four. Puppeteers control constructs on strings of pure mana: a Puppet Dance of coordinated violence, Marionette Strings that make the show personal. You direct the battle from behind your cast, and the cast never argues, never tires, and never, ever misses a cue.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Puppeteer.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hands move even when you're not controlling anything and people find your smile slightly unsettling when you concentrate.

Rabbitkin.name: Rabbitkin
Rabbitkin.description:
Long ears that pivot like radar dishes, powerful legs that can clear a rooftop from standing, and a nervous energy that people constantly mistake for timidity. Rabbitkin are the fastest of the beastkin clans, built for explosive speed, evasion, and hitting much harder than anyone expects from something this cute. Your heartbeat runs fast, your reflexes are phenomenal, and you've survived this long by being quicker, cleverer, and more stubborn than everything trying to eat you. The cute appearance is not a weakness. It is a trap.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Rabbitkin have human skin, rabbit ears, and a small tail; no fur-covered body, no rabbit face, no paws.

RACE REFERENCE: Rabbitkin is a humanoid person with long rabbit ears, one small tail, light-footed posture, and alert expressions. Use quick movement, sensitive hearing, nervous tells, and sudden courage as background hooks.
Rabbitkin.traitNarrativeEffects: Your nose twitches when you're thinking hard, your ears droop when you're sad, and you have kicked at least one person through a wall for calling you 'adorable' in combat. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Rabbitkin have human skin, rabbit ears, and a small tail; no fur-covered body, no rabbit face, no paws. RACE REFERENCE: Rabbitkin is a humanoid person with long rabbit ears, one small tail, light-footed posture, and alert expressions.

Rope Dart.name: Rope Dart
Rope Dart.description:
A weighted dart on a long cord, thrown, retracted, wrapped, and whipped in patterns that make distance meaningless. Strike from past arm's reach, yank an enemy off balance, coil the cord around a limb and reel them in. Its wielders are never quite where you expect and always exactly where they need to be, which is the entire trick.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Rope Dart.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with a rope dart. Describe combat with whipping cord strikes, mid-range reeling pulls, entangling wraps, fluid retract-and-throw patterns, and the hypnotic grace of a weapon that dances on a string. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Rose Eyes.name: Rose Eyes
Rose Eyes.description: Rose Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Rose Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Rose Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #D86880. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Side Part.name: Side Part
Side Part.description: A classic side part, hair swept to one side with a clean part line. Polished, reliable, and the kind of style that says you have your life together even when you absolutely don't.
Side Part.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair parted to one side and swept across.

Sleek Bun.name: Sleek Bun
Sleek Bun.description: A sleek, polished bun pulled tight against the head, elegant, professional, and the kind of style that means business. Not a strand out of place, not a second wasted.
Sleek Bun.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render a tight, polished, sleek bun with no loose strands.

Soulblade.name: Soulblade
Soulblade.description:
The blade grows keener as you grow more certain of who you are. Soulblades bond steel to spirit, Resonance Strikes sharpened by conviction, a Spirit Awakening when the bond fully opens. Fighting for something you believe in, you cut far above your steel. Fighting hollow, you're just a person with a sword, and the sword knows. It is a partner, a mirror, and a lie detector. It has never been 'just a sword.'

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Soulblade.traitNarrativeEffects: You talk to your weapon in public, argue with it under your breath during negotiations, and get defensive when anyone suggests it's 'just a sword.'

Swordsman.name: Swordsman
Swordsman.description:
The bread and butter of every adventuring party, and the face on the recruitment poster. Swordsmen live and die by the blade, Cross Slashes that end negotiations, a Sword Draw that starts them properly. No gimmick, no patron, no fine print: just steel, training, and the stubborn versatility that makes 'simple' the hardest class to actually fight. Every legend started here. Most of them came back.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Swordsman.traitNarrativeEffects: You practice draws at dawn wherever you are, you evaluate every stranger by grip and stance out of habit, and when asked about your technique you say 'it's just swordsmanship,' which has never once been true.

Teal Eyes.name: Teal Eyes
Teal Eyes.description: Teal Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Teal Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Teal Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #2A8878. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Teal Hair.name: Teal Hair
Teal Hair.description: Teal Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Teal Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Teal Hair. Exact hex color reference: #2A9B8E. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Trickster.name: Trickster
Trickster.description:
Straightforward fighters find you EXHAUSTING, which is the point. Tricksters win through misdirection, improvisation, and lateral thinking with a body count, Misdirection that spends the enemy's best attack on a rumor, Elaborate Traps assembled from whatever the room offered. You don't beat opponents. You out-plan, out-cheat, and out-imagine them, and then you take a bow.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Trickster.traitNarrativeEffects: You never enter a room without mentally cataloging what could be used as a weapon, a trap, or a distraction. Dinner parties are exhausting.

Twin Buns.name: Twin Buns
Twin Buns.description: Twin Buns styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Twin Buns.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use twin buns as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Wavy Hair.name: Wavy Hair
Wavy Hair.description: Soft, natural waves that give hair body and movement without the tightness of curls, the kind of effortless texture that makes people ask 'how do you get your hair to do that?' The answer is always genetics, magic, or both.
Wavy Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Ocean breezes and your hair have a long-standing arrangement. The result is always photogenic.

Yuki-Onna.name: Yuki-Onna
Yuki-Onna.description:
Yuki-Onna are winter spirits who crossed into mortal society from frozen mountains, moonlit snowfields, and old shrine legends. Pale or cool-toned complexions, snow-white or silver hair, icy eyes, and an aura of winter calm. Frost gathers on their eyelashes, sleeves, and footprints. When strong emotion moves them, the air chills, mists, or sparkles with snow crystals. Many are emotionally reserved, not because they lack feeling, but because feelings make the temperature drop. In Luxcellia, Yuki-Onna often become mages, shrine guardians, assassins, or lonely travelers searching for a place warm enough to stay.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid snow-spirit person with elegant winter traits; no monster anatomy, no full ice statue body unless specifically selected.

RACE REFERENCE: Yuki-Onna is a humanoid winter-spirit person with cool-toned beauty, white or silver hair, icy features, and frost accents. Use emotional temperature shifts, snow omens, and shrine folklore as background hooks.
Yuki-Onna.traitNarrativeEffects: Your breath mists in any temperature, frost patterns form on surfaces you touch absentmindedly, and you have accidentally frozen at least one cup of tea while thinking about someone you probably shouldn't be thinking about. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid snow-spirit person with elegant winter traits; no monster anatomy, no full ice statue body unless specifically selected. RACE REFERENCE: Yuki-Onna is a humanoid winter-spirit person with cool-toned beauty, white or silver hair, icy features, and frost accents.

Afro Puffs.name: Afro Puffs
Afro Puffs.description: Tight, voluminous curls gathered into playful puffs, bold, joyful, and full of energy. The kind of style that announces you before you enter a room.
Afro Puffs.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair styled into two rounded voluminous puffs.

Amber Eyes.name: Amber Eyes
Amber Eyes.description: Amber Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Amber Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Amber Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #C07820. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Armorsmith.name: Armorsmith
Armorsmith.description:
A protective-gear specialist who forges plate, mail, fittings, and battle-ready defense. Armorsmiths think in durability, comfort, and how to keep people alive when monsters hit back.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Armorsmith.traitNarrativeEffects: You keep adjusting people's armor straps without asking because "that fit is going to get you stabbed."

Ashen Gray.name: Ashen Gray
Ashen Gray.description: Unnatural gray-toned skin, the mark of prolonged Pulse exposure, undead heritage, or something stranger. Not dead, but not entirely alive-looking.
Ashen Gray.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. People check your pulse without asking and you have stopped being offended.

Astrologer.name: Astrologer
Astrologer.description:
You read the heavens, and the heavens answer. Astrologers pull power from constellations and celestial alignment, star charts that reveal what's coming, bolts of falling light, and a fighting rhythm timed to a sky only you can read. You are the party's early warning and its artillery from above. Enemies call it fortune-telling right up until the stars start landing on them.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Astrologer.traitNarrativeEffects: You compulsively check the night sky before making any decision and have accidentally predicted three breakups, two wars, and a rainstorm that ruined a royal wedding.

Azure Eyes.name: Azure Eyes
Azure Eyes.description: Azure Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Azure Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Azure Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #2090D8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Battle Axe.name: Battle Axe
Battle Axe.description:
Heavy, direct, and brutally honest. A battle axe doesn't parry, it breaks the parry; it doesn't deflect a shield, it splits one. This is a weapon for fighters who want every hit to land like it means something and are willing to commit fully to each swing. To the axe, defense is just offense that hasn't happened yet.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Battle Axe.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a battle axe. Describe combat with crushing overhead strikes, shield-breaking impacts, raw power, and the berserker energy of someone who chose an axe over a sword. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Axe Fighting.

Black Eyes.name: Black Eyes
Black Eyes.description: Black Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. The irises are true jet black, as dark as the pupils, so the eyes read as deep solid black with a small white catch-light. They stay black in close-ups, emotional reaction shots, and cinematic portrait lighting, and never pick up the hair, outfit, or background color.
Black Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Black Eyes. Draw the irises solid jet black (hex #0A0A0A), as dark as the pupil, so iris and pupil read as one deep black. The only highlight is a small white catch-light. Never tint the irises brown, gray, red, violet, blue, or any hair, outfit, or background color, and never make them glow. When two eye colors are selected, use each color for one eye precisely.

Black Hair.name: Black Hair
Black Hair.description: Black Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Black Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Black Hair. Exact hex color reference: #0D0D0D. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
Blacksmith.description:
A weapon-focused forge professional who shapes steel, repairs blades, and respects honest craftsmanship. If something sharp, heavy, or heroic needs making, a blacksmith understands it.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Blacksmith.traitNarrativeEffects: You judge people by how they maintain their weapons and have strong opinions about bad edge care.

Blood Mage.name: Blood Mage
Blood Mage.description:
Your spellbook is written in your own pulse. Blood Mages pay for power openly, in the oldest currency, life force and crimson ritual turned into magic that costs exactly what it says. Blood Strikes that spend you, Blood Drains that collect. Every great working leaves you paler and the field redder. It is intimate, dramatic, and honest. Your veins were always the truest mana pool.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Blood Mage.traitNarrativeEffects: Your pulse quickens audibly when casting and you've been told your eyes go unsettlingly red during intense spells.

Box Braids.name: Box Braids
Box Braids.description: Box Braids styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Box Braids.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use box braids as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Brewmaster.name: Brewmaster
Brewmaster.description:
A maker of alcohol, tonics, teas, fermented goods, and tavern-quality beverages with social power. Brewmasters understand hospitality, mood, and how drinks change a room.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Brewmaster.traitNarrativeEffects: You can identify any liquid by smell alone, and you always know when someone watered down the ale.

Brown Eyes.name: Brown Eyes
Brown Eyes.description: Brown Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Brown Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Brown Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #795430. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Brown Hair.name: Brown Hair
Brown Hair.description: Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #5C3A1E. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Changeling.name: Changeling
Changeling.description:
Your true face is the one nobody's seen, or maybe they have and you've forgotten which one it was. Changelings carry the blood of the fae doppelgangers, ancient mimics of the spirit courts, or something older that wore faces before faces were invented. You can shift your features, your build, your coloring, even your voice with a concentration that gets easier every time you do it. You are the ultimate infiltrator, the perfect spy, the ideal companion for social intrigue, and the loneliest person in any room, because nobody knows what you actually look like, including, increasingly, you. In Luxcellia, Changelings are simultaneously the most desired party members for political quests and the most watched guests at noble functions. Trust is the currency you can never quite accumulate enough of.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid shapeshifter with attractive humanlike anatomy; no faceless mannequin, no horror duplicate, no nonhuman body plan unless explicitly chosen.

RACE REFERENCE: Changeling is a humanlike shapeshifter with subtle mutable features, slightly uncanny symmetry, and expression that can shift with mood. Use identity play, disguise instincts, and social camouflage as background hooks.
Changeling.traitNarrativeEffects: You sometimes forget which face is your original and have to check. You collect expressions the way other people collect souvenirs, and mirrors make you philosophical. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid shapeshifter with attractive humanlike anatomy; no faceless mannequin, no horror duplicate, no nonhuman body plan unless explicitly chosen. RACE REFERENCE: Changeling is a humanlike shapeshifter with subtle mutable features, slightly uncanny symmetry, and expression that can shift with mood.

Cheek Scar.name: Cheek Scar
Cheek Scar.description: A horizontal or diagonal scar across one cheek, a duelist's mark, a childhood accident, or a reminder of the fight that changed everything. Visible but not disfiguring. Character, not damage.
Cheek Scar.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render a visible scar on one cheek.

Cool Ebony.name: Cool Ebony
Cool Ebony.description: The deepest black-brown skin, cool undertones, almost blue-black in certain light. Rare and impossible to ignore.
Cool Ebony.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. Your skin has a natural sheen that makes you look polished without trying.

Coral Eyes.name: Coral Eyes
Coral Eyes.description: Coral Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Coral Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Coral Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #E07060. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Curly Hair.name: Curly Hair
Curly Hair.description: Natural curls that spring and bounce with personality and volume, spirals, waves, and ringlets that frame the face with dynamic texture. Curly hair catches light from a dozen angles and never sits quite the same way twice, making every moment a new portrait.
Curly Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Humidity is your sworn enemy in theory but has never actually affected your curls in any way that wasn't attractive.

Dark Umber.name: Dark Umber
Dark Umber.description: Very deep, cool-toned dark skin, dark enough to blend with shadows in dim light. Striking and commanding.
Dark Umber.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. In low light your silhouette is all people see, and you have learned to use that.

Deep Brown.name: Deep Brown
Deep Brown.description: Very deep brown skin, rich and dark with warm undertones that surface in bright light.
Deep Brown.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. Dramatic lighting was invented for you and everyone in the room knows it.

Dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
Dragonborn.description:
Somewhere in your ancestry, a dragon left its mark, and dragon blood does not dilute quietly. Subtle scales trace your jawline, your collarbones, your forearms. Your pupils slit when you're angry. Heat sits in your chest like a second heartbeat. Dragonborn are rare in Luxcellia, treated with a mixture of awe, fear, and the kind of fascinated attention that people give to beautiful things that might explode. Your bloodline carries elemental affinity, physical resilience, and an instinctive territorial pride that makes sharing difficult and backing down nearly impossible.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Dragonborn remain humanlike with subtle scales, slit pupils, small horns, or draconic markings; no full dragon head, no reptile body, no claws replacing hands unless selected.

RACE REFERENCE: Dragonborn is an anime humanoid with humanlike face, small horns, subtle scales, slit pupils, strong posture, and dragon-blood presence. Use pride, elemental inheritance, treasure instincts, and controlled power as background hooks.
Dragonborn.traitNarrativeEffects: You unconsciously hoard shiny objects, growl when people touch your belongings, and sleep significantly better on piles of things. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Dragonborn remain humanlike with subtle scales, slit pupils, small horns, or draconic markings; no full dragon head, no reptile body, no claws replacing hands unless selected. RACE REFERENCE: Dragonborn is an anime humanoid with humanlike face, small horns, subtle scales, slit pupils, strong posture, and dragon-blood presence.

Dreadlocks.name: Dreadlocks
Dreadlocks.description: Thick, rope-like dreadlocks, each one a statement of patience, culture, or stubborn refusal to own a comb. Worn with the gravity of someone who committed to a look years ago.
Dreadlocks.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render thick rope-like dreadlocks.

Fang Teeth.name: Fang Teeth
Fang Teeth.description: Slightly elongated canine teeth visible when smiling or speaking, a single fang peeking out, or a matched pair. Could be beastkin heritage, vampire blood, or just anime genetics.
Fang Teeth.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render one or two visible fang teeth.

Full Beard.name: Full Beard
Full Beard.description: A substantial, well-grown beard covering the jaw and chin. The look of a seasoned warrior, a master craftsman, or a wizard who has earned the right to stop shaving.
Full Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a full beard covering the jaw and chin.

Golden Tan.name: Golden Tan
Golden Tan.description: Medium skin with warm golden undertones, sun-touched and even. Common among Veinreach frontier folk and Skyreach climbers.
Golden Tan.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. You look like you have spent your whole life outdoors even if you have not.

Greatsword.name: Greatsword
Greatsword.description:
A blade so large it doubles as a shield, a barricade, and a statement. Greatswords belong to the protagonists who decided bigger is simply better and then trained until they were right. Every swing is a full commitment, every clean hit is devastating, and subtlety was never in the design brief. What you lose in speed you get back in the way a crowd steps away from you.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Greatsword.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a massive greatsword. Describe combat with heavy cleaving swings, earth-shaking impacts, wide arcs, and the raw power fantasy of wielding something that shouldn't be physically possible. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Heavy Weapons.

Green Eyes.name: Green Eyes
Green Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: vivid green eyes with the depth of ancient forests and the brightness of spring leaves. Green eyes catch light differently than any other color, they seem to glow from within.
Green Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Green Eyes. Exact color reference: vivid green #27AE60 with deeper #1E8449 depth. Render clear, bright green irises.

Gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
Gunslinger.description:
In a world of swords and spells, you brought gunpowder and a stubborn refusal to be impressed. Gunslingers treat firearms as extensions of the soul, Quick Draws faster than the blink they're named for, Trick Shots that bend the argument. You win the first beat of every fight, and everyone who's watched you work keeps their hands visible around you forever after.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Gunslinger.traitNarrativeEffects: You maintain your weapon like a sacred ritual and the sound of a click before a fight fills you with something between joy and madness.

Hazel Eyes.name: Hazel Eyes
Hazel Eyes.description: Hazel Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Hazel Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Hazel Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #7B6520. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Hex Knight.name: Hex Knight
Hex Knight.description:
Every exchange with you is a bad deal, and you set the terms. Hex Knights fight in cursed armor with maledicted steel, Curse Blades that trade blows AND afflictions, Hex Armor that makes hitting you its own punishment. Block and be jinxed. Dodge and be marked. Trade and lose twice. Duelists hate you. Healers triple-check you. Both reactions are correct.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Hex Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: Your weapon whispers to you in languages you almost understand, your armor has stress fractures that glow purple under moonlight, and healers always do a double-take when they scan you.

Hex Weaver.name: Hex Weaver
Hex Weaver.description:
You win fights that started three days ago. Hex Weavers layer misfortune from the midline, Layered Curses stacking small dooms, Jinx Fields where the enemy's luck, gear, and confidence all fail in the same breath. You are a planner, not a bruiser: if you're visibly fighting, something already went wrong. When the enemy champion trips, nobody asks why anymore.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Hex Weaver.traitNarrativeEffects: You mutter under your breath when annoyed, and small unfortunate things happen to people you're angry at, shoelaces untie, drinks spill, chairs wobble.

Homunculus.name: Homunculus
Homunculus.description:
A beautiful artificial humanoid created through forbidden alchemy, ancient laboratories, noble experiments, or a suspiciously convenient secret route. Homunculi are not robots, golems, or dolls without souls, they are living people with crafted bodies, alchemical marks, controlled mana channels, and the unsettling question of who designed them and why. They fit secret-boss backstories, academy research arcs, abandoned lab awakenings, and romance routes about choosing your own purpose. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: humanoid alchemical person with humanlike skin or subtle crafted sheen, faint runes or seams optional; no mechanical robot body, no stone golem form, no puppet joints unless explicitly chosen elsewhere.

RACE REFERENCE: Homunculus is a living artificial humanoid with humanlike face, alchemical marks, precise seams, controlled mana channels, or crafted beauty. Use creator mysteries, identity tension, and designed purpose versus chosen life as background hooks.
Homunculus.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Treat this as an artificial-but-living person. Reference alchemical marks, creator mysteries, precise mana flow, and identity tension. Do not make them a machine, construct monster, or emotionless prop unless the player asks.

Inquisitor.name: Inquisitor
Inquisitor.description:
Divine justice, sharp end first. Inquisitors hunt what the establishment fears, heretics, demons, cursed things with good lawyers. Judgment Marks that make guilt visible, Sanctified Strikes that execute the verdict. You track, you interrogate, you conclude. The Church sends Priests to comfort and Paladins to protect. It sends you when it already knows the answer.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Inquisitor.traitNarrativeEffects: You can tell when someone is lying with unsettling accuracy and you interrogate menus before ordering at taverns. Casual conversations with you feel like depositions.

Kusarigama.name: Kusarigama
Kusarigama.description:
A sickle in one hand, a weighted chain in the other. The kusarigama fights in the gap between seen and unseen: the chain snares weapons, wraps limbs, and drags the enemy onto the sickle's waiting edge. It is unorthodox and deeply unfair, which stops being a complaint the moment you are the one holding it.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Kusarigama.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with a kusarigama. Describe combat with sickle reaping slashes, chain entangling throws, grappling pulls into close range, and the deceptive lethality of a weapon that looks like a farmer's tool and fights like an assassin's signature. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Lilac Hair.name: Lilac Hair
Lilac Hair.description: Lilac Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Lilac Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Lilac Hair. Exact hex color reference: #C8A8D4. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Long Braid.name: Long Braid
Long Braid.description: A single thick braid down the back, practical, traditional, and it never gets in your face. The reliable delver style.
Long Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: You use your braid as a measuring tool and a stress fidget.

Loose Updo.name: Loose Updo
Loose Updo.description: Hair gathered up but imperfectly, strands escaping, pins barely holding, elegance on the edge of collapse. The formal-gone-feral look.
Loose Updo.traitNarrativeEffects: You put it up for important events and it starts falling apart within twenty minutes like clockwork.

Messy Hair.name: Messy Hair
Messy Hair.description: Messy, tousled hair that looks like you just woke up and decided that was a style. It is. It's called confidence.
Messy Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render messy, tousled, unstructured hair.

Open Heart.name: Open Heart
Open Heart.description: You are emotionally available, receptive, and willing to meet people with honesty. This makes you easy to trust and occasionally very easy to hurt.
Open Heart.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use openness, empathy, and warm emotional accessibility.

Peach Eyes.name: Peach Eyes
Peach Eyes.description: Peach Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Peach Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Peach Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #E8A880. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Peach Hair.name: Peach Hair
Peach Hair.description: Peach Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Peach Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Peach Hair. Exact hex color reference: #F4C195. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Pearl Eyes.name: Pearl Eyes
Pearl Eyes.description: Pearl Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Pearl Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Pearl Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #F0EDE8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Quick Swap.name: Quick Swap
Quick Swap.description: You can change equipment instantaneously. Quick Swap lets you switch weapons, armor, accessories, and outfits in the blink of an eye, pulling gear from your person (or Infinite Inventory if you have it) and equipping it with no delay. Mid-fight weapon switches, instant armor changes, swapping to formal wear between the dungeon entrance and the guild counter, all of it happens so fast it looks like a visual glitch. This makes you unpredictable in combat and suspiciously well-dressed for someone who was crawling through a Riftmaw ten minutes ago.
Quick Swap.traitNarrativeEffects: You've changed outfits mid-conversation and companions have stopped asking how because the answer is always 'I just did.'

Rich Brown.name: Rich Brown
Rich Brown.description: Deep brown skin with warm undertones, steady, striking, and photographs beautifully in any setting.
Rich Brown.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. Jewelry looks twice as expensive against your skin and you take full advantage.

Short Hair.name: Short Hair
Short Hair.description: Simple short hair that frames the face cleanly, versatile, practical, and effortlessly attractive. Short enough to stay out of the way, long enough to have personality. The default protagonist option that works for every genre and every situation.
Short Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair grows at exactly the speed needed to always look like this. Anime physics are real.

Side Braid.name: Side Braid
Side Braid.description: Side Braid styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Side Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use side braid as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Side Shave.name: Side Shave
Side Shave.description: Side Shave styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Side Shave.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use side shave as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Soft Waves.name: Soft Waves
Soft Waves.description: Soft, undulating waves that catch light like water, gentle, romantic, and the kind of style that makes every breeze look choreographed.
Soft Waves.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render soft, gentle waves in the hair.

Space Buns.name: Space Buns
Space Buns.description: Two buns perched high on either side of the head, cute, bold, and utterly unmissable in a crowd. The fun option.
Space Buns.traitNarrativeEffects: You have been told you look like a character from something and you take it as a compliment every time.

Spellblade.name: Spellblade
Spellblade.description:
You stand where the Mage won't and cast what the Swordsman can't. Spellblades weave magic into every strike, Enchanted Slashes carrying your attunement's color, a Mana Blade that turns the enemy's measured distance into a fatal miscalculation. One weapon, two languages, zero warning about which one is speaking next. The academy calls it a hybrid style. The people you duel call it unfair.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Spellblade.traitNarrativeEffects: Your blade hums with unused mana and you've accidentally set fire to your scabbard more times than you'll admit.

Spiky Hair.name: Spiky Hair
Spiky Hair.description: Spiky Hair styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Spiky Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use spiky hair as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Swordstaff.name: Swordstaff
Swordstaff.description:
A traditional double-edged sword blade affixed securely to the end of a long wooden staff, which functions as a long handle. Blade up, the Swordstaff has the long-reach benefits of a pole weapon combined with the heavy cutting and thrusting capabilities of a sword. Blade down, the Swordstaff's pommel serves as the focus for a caster.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Swordstaff.traitNarrativeEffects: SIGNATURE WEAPON: A traditional double-edged sword blade affixed securely to the end of a long wooden staff, which functions as a long handle. Blade up, the Swordstaff has the long-reach benefits of a pole weapon combined with the heavy cutting and thrusting capabilities of a sword. Blade down, the Swordstaff's pommel serves as the focus for a caster. Treat this as the selected signature weapon in character creator; depict it clearly as one sword blade on a long wooden staff, not a double-ended weapon and not two separate swords. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Taper Fade.name: Taper Fade
Taper Fade.description: Taper Fade styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Taper Fade.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Topaz Eyes.name: Topaz Eyes
Topaz Eyes.description: Topaz Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Topaz Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Topaz Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #C89830. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Twin Tails.name: Twin Tails
Twin Tails.description: EXACT VISUAL LOCK: twin pigtails / twin tails hairstyle. The final Appearance must show two tied side sections and must not replace this with loose or cascading hair. Twin pigtails / twin tails hairstyle. The hair is divided into two clear tied sections, one on each side, visible within the selected frame when hair is visible.
Twin Tails.traitNarrativeEffects: You tie them tighter before fights and people can read your mood by how high they sit.

War Hammer.name: War Hammer
War Hammer.description:
Blunt, heavy, and completely indifferent to armor. Hammers don't cut, they crush, and against plate that beats any edge, because the force just travels straight through into whatever is wearing it. Paladins, forge-warriors, and pragmatists all reach the same tidy conclusion: the elegant answer to 'how do I get through this armor' is that you don't have to.

Primary Attribute: Strength
War Hammer.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a war hammer. Describe combat with crushing blows, concussive impacts, denting armor, and the satisfying authority of blunt-force problem-solving. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

War Priest.name: War Priest
War Priest.description:
More aggressive than a Priest, more divine than a Paladin, first through the door regardless. War Priests fight the front line with holy magic and heavy conviction, Cover Ally interceptions drilled to reflex, Healing Draughts thrown mid-melee. You believe in prevention, delivered at close range. The sermon has a mace. Attendance is not optional for the enemy.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Strength
War Priest.traitNarrativeEffects: You pray before meals, battles, and before healing anyone who got hurt doing something stupid. Your disapproval is itself divine punishment.

Warm Brown.name: Warm Brown
Warm Brown.description: Medium-deep brown with warm red-gold undertones. Rich, even, and warm in every kind of light.
Warm Brown.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. You look incredible in earth tones and you have built your entire wardrobe around it.

Warm Mocha.name: Warm Mocha
Warm Mocha.description: A rich warm brown complexion with soft highlights and clean anime shading. It suits adventurers, nobles, mages, beastkin, shrine attendants, and any character who should have a grounded, warm, beautifully readable skin tone across both daylight and candlelight scenes.
Warm Mocha.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use warm mocha brown as the definitive complexion. Render soft warm highlights and clean shadows; avoid muddy shading or color drift.

Warm Peach.name: Warm Peach
Warm Peach.description: Light-medium skin with pink-warm undertones. Rosy and approachable, the kind of complexion that looks good in firelight.
Warm Peach.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. Your cheeks go pink in the cold and people think it is charming.

White Eyes.name: White Eyes
White Eyes.description: White Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
White Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: White Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #F0F0F0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

White Hair.name: White Hair
White Hair.description: White Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
White Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: White Hair. Exact hex color reference: #F8F8F8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Woodworker.name: Woodworker
Woodworker.description:
A craftsperson of bows, staves, furniture, carved pieces, and quietly essential daily goods. Woodworkers bring warmth and utility to a world that would otherwise be all steel and ruins.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Woodworker.traitNarrativeEffects: You pick up sticks and rate their potential.

Almond Eyes.name: Almond Eyes
Almond Eyes.description: Large, expressive almond-shaped eyes, slightly tilted at the outer corners, elegant and captivating. The kind of eyes that make people feel like you're seeing through them.
Almond Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls eye shape only. Render large, expressive, almond-shaped eyes with slight upward tilt.

Arachne-Kin.name: Arachne-Kin
Arachne-Kin.description:
Multiple eyes. Silk glands. An instinct for architectural engineering that would put dwarven builders to shame. Arachne-Kin carry the blood of the great spider clans, not full arachne, but enough that the traits show in the extra pairs of small eyes along your temples, the delicate spinnerets at your wrists, and the ability to sense vibrations through any surface you're touching. Most people are scared of you. The smart ones realize you're the best trapmaker, weaver, and ambush specialist in any adventuring party. You are patient, precise, and comfortable in the dark. You also have very strong feelings about interior decorating.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Arachne-Kin have a normal humanlike body with optional arachne-themed eyes, small temple eye markings, silk motifs, or wrist spinneret accents; no spider abdomen, no extra arms, no spider legs.

RACE REFERENCE: Arachne-Kin is a humanoid person with silk motifs, fine web accessories, small extra-eye markings, or spider-lace patterns while keeping normal humanoid anatomy. Use patience, weaving, trap sense, and elegant predatory focus as background hooks.
Arachne-Kin.traitNarrativeEffects: You organize everything into webs, schedules, plans, relationships, and get mildly offended when people call your meticulously crafted silk 'cobwebs.' Those are structural, thank you. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Arachne-Kin have a normal humanlike body with optional arachne-themed eyes, small temple eye markings, silk motifs, or wrist spinneret accents; no spider abdomen, no extra arms, no spider legs. RACE REFERENCE: Arachne-Kin is a humanoid person with silk motifs, fine web accessories, small extra-eye markings, or spider-lace patterns while keeping normal humanoid anatomy.

Auburn Hair.name: Auburn Hair
Auburn Hair.description: Auburn Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Auburn Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Auburn Hair. Exact hex color reference: #8B3A2A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Battle Chef.name: Battle Chef
Battle Chef.description:
A culinary professional whose skills translate straight into combat support, morale boosts, fast field prep, and knife confidence. Battle Chefs make danger survivable and dinner non-negotiable.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Battle Chef.traitNarrativeEffects: You rate every monster you fight on edibility before threat level.

Beast Tamer.name: Beast Tamer
Beast Tamer.description:
Your companions chose you, and they fight like they mean it. Beast Tamers bond with wild creatures as partners, not pets, a Wild Call that brings the local wilderness to your side, a pack that strikes as one. You fight surrounded by loyalty with claws. Enemies who target the tamer learn the arrangement's fine print: every beast on the field takes that personally.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Beast Tamer.traitNarrativeEffects: Animals cross streets to greet you, you carry treats in every pocket including formal wear, and you've argued 'he's friendly' about creatures actively displaying threat behavior. You were right every time. So far.

Beauty Mark.name: Beauty Mark
Beauty Mark.description: A single dark beauty mark, near the lips, beneath the eye, or at the corner of the mouth. Small, elegant, and disproportionately memorable. The kind of detail artists include on purpose.
Beauty Mark.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render a small beauty mark near the mouth or eye.

Blonde Hair.name: Blonde Hair
Blonde Hair.description: Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #D4A843. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Button Nose.name: Button Nose
Button Nose.description: A short nose with a rounded tip and a slight upward angle, compact in profile, clearly defined at the bridge.
Button Nose.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls nose shape only. Render a short, rounded, slightly upturned nose.

Center Part.name: Center Part
Center Part.description: A classic center part, hair divided evenly down the middle. Clean, symmetrical, and the kind of style that works with everything from formal robes to battle armor.
Center Part.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair parted cleanly down the center.

Coiled Hair.name: Coiled Hair
Coiled Hair.description: Coiled Hair styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Coiled Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use coils as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Copper Eyes.name: Copper Eyes
Copper Eyes.description: Copper Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Copper Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Copper Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #B86830. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Copper Hair.name: Copper Hair
Copper Hair.description: Copper Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Copper Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Copper Hair. Exact hex color reference: #B87333. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Crown Braid.name: Crown Braid
Crown Braid.description: A braid wrapped around the head like a crown, regal, practical, and surprisingly combat-ready. No loose strands, no distractions.
Crown Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: People try to figure out where the braid starts and give up every time.

Dark Knight.name: Dark Knight
Dark Knight.description:
Tragic hero energy, in plate. Dark Knights turn burden into pressure, Shadow Cleaves that hit like grief with an edge, Dark Pulses that clear the room around a person the night itself seems to follow. Your power has a cost and everyone can see you paying it, which is exactly why the front line trusts you. Cursed, ominous, and always, always first through the door.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Dark Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: Your armor creaks ominously even when freshly oiled, ravens land near you with an air of appointment, and you deliver genuinely warm compliments in a voice that makes them sound like prophecies of doom.

Dual Blades.name: Dual Blades
Dual Blades.description:
Two blades, one in each hand, fast and relentlessly aggressive. Dual wielding trades reach and blocking power for pressure that never lets up: you don't stop attacking, every defense is a counter-slash, and each opening takes two hits instead of one. It's for people who looked at a single sword and genuinely felt shortchanged.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Dual Blades.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist dual-wields blades. Describe combat with rapid alternating strikes, crossed-blade blocks, spinning attacks, and the flashy aggression of a twin-sword style. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Swordsmanship.

Enchantress.name: Enchantress
Enchantress.description:
You strengthen exactly what they were proudest of, and unravel exactly what they were hiding. The Enchantress bends a fight's pace through allure, glamour, and impeccably layered support magic, allies empowered, enemies distracted, rooms complicated. Seduction, buffing, and social danger, fused into one class that wins battles people didn't realize were happening.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Enchantress.traitNarrativeEffects: People lose the thread of an argument when you smile, and tell you things they meant to keep. Your hands glow faintly when you weave a glamour, and the light flatters you.

Fluffy Hair.name: Fluffy Hair
Fluffy Hair.description: Fluffy Hair styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Fluffy Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use fluffy hair as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

French Crop.name: French Crop
French Crop.description: A short, textured French crop, cropped tight on the sides with textured length on top. Modern, sharp, and the kind of cut that looks like it was styled by someone who knows what they're doing.
French Crop.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render a short French crop with textured length on top and tight sides.

Ginger Hair.name: Ginger Hair
Ginger Hair.description: Ginger Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Ginger Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Ginger Hair. Exact hex color reference: #C86427. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Holy Gunner.name: Holy Gunner
Holy Gunner.description:
The healer just drew a weapon, and it's blessed. Holy Gunners fire sacrament at range, exorcism rounds, radiant tracers, Aimed Shots with a prayer inscribed on every one, and a Holy Strike for whatever gets close. Calm, stylish, and divine without ever standing still in robes. You belong in church conspiracies and demon-court standoffs. You know it. You dress for it.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Holy Gunner.traitNarrativeEffects: You bless each round out loud before loading, tip your hat after every confirmed exorcism, and refuse to shoot anything on consecrated ground without apologizing to the floor first.

Illusionist.name: Illusionist
Illusionist.description:
Reality is a suggestion, and you suggest otherwise. Illusionists weaponize perception, Mirror Images that soak the killing blow, Phantasms the enemy's body believes before their mind can argue. Phantom armies, false terrain, five of you, none of you. Enemies who beat an Illusionist are never quite sure they did. Usually they're right to wonder.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Illusionist.traitNarrativeEffects: You've lied so beautifully that you once convinced a mirror you were someone else. You narrate your own entrance into rooms and nobody's sure if it's a spell or a personality disorder.

Indigo Eyes.name: Indigo Eyes
Indigo Eyes.description: Indigo Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Indigo Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Indigo Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #3A2890. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Light Ivory.name: Light Ivory
Light Ivory.description: Light skin with warm yellow undertones, soft, warm, and steady in any lighting.
Light Ivory.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. You look healthy even when you are exhausted and people resent you for it.

Light Olive.name: Light Olive
Light Olive.description: Light-medium skin with green-gold undertones, common along trade routes and coastal regions. Tans easily, burns rarely.
Light Olive.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. You pick up color fast and lose it slowly.

Long Lashes.name: Long Lashes
Long Lashes.description: Long, thick lashes that frame the eyes like curtains, the kind that make every glance feel intentional and every blink look like a scene transition.
Long Lashes.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls eye framing only. Render long, prominent eyelashes.

Loose Curls.name: Loose Curls
Loose Curls.description: Loose, flowing curls that tumble softly around the face and shoulders, romantic, relaxed, and the kind of curls that look like they happened on purpose even when they didn't.
Loose Curls.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render loose, soft, flowing curls.

Medium Hair.name: Medium Hair
Medium Hair.description: Hair at that perfect middle length, past the ears, brushing the neck, with just enough body to move and flow without getting in the way. The versatile center of hair length that can be styled up, down, or just left to do its own beautiful thing.
Medium Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair hits the sweet spot between 'I tried' and 'I woke up like this' and you will never reveal which one is true.

Moon Rabbit.name: Moon Rabbit
Moon Rabbit.description:
Moon Rabbits are celestial-touched rabbitfolk said to descend from spirits who once lived on the moon. Soft rabbit ears, luminous eyes, faint moon-shaped markings, and hair in white, silver, pale gold, lavender, or moonlit blue. Under moonlight, their eyes glow and their steps seem almost weightless. Quick, graceful, lucky, and deeply associated with medicine, alchemy, dreams, and moonlit shrines. Some serve as shrine attendants or wandering healers; others become adventurers whose harmless appearance causes enemies to underestimate them exactly once. A Moon Rabbit is considered a sign of good fortune, though their luck often arrives in strange and inconvenient ways.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Moon Rabbit traits mean human skin, elegant rabbit ears, lunar eyes or markings, and a small tail; no full rabbit body or fur-covered skin.

RACE REFERENCE: Moon Rabbit is a humanoid rabbitkin touched by lunar magic, with long ears, moonlit eyes or markings, one small tail, and graceful light-footed movement. Use moon omens, shrine ties, and impossible leaps as background hooks.
Moon Rabbit.traitNarrativeEffects: Your ears twitch before you consciously register danger, you instinctively hop over puddles and low obstacles, and you have been thanked by strangers for luck you didn't realize you were radiating. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Moon Rabbit traits mean human skin, elegant rabbit ears, lunar eyes or markings, and a small tail; no full rabbit body or fur-covered skin. RACE REFERENCE: Moon Rabbit is a humanoid rabbitkin touched by lunar magic, with long ears, moonlit eyes or markings, one small tail, and graceful light-footed movement.

Necromancer.name: Necromancer
Necromancer.description:
The dead work for you, and the paperwork is immaculate. Necromancers practice death as a field science, Raising Dead with a professor's calm, Soul Drains that balance the books mid-battle. Your army grows with every enemy mistake and your patience outlasts sieges. Methodical, eerie, strangely academic. Your best skeleton has a name and a hat. He's earned both.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Necromancer.traitNarrativeEffects: You talk to corpses out of professional habit and have given your most reliable skeleton minion a name and a hat.

Oni-Blooded.name: Oni-Blooded
Oni-Blooded.description:
A horn, or two, rising from your forehead, inhuman physical strength, and the blood of the oni: ogre-demons of myth and legend. Oni-blooded are loud, powerful, and dramatically larger than life in every sense. You hit harder than physics should allow, your pain tolerance is legendary, and your appetite, for food, for drink, for battle, for everything, makes even seasoned adventurers stare. Oni culture values strength, honesty, and spectacular excess. You were not built for subtlety. You were built for breaking things beautifully.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Oni-Blooded remain humanlike with one or two horns, intense eyes, and strong presence; no ogre monster body, no abnormal skin unless skin tone says so.

RACE REFERENCE: Oni-Blooded is a powerful humanoid with one or two horns, small fangs, strong build, vivid eyes, and bold presence. Use strength, appetite, competitive courtship, and direct emotional honesty as background hooks.
Oni-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: You challenge people to drinking contests as a greeting, your laughter shakes rooms, and you've accidentally broken every delicate thing you've ever been asked to hold.
