IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Oni-Blooded remain humanlike with one or two horns, intense eyes, and strong presence; no ogre monster body, no abnormal skin unless skin tone says so. RACE REFERENCE: Oni-Blooded is a powerful humanoid with one or two horns, small fangs, strong build, vivid eyes, and bold presence.

Orange Hair.name: Orange Hair
Orange Hair.description: Orange Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Orange Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Orange Hair. Exact hex color reference: #CC5500. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Orc-Blooded.name: Orc-Blooded
Orc-Blooded.description:
Tall, broad-shouldered, and built like a living weapon, with the cheekbones and jawline of a war god sculpted from bronze or jade-green stone. Orc-Blooded carry the inheritance of the great orc warrior clans: powerful frames that tower over most humans, small tusks that jut from the lower jaw like natural jewelry, pointed ears, and features that are striking rather than brutish, high cheekbones, strong brows, intense eyes, and the kind of physical presence that makes a room rearrange itself around them. Their skin ranges from deep green to warm bronze to ashen gray, always with a faint metallic sheen that catches firelight beautifully. Orc culture values strength, honesty, and the beauty of a well-fought battle. Other races find them intimidating. Then attractive. Then intimidating because they're attractive.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fantasy person with subtle tusks or strong features; no full green monster body unless skin tone says so, no hunchback creature anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Orc-Blooded is a powerful humanoid with broad build, strong jaw, small tusks, pointed ears, and striking warrior presence. Use clan honor, physical confidence, and direct social habits as background hooks.
Orc-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: You settle disagreements by arm wrestling before you consider talking, and you genuinely cannot understand why other races find this unreasonable. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fantasy person with subtle tusks or strong features; no full green monster body unless skin tone says so, no hunchback creature anatomy. RACE REFERENCE: Orc-Blooded is a powerful humanoid with broad build, strong jaw, small tusks, pointed ears, and striking warrior presence.

Phoenixborn.name: Phoenixborn
Phoenixborn.description:
Somewhere in your lineage, a phoenix chose your bloodline. The fire didn't just burn, it nested, bred, and wove itself into your genetics like a hereditary argument with mortality. Your hair carries natural ember-like luminescence. Your skin is warm to the touch in ways that make physical contact memorable. Wounds close faster than they should. And once, maybe just once so far, you came back from something that should have killed you, wreathed in flame and furious about it. Phoenixborn are vanishingly rare, borderline mythical, and treated by the Church, the Academy, and every magical researcher in Luxcellia as either a miracle or a specimen. You're trying to be a person instead.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Phoenixborn remain humanlike with ember hair, warm glow, feather accents, or fiery markings; no bird head, no full phoenix body.

RACE REFERENCE: Phoenixborn is a humanoid person with warm radiance, feather motifs, ember markings, flame-colored hair accents, or golden-red eyes. Use rebirth symbolism, dramatic resilience, and heat-linked emotion as background hooks.
Phoenixborn.traitNarrativeEffects: Your body temperature runs noticeably warm, your tears evaporate before they fall, and you have died at least once already, which you bring up at parties with deeply unsettling casualness. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Phoenixborn remain humanlike with ember hair, warm glow, feather accents, or fiery markings; no bird head, no full phoenix body. RACE REFERENCE: Phoenixborn is a humanoid person with warm radiance, feather motifs, ember markings, flame-colored hair accents, or golden-red eyes.

Purple Eyes.name: Purple Eyes
Purple Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: deep, rich purple eyes. Rare, regal, and inherently magical. Purple eyes suggest noble blood, arcane affinity, or a destiny that isn't quite human. They are the eye color of characters who change the world.
Purple Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Purple Eyes. Exact color reference: rich purple #8E44AD with deeper #6C3483 depth. Render deep, vivid purple irises.

Purple Hair.name: Purple Hair
Purple Hair.description: Purple Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Purple Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Purple Hair. Exact hex color reference: #6A2EAB. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Rune Carver.name: Rune Carver
Rune Carver.description:
A specialist in inscribing magical symbols onto objects, buildings, wards, and gear. Rune Carvers are slower and more deliberate than enchanters, but excellent at lasting structured magic.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Rune Carver.traitNarrativeEffects: You see runes that others miss, scratched into dungeon walls, etched into old coins, hidden in the grain of ancient wood.

Rune Knight.name: Rune Knight
Rune Knight.description:
You carved power into your weapon, your armor, and, where it counted, yourself. Rune Knights channel ancient symbols through steel: Rune Strikes that cycle fire, frost, and force, Runic Shields that answer in kind. Every glowing line on your gear is a promise with a trigger. Rune-readers can tell across a battlefield exactly what school you studied and exactly what is about to be proven.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Rune Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: You doodle runes on any surface when thinking, some of them faintly glow, which alarms innkeepers, and you explain each rune's meaning to anyone nearby whether they asked or not. They rarely asked.

Shaved Head.name: Shaved Head
Shaved Head.description: Completely bare, no hair, no pretense, no distractions. The shaved head is the ultimate statement of confidence, revealing every line of the face and the shape of the skull. Warriors, monks, and those who've made vows favor this look. It says 'I have nothing to hide.'
Shaved Head.traitNarrativeEffects: You never have a bad hair day. This is your superpower and you wield it mercilessly against those who do.

Short Beard.name: Short Beard
Short Beard.description: A neatly maintained short beard, trimmed close, following the jawline. Adds maturity and authority without the maintenance of a full beard.
Short Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a short trimmed beard.

Silver Eyes.name: Silver Eyes
Silver Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: luminous silver eyes like polished mirrors or moonlight given form. Cool, ethereal, and achingly beautiful, silver eyes see through deception and reflect the truth. The color of seers, moonchild bloodlines, and winter spirits.
Silver Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Silver Eyes. Exact color reference: bright silver #BDC3C7 with cool steel #95A5A6 depth and bright #ECF0F1 highlights. Render luminous metallic silver irises.

Silver Hair.name: Silver Hair
Silver Hair.description: Silver Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Silver Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Silver Hair. Exact hex color reference: #C0C0C0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Small Horns.name: Small Horns
Small Horns.description: Small horns rising from the forehead or temples, demon blood, dragon heritage, or oni ancestry made visible. They're short enough to almost hide under hair. Almost.
Small Horns.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial/head appearance only. Render small horns on the forehead or temples.

Violet Eyes.name: Violet Eyes
Violet Eyes.description: Violet Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Violet Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Violet Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #7030A8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Barrier Mage.name: Barrier Mage
Barrier Mage.description:
Your entire practice is one promise: nobody dies. Barrier Mages don't throw fireballs, they CATCH them. Walls, domes, platforms, and shields raised exactly where the harm was headed, an Aegis for every ally and a Reflect for anything rude enough to insist. You are the reason the party takes risks. You are also the reason those risks keep working out.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Barrier Mage.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively put your hand up to block things, thrown objects, rain, harsh sunlight, and a faint shimmer appears before you remember you're off-duty.

Beast Keeper.name: Beast Keeper
Beast Keeper.description:
A handler of mounts, familiars, ranch creatures, and difficult magical animals. Beast Keepers understand feeding, calming, training, and not getting bitten in front of customers.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Beast Keeper.traitNarrativeEffects: You give dangerous monsters cute nicknames before confirming they are friendly.

Blade Dancer.name: Blade Dancer
Blade Dancer.description:
Two swords, one rhythm, zero pauses. Blade Dancers flow between strikes like the fight is choreography only they rehearsed, an Infinite Edge of spinning steel, footwork that never presents a target, offense that never stops to breathe. You are beautiful to watch and miserable to fight, and the enemy will spend the whole duel one beat behind the music.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Blade Dancer.traitNarrativeEffects: You dual-wield everything including conversations. Standing still physically hurts and you fidget with your blades when bored.

Braided Hair.name: Braided Hair
Braided Hair.description: Hair woven into a clean, structured braid, whether thick and heavy or tight and practical. The braid speaks of patience, discipline, and a character who takes the time to prepare properly before facing the day or the battlefield.
Braided Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: You braid your hair every morning with the same meditative focus a swordsman uses to maintain their blade. The routine centers you.

Chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
Chronomancer.description:
You fight in moments that haven't happened yet. Chronomancers bend time's flow, Haste Steps that leave the world in slow motion, Time Dilation that steals seconds from the enemy and hands them to your allies. Every fight against you is fought at your tempo, and your tempo cheats. Time keeps books on people like you. So far, you're ahead.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Chronomancer.traitNarrativeEffects: You occasionally experience events slightly out of order and have to pretend you weren't surprised by something that hasn't happened yet.

Clean-Shaven.name: Clean-Shaven
Clean-Shaven.description: No facial hair, smooth jaw, clear chin, the classic anime protagonist default. Clean, youthful, and unambiguous.
Clean-Shaven.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a clean-shaven face with no visible facial hair.

Crimson Eyes.name: Crimson Eyes
Crimson Eyes.description: Crimson Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Crimson Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Crimson Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #A01820. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Crimson Hair.name: Crimson Hair
Crimson Hair.description: Crimson Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Crimson Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Crimson Hair. Exact hex color reference: #8B0000. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Crystal-Born.name: Crystal-Born
Crystal-Born.description:
Part of your body is living crystal, not embedded in flesh but grown from it, as natural as bone. Translucent gemstone formations trace your skin like veins of quartz through marble: along your temples, down your forearms, across your collarbones, or clustered at your joints. Your eyes are faceted like cut gems, refracting light into soft prismatic halos. Your skin has a faint mineral sheen, cool to the touch, harder than it looks, and beautiful in a way that makes jewelers stare. Crystal-Born are rare: children of elemental convergences, mana crystallization events, or bloodlines that touched the Riftlight and came back changed. Your body hums at frequencies other people can't hear, and in direct sunlight, you scatter rainbows.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid person with crystal accents, facets, or markings; no full crystal golem body and no jagged monster silhouette.

RACE REFERENCE: Crystal-Born is a humanoid person with living crystal accents on skin, temples, collarbones, joints, or eyes. Use resonance, mineral memory, prismatic mana, and jewelcraft attention as background hooks.
Crystal-Born.traitNarrativeEffects: You chime faintly when struck, your crystal formations glow brighter when you cast magic, and you are deeply uncomfortable around pickaxes. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid person with crystal accents, facets, or markings; no full crystal golem body and no jagged monster silhouette. RACE REFERENCE: Crystal-Born is a humanoid person with living crystal accents on skin, temples, collarbones, joints, or eyes.

Deal Breaker.name: Deal Breaker
Deal Breaker.description: Every negotiation tilts in your favor. Deal Breaker is a cheat-tier social instinct that lets you sense what someone really wants in a deal, spot leverage you shouldn't logically know about, and propose terms that feel irresistibly fair to the other party while being absurdly favorable to you. Merchants give you discounts they don't understand. Nobles agree to terms they normally wouldn't. Guild quest rewards mysteriously end up better than posted. At higher levels, you can negotiate with non-standard entities: spirits, dungeon sentiences, ancient constructs, and the occasional demon who respects a good contract.
Deal Breaker.traitNarrativeEffects: You have never paid full price for anything in Luxcellia and the merchant's guild has a file on you that's labeled 'HOW.'

Death Knight.name: Death Knight
Death Knight.description:
You kept fighting after the limits stopped mattering. Death Knights are necrotic endurance in armor, Deathgrips that drag the enemy to you, Unholy Surges that answer wounds with aggression. You do not tire the way the living do, you do not fall on schedule, and enemies who plan around a normal knight's stamina discover you were never using any.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Death Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: The temperature drops when you enter a room and drinks near you go cold. You've stopped apologizing for it and started calling it ambiance.

Dungeon Chef.name: Dungeon Chef
Dungeon Chef.description:
A monster-ingredient survival cook who can turn whatever the dungeon tried to kill you with into something hot, useful, and aggressively comforting. Distinct from a Battle Chef, this is adaptation cuisine.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Dexterity
Dungeon Chef.traitNarrativeEffects: Use for camp cooking, monster ingredient prep, morale boosts, survival meals, and food-as-care scenes. Meals may support the party, reveal culture, or create warm downtime moments.

Emerald Eyes.name: Emerald Eyes
Emerald Eyes.description: Emerald Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Emerald Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Emerald Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #1A7A3A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Fallen Angel.name: Fallen Angel
Fallen Angel.description:
A Fallen Angel is proof that even heaven has politics. Once bound to the celestial order, they now walk Luxcellia as exiles, rebels, or abandoned servants of divine power. Their wings carry ash-dark feathers, missing plumes, or burn-like celestial markings. Their halos are cracked, dimmed, or shadowed, sacred light strained through grief. The Church views them with deep unease; the Twilight Dominion treats them as fascinating contradictions. A Fallen Angel holds sacred light and old sorrow at once, which makes them a powerful ally, a dangerous enemy, and a mystery no one quite solves.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Fallen angels remain humanlike with dark wings, halo fragments, or shadowed divine markings; no monstrous demon body, no horror anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Fallen Angel is a humanoid celestial exile with dark wings, cracked halo, shadowed light markings, and beautiful solemn presence. Use exile, divine politics, fractured faith, and mixed light/shadow power as background hooks.
Fallen Angel.traitNarrativeEffects: Your cracked halo flickers into visibility when you feel strong emotion, and your shadow moves a half-second behind you, which makes solemn entrances very dramatic and casual lies very difficult. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Fallen angels remain humanlike with dark wings, halo fragments, or shadowed divine markings; no monstrous demon body, no horror anatomy. RACE REFERENCE: Fallen Angel is a humanoid celestial exile with dark wings, cracked halo, shadowed light markings, and beautiful solemn presence.

Feral Energy.name: Feral Energy
Feral Energy.description: There is a wildness in your movement and gaze that makes civilization seem slightly optional. People assume you will either protect them with your whole chest or bite someone.
Feral Energy.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs read the protagonist as half wild: they expect climbing, biting and no table manners, while animals and beastkin relax around them.

French Braid.name: French Braid
French Braid.description: French Braid styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
French Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use french braid as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Gift Crafter.name: Gift Crafter
Gift Crafter.description:
A specialist in meaningful keepsakes, romantic tokens, personalized charms, and the kind of handcrafted presents people keep for years. It is a soft-power profession with surprising emotional reach.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Gift Crafter.traitNarrativeEffects: You remember tiny emotional details and turn them into devastatingly personal gifts.

Gravity Mage.name: Gravity Mage
Gravity Mage.description:
Down is negotiable, and you hold the pen. Gravity Mages command weight itself, enemies crushed into the ground or floated helplessly off it, Gravitational Vortexes that reorganize formations, Weightless Zones where armor becomes a liability. Nothing anyone carries works the way they trained. Everything you dislike gets heavier. That's the whole negotiation.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Gravity Mage.traitNarrativeEffects: Small objects near you occasionally float when you're distracted, and you always land from jumps slightly more gracefully than physics should allow.

Half-Up Hair.name: Half-Up Hair
Half-Up Hair.description: Half-Up Hair styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Half-Up Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use half-up hair as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Honeyed Gold.name: Honeyed Gold
Honeyed Gold.description: A warm golden complexion with soft sunlit undertones, ideal for travelers, cheerful adventurers, beastkin settlements, coastal merchants, and characters who look like they spend real time outdoors. It should feel healthy, warm, and inviting rather than orange or overly saturated.
Honeyed Gold.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use warm honey-gold skin as the definitive complexion. Render golden undertones and natural anime shading; avoid orange spray-tan color or heavy artificial glow.

Ice Affinity.name: Ice Affinity
Ice Affinity.description:
Ice magic is the elegant art of cold, stillness, and precision. It freezes, preserves, sharpens, restrains, and builds beautiful battlefield geometry out of absolute temperature control.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Ice Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Ice for freezing, restraint, sharp crystal edges, cold denial, and controlled elegance. Distinguish it from Water by emphasizing stillness and exactness.

Layered Hair.name: Layered Hair
Layered Hair.description: Layered hair with varying lengths creating volume and dimension, the kind of style that has texture and movement without being messy.
Layered Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render layered hair with visible length variations creating volume.

Low Ponytail.name: Low Ponytail
Low Ponytail.description: Gathered at the nape, relaxed, composed, and quietly put-together. The scholar's ponytail, the swordsman's resting style.
Low Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: You pull it over one shoulder when you are reading and it has become your whole personality.

Magic Tailor.name: Magic Tailor
Magic Tailor.description:
A tailor who works enchantments into fabric, hems, sigils, and decorative construction. Magic Tailors create clothing that is beautiful first and useful the moment someone underestimates it.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Magic Tailor.traitNarrativeEffects: Use for enchanted clothing, outfit repair, disguise styling, noble fashion knowledge, and magical fabric upgrades. The protagonist can read status, faction, and mood through clothing details.

Mutton Chops.name: Mutton Chops
Mutton Chops.description: Bold sideburns extending down the jaw without connecting at the chin, theatrical, commanding, and radiating 'seasoned military officer' or 'noble duelist' energy.
Mutton Chops.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render bold mutton chop sideburns.

Painted Lips.name: Painted Lips
Painted Lips.description: Lips tinted or painted in a signature shade, bold red, soft rose, deep plum, or something more unusual. The kind of detail that makes every word feel like it matters.
Painted Lips.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls lip color only. Render tinted or painted lips in a distinct shade.

Pointed Ears.name: Pointed Ears
Pointed Ears.description: Subtly pointed ear tips, not full elven length, just enough to mark non-human heritage. They peek through hair and catch attention in profile.
Pointed Ears.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls ear shape only. Render subtly pointed ear tips.

Rainbow Hair.name: Rainbow Hair
Rainbow Hair.description: Rainbow Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Rainbow Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Rainbow Hair. Exact hex color reference: #FF6B8A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Refined Nose.name: Refined Nose
Refined Nose.description: A small, elegant nose with a narrow bridge and refined tip, the kind that makes every profile look like it belongs on a coin. Aristocratic without being severe.
Refined Nose.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls nose shape only. Render a small, elegant, narrow-bridged nose.

Sanpaku Eyes.name: Sanpaku Eyes
Sanpaku Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: eyes where white is visible beneath the iris, creating an intense, slightly wild, unforgettable gaze. In anime, sanpaku eyes signal dangerous charisma, hidden instability, or a character who operates at a different emotional frequency than everyone around them. Striking and magnetic.
Sanpaku Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Sanpaku Eyes. Exact color reference: use the iris color naturally but render white sclera visible below the iris (sanpaku-style). Keep eyes expressive and anime-attractive, emphasizing intensity rather than fear.

Scarlet Eyes.name: Scarlet Eyes
Scarlet Eyes.description: Scarlet Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Scarlet Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Scarlet Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #B81020. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Serial Flirt.name: Serial Flirt
Serial Flirt.description: You enjoy teasing, banter, innuendo, and the social spark of attraction whether or not you intend anything serious. You know exactly how to make a room react.
Serial Flirt.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use playful charm, provocation, and practiced social confidence.

Shadow Beard.name: Shadow Beard
Shadow Beard.description: A permanent five o'clock shadow, not quite stubble, not quite clean. The perpetual 'tired handsome mentor' look that anime gives to cool older characters.
Shadow Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a permanent shadow beard across the jaw.

Shield Saint.name: Shield Saint
Shield Saint.description:
You committed entirely, and the commitment holds. Shield Saints elevate protection into a calling, Cover Ally throwing you into the path of harm with practiced precision, Bulwark Charges that relocate the definition of 'front line.' Where Knights balance offense and defense, you deleted the first word. Nothing gets through you. That is not a boast. It is a job description.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Shield Saint.traitNarrativeEffects: Your shield has a name and you introduce it to people. You position yourself between your party and every door by reflex.

Shonen Spike.name: Shonen Spike
Shonen Spike.description: Wild, volumetric spikes that defy gravity and common sense, the iconic shonen protagonist style. Every spike is a declaration of determination, every chaotic angle suggests someone who fights with heart over strategy, and the sheer volume implies a reservoir of power that may or may not exist. Hot-blooded, unstoppable, and suspiciously attractive for something that looks like it was styled by a thunderstorm.
Shonen Spike.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair has achieved a shape that physics cannot explain. Enemies have tried to use it as a grip. It didn't work.

Slicked Back.name: Slicked Back
Slicked Back.description: Smoothed back from the forehead with product or sheer will, clean, sharp, slightly intimidating. Works on anyone.
Slicked Back.traitNarrativeEffects: You run your hand through your hair to slick it back when you're about to say something important.

Soft Jawline.name: Soft Jawline
Soft Jawline.description: A rounded jawline with smooth contours rather than sharp angles, the lower face reads curved and even in profile.
Soft Jawline.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls jaw shape only. Render a rounded jawline with smooth, unangular contours.

Spell-Pistol.name: Spell-Pistol
Spell-Pistol.description:
A compact arcane sidearm that fires mana cartridges, spell rounds, glyph bullets, and condensed elemental shots. It's stylish, faintly illegal-looking, and perfect for anyone who wants ranged magic delivered with a gunslinger's swagger. Keep the feel closer to fantasy engineering than modern hardware: glowing runes on the barrel, arcane recoil, and a reload that looks like a spell of its own.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Spell-Pistol.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a spell-pistol. Describe magic rounds, glowing barrel runes, precise shots, reload gestures, and arcane recoil. Keep it fantasy/JRPG, not realistic modern gunplay. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Firearms.

Storm Caller.name: Storm Caller
Storm Caller.description:
You are a weather system with opinions. Storm Callers command the sky wholesale, Chain Lightning that chooses its circuit, Stormwalls that make the wind take a side. Lightning from clear skies, thunder shaped into blunt instruments, and a battlefield that checks with you before deciding on conditions. Enemies fight you and the forecast simultaneously. The forecast is worse.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Storm Caller.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair stands on end when you're emotional, static shocks everything you touch, and you've been banned from three libraries for accidentally magnetizing the shelving.

Styled Brows.name: Styled Brows
Styled Brows.description: Eyebrows shaped and styled with care, arched, defined, and expressive in a way that makes every reaction readable. The kind of detail that makes resting faces look like art and emotional faces look like theater.
Styled Brows.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls eyebrow shape and styling only. Render shaped, styled, defined eyebrows.

Twin Daggers.name: Twin Daggers
Twin Daggers.description:
Short, fast, and personal. Twin daggers belong to assassins, rogues, and fighters who would rather be inside the enemy's guard than politely outside it. Every exchange happens close enough to watch the other person realize the blades are already moving. Speed and nerve matter more than power, at a range where a mistake is fatal for everyone involved.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Twin Daggers.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapons are twin daggers. Describe combat with rapid slashes, reverse-grip techniques, close-quarters lethality, and the assassin's art of being too close to block. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dagger Fighting.

Twisted Locs.name: Twisted Locs
Twisted Locs.description: Twisted Locs styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Twisted Locs.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Amethyst Eyes.name: Amethyst Eyes
Amethyst Eyes.description: Amethyst Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Amethyst Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Amethyst Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #9B50C0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Ancient Ruins.name: Ancient Ruins
Ancient Ruins.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: Crumbling stone ruins of a forgotten civilization, massive broken columns, vine-covered archways, half-buried statues with weathered faces, and mysterious carved symbols still faintly glowing with residual enchantment. Shafts of light pierce through collapsed ceilings. The atmosphere is mysterious, ancient, and pregnant with secrets waiting to be discovered.
Ancient Ruins.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Appraisal All.name: Appraisal All
Appraisal All.description: You can read the stats, properties, and hidden information of anything you focus on: items, people, monsters, materials, traps, enchantments, food quality, structural integrity, and yes, whether the suspicious potion is actually poisoned. Appraisal All is the cheat skill that turns you into a walking encyclopedia. At higher levels you can appraise abstract things, the strength of a magical barrier, the mood of a guarded person, the structural weakness of a dungeon wall, or the rough value of a noble's entire estate from one glance at the architecture.
Appraisal All.traitNarrativeEffects: You compulsively appraise everything you see and have caught yourself mentally evaluating the thread count of someone's shirt mid-conversation. Checks route by target: reading a person rolls Insight; an item, relic or material rolls Relic Appraisal; a price rolls Merchant Trade; a monster, trap or mechanism rolls investigation.

Arcane Archer.name: Arcane Archer
Arcane Archer.description:
Every arrow is a spell with fletching. Arcane Archers turn the bow into a delivery system for magic, seeker shots that curve around cover, arcane payloads that detonate on arrival, and range that makes enemy casters deeply nervous. You fight from distance, you never waste a shot, and every draw asks the same question: what do you want this arrow to DO? Rangers hunt. Arcane Archers solve.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Arcane Archer.traitNarrativeEffects: You treat every arrow as a spell component and get genuinely offended when someone calls it 'just shooting.'

Auto-Parry EX.name: Auto-Parry EX
Auto-Parry EX.description:
Your body blocks attacks you haven't consciously registered yet. Auto-Parry EX is a cheat-tier defensive reflex that intercepts incoming strikes, projectiles, and sneak attacks before your brain catches up. You've deflected arrows while eating breakfast. You parried a bandit mid-conversation without breaking your sentence. At higher levels it extends to magical attacks, environmental hazards, and 'attacks' your subconscious reads as socially dangerous, like a noble trying to pour you a poisoned drink.

How it works: your body turns part of every blow; a quarter of the health you lose each turn is restored at the end of it.
Auto-Parry EX.traitNarrativeEffects: You've caught thrown objects out of the air so many times that your companions have started testing you by tossing things at your head. You've never missed.

Braided Beard.name: Braided Beard
Braided Beard.description: A beard worked into one or more tight braids, sometimes clasped with metal rings or beads. Dwarven tradition, warrior styling, or pure aesthetic commitment.
Braided Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a braided beard with optional metal clasps.

Burgundy Hair.name: Burgundy Hair
Burgundy Hair.description: Burgundy Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Burgundy Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Burgundy Hair. Exact hex color reference: #6B1F2A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Cerulean Eyes.name: Cerulean Eyes
Cerulean Eyes.description: Cerulean Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Cerulean Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Cerulean Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #1080C8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Charcoal Eyes.name: Charcoal Eyes
Charcoal Eyes.description: Charcoal Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. The irises are a very dark, neutral charcoal gray, only a shade lighter than the pupils, with no blue or brown cast. They keep that smoky near-black in close-ups, emotional reaction shots, and cinematic portrait lighting, and never pick up the hair, outfit, or background color.
Charcoal Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Charcoal Eyes. Draw the irises very dark neutral charcoal gray (hex #36383C), only a shade lighter than the pupil, with a small white catch-light. Never tint the irises blue, brown, violet, or any hair, outfit, or background color, and never lighten them to silver or slate. When two eye colors are selected, use each color for one eye precisely.

Chestnut Eyes.name: Chestnut Eyes
Chestnut Eyes.description: Chestnut Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Chestnut Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Chestnut Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #7A3A18. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Curtain Bangs.name: Curtain Bangs
Curtain Bangs.description: Soft bangs parted in the middle, framing the face like curtains. Trendy, face-shaping, and deceptively high-maintenance.
Curtain Bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: You blow-dry your bangs every morning and the rest of your life bends around that schedule.

Dark Affinity.name: Dark Affinity
Dark Affinity.description:
Dark magic bends sinister force, curse-adjacent pressure, and the fearful gravity of the unknown into a weapon. Heavier, more ominous, and more overtly dangerous than simple Shadow, it deals in dread rather than stealth.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Dark Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Dark for curses, oppressive darkness, abyssal pressure, and threatening magical force. Distinguish it from Shadow by making it feel heavier and more hostile.

Double Braids.name: Double Braids
Double Braids.description: Two braids flanking the face, traditional, sturdy, and built for movement. The adventurer's default when the job gets serious.
Double Braids.traitNarrativeEffects: You braid them tighter the more dangerous the contract and your party reads the tension level.

Dragon Knight.name: Dragon Knight
Dragon Knight.description:
The dragon isn't your mount. The dragon is YOU. Dragon Knights carry draconic blood in mortal frames, claws in combat, scales when it matters, and an intimidating pressure that predates polite society. You fight like the bloodline remembers: overwhelming, territorial, and completely uninterested in whether the enemy was ready. They weren't. Bloodlines never wait.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Dragon Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: Your body temperature runs noticeably hot and you've been asked to stop breathing on people's drinks to warm them.

Dwarf-Blooded.name: Dwarf-Blooded
Dwarf-Blooded.description:
Compact, dense, and built like the mountain stone your ancestors carved their kingdoms from. Dwarf blood means forge affinity in the veins, an instinctive understanding of metal and stone, and a constitution that lets you outdrink creatures twice your size. Dwarven culture values craft, loyalty, and stubbornness, which they call 'determination' and everyone else calls 'refusing to admit you're wrong.' You're shorter than most adventurers. You're also harder to knock down, harder to outlast, and harder to impress.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fantasy person with sturdy proportions; no stone body, no exaggerated caricature anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Dwarf-Blooded is a sturdy humanoid with compact proportions, strong hands, grounded posture, and craft-ready presence. Use forge instinct, endurance, stone sense, and stubborn loyalty as background hooks.
Dwarf-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: You appraise the structural integrity of every building you enter and have caught yourself critiquing dungeon masonry mid-combat. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fantasy person with sturdy proportions; no stone body, no exaggerated caricature anatomy. RACE REFERENCE: Dwarf-Blooded is a sturdy humanoid with compact proportions, strong hands, grounded posture, and craft-ready presence.

Fairy-Blooded.name: Fairy-Blooded
Fairy-Blooded.description:
Delicate features, a faint shimmer to your skin in certain light, and an ancestral connection to the fae courts that makes reality slightly negotiable in your presence. Fairy-blooded are small or slight, mischievous by nature, and carry the old fae gift for glamour, not powerful illusion magic, but a subtle charm that makes everything around you feel a little more beautiful, a little more enchanted. Flowers bloom where you sleep. Small animals follow you. And the fae courts consider you one of theirs, whether you agreed to that arrangement or not.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fae-blooded person with delicate features and optional small translucent wings or shimmer; not a tiny insect, not a nonhuman bug body.

RACE REFERENCE: Fairy-Blooded is a delicate humanoid fae-blooded person with soft shimmer, graceful features, and optional small translucent wings. Use glamour, mischief, nature omens, and iron discomfort as background hooks.
Fairy-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: Butterflies land on you constantly, you get lost following beautiful things without realizing it, and iron gives you a rash you insist is unrelated. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid fae-blooded person with delicate features and optional small translucent wings or shimmer; not a tiny insect, not a nonhuman bug body. RACE REFERENCE: Fairy-Blooded is a delicate humanoid fae-blooded person with soft shimmer, graceful features, and optional small translucent wings.

Fire Affinity.name: Fire Affinity
Fire Affinity.description:
Fire magic answers you with speed, aggression, and theatrical confidence. Its territory is heat, combustion, pressure, battlefield denial, explosive offense, and the kind of dramatic finishing move that scorches reputations as well as stone.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Fire Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use fire for combustion, heat, explosive pressure, molten force, and aggressive offense. Keep it distinct from Light, Lightning, and pure destruction-for-destruction's-sake.

Foxlike Smile.name: Foxlike Smile
Foxlike Smile.description: A narrow, playful smile that makes every sentence feel like it has a hidden route. The face should imply mischief, cleverness, and the possibility that the character knows exactly what everyone in the room wants and is deciding whether to say it out loud.
Foxlike Smile.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL FEATURE LOCK: Render a sly foxlike smile and playful expression. This can support trickster energy without adding animal anatomy; animal ears/tail still require race traits.

Fulani Braids.name: Fulani Braids
Fulani Braids.description: Fulani Braids styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Fulani Braids.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Heavy Stubble.name: Heavy Stubble
Heavy Stubble.description: A few days' worth of dark growth covering the jaw and upper lip, rough, textured, and projecting the energy of someone who has priorities other than grooming.
Heavy Stubble.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render heavy stubble across the jaw, chin, and upper lip.

High Pigtails.name: High Pigtails
High Pigtails.description: Two high pigtails, youthful, energetic, and the kind of style that suggests you fight with enthusiasm and win through sheer determination. Also very grabbable. Choose wisely.
High Pigtails.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair gathered into two pigtails high on the head.

High Ponytail.name: High Ponytail
High Ponytail.description: Tied high and tight, the fighting style. Practical, clean, and the moment you let it down people don't recognize you.
High Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: You tie your hair up before every fight and people know things are serious when you do.

Hot Pink Hair.name: Hot Pink Hair
Hot Pink Hair.description: Hot Pink Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Hot Pink Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Hot Pink Hair. Exact hex color reference: #FF3899. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Ice Blue Eyes.name: Ice Blue Eyes
Ice Blue Eyes.description: Ice Blue Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Ice Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Ice Blue Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #B8D8EC. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Icy Gray Eyes.name: Icy Gray Eyes
Icy Gray Eyes.description: Icy Gray Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Icy Gray Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Icy Gray Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #B8C8CC. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Lamia-Blooded.name: Lamia-Blooded
Lamia-Blooded.description:
Your bloodline carries the inheritance of the great serpent clans, ancient, beautiful, and hypnotically dangerous. It shows in the faint iridescent scales along your throat and collarbones, the way your eyes catch light in the dark, the inhuman flexibility of your spine, and the subtle compulsion in your voice that makes people lean closer when you speak. Lamia-Blooded are rare in Luxcellia and treated with a mix of fascination and wariness. Your ancestors ruled desert kingdoms through charm and constriction. You've inherited both talents. Society finds you mesmerizing, which is exactly what your bloodline was designed to produce.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Draw a human body standing on two human legs. The serpent blood shows only as slit-pupil eyes and a few small iridescent scales at the temples, throat or shoulders. In an image prompt write human, never lamia.

RACE REFERENCE: Lamia-Blooded is a human-bodied person on two human legs, with a human face, slit pupils, a few small scales at the temples, cheeks or throat, and an unhurried sinuous grace. Use hypnotic stillness, heat sense, and old serpent folklore as background hooks.
Lamia-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: You bask in warm sunlight like it's a religious experience and your pupils go slit-shaped when you're focused, which makes staring contests profoundly unfair. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Draw a human body standing on two human legs. The serpent blood shows only as slit-pupil eyes and a few small iridescent scales at the temples, throat or shoulders. In an image prompt write human, never lamia. RACE REFERENCE: Lamia-Blooded is a human-bodied person on two human legs, with a human face, slit pupils, a few small scales at the temples, cheeks or throat, and an unhurried sinuous grace.

Lavender Eyes.name: Lavender Eyes
Lavender Eyes.description: Lavender Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Lavender Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Lavender Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #9080C0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Lavender Hair.name: Lavender Hair
Lavender Hair.description: Lavender Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Lavender Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Lavender Hair. Exact hex color reference: #8A7CB8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Leatherworker.name: Leatherworker
Leatherworker.description:
A maker of boots, belts, travel gear, light armor, and fitted utility pieces. Leatherworkers shine where flexibility, comfort, and practical adventuring equipment matter.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Leatherworker.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively assess the quality and origin of any leather item at a glance.

Light Stubble.name: Light Stubble
Light Stubble.description: A day or two of growth, the 'too busy adventuring to shave' look that adds rugged charm without committing to a full beard.
Light Stubble.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render light stubble across the jaw and chin.

Mahogany Eyes.name: Mahogany Eyes
Mahogany Eyes.description: Mahogany Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Mahogany Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Mahogany Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #6B2218. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Meteor Hammer.name: Meteor Hammer
Meteor Hammer.description:
A heavy striking head on a long chain, built for sweeping arcs, brutal momentum, and the specific pleasure of watching a crowd take a step back. It treats gravity as a partner rather than an obstacle, and it excels at battlefield control, arena theater, and extremely satisfying impacts against anything large enough to deserve one.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Meteor Hammer.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a meteor hammer. Describe spinning momentum, chain control, heavy impacts, wide arcs, and gravity-assisted strikes. Keep the weapon readable and not confused with a normal hammer. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Natural Curls.name: Natural Curls
Natural Curls.description: Defined, bouncy curls in their natural pattern, worn with the quiet confidence of someone who stopped fighting their hair and started owning it.
Natural Curls.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render defined natural curls in their natural pattern.

Noble Bearing.name: Noble Bearing
Noble Bearing.description: You carry yourself with the polish, posture, and social confidence of someone raised around rank. Even people who dislike nobility tend to clock the aura instantly.
Noble Bearing.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs assume good breeding and an education: polite treatment, better rooms, and invitations commoners never see, whether or not you hold the title.

Obsidian Eyes.name: Obsidian Eyes
Obsidian Eyes.description: Obsidian Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. The irises are glossy volcanic-glass black, as dark as the pupils, with a sharp white glint like light on polished stone. They stay black in close-ups, emotional reaction shots, and cinematic portrait lighting, and never pick up the hair, outfit, or background color.
Obsidian Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Obsidian Eyes. Draw the irises glossy obsidian black (hex #080808), as dark as the pupil, with a glassy shine made only of sharp white highlights. Never tint the irises brown, gray, red, violet, blue, or any hair, outfit, or background color, and never make them glow. When two eye colors are selected, use each color for one eye precisely.

Phantom Thief.name: Phantom Thief
Phantom Thief.description:
You don't just steal. You steal BEAUTIFULLY. Phantom Thieves take everything that isn't nailed down, including advantages, Steal Skill lifting the enemy's best trick mid-fight, a Vanishing Act for the exit the audience expected and still didn't catch. Calling cards, masquerade masks, impossible escapes. The guards aren't chasing a criminal. They're chasing a legend, and legends don't get caught.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Phantom Thief.traitNarrativeEffects: You leave calling cards after stealing things, not because it's tactical but because it's aesthetically necessary. You've stolen your own wanted poster and framed it.

Poison Brewer.name: Poison Brewer
Poison Brewer.description:
A toxin specialist who studies venoms, paralytics, corrosives, sleep draughts, and subtle contamination. Poison Brewers are precise, prepared, and always a little alarming to dine with.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Poison Brewer.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hands are faintly stained in ways that don't wash off, you taste things you shouldn't to identify them, and your survival kit is ninety percent antidotes.

Potion Vendor.name: Potion Vendor
Potion Vendor.description:
A merchant-apothecary who specializes in stocking, selling, and recommending everyday potions. This is the commercial, customer-facing side of alchemy: less forbidden research, more profitable utility.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Potion Vendor.traitNarrativeEffects: You can guess someone's recent injuries from what potion they ask for.

Rift Affinity.name: Rift Affinity
Rift Affinity.description:
Rift magic senses and manipulates cracks in reality: portal seams, unstable thresholds, dungeon scars, and places where the world never healed correctly. It is suspicious, rare, and invaluable in a world that keeps tearing open.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Rift Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Rift for tears in space, unstable portals, cracked thresholds, dimensional scars, and dangerous transit. Distinguish it from Space by making it jagged and unstable.

Ruby Red Eyes.name: Ruby Red Eyes
Ruby Red Eyes.description: Ruby Red Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Ruby Red Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Ruby Red Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #8B0028. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Sharp Jawline.name: Sharp Jawline
Sharp Jawline.description: A defined, angular jawline that could cut glass, the kind of bone structure that makes portraits look like they belong on a coin or a wanted poster.
Sharp Jawline.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial bone structure only. Render a defined angular jawline.

Side Ponytail.name: Side Ponytail
Side Ponytail.description: Pulled to one side, playful, asymmetric, and full of movement. The kind of style that makes you look mid-scene at all times.
Side Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: You switch sides depending on your mood and your party tracks your emotional state by it.

Single Dimple.name: Single Dimple
Single Dimple.description: A single dimple that appears on one cheek when you smile, asymmetric, charming, and utterly disarming. The kind of feature that makes people forgive things they shouldn't.
Single Dimple.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls cheek appearance only. Render one visible dimple on one cheek.

Siren-Blooded.name: Siren-Blooded
Siren-Blooded.description:
Your ancestor was a siren, one of the ancient song-spirits whose voices could calm storms, shatter stone, and make sailors forget everything they'd ever loved. The inheritance shows in your voice first: rich, resonant, and carrying harmonic overtones that make people stop mid-sentence to listen. But it shows in your appearance too, ethereally beautiful features with an avian edge: high cheekbones, large luminous eyes, graceful neck, and small iridescent feathers that trace your temples, shoulders, or the outer edge of your ears like natural jewelry. Your hair has a feathered quality, your movements are fluid and hypnotic, and when you sing, even casually, even humming, the air itself seems to lean closer.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Siren-blooded characters have a human body on two human legs, a human face, a musical or aquatic glamour, and faint scale or feather accents.

RACE REFERENCE: Siren-Blooded is a humanoid person with a resonant voice, aquatic or featherlike accents, refined features, and expressive eyes. Use song magic, social magnetism, and the danger of being heard too clearly as background hooks.
Siren-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: You unconsciously hum melodies that match the emotional atmosphere of a room, and people near you find themselves swaying without realizing it. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Siren-blooded characters have a human body on two human legs, a human face, a musical or aquatic glamour, and faint scale or feather accents. RACE REFERENCE: Siren-Blooded is a humanoid person with a resonant voice, aquatic or featherlike accents, refined features, and expressive eyes.

Sky Blue Eyes.name: Sky Blue Eyes
Sky Blue Eyes.description: Sky Blue Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Sky Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Sky Blue Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #90CEEC. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Sky Blue Hair.name: Sky Blue Hair
Sky Blue Hair.description: Sky Blue Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Sky Blue Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Sky Blue Hair. Exact hex color reference: #87CEEB. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Soul Affinity.name: Soul Affinity
Soul Affinity.description:
Soul magic engages identity, spirit, essence, afterlife resonance, and the hidden weight inside living beings. This is deeply personal magic, suited to exorcists, mediums, healers, and anyone who deals with what remains when the body is not the whole story.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Soul Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Soul for spirits, essence, afterlife links, identity, and intimate metaphysical contact.

Spirit Medium.name: Spirit Medium
Spirit Medium.description:
A go-between for the living and the dead, or at least the unseen. Spirit Mediums calm hauntings, hear whispers, and treat ghosts less like jump scares and more like difficult clients.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Spirit Medium.traitNarrativeEffects: You sometimes answer questions no one asked because a spirit whispered the answer before the person finished speaking.

Spirit Walker.name: Spirit Walker
Spirit Walker.description:
One foot among the living, one among the dead, both of them dangerous. Spirit Walkers channel the departed into combat, Spirit Heals warm as being remembered fondly, a Spirit Phase that steps you briefly out of the world's reach. You see the ghosts. You speak for them. And sometimes, when it matters, they answer on your behalf, all at once.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Spirit Walker.traitNarrativeEffects: You occasionally respond to questions no one asked and your eyes unfocus when something invisible enters the room.

Split Eyebrow.name: Split Eyebrow
Split Eyebrow.description: A clean gap shaved or scarred through one eyebrow, a tiny detail that adds an unreasonable amount of attitude to any face.
Split Eyebrow.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls eyebrow appearance only. Render a gap or scar line through one eyebrow.

Star Affinity.name: Star Affinity
Star Affinity.description:
Star magic draws on constellations, astral guidance, celestial pathways, and the strange authority of the night sky. It feels prophetic, elegant, and a little grandiose in the best possible way.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Star Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Star for constellations, astral light, navigation, prophecy, and high beautiful sky-magic. Distinguish it from Light by keeping the celestial flavor strong.

Stitched Scar.name: Stitched Scar
Stitched Scar.description: A scar that was stitched closed, visible suture marks crossing the wound line on the face, jaw, or forehead. Crude or precise, it speaks to a wound that was bad enough to need closing and a life that kept going afterward.
Stitched Scar.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render a stitched or sutured scar on the face.

Straight Hair.name: Straight Hair
Straight Hair.description: Perfectly straight hair that falls like silk, smooth, sleek, and reflecting light in a single clean sheet. The classic beauty standard of a dozen fantasy cultures, achieved here without a flat iron because this world has better priorities for enchantment.
Straight Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair reflects moonlight like water. This is deeply unfair to everyone standing next to you.

Textured Crop.name: Textured Crop
Textured Crop.description: A short, textured crop with clean edges, modern, stylish, and low-maintenance in a way that somehow looks high-effort. The haircut of people who wake up looking good and resent it.
Textured Crop.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render a short textured crop with clean edges and textured top.

Time Affinity.name: Time Affinity
Time Affinity.description:
Time magic brushes against acceleration, delay, memory of motion, brief rewinds, and stolen fractions of a second. It should feel uncanny and precious, less an everyday toolkit than a dangerous advantage over reality's pacing.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Time Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Time for delay, haste, slowed moments, temporal echoes, and costly precision. Avoid making it omnipotent.

Upturned Nose.name: Upturned Nose
Upturned Nose.description: A small, slightly upturned nose, elegant with a hint of playfulness. The kind of feature that gives even serious expressions a trace of mischief.
Upturned Nose.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls nose shape only. Render a small, elegant, slightly upturned nose.

Vampire Scion.name: Vampire Scion
Vampire Scion.description:
Pale, beautiful, and cursed with a thirst you manage through willpower, alchemy, or quiet arrangements you don't discuss in polite company. Vampire blood is rare in Luxcellia, most bloodlines were hunted to extinction centuries ago. You're one of the survivors, carrying enhanced senses, unnatural beauty, physical power that spikes after feeding, and an allergy to direct sunlight that ranges from 'uncomfortable' to 'medically concerning.' Society's feelings about vampires range from terrified to fascinated, and the line between the two is thinner than you'd like.

HIDDEN FORM: Old blood keeps a second face. When you stop holding it in, you become the thing the portraits never show: eyes gone to embers, jaw and fingers too long, a shadow that moves late. By choice, in a rage, or when badly starved. It lasts a scene, grants no extra stats, and nobody who sees it forgets.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Vampire Scions are humanlike nobles with fangs, refined eyes, and gothic elegance; no bat monster body, no horror gore.

RACE REFERENCE: Vampire Scion is a humanoid vampire-blooded noble or survivor with fangs, refined eyes, gothic elegance, and controlled predatory grace. Use thirst management, old blood politics, and nocturnal habits as background hooks.
Vampire Scion.traitNarrativeEffects: You avoid garlic not because it hurts you but because it gives you a splitting headache, and you have very strong opinions about blood quality that you know better than to share. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Vampire Scions are humanlike nobles with fangs, refined eyes, and gothic elegance; no bat monster body, no horror gore. RACE REFERENCE: Vampire Scion is a humanoid vampire-blooded noble or survivor with fangs, refined eyes, gothic elegance, and controlled predatory grace. HIDDEN FORM: narrative only, no stat change; a monstrous true face shown by choice, rage or starvation for one scene. Draw the everyday noble form unless the hidden form is the scene.

Void Affinity.name: Void Affinity
Void Affinity.description:
Void magic touches the absence outside ordered creation: erasure, nullification, silence, anti-magic, and the unsettling relief of nothing. Colder and more absolute than Dark, it is defined by subtraction rather than menace.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Void Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Void for erasure, nullification, anti-magic, impossible silence, and empty-space pressure. Distinguish it from Dark by making it feel subtractive, not sinister.

Wind Affinity.name: Wind Affinity
Wind Affinity.description:
Wind magic is speed, motion, lift, and razor-clean mobility. It favors acceleration, evasion, ranged cutting currents, scouting, aerial movement, and making the impossible jump look easy.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Wind Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Wind for agility, movement, pressure waves, cutting currents, and aerial freedom. Distinguish it from Storm by keeping it cleaner and less explosive.

Wine Red Eyes.name: Wine Red Eyes
Wine Red Eyes.description: Wine Red Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Wine Red Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Wine Red Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #6A1828. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Wine Red Hair.name: Wine Red Hair
Wine Red Hair.description: Wine Red Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Wine Red Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Wine Red Hair. Exact hex color reference: #722F37. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Arcane Brawler.name: Arcane Brawler
Arcane Brawler.description:
Why cast at a problem when you can punch it twice? Arcane Brawlers wrap their fists in runes and their grapples in impact glyphs, a caster who closed the distance and never looked back. You parry spells on your knuckles, you end magical duels at headbutt range, and mages who fight you once refuse a rematch on principle. The magic is in the fists. The confidence is structural.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Arcane Brawler.traitNarrativeEffects: You solve delicate magical problems by poking them, your knuckle-runes glow when you're annoyed, and you've been formally banned from at least one spellcasting duel circuit for 'excessive proximity.'

Ash Brown Hair.name: Ash Brown Hair
Ash Brown Hair.description: Ash Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Ash Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Ash Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #7D6E5A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Asymmetric Cut.name: Asymmetric Cut
Asymmetric Cut.description: One side longer than the other, dramatic, modern, and just lopsided enough to look intentional.
Asymmetric Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: People tilt their head when they talk to you and you're not sure if it's the hair or the conversation.

Blood Affinity.name: Blood Affinity
Blood Affinity.description:
Blood magic channels vitality, sacrifice, lineage, wounds, and the terrifying intimacy of life used as fuel. It is emotional, ritualistic, and often powerful precisely because it costs something.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Blood Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Blood for life-force, sacrifice, crimson rituals, lineage, and visceral power. Distinguish it from Poison and Dark by emphasizing living force and personal cost.

Charm Affinity.name: Charm Affinity
Charm Affinity.description:
Charm magic influences emotion, attraction, social tension, enchantment, and the art of making people want what you want. It should feel seductive, dangerous, and socially catalytic without turning every interaction into mind control.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Charm Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Charm for allure, emotional influence, attraction, elegance, and tension. Distinguish it from Illusion by focusing on hearts and reactions, not false sights.

Damage Convert.name: Damage Convert
Damage Convert.description:
A share of incoming damage turns into mana instead of hurting you. Damage Convert means getting hit charges you up rather than wearing you down. The harder you're hit, the more power you soak in. At higher levels you can take hits on purpose to fuel devastating counterattacks, turning an enemy's strongest move into ammunition for your own. Healers find the ability morally confusing. Enemies find it deeply unfair.

How it works: half of the health you lose each turn comes back to you as mana.
Damage Convert.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been known to walk into attacks on purpose and your party healer has yelled at you about this several times.

Deep Plum Hair.name: Deep Plum Hair
Deep Plum Hair.description: Deep Plum Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Deep Plum Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Deep Plum Hair. Exact hex color reference: #4A1A4A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Dream Affinity.name: Dream Affinity
Dream Affinity.description:
Dream magic navigates sleep, symbol, prophecy, nightmares, emotional landscapes, and the surreal truth people only admit in half-light. It is softer than Illusion, stranger than Charm, and often more revealing than either.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Dream Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Dream for sleep, visions, symbolism, nightmares, prophetic fragments, and surreal emotional imagery. Distinguish it from Illusion by making it inward and meaningful.

Earth Affinity.name: Earth Affinity
Earth Affinity.description:
Earth magic is stability, structure, terrain shaping, and deliberate force. It raises walls, anchors positions, reinforces structures, senses the ground beneath a lie, and wins by being harder to move than everyone else.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Earth Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Earth for defense, fortification, stone shaping, terrain control, and slow unstoppable pressure.

Goddess Braids.name: Goddess Braids
Goddess Braids.description: Goddess Braids styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Goddess Braids.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Ivy League Cut.name: Ivy League Cut
Ivy League Cut.description: A neat ivy league cut, short on the sides, slightly longer on top, swept to one side. The haircut of someone who reads terms and conditions before signing.
Ivy League Cut.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render a short neat cut with slightly longer top swept to one side.

Jet Black Hair.name: Jet Black Hair
Jet Black Hair.description: Jet Black Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Jet Black Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Jet Black Hair. Exact hex color reference: #0A0A0A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Light Affinity.name: Light Affinity
Light Affinity.description:
Light magic governs radiance, clarity, purification, revelation, and blessed force. It burns monsters, exposes lies, comforts allies, and turns illumination itself into a weapon or a sanctuary.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Light Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Light for radiance, purification, revelation, holy force, and comfort. Distinguish it from Fire by keeping the heat secondary to brightness and sanctity.

Long and Loose.name: Long and Loose
Long and Loose.description: Worn down, free-moving, sometimes in your face. You don't bother tying it back, you just fight through it.
Long and Loose.traitNarrativeEffects: You push hair out of your face constantly and it always falls back.

Mana-Pale Cyan.name: Mana-Pale Cyan
Mana-Pale Cyan.description: A pale cyan complexion with a magical laboratory glow, as if the body was rebuilt by mana rather than born normally. Clean, cool, and striking for artificial vessels, reincarnated anomalies, or arcane experiments.
Mana-Pale Cyan.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Mana-Pale Cyan as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: healing magic and spell circles make your skin softly illuminate.

Material Sense.name: Material Sense
Material Sense.description: You can detect rare materials, ore veins, herb clusters, and valuable resources within a significant radius. Material Sense pulses like radar: the rarer the material, the stronger the signal. You walk through a forest and feel the mithril deposit under your feet. You enter a dungeon and know which walls hide treasure and which hide traps. You browse a merchant's stall and instantly spot the one actually valuable item buried under junk. This makes you invaluable to mining expeditions, gathering parties, and anyone who needs rare materials found quickly. It also makes walks in nature significantly more profitable.
Material Sense.traitNarrativeEffects: You've alarmed companions by suddenly stopping mid-conversation to stare at the ground and mutter 'there's something down there.'

Navy Blue Hair.name: Navy Blue Hair
Navy Blue Hair.description: Navy Blue Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Navy Blue Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Navy Blue Hair. Exact hex color reference: #0A1E5E. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Pale Gray Eyes.name: Pale Gray Eyes
Pale Gray Eyes.description: Pale Gray Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Pale Gray Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Pale Gray Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #C0C8CC. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Pale Porcelain.name: Pale Porcelain
Pale Porcelain.description: Very light, cool-toned skin, almost translucent in certain light. Common among scholars, underground dwellers, and anyone who hasn't seen sunlight in months.
Pale Porcelain.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. You sunburn if someone describes a sunny day too vividly.

Perfect Memory.name: Perfect Memory
Perfect Memory.description: You remember everything. Every conversation, every face, every page of every book you've glanced at, every turn in every dungeon, every technique you've watched performed. Perfect Memory makes your mind a flawless archive. You recall exact wording from contracts, reproduce maps from a single viewing, quote conversations verbatim, and pick out people you saw once three months ago in a crowd. Combined with your old-world knowledge, this makes you a walking library of two worlds. Scholars love you. Liars fear you. Politicians are deeply concerned.
Perfect Memory.traitNarrativeEffects: You've won arguments by quoting people's own words back to them with exact inflection, which they find extremely unsettling.

Perfect Palate.name: Perfect Palate
Perfect Palate.description: You can identify any substance by taste, detect poison with a sip, determine the exact composition of any food or potion, and cook with supernatural precision because you know exactly how each ingredient will affect the final result. Perfect Palate turns eating into intelligence gathering and cooking into an art form. Your meals grant heightened restorative and strengthening effects because you instinctively balance flavor profiles for magical resonance. You can taste the history of a wine, identify a spice by its region of origin, and tell whether an alchemist used fresh or dried components in their potion. Also, everything you cook is unreasonably delicious.
Perfect Palate.traitNarrativeEffects: You have involuntarily critiqued the seasoning of meals served to you by nobles, causing both offense and grudging recipe changes.

Rose Gold Eyes.name: Rose Gold Eyes
Rose Gold Eyes.description: Rose Gold Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Rose Gold Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Rose Gold Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #C87878. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Rose Gold Hair.name: Rose Gold Hair
Rose Gold Hair.description: Rose Gold Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Rose Gold Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Rose Gold Hair. Exact hex color reference: #D4897A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Rune Gauntlets.name: Rune Gauntlets
Rune Gauntlets.description:
Reinforced gauntlets etched with runes that push impact magic through every punch, block, grapple, and spell-parry. They make the wearer's hands a casting focus and a weapon at the same moment, which is exactly what brawler-mages, forge-fighters, and anyone who wants to punch a spell until it apologizes have been waiting for.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Rune Gauntlets.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapons are rune gauntlets. Describe glowing knuckle runes, impact glyphs, reinforced blocks, spell-parries, and magical hand-to-hand combat. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Unarmed Combat.

Shadow Monarch.name: Shadow Monarch
Shadow Monarch.description:
You don't hide in the dark. You RULE it. Shadow Monarchs command darkness as territory, Shadow Rise raising servants from every silhouette on the field, Shadow Commands the night obeys like a court. Every defeated enemy is a potential new subject. The shadows lean toward you in lit rooms. The throne is wherever the light fails, and near you, it fails often.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Shadow Monarch.traitNarrativeEffects: Shadows lean toward you in well-lit rooms and away from you in dark ones. You've started naming the persistent ones and they respond to it.

Skill Predator.name: Skill Predator
Skill Predator.description:
When you defeat a sufficiently powerful enemy, you can permanently absorb one of their abilities. Skill Predator is the ultimate growth cheat: every apex battle is a chance to claim a new art. The absorbed skill blends with your existing abilities, sometimes combining in unexpected ways. A fire technique taken alongside ice magic might make steam. A beast's regeneration layered over your own healing turns into something monstrous. The catch: absorbed skills start weaker than the original and need practice to reach full power. The other catch: people who work out what you're doing get very nervous about fighting you.

How it works: defeat a powerful enemy who used a distinctive technique and you absorb it as a new learned ability, about once every 30 turns.
