Skill Predator.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively study enemies mid-fight, looking for the one technique worth keeping. Companions have noticed you smiling at particularly impressive attacks aimed at your face.

Soft Oval Face.name: Soft Oval Face
Soft Oval Face.description: An oval face shape with even contours, balanced length to width, curving cleanly from cheekbone to chin without hard angles.
Soft Oval Face.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial bone structure only. Render an oval adult face shape with even contours.

Sound Affinity.name: Sound Affinity
Sound Affinity.description:
Sound magic turns voice, vibration, resonance, rhythm, and silence-breaking force into a magical system. It can soothe, shatter, command, disorient, or elevate depending on how the note is struck.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Sound Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Sound for voice, resonance, vibration, music, sonic force, and emotional atmosphere.

Space Affinity.name: Space Affinity
Space Affinity.description:
Space magic governs distance, positioning, pocket-space, and the geometry between points. Cleaner and more intentional than Rift magic, it specializes in controlled teleportation, storage, reach, and spatial arrangement.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Space Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Space for distance control, teleportation, pocket dimensions, spatial geometry, and clean relocation. Distinguish it from Rift by avoiding broken or unstable visuals.

Spirit Rancher.name: Spirit Rancher
Spirit Rancher.description:
A caretaker of magical livestock, minor spirits, or semi-domesticated mystical creatures. Spirit Ranchers live at the boundary between farming, animal care, and folklore.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Spirit Rancher.traitNarrativeEffects: Use for spirit beast care, familiar bonding, magical animal behavior, taming support, shrine creature etiquette, and beast-related quest hooks. The protagonist reads animals as characters, not props.

Starlight Eyes.name: Starlight Eyes
Starlight Eyes.description: Starlight Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Starlight Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Starlight Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #A8B8D8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Starlit Bronze.name: Starlit Bronze
Starlit Bronze.description: A bronze complexion with a subtle cool luminosity, as if sunlight and moonlight both decided to stay on the skin. It suits star magic, desert ruins, coastal nights, celestial bloodlines, and characters whose portraits need warmth with a faint magical sheen.
Starlit Bronze.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use luminous starlit bronze as the definitive complexion. Keep it humanlike and natural with cool highlights; do not turn the skin blue, silver, or metallic unless another trait says so.

Storm Affinity.name: Storm Affinity
Storm Affinity.description:
Storm magic gathers wind, rain, thunder, and pressure systems into full-weather domination. Larger, moodier, and more catastrophic than plain Lightning or Wind, it is the affinity of tempests, naval disasters, and dramatic boss-fight skies.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Storm Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Storm for full weather systems, thunder, cyclones, rain, and battlefield-scale atmospheric fury. Distinguish it from Wind and Lightning by making it broader and more environmental.

Tanuki-Blooded.name: Tanuki-Blooded
Tanuki-Blooded.description:
A humanoid trickster lineage tied to lucky disguises, playful illusions, tavern rumors, and the chaotic comfort of folklore creatures who somehow survive every bad idea. Tanuki-Blooded characters tend to be socially slippery, difficult to corner, and weirdly lucky when plans become disasters. They often fit comedic isekai episodes, gambling dens, merchant stalls, roadside shrines, and prank-heavy companion scenes. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: humanoid person with human skin, rounded tanuki-like ears and one soft tail; no fur-covered body, no animal muzzle, no paws, no full raccoon-dog anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Tanuki-Blooded is a humanoid trickster ancestry with rounded tanuki ears, one tail, lucky charm energy, and harmless-looking mischief. Use disguises, tavern luck, comic escapes, and sudden usefulness as background hooks.
Tanuki-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Use tanuki folklore energy. Lucky escapes, disguise tricks, harmless-looking mischief, and sudden usefulness when everything goes wrong. Visually keep them humanoid with ears/tail only; do not depict a full animal-person body.

The Mom Friend.name: The Mom Friend
The Mom Friend.description: You naturally slide into caretaker logistics: checking whether everyone ate, noticing what is wrong, and keeping a group functional through equal parts affection and exasperation. You are supportive first and terrifyingly competent second.
The Mom Friend.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Make them naturally nurturing, organized, and quietly responsible for keeping everyone functioning.

Third Eye Mark.name: Third Eye Mark
Third Eye Mark.description: A mark or gem centered on the forehead, a painted dot, a crystallized third eye, a divine brand, or a sealed magical organ. It pulses faintly in the presence of strong magic.
Third Eye Mark.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls forehead appearance only. Render a visible mark, gem, or brand at the center of the forehead.

Turquoise Eyes.name: Turquoise Eyes
Turquoise Eyes.description: Turquoise Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Turquoise Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Turquoise Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #40C0B0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Turquoise Hair.name: Turquoise Hair
Turquoise Hair.description: Turquoise Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Turquoise Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Turquoise Hair. Exact hex color reference: #40CFC0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Water Affinity.name: Water Affinity
Water Affinity.description:
Water magic is adaptive, fluid, and deceptively versatile. It thrives on flowing defense, healing-adjacent support, purification, pressure control, tides, currents, and shaping the battlefield through movement rather than brute impact.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Water Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Water for flow, purification, tides, shaping, support, and flexible control. Distinguish it from Ice by keeping it mobile and fluid.

Windswept Hair.name: Windswept Hair
Windswept Hair.description: Windswept Hair styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Windswept Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Ash Blonde Hair.name: Ash Blonde Hair
Ash Blonde Hair.description: Ash Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Ash Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Ash Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #C8B89A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Azure Blue Skin.name: Azure Blue Skin
Azure Blue Skin.description: A vivid fantasy-blue complexion with clean azure undertones, striking without looking flat or painted. It suits aquatic bloodlines, sky spirits, mana-touched beings, and anyone whose silhouette should read instantly otherworldly.
Azure Blue Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Azure Blue Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: cool light makes you look ethereal; warm tavern light makes everyone stare.

Beast King Fist.name: Beast King Fist
Beast King Fist.description:
Martial arts with a predator's heart. Beast King Fist channels raw animal instinct into explosive unarmed combat, savage footwork, bone-rattling strikes, and a pressure that makes lesser fighters' instincts scream RUN before you move. The style has no belts and no ceremony. The king is whoever is still standing, and everyone in the room can already feel who that's going to be.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Beast King Fist.traitNarrativeEffects: You size up every room by instinct, exits, threats, who's alpha, and you crack your knuckles before doing completely mundane tasks. Stray animals follow you around like you're royalty, because as far as they're concerned, you are.

Bladed Umbrella.name: Bladed Umbrella
Bladed Umbrella.description:
An elegant parasol hiding a straight blade along the spine and razor ribs that double as thrown projectiles. Open, it blocks and misdirects; closed, it thrusts and slashes; in the rain, it's practically a fashion statement. Noble assassins and secret agents favor it on one firm principle: looking impeccable while fighting is not optional.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Bladed Umbrella.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with a bladed umbrella. Describe combat with parasol-deflected attacks, concealed blade thrusts, rib-throwing techniques, and the sophisticated menace of a weapon that looks like an accessory and fights like an armory. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Exotic Weapons.

Blue-Black Hair.name: Blue-Black Hair
Blue-Black Hair.description: Blue-Black Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Blue-Black Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Blue-Black Hair. Exact hex color reference: #0D0D1E. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Blush Pink Skin.name: Blush Pink Skin
Blush Pink Skin.description: A soft pink fantasy complexion with warm romantic undertones, suited to fairy-blooded, charm-touched, love-spirit, or dreamborn character designs. Polished and clear, not neon.
Blush Pink Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Blush Pink Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: your blush is impossible to hide and unfairly charming.

Cherry Red Hair.name: Cherry Red Hair
Cherry Red Hair.description: Cherry Red Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Cherry Red Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Cherry Red Hair. Exact hex color reference: #B52A2A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Coral Pink Hair.name: Coral Pink Hair
Coral Pink Hair.description: Coral Pink Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Coral Pink Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Coral Pink Hair. Exact hex color reference: #E8786A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Coral Reef Skin.name: Coral Reef Skin
Coral Reef Skin.description: A warm coral fantasy skin tone between pink, orange, and red, with tropical brightness and sea-spirit energy. It suits merfolk, island shrine keepers, tide-blessed charmers, and festival-ready fantasy designs.
Coral Reef Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Coral Reef Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: ocean light, flowers, and festival lanterns make you look celebratory by default.

Danger Sense EX.name: Danger Sense EX
Danger Sense EX.description: You feel threats before they materialize. Danger Sense EX is a supernatural early-warning system: ambushes, traps, poisoned food, treacherous allies, structural collapse, and incoming sneak attacks all trigger a visceral premonition anywhere from half a second to several minutes before they arrive. The warning scales with severity: a pickpocket earns a tingle, a dungeon boss earns a scream. At higher levels, you can sense danger aimed at nearby allies, and the premonitions sharpen enough to identify the type and direction of the threat.
Danger Sense EX.traitNarrativeEffects: You've ducked before the arrow was fired, sidestepped before the trap triggered, and left a building ten seconds before the roof collapsed. People have stopped questioning it and started betting on it.

Dark Brown Hair.name: Dark Brown Hair
Dark Brown Hair.description: Dark Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Dark Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Dark Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #2C1A0E. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Deep Amber Eyes.name: Deep Amber Eyes
Deep Amber Eyes.description: Deep Amber Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Deep Amber Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Deep Amber Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #A86010. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Dungeon Breaker.name: Dungeon Breaker
Dungeon Breaker.description:
You are the walking answer to a labyrinth's ego. Dungeon Breakers crack boss rooms like siege engineers, Ground Breakers that end trap floors, an Unbreakable Stance for everything the dungeon throws back. You read mechanics like blueprints and solve an impressive number of ancient puzzles with a hammer. Everything opens eventually. You're why.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Dungeon Breaker.traitNarrativeEffects: You knock on walls out of habit and can identify a false floor by sound alone. Every door you meet gets professionally assessed for weaknesses, including doors that are already open.

Dusty Rose Hair.name: Dusty Rose Hair
Dusty Rose Hair.description: Dusty Rose Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Dusty Rose Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Dusty Rose Hair. Exact hex color reference: #DCAE96. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Enchanted Cards.name: Enchanted Cards
Enchanted Cards.description:
A deck of inscribed cards, each one a sealed spell, a summoning formula, or a projectile depending on how you throw it. Card mages, gamblers-turned-wizards, and anyone who took 'dealing' a little too literally love them: sharp enough to cut at range, magical enough to detonate on contact, and stylish enough that every attack lands like a magic trick that happened to hurt.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Enchanted Cards.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights with enchanted cards. Describe combat with card-throwing, spell activation through card play, dramatic card fanning, and the gambler-mage aesthetic of treating combat like a card game. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Exotic Weapons.

Fashion Stylist.name: Fashion Stylist
Fashion Stylist.description:
A social presentation expert who understands silhouettes, trends, status reads, and how clothing changes the way people are treated. Less sewing, more the politics of looking incredible.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Fashion Stylist.traitNarrativeEffects: You say "you cannot confess in that outfit" like it is a medical diagnosis.

Fear of Heights.name: Fear of Heights
Fear of Heights.description: Balconies, cliffs, airships, and dramatic rooftop scenes all cost you extra courage.
Fear of Heights.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Balconies, cliffs, rooftops, airships, and flying mounts cost the protagonist real courage. Show white knuckles and negotiated dignity; heights make simple traversal into drama. Use for comedy, vulnerability a companion can steady, and heroism that costs extra.

Festival Yukata.name: Festival Yukata
Festival Yukata.description: A colorful cotton yukata with an obi sash, geta sandals, and a fan tucked at the waist. Celebration wear for shrines, fireworks, and summer nights.
Festival Yukata.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Kimono and Sash; in play, describe what is worn now.

High Cheekbones.name: High Cheekbones
High Cheekbones.description: Prominent, sculpted cheekbones that catch light dramatically, the kind of facial structure that makes every angle a good angle and every shadow a feature.
High Cheekbones.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial bone structure only. Render prominent high cheekbones.

Hot Spring Host.name: Hot Spring Host
Hot Spring Host.description:
A hospitality professional built around baths, comfort, ritual relaxation, and the healing social power of a perfect onsen experience. Ideal for the cozy, romantic side of fantasy life.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Hot Spring Host.traitNarrativeEffects: Use for hot springs, recovery care, hospitality, herbal baths, guest comfort, and quiet emotional conversations. Keep scenes tasteful, relaxing, and character-focused.

Iridescent Eyes.name: Iridescent Eyes
Iridescent Eyes.description: Iridescent Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Iridescent Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Iridescent Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #C0B0D0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Iridescent Hair.name: Iridescent Hair
Iridescent Hair.description: Iridescent Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Iridescent Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Iridescent Hair. Exact hex color reference: #C8A8D8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Jade Green Hair.name: Jade Green Hair
Jade Green Hair.description: Jade Green Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Jade Green Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Jade Green Hair. Exact hex color reference: #2E9468. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Jealousy Magnet.name: Jealousy Magnet
Jealousy Magnet.description: Your existence reliably creates triangles, misunderstandings, possessiveness, or inconveniently visible interest. You do not always mean to stir things up, but the results rarely care.
Jealousy Magnet.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use unintended romantic competition and emotional crossfire.

Kitsune-Blessed.name: Kitsune-Blessed
Kitsune-Blessed.description:
A humanoid fox-spirit bloodline blessed by playful shrine spirits, old forest magic, and the kind of charm that makes trouble feel like destiny. Kitsune-Blessed characters carry a foxlike grace in their movements, a talent for misdirection, and an instinctive connection to foxfire, riddles, spirit paths, and flirtatious social traps. They are not monsters or full foxes, they are anime fantasy people with fox-spirit traits layered over a humanlike body. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: humanoid person with human skin, fox ears, and one elegant fox tail by default; no furry body, no muzzle, no paws, no full animal head, no feral anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Kitsune-Blessed is a humanoid fox-spirit ancestry with humanlike face, fox ears, one fox tail, shrine charm, and foxfire associations. Use riddles, playful misdirection, spirit paths, and tail/ear tells as background hooks.
Kitsune-Blessed.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Treat this as a humanoid fox-spirit ancestry. In scenes, reference cleverness, foxfire, shrine omens, tail/ear tells, teasing charm, and spirit-world instincts. Portraits must keep human skin and normal humanoid anatomy with fox ears and a tail only.

Kohl-Lined Eyes.name: Kohl-Lined Eyes
Kohl-Lined Eyes.description: Eyes lined with kohl or dark pigment, dramatic, defined, and the kind of detail that makes every glance feel like a statement. The liner makes you look like you know something everyone else doesn't.
Kohl-Lined Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls eye makeup only. Render eyes with kohl or dark eyeliner.

Light Blue Eyes.name: Light Blue Eyes
Light Blue Eyes.description: Light Blue Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Light Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Light Blue Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #87AEDD. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Loot Multiplier.name: Loot Multiplier
Loot Multiplier.description: Enemies you defeat drop better and more valuable items than they should. Loot Multiplier is the cheat skill that makes dungeon runs profitable and boss fights into jackpots. Monsters that normally drop common materials drop rare ones for you. Treasure chests contain items a tier above their usual contents. Quest rewards somehow end up more generous. At higher levels, you occasionally trigger 'bonus drops', extra items that materialize from defeated enemies as if the universe decided you deserved a tip. Guild accountants have flagged your loot reports. Repeatedly.
Loot Multiplier.traitNarrativeEffects: Your party fights over who stands closest to you when looting because proximity to you seems to improve everyone's drops.

Mana Wellspring.name: Mana Wellspring
Mana Wellspring.description:
Your mana pool is several orders of magnitude larger than it should be. Mana Wellspring means you can cast spells that would drain a normal mage dry and barely feel it. You can hold enchantments, barriers, and protective blessings that need constant mana input without breaking concentration. You can brute-force your way through magical locks, power items nobody else has enough mana to activate, and serve as a living battery for group rituals. Mages who sense your reserves tend to stare. Some stare respectfully. Some stare with naked jealousy. A few stare with the focused intensity of someone running rapid political calculations.

How it works: on top of the huge pool, you regain about 4% of your mana every turn.
Mana Wellspring.traitNarrativeEffects: Mana detection spells aimed at you return readings that are usually associated with dungeon cores or minor ley lines, not people.

Mint Green Eyes.name: Mint Green Eyes
Mint Green Eyes.description: Mint Green Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Mint Green Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Mint Green Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #60C090. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Mint Green Hair.name: Mint Green Hair
Mint Green Hair.description: EXACT VISUAL LOCK: mint green hair. The final Appearance must say mint green hair and must not shift the hair to auburn, brown, red, blue, silver, white, or generic fantasy hair. Mint green hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. This is the definitive hair color: write mint green hair in Appearance, not auburn, red, brown, blue, silver, white, or generic anime hair.
Mint Green Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Mint Green Hair. Exact hex color reference: #68C9A0. Apply this as the hair color in the portrait. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Mint Green Skin.name: Mint Green Skin
Mint Green Skin.description: A pale mint-green fantasy complexion that feels fresh, cute, and magical rather than intimidating. Ideal for slime-born, fairy-blooded, herbalist, forest sprite, or soft monster-girl character designs.
Mint Green Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Mint Green Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: pastel outfits and spring flowers make you look like a limited-edition charm.

Moonlit Rooftop.name: Moonlit Rooftop
Moonlit Rooftop.description: A moonlit rooftop at night, tiles, city lights below, and the kind of vantage point that makes you feel like the world is yours to watch.
Moonlit Rooftop.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render a moonlit rooftop overlooking a city.

Nature Affinity.name: Nature Affinity
Nature Affinity.description:
Nature magic connects you to growth, roots, bloom, pollen, healing greenery, and the quiet authority of living ecosystems. It thrives on supportive control, plant growth, natural toxins, and making the wilderness itself feel allied.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Nature Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Nature for plants, growth, roots, bloom, herbal healing, and ecosystem imagery. Distinguish it from Earth by emphasizing life rather than stone.

Poison Affinity.name: Poison Affinity
Poison Affinity.description:
Poison magic works through venoms, miasma, corrosion, sickness, and patient battlefield decay. It suits strategists, assassins, monster experts, and anyone who prefers elegant suffering over clean explosions.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Poison Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Poison for toxins, corrosion, miasma, status effects, and subtle lethality. Keep it distinct from Blood and Nature.

Pulse-Pale Glow.name: Pulse-Pale Glow
Pulse-Pale Glow.description: Skin so pale it faintly luminesces, a sign of deep Pulse corruption or blessing. Veins visible beneath the surface carry faint light.
Pulse-Pale Glow.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. You glow in the dark just enough to be unsettling at sleepovers.

Relic Appraiser.name: Relic Appraiser
Relic Appraiser.description:
An evaluator of mysterious finds, cursed heirlooms, and dungeon loot that should not be trusted at face value. Relic Appraisers know what something is worth, what it does, and whether touching it was a terrible idea.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Relic Appraiser.traitNarrativeEffects: You talk to mysterious artifacts as if they might answer. Sometimes they do.

Rose Pearl Glow.name: Rose Pearl Glow
Rose Pearl Glow.description: A very light fair skin tone with a faint rosy pearl quality, soft highlights, and gentle blush-friendly warmth. It suits saintess routes, noble portraits, delicate academy prodigies, and characters who look best under candlelight, moonlight, or holy glow without becoming washed out.
Rose Pearl Glow.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use rose-pearl fair skin as the definitive complexion: pale with subtle rosy warmth and soft luminous highlights. Keep shading clean and natural; do not turn it metallic or gray.

Royal Blue Eyes.name: Royal Blue Eyes
Royal Blue Eyes.description: Royal Blue Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Royal Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Royal Blue Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #2030B0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Shadow Affinity.name: Shadow Affinity
Shadow Affinity.description:
Shadow magic specializes in concealment, stealth, dim pathways, and turning darkness into a medium for movement and misdirection. It is subtle, elegant, and more about slipping through than raw malice.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Shadow Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Shadow for concealment, stealth, dimness, soft darkness, and movement between unseen places. Distinguish it from Dark by avoiding overt corruption or abyssal themes.

Soft Hazel Eyes.name: Soft Hazel Eyes
Soft Hazel Eyes.description: Soft Hazel Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Soft Hazel Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Soft Hazel Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #9A8040. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Soft Round Face.name: Soft Round Face
Soft Round Face.description: A rounded face shape with full cheeks and a curved chin, broad through the cheekbones, tapering gently rather than squaring off.
Soft Round Face.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial bone structure only. Render a rounded adult face shape with full cheeks.

The Lazy Genius.name: The Lazy Genius
The Lazy Genius.description: You are genuinely brilliant and deeply allergic to unnecessary effort. When forced to care, you are terrifyingly effective; when unmotivated, you become a case study in wasted potential.
The Lazy Genius.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Highlight brilliance constantly fighting with laziness, boredom, or refusal to overexert.

Treasure Seeker.name: Treasure Seeker
Treasure Seeker.description:
A hunter of hidden valuables, old caches, secret rooms, and rumor-backed fortunes. Treasure Seekers are driven by curiosity, greed, and the joy of finding what other people missed.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Treasure Seeker.traitNarrativeEffects: You visibly perk up when someone says "probably nothing."

Warm Brown Eyes.name: Warm Brown Eyes
Warm Brown Eyes.description: Warm Brown Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Warm Brown Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Warm Brown Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #8A5A28. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Warm Brown Hair.name: Warm Brown Hair
Warm Brown Hair.description: Warm Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Warm Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Warm Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #7A5230. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Anime Beauty Bob.name: Anime Beauty Bob
Anime Beauty Bob.description: A perfectly styled chin-length bob with face-framing volume and razor-sharp edges, the cool beauty signature. Every strand falls exactly where it should, the bangs are precision instruments, and the overall effect is someone who could destroy you socially, physically, or both without a single hair out of place.
Anime Beauty Bob.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair never has a strand out of place. This is either meticulous care or dark magic. Nobody has been brave enough to ask.

Ashen Slate Skin.name: Ashen Slate Skin
Ashen Slate Skin.description: A cool slate-gray complexion with a smooth, statue-like fantasy finish. It suits gargoyle-blooded, undead-adjacent, moon-cursed, subterranean, or solemn characters with a strong gothic silhouette.
Ashen Slate Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Ashen Slate Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: stillness makes you look carved from expensive cathedral stone.

Braided Ponytail.name: Braided Ponytail
Braided Ponytail.description: Braided Ponytail styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Braided Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use this as the selected hairstyle. Preserve species anatomy and head shape. Adds no stats, powers, allegiance, or gameplay bonuses.

Combat Alchemist.name: Combat Alchemist
Combat Alchemist.description:
You brew under fire and it WORKS. Combat Alchemists weaponize the lab, Healing Draughts thrown with sniper accuracy, Volatile Potions that turn formations into chemistry lessons. Your belt is an arsenal, your hands are steady when nothing else is, and the sound of desperate rummaging means either salvation or something about to be very interesting. Often both.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Combat Alchemist.traitNarrativeEffects: You taste-test things a sane person wouldn't, you label your belt pouches in a shorthand only you can read mid-panic, and the phrase 'hold this and don't shake it' precedes your finest work.

Contract Romance.name: Contract Romance
Contract Romance.description: You understand affection through terms, roles, arrangements, obligations, or deals that get more sincere than anyone expected. What starts as structure often becomes real.
Contract Romance.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use negotiated intimacy, formal arrangements, and feelings sneaking in through the paperwork.

Crimson Red Skin.name: Crimson Red Skin
Crimson Red Skin.description: A bold crimson fantasy complexion associated with oni, demonkin, fire spirits, volcanic bloodlines, and characters who look like they were born under battle drums. Powerful, warm, and impossible to ignore.
Crimson Red Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Crimson Red Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: embarrassment, anger, and battle excitement all look like the same dramatic glow.

Crystal Affinity.name: Crystal Affinity
Crystal Affinity.description:
Crystal magic focuses on faceted structure, refracted energy, resonance lattices, and hard-edged magical constructs. It can be defensive, precise, or extravagantly decorative while still being deadly.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Crystal Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Crystal for prisms, gem growth, resonance, refracted light, and elegant hard-structure magic.

Cupid's Bow Lips.name: Cupid's Bow Lips
Cupid's Bow Lips.description: Lips with a defined Cupid's bow, the upper lip shaped like a bow, full and shapely. Classic, romantic, and the kind of feature that makes even a neutral expression look like it's hiding a secret.
Cupid's Bow Lips.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls lip shape only. Render lips with a defined Cupid bow upper lip.

Dark Violet Eyes.name: Dark Violet Eyes
Dark Violet Eyes.description: Dark Violet Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Dark Violet Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Dark Violet Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #5A1888. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Deep Violet Skin.name: Deep Violet Skin
Deep Violet Skin.description: A saturated violet complexion that reads as powerful, arcane, and dramatic. It suits demonkin aristocrats, void-touched mages, dream spirits, and characters whose presence should feel expensive and dangerous.
Deep Violet Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Deep Violet Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: gold jewelry and dark clothing make you look like villain royalty.

Devoted Romantic.name: Devoted Romantic
Devoted Romantic.description: When you love, you commit fully. You are steady, sincere, and built for long-haul bonds rather than casual drifting.
Devoted Romantic.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use loyalty, sincerity, and a strong desire to build something lasting.

Dragon Gold Eyes.name: Dragon Gold Eyes
Dragon Gold Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: intense gold eyes with dragonlike authority, pride, and ancient pressure. They should feel powerful and sharp while staying attractive and character-focused.
Dragon Gold Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Dragon Gold Eyes. Exact color reference: molten gold #E6A625 with amber shadow #9A5A12. Vertical pupils are allowed only if race/eye pattern supports them.

Dungeon Surveyor.name: Dungeon Surveyor
Dungeon Surveyor.description:
A mapper and evaluator of dungeon structure, routes, hazards, and resource value. Surveyors make dangerous places readable and turn chaos into usable information.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Dungeon Surveyor.traitNarrativeEffects: You draw maps on napkins, walls, arms, and occasionally sleeping companions.

Dusky Mauve Skin.name: Dusky Mauve Skin
Dusky Mauve Skin.description: A muted mauve fantasy complexion with smoky purple-gray warmth. It feels gothic, romantic, and mature, ideal for Thornveil nobles, twilight spirits, dark elves, or vampire-blooded characters with soft danger.
Dusky Mauve Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Dusky Mauve Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: roses, candlelight, and dark velvet make you look like court gossip incarnate.

Ember-Bronze Red.name: Ember-Bronze Red
Ember-Bronze Red.description: A red-bronze fantasy complexion like heated metal cooling under forge light. It feels volcanic, athletic, and heroic, perfect for oni-blooded warriors, fire mages, forge clans, or anyone tied to Emberwake drama.
Ember-Bronze Red.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Ember-Bronze Red as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: sweat, sparks, and forge-light make you look like a training arc poster.

Frosted Ice Skin.name: Frosted Ice Skin
Frosted Ice Skin.description: A pale icy-blue-white complexion with cool highlights, ideal for snow spirits, frost mages, winter beastkin, or anyone who should look beautiful in falling snow and dangerous in silence.
Frosted Ice Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Frosted Ice Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: cold weather makes you look elegant while everyone else looks miserable.

Gravity Affinity.name: Gravity Affinity
Gravity Affinity.description:
Gravity magic manipulates weight, pressure, pull, momentum, and the crushing logic every body obeys. It can pin enemies, enhance strikes, distort movement, or make the battlefield itself feel unbearably heavy.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Gravity Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Gravity for weight, pull, pressure fields, anchored movement, and crushing force. Distinguish it from Earth by focusing on force, not stone.

Hazel Green Eyes.name: Hazel Green Eyes
Hazel Green Eyes.description: Hazel Green Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Hazel Green Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Hazel Green Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #7A8040. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Honey Brown Eyes.name: Honey Brown Eyes
Honey Brown Eyes.description: Honey Brown Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Honey Brown Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Honey Brown Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #A07030. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Hot Spring Steam.name: Hot Spring Steam
Hot Spring Steam.description: Hot spring steam rising around a mountain bath, soft light, curling mist, and the kind of atmosphere that makes confessions feel inevitable.
Hot Spring Steam.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render hot spring steam around a mountain bath.

Light Brown Hair.name: Light Brown Hair
Light Brown Hair.description: Light Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Light Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Light Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #8B5E3C. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Mocha Brown Hair.description: Mocha Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Mocha Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Mocha Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #5C3A1A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Molten Gold Eyes.description: Molten Gold Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Molten Gold Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Molten Gold Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #D49010. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Noble Side Braid.name: Noble Side Braid
Noble Side Braid.description: A refined side braid with decorative detail, formal enough for noble events but sturdy enough for travel. It suggests education, court polish, and someone who can look composed even after the dungeon starts collapsing.
Noble Side Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR STYLE LOCK: Render a neat side braid with refined details. Keep it elegant, visible, and compatible with selected accessories; this controls hairstyle only.

Pastel Pink Hair.name: Pastel Pink Hair
Pastel Pink Hair.description: Pastel Pink Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Pastel Pink Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Pastel Pink Hair. Exact hex color reference: #F8C8D0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Raven Black Hair.description: Raven Black Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Raven Black Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Raven Black Hair. Exact hex color reference: #0C0C14. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Reborn Soul Eyes.name: Reborn Soul Eyes
Reborn Soul Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: luminous otherworldly eyes that look like they remember another life. The color should feel layered and impossible to place, with a subtle system-window sparkle rather than a constant glow.
Reborn Soul Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Reborn Soul Eyes. Use layered blue-violet-gold irises with subtle luminous depth. Keep eyes readable and humanlike; no monstrous eye anatomy unless race traits require it.

Riftscar Rupture.name: Riftscar Rupture
Riftscar Rupture.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A jagged dungeon rift has torn open the earth, spilling violet-blue mana light into the air. Cracked stone, drifting sparks, and warped space frame the scene with dangerous adventure energy. {{portraitprompt}}: magical rift background, cracked earth, violet-blue mana glow, warped air, drifting sparks, fantasy dungeon rupture, anime portrait background behind character
Riftscar Rupture.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Short Curly Hair.name: Short Curly Hair
Short Curly Hair.description: Short Curly Hair styled as a distinct anime character silhouette, easy to recognize at a glance. The shape should support the character's personality, frame the face clearly, and stay consistent across portraits.
Short Curly Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Use short curly hair as the main hairstyle silhouette. Adds no stats or gameplay bonuses.

Side-Swept Bangs.name: Side-Swept Bangs
Side-Swept Bangs.description: Bangs swept dramatically to one side, elegant, dynamic, and the kind of style that suggests you're always looking at something interesting.
Side-Swept Bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render bangs swept dramatically to one side of the face.

The Loyal Second.name: The Loyal Second
The Loyal Second.description: You are comfortable supporting, backing up, and standing beside someone worth believing in. Loyalty is your strongest instinct, and being underestimated because of it only makes you more effective.
The Loyal Second.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Emphasize dependable support, backing someone they trust, and strength that works best beside others.

Training Grounds.name: Training Grounds
Training Grounds.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: An open-air training area behind a guild or academy, wooden practice dummies scored with sword marks, weapon racks, a sand-floored sparring ring, benches for spectators, and the warm morning light of a new day of growth. Sweat stains on the packed earth prove this place is well-used. The atmosphere is focused, energetic, and full of potential.
Training Grounds.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Walking Red Flag.name: Walking Red Flag
Walking Red Flag.description: You are obviously a bad idea to someone, somewhere, and that only makes you more memorable. Common sense says keep distance; curiosity says absolutely not.
Walking Red Flag.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs react as if you are risky, tempting, or one bad decision away from changing their life.

Wispy Sage Beard.name: Wispy Sage Beard
Wispy Sage Beard.description: A long, thin, wispy beard, the classic 'ancient master who is also somehow only 30' look that isekai loves. Scholarly, mysterious, and slightly impractical in combat.
Wispy Sage Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a long thin wispy sage-style beard.

Burnt Orange Hair.name: Burnt Orange Hair
Burnt Orange Hair.description: Burnt Orange Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Burnt Orange Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Burnt Orange Hair. Exact hex color reference: #CC4410. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Delicate Features.name: Delicate Features
Delicate Features.description: Finely proportioned features, a narrow nose bridge, an even jaw, and precise brow lines. Every element scaled down and exactly placed.
Delicate Features.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial structure only. Render finely scaled, precisely proportioned adult features.

Demon Throne Room.name: Demon Throne Room
Demon Throne Room.description: A demon throne room, dark crystal, permanent twilight through stained windows, and the kind of grandeur that makes you understand why they call them lords.
Demon Throne Room.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render a dark crystal demon throne room.

Dullahan Heritage.name: Dullahan Heritage
Dullahan Heritage.description:
Your ancestor was a Dullahan, a headless horseman of the death courts, a harbinger of endings, a collector of names. The bloodline didn't give you a removable head (probably), but it gave you everything else: an aura of dread that makes animals nervous and children stare, an instinctive knowledge of who is closest to death in any room, skin that runs cold to the touch, and a presence so unsettling that intimidation is less a skill and more a passive effect. Dullahan Heritage is rare, feared, and completely misunderstood, you're not a death omen. You're just someone whose family tree includes death omens. The distinction matters to you. It doesn't matter to the villagers.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Keep the head attached and the body humanlike; use a faint neck mark, deathly aura, or gothic styling instead of rendering a headless body.

RACE REFERENCE: Dullahan Heritage is a humanoid death-court bloodline with head attached, faint neck mark, cold presence, and gothic styling. Use death omens, name magic, animal unease, and dramatic collars as background hooks.
Dullahan Heritage.traitNarrativeEffects: Your head occasionally feels loosely attached. You unconsciously check that it's still there. Your neck has a faint dark line that glows when you're angry, and you've learned to style collars around it. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID. Keep the head attached and the body humanlike; use a faint neck mark, deathly aura, or gothic styling instead of rendering a headless body. RACE REFERENCE: Dullahan Heritage is a humanoid death-court bloodline with head attached, faint neck mark, cold presence, and gothic styling.

Dungeon Architect.name: Dungeon Architect
Dungeon Architect.description:
A builder or analyst of traps, layouts, chambers, and environmental challenge design. Dungeon Architects think like someone who could create the problem instead of merely surviving it.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Dungeon Architect.traitNarrativeEffects: You narrate structural criticism while exploring dungeons, 'load-bearing pillar, poor placement, that's a collapse risk', and your party can't tell if you're being helpful or just insufferable.

Elven Court Silks.name: Elven Court Silks
Elven Court Silks.description: Elven court silks, flowing, iridescent fabric that moves like water, adorned with leaf-patters and starlight embroidery. The kind of outfit that makes humans feel underdressed by comparison.
Elven Court Silks.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Forest Green Eyes.name: Forest Green Eyes
Forest Green Eyes.description: Forest Green Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Forest Green Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Forest Green Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #2D6A2D. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Forest Green Skin.name: Forest Green Skin
Forest Green Skin.description: A natural green complexion with warm living undertones, suited to dryads, goblin-blooded beauties, plant spirits, jungle guardians, and characters who should look connected to roots, leaves, and old magic.
Forest Green Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Forest Green Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: foliage frames you so naturally that artists accuse the background of flirting.

Golden Brown Hair.name: Golden Brown Hair
Golden Brown Hair.description: Golden Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Golden Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Golden Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #8B6530. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Hair Over One Eye.name: Hair Over One Eye
Hair Over One Eye.description: A curtain of hair swept deliberately over one eye, creating a mysterious, half-hidden silhouette that screams 'I have secrets and they're beautiful.' The visible eye does twice the emotional work. Whether hiding a scar, a special eye, or just cultivating an aura of enigmatic cool, this style is pure anime mystique.
Hair Over One Eye.traitNarrativeEffects: People constantly want to brush the hair from your face. You never let them. The hidden eye sees everything they don't want you to see.

Half-Up Half-Down.name: Half-Up Half-Down
Half-Up Half-Down.description: The compromise style, tied at the crown but flowing below. Controlled chaos. Best of both worlds.
Half-Up Half-Down.traitNarrativeEffects: You always have a hair tie on your wrist and you use it constantly.

Heart-Shaped Face.name: Heart-Shaped Face
Heart-Shaped Face.description: A face wider at the brow and cheekbones, tapering to a narrow chin, the classic heart shape. Expressive and highly memorable in profile.
Heart-Shaped Face.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls face shape only. Render a heart-shaped face with wider cheekbones tapering to a pointed chin.

High Elegant Brow.name: High Elegant Brow
High Elegant Brow.description: A high, smooth forehead with elegant arch to the brow, aristocratic, intelligent, and the kind of feature that makes you look like you're always thinking two steps ahead.
High Elegant Brow.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls brow and forehead shape only. Render a high, smooth, elegant brow.

Honey Blonde Hair.name: Honey Blonde Hair
Honey Blonde Hair.description: Honey Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Honey Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Honey Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #D4993A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Illusion Affinity.name: Illusion Affinity
Illusion Affinity.description:
Illusion magic reshapes perception: sightlines, false images, misread distances, sensory tricks, and narrative bait. It is about what people think is real, not about entering dreams or rewriting hearts.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Illusion Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Illusion for false perceptions, decoys, glamour, sensory misdirection, and believable unreality. Distinguish it from Dream and Charm.

Isekai Raven Hair.name: Isekai Raven Hair
Isekai Raven Hair.description: Portrait appearance detail: deep raven-black hair with clean cool-blue highlights, classic reborn protagonist energy. It should read as black first, with the blue sheen appearing in lighting rather than taking over the color.
Isekai Raven Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Isekai Raven Hair. Exact color reference: deep black #101018 with cool blue highlight sheen #1C2A44. Apply this as the selected hair color; do not drift into navy, gray, or purple.

Monster Harvester.name: Monster Harvester
Monster Harvester.description:
A specialist in butchering, preserving, and safely collecting the useful parts of monsters. Pick this if you look at a slain beast and see ingredients, reagents, and market value.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Monster Harvester.traitNarrativeEffects: You get excited when a monster has "excellent parts," which makes people slightly uncomfortable.

Oblivious to Love.name: Oblivious to Love
Oblivious to Love.description: Flirting reaches you, then gets filed under the wrong heading: friendship, a business offer, a sparring invitation, worry about your health. You are not cold, just creatively wrong, and even a plain confession may need saying twice.
Oblivious to Love.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Flirting always lands as something else. Play the inventive misreadings; feelings grow around the protagonist, and a confession may need a second try.

Pearl Blonde Hair.name: Pearl Blonde Hair
Pearl Blonde Hair.description: Pearl Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Pearl Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Pearl Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #F0EAD6. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Protagonist Spike.name: Protagonist Spike
Protagonist Spike.description: Dramatic spiky hair that defies gravity, the protagonist special. The kind of style that requires either magic or a concerning amount of hair product.
Protagonist Spike.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render dramatic gravity-defying spiky hair.

Royal Purple Hair.name: Royal Purple Hair
Royal Purple Hair.description: Royal Purple Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Royal Purple Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Royal Purple Hair. Exact hex color reference: #5A1A9A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Saintess Sky Eyes.name: Saintess Sky Eyes
Saintess Sky Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: clear sky-blue eyes with gentle holy brightness, perfect for healers, saintesses, celestial bloodlines, and characters whose kindness still has resolve behind it.
Saintess Sky Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Saintess Sky Eyes. Exact color reference: clear sky blue #79CFFF with pale highlights. Apply as iris color; keep the look gentle, not blank.

Sandy Blonde Hair.name: Sandy Blonde Hair
Sandy Blonde Hair.description: Sandy Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Sandy Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Sandy Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #C8A86A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Slow Burn Yearner.name: Slow Burn Yearner
Slow Burn Yearner.description: You fall early and hide it well. The longing is all there, in glances, kept distance and almost-touches, while your mouth stays firmly shut for chapters.
Slow Burn Yearner.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: The feelings already exist and stay hidden. Show private longing through glances, restraint and small tells until it finally spills over.

Sun-Kissed Bronze.name: Sun-Kissed Bronze
Sun-Kissed Bronze.description: Medium-deep skin with rich warm undertones, bronze in sunlight, copper in firelight. Striking and warm.
Sun-Kissed Bronze.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. Your skin catches light like metal and people stare without realizing it.

Tear-Track Tattoo.name: Tear-Track Tattoo
Tear-Track Tattoo.description: Thin tattoo lines running from beneath one or both eyes down the cheeks, like permanent tears. Might be tribal, might be mourning marks, might be purely aesthetic. Either way, they're hauntingly beautiful.
Tear-Track Tattoo.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render thin tattoo lines descending from beneath the eyes.

The Battle Junkie.name: The Battle Junkie
The Battle Junkie.description: You come alive in challenge, conflict, and the electric honesty of a good fight. The thrill is not mindless bloodlust so much as the exhilaration of testing yourself where things are finally simple.
The Battle Junkie.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Treat good combat as exhilarating and clarifying rather than simply violent.

The Gentle Healer.name: The Gentle Healer
The Gentle Healer.description: You are calm, compassionate, and instinctively soothing, the kind of person whose presence lowers a room's temperature in the best way. Care comes naturally to you, but softness should never be mistaken for weakness.
The Gentle Healer.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Use soothing kindness, patient care, and softness that still has inner strength.

The Secret Softie.name: The Secret Softie
The Secret Softie.description: In public you are all cool competence: brisk, unbothered, a little intimidating. Past that, you are embarrassingly tender, the kind who keeps every letter and remembers every favorite food.
The Secret Softie.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Composed and cool in public; tenderness shows in private, in small kept things, and in care done before anyone notices.

The Tired Veteran.name: The Tired Veteran
The Tired Veteran.description: You have already seen enough to know better, and the world keeps asking more from you anyway. There is weariness in you, but also a stubborn professionalism that refuses to disappear.
The Tired Veteran.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Carry experience, fatigue, and a capable "I have seen enough" tone that never fully kills professionalism.

Throne Room Ruins.name: Throne Room Ruins
Throne Room Ruins.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: The shattered remains of an old throne room with cracked steps, toppled pillars, faded banners, and a lingering sense of lost authority. The atmosphere is dramatic and haunted by history. {{portraitprompt}}: ruined throne room, toppled pillars, faded banners, ancient authority, dramatic fantasy portrait background behind character
Throne Room Ruins.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Amethyst Glow Skin.name: Amethyst Glow Skin
Amethyst Glow Skin.description: A luminous amethyst fantasy skin tone with faint jewel-like warmth beneath the surface. It feels magical rather than biological, perfect for crystal-touched, star-blessed, or arcane-core characters.
Amethyst Glow Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Amethyst Glow Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: your skin catches mana-light like polished gemstone facets.

Arena Battle Floor.name: Arena Battle Floor
Arena Battle Floor.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A grand arena with marked stone or sand underfoot, bright banners, and distant cheering stands. The backdrop suggests glory, rivalry, and public spectacle. {{portraitprompt}}: fantasy arena floor, cheering stands, battle platform, banners, tournament background behind character
Arena Battle Floor.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Beauty Mark on Lip.name: Beauty Mark on Lip
Beauty Mark on Lip.description: A beauty mark on or near the lip, small, dark, and precisely placed. The kind of detail that makes a face iconic. Marilyn Monroe had one. So do you.
Beauty Mark on Lip.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial mark placement only. Render a beauty mark on or near the lip.

Cannot Hold Liquor.name: Cannot Hold Liquor
Cannot Hold Liquor.description: Alcohol catches up with you embarrassingly fast. Social drinking scenes are a gamble and everyone knows it.
Cannot Hold Liquor.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Alcohol wins fast and publicly. One drink loosens truth; two rewrite the evening. Companions manage their intake or mine it for confessions. Use for tavern comedy, accidental honesty, morning-after embarrassment, and the things said that cannot be unsaid.

Caramel Brown Hair.name: Caramel Brown Hair
Caramel Brown Hair.description: Caramel Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Caramel Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Caramel Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #9B6B3A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Crystal Prospector.name: Crystal Prospector
Crystal Prospector.description:
A seeker of magical crystal veins, resonant gems, and high-value mineral finds. Crystal Prospectors combine geology, greed, and the hope of finding something beautiful enough to change their life.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Crystal Prospector.traitNarrativeEffects: You stare at glowing rocks like they are flirting with you.

Electric Blue Hair.name: Electric Blue Hair
Electric Blue Hair.description: Electric Blue Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Electric Blue Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Electric Blue Hair. Exact hex color reference: #1565C0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Elemental Gradient.name: Elemental Gradient
Elemental Gradient.description: A smooth gradient from the main hair color into an elemental hue at the tips or lower layers. Fire may warm into red-orange, ice into pale blue, shadow into violet-black, and so on. The effect should be stylish and controlled, not messy dye.
Elemental Gradient.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR PATTERN LOCK: Apply a smooth elemental gradient to the hair, preferably toward tips or lower sections. Use the chosen element/secondary color when available; keep transitions clean and premium.

Emberforge Chamber.name: Emberforge Chamber
Emberforge Chamber.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A blazing forge chamber with molten channels, glowing steel, and smithing heat bathing the stone walls in orange light. The scene feels powerful, industrious, and intense. {{portraitprompt}}: forge chamber, molten metal, glowing steel, smithing fire, orange fantasy light, anime portrait background behind character
Emberforge Chamber.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Emerald Green Hair.name: Emerald Green Hair
Emerald Green Hair.description: Emerald Green Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Emerald Green Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Emerald Green Hair. Exact hex color reference: #1A6B3A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Empress's War Gown.name: Empress's War Gown
Empress's War Gown.description: A full-length gown of rich fabric and armored corsetry, split for movement, with gauntlets, a crown or diadem, and the unmistakable presence of someone who rules a nation and personally leads its armies. Every element serves double duty, beautiful and functional, regal and lethal. The train detaches for combat.
Empress's War Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Armored Battle Gown; in play, describe what is worn now.

Flaxen Blonde Hair.name: Flaxen Blonde Hair
Flaxen Blonde Hair.description: Flaxen Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Flaxen Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Flaxen Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #E6D08A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Fox Shrine at Dusk.name: Fox Shrine at Dusk
Fox Shrine at Dusk.description: A fox shrine at dusk, paper lanterns, stone foxes, and the kind of golden-hour light that makes everything feel like a memory.
Fox Shrine at Dusk.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render a fox shrine at golden hour dusk.

Golden Blonde Hair.name: Golden Blonde Hair
Golden Blonde Hair.description: Golden Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Golden Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Golden Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #E2B848. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Golden Divine Skin.name: Golden Divine Skin
Golden Divine Skin.description: A warm metallic-gold fantasy complexion that suggests divine blessing, ancient royalty, sun spirits, or a body remade by holy magic. It should feel radiant and beautiful rather than statue-stiff.
Golden Divine Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Golden Divine Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: direct sunlight makes you look personally endorsed by fate.

Guild Receptionist.name: Guild Receptionist
Guild Receptionist.description:
An administrative, social, and logistical professional who manages requests, paperwork, adventurer chaos, and information flow. In fantasy worlds, this is secretly a high-impact class.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Guild Receptionist.traitNarrativeEffects: Use for Guild paperwork, quest routing, adventurer gossip, rank procedures, receptionist contacts, and social leverage. The protagonist understands the Guild from behind the counter, not just from the quest board.

Heroic Silver Hair.name: Heroic Silver Hair
Heroic Silver Hair.description: Portrait appearance detail: bright heroic silver hair with luminous anime highlights, instantly suggesting rare bloodline, divine favor, tragic backstory, or secret-boss potential.
Heroic Silver Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Heroic Silver Hair. Exact color reference: bright silver #DDE6F2 with white highlights. Apply this as the selected hair color; do not make it flat gray or washed-out white.

Hidden Inner Color.name: Hidden Inner Color
Hidden Inner Color.description: A vivid underlayer hidden beneath the main hair color, visible when the character turns, runs, casts, or gets caught in wind. Perfect for secret power reveals, academy uniforms, and characters whose appearance has one dramatic surprise.
Hidden Inner Color.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR PATTERN LOCK: Apply a concealed inner hair color layer visible at edges, movement, or parted sections. Do not overpower the main hair color; this is a reveal detail, not the whole design.

Infinite Inventory.name: Infinite Inventory
Infinite Inventory.description: You have a personal spatial storage dimension accessible only to you. Infinite Inventory lets you stash any number of items in a pocket dimension you can reach into thin air to access. Items keep the exact state they were stored in: food stays fresh, potions stay potent, weapons stay sharp. You can organize it mentally and retrieve specific items instantly. The storage space has no apparent limit. You've put a tent in there. A boat. Three hundred potions. An entire suit of armor. Your companions stopped being surprised around the time you pulled a fully set dining table out of nothing during a camping trip.
Infinite Inventory.traitNarrativeEffects: You reach into empty air to retrieve things so often that new acquaintances think you're a very committed mime.

Lightning Affinity.name: Lightning Affinity
Lightning Affinity.description:
Lightning magic is speed made violent: crackling impact, flash-step aggression, nerve-jolting precision, and split-second lethality. Sharper and more direct than Storm, it is built around discharge rather than weather.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Lightning Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use Lightning for discharge, speed, stun, chain arcs, and lethal precision. Distinguish it from Storm by keeping the focus on electricity rather than full atmospheric control.

Living Relic Blade.name: Living Relic Blade
Living Relic Blade.description:
A sentient or half-sentient ancient sword that remembers old wielders, forgotten wars, and at least one secret it won't explain until the timing is properly dramatic. It may pulse, whisper, warm in your grip, reject an unworthy hand, or nudge a strike true when a scene demands it. This isn't equipment so much as a relationship, a plot hook, and a very sharp opinion.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Living Relic Blade.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a living relic blade. Reference faint whispers, relic memory, chosen-wielder moments, and ancient magic. Keep it as one clear sword unless the player describes otherwise. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Swordsmanship.

Looks Like Trouble.name: Looks Like Trouble
Looks Like Trouble.description: You give off the unmistakable energy of someone whose storylines end in chases, broken furniture, or emotionally compromising decisions. Fun people love this about you. Guards do not.
Looks Like Trouble.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs expect disruption, adventure, or bad decisions to follow you around.

Merfolk Descendant.name: Merfolk Descendant
Merfolk Descendant.description:
Somewhere in your bloodline, the ocean left its mark. Faint iridescent scales trace your neck, your wrists, the backs of your hands, visible in certain light, invisible in others. Water responds to you in small ways: currents shift, rain parts around your shoulders, and you can hold your breath long enough to make divers nervous. Merfolk descendants are rare on land, carrying the deep ocean's patience, an unsettling calm in crisis, and a pull toward the sea that never fully goes away. You hear the tide in your dreams. Sometimes it speaks back.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID ON LAND. Merfolk descendants have normal legs, human skin, aquatic eyes or faint scale accents; no full fish tail unless an underwater transformation is explicitly requested.

RACE REFERENCE: Merfolk Descendant is a humanoid person who keeps legs on land, with aquatic accents such as fin-like ears, subtle scales, gill marks, pearl sheen, or ocean-colored features. Use tide sense, swimming grace, and sea-culture tension as background hooks.
Merfolk Descendant.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively know the nearest body of water at all times, and you zone out near fountains in a way that concerns your companions. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: DEMI-HUMAN HUMANOID ON LAND. Merfolk descendants have normal legs, human skin, aquatic eyes or faint scale accents; no full fish tail unless an underwater transformation is explicitly requested. RACE REFERENCE: Merfolk Descendant is a humanoid person who keeps legs on land, with aquatic accents such as fin-like ears, subtle scales, gill marks, pearl sheen, or ocean-colored features.

Messy Low Ponytail.name: Messy Low Ponytail
Messy Low Ponytail.description: A low, casually gathered ponytail at the nape of the neck with deliberately imperfect texture, strands escaping, volume at the crown, and the general energy of someone who is extremely attractive and either doesn't know it or doesn't care. The signature style of cool mentors, laid-back swordsmen, and dangerously competent people who look like they just woke up.
Messy Low Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: You tie your hair back with whatever's nearby, a leather cord, a ribbon someone gave you, a torn bandage. It always looks perfect.

Molten Copper Skin.name: Molten Copper Skin
Molten Copper Skin.description: A rich copper fantasy complexion with subtle molten undertones. It suits forge clans, fire-blessed warriors, desert wanderers, and characters whose warmth feels physical, social, and slightly dangerous.
Molten Copper Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Molten Copper Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: forge sparks and sunset light make your skin look alive with heat.

Opal Rainbow Sheen.name: Opal Rainbow Sheen
Opal Rainbow Sheen.description: A pale fantasy complexion with a faint opalescent sheen that shifts through soft rainbow undertones. It should read as magical and premium, ideal for rare bloodlines, divine anomalies, and reborn bodies touched by impossible light.
Opal Rainbow Sheen.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Opal Rainbow Sheen as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: people argue about what color your skin is depending on the lighting.

Pain Nullification.name: Pain Nullification
Pain Nullification.description: You can switch off pain at will. Pain Nullification doesn't stop damage, you still get hurt, still bleed, still break bones. You just don't feel it unless you choose to. Injuries that would drop a normal person through pain shock barely slow you. You fight through wounds that should have downed you three hits ago. You calmly set your own broken arm. You smile through injuries that turn onlookers green. At higher levels you can extend the nullification to nearby allies through touch. The downside: you have to actively watch your body for damage you might not notice, and companions find your calm at visible injuries deeply unsettling.
Pain Nullification.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been stabbed and continued a conversation without flinching, which your healer considers a personal insult to their profession.

Plot Armor Passive.name: Plot Armor Passive
Plot Armor Passive.description:
You are suspiciously lucky when it comes to surviving things that should kill you. Plot Armor Passive is the meta-cheat: killing blows get deflected by a belt buckle, fatal falls get broken by a conveniently placed awning, explosions throw you clear instead of through. This isn't invincibility. You still get hurt, still face real danger, and the 'saves' are never comfortable. But the universe seems reluctant to let you die permanently. Scholars who study probability find your survival record statistically impossible. The Church thinks you're divinely protected. The demon lord thinks you're entertaining. Your companions have stopped panicking when you fall off things.

How it works: once every 40 turns, if your health drops below 15%, the universe intervenes and you regain about a third of it.
Plot Armor Passive.traitNarrativeEffects: You've survived at least three things that should have been lethal and your party has started calling near-death experiences 'Tuesdays.'

Radiates Authority.name: Radiates Authority
Radiates Authority.description: Your presence suggests competence, control, and a dangerous ability to make decisions under pressure. People look to you for cues even when you did not ask them to.
Radiates Authority.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs defer, listen, or brace themselves around your authoritative presence.

Rival-Lover Seeker.name: Rival-Lover Seeker
Rival-Lover Seeker.description: For you, the spark lives inside the contest itself: sharp banter, mid-fight wagers, rooftop dares, and the immediate thrill of trading blows or wits with anyone bold enough to push back.
Rival-Lover Seeker.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Play immediate flirt-duel chemistry built on live banter, sparring wagers, and playful one-upmanship in the moment.

Runic-Etched Beard.name: Runic-Etched Beard
Runic-Etched Beard.description: A beard with faintly glowing runes shaved or magically etched into the hair pattern, dwarven rune-smithing tradition, wizard vanity, or a seal that happens to look incredibly cool.
Runic-Etched Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a beard with faint glowing rune patterns.

Sapphire Blue Eyes.name: Sapphire Blue Eyes
Sapphire Blue Eyes.description: Sapphire Blue Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Sapphire Blue Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Sapphire Blue Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #1A3A8A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Sapphire Blue Hair.name: Sapphire Blue Hair
Sapphire Blue Hair.description: Sapphire Blue Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Sapphire Blue Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Sapphire Blue Hair. Exact hex color reference: #1A3A8A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Sleep Optimization.name: Sleep Optimization
Sleep Optimization.description: Two hours of sleep gives you the benefit of a full night's rest. Sleep Optimization means you're always well-rested, always sharp, and always the one who volunteers for the last watch because you genuinely don't need the sleep. You run at full capacity on power naps. Long dungeon runs that grind parties down through attrition barely slow you. The extra hours in your day mean you train more, study more, craft more, and socialize more than anyone who needs eight hours of unconsciousness. Night owls envy you. Healers are baffled by you.
