Sleep Optimization.traitNarrativeEffects: You wake up refreshed after naps so short that companions think you're faking sleep. You were not faking.

Tavern Hearth Fire.name: Tavern Hearth Fire
Tavern Hearth Fire.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A cozy tavern interior with a roaring hearth, polished wood, mugs, warm light, and the hum of late-night conversation. It feels welcoming, intimate, and ideal for party scenes. {{portraitprompt}}: fantasy tavern interior, roaring hearth, warm firelight, cozy wood interior, anime portrait background behind character
Tavern Hearth Fire.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

The Brooding Loner.name: The Brooding Loner
The Brooding Loner.description: You keep to yourself, speak sparingly, and carry the sort of atmosphere that makes people think rain should start falling when you enter frame. Underneath that, there is usually more loneliness than cruelty.
The Brooding Loner.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write solitude, guardedness, and loneliness that reads sad before it reads cruel.

The Edgy Anti-Hero.name: The Edgy Anti-Hero
The Edgy Anti-Hero.description: You cultivate a sharper, more deliberate darkness than the Brooding Loner: harsher choices, colder humor, and a willingness to do what nicer people hesitate to do. The edge is intentional and often, annoyingly, effective.
The Edgy Anti-Hero.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep the darkness more intentional and morally rough than a simple loner archetype.

The Flag Collector.name: The Flag Collector
The Flag Collector.description: You collect story flags the way other people collect coins. Rival flags, romance flags, hidden quest flags, dungeon warning flags, suspicious noble invitation flags, somehow they all end up in your hands. You spot trope-shaped situations before anyone else does and are dangerously tempted to poke them just to see what route opens. This makes your life exciting, complicated, and crowded with people who swear they only meant to talk to you for five minutes.
The Flag Collector.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Let them accidentally rack up suspiciously many route flags, foreshadowing moments, and emotional triggers.

The Mischief Maker.name: The Mischief Maker
The Mischief Maker.description: You like teasing, practical jokes, playful sabotage, and the kind of small chaos that keeps life interesting without collapsing the building. You are more prankster than anarchist.
The Mischief Maker.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write playful teasing, pranks, and low-stakes chaos more than true destructive unpredictability.

The Noble Idealist.name: The Noble Idealist
The Noble Idealist.description: You believe people and systems can be better, and you hold yourself to standards high enough to be inconvenient. Cynicism annoys you more than hardship does.
The Noble Idealist.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Emphasize moral standards, sincere compassion, and belief that people can be better.

The Reluctant Hero.name: The Reluctant Hero
The Reluctant Hero.description: You do the right thing even when you would strongly prefer not to be the person responsible for it. Responsibility finds you faster than comfort ever does.
The Reluctant Hero.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who resists the spotlight but still steps up when people truly need them.

Truck-kun's Chosen.name: Truck-kun's Chosen
Truck-kun's Chosen.description: The classic, the sacred rite, the isekai handshake. You were crossing the street for some painfully normal reason when a truck appeared with the timing of a divine ambush. Your old life ended in one absurd instant, and Luxcellia began with sunlight, grass, and the terrible realization that the memes were documentary evidence. Loud carts still make you suspicious.
Truck-kun's Chosen.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Overworked to Death.name: Overworked to Death
Overworked to Death.description: You were ground down by schedules, deadlines, exams, shifts, and a world that treated exhaustion like a personality trait. Your final scene was not dramatic; it was a desk, a train seat, a break room, or a dim apartment where your body finally refused to keep pretending. Luxcellia feels dangerous, but at least the monsters are honest when they try to kill you. Also, naps feel holy now.
Overworked to Death.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Died a Hero (By Accident).name: Died a Hero (By Accident)
Died a Hero (By Accident).description: You did not wake up that day planning to be noble. Someone was in danger, your body moved before your brain could object, and your old life ended in the space between reflex and consequence. The person you saved probably never knew your whole story. In Luxcellia, that same stupidly brave instinct keeps activating at the worst possible times.
Died a Hero (By Accident).traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Gamer's Last Logout.name: Gamer's Last Logout
Gamer's Last Logout.description: Your old life ended mid-session, with a screen still glowing and some objective still unfinished. Maybe it was a raid, a ranked match, a cozy farming save, or one of those games where the tutorial takes eight hours and calls it freedom. Luxcellia is not a game, but your brain keeps reading the world in builds, routes, cooldowns, aggro ranges, and suspiciously obvious quest NPCs. Annoyingly, that helps.
Gamer's Last Logout.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Choked on Something Embarrassing.name: Choked on Something Embarrassing
Choked on Something Embarrassing.description: Your final boss was not impressive. It was a snack, drink, noodle, candy, or bite taken at exactly the wrong moment while fate watched with a clipboard and zero mercy. You refuse to give details, and every afterlife official who knows the truth has been sworn to silence in your heart. Luxcellia gave you a second life, but not a second dignity.
Choked on Something Embarrassing.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Lightning, Twice.name: Lightning, Twice
Lightning, Twice.description: The first lightning strike was already excessive. The second felt personal. Your final moment was less tragedy and more the universe mashing the dramatic effect button until the budget broke. You arrived in Luxcellia with the emotional posture of someone who wants to speak to fate's manager.
Lightning, Twice.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Slipped at the Worst Moment.name: Slipped at the Worst Moment
Slipped at the Worst Moment.description: No demon king. No noble betrayal. No poetic final battle. Your old life ended because a floor, stair, puddle, bathtub, or icy patch decided to become your mortal enemy. Luxcellia gave you a second chance, and you now treat suspicious surfaces with the same caution adventurers reserve for cursed treasure chests.
Slipped at the Worst Moment.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Heroic Last Stand.name: The Heroic Last Stand
The Heroic Last Stand.description: Your final scene was all smoke, alarms, shouts, or collapsing time. You stayed behind because someone had to, and because the people you protected mattered more than your odds. You did not survive, but others did. In Luxcellia, heroism does not feel inspiring to you; it feels familiar, heavy, and impossible to ignore.
The Heroic Last Stand.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Betrayed at the End.name: Betrayed at the End
Betrayed at the End.description: Someone you trusted wrote the ending for you. A friend, lover, coworker, partner, or family member turned a safe place into a trap, and your last clear memory was understanding the betrayal before the darkness arrived. Luxcellia gave you a fresh start, but not a clean slate. You can still love deeply; you just count the knives before you do.
Betrayed at the End.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Died Mid-Confession.name: Died Mid-Confession
Died Mid-Confession.description: You finally said it, or almost did. After years of cowardice, timing, friendship, longing, and anime-level emotional incompetence, you opened your mouth and fate cut the scene before the important line landed. Your old life ended with a confession unfinished. Luxcellia is now full of attractive people and dramatic sunsets, which feels rude.
Died Mid-Confession.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Final Exam Martyr.name: Final Exam Martyr
Final Exam Martyr.description: You were the honor student everyone praised and nobody checked on closely enough. Your final week was notes, pressure, perfect expectations, and the kind of exhaustion adults call discipline when it happens to someone useful. You died before the results ever mattered. Luxcellia's first lesson is that being alive is not an assignment you have to ace.
Final Exam Martyr.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Delinquent's Last Good Deed.name: Delinquent's Last Good Deed
Delinquent's Last Good Deed.description: Your reputation was louder than your heart. People saw trouble, attitude, and a face that made adults sigh, but your final act was helping someone who probably expected you to walk away. You died proving, to nobody important enough, that you were better than the rumor. In Luxcellia, nobody knows your old record, so you get the terrifying luxury of being judged by what you do next.
Delinquent's Last Good Deed.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Nobody Special, Until Now.name: Nobody Special, Until Now
Nobody Special, Until Now.description: Your old life was painfully normal: average room, average routine, average dreams carefully folded smaller every year. Your ending was quiet enough that the world probably kept moving without stumbling. Then you woke in Luxcellia, where magic hums in the grass and people look at you like you might matter. The scariest part is that you want to believe them.
Nobody Special, Until Now.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

A God Got Bored.name: A God Got Bored
A God Got Bored.description: You died, blinked, and found a divine being treating your reincarnation like premium entertainment. They offered no proper briefing, answered no useful questions, and seemed delighted by how confused you were. Maybe you were chosen. Maybe you were content. Maybe the god just wanted to see what would happen if a normal person got dropped into a world with demon nobles and suspiciously attractive guild staff.
A God Got Bored.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Peaceful End, Restless Soul.name: Peaceful End, Restless Soul
Peaceful End, Restless Soul.description: You had already finished one story. You grew old, loved people, lost people, made mistakes, forgave some of them, and eventually closed your eyes in peace. Then Luxcellia opened them again in a younger body with a sky too bright to ignore. You carry a lifetime of memory into a world that thinks you are just beginning.
Peaceful End, Restless Soul.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Died Saving an Animal.name: Died Saving an Animal
Died Saving an Animal.description: Your last decision involved a cat, dog, bird, turtle, or some tiny fool of a creature with no survival instincts and perfect timing. You moved, the animal lived, and you did not. It was absurd, tender, and exactly the kind of thing you would probably do again. In Luxcellia, beasts and beastkin seem to trust you before you have earned it.
Died Saving an Animal.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Medical Emergency, Terrible Timing.name: Medical Emergency, Terrible Timing
Medical Emergency, Terrible Timing.description: Your body picked the worst possible moment to fail. Mid-sentence, mid-meal, mid-errand, or right before something you had been waiting for, the floor rose up and the old world faded out. There was probably a clinical explanation. You prefer the version where fate saw your life ending badly and panic-reassigned you to a fantasy continent.
Medical Emergency, Terrible Timing.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Penthouse With No Sky.name: Penthouse With No Sky
Penthouse With No Sky.description: You had success, status, money, or the shiny version of achievement your old world worshipped. Your final scene happened somewhere expensive and strangely empty, with a view that should have made you feel victorious. Instead, your last thought was that you had bought everything except a reason. Luxcellia, ridiculous and dangerous as it is, gives you one immediately.
Penthouse With No Sky.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Unsent Last Message.name: Unsent Last Message
Unsent Last Message.description: Your final words were trapped behind glass. An apology, confession, thank-you, warning, or simple 'I'm almost home' sat typed on a screen while hesitation stole the last second. Then the old world ended without letting the message leave. In Luxcellia, unfinished words follow you like a ghost with terrible timing.
Unsent Last Message.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Missed the Final Goodbye.name: Missed the Final Goodbye
Missed the Final Goodbye.description: Someone important was waiting, or you were trying to reach them. A delayed train, unanswered call, locked door, storm, traffic jam, or hospital hallway stretched one minute too long. Your old life ended just outside the goodbye you needed. In Luxcellia, departures bother you more than battles do.
Missed the Final Goodbye.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Caregiver's Last Shift.name: The Caregiver's Last Shift
The Caregiver's Last Shift.description: You spent your old life holding everyone else together: family, patients, friends, coworkers, people who assumed your strength refilled itself overnight. Your final day was another emergency, another favor, another moment where you put yourself last until there was nothing left to postpone. Luxcellia's strangest kindness is that people now try to protect you back.
The Caregiver's Last Shift.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Midnight Call.name: The Midnight Call
The Midnight Call.description: You were the person people called when everything fell apart. Your final scene began with someone else's crisis, your phone lighting up in the dark, and your voice becoming steady because theirs could not. You helped them survive the night, then never got your own morning. In Luxcellia, you still answer when people call, but you are learning that heroes need sleep too.
The Midnight Call.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

I’m Fine Until I Wasn’t.name: I’m Fine Until I Wasn’t
I’m Fine Until I Wasn’t.description: Your old catchphrase was a lie polished smooth from overuse. You smiled, showed up, handled things, and convinced everyone, including yourself, that needing help would be inconvenient. Your old life ended when the act finally outlasted the actor. Luxcellia has healers, hot meals, and annoyingly perceptive companions who do not accept 'I'm fine' as a full answer.
I’m Fine Until I Wasn’t.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Window Between Worlds.name: The Window Between Worlds
The Window Between Worlds.description: You spent too much of your old life looking through glass: hospital windows, bus windows, rain-streaked apartment panes, screens showing places your body never reached. Your final moment was quiet, your eyes on a sky you wanted more of. When you woke in Luxcellia under an impossible horizon, it felt like someone finally opened the window.
The Window Between Worlds.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Empty Apartment, Open Door.name: Empty Apartment, Open Door
Empty Apartment, Open Door.description: Your old life ended in a room too quiet for the number of dreams once stored there. There were dishes, bills, half-finished plans, and no one close enough to notice right away. That loneliness followed you across death, but Luxcellia answers solitude with noisy taverns, nosy companions, and strangers who keep deciding you belong at their table.
Empty Apartment, Open Door.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Birthday Candle in the Dark.name: Birthday Candle in the Dark
Birthday Candle in the Dark.description: Your final day should have been remembered. A birthday, anniversary, small celebration, or private milestone passed with too little noise and too much pretending it did not hurt. The candle went out, and so did your old life. In Luxcellia, festivals feel dangerous because people actually notice when you are missing.
Birthday Candle in the Dark.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Promise Kept Too Well.name: The Promise Kept Too Well
The Promise Kept Too Well.description: You made a promise and built your life around keeping it. Protect someone. Finish something. Stay until the end. Come back no matter what. Your final moment came after fulfilling the vow so completely there was nothing left of you to spare. Luxcellia gave you a second life, but the shape of that promise is still carved into your soul.
The Promise Kept Too Well.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Last Train Home.name: The Last Train Home
The Last Train Home.description: Your old life ended on the way back from somewhere, with lights sliding past a window and fatigue making the world feel unreal. Maybe you missed your stop. Maybe the train never reached it. Maybe, for one impossible second, the doors opened onto moonlit grass instead of a platform. You still listen for station announcements in dreams.
The Last Train Home.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Convenience Store Saint.name: Convenience Store Saint
Convenience Store Saint.description: Your final scene happened under fluorescent lights, somewhere between instant noodles, cheap umbrellas, and somebody having the worst night of their life. You helped a stranger, covered a shift, stepped into danger, or gave away the last kindness you had in stock. Then Luxcellia replaced the sliding doors with a fantasy sky. You still judge every world by its snacks.
Convenience Store Saint.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Isekai Reader Got Isekai’d.name: Isekai Reader Got Isekai’d
Isekai Reader Got Isekai’d.description: You went through reincarnation stories like emergency rations: villainess arcs, cheat skills, demon lords, guild ranks, slow-burn romances, the whole buffet. Your final moment came with a book, phone, or manga still open and the smug thought that you would handle an isekai better than those protagonists. Luxcellia heard that. Luxcellia took it personally.
Isekai Reader Got Isekai’d.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Author Killed by Own Plot.name: Author Killed by Own Plot
Author Killed by Own Plot.description: You wrote stories full of cliffhangers, doomed nobles, suspicious mentors, and romantic misunderstandings you absolutely intended to resolve later. Your old life ended surrounded by notes, drafts, or one final scene that refused to work. Then you woke inside a world running the exact plot nonsense you used to inflict on characters. This may be karma with good lighting.
Author Killed by Own Plot.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Unfinished Novel.name: Unfinished Novel
Unfinished Novel.description: There was a story you never finished. Maybe a secret draft, a web serial, a notebook nobody found, or one chapter shy of becoming something real. Your final scene left the cursor blinking, the page half-filled, the ending unwritten. Luxcellia feels like the universe handing you a pen and saying, badly, 'continue.'
Unfinished Novel.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Tabletop Campaign Final Session.name: Tabletop Campaign Final Session
Tabletop Campaign Final Session.description: Your old life ended on game night. Dice on the table, snacks open, character sheet marked with too many erased hit points, everyone leaning in for the final encounter. The last roll left your hand and never landed in the world you knew. In Luxcellia, tavern strangers keep forming parties, and you keep checking whether anyone brought backup dice.
Tabletop Campaign Final Session.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Dungeon Master Forever.name: Dungeon Master Forever
Dungeon Master Forever.description: You spent years building worlds for other people to ruin beautifully. Your final session was supposed to reveal the twist, crown the heroes, or finally punish the murderhobo. Instead the old world faded before the campaign ended. Luxcellia feels suspiciously like a setting you would have designed, except now the NPCs flirt back and the monsters are not balanced.
Dungeon Master Forever.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Streamer Forgot to Log Off.name: Streamer Forgot to Log Off
Streamer Forgot to Log Off.description: Your final moments were broadcast, clipped, misinterpreted, or immortalized by an audience that knew your voice better than your face. You were streaming a game, art, music, cooking, nonsense, or late-night honesty when reality cut the feed. Luxcellia gives you no chat window, no mute button, and way too many people reacting live to your choices.
Streamer Forgot to Log Off.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Bad Gacha Pull Regret.name: Bad Gacha Pull Regret
Bad Gacha Pull Regret.description: Your last old-world emotion was betrayal by probability. You spent resources you should not have spent, chased the banner, missed the rate-up, and learned instantly that fate has a sense of comedic timing. Then you died before the pity could reset. Luxcellia is now full of beautiful rare characters, which is either compensation or psychological warfare.
Bad Gacha Pull Regret.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Tutorial Skipper.name: Tutorial Skipper
Tutorial Skipper.description: You ignored the instructions. In games, appliances, contracts, warning signs, emergency procedures, and possibly life itself, you treated tutorials as obstacles between you and fun. Your final moment involved realizing, too late, that some pop-ups exist for a reason. Luxcellia has no manual, which means you are either finally free or completely doomed.
Tutorial Skipper.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Speedran Life, Missed the Sidequests.name: Speedran Life, Missed the Sidequests
Speedran Life, Missed the Sidequests.description: You optimized everything: grades, career, money, chores, routes, responses, efficiency. Your final scene came after a life cleared quickly and lived thinly, too many optional moments skipped because they did not look productive. Luxcellia is full of side quests, hot springs, festivals, suspicious strangers, and delicious distractions. This time, you are trying not to mash skip.
Speedran Life, Missed the Sidequests.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Death by Overconfidence.name: Death by Overconfidence
Death by Overconfidence.description: You looked at a situation and thought, 'I can make that.' Jump, stunt, shortcut, argument, spicy food challenge, dangerous repair, dramatic entrance; the shape varies, the arrogance does not. Your final moment was the exact second confidence became evidence against you. In Luxcellia, you still say 'watch this,' but now companions physically prepare to intervene.
Death by Overconfidence.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Customer Service Clerical Error.name: Customer Service Clerical Error
Customer Service Clerical Error.description: Your death should have been processed normally, but the afterlife paperwork went feral. A tired celestial clerk, a duplicated soul ticket, a mistranslated reincarnation form, and suddenly you were routed to Luxcellia with a cheerful apology and no receipt. You are not sure whether to be grateful or request escalation. Either way, the gods owe you store credit.
Customer Service Clerical Error.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Chosen by Accident.name: Chosen by Accident
Chosen by Accident.description: You were near the chosen one when destiny misfired. A summoning circle clipped you, a divine beam had terrible aim, or a hero selection spell grabbed the person standing slightly to the left. Your old life ended as collateral narration, and Luxcellia now keeps acting like this was intentional. You are beginning to suspect nobody checked the paperwork.
Chosen by Accident.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Wrong Place, Mythic Time.name: Wrong Place, Mythic Time
Wrong Place, Mythic Time.description: You wandered into the wrong place during the exact wrong cosmic minute: eclipse, shrine festival, meteor shower, abandoned station, haunted stairwell, or a ritual someone swore was just local folklore. Your old life ended at the border between normal and myth. Luxcellia was waiting on the other side like it had reserved a seat.
Wrong Place, Mythic Time.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Cosplay Armor Incident.name: Cosplay Armor Incident
Cosplay Armor Incident.description: You dressed as someone much cooler than you were and fate took it as a challenge. Convention hall, photo shoot, prop mishap, overheated armor, cursed-looking accessory from a vendor with no refund policy; the details are both embarrassing and suspicious. Your final old-world outfit had more dramatic flair than practical safety. Luxcellia respects the commitment.
Cosplay Armor Incident.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Idol Who Burned Out.name: Idol Who Burned Out
Idol Who Burned Out.description: You lived under lights: rehearsals, smiles, fan expectations, curated perfection, and the exhausting work of being adored without being known. Your final performance ended with applause you could barely hear over your own fading strength. Luxcellia has stages too, but here people might love the person behind the pose. That is somehow scarier.
Idol Who Burned Out.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Prodigy’s Final Recital.name: Prodigy’s Final Recital
Prodigy’s Final Recital.description: You were special too early. Music, math, sports, art, academics, magic in a world without magic; adults loved your potential until it became a cage. Your final scene came before one more performance, competition, exam, or showcase where everyone expected brilliance and nobody asked whether you wanted rest. Luxcellia gives you talent again, but maybe this time you choose what it is for.
Prodigy’s Final Recital.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Gifted Kid Deadline Collapse.name: Gifted Kid Deadline Collapse
Gifted Kid Deadline Collapse.description: You were told you were smart, talented, advanced, destined, gifted. Then adulthood arrived with bills, exhaustion, and the horrifying discovery that potential does not come with instructions. Your old life ended under the weight of a future everyone assumed you would automatically survive. Luxcellia's quests are at least honest enough to mark themselves dangerous.
Gifted Kid Deadline Collapse.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Chuunibyou Was Correct.name: Chuunibyou Was Correct
Chuunibyou Was Correct.description: You used to joke about hidden powers, secret bloodlines, sealed eyes, forbidden techniques, and ancient forces recognizing your greatness. Everyone called it a phase. Your final moment involved something glowing, humming, or suspiciously arranged like a magic circle, and suddenly the joke stopped being a joke. Luxcellia is terrible for your ego, because it keeps validating your worst dramatic instincts.
Chuunibyou Was Correct.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Office Rival’s Last Laugh.name: Office Rival’s Last Laugh
Office Rival’s Last Laugh.description: You and your office rival spent years turning spreadsheets, meetings, promotions, and passive-aggressive emails into psychological warfare. Your final day should have been a victory, or at least a tie, but fate let them get the last smug expression before your old life ended. Luxcellia has noble courts and guild politics now. Unfortunately, you are already trained.
Office Rival’s Last Laugh.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Lottery Winner, Worst Timing.name: Lottery Winner, Worst Timing
Lottery Winner, Worst Timing.description: You finally won. The number matched, the email was real, the ticket was valid, the impossible thing happened. Then, before you could spend a single coin of that beautiful, useless fortune, your old life ended with slapstick cosmic cruelty. Luxcellia gave you adventure instead of money, which is technically priceless and emotionally unacceptable.
Lottery Winner, Worst Timing.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Wedding Day What-If.name: The Wedding Day What-If
The Wedding Day What-If.description: Your final day was tangled in rings, vows, invitations, cold feet, old feelings, or the terrifying question of whether love was supposed to feel like that. Maybe you were going to the wedding, running from it, or realizing too late whom you should have chosen. Your old life ended before the answer. Luxcellia is not subtle about second chances in romance.
The Wedding Day What-If.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Confession Letter in the Drawer.name: Confession Letter in the Drawer
Confession Letter in the Drawer.description: You wrote the letter and never sent it. Folded, hidden, rewritten, reread, protected from the one person who needed it most. Your final old-world scene left that paper waiting in a drawer like a tiny emotional time bomb. In Luxcellia, every unsaid feeling seems to come back wearing nicer clothes and carrying a sword.
Confession Letter in the Drawer.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The One Who Walked Home Alone.name: The One Who Walked Home Alone
The One Who Walked Home Alone.description: Your old life ended on a walk nobody thought was important. Streetlights, rain, headphones, a quiet shortcut, the kind of ordinary route that should have delivered you safely to bed. Instead, it became the last scene. Luxcellia's roads are stranger and more dangerous, but somehow less lonely.
The One Who Walked Home Alone.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Rainy Day Final Scene.name: Rainy Day Final Scene
Rainy Day Final Scene.description: Your ending had rain in it because apparently fate has a director. Umbrella forgotten, clothes damp, neon or streetlamps blurred, one last look at a world that felt softer and sadder under water. Then the sound of rain became leaves, river, or tavern roof in Luxcellia. You still get quiet when storms start.
Rainy Day Final Scene.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Festival Night Disappearance.name: Festival Night Disappearance
Festival Night Disappearance.description: Lanterns, fireworks, shrine stalls, music, summer heat, someone's hand almost in yours; your old world was bright enough to hide the impossible thing opening behind it. You vanished during a festival night, and people probably argued for years about where you went. Luxcellia remembers the lantern light too. Festivals here feel like doorways.
Festival Night Disappearance.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Almost Graduate.name: The Almost Graduate
The Almost Graduate.description: You were nearly done. Cap, gown, certificate, final project, last exam, one signature, one ceremony, one family photo away from the finish line. Your old life ended before the proof arrived. Luxcellia cannot give you that diploma, but it keeps offering mentors, trials, rankings, and the dangerous comfort of beginning again.
The Almost Graduate.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Dropout Who Survived Anyway.name: The Dropout Who Survived Anyway
The Dropout Who Survived Anyway.description: You left the expected path and kept walking. School, career, family plan, approved future; whatever you dropped, it taught you how to live without applause. Your final moment came after years of surviving people who thought you had failed. Luxcellia does not care about your transcript. It cares whether you get back up.
The Dropout Who Survived Anyway.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Debt Spiral Escapee.name: The Debt Spiral Escapee
The Debt Spiral Escapee.description: Your old life was ruled by numbers: rent, loans, interest, late fees, impossible math wearing a polite smile. Your final scene came just as you saw a way out, or just as the walls closed in again. Luxcellia has debts too, but they come with dragon hoards, guild rewards, and at least one suspicious merchant you can glare at in person.
The Debt Spiral Escapee.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Minimum Wage Last Stand.name: Minimum Wage Last Stand
Minimum Wage Last Stand.description: You worked a job that treated patience as a renewable resource and dignity as optional. Your final shift had customers, managers, broken equipment, and the kind of chaos only low wages can summon. Somewhere in that mess you protected a coworker, helped a stranger, or simply stayed too long because nobody else would. Luxcellia's guild jobs are dangerous, but at least the quest board admits it.
Minimum Wage Last Stand.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Night Shift Ghost.name: The Night Shift Ghost
The Night Shift Ghost.description: You lived while the world slept: convenience counters, hospital halls, security desks, kitchens, warehouses, empty roads. Your final old-world scene was lit by vending machines and tired fluorescent bulbs, with dawn always one more hour away. Luxcellia's nights are full of moons, monsters, and campfire conversations. You are still weirdly good at staying awake when everyone else cannot.
The Night Shift Ghost.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Pet Parent’s Last Worry.name: The Pet Parent’s Last Worry
The Pet Parent’s Last Worry.description: Your final panic was not about yourself. It was about the animal waiting at home: food bowl, medicine, walk, litter box, favorite blanket, the small life that depended on you without understanding absence. That worry crossed worlds with you. In Luxcellia, strays find you fast, because apparently your soul still smells like someone who carries treats.
The Pet Parent’s Last Worry.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Lost Sibling Vow.name: The Lost Sibling Vow
The Lost Sibling Vow.description: A sibling shaped your old life: protected, rivaled, missed, resented, adored, or searched for. Your final moment tied back to them through a promise, apology, argument, joke, or empty chair nobody else understood. Luxcellia gave you a new world, but not a new heart. You still look sideways when someone calls for their brother or sister.
The Lost Sibling Vow.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Perfect Mask.name: The Perfect Mask
The Perfect Mask.description: You were polished until you barely knew what was underneath. Right smile, right outfit, right answer, right role, right life; everyone praised the performance and missed the person disappearing inside it. Your old life ended after one more perfect day that cost too much. Luxcellia is messy, loud, emotional, and very bad for masks.
The Perfect Mask.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Class Clown’s Quiet Ending.name: The Class Clown’s Quiet Ending
The Class Clown’s Quiet Ending.description: You made people laugh because silence had teeth. Your final day was full of jokes, deflections, group-chat nonsense, and one last punchline nobody knew was hiding a goodbye. Then the laughter moved on without you. In Luxcellia, humor is still your shield, but companions here keep noticing when you hold it too tightly.
The Class Clown’s Quiet Ending.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Unlucky Lucky One.name: The Unlucky Lucky One
The Unlucky Lucky One.description: Your life was a probability crime scene. You dodged disasters, found coins, missed buses that later broke down, won tiny prizes, lost important chances, and generally made luck look drunk. Your final moment was so absurdly timed that even fate probably checked the math twice. Luxcellia feels less like a new genre and more like your luck finally evolving.
The Unlucky Lucky One.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Mystery Case.name: The Mystery Case
The Mystery Case.description: Your old-world death became a question mark. Missing records, a locked room, a contradictory witness, a phone found somewhere odd, a final location nobody could explain. You remember fragments, not answers. In Luxcellia, mysteries itch under your skin, because one of them used to be your name.
The Mystery Case.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Canceled Before the Finale.name: Canceled Before the Finale
Canceled Before the Finale.description: Your life ended one episode before the payoff. Relationship unresolved, rival still smug, goal almost reached, favorite person still unkissed, emotional arc rudely cut short. It was narratively offensive. Luxcellia is your surprise second season, and this time you intend to force a proper finale out of the universe.
Canceled Before the Finale.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Quiet Winner.name: The Quiet Winner
The Quiet Winner.description: You had just begun to win in small, sacred ways. Better habits, better boundaries, a room that felt like yours, a morning that did not feel impossible. Then the old world ended before the victory could grow roots. Luxcellia carries the ache of interruption, but also the proof that you were becoming someone worth saving.
The Quiet Winner.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The One Who Wanted More.name: The One Who Wanted More
The One Who Wanted More.description: You did not hate your old life. You just kept wishing it had more color, danger, romance, magic, flavor, music, anything. Your final thought was less a prayer than a complaint filed with reality itself. Luxcellia apparently reads complaints, stamps them APPROVED, and sends monsters as part of the welcome package.
The One Who Wanted More.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Skeptic Who Was Wrong.name: The Skeptic Who Was Wrong
The Skeptic Who Was Wrong.description: You did not believe in gods, souls, omens, reincarnation, prophecies, curses, or anything that would make your current situation convenient. Your final moment involved confidently dismissing something strange right before it proved you wrong. Luxcellia is now a daily humiliation for your old worldview. You are adapting, but you refuse to look smug gods in the eye.
The Skeptic Who Was Wrong.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Believer Who Got Receipts.name: The Believer Who Got Receipts
The Believer Who Got Receipts.description: You believed in signs before there was evidence: destiny, spirits, reincarnation, karma, divine timing, dreams that meant something. People humored you. Then your final moment arrived exactly under the omen you had been watching, and Luxcellia answered with impossible proof. Being right is satisfying. Being this right is deeply inconvenient.
The Believer Who Got Receipts.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The City Kid in the Wrong Genre.name: The City Kid in the Wrong Genre
The City Kid in the Wrong Genre.description: Your old survival skills involved elevators, delivery apps, public transit, convenience stores, and knowing which streets to avoid after midnight. Your final scene came during a deeply unfair encounter with nature, travel, or a power outage that proved you were not built for wilderness content. Luxcellia has forests, dragons, and no phone signal. You are furious, but learning.
The City Kid in the Wrong Genre.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Rural Soul in Neon Hell.name: The Rural Soul in Neon Hell
The Rural Soul in Neon Hell.description: You came from fields, small roads, quiet mornings, weather sense, practical repairs, gossip networks, and the comfort of knowing which stars meant rain. Your old life ended somewhere too bright, too fast, too loud, and too far from home. Luxcellia's villages and wildlands hurt in a familiar way. For once, the fantasy world feels less alien than the city did.
The Rural Soul in Neon Hell.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Online Legend.name: The Online Legend
The Online Legend.description: Your old name was a username. Guide writer, fan artist, forum menace, theorycrafter, raid caller, moderator, comment-section cryptid; people knew the handle before the person. Your final scene happened while posting, uploading, arguing, helping, or being perceived far too intensely by strangers. Luxcellia erased the account but not the instincts. You still narrate bad decisions like patch notes.
The Online Legend.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Person Behind the Account.name: The Person Behind the Account
The Person Behind the Account.description: Your public self and private self lived in different tabs. Avatars, drafts, DMs, saved posts, jokes you could type but not say; online you were braver, softer, louder, or more honest. Your old life ended before those versions could reconcile. Luxcellia gives you one body, no edit button, and companions who expect eye contact.
The Person Behind the Account.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Almost Villain.name: The Almost Villain
The Almost Villain.description: Your old life ended while bitterness was loading the villain route. You had not crossed the line yet, but you could see it from where you stood: revenge, cruelty, selfishness, the tempting clarity of giving up on being good. Then death cut the arc short. Luxcellia is either your redemption route or the universe checking whether you learned anything.
The Almost Villain.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Accidental Mentor.name: The Accidental Mentor
The Accidental Mentor.description: People kept handing you their fragile beginnings: younger siblings, classmates, coworkers, online strangers, friends in terrible romances, anyone who needed advice from someone pretending to be less scared. Your final moment came while guiding someone else through their crisis. In Luxcellia, lost people still find you, which is flattering, exhausting, and probably destiny being lazy.
The Accidental Mentor.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Background Character.name: The Background Character
The Background Character.description: You spent your old life near the story but never in the frame. Friend of the brilliant one, coworker in the back, extra in the photo, reliable support with no theme music. Your ending happened during someone else's big moment, almost as if the narrative forgot you were a person. Luxcellia overcorrected by giving you main-character lighting. It is terrifying.
The Background Character.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Main Character Denier.name: The Main Character Denier
The Main Character Denier.description: You avoided attention, destiny, drama, leadership, and anyone who used the phrase 'chosen one' without irony. Your old life ended because you tried to step out of a dramatic situation and somehow saved people anyway. Luxcellia took that as an audition. You are still filing objections with the plot.
The Main Character Denier.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Romance Route Avoider.name: The Romance Route Avoider
The Romance Route Avoider.description: You dodged feelings with elite footwork. Unread signals, safe jokes, sudden busyness, tactical subject changes, and the ancient art of pretending not to notice when someone looked at you softly. Your final scene came right after avoiding one confession too many. Luxcellia is now built out of eye contact, balconies, festivals, and emotionally available swordfighters. You are doomed.
The Romance Route Avoider.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Romance Route Completionist.name: The Romance Route Completionist
The Romance Route Completionist.description: You loved love stories enough to recognize every route: fake engagement, rivals to lovers, tragic noble, soft healer, dangerous demon, childhood friend, the whole suspicious buffet. Your old life ended before your own romance ever got a clean route. Luxcellia keeps introducing beautiful people with unresolved arcs. You know the tropes, which makes this worse, not safer.
The Romance Route Completionist.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Foodie With Unfinished Reservations.name: The Foodie With Unfinished Reservations
The Foodie With Unfinished Reservations.description: Your final regret was culinary, which sounds shallow until someone misses the meal they waited years to taste. Reservation finally booked, recipe half-tested, food trip planned, festival stall closing in ten minutes; then your old life ended before the bite. Luxcellia's cuisine is so unfairly good it feels like an apology written by a god with excellent seasoning.
The Foodie With Unfinished Reservations.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Traveler Who Never Arrived.name: The Traveler Who Never Arrived
The Traveler Who Never Arrived.description: You were on the way somewhere that mattered: new city, old hometown, first date, family visit, interview, convention, vacation, apology. Bags packed, route planned, anticipation alive. Then the journey broke. Luxcellia turned your unfinished departure into an arrival, but some part of you still carries the ticket.
The Traveler Who Never Arrived.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Artist Who Saw Too Much Beauty.name: The Artist Who Saw Too Much Beauty
The Artist Who Saw Too Much Beauty.description: You chased beauty with whatever tools you had: camera, pen, brush, music, design software, stage lights, or just eyes trained to notice. Your final moment happened while trying to catch something fleeting before it vanished. Then you woke in Luxcellia, a world so beautiful it feels personally aggressive. You are inspired, offended, and constantly distracted.
The Artist Who Saw Too Much Beauty.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Disaster Magnet.name: The Disaster Magnet
The Disaster Magnet.description: Weird things happened around you before magic was officially real. Elevators stopped, animals followed, alarms triggered, strangers confessed secrets, normal errands became side quests, and your final day was a chain reaction of nonsense that ended with destiny shrugging. Luxcellia did not change your genre. It only admitted what genre you had always been in.
The Disaster Magnet.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Villain Route Transmigration.name: Villain Route Transmigration
Villain Route Transmigration.description: You died with a villainess novel, otome game, revenge manga, or doomed-rival storyline still fresh in your mind, and woke up inside the life of someone the narrative had already sentenced. The beautiful problem. The arrogant rival. The noble everyone thinks they understand. Your old ending gave you genre awareness; Luxcellia gives you death flags and attractive people who refuse to follow the script.
Villain Route Transmigration.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Hero After the Credits.name: The Hero After the Credits
The Hero After the Credits.description: You already saved people once. Maybe not with magic, maybe not with a sword, but your final old-world act ended someone else's disaster and spent everything you had left. You expected rest, or at least credits. Instead Luxcellia opened on a new season where everyone keeps looking at you like the hero role is still available.
The Hero After the Credits.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Seal Broke With You.name: The Seal Broke With You
The Seal Broke With You.description: Your old life ended after touching, opening, buying, inheriting, or photographing something that should have stayed sealed. Antique mirror, shrine box, cursed ring, museum relic, family heirloom with suspicious vibes; you ignored exactly enough warnings to become plot-relevant. Something ancient crossed the border with your soul. It does not grant you power for free, but it does make commentary, dreams, and bad decisions more dramatic.
The Seal Broke With You.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Villainess Cascade.name: Villainess Cascade
Villainess Cascade.description: A dramatic villainess cascade, impossibly long, voluminous hair that flows like a waterfall of silk. The kind of hair that makes standing still look like a power move.
Villainess Cascade.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render extremely long, voluminous, flowing hair cascading dramatically.

War Paint Markings.name: War Paint Markings
War Paint Markings.description: Bold painted marks across the face, tribal stripes, clan sigils, or personal war paint applied before battle and never fully washed off. The markings are identity as much as decoration.
War Paint Markings.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render bold painted markings across the face.

Anime Curtain Bangs.name: Anime Curtain Bangs
Anime Curtain Bangs.description: Soft, face-framing bangs that part in the middle and sweep down like curtains, the quintessential ikemen look. Effortlessly handsome, deceptively low-maintenance, and responsible for more double-takes per capita than any other hairstyle on the continent.
Anime Curtain Bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair falls perfectly across your forehead in a way that makes people assume you're the mysterious transfer student.

Burnished Gold Eyes.name: Burnished Gold Eyes
Burnished Gold Eyes.description: Burnished Gold Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Burnished Gold Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Burnished Gold Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #C89020. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Casual Town Clothes.name: Casual Town Clothes
Casual Town Clothes.description: Comfortable everyday wear, a simple shirt, trousers or skirt, and practical shoes. No armor, no pretense, just you.
Casual Town Clothes.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Everyday Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Chestnut Brown Hair.name: Chestnut Brown Hair
Chestnut Brown Hair.description: Chestnut Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Chestnut Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Chestnut Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #7B3F2A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Chronic Oversleeper.name: Chronic Oversleeper
Chronic Oversleeper.description: You can and will sleep through things you absolutely should not sleep through if nobody intervenes.
Chronic Oversleeper.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist sleeps through alarms, departures, and at least one emergency unless bodily intervened upon. Companions develop wake-up strategies with escalating force. Use for morning comedy, late arrivals with consequences, and the vulnerability of someone truly at rest.

Desert Caravan Camp.name: Desert Caravan Camp
Desert Caravan Camp.description: A desert caravan camp at dusk, tents, campfires, and the kind of temporary community that forms between strangers crossing the same wasteland.
Desert Caravan Camp.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render a desert caravan camp at dusk.

Desert Oasis Mirage.name: Desert Oasis Mirage
Desert Oasis Mirage.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: Golden dunes open onto a luxurious oasis with palms, shimmering water, patterned silks, and mirage-like heat haze. The scene feels exotic, alluring, and adventurous. {{portraitprompt}}: desert oasis, palm trees, shimmering water, golden dunes, heat haze, fantasy mirage background behind character
Desert Oasis Mirage.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Divine Cross Pupils.name: Divine Cross Pupils
Divine Cross Pupils.description: A holy cross-shaped pupil or iris highlight that suggests blessing, divinity, judgment, or saintly authority. It should look elegant and readable, not horror-like or medically strange.
Divine Cross Pupils.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN LOCK: Apply refined divine cross-shaped pupils/highlights. Keep the eyes beautiful, symmetrical, and anime-clean; do not make them grotesque or replace the iris color.

Doll-Pale Porcelain.name: Doll-Pale Porcelain
Doll-Pale Porcelain.description: A very pale porcelain complexion with a crafted, delicate finish. It works especially well for homunculi, gothic nobles, vampires, academy dolls, artificial bodies, and characters whose beauty feels a little too perfect to be accidental. The result should be pale and refined, not lifeless.
Doll-Pale Porcelain.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use doll-pale porcelain as the definitive complexion: very fair, smooth, refined, and delicate. Keep the character alive and expressive; do not make them a literal doll unless race/origin supports it.

Face-Framing Layers.name: Face-Framing Layers
Face-Framing Layers.description: Long layers that frame the face and sweep outward, volume, movement, and the kind of style that looks good from every angle because it was designed to.
Face-Framing Layers.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render layered hair that frames the face, with shorter front pieces and longer back layers.

Frost-Covered Peaks.name: Frost-Covered Peaks
Frost-Covered Peaks.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: Snow-draped mountain peaks rise behind the character, with cold wind, glittering ice, and crisp alpine light. The atmosphere is noble, remote, and majestic. {{portraitprompt}}: snowy mountain peaks, icy wind, alpine fantasy landscape, cold blue light, majestic peak background behind character
Frost-Covered Peaks.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Frost-Touched Beard.name: Frost-Touched Beard
Frost-Touched Beard.description: A beard perpetually tinged with frost, ice crystals clinging to the hairs, cold mist near the chin. Whether it's a bloodline trait, a curse, or an ice-affinity side effect, it looks spectacular.
Frost-Touched Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial hair appearance only. Render a frost-covered beard with ice crystal accents.

Gothic Lolita Dress.name: Gothic Lolita Dress
Gothic Lolita Dress.description: Layers of lace, a parasol, platform shoes, and a bonnet or headdress, all in blacks, deep reds, and purples with an unexpectedly sharp edge hidden in the frills.
Gothic Lolita Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Heroic Mentor Beard.name: Heroic Mentor Beard
Heroic Mentor Beard.description: A clean heroic beard with mentor energy, mature, dependable, and ready to deliver advice before the third-act crisis. It should look strong and maintained, not wild, ragged, or comedic.
Heroic Mentor Beard.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL HAIR LOCK: Render a maintained heroic short-to-medium beard suitable for a mentor, knight, veteran, or guild master. Keep face shape and expression readable.

Hidden Quest Magnet.name: Hidden Quest Magnet
Hidden Quest Magnet.description: You stumble into rare, hidden, and secret quests that most adventurers never find. Hidden Quest Magnet means you take the wrong turn and find a sealed dungeon. You help a stranger and discover they're a disguised noble with a world-altering problem. You order food at a tavern and the chef turns out to be a retired legendary adventurer who wants to train one last student. The quests are always dramatic, always rewarding, and always more complicated than they first appear. Guild staff have started flagging your completed quest reports as 'statistically improbable.'
Hidden Quest Magnet.traitNarrativeEffects: You cannot walk through a market, forest, or dungeon without something plot-relevant happening. You have tried. It doesn't work.

Incurable Curiosity.name: Incurable Curiosity
Incurable Curiosity.description: If it is sealed, glowing or marked do not touch, your hand is already moving. You press the button, open the door and read the cursed page aloud before anyone can stop you.
Incurable Curiosity.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Hands-on, in-the-moment curiosity: the protagonist touches, opens and activates forbidden things on the spot. Use to spring traps, wake sleeping things, and give companions a full-time job.

Lavender Lilac Skin.name: Lavender Lilac Skin
Lavender Lilac Skin.description: A pale lavender complexion with soft magical undertones. Dreamy, elegant, and a little unreal, ideal for fairy-blooded, twilight-touched, illusionist, or noble fantasy characters with refined otherworldly beauty.
Lavender Lilac Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Lavender Lilac Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: dusk and violet magic make you look like you belong in a forbidden ballroom.

Mahogany Brown Hair.name: Mahogany Brown Hair
Mahogany Brown Hair.description: Mahogany Brown Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Mahogany Brown Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Mahogany Brown Hair. Exact hex color reference: #6B2A1A. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Miko Battle Regalia.name: Miko Battle Regalia
Miko Battle Regalia.description: A combat-modified shrine maiden outfit, the traditional red hakama and white kosode reinforced with hidden armor panels, talisman pouches sewn into the sleeves, a shimenawa rope belt with purification bells, and ceremonial ribbons that double as binding seals. Sacred duty made fashionable and lethal.
Miko Battle Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Battle Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Moon-Touched Silver.name: Moon-Touched Silver
Moon-Touched Silver.description: Skin with a faint silver-white sheen, blessed by moonlight exposure, Moonsilver rituals, or lunar heritage. Ethereal and otherworldly.
Moon-Touched Silver.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. You practically glow under moonlight and it makes nighttime stealth impossible.

Moonlit Forest Path.name: Moonlit Forest Path
Moonlit Forest Path.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A winding forest path under silver moonlight, with ancient trees, drifting fireflies, and a romantic fantasy atmosphere. The world feels quiet, beautiful, and a little dangerous. {{portraitprompt}}: moonlit forest path, silver moonlight, ancient trees, fireflies, romantic fantasy atmosphere, anime portrait background behind character
Moonlit Forest Path.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Moonlit Silver Eyes.name: Moonlit Silver Eyes
Moonlit Silver Eyes.description: Moonlit Silver Eyes with a clear, readable anime gaze. Use this as the defining iris color in every portrait.
Moonlit Silver Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Moonlit Silver Eyes. Exact hex color reference: #C0C8D0. Do not approximate or drift from this color value. When two eye colors are selected, use each hex value for one eye precisely.

Pride Before Reason.name: Pride Before Reason
Pride Before Reason.description: Doubt your skill or insult your name, and common sense has to fight for its life.
Pride Before Reason.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Once pride is stung, the protagonist refuses help they need, will not let an insult pass, and doubles down past the exit. Rivals exploit it deliberately. Use for escalating duels, avoidable trouble, and the humbling moments that teach nothing.

Romcom-Level Clumsy.name: Romcom-Level Clumsy
Romcom-Level Clumsy.description: Your body occasionally behaves like it was written by a mischievous romance director.
Romcom-Level Clumsy.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: At the worst moments the protagonist trips, slips, collides, and lands in compromising tableaux. Physics conspires toward misunderstanding. Use for classic romcom staging, interrupted moments, and accidental intimacy that must then be explained to witnesses.

Rose-Red Demon Skin.name: Rose-Red Demon Skin
Rose-Red Demon Skin.description: A softer rose-red tone that keeps demonic beauty, warmth, and romance tension without becoming too harsh. It suits charming demonkin, pact-born nobles, and characters whose danger comes wrapped in elegance.
Rose-Red Demon Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Rose-Red Demon Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: candlelight makes your skin look dangerously romantic.

Saintess Bell Staff.name: Saintess Bell Staff
Saintess Bell Staff.description:
A sacred staff topped with a ritual bell and holy ornaments that chime when healing, barriers, purification, or a divine warning takes hold. Saintesses, shrine attendants, and gentle support casters favor it, partly because one clear bell-note can make a whole battlefield pause. Beautiful, ceremonial, and considerably more dangerous to evil than it looks.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Saintess Bell Staff.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a sacred bell staff. Reference chimes, purification waves, barrier pulses, healing rites, and holy sound motifs. Depict one staff with a visible bell focus. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Divinity.

Saintly Gentle Face.name: Saintly Gentle Face
Saintly Gentle Face.description: Calm, luminous, composed features with the steady bearing of a healer, saintess, or shrine attendant. The expression reads as quiet strength, not emptiness.
Saintly Gentle Face.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL FEATURE LOCK: Render gentle saintly facial features: soft eyes, warm expression, calm compassion. Use for visual identity only; do not override selected personality or origin.

Scar Across the Eye.name: Scar Across the Eye
Scar Across the Eye.description: A clean or jagged scar running diagonally across one eye, the universal mark of someone who survived something they shouldn't have. The eye beneath may still work, or it may not. Either way, the scar tells a story before you open your mouth.
Scar Across the Eye.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render a visible scar crossing diagonally over one eye.

Secret Boss Chamber.name: Secret Boss Chamber
Secret Boss Chamber.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A sealed late-game chamber with a cracked throne, floating boss-core fragments, glowing runes, ancient chains, and dramatic light pouring through broken stone. The scene should imply the character belongs to a hidden route or final encounter, even if they are trying very hard to be normal. {{portraitprompt}}: secret boss chamber, cracked throne, glowing runes, floating relic fragments, ancient chains, cinematic anime fantasy portrait background behind character
Secret Boss Chamber.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: This trait controls portrait background only. Use a sealed boss-room atmosphere with throne, runes, relic fragments, and late-game mystery.

Sleek Wet-Look Hair.name: Sleek Wet-Look Hair
Sleek Wet-Look Hair.description: Hair styled to look perpetually slicked and glossy, as if the wearer just emerged from rain, a hot spring, or an anime opening sequence. Every strand lies flat and reflective, catching light like liquid obsidian or molten silver. Dangerous, seductive, and impossibly cool.
Sleek Wet-Look Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: You look like you just stepped out of a downpour and the rain made you more attractive. This is accurate.

Sleepless Sage Gaze.name: Sleepless Sage Gaze
Sleepless Sage Gaze.description: Intelligent, tired eyes with subtle under-eye shadows and the haunted look of someone who solved a dungeon, decoded a prophecy, or rewrote a spell formula instead of sleeping. The face should still be attractive and readable, but with a scholar's exhaustion baked in.
Sleepless Sage Gaze.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL FEATURE LOCK: Render tired, intelligent eyes and subtle sleep-deprived detail. Keep it stylish and anime-clean, not sickly or grotesque; this is genius fatigue, not horror.

Starlit Observatory.name: Starlit Observatory
Starlit Observatory.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A high observatory beneath a star-filled sky, with brass telescopes, glowing astrolabes, and cosmic charts. The setting suggests prophecy, scholarship, and wonder. {{portraitprompt}}: starlit observatory, fantasy telescope, glowing astrolabe, night sky, celestial background behind character
Starlit Observatory.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Stormy Coast Cliffs.name: Stormy Coast Cliffs
Stormy Coast Cliffs.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: Dark sea cliffs battered by wind and spray, with crashing waves, dramatic clouds, and distant lighthouse glow. The mood is fierce, cinematic, and romantic. {{portraitprompt}}: stormy coast cliffs, crashing waves, sea spray, dramatic clouds, fantasy coastline, anime portrait background behind character
Stormy Coast Cliffs.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Terrible with Money.name: Terrible with Money
Terrible with Money.description: You are bad at budgeting, suspiciously vulnerable to impulse purchases, or both.
Terrible with Money.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist overspends, splurges on impulse, and haggles badly. Merchants notice the easy mark; companions confiscate the coin purse. Use for shopping comedy, debt complications, and the gap between dungeon riches and empty pockets.

The Cool Strategist.name: The Cool Strategist
The Cool Strategist.description: You think a few moves ahead, keep your head under pressure, and prefer elegance over panic. Other people bring emotion to the table; you bring a plan that survives contact with reality.
The Cool Strategist.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write measured thinking, calm planning, and elegant control under pressure.

The Smooth Operator.name: The Smooth Operator
The Smooth Operator.description: You are socially polished, verbally quick, and annoyingly good at saying the right thing with the right smile at the right time. Unlike the Shameless Enjoyer, you are calculated about charm instead of simply honest about appetite.
The Smooth Operator.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Use deliberate charm, social timing, and someone who knows exactly how to say the right thing.

The Unhinged Genius.name: The Unhinged Genius
The Unhinged Genius.description: Your mind works at dazzling speed and occasionally alarming angles. People around you are never fully sure whether your next idea will save the day or create a new category of problem.
The Unhinged Genius.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Make them brilliant, alarming, and capable of solving problems in ways that unsettle everybody else.

Alchemist's Lab Coat.name: Alchemist's Lab Coat
Alchemist's Lab Coat.description: A long stained coat over practical clothes, vial belts, fingerless gloves, and goggles pushed up on the forehead. Science is a blast.
Alchemist's Lab Coat.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Battle-Worn Features.name: Battle-Worn Features
Battle-Worn Features.description: Multiple small scars, a slightly crooked nose, and the general look of someone whose face has been in the vicinity of violence more than once. Not disfigured, experienced.
Battle-Worn Features.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render multiple small scars and weathered features.

Beach at Golden Hour.name: Beach at Golden Hour
Beach at Golden Hour.description: A beach at golden hour, warm light, gentle waves, and the kind of scene that makes people say things they'll either cherish or regret.
Beach at Golden Hour.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render a beach at golden hour sunset.

Beastkin Tribal Furs.name: Beastkin Tribal Furs
Beastkin Tribal Furs.description: Beastkin tribal furs, practical, warm, and decorated with clan markers, bone charms, and the kind of natural ornamentation that makes city tailors uncomfortable.
Beastkin Tribal Furs.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Furs and Hides; in play, describe what is worn now.

Blessing of the Echo.name: Blessing of the Echo
Blessing of the Echo.description: You learn by watching. The Blessing of the Echo lets you copy any physical technique, combat style, or skill after seeing it once; your body reproduces the movements perfectly, as if you'd trained for years. At higher levels you can copy magical techniques, splice copied skills into hybrids nobody else can pull off, and even echo Blessing abilities for a time. The limitation: copied techniques fade unless you reinforce them through practice, and you can only hold so many at once. The ultimate cheat skill for a protagonist who fights every kind of enemy and has to stay versatile. Your fighting style is everyone's fighting style, and that's terrifying.
Blessing of the Echo.traitNarrativeEffects: You learn physical skills at roughly three times the normal speed and have picked up fighting techniques by watching street performers.

Brawler's Fist Wraps.name: Brawler's Fist Wraps
Brawler's Fist Wraps.description: Hand wraps, a sleeveless shirt or open vest, loose pants, and the confidence of someone who solves problems with their fists. No weapon needed.
Brawler's Fist Wraps.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Training Gi; in play, describe what is worn now.

Cannot Read the Room.name: Cannot Read the Room
Cannot Read the Room.description: Social atmosphere can be obvious to everyone else and still somehow miss you cleanly.
Cannot Read the Room.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist misses atmosphere everyone else feels. Speaks into solemn silences, laughs at funerals, asks the unaskable question. Use for comedy, and the rare moment their bluntness cuts through what tact couldn't.

Dangerous Attraction.name: Dangerous Attraction
Dangerous Attraction.description: You are drawn to intensity, risk, and the sort of people whose warning label only makes them more interesting. Safety is admirable; mystery is harder to resist.
Dangerous Attraction.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use temptation, danger, and a willingness to lean toward complicated people.

Deep Ocean Blue Skin.name: Deep Ocean Blue Skin
Deep Ocean Blue Skin.description: A rich deep-blue skin tone like twilight water over hidden ruins. Elegant, mysterious, and dramatic in moonlight, especially for merfolk, sea spirits, abyssal sorcerers, or characters tied to tides and secrets.
Deep Ocean Blue Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Deep Ocean Blue Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: you look most natural near water, rain, mist, or moonlight.

Emerald Verdant Skin.name: Emerald Verdant Skin
Emerald Verdant Skin.description: A jewel-toned emerald complexion with lush fantasy presence. It suits ancient jungle bloodlines, serpentkin nobility, poison mages, and beautiful monsters whose elegance comes with warning signs.
Emerald Verdant Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Emerald Verdant Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: your skin looks regal near vines, gold, black silk, or temple stone.

Floating Sky Islands.name: Floating Sky Islands
Floating Sky Islands.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A breathtaking vista of floating islands suspended in an endless sky, waterfalls cascading off island edges into clouds below, ancient ruins and green forests growing on the floating landmasses, bridges of light or chain connecting them, and the character standing at the edge of one island looking out at the impossible geography.
Floating Sky Islands.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Gentle Sleeping Face.name: Gentle Sleeping Face
Gentle Sleeping Face.description: Half-lidded eyes, a permanently relaxed expression, and the serene, drowsy quality of someone who always looks like they just woke up or are about to fall asleep. Devastatingly peaceful.
Gentle Sleeping Face.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls facial expression default only. Render a relaxed half-lidded drowsy expression as the resting face.

Glowing Facial Runes.name: Glowing Facial Runes
Glowing Facial Runes.description: Faintly luminous rune patterns traced along the cheeks, temples, or jawline, visible magical circuitry etched into the skin. They glow brighter when magic is active.
Glowing Facial Runes.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render faint glowing rune patterns on the face.

Looks Like a Villain.name: Looks Like a Villain
Looks Like a Villain.description: You have the sort of poise, beauty, and ominous visual language that makes people think you are either the antagonist or the secret route. The truth rarely helps.
