Looks Like a Villain.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs assume ulterior motives, dangerous charm, or deliciously bad ideas.

Misty Marsh Crossing.name: Misty Marsh Crossing
Misty Marsh Crossing.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A wooden path crossing a misty marsh with reeds, shallow water, pale mist bands, and scattered lanterns. The atmosphere is eerie but beautiful. {{portraitprompt}}: misty marsh crossing, reeds, shallow water, pale mist bands, lanterns, fantasy swamp background behind character
Misty Marsh Crossing.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Passive Regeneration.name: Passive Regeneration
Passive Regeneration.description:
You heal constantly. Not fast enough to regrow limbs mid-combat, but fast enough that cuts close in minutes, bruises fade in hours, and injuries that would sideline a normal adventurer for weeks have you back on your feet in days. Passive Regeneration never switches off, sleeping, waking, fighting, eating. Minor injuries heal almost as fast as they land. Major injuries heal at a rate that makes healers recheck their math. At higher levels the regeneration reaches stamina, mana, and even mild status effects. You're the protagonist who walks out of a dungeon looking better than when you walked in.

How it works: you regain about 3% of your health every turn, in or out of a fight.
Passive Regeneration.traitNarrativeEffects: You've confused more than one healer by arriving at the infirmary with injuries that are already half-healed by the time they examine you.

Pathological Honesty.name: Pathological Honesty
Pathological Honesty.description: Lying feels awful, half-truths feel suspicious, and your mouth sometimes picks honesty at the least convenient possible moment.
Pathological Honesty.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist's mouth chooses truth at the least convenient moments, undermining bluffs, answering rhetorical questions, confirming what tact would bury. Use for diplomatic disasters, comedy, ruined surprise plans, and the deep trust that radical honesty slowly builds.

Platinum Blonde Hair.name: Platinum Blonde Hair
Platinum Blonde Hair.description: Platinum Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Platinum Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Platinum Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #F5F0E8. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Porcelain Complexion.name: Porcelain Complexion
Porcelain Complexion.description: Flawless, luminous skin with a porcelain quality, pale, smooth, and almost too perfect. The kind of complexion that makes healers suspicious and poets inspired.
Porcelain Complexion.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls skin quality only. Render smooth, luminous, porcelain-quality skin.

Protagonist Presence.name: Protagonist Presence
Protagonist Presence.description: You have main-character energy and it's not subtle. Protagonist Presence means when you walk into a room, attention shifts. Conversations pause. People look. This runs deeper than good looks: a supernatural quality that makes you feel significant, like the universe arranged the lighting to hit you correctly. Important people notice you. Destiny seems to gravitate toward you. Strangers feel compelled to talk to you, help you, challenge you, or fall into step beside you. This is the meta-cheat that explains why an isekai protagonist keeps accidentally meeting every important person in the kingdom.
Protagonist Presence.traitNarrativeEffects: You cannot enter a room quietly. Even when you try to be invisible, someone important notices you. You've been seated next to three different royals 'by coincidence.'

Refined Noble Goatee.name: Refined Noble Goatee
Refined Noble Goatee.description: A neat, deliberate goatee with courtly polish and a hint of dangerous intelligence. It suits noble strategists, charming villains, demon diplomats, professors, and anyone who treats social scenes like duels.
Refined Noble Goatee.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL HAIR LOCK: Render a refined, well-groomed goatee. Keep it elegant and precise; do not add messy stubble or a full beard unless selected elsewhere.

Ribbon-Wrapped Braid.name: Ribbon-Wrapped Braid
Ribbon-Wrapped Braid.description: A long braid interwoven with a visible ribbon that spirals down its length, silk, enchanted thread, or a lover's gift braided permanently into place. The ribbon color and material tell a story. This style is common among shrine maidens, elven nobility, and characters whose braids are love letters wearing hair-shaped disguises.
Ribbon-Wrapped Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: The ribbon in your braid was given to you by someone important. You have never explained who, and people have stopped asking because the look on your face when they do is devastating.

Ritual Scarification.name: Ritual Scarification
Ritual Scarification.description: Raised, deliberate scar patterns on the face, not from injury but from ceremony. Precise geometric or organic designs carved into the skin as marks of passage, devotion, or power.
Ritual Scarification.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial appearance only. Render deliberate ritual scar patterns on the face.

Royal Garden Terrace.name: Royal Garden Terrace
Royal Garden Terrace.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A refined palace garden terrace overlooking elegant white stone architecture, fountains, trimmed hedges, roses, and noble banners. The setting feels graceful, wealthy, and courtly. {{portraitprompt}}: royal garden terrace, palace backdrop, roses, fountain, noble banners, elegant fantasy court background behind character
Royal Garden Terrace.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Samurai Warrior Tail.name: Samurai Warrior Tail
Samurai Warrior Tail.description: A tight warrior tail at the back of the head, functional, disciplined, and the kind of style that means you've been in enough fights to know loose hair is a liability.
Samurai Warrior Tail.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair pulled into a tight warrior tail at the back of the head.

Shoulder-Length Hair.name: Shoulder-Length Hair
Shoulder-Length Hair.description: Shoulder-length hair, long enough to tie back, short enough to manage. The kind of length that works in a boardroom or a dungeon without changing anything.
Shoulder-Length Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render hair reaching to the shoulders.

Soft Spot for Strays.name: Soft Spot for Strays
Soft Spot for Strays.description: Lonely animals, lost spirits and people with nowhere to go keep following you home, because you keep letting them.
Soft Spot for Strays.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Lonely creatures and lonely people attach themselves to the protagonist, who cannot turn them away. The party gains members nobody voted for. Use for found family, strained supplies, and the occasional stray who was a very bad idea.

The Chaotic Wildcard.name: The Chaotic Wildcard
The Chaotic Wildcard.description: You are difficult to predict even for people who know you well. Plans survive around you only if they are flexible, because your instincts are dramatic, opportunistic, and occasionally genius.
The Chaotic Wildcard.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep their decisions unpredictable, dramatic, and occasionally brilliant in ways no planner can model.

The Kuudere Ice Wall.name: The Kuudere Ice Wall
The Kuudere Ice Wall.description: You are composed, emotionally restrained, and initially difficult to read, but warmth does exist under the frost if someone earns it. Every small crack in the wall matters.
The Kuudere Ice Wall.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep them emotionally restrained and hard to read at first, with warmth showing only through small cracks.

The Ruthless Climber.name: The Ruthless Climber
The Ruthless Climber.description: You are ambitious enough to scare people who mistake your smile for softness. Progress matters to you, and you do not like being told where your ceiling is.
The Ruthless Climber.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write ambition with teeth and someone determined to rise no matter who doubts them.

Villainess Rose Eyes.name: Villainess Rose Eyes
Villainess Rose Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: elegant rose-colored eyes with noble warmth and controlled danger. Ideal for villainess routes, noble heirs, social duelists, and characters who smile before making the room nervous.
Villainess Rose Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Villainess Rose Eyes. Exact color reference: rose #B65C7A with soft wine shadows. Apply as iris color; avoid neon pink or muddy red.

War-Torn Battlefield.name: War-Torn Battlefield
War-Torn Battlefield.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: The aftermath of a massive battle, scorched earth, embedded weapons, tattered banners, craters from magic, and the heavy silence that follows violence. The sky is overcast with the remnants of combat magic. Despite the devastation, wildflowers have begun to push through the scarred ground.
War-Torn Battlefield.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Accelerated Evolution.name: Accelerated Evolution
Accelerated Evolution.description:
Your abilities evolve under pressure instead of through training. Accelerated Evolution means every desperate fight, every emotional peak, every moment you reach past your limits has a chance of triggering a permanent upgrade to an existing skill or Blessing. Near-death experiences work especially well. So you grow strongest when things are worst, which the universe has apparently read as an invitation to drop you into terrible situations as often as it can.

How it works: once every 40 turns, when your health falls to a quarter or less, one of your abilities evolves on the spot into its next stage.
Accelerated Evolution.traitNarrativeEffects: Your companions have started classifying your injuries by whether they resulted in a power-up. 'Was it a growth near-death or a regular near-death?'

Adventurer Guild Hall.name: Adventurer Guild Hall
Adventurer Guild Hall.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: The lively interior of a fantasy adventurer guild. Wooden counters, ranked badges, quest boards, warm hanging lanterns, and bustling adventurers create a social hub full of opportunity. {{portraitprompt}}: adventurer guild hall interior, quest board, wooden counters, fantasy guild, warm lantern light, anime isekai guild atmosphere, portrait background behind character
Adventurer Guild Hall.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Approachable and Warm.name: Approachable and Warm
Approachable and Warm.description: You immediately read as kind, open, and easy to talk to. Strangers relax around you faster than they intended to.
Approachable and Warm.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs treat you as safe company, making casual trust and easy conversation more common.

Aristocratic Features.name: Aristocratic Features
Aristocratic Features.description: Refined, delicate bone structure, a narrow nose, elegant brows, a chin that suggests generations of careful breeding or divine favoritism. The kind of face that belongs on a portrait in a manor hallway.
Aristocratic Features.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial bone structure only. Render refined elegant aristocratic features.

Champagne Blonde Hair.name: Champagne Blonde Hair
Champagne Blonde Hair.description: Champagne Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Champagne Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Champagne Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #F7E7CE. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Clockwork Time Irises.name: Clockwork Time Irises
Clockwork Time Irises.description: Tiny clockwork rings, gear-like iris marks, or faint timepiece motifs within the eyes. Perfect for time magic, prophecy, chronomancers, and characters who look like they know what happens three seconds from now.
Clockwork Time Irises.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN LOCK: Add subtle clockwork/time-ring iris detail. Keep it delicate and readable inside the selected eye color; do not turn the whole face mechanical.

Crafting Intuition EX.name: Crafting Intuition EX
Crafting Intuition EX.description: You instinctively know how to combine materials, improve recipes, and create items that shouldn't be possible at your skill level. Crafting Intuition EX means you look at a pile of dungeon drops and see a legendary weapon. You taste a failed potion and know exactly what to add. You hold a broken relic and understand how to repair it. It covers twenty crafts: alchemy, enchanting, blacksmithing, armorsmithing, artifice, cooking, battle cooking, gift crafting, jewelcrafting, leatherworking, rune carving, scribal arts, tailoring, woodworking, brewing, inscription, perfumery, poison craft, engineering and thread arts. You don't just follow recipes, you invent them. Master crafters who've spent decades perfecting their art find this both inspiring and deeply annoying.
Crafting Intuition EX.traitNarrativeEffects: You've improved centuries-old recipes on your first attempt and been banned from two cooking competitions for 'suspicious competence.'

Crystal Cavern Depths.name: Crystal Cavern Depths
Crystal Cavern Depths.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A luminous cavern filled with giant mana crystals, reflective stone, and soft prismatic light. The cave feels magical, expensive, and mysterious. {{portraitprompt}}: crystal cavern background, glowing mana crystals, reflective stone, prismatic light, fantasy cave portrait background behind character
Crystal Cavern Depths.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Enchanted Mirror Lake.name: Enchanted Mirror Lake
Enchanted Mirror Lake.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A perfectly still mountain lake that reflects the sky so flawlessly it's impossible to tell where water ends and sky begins. Surrounded by ancient trees and wildflowers, with fireflies beginning to emerge in the twilight. The silence is sacred. The beauty is heartbreaking.
Enchanted Mirror Lake.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Forge-Scorched Copper.name: Forge-Scorched Copper
Forge-Scorched Copper.description: Skin with an unnatural metallic copper tint, heat-treated by volcanic exposure, Forge Cult rituals, or elemental bloodline. Warm to the touch.
Forge-Scorched Copper.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use the selected skin tone as the definitive skin color reference in portrait generation. Your skin is always warm and people grab your hands in cold weather.

Long Warrior Ponytail.name: Long Warrior Ponytail
Long Warrior Ponytail.description: Long hair gathered into a low ponytail that sways with every movement, the look of wandering swordsmen, seasoned warriors, and anyone whose beauty is sharpened by danger rather than diminished by it. There's a reason this style appears in every legendary swordsman portrait. It's practical, striking, and catches the light during dramatic moments with suspicious perfection.
Long Warrior Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: Your ponytail catches the wind during dramatic moments. Enemies have been distracted mid-swing. You pretend not to notice.

Love Is a Battlefield.name: Love Is a Battlefield
Love Is a Battlefield.description: You treat romance as something to contest, defend, win, survive, or push through with force of personality. Vulnerability is real, but it tends to arrive dressed like a challenge.
Love Is a Battlefield.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use pride, determination, and emotionally combative chemistry.

Mysterious Loner Aura.name: Mysterious Loner Aura
Mysterious Loner Aura.description: You look like someone with a sad past and nobody to share it with. People soften around you, guess at old tragedies, and some decide you need company whether you asked or not.
Mysterious Loner Aura.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs assume a tragic backstory and solitude: gentle curiosity, sympathy, and the occasional person determined to keep you company.

Ojou-Sama Drill Curls.name: Ojou-Sama Drill Curls
Ojou-Sama Drill Curls.description: Elegant corkscrew drill curls framing the face, aristocratic, dramatic, and the kind of hairstyle that says you have servants to maintain it and the personality to justify it.
Ojou-Sama Drill Curls.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render elegant corkscrew drill curls framing the face.

Overgrown Throne Room.name: Overgrown Throne Room
Overgrown Throne Room.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: An ancient throne room reclaimed by nature, vines climbing marble pillars, flowers growing through cracked tiles, trees pushing through the ceiling, sunlight streaming through holes in the roof, and a throne half-buried in moss and roses. The beautiful decay of a fallen kingdom becoming something new.
Overgrown Throne Room.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Saint's Miracle Robes.name: Saint's Miracle Robes
Saint's Miracle Robes.description: Pristine white and gold vestments that glow with faint divine radiance, layered robes with elaborate religious embroidery, a sacred stole, ceremonial jewelry, and sandals that somehow never get dirty. The outfit of someone the Church considers a living miracle and dresses accordingly. Comes with the weight of everyone's expectations.
Saint's Miracle Robes.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Holy Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Shrine Gate Courtyard.name: Shrine Gate Courtyard
Shrine Gate Courtyard.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A sacred courtyard with a painted shrine gate, stone lanterns, prayer ribbons, and soft spiritual light. The scene feels serene, reverent, and quietly magical. {{portraitprompt}}: shrine gate courtyard, stone lanterns, prayer ribbons, spiritual fantasy setting, anime portrait background behind character
Shrine Gate Courtyard.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Sky-Touched Pale Blue.name: Sky-Touched Pale Blue
Sky-Touched Pale Blue.description: A soft pale-blue complexion with airy, celestial undertones. It feels gentle rather than monstrous, ideal for frost-touched, cloud-blessed, fairy-blooded, or spirit-adjacent characters with a delicate anime glow.
Sky-Touched Pale Blue.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Sky-Touched Pale Blue as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: silver, white, and pale-gold clothing makes you look unfairly angelic.

Snowy Mountain Shrine.name: Snowy Mountain Shrine
Snowy Mountain Shrine.description: A snowy mountain shrine, torii gates dusted with snow, incense smoke in cold air, and the kind of silence that feels sacred.
Snowy Mountain Shrine.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render a snowy mountain shrine with torii gates.

Soft Contoured Cheeks.name: Soft Contoured Cheeks
Soft Contoured Cheeks.description: Softly contoured cheeks with a natural flush or subtle sculpting, healthy, vibrant, and the kind of detail that makes people think you just came from somewhere wonderful.
Soft Contoured Cheeks.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls cheek appearance only. Render softly contoured, flushed cheeks.

Swept-Back Anime Hair.name: Swept-Back Anime Hair
Swept-Back Anime Hair.description: Dramatic hair swept back from the face with volume and intent, the unmistakable look of the cool rival, the confident ace, or the person who just walked into the room and already owns it. Every strand is perfectly chaotic, as if the wind exists solely to make this hair look good.
Swept-Back Anime Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Even standing still, your hair looks like it's caught in a dramatic wind. People instinctively step aside when you walk through doorways.

The Crybaby Berserker.name: The Crybaby Berserker
The Crybaby Berserker.description: Your heart is loud, your emotions are immediate, and under enough stress you become a wildly dangerous storm of sincerity and violence. Crying and winning are not mutually exclusive.
The Crybaby Berserker.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Mix loud feelings, visible tears, and explosive fighting spirit without embarrassment.

The Dense Protagonist.name: The Dense Protagonist
The Dense Protagonist.description: Your head is full of the goal in front of you: the next fight, the next floor, lunch. Subtext of every kind slides past, flirting included, and it lands much later, usually at an inconvenient moment.
The Dense Protagonist.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Single-minded and earnest; subtext, hints and flirting slide past until they land much later.

The Former Final Boss.name: The Former Final Boss
The Former Final Boss.description: You carry intimidating aura, overwhelming competence, or a suspicious amount of villain-coded confidence, whether or not you are still trying to be terrifying. People often assume you came from the back half of someone else's plot.
The Former Final Boss.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write intimidating charisma, suspicious competence, and someone who feels like they came from the final act of another story.

The Gentleman or Lady.name: The Gentleman or Lady
The Gentleman or Lady.description: You approach affection with courtesy, polish, and visible intention. Even your flirtation has posture.
The Gentleman or Lady.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use formal charm, respectful gestures, and romantic old-world elegance.

The Harem Protagonist.name: The Harem Protagonist
The Harem Protagonist.description: Hearts gather around you and you know it. You are warm to every one of them, a little greedy, and fully willing to make it work. The hard part is the jealousy, the scheduling and everyone's feelings at once.
The Harem Protagonist.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: The protagonist welcomes several bonds knowingly and juggles them in the open. Play the magnetism, rivalry among admirers and the logistics of too many hearts.

The Hopeless Romantic.name: The Hopeless Romantic
The Hopeless Romantic.description: You believe in yearning, chemistry, and emotionally meaningful nonsense with all your heart. Love is not just something you want, it is something you earnestly believe is worth being ridiculous for.
The Hopeless Romantic.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Lean into yearning, emotional sincerity, and a wholehearted belief in love and dramatic connection.

The Obsessive Scholar.name: The Obsessive Scholar
The Obsessive Scholar.description: You are consumed by curiosity, research, and the need to understand things fully, sometimes at the expense of normal sleep, ordinary social behavior, or self-preservation. Knowledge is rarely enough once you smell the next answer.
The Obsessive Scholar.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Let curiosity consume them; research and understanding should visibly matter more than normal social limits.

The Shameless Enjoyer.name: The Shameless Enjoyer
The Shameless Enjoyer.description: You say what you enjoy out loud: the stew is perfect, that coat suits them, this bath is the best part of your week. No shame and no performance, just honest delight, and it is contagious.
The Shameless Enjoyer.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Openly and honestly delighted by small pleasures, food, beauty and affection, without apology or excess.

The Wholesome Airhead.name: The Wholesome Airhead
The Wholesome Airhead.description: You are sweet, sincere, and occasionally running on the sort of logic that worries your friends and charms everyone else. Your innocence is genuine, but it should not be confused with uselessness.
The Wholesome Airhead.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep them sweet, sincere, and occasionally adorably misguided without making them useless.

Twilight Market Alley.name: Twilight Market Alley
Twilight Market Alley.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A narrow evening market street in the demon quarter, lit by amber lanterns and violet dusk. Rich fabrics, hanging charms, and elegant stalls create dark fantasy charm without becoming grim. {{portraitprompt}}: twilight market alley, lanterns, dark fantasy bazaar, violet dusk, elegant stalls, anime portrait background behind character
Twilight Market Alley.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Vampire Manor Balcony.name: Vampire Manor Balcony
Vampire Manor Balcony.description: A vampire manor balcony, gothic stonework, moonlit gardens below, and the kind of view that makes immortality seem almost worth it.
Vampire Manor Balcony.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render a gothic vampire manor balcony at night.

Academy Festival Stall.name: Academy Festival Stall
Academy Festival Stall.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A colorful magical academy festival stall with banners, lanterns, food trays, charm prizes, student decorations, and cheerful crowd energy behind the character. The scene should feel like a romcom festival episode where contests, confessions, and accidental chaos are all equally likely. {{portraitprompt}}: magical academy festival stall, colorful banners, lanterns, food booth, cheerful anime crowd, fantasy school festival portrait background behind character
Academy Festival Stall.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: This trait controls portrait background only. Use a festive academy booth/stall atmosphere with magical school details.

Academy Library Stacks.name: Academy Library Stacks
Academy Library Stacks.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: Towering library shelves, floating lamps, stacked tomes, and magical study nooks inside a prestigious academy. The mood is refined, intellectual, and quietly powerful. {{portraitprompt}}: magical academy library, towering bookshelves, floating lamps, study nook, anime portrait background behind character
Academy Library Stacks.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Bustling Market Bazaar.name: Bustling Market Bazaar
Bustling Market Bazaar.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A colorful fantasy bazaar packed with food stalls, potion sellers, textiles, jewelry, and cheerful crowd energy. The atmosphere is lively, tempting, and full of sensory detail. {{portraitprompt}}: bustling fantasy market, colorful bazaar, potion stall, textiles, food vendors, lively anime portrait background behind character
Bustling Market Bazaar.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Chaotic Harem Diplomat.name: Chaotic Harem Diplomat
Chaotic Harem Diplomat.description: You are less the center of a love polygon and more the exhausted diplomat trying to keep one from igniting. You manage tensions, bruised egos, and emotional logistics with alarming competence.
Chaotic Harem Diplomat.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use mediation, emotional balancing, and social agility under romantic pressure.

Charcoal Obsidian Skin.name: Charcoal Obsidian Skin
Charcoal Obsidian Skin.description: A deep charcoal-black fantasy complexion with obsidian undertones, dramatic and polished rather than muddy. Perfect for shadowkin, volcanic beings, abyssal nobles, or characters who look born from night and glass.
Charcoal Obsidian Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Charcoal Obsidian Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: rim lighting turns your silhouette into instant boss-intro material.

Court Magician's Dress.name: Court Magician's Dress
Court Magician's Dress.description: A tailored dress of deep blue and silver with arcane constellation patterns that slowly rotate across the fabric, scholarly, elegant, and slightly intimidating. The kind of outfit that says you can recite seven schools of magic and look phenomenal doing it.
Court Magician's Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Demon Lord Violet Eyes.name: Demon Lord Violet Eyes
Demon Lord Violet Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: deep violet eyes with magical authority, courtly menace, and the feeling that a contract may already be forming. They should be elegant rather than monstrous.
Demon Lord Violet Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Demon Lord Violet Eyes. Exact color reference: royal violet #7A35C9 with dark amethyst shadow #30104F. Keep irises readable and refined.

Demon Lord Violet Hair.name: Demon Lord Violet Hair
Demon Lord Violet Hair.description: Portrait appearance detail: deep violet hair with dark magical richness, elegant enough for nobility and ominous enough for demon courts, pact mages, and secret villain routes.
Demon Lord Violet Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Demon Lord Violet Hair. Exact color reference: deep violet #4B257A with darker shadow violet #251133. Apply this as the selected hair color; keep it rich and readable, not muddy black.

Demon Princess Balcony.name: Demon Princess Balcony
Demon Princess Balcony.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A moonlit balcony in the demon court, with black marble railings, red lanterns, distant spires, velvet curtains, and a dangerous romantic view over the Twilight Dominion. The scene should feel elegant, political, and charged with contract-route tension without becoming explicit. {{portraitprompt}}: demon palace balcony, moonlit gothic fantasy court, black marble, red lanterns, distant spires, elegant anime portrait background behind character
Demon Princess Balcony.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: This trait controls portrait background only. Use a moonlit demon court balcony with elegance, danger, and political romance atmosphere.

Flowing and Voluminous.name: Flowing and Voluminous
Flowing and Voluminous.description: Dramatic, flowing hair that moves like it has its own wind machine, the anime protagonist long style. Gravity is a suggestion.
Flowing and Voluminous.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair catches the breeze even indoors and people notice.

Forest Green Dark Hair.name: Forest Green Dark Hair
Forest Green Dark Hair.description: Forest Green Dark Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Forest Green Dark Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Forest Green Dark Hair. Exact hex color reference: #1A4020. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Married to the Mission.name: Married to the Mission
Married to the Mission.description: Duty, goals, or responsibilities consistently take priority over romance, even when your heart would prefer otherwise. Feelings are not absent, just forced to queue politely.
Married to the Mission.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use discipline, sacrifice, and emotional postponement.

Moonlit Bathhouse Robe.name: Moonlit Bathhouse Robe
Moonlit Bathhouse Robe.description: A moonlit bathhouse robe, soft, white, and tied with a simple sash. The kind of outfit that suggests you're either incredibly relaxed or about to be incredibly surprised.
Moonlit Bathhouse Robe.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Kimono and Sash; in play, describe what is worn now.

Mutual Pining Disaster.name: Mutual Pining Disaster
Mutual Pining Disaster.description: You are capable of sustaining absurdly obvious unresolved feelings for an unreasonable amount of time. If emotional tension were a resource, you would be rich.
Mutual Pining Disaster.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use yearning, hesitation, and painfully obvious chemistry.

Pearlescent White Skin.name: Pearlescent White Skin
Pearlescent White Skin.description: A luminous pearl-white fantasy complexion with subtle iridescent undertones. It suits celestial, spirit, moon-touched, snow-born, or artificial beings with an elegant, almost sacred visual presence.
Pearlescent White Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Pearlescent White Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: colored light reflects softly across your skin like mother-of-pearl.

Saintess Curtain Bangs.name: Saintess Curtain Bangs
Saintess Curtain Bangs.description: Soft curtain bangs framing the face with gentle holy-romance energy. The hairstyle should feel approachable, luminous, and emotionally warm, especially in healing, confession, shrine, and quiet aftermath scenes.
Saintess Curtain Bangs.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR STYLE LOCK: Render soft curtain bangs framing the face with smooth, clean strands. Preserve eye visibility and facial expression; this controls hairstyle only.

Saintess Platinum Hair.name: Saintess Platinum Hair
Saintess Platinum Hair.description: Portrait appearance detail: soft platinum hair with luminous holy highlights, clean enough for saintess routes, celestial bloodlines, and shrine scenes without becoming plain white.
Saintess Platinum Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Saintess Platinum Hair. Exact color reference: platinum #F1EEE4 with pearl highlights #FFF8EC. Apply this as the selected hair color; preserve soft warmth and avoid gray drift.

Samurai's Ornate Armor.name: Samurai's Ornate Armor
Samurai's Ornate Armor.description: Lacquered lamellar plates over silk, a crested kabuto helmet, and a katana at the hip. Discipline and deadly elegance in equal measure.
Samurai's Ornate Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Lacquered Lamellar Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Severe Motion Sickness.name: Severe Motion Sickness
Severe Motion Sickness.description: Carriages, boats, flying mounts, elevators, spinning attacks, and anything that moves you without your legs being involved turns you into a green-faced disaster. You are a powerful adventurer who can fight dragons and charm nobles but cannot sit in the back of a wagon without quietly praying for death. The most powerful Reborn in Luxcellia, brought low by a bumpy road.
Severe Motion Sickness.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist gets violently motion sick in carriages, boats, and on mounts. Travel scenes should include this struggle. This is a comedic weakness that humanizes an otherwise powerful character.

Shadow Assassin's Garb.name: Shadow Assassin's Garb
Shadow Assassin's Garb.description: Skin-tight dark weave, a half-mask or hood, blades hidden in every seam, and a cloak that seems to drink the light. You were never here.
Shadow Assassin's Garb.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Shadow Garb; in play, describe what is worn now.

Shrine Maiden Straight.name: Shrine Maiden Straight
Shrine Maiden Straight.description: Straight, pristine shrine maiden hair, jet black, perfectly smooth, and cut with precision. The kind of hair that looks like it was blessed by the spirits themselves.
Shrine Maiden Straight.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls hair style only. Render perfectly straight, pristine, long dark hair with a shrine maiden aesthetic.

Starless Midnight Skin.name: Starless Midnight Skin
Starless Midnight Skin.description: A very dark blue-black fantasy complexion like a night sky before the stars appear. It feels celestial, elegant, and mysterious, perfect for void-touched, star mages, dream walkers, and moonlit assassins.
Starless Midnight Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Starless Midnight Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: tiny light sources along your silhouette look like stars trying to appear.

Strawberry Blonde Hair.name: Strawberry Blonde Hair
Strawberry Blonde Hair.description: Strawberry Blonde Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Strawberry Blonde Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Strawberry Blonde Hair. Exact hex color reference: #CC7755. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Suspiciously Main Cast.name: Suspiciously Main Cast
Suspiciously Main Cast.description: People assume you are involved. Crimes, prophecies, missing heirs, sudden quests: if something is happening, someone is sure you are part of it, and they are often right.
Suspiciously Main Cast.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs pull the protagonist into events as if they were already part of them: suspect, chosen one, or the person to ask.

The Competitive Maniac.name: The Competitive Maniac
The Competitive Maniac.description: Everything becomes a contest, whether anyone agreed to it or not: who eats faster, who reaches the inn first, who carries more. You are driven, loud, and having a wonderful time.
The Competitive Maniac.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Turn everything into a challenge, contest, or one-upmanship opportunity.

The Responsible Menace.name: The Responsible Menace
The Responsible Menace.description: You look like the one adult in the room until people realize your competence only makes your bad ideas more effective. You keep everyone alive and somehow still encourage disaster.
The Responsible Menace.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Balance competence and maturity with the fact that their bad ideas are still very effective.

The Scheming Puppeteer.name: The Scheming Puppeteer
The Scheming Puppeteer.description: You prefer influence, manipulation, and subtle positioning over straightforward confrontation. A conversation, a rumor, and a well-placed suggestion can be more useful to you than a sword swing.
The Scheming Puppeteer.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Favor indirect influence, subtle manipulation, and a habit of thinking in setups and leverage.

The Theatrical Showoff.name: The Theatrical Showoff
The Theatrical Showoff.description: You believe style matters, entrances matter, and doing something dramatically is often simply better than doing it quietly. Attention is a tool, and you use it beautifully.
The Theatrical Showoff.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Give them flair, dramatic instincts, and a desire to make every moment land with style.

The Villainess Enjoyer.name: The Villainess Enjoyer
The Villainess Enjoyer.description: You are sincerely drawn to elegance, sharp tongues, proud women, doomed court drama, and the entire glorious ecosystem of villainess energy. Whether as admiration or aspiration, the aesthetic has you completely.
The Villainess Enjoyer.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Lean into admiration for villainess elegance, court drama, and proud, refined, dangerous beauty.

Villainess Noble Smile.name: Villainess Noble Smile
Villainess Noble Smile.description: A composed noble smile that looks polite on the surface and three steps ahead underneath. The lips, cheeks, and eyes should suggest court training, social danger, and the ability to destroy someone's reputation while asking for tea.
Villainess Noble Smile.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL FEATURE LOCK: Render an elegant noble smile with controlled, slightly dangerous composure. Use for expression and facial presence only; do not force villain behavior if the personality says otherwise.

Void-Touched Dark Eyes.name: Void-Touched Dark Eyes
Void-Touched Dark Eyes.description: Portrait appearance detail: eyes so deeply dark they seem to absorb light rather than reflect it, not just black, but a darkness with visible depth, as if looking into the eye reveals layers of shadow moving beneath the surface. Beautiful in a haunting, magnetic way.
Void-Touched Dark Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE COLOR SELECTED: Void-Touched Dark Eyes. Exact color reference: deepest black #0B0B0B with faint dark purple #1A0A2E depth layers visible. Render eyes that look impossibly deep and dark with subtle shadow movement. Keep attractive and magnetic, not hollow.

Wild Untamed Lion Mane.name: Wild Untamed Lion Mane
Wild Untamed Lion Mane.description: A massive, voluminous explosion of hair, thick, wild, untamed, and gloriously chaotic. It frames the face like a lion's mane and refuses to be contained by any clip, tie, or enchantment. This is the hair of someone whose power and personality are too big for polite society.
Wild Untamed Lion Mane.traitNarrativeEffects: Hairdressers have tried. Enchanters have tried. A literal wind goddess offered to help once. Your hair remains unconquered and magnificent.

Anime Hero Messy Layers.name: Anime Hero Messy Layers
Anime Hero Messy Layers.description: Messy layered hair with deliberate main-character shape: tousled enough to look effortless, structured enough to silhouette well in a portrait. It should feel like the character woke up in another world and somehow still has protagonist hair.
Anime Hero Messy Layers.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR STYLE LOCK: Render clean messy layered anime hair with strong silhouette and readable bangs. Avoid chaotic spaghetti strands or helmet hair; this controls hairstyle only.

Blessing of the Undying.name: Blessing of the Undying
Blessing of the Undying.description: You refuse to die. The Blessing of the Undying grants supernatural regeneration, wounds close in minutes, broken bones set in hours, and injuries that should be fatal merely inconvenience you. At higher levels, you can regenerate from damage that would kill any normal person, reattach severed parts, and shrug off status effects that would cripple others. Your ultimate ability is literal, if killed, you revive once with a surge of power proportional to how unfair the death was. The catch is that each revival leaves a mark, a white streak of hair, a changed eye, a scar that doesn't fade, and the cost escalates. Dying is never free, even for the Undying.
Blessing of the Undying.traitNarrativeEffects: You heal from injuries disconcertingly fast and doctors find your vitals 'unusual' in ways they can't articulate.

Blessing-Touched Streak.name: Blessing-Touched Streak
Blessing-Touched Streak.description: One clean, intentional streak of color tied to a blessing, bloodline, cheat skill, or dramatic awakening. It should look like a meaningful supernatural mark rather than random highlights, the kind of detail NPCs notice after a power-up scene.
Blessing-Touched Streak.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR PATTERN LOCK: Apply a single clear streak using the selected secondary color or the character's magic theme. Keep it clean, localized, and readable. Do not turn the entire hairstyle multicolored.

Dungeon Runner Ponytail.name: Dungeon Runner Ponytail
Dungeon Runner Ponytail.description: A practical high ponytail with loose strands, built for sprinting through dungeons, dodging traps, and looking good while pretending this was all planned. It should feel functional, energetic, and adventure-ready.
Dungeon Runner Ponytail.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR STYLE LOCK: Render a high practical ponytail with a few loose action strands. Keep it readable during combat poses; do not turn it into formal noble hair.

Emotionally Unavailable.name: Emotionally Unavailable
Emotionally Unavailable.description: Feelings make you step back. You deflect with a joke, change the subject, or find somewhere else to be. It is old hurt, not high standards, and getting through takes patience more than proof.
Emotionally Unavailable.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use deflection, distance and changed subjects whenever feelings get close; old hurt, not standards, keeps the door shut until patience opens it.

Enchanted Flower Garden.name: Enchanted Flower Garden
Enchanted Flower Garden.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A lush garden of oversized blossoms, drifting petals, and softly glowing flora. The scene feels dreamy, tempting, and distinctly magical. {{portraitprompt}}: enchanted flower garden, glowing flowers, drifting petals, dreamy magical garden, anime portrait background behind character
Enchanted Flower Garden.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Expressive Arched Brows.name: Expressive Arched Brows
Expressive Arched Brows.description: Arched, expressive eyebrows, shaped and defined in a way that makes every reaction theatrical. The kind of brows that can convey skepticism, delight, or devastation without a single word.
Expressive Arched Brows.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls eyebrow shape only. Render arched, well-defined, expressive eyebrows.

Festival Lantern Street.name: Festival Lantern Street
Festival Lantern Street.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A festive evening street strung with lanterns, paper charms, food stalls, and celebratory lights. The setting feels warm, lively, and perfect for romance or slice-of-life moments. {{portraitprompt}}: festival lantern street, evening festival, glowing lanterns, food stalls, romantic anime portrait background behind character
Festival Lantern Street.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Flowing Anime Long Hair.name: Flowing Anime Long Hair
Flowing Anime Long Hair.description: Dramatic, floor-grazing long hair that flows like liquid moonlight, the look of legendary mages, ancient spirits, and figures whose arcane stature seems to grow in direct proportion to their hair length. It moves on its own during emotional moments, catches light during confessions, and implies either centuries of careful growth or a very dedicated hair care routine.
Flowing Anime Long Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair moves on its own during dramatic moments. You've been accused of having wind magic you don't possess.

Gladiator's Arena Armor.name: Gladiator's Arena Armor
Gladiator's Arena Armor.description: Minimalist but flashy, a bronze chest plate, leather straps, one armored arm, and a dramatic helmet crest. Built for spectacle as much as survival.
Gladiator's Arena Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Breastplate and Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Guild Rooftop at Sunset.name: Guild Rooftop at Sunset
Guild Rooftop at Sunset.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A quiet rooftop above the Adventurer's Guild at sunset, with warm orange sky, distant city roofs, fluttering guild banners, and a peaceful view after a long quest. The scene should feel like a reward moment: private conversation, confession possibility, or the calm before the next absurd adventure. {{portraitprompt}}: guild rooftop at sunset, fantasy city skyline, warm orange sky, fluttering banners, quiet anime RPG portrait background behind character
Guild Rooftop at Sunset.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: This trait controls portrait background only. Use a peaceful guild rooftop sunset with city skyline and emotional downtime atmosphere.

Hidden Waterfall Grotto.name: Hidden Waterfall Grotto
Hidden Waterfall Grotto.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A secret grotto behind a waterfall, a cave of smooth stone with a natural pool fed by the falls, dappled light filtering through the water curtain, luminous crystals in the walls, and the constant soothing roar of cascading water. Private, beautiful, and the kind of place people stumble into during anime journey episodes.
Hidden Waterfall Grotto.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Main Character Presence.name: Main Character Presence
Main Character Presence.description: You walk into a room and the narrative focus shifts toward you. People feel, without fully understanding why, that something important is about to happen around you.
Main Character Presence.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs notice you, remember you, and often sense importance before they know anything about you.

Priest's Holy Vestments.name: Priest's Holy Vestments
Priest's Holy Vestments.description: Clean white and gold robes, a stole with sacred embroidery, and a holy symbol prominently displayed. The unmistakable garb of the faithful.
Priest's Holy Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Holy Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Qipao of the Jade Court.name: Qipao of the Jade Court
Qipao of the Jade Court.description: An elegant fitted qipao in jade silk with gold embroidery, hair pins, and slippers made for both grace and combat. Beauty is a blade.
Qipao of the Jade Court.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

The Chuunibyou Edgelord.name: The Chuunibyou Edgelord
The Chuunibyou Edgelord.description: You have awakened the dark power sealed within your left arm. At least, that's what you tell people. Your theatrics are legendary, your poses are rehearsed, and your dramatic monologues could fill a novel. The catch is, in Luxcellia, your chuunibyou delusions are accidentally real. The darkness you pretended to command actually responds. The sealed power you invented as a backstory is actually sealed in your arm. The universe has called your bluff and you're not sure whether to be thrilled or terrified.
The Chuunibyou Edgelord.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Use dramatic fantasy self-mythologizing, embarrassing coolness, and sincere commitment to the bit.

The Guilt-Driven Atoner.name: The Guilt-Driven Atoner
The Guilt-Driven Atoner.description: You carry guilt like a second shadow, for something you did, something you failed to do, or something you survived when others didn't. You atone through action, and no amount of good deeds ever feels like enough.
The Guilt-Driven Atoner.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Let regret motivate them; they are trying to make up for something they still carry heavily.

Tired Under-Eye Circles.name: Tired Under-Eye Circles
Tired Under-Eye Circles.description: Dark circles beneath the eyes, from sleepless nights, excessive mana use, chronic overwork, or the kind of existential exhaustion that comes from being reborn into a world that won't let you rest. Somehow attractive.
Tired Under-Eye Circles.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls under-eye appearance only. Render visible dark circles beneath both eyes.

Too Pretty to Be Normal.name: Too Pretty to Be Normal
Too Pretty to Be Normal.description: Your beauty is so polished, uncanny, or attention-grabbing that people assume there must be a catch. They are often correct.
Too Pretty to Be Normal.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs suspect secrets simply because nobody that pretty is allowed to be uncomplicated.

Transparent Energy Hair.name: Transparent Energy Hair
Transparent Energy Hair.description: Transparent Energy Hair with polished anime shading, clean highlights, and a consistent dominant color read. Use this as the definitive hair color in every portrait.
Transparent Energy Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Transparent Energy Hair. Exact hex color reference: #A8D8FF. Do not approximate or drift from this color value.

Traveler's Road Clothes.name: Traveler's Road Clothes
Traveler's Road Clothes.description: Practical layers for the journey, a cloak, sturdy boots, a scarf, and a pack. The road is long and the outfit doesn't care.
Traveler's Road Clothes.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Traveling Cloak and Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Underwater Temple Ruins.name: Underwater Temple Ruins
Underwater Temple Ruins.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: Submerged ancient temple ruins visible through crystal-clear water, coral growing on marble columns, schools of luminous fish weaving through archways, shafts of surface light piercing the depths, and the haunting beauty of a holy place claimed by the sea.
Underwater Temple Ruins.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Volcanic Forge Interior.name: Volcanic Forge Interior
Volcanic Forge Interior.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A dwarven or artificer forge built into the heart of a volcano, rivers of magma flowing through carved channels, massive anvils, glowing metal, steam, and the orange-red light of liquid fire illuminating everything. The heat is visible in the air. The forge itself seems alive.
Volcanic Forge Interior.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Academy Dormitory Window.name: Academy Dormitory Window
Academy Dormitory Window.description: An academy dormitory window, open curtains, a desk, and the kind of view that makes studying impossible but daydreaming mandatory.
Academy Dormitory Window.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render an academy dormitory window view.

Academy Festival Uniform.name: Academy Festival Uniform
Academy Festival Uniform.description: A festive academy uniform adapted for stalls, performances, tournaments, or cultural festival episodes. It should keep the school identity visible while adding ribbons, sashes, badges, aprons, or event details that make the scene feel cheerful and episode-specific.
Academy Festival Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Academy Uniform; in play, describe what is worn now. Render an academy uniform with festival accents. Keep school/fantasy identity clear; do not replace it with modern streetwear or a stage costume unless selected elsewhere.

Adventurer's Starter Kit.name: Adventurer's Starter Kit
Adventurer's Starter Kit.description: A sturdy leather vest, canvas trousers, a bedroll, and a dagger on the belt. Nothing fancy, just enough to survive the first dungeon.
Adventurer's Starter Kit.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Adventurer's Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Arcane Workshop Interior.name: Arcane Workshop Interior
Arcane Workshop Interior.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: The inside of a magical workshop lined with spellbooks, alchemy glassware, runic circles, and softly glowing crystals. The setting feels scholarly, practical, and magical. {{portraitprompt}}: arcane workshop, spellbooks, runes, glowing crystals, alchemy tools, anime portrait background behind character
Arcane Workshop Interior.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Blessing of the Ironclad.name: Blessing of the Ironclad
Blessing of the Ironclad.description: Your body is a fortress. The Blessing of the Ironclad hardens your skin to resist blows that would shatter bone, lets you shrug off impacts that would kill normal fighters, and makes your physical endurance borderline absurd. At its peak, blades spark against your flesh like striking an anvil. You don't dodge, you don't need to. The Blessing grows stronger the more you choose to protect others, as if the power itself respects the decision to stand between danger and the people behind you.
Blessing of the Ironclad.traitNarrativeEffects: Your skin has a faint metallic sheen in direct sunlight and people instinctively step around you like they would a wall.

Blessing of the Starfall.name: Blessing of the Starfall
Blessing of the Starfall.description: You carry starlight in your veins. The Blessing of the Starfall channels celestial energy, light condensed into projectiles, barriers, and devastating area attacks that rain down like falling stars. Your light magic isn't gentle; it's the blinding, burning fury of stellar fire packed into a form a mortal body can aim. At higher levels you can call down real starfall, a bombardment of pure celestial energy that leaves craters. The Church thinks you're divinely touched. The Academy wants to study the energy signature. The craters speak for themselves.
Blessing of the Starfall.traitNarrativeEffects: You glow faintly in complete darkness and shooting stars seem to appear when you look up at the night sky.

Crystal-Translucent Skin.name: Crystal-Translucent Skin
Crystal-Translucent Skin.description: A semi-translucent crystalline fantasy complexion where light seems to pass through the edges of the face, ears, hands, or shoulders. It should stay beautiful and humanoid, not glassy or uncanny.
Crystal-Translucent Skin.traitNarrativeEffects: SKIN TONE LOCK: Use Crystal-Translucent Skin as the definitive skin color in portraits. Quirk: mana veins and jewelry glow beautifully through the surface.

Dark Knight's Omen Plate.name: Dark Knight's Omen Plate
Dark Knight's Omen Plate.description: Blackened full plate with crimson accents, spiked pauldrons, and a visor carved into a snarling demon. Menacing, dramatic, and absolutely here for it.
Dark Knight's Omen Plate.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Blackened Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Demon Frontier Wasteland.name: Demon Frontier Wasteland
Demon Frontier Wasteland.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A dark but alluring frontier of black rock, strange crimson flora, drifting embers, and distant demon architecture. The scene feels dangerous, stylish, and exotic rather than monstrous. {{portraitprompt}}: demon frontier wasteland, black rock, crimson plants, drifting embers, dark fantasy anime portrait background behind character
Demon Frontier Wasteland.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Demon King's Casual Wear.name: Demon King's Casual Wear
Demon King's Casual Wear.description: A simple t-shirt and jeans worn by someone radiating enough magical pressure to crack stone. The casual look is the flex. You could end the world but it's laundry day.
Demon King's Casual Wear.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Otherworld Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Duelist's Fencing Attire.name: Duelist's Fencing Attire
Duelist's Fencing Attire.description: A fitted jacket with brass buttons, leather gloves, a cravat, and a rapier or saber at the hip. Honor, precision, and impeccable taste.
Duelist's Fencing Attire.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Long Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

Hopeless with Directions.name: Hopeless with Directions
Hopeless with Directions.description: Left, right, north, south, all of it eventually becomes fiction.
Hopeless with Directions.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist gets lost in cities, dungeons, and buildings with one hallway. Companions navigate or suffer; wrong turns discover things nobody meant to find. Use for comedy, accidental encounters, and being late to important moments.

Intimidatingly Beautiful.name: Intimidatingly Beautiful
Intimidatingly Beautiful.description: You are striking enough that some people go awkward and flustered before you even speak. Your looks impress first and comfort later.
Intimidatingly Beautiful.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs react strongly to your beauty, sometimes with fascination and sometimes with nerves.

Moon-Tide Palace Balcony.name: Moon-Tide Palace Balcony
Moon-Tide Palace Balcony.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A beautiful palace balcony overlooking moonlit water and tidal reflections, with pearl-white railings, sea breeze, and noble elegance. The mood is romantic and luxurious. {{portraitprompt}}: moonlit palace balcony, ocean reflections, noble fantasy architecture, romantic sea breeze, anime portrait background behind character
Moon-Tide Palace Balcony.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

No Weapon: Fists Only.name: No Weapon: Fists Only
No Weapon: Fists Only.description:
You walked into a world of sword masters, demon lords, and dungeon bosses carrying nothing but your hands. This is either the most confident decision ever made or the most foolish, and the answer comes down entirely to how hard you hit. Going bare-fisted among enchanted weapons is a statement: you don't need a tool, because you are the tool, and your body is the only weapon you'll ever bother with.

Primary Attribute: Strength
No Weapon: Fists Only.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist fights unarmed. Describe combat with fists, kicks, throws, grapples, martial arts techniques, and the pure audacity of punching things that other people use swords for. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Unarmed Combat.

Onsen Town Casual Yukata.name: Onsen Town Casual Yukata
Onsen Town Casual Yukata.description: A casual onsen yukata in soft cotton, relaxed, comfortable, and the kind of outfit that makes you want to find the nearest hot spring immediately.
Onsen Town Casual Yukata.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Kimono and Sash; in play, describe what is worn now.

Portrait Frame - Cropped.name: Portrait Frame - Cropped
Portrait Frame - Cropped.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Cropped upper-body portrait of [character name], framed from the upper torso to the top of the head with the face, hair, shoulders, chest, upper arms, and upper outfit clearly visible. The image stays inside an upper-body crop with the composition ending above the waist.
Portrait Frame - Cropped.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: Voyage-standard cropped upper-body portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority. Frame from the upper torso or lower chest to above the complete head, showing the full hair silhouette, face, neck, shoulders, upper chest, upper arms when visible, and clear outfit construction. Keep the composition centered with readable eyes and a specific selected background. End the image above the waist; do not force belt, hips, legs, feet, or a full figure into view. This is not a face-only close-up. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Princess-Carry Protector.name: Princess-Carry Protector
Princess-Carry Protector.description: You express care through action, rescue, carrying, shielding, and stepping between danger and the people you care about. Subtle? Not especially. Effective? Usually.
Princess-Carry Protector.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use physical protectiveness, dependable rescue energy, and obvious acts of care.

Royal Ballroom Mid-Dance.name: Royal Ballroom Mid-Dance
Royal Ballroom Mid-Dance.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A grand royal ballroom during a formal ball, crystal chandeliers casting prismatic light, couples dancing in elegant formalwear, musicians on a raised platform, marble floors reflecting candlelight, and the intoxicating atmosphere of music, wine, politics, and barely concealed romantic tension.
Royal Ballroom Mid-Dance.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Royal Ceremonial Regalia.name: Royal Ceremonial Regalia
Royal Ceremonial Regalia.description: A crown or tiara, ermine-trimmed cape, and garments so richly embroidered they're practically armor. The weight of a nation on your shoulders.
Royal Ceremonial Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Court Regalia; in play, describe what is worn now.

Sacred World Tree Canopy.name: Sacred World Tree Canopy
Sacred World Tree Canopy.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: High in the canopy of an impossibly massive world tree, branches as wide as roads, leaves the size of houses, bioluminescent moss, fairy lights, elven platforms and walkways built into the bark, and a view through gaps in the canopy that reveals the world far, far below.
Sacred World Tree Canopy.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

System Window Reflection.name: System Window Reflection
System Window Reflection.description: A faint rectangular or glyph-like reflection in the eyes, as if a system window, status screen, or hidden interface is visible only from the right angle. It should be subtle enough for portraits but clear enough to scream 'isekai protagonist.'
System Window Reflection.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN LOCK: Add a subtle system-window reflection inside the irises or highlights. This is a visual detail only; do not cover the eyes with text, numbers, UI panels, or unreadable symbols.

The Oblivious Harem Lead.name: The Oblivious Harem Lead
The Oblivious Harem Lead.description: People keep circling you with very obvious feelings, and somehow you continue interpreting the entire situation as friendship, teamwork, or a group scheduling issue. You are idealistic, unintentionally magnetic, and an absolute menace to clear communication.
The Oblivious Harem Lead.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Attract multiple strong attachments while misunderstanding the entire emotional situation as friendship or coincidence.

Villainess Ringlet Curls.name: Villainess Ringlet Curls
Villainess Ringlet Curls.description: Elegant ringlet curls with noble volume, formal polish, and otome-game drama. The curls should frame the face and shoulders beautifully, making every turn of the head feel like a court event.
Villainess Ringlet Curls.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR STYLE LOCK: Render polished ringlet curls with noble volume and clean curl shapes. Keep the style elegant and controlled; do not obscure the face or race traits.

Warlock's Pact Vestments.name: Warlock's Pact Vestments
Warlock's Pact Vestments.description: A dramatic pact-caster ensemble with occult detailing, rich dark fabrics, and the sort of dangerous elegance that implies someone signed something they should not have and looked fantastic doing it.
Warlock's Pact Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Occult Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Wizard's Starlight Robes.name: Wizard's Starlight Robes
Wizard's Starlight Robes.description: A refined wizard robe ensemble with layered fantasy fabrics, celestial trim, and luminous magical authority. It should feel wise, beautiful, and distinctly high-fantasy rather than shapeless.
Wizard's Starlight Robes.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Academy Rooftop at Sunset.name: Academy Rooftop at Sunset
Academy Rooftop at Sunset.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: The rooftop of a magical academy at golden hour, the setting sun painting everything in warm amber, the campus visible below with students heading home, a gentle breeze, and the intimate atmosphere of a private conversation above the world. The classic confession scene location.
Academy Rooftop at Sunset.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Airship Deck Above Clouds.name: Airship Deck Above Clouds
Airship Deck Above Clouds.description: The deck of an airship above the clouds, wind, sky, and the kind of view that makes everything below seem small and temporary.
Airship Deck Above Clouds.traitNarrativeEffects: VISUAL TRAIT: This trait controls scene background only. Render an airship deck above clouds.

Angular Fox-Like Features.name: Angular Fox-Like Features
Angular Fox-Like Features.description: Narrow, sharp facial features with high cheekbones, a pointed chin, and slightly upturned eyes, the kind of face that always looks like it knows something you don't.
Angular Fox-Like Features.traitNarrativeEffects: FACE STRUCTURE: This trait controls facial bone structure only. Render sharp angular features with high cheekbones and a pointed chin.

Battle Healer's Vestments.name: Battle Healer's Vestments
Battle Healer's Vestments.description: Practical white-and-gold healer's attire, fitted tunic, reinforced skirt, and enough pockets for emergency supplies. Designed for the battlefield, tailored for the woman who refuses to choose between capability and dignity.
Battle Healer's Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Battle Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Battlemage's Arcane Armor.name: Battlemage's Arcane Armor
Battlemage's Arcane Armor.description: Reinforced leather or light plate inscribed with glowing rune-circuits, a short cape, and gauntlets that crackle with stored spells. Magic and steel as one.
Battlemage's Arcane Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Breastplate and Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Beastkin Village Clearing.name: Beastkin Village Clearing
Beastkin Village Clearing.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A warm woodland clearing with carved totems, lantern strings, wooden homes, and signs of a lively beastkin community. The background feels cozy, communal, and slightly wild. {{portraitprompt}}: beastkin village, woodland clearing, carved totems, lanterns, cozy fantasy settlement, anime portrait background behind character
Beastkin Village Clearing.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Blessing of the Null Zone.name: Blessing of the Null Zone
Blessing of the Null Zone.description: You are the silence in a room full of magic. The Blessing of the Null Zone lets you negate, suppress, and erase magical effects in your vicinity, canceling spells mid-cast, dispelling enchantments with a touch, and creating dead zones where magic simply doesn't work. At higher levels, you can selectively nullify specific types of magic while allowing others, shut down an enemy caster's abilities entirely, and even suppress Blessings temporarily. You are every mage's worst nightmare and every melee fighter's best friend. The Academy finds you 'theoretically impossible.' You find that comment theoretically offensive.
Blessing of the Null Zone.traitNarrativeEffects: Enchanted items occasionally flicker off when you touch them and fortune tellers refuse to read your future.

Dark Magical Knight Armor.name: Dark Magical Knight Armor
Dark Magical Knight Armor.description: A darkly beautiful armor set that blends knightly structure with magical-drama styling. It should feel like the outfit of someone torn between nobility, curse energy, and looking incredible in moonlight.
Dark Magical Knight Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Blackened Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Elemental Affinity Master.name: Elemental Affinity Master
Elemental Affinity Master.description: You aren't aligned with one element. You're the suspiciously overpowered exception every magic instructor trots out as a cautionary tale and every rival mage quietly hates. Twenty arts answer to you: eighteen schools (fire, water, ice, wind, earth, lightning, nature, light, shadow, poison, blood, sound, illusion, space, time, soul, star and void magic), Elemental Magic, the art of braiding them together, and Arcane Magic, the raw craft beneath them all. Charm, dream, rift and dark magic are not elements: each is a path of its own. Your mana pool is enormous, your vitality is unfair, your hybrid spells look like final-boss mechanics, and every specialist eventually has to accept that you picked up their life's work as a side route.
Elemental Affinity Master.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT SKILL RULE: All elements respond to you, but narration should still respect mana cost, scene stakes, and dramatic backlash from overcasting.

Hero Party Breakup Tavern.name: Hero Party Breakup Tavern
Hero Party Breakup Tavern.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A warm but tense adventurer tavern moments after a public party breakup, with a quest board, overturned chair, half-finished drinks, watching adventurers, and firelight catching dust in the air. The background should feel like the start of a revenge/glow-up route: humiliating, cinematic, and full of witnesses who will remember what happens next. {{portraitprompt}}: fantasy adventurer tavern, public hero party breakup, quest board, warm firelight, tense onlookers, anime RPG portrait background behind character
Hero Party Breakup Tavern.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: This trait controls portrait background only. Use a tavern breakup scene with visible guild/tavern details and social tension.

Overprotective to a Fault.name: Overprotective to a Fault
Overprotective to a Fault.description: When you care, you start guarding people harder than they asked for and sometimes harder than they need.
Overprotective to a Fault.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: When the protagonist cares, they guard harder than asked, intercepting risks, hovering in fights, smothering with vigilance. Loved ones push back against being shielded. Use for protective drama, friction with capable companions, and the fear underneath the guarding.

Portrait Frame - Kneeling.name: Portrait Frame - Kneeling
Portrait Frame - Kneeling.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Kneeling portrait of [character name], framed to show the lowered posture, face, shoulders, torso, hands when visible, visible outfit structure, and selected background without cropping away the pose.
Portrait Frame - Kneeling.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: kneeling portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority. Show the character on one knee or both knees with enough body range to make the lowered posture unmistakable. Keep the complete head, face, torso, arms, hands when visible, bent-leg geometry, outfit folds, and ground contact readable. Use only the selected expression and scene. Do not invent a planted weapon, prayer gesture, reaching action, injury, grief, aura, or standing pose. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Portrait Frame - Mid-Leap.name: Portrait Frame - Mid-Leap
Portrait Frame - Mid-Leap.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Mid-leap portrait of [character name], capturing the character suspended in motion with the face, hair, limbs, outfit silhouette, and selected background readable. The pose shows lift and motion without losing character clarity.
Portrait Frame - Mid-Leap.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: mid-leap aerial portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority. Show the complete figure suspended at the peak of a jump, flip, dive, or aerial maneuver with no ground contact. Keep the face, all limbs, selected wings or tail, hair, clothing motion, and body orientation anatomically coherent. The selected background provides height and spatial reference. Do not invent wings, flight magic, weapons, debris, extra limbs, or a grounded standing pose. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Portrait Frame - Mug Shot.name: Portrait Frame - Mug Shot
Portrait Frame - Mug Shot.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Official mug-shot style portrait of [character name], framed in a flat identification-photo composition with the face clearly visible, upper neck and collar included, and a plain institutional background behind the character.
Portrait Frame - Mug Shot.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: official identification-style portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority. Use a straight-on chest-up composition with the head, full hair silhouette, face, neck, shoulders, and upper chest centered against a plain institutional wall. Lighting is flat, even, and readable. The backdrop may contain subtle blank horizontal guide lines but no numbers, labels, writing, signage, cards, or interface elements. Do not turn this into a heroic pose, action angle, glamour layout, waist-up scene, or full-body portrait. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Rugged Adventurer Stubble.name: Rugged Adventurer Stubble
Rugged Adventurer Stubble.description: Short, rough stubble that suggests long roads, tavern jobs, cheap inns, and not enough sleep. It adds rugged charm without becoming a full beard, perfect for seasoned adventurers, tired healers, and reluctant protectors.
Rugged Adventurer Stubble.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL HAIR LOCK: Render short rugged stubble along jaw/chin/upper lip. Keep it neat enough for anime portrait clarity; no full beard unless another trait says so.

Seems Completely Harmless.name: Seems Completely Harmless
Seems Completely Harmless.description: Nobody counts you as a threat. Guards wave you through, plotters talk in front of you, and doors open that would stay shut for anyone who looked dangerous.
Seems Completely Harmless.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs dismiss the protagonist as no threat: they speak freely nearby, ignore them in tense rooms, and let them into places a dangerous person would not get.

The Unapologetic Hedonist.name: The Unapologetic Hedonist
The Unapologetic Hedonist.description: You chase the finer things like a calling: silk sheets, rare vintages, the best room in the inn and a party that runs until dawn. Where the Smooth Operator uses charm as a tool, you use it to drag everyone into a better evening.
The Unapologetic Hedonist.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Pursue luxury and indulgence as a lifestyle, spend freely on it, and pull others into the celebration.

Villainess Rose-Gold Hair.name: Villainess Rose-Gold Hair
Villainess Rose-Gold Hair.description: Portrait appearance detail: polished rose-gold hair with noble warmth, ideal for ballroom scenes, villainess routes, noble heirs, and emotional otome-style CG portraits.
