Villainess Rose-Gold Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: HAIR COLOR SELECTED: Villainess Rose-Gold Hair. Exact color reference: rose gold #DFA6A2 with warm golden highlights #F0C28A. Apply this as the selected hair color; keep it elegant, not neon pink.

Addicted to Combat Thrills.name: Addicted to Combat Thrills
Addicted to Combat Thrills.description: The rush of a good fight is more intoxicating to you than it probably should be.
Addicted to Combat Thrills.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist lights up when a fight starts. Grins at bad odds, lingers when retreat is smart, picks the dangerous route for fun. Companions notice and worry. Use for reckless choices, battle-drunk momentum, and quiet questions about what they're chasing.

Artificer's Tinkerer Apron.name: Artificer's Tinkerer Apron
Artificer's Tinkerer Apron.description: A leather apron over sturdy clothes, a tool belt bristling with instruments, and goggles that never come off. If you can't buy it, build it.
Artificer's Tinkerer Apron.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Adventurer's Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Attracts Misunderstandings.name: Attracts Misunderstandings
Attracts Misunderstandings.description: You have a cursed talent for being seen in the worst context possible.
Attracts Misunderstandings.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Context assembles itself against the protagonist. Innocent scenes look damning, explanations arrive too late, and rumors write themselves. Use for comedy, jealousy sparks, reputation complications, and the running gag that the truth is never believed the first time.

Battle Maid's Combat Apron.name: Battle Maid's Combat Apron
Battle Maid's Combat Apron.description: A combat-ready maid uniform balancing frilled charm with practical battle function. It should feel stylish, playful, and genuinely believable as an outfit worn by someone dangerous.
Battle Maid's Combat Apron.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Servant's Uniform; in play, describe what is worn now.

Blessing of the Beast King.name: Blessing of the Beast King
Blessing of the Beast King.description: Every beast recognizes you as sovereign. The Blessing of the Beast King grants absolute dominion over creatures, monsters hesitate, spirit beasts acknowledge your authority, and tamed companions fight with ferocity that borders on devotion. You can communicate with animals intuitively, command lesser beasts with a glance, and at higher levels, temporarily manifest bestial traits, claws, fangs, predator senses, and a presence so overwhelming that even sapient beings feel the primal urge to submit. The Fanged Covenant considers this Blessing sacred. Having it makes beastkin politics very interesting.
Blessing of the Beast King.traitNarrativeEffects: Animals follow you home constantly and wild predators that should want to eat you instead sit and wait for instructions.

Blessing of the Blood Oath.name: Blessing of the Blood Oath
Blessing of the Blood Oath.description: Your blood is your weapon, your shield, and your contract with power. The Blessing of the Blood Oath lets you turn your own vitality into a tool: crystallizing blood into blades, burning life force to speed your healing, sensing the living through their circulation, and forging unbreakable blood pacts that bind allies in shared strength. Every spell costs something personal. Every sacrifice makes the next casting stronger. The Church calls it heresy. Your enemies call it the last thing they remember.
Blessing of the Blood Oath.traitNarrativeEffects: Your blood glows faintly when exposed to air and wounds you inflict take noticeably longer to clot.

Blessing of the Chrono Eye.name: Blessing of the Chrono Eye
Blessing of the Chrono Eye.description: You see the threads of time. The Blessing of the Chrono Eye grants temporal perception: you catch attacks before they land, read enemy movement with terrifying accuracy, and can slow, speed up, or briefly rewind time in a small zone around you. At higher levels you glimpse several possible futures at once and pick the one where you win. Your eye visibly changes when the Blessing activates, the iris turning to a clock face, a spiral, or a fractal depending on how deep you're reading the timestream. The cost: you sometimes live time out of order, answering questions before they're asked and grieving things that haven't happened yet.
Blessing of the Chrono Eye.traitNarrativeEffects: You always know the exact time without checking and you've accidentally spoiled the endings of stories because you 'just knew.'

Blessing of the Lucky Star.name: Blessing of the Lucky Star
Blessing of the Lucky Star.description: Probability is your best friend. The Blessing of the Lucky Star bends chance your way: enemy attacks miss by inches, your wild swings connect, dropped loot lands somewhere useful, and you trip into opportunities that shouldn't exist. At higher levels you can deliberately 'spend' luck to force a good outcome, steal an enemy's lucky break, or set off cascades where one fortunate event triggers the next. The downside: luck is finite, and push it too hard and the universe balances the books with matching misfortune. The most isekai of all Blessings. The protagonist who falls face-first into treasure chests and romantic encounters. On purpose? Maybe. Blessed? Absolutely.
Blessing of the Lucky Star.traitNarrativeEffects: You win coin flips roughly 80% of the time and have survived at least three situations that should have killed you through improbable coincidence.

Blessing of the Soul Flame.name: Blessing of the Soul Flame
Blessing of the Soul Flame.description: You heal what medicine can't reach. The Blessing of the Soul Flame lets you see and mend damage to the soul itself: spiritual wounds, emotional trauma, Blessing corruption, cursed injuries that shrug off normal healing, and the invisible scars that pile up in people who've seen too much. Your flame is warm, gentle, impossibly comforting. At higher levels you can relight a soul's will to live, restore lost memories, and pull someone back from the edge of spiritual death. You're the rarest and most precious kind of healer. Every faction wants you. Everyone you heal remembers how it felt.
Blessing of the Soul Flame.traitNarrativeEffects: People feel inexplicably warm and safe standing near you and your eyes glow softly when you're healing someone.

Can't Refuse a Pretty Face.name: Can't Refuse a Pretty Face
Can't Refuse a Pretty Face.description: Your willpower collapses in the presence of beauty. An attractive person asks you for a favor and your brain short-circuits, yes comes out of your mouth before the question is finished. You've accepted quests you shouldn't have, carried bags you didn't need to carry, and agreed to attend events you couldn't afford because someone beautiful asked with a smile. You know this about yourself. It doesn't help.
Can't Refuse a Pretty Face.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist is easily persuaded by attractive NPCs. Beautiful characters should have an easier time getting favors, information, or compliance from the protagonist. This creates comedic and dramatic situations where the protagonist gets roped into problems through charm.

Card Summoner's Dandy Coat.name: Card Summoner's Dandy Coat
Card Summoner's Dandy Coat.description: A dramatic long coat with card-suit embroidery, fingerless drawing gloves, and a deck holster at the hip. Every fight is a game and the house always wins.
Card Summoner's Dandy Coat.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Tailored Formalwear; in play, describe what is worn now.

Demon Hunter Corps Uniform.name: Demon Hunter Corps Uniform
Demon Hunter Corps Uniform.description: A sharp, militaristic uniform in black and silver with a distinctive corps insignia, reinforced joints, a short cape clasped with a demon-tooth brooch, and built-in holy-ward stitching along every seam. Clean lines, functional elegance, and the unmistakable look of an organization that takes killing demons very seriously and looks incredible while doing it.
Demon Hunter Corps Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Long Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

Dungeon Safe Room Campfire.name: Dungeon Safe Room Campfire
Dungeon Safe Room Campfire.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A protected rest chamber near a dungeon route, with bedrolls, supplies, lanterns, and a small campfire giving off warm light against surrounding stone. The mood is adventurous and intimate. {{portraitprompt}}: fantasy dungeon safe room, campfire, bedrolls, supplies, warm lantern light, anime portrait background behind character
Dungeon Safe Room Campfire.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Elegant Side-Swept Chignon.name: Elegant Side-Swept Chignon
Elegant Side-Swept Chignon.description: A low, side-swept chignon, hair gathered and twisted into a graceful knot at the nape, slightly off-center, with soft face-framing pieces. Refined and romantic, the hairstyle of diplomats, noble spies, and anyone who can kill you while looking like they're dressed for opera.
Elegant Side-Swept Chignon.traitNarrativeEffects: You can disassemble this updo and use the hidden pins as lockpicks in approximately four seconds. This is not common knowledge.

Eye Pattern - Black Sclera.name: Eye Pattern - Black Sclera
Eye Pattern - Black Sclera.description: Black Sclera as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Black Sclera.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply black sclera to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Eye Pattern - Glowing Eyes.name: Eye Pattern - Glowing Eyes
Eye Pattern - Glowing Eyes.description: Glowing Eyes as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Glowing Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply glowing eyes to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Fairy Queen's Living Dress.name: Fairy Queen's Living Dress
Fairy Queen's Living Dress.description: A gown seemingly grown rather than sewn, living vines, fresh flowers that bloom and change, translucent petal layers, dewdrop jewels, and a crown of woven branches. The dress responds to the wearer's emotions: flowers bloom when happy, thorns emerge when angry, petals fall when sad. Nature's couture.
Fairy Queen's Living Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now. Render visible living plant elements, flowers, vines, petals, integrated into the dress structure.

Heroic Pretty-Boy Features.name: Heroic Pretty-Boy Features
Heroic Pretty-Boy Features.description: Softly handsome features with clean anime symmetry, gentle eyes, and just enough sharpness in the jaw or gaze to read as the lead of a fantasy romance route. The face should look approachable until the serious scene starts, then suddenly feel impossible to ignore.
Heroic Pretty-Boy Features.traitNarrativeEffects: FACIAL FEATURE LOCK: Render heroic pretty-boy facial structure: handsome, gentle, clean-lined, and protagonist-coded. Controls face design only; no stats or gameplay effects.

Kensei's Blade-Master Garb.name: Kensei's Blade-Master Garb
Kensei's Blade-Master Garb.description: Minimalist hakama, a sword through the sash, and a haori with a kanji crest. One cut is all you need.
Kensei's Blade-Master Garb.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Kimono and Sash; in play, describe what is worn now.

Necromancer's Grave Shroud.name: Necromancer's Grave Shroud
Necromancer's Grave Shroud.description: Tattered black layers over formal mourning clothes, bone accessories, and a veil or half-mask. Smells faintly of graveyards and bad decisions.
Necromancer's Grave Shroud.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Occult Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Portrait Frame - Full Body.name: Portrait Frame - Full Body
Portrait Frame - Full Body.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Vertical pulled-back full-body portrait of [character name], showing the complete figure from the highest anatomy to the lowest feet, tail, or body structure. Keep the figure at roughly 65-75 percent of canvas height with clear space above and visible ground or lower-body clearance below. Nothing touches the image edges.
Portrait Frame - Full Body.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: mandatory vertical pulled-back head-to-toe character illustration. This is the final camera and composition authority. Show the complete figure from the highest hair, ears, horns, wings, or headwear to both feet or the lowest equivalent anatomy. Keep the figure at approximately 65-75 percent of canvas height, with visible space above the highest anatomy and visible ground or lower-body clearance beneath the complete figure. Keep all limbs, hands, footwear, tails, wings, clothing, accessories, and explicitly selected props fully inside the canvas with no edge contact. Use a readable central silhouette and a specific selected background. Reject face-only, close-up, headshot, bust, chest-up, waist-up, thigh-up, knee-up, three-quarter-body, and cropped upper-body framing. The selected Portrait Style, scene detail, expression, and character importance cannot move the camera closer, enlarge the figure, or override this frame.

Skybridge Above the Clouds.name: Skybridge Above the Clouds
Skybridge Above the Clouds.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A high stone bridge or platform suspended above a sea of clouds, with bright sky, wind-swept banners, and distant floating structures. The setting feels elevated, magical, and awe-inspiring. {{portraitprompt}}: skybridge above clouds, floating structures, bright sky, wind banners, anime fantasy portrait background behind character
Skybridge Above the Clouds.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

The Chosen One (In Denial).name: The Chosen One (In Denial)
The Chosen One (In Denial).description: Somehow the world keeps pointing at you and you keep insisting there has been a mistake. Destiny may be real, but you are not obliged to enjoy the paperwork.
The Chosen One (In Denial).traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Let destiny keep colliding with someone who still thinks this whole situation sounds exhausting.

The Stubborn Cinnamon Roll.name: The Stubborn Cinnamon Roll
The Stubborn Cinnamon Roll.description: You are sweet, caring, and maddeningly difficult to budge once you have decided on something. Gentle does not mean easy to move.
The Stubborn Cinnamon Roll.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep them sweet, kind, and impossible to move once they have committed their heart.

Underground Fighting Arena.name: Underground Fighting Arena
Underground Fighting Arena.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A rough underground arena lit by mana-torches and betting lanterns, a sand-floored fighting pit surrounded by roaring crowds on tiered wooden benches, bookmakers shouting odds, and the electric atmosphere of sanctioned violence where anything goes except boring the audience.
Underground Fighting Arena.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Villainess Tea Party Dress.name: Villainess Tea Party Dress
Villainess Tea Party Dress.description: A refined noble tea dress with aristocratic polish, feminine drama, and the unmistakable energy of someone who could destroy reputations over pastries without spilling her tea.
Villainess Tea Party Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Waist-Length Straight Hair.name: Waist-Length Straight Hair
Waist-Length Straight Hair.description: Perfectly straight hair falling like a silk curtain to the waist, no curls, no waves, just impossibly smooth, impossibly shiny, and impossibly beautiful. The hair of someone who radiates quiet power and makes everyone else feel underdressed. It moves like water when the wearer turns.
Waist-Length Straight Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair catches every light source in the room. Candlelight, moonlight, mana-glow, it doesn't matter. You are always backlit.

Blessing of Ice Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Ice Sovereignty
Blessing of Ice Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over winter clarity, preservation, restraint, and beautiful lethal stillness. Ice obeys you like a judgment rendered in crystal. This blessing lets your ice magic freeze terrain into architecture, preserve fragile things, seal wounds or curses for a time, trap enemies in layered frost, form blades and mirrors of cold, and slow chaos into something you can read. It isn't merely colder ice; it's the authority to decide what stops moving.
Blessing of Ice Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Ice should feel precise, composed, and terrifyingly beautiful. Use snow-bright crowns, mirror ice, crystalline restraints, frozen geometry, preserved flowers, and silent winter courts. This blessing allows battlefield freezing, restraint, preservation, ice constructs, cold barriers, and controlled shattering.

Blessing of the Dragon Vein.name: Blessing of the Dragon Vein
Blessing of the Dragon Vein.description: Ancient draconic power flows through your mana circuits like molten gold. The Blessing of the Dragon Vein massively amplifies your magical capacity and output, spells that should take all your mana feel like breathing, elemental attacks carry the weight of something ancient and enormous, and your presence makes the ambient mana in an area feel pressurized. At higher levels, you can manifest draconic traits temporarily, wings, scaled armor, a breath weapon of devastating elemental fury. The dragonkin respect you. The Academy fears you. Your mana pool is a strategic resource that entire factions make plans around.
Blessing of the Dragon Vein.traitNarrativeEffects: Your mana capacity is roughly triple the human average and your sneeze once set a curtain on fire.

Blessing of the Void Walker.name: Blessing of the Void Walker
Blessing of the Void Walker.description: You walk between worlds. The Blessing of the Void Walker lets you step into the space between dimensions, a void between realities you can cross to teleport, phase through solid matter, and hide where nobody can follow. At higher levels you can drag enemies into the void for a moment, tuck objects into dimensional pockets, and tear open passages between locations for your allies. The void is dark, cold, and not entirely empty; things live in the gaps between worlds, and they've noticed you. Your Blessing is a door. What's on the other side is the real question. The most mysterious and lore-connected Blessing, tied directly to the Rebirth phenomenon and the dimensional instability that brings Reborn souls to Luxcellia.
Blessing of the Void Walker.traitNarrativeEffects: You can feel the dimensional barriers like skin and stepping through a Riftmaw entrance feels like coming home.

Cherry Blossom Path at Dawn.name: Cherry Blossom Path at Dawn
Cherry Blossom Path at Dawn.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A winding stone path lined with cherry blossom trees in full bloom, petals drifting through golden dawn light. The air seems thick with pink and gold. Lanterns hang unlit from the branches. A distant shrine gate is visible at the end of the path. The atmosphere is romantic, hopeful, and achingly beautiful.
Cherry Blossom Path at Dawn.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Demon Lord's Private Garden.name: Demon Lord's Private Garden
Demon Lord's Private Garden.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A hauntingly beautiful garden in the Twilight Dominion, night-blooming flowers in impossible colors, a dark marble fountain, glowing amber lanterns, paths of obsidian stone, and the eternal violet twilight sky overhead. Elegant, romantic, and just dangerous enough to remind you where you are.
Demon Lord's Private Garden.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Dragon Rider's Flight Armor.name: Dragon Rider's Flight Armor
Dragon Rider's Flight Armor.description: Aerodynamic leather-and-scale armor designed for high-altitude dragon combat, wind-resistant panels, a fur-lined collar, reinforced gloves, flight goggles pushed up on the forehead, and scorch marks that are considered decorative. The armor smells faintly of ozone and dragon musk.
Dragon Rider's Flight Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Scale Battle Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Exorcist's Spirit Ward Garb.name: Exorcist's Spirit Ward Garb
Exorcist's Spirit Ward Garb.description: Layered prayer robes covered in written sutras and talismans, a wide-brimmed hat, and paper seals ready to be thrown. When the spirits fight back, so do you.
Exorcist's Spirit Ward Garb.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Shrine Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Eye Pattern - Gradient Eyes.name: Eye Pattern - Gradient Eyes
Eye Pattern - Gradient Eyes.description: Gradient Eyes as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Gradient Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply gradient eyes to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Eye Pattern - Ringed Irises.name: Eye Pattern - Ringed Irises
Eye Pattern - Ringed Irises.description: Ringed Irises as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Ringed Irises.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply ringed irises to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Forgettable at First Glance.name: Forgettable at First Glance
Forgettable at First Glance.description: Nothing about you screams for attention at first, which makes you surprisingly easy to overlook in a crowd. The people who do notice you later tend to feel foolish for missing you.
Forgettable at First Glance.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs do not remember you clearly at first, which helps with slipping past notice and surprises later.

Gunslinger's Duster and Hat.name: Gunslinger's Duster and Hat
Gunslinger's Duster and Hat.description: A long duster coat, a wide-brimmed hat, leather gun belt, and spurs that jingle with every step. Six shots, no questions.
Gunslinger's Duster and Hat.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Long Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

Harbor at Sunset with Ships.name: Harbor at Sunset with Ships
Harbor at Sunset with Ships.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A bustling fantasy harbor at sunset, tall ships with magic-enhanced sails, merchant vessels from distant lands, dock workers and sailors, seagulls, the smell of salt and adventure, and a sky painted in oranges and purples reflected on the water. The gateway between the known world and everywhere else.
Harbor at Sunset with Ships.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Looks Like the Secret Route.name: Looks Like the Secret Route
Looks Like the Secret Route.description: You look like the person a player would only find by making oddly specific choices. There is immediate intrigue in your presence.
Looks Like the Secret Route.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs sense hidden depth, optional-content energy, or suspiciously specific importance.

Looks Younger Than They Are.name: Looks Younger Than They Are
Looks Younger Than They Are.description: You look five to ten years younger than your actual age. Whether it's your face, your frame, your energy, or some combination of all three, people consistently mistake you for someone much younger, and treat you accordingly. You get carded, underestimated, called 'kid,' and talked down to by NPCs who assume they're dealing with a child or teenager. This is infuriating when you're trying to be taken seriously and occasionally useful when you want to be underestimated.
Looks Younger Than They Are.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs consistently assume the protagonist is younger than they are. Guards try to escort you to your parents, guild staff question your registration, and enemies underestimate your capabilities. Looking young means being treated like it until you prove otherwise.

Magical Girl's Battle Dress.name: Magical Girl's Battle Dress
Magical Girl's Battle Dress.description: A bright, polished magical-girl battle dress with transformation-sequence energy, decorative detail, and a silhouette designed to look beautiful while still reading as fantasy combat wear.
Magical Girl's Battle Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Paladin's Consecrated Armor.name: Paladin's Consecrated Armor
Paladin's Consecrated Armor.description: Plate armor etched with holy symbols, a radiant cape clasped at the shoulder, and a glow that seems to come from within. Righteousness you can wear.
Paladin's Consecrated Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Knightly Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Swashbuckler's Duelist Coat.name: Swashbuckler's Duelist Coat
Swashbuckler's Duelist Coat.description: A rakish long coat with gold buttons, a ruffled shirt, leather boots with turned-down cuffs, and a rapier at the hip. Style is a weapon.
Swashbuckler's Duelist Coat.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Seafarer's Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

The Overprotective Guardian.name: The Overprotective Guardian
The Overprotective Guardian.description: You love through vigilance, intervention, and refusing to let people you care about get hurt if you can help it. Your care is obvious, sometimes overwhelming, and rarely subtle.
The Overprotective Guardian.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Show care through guarding, intervening, and physically or emotionally shielding people they love.

The Tutorial-Skipping Idiot.name: The Tutorial-Skipping Idiot
The Tutorial-Skipping Idiot.description: You meet systems, warnings, and instructions with the confidence of someone who assumes they can figure it out live. Sometimes this works. Sometimes it absolutely does not.
The Tutorial-Skipping Idiot.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Show reckless confidence toward rules, systems, warnings, and explanations.

Training Arc Bandaged Wraps.name: Training Arc Bandaged Wraps
Training Arc Bandaged Wraps.description: Minimal clothing, bandaged wraps around the hands, forearms, and torso, loose training pants, bare feet, and visible signs of intense physical conditioning. Sweat, determination, and the raw appeal of someone in the middle of becoming stronger. The anime training montage outfit.
Training Arc Bandaged Wraps.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Training Wraps; in play, describe what is worn now. Render visible training effort, bandages, wraps, minimal clothing focused on physical conditioning.

Blessing of Dark Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Dark Sovereignty
Blessing of Dark Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over dread, curses, forbidden force, night pressure, and the heavy magic people mistake for evil because it scares them. Dark magic gathers like a throne room after the candles go out. This blessing lets your dark magic weigh on enemies, curse weapons, weaken resolve, smother hostile light, sharpen fear-based intimidation, and open oppressive zones where enemies feel every mistake. It's heavier and more confrontational than Shadow, but not mindless cruelty.
Blessing of Dark Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Dark should feel heavy, regal, curse-laced, and intimidating. Use black-crimson crowns, oppressive halos, thorned sigils, dimming candlelight, and pressure like a throne room. This blessing allows curse pressure, morale suppression, hostile-light smothering, dread zones, and dark weapon empowerment.

Blessing of Fire Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Fire Sovereignty
Blessing of Fire Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over flame, heat, courage, destruction, and rebirth. Fire doesn't just answer you, it behaves like a royal order has come down. This blessing lets your fire magic burn hotter without turning sloppy, shape itself into crowns, wings, walls, blades, brands, and phoenix-like bursts, and tell what must be destroyed from what must be protected. In battle it favors overwhelming offense, explosive zone control, purification through heat, forge-level temperature work, and dramatic second-wind moments where dying embers flare back into impossible life.
Blessing of Fire Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Fire should feel like royal flame given purpose. Use phoenix imagery, forge heat, ember crowns, controlled infernos, fire that shields allies instead of spreading blindly, and rebirth-through-burning themes. This blessing allows controlled destruction, heat shaping, purifying burns, fire barriers, explosive finishers, and morale-shaking displays of divine courage.

Blessing of Rift Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Rift Sovereignty
Blessing of Rift Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over dungeon scars, broken thresholds, unstable crossings, dimensional seams, and the dangerous places where reality forgot to heal. Rift magic doesn't politely teleport, it negotiates with the wound. This blessing lets your rift magic sense dungeon instability, stabilize small tears, cut jagged portals, redirect Riftmaw hazards, cross broken spaces, expose hidden seams, and meddle with dungeon architecture. It excels underground, near anomalies, and anywhere the world is already cracked.
Blessing of Rift Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Rift should feel jagged, dungeon-linked, and dangerous but useful. Use blue-violet crowns, broken portal rings, fractured glyphs, Riftlight seams, and threshold imagery. This blessing allows anomaly sensing, tear stabilization, jagged portals, dungeon-hazard redirection, seam exposure, and cracked-space traversal.

Blessing of Soul Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Soul Sovereignty
Blessing of Soul Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over identity, spirits, vows, ghosts, reincarnation, and the shape of the self. Soul magic answers you like a name finally spoken correctly. This blessing lets your soul magic brace identity against possession, calm restless spirits, sense soul wounds, bind vows, shield memories, reveal spiritual scars, and reach across the veil without treating people like objects. It excels at exorcism, healing the unseen, Reborn mysteries, and bonds that survive death's paperwork.
Blessing of Soul Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Soul should feel intimate, gentle, sacred, and identity-focused. Use pale soulfire crowns, spirit threads, translucent sigils, name-light, and vow circles. This blessing allows anti-possession protection, spirit communication, soul-wound sensing, vow binding, memory shielding, and exorcism scenes.

Blessing of Star Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Star Sovereignty
Blessing of Star Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over constellations, fate maps, astral light, navigation, omens, and heavenly perspective. Star magic reads the night sky as a living diagram. This blessing lets your star magic draw constellation lines between targets, guide travel, reveal auspicious paths, fire astral beams, mark destiny points, read omen-patterns, and turn darkness into a map instead of a threat. It excels at guidance, ranged precision, prophecy flavor, and looking unfairly majestic under open sky.
Blessing of Star Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Star should feel majestic, guiding, and fate-touched. Use midnight crowns, constellation lines, astral geometry, star maps, falling starlight, and omen halos. This blessing allows navigation, omen reading, astral marks, constellation targeting, dark-sight guidance, and stellar ranged miracles.

Blessing of Time Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Time Sovereignty
Blessing of Time Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over seconds, delay, memory, rhythm, prophecy, and the terrible value of one more moment. Time never becomes fully yours, but it hesitates when you speak. This blessing lets your time magic hasten allies, slow projectiles, delay wounds for a breath, preserve a fragile moment, read temporal echoes, and open narrow windows where impossible actions turn barely possible. It's powerful because it's limited, precious, and never wasted.
Blessing of Time Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Time should feel rare, precise, and awe-inducing, not omnipotent. Use clockwork crowns, frozen motes, gold-blue rings, afterimages, and breath-held silence. This blessing allows haste, slow fields, delayed impact, temporal echoes, moment preservation, and narrow miracle openings without unrestricted time travel.

Blessing of Void Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Void Sovereignty
Blessing of Void Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over absence, silence, nullification, forbidden edges, and the mercy of making something stop being a problem. Void isn't darkness; it's subtraction. This blessing lets your void magic erase minor spell effects, mute sound, carve negative-space cuts, banish unstable constructs, open anti-magic pockets, and tear terrifying gaps where force, light, or matter briefly fails. It's immensely powerful, but every clean use should feel controlled, costly, and watched by people who know better.
Blessing of Void Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Void should feel subtractive, silent, restrained, and frightening. Use black-violet crowns, negative-space halos, clean fractures, vanishing motes, and reality going quiet. This blessing allows nullification, anti-magic pockets, silence fields, construct banishment, negative-space cutting, and controlled erasure without casual omnipotence.

Blessing of Wind Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Wind Sovereignty
Blessing of Wind Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over speed, breath, freedom, motion, and untouchable grace. Wind treats your movement like law and your silence like a pathway. This blessing lets your wind magic speed up bodies, soften falls, redirect arrows, carry voices, cut with pressure currents, step across the air for brief moments, and turn battlefield positioning into an art. It's the blessing of never being where the enemy needed you to be.
Blessing of Wind Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Wind should feel free, graceful, evasive, and exhilarating. Use transparent crowns, feather motes, spiraling motion lines, pressure blades, lifted cloaks, and breath-as-magic imagery. This blessing allows mobility, evasion, air-step movement, projectile redirection, cutting gusts, and voice-carrying utility.

Blessing of the Blade Dancer.name: Blessing of the Blade Dancer
Blessing of the Blade Dancer.description: Your body is a weapon that never stops moving. The Blessing of the Blade Dancer turns combat into choreography, your sword strikes flow into each other without pause, every dodge becomes an attack angle, and your fighting accelerates the longer you sustain it until you're a blur of steel that can't be tracked by normal eyes. At higher levels, you generate phantom slashes, cuts that arrive from angles your blade never physically traveled. Your Blessing doesn't just make you fast. It makes you inevitable.
Blessing of the Blade Dancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Your movements are rhythmic even when you're not trying and you can't walk past a weapon rack without evaluating every piece.

Blessing of the Gravity Well.name: Blessing of the Gravity Well
Blessing of the Gravity Well.description: Weight is a number you can edit. The Blessing of the Gravity Well hands you absolute authority over gravitational force nearby: pinning enemies under amplified gravity, launching yourself by canceling your own mass, raising repulsion fields that swat attacks aside, and at higher levels spinning up miniature singularities that drag everything toward a point you pick. Your power is elegant and devastating in equal measure. The Academy's physics department has written seventeen papers about you. None of them agree.
Blessing of the Gravity Well.traitNarrativeEffects: You weigh slightly different amounts depending on your mood and once accidentally pinned a merchant to his own counter during a haggling disagreement.

Blessing of the Healing Dawn.name: Blessing of the Healing Dawn
Blessing of the Healing Dawn.description: You mend what is broken. The Blessing of the Healing Dawn grants restorative power that transcends normal healing magic, closing wounds instantly, neutralizing poisons, curing diseases, and regenerating damage that other healers consider permanent. Your healing light is warm, golden, and feels like being held by someone who cares. At higher levels, you can heal multiple allies simultaneously, regenerate severed limbs, and create sanctuaries where no harm can be done. Your power grows strongest when healing someone you love. The Church wants to canonize you. Your party wants you to stop running into danger to heal them.
Blessing of the Healing Dawn.traitNarrativeEffects: Injuries near you heal slightly faster even without magic and children and animals gravitate toward you instinctively.

Blessing of the Phantom Step.name: Blessing of the Phantom Step
Blessing of the Phantom Step.description: You exist between moments. The Blessing of the Phantom Step lets you move faster than perception, phase briefly through solid matter, and appear behind enemies who were certain you were in front of them. At its core, you slip between the cracks in reality, not teleportation, but a step so fast it bypasses everything between here and there. Your presence flickers. Your footsteps are silent. And the afterimage you leave behind smiles for half a second longer than it should.
Blessing of the Phantom Step.traitNarrativeEffects: You leave no footprints and occasionally walk through conversations people swear you weren't part of.

Blessing of the Storm Caller.name: Blessing of the Storm Caller
Blessing of the Storm Caller.description: You are the storm. The Blessing of the Storm Caller lets you summon lightning from clear skies, generate cyclonic winds from standing air, and move with the speed of a thunderbolt. Your power scales with atmospheric conditions, in rain you're dangerous, in a thunderstorm you're apocalyptic. The storm responds to your mood, calm days when you're happy, static buildup when you're angry, and the ominous pressure drop before violence that makes everyone around you check the sky.
Blessing of the Storm Caller.traitNarrativeEffects: Electronics, or the magical equivalent, short out around you and your hair has never been tame in its entire existence.

Blessing of the Titan's Grip.name: Blessing of the Titan's Grip
Blessing of the Titan's Grip.description: Your strength has no ceiling. The Blessing of the Titan's Grip amplifies physical power to levels that shouldn't be possible in a human-sized body, lifting boulders, shattering castle walls with bare fists, and wielding weapons designed for creatures three times your size as if they weigh nothing. At higher levels, your strikes generate shockwaves, your grip can crack enchanted armor, and your physical presence alone creates a pressure field that pushes lighter enemies backward. You are the answer to every problem that can be solved by hitting it harder. Most problems can be solved by hitting them harder.
Blessing of the Titan's Grip.traitNarrativeEffects: You can open every jar on the first try and have accidentally crushed three doorknobs this month.

Blessing of the Verdant Soul.name: Blessing of the Verdant Soul
Blessing of the Verdant Soul.description: Life grows where you walk. The Blessing of the Verdant Soul connects you to every living plant, fungus, and root system in your vicinity, commanding growth at impossible speed, turning barren stone into a forest in minutes, and healing allies by channeling the regenerative force of nature itself. Your vines are stronger than steel cable. Your thorns are sharper than swords. And the ancient trees recognize your authority in a way that makes the Verdania Wilds' elven guardians very, very interested.
Blessing of the Verdant Soul.traitNarrativeEffects: Flowers bloom in your footprints and houseplants in your vicinity grow at triple speed. You've been banned from two greenhouses.

Blood Knight's Crimson Armor.name: Blood Knight's Crimson Armor
Blood Knight's Crimson Armor.description: Battle-scarred plate armor in deep crimson and black, with a tattered half-cape and visible damage that's been repaired but never polished. The armor tells the story of a hundred fights survived. Rose-thorn motifs are etched into the pauldrons and gauntlets. Beautiful, brutal, and worn with the confidence of someone who has bled in it and made others bleed more.
Blood Knight's Crimson Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Blackened Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Eye Pattern - Catlike Pupils.name: Eye Pattern - Catlike Pupils
Eye Pattern - Catlike Pupils.description: Catlike Pupils as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Catlike Pupils.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply catlike pupils to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Eye Pattern - Glasslike Eyes.name: Eye Pattern - Glasslike Eyes
Eye Pattern - Glasslike Eyes.description: Glasslike Eyes as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Glasslike Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply glasslike eyes to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Magical Library Spiral Tower.name: Magical Library Spiral Tower
Magical Library Spiral Tower.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A towering cylindrical library with bookshelves spiraling upward into impossible heights, floating platforms carry readers between levels, enchanted books drift on their own, mage-lights glow at reading nooks, and the sheer volume of accumulated knowledge creates its own gravity.
Magical Library Spiral Tower.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Martial Artist's Training Gi.name: Martial Artist's Training Gi
Martial Artist's Training Gi.description: A clean white or colored gi with a belt ranking, hand wraps, and bare feet or light sandals. Discipline made visible.
Martial Artist's Training Gi.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Training Gi; in play, describe what is worn now.

Master Thief's Dark Leathers.name: Master Thief's Dark Leathers
Master Thief's Dark Leathers.description: Supple black leather, a masked cowl, soft-soled boots, and a belt of picks and pouches. Silence is the style.
Master Thief's Dark Leathers.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Adventurer's Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Portrait Frame - Action Pose.name: Portrait Frame - Action Pose
Portrait Frame - Action Pose.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Dynamic action portrait of [character name], framed to keep the character readable while showing active motion, posture, and outfit structure. The face, silhouette, selected style, and selected background remain clear.
Portrait Frame - Action Pose.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: dynamic action portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority. Use a complete or near-complete figure with a clear line of motion, shifted weight, readable limb placement, stable anatomy, visible face, and selected outfit silhouette. Hair and loose selected garments may respond naturally to motion. Keep the selected background legible as context. Do not invent a weapon, power effect, opponent, impact debris, speed-line text, extra limbs, or a different crop. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Portrait Frame - Back Turned.name: Portrait Frame - Back Turned
Portrait Frame - Back Turned.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Back-turned portrait of [character name], framed to show the back silhouette, hair, shoulders, rear outfit structure, and selected background while keeping the head angle and identity readable.
Portrait Frame - Back Turned.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: back-turned portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority. Show the character facing away in a waist-up or full-body composition according to the selected body plan and scene. Make the back of the head, hair, shoulders, spine line, rear garment construction, tail, wings, or other selected rear anatomy readable. A slight side angle may preserve identity without turning the face toward camera. Do not force a front-facing pose, walking action, cape, destination vista, or unselected prop. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Portrait Frame - Hero Stance.name: Portrait Frame - Hero Stance
Portrait Frame - Hero Stance.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Hero-stance portrait of [character name], centered in a confident upright composition with the face visible and posture clearly readable. The frame emphasizes shoulders, torso, arms when visible, costume shape, and selected background.
Portrait Frame - Hero Stance.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: heroic knees-up stance portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority. Frame from the complete head to the thighs or knees with the face, shoulders, torso, waist, arms, hands when naturally visible, and upper legs readable. Use a confident planted posture and a restrained eye-level, slight low, or three-quarter angle. Preserve the selected expression and background. Do not invent a weapon, cape, emblem, power effect, battlefield, full-body feet, or face-only crop. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Portrait Frame - Weapon Draw.name: Portrait Frame - Weapon Draw
Portrait Frame - Weapon Draw.description: FRAME LOCK TEXT: Weapon-draw portrait of [character name], framed around the upper body and visible weapon motion with the face, shoulders, arms, hands when visible, outfit, weapon silhouette, and selected background readable.
Portrait Frame - Weapon Draw.traitNarrativeEffects: FRAME LOCK: weapon-draw portrait. This is the final camera and composition authority and explicitly requests a visible weapon action. Use the selected Signature Weapon or another explicitly selected visible weapon when available, shown being drawn, raised, unfolded, or readied in a waist-up to full-body composition that preserves the face, hands, weapon silhouette, and selected background. When no weapon selection exists, use a draw-ready empty-hand motion rather than inventing one. Do not add spell energy, extra weapons, combat damage, enemies, or action text. The selected Portrait Style and scene detail cannot override this frame, move the camera, or change its visible body range.

Rapunzel-Length Flowing Hair.name: Rapunzel-Length Flowing Hair
Rapunzel-Length Flowing Hair.description: Hair so impossibly long it trails behind like a bridal veil, pooling on the ground in still moments and billowing dramatically in every breeze. The kind of hair that makes people stop and stare, that catches light like spun silk, and that absolutely should not be practical for combat, but somehow is. This is the hair of someone blessed by the world itself.
Rapunzel-Length Flowing Hair.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair has its own gravitational pull on the narrative. Wind exists specifically to make it move beautifully. You have never once gotten it caught in a door, destiny wouldn't allow it.

Tribal Shaman's Bone Regalia.name: Tribal Shaman's Bone Regalia
Tribal Shaman's Bone Regalia.description: Bone jewelry, face paint, a headdress of feathers or skulls, and a cloak of spirit-marked hide. The ancestors wear you.
Tribal Shaman's Bone Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Furs and Hides; in play, describe what is worn now.

Abandoned Clocktower Interior.name: Abandoned Clocktower Interior
Abandoned Clocktower Interior.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: The interior of a massive abandoned clocktower, enormous gears frozen mid-turn, shafts of dusty light streaming through broken clock faces, scattered papers and old mechanisms, and the melancholy beauty of something that once measured all the time in the world and now measures none.
Abandoned Clocktower Interior.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Barbarian's Fur and War Paint.name: Barbarian's Fur and War Paint
Barbarian's Fur and War Paint.description: Heavy furs draped over bare muscle, leather bracers, a horned or antlered headdress, and ritual war paint across exposed skin. Savage and proud.
Barbarian's Fur and War Paint.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Furs and Hides; in play, describe what is worn now.

Blessing of Blood Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Blood Sovereignty
Blessing of Blood Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over blood, vitality, wounds, lineage, sacrifice, and the terrifying honesty of life force. Blood answers you as both weapon and oath. This blessing lets your blood magic seal bleeding, reinforce bodies, mark vows, bind enemies through spilled blood, empower crimson weapons, sense living presence nearby, and trade personal cost for impossible output when the moment truly matters. It's intimate, dramatic, and never casual.
Blessing of Blood Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Blood should feel intimate, costly, and oath-bound. Use crimson crowns, pulse rings, vow sigils, heartbeat light, blood-thread bindings, and sacrifice imagery. This blessing allows wound sealing, vitality reinforcement, blood marks, crimson weapon shaping, living-presence sense, and high-cost miracle casting.

Blessing of Charm Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Charm Sovereignty
Blessing of Charm Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over presence, affection, morale, glamour, emotional resonance, and the social gravity of being impossible to ignore. Charm doesn't hand you ownership of anyone's will; it makes every feeling in the room harder to lie about. This blessing lets your charm magic calm panic, steady ally morale, weave glamour, draw attention, soften hostility, expose emotional contradictions, and open social doors that still demand real choices. It's powerful because it amplifies connection, not because it deletes consent.
Blessing of Charm Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Charm should feel radiant, socially magnetic, and emotionally catalytic without mind control. Use rose-gold crowns, heartlike glyphs, spotlight halos, glamour rings, and visible morale shifts. This blessing allows morale boosts, emotional resonance, glamour, hostility softening, social openings, and attention control while preserving free will.

Blessing of Dream Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Dream Sovereignty
Blessing of Dream Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over sleep, symbolism, longing, nightmares, memory-theater, and the truths people only admit once the waking world lets go. Dream magic becomes a royal road into the inward world. This blessing lets your dream magic soothe nightmares, draw symbolic constructs into battle, read emotional omens, bring on restful sleep, enter dreamscapes with permission or proper ritual, and turn fears into forms that can be faced. It's softer than Illusion, stranger than Charm, and more honest than either.
Blessing of Dream Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Dream should feel surreal, emotional, symbolic, and tenderly strange. Use lavender crowns, crescent glyphs, soft star motes, floating doors, dream mist, and nightmare-to-symbol imagery. This blessing allows nightmare soothing, symbolic constructs, dreamwalking with boundaries, emotional omen reading, sleep magic, and fear-made-visible scenes.

Blessing of Earth Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Earth Sovereignty
Blessing of Earth Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over stone, soil, roots, shelter, endurance, and unshakable resolve. The ground takes your command as a promise to hold. This blessing lets your earth magic raise walls, anchor allies, shape trenches, pillars, bridges, and sanctuaries, feel movement through the ground, reinforce structures, and turn a collapsing battlefield into a fortress. It excels at protection, terrain mastery, siege-breaking, and the quiet authority of refusing to fall.
Blessing of Earth Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Earth should feel grounded, protective, and immovable. Use stone crowns, golden-brown sigils, root-thrones, fortress plates, dust rings, and terrain rising in loyal response. This blessing allows fortification, terrain shaping, seismic sense, structural reinforcement, anchoring, and sanctuary creation.

Blessing of Light Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Light Sovereignty
Blessing of Light Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over radiance, revelation, protection, sanctity, and hope made visible. Light becomes more than brightness in your hands, it becomes proof. This blessing lets your light magic reveal hidden enemies, cleanse corruption, form radiant shields, burn undead or cursed things, illuminate truth in sacred spaces, and create morale-restoring beacons that make allies stand taller. It is not subtle, but it is very hard to argue with.
Blessing of Light Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Light should feel holy, revealing, protective, and emotionally uplifting. Use golden-white crowns, stained-glass flares, sunburst sigils, clean beams, and sanctuary halos. This blessing allows purification, revelation, radiant barriers, anti-undead force, morale beacons, and truth-lit scenes.

Blessing of Sound Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Sound Sovereignty
Blessing of Sound Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over voice, rhythm, vibration, silence, music, and the hidden structure of every impact. Sound becomes command, comfort, and weapon at once. This blessing lets your sound magic shatter brittle defenses, carry words across chaos, dampen noise, tune morale, disorient enemies, map spaces through echoes, and turn songs or spoken names into magical anchors. It excels at support, disruption, performance, and the dramatic power of being heard at exactly the right moment.
Blessing of Sound Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Sound should feel resonant, musical, and commandingly clear. Use ringing crowns, waveform halos, bell-light, vibrating sigils, sudden silence, and voice-as-magic moments. This blessing allows sonic shattering, silence fields, echo mapping, morale songs, disorientation, and voice projection.

Blessing of Space Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Space Sovereignty
Blessing of Space Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over distance, position, geometry, doors, and the impossible usefulness of being elsewhere. Space folds for you with clean obedience instead of tearing open. This blessing lets your space magic shorten movement, extend reach, open small gates, stash objects in pocket rooms, lock positions, redirect paths, and cut elegant spatial shortcuts. It's precise, controlled, and terrifying to anyone who believed distance could protect them.
Blessing of Space Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Space should feel clean, exact, and geometrically royal. Use silver-blue crowns, folded squares, gate rings, clean spatial grids, and elegant pocket-room imagery. This blessing allows short teleportation, pocket storage, distance folding, reach extension, position locks, and controlled gates.

Blessing of Storm Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Storm Sovereignty
Blessing of Storm Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over thunderheads, rain, pressure, windshear, sky wrath, and command presence. Storm isn't just lightning made bigger; it's the power to make the battlefield look up. This blessing lets your storm magic call down localized rain, crush morale with pressure drops, summon thunderclaps, empower allies with storm rhythm, disrupt flight, drown fire, and turn the air above a fight into a living weapon. It excels at battlefield-scale control and dramatic phase-change energy.
Blessing of Storm Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Storm should feel vast, commanding, and atmospheric. Use thundercloud crowns, violet-blue arcs, rain halos, pressure rings, and sky-darkening miracles. This blessing allows weather shaping, pressure control, thunder shockwaves, rain fields, flight disruption, and battlefield-wide elemental presence.

Blessing of Water Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Water Sovereignty
Blessing of Water Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over tides, purity, reflection, adaptability, and living flow. Water gathers around your will like a loyal court, changing shape without losing strength. This blessing lets your water magic cleanse poisons, cushion impact, bind enemies in pressure currents, spin up restorative healing-adjacent flows, read movement through ripples, and turn rivers, rain, bloodless moisture, or summoned water into elegant battlefield control. It excels at survival, recovery, mobility, purification, and turning an enemy's force aside instead of meeting it head-on.
Blessing of Water Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Water should feel adaptive, merciful, and impossible to truly grasp. Use rippling halos, pearl light, mirrored surfaces, pressure currents, cleansing waves, and tide-throne imagery. This blessing allows purification, impact cushioning, current control, temporary water constructs, battlefield redirection, and restorative flow scenes.

Blessing of the Burning Heart.name: Blessing of the Burning Heart
Blessing of the Burning Heart.description: Your passion is literal. The Blessing of the Burning Heart channels emotion into flame, the hotter you feel, the hotter you burn. Rage produces infernos. Determination produces controlled, focused heat that can cut through dragon scale. And when you care deeply enough about someone, your fire becomes protective, wrapping around allies as a warm shield instead of a destructive wave. Your fire has a personality because it IS your personality, expressed as an element.
Blessing of the Burning Heart.traitNarrativeEffects: Your body temperature runs dangerously hot when you're emotional and you've melted three mugs by holding them too tightly.

Blessing of the Constellation.name: Blessing of the Constellation
Blessing of the Constellation.description: The stars have named you. A celestial constellation, maybe ancient, maybe invented just for you, has written itself into your mana signature, granting bursts of prescient clarity, resistance to fate-altering magic, and occasional flashes of insight that feel less like intuition and more like someone whispering the answer from very far away. The constellation brightens and grows more complex as you do. Whether this is a blessing from a star god, a celestial navigation system, or something the universe is doing to you specifically stays unclear.
Blessing of the Constellation.traitNarrativeEffects: A faint pattern of stars is visible on your skin under moonlight, a constellation that doesn't match any known chart. It shifts position every few weeks, and Astrologers keep trying to read your shoulder blade.

Blessing of the Divine Shield.name: Blessing of the Divine Shield
Blessing of the Divine Shield.description: You are the shield between the world and everything that threatens it. The Blessing of the Divine Shield generates protective barriers of holy light, around yourself, around allies, around entire areas. Your barriers scale with your conviction, a half-hearted shield cracks under pressure, but a barrier raised to protect someone you love is nearly indestructible. At higher levels, you can create ward fields that heal allies inside them while damaging enemies. The Blessing's visual signature, radiant golden shields that bloom like wings, makes every defensive stand look like divine intervention. Because it might be.
Blessing of the Divine Shield.traitNarrativeEffects: A faint golden shimmer appears around you when someone nearby is in danger and you instinctively step in front of people.

Blessing of the Frozen Throne.name: Blessing of the Frozen Throne
Blessing of the Frozen Throne.description: You command cold at a level that transcends elemental magic. The Blessing of the Frozen Throne lets you flash-freeze enemies, create ice constructs of extraordinary complexity, and lower the temperature in an area to lethal levels with a thought. Your ice is not just frozen water, it's frozen possibility, crystallized into whatever shape your will demands. At higher levels, you can freeze concepts, movement, sound, even time in a localized area. Your composure and your power are directly linked, the calmer you are, the colder the world becomes.
Blessing of the Frozen Throne.traitNarrativeEffects: Drinks cool to the perfect temperature in your hand and your breath fogs even in summer.

Blessing of the Mirage Weaver.name: Blessing of the Mirage Weaver
Blessing of the Mirage Weaver.description: You become anyone. The Blessing of the Mirage Weaver lets you reshape your appearance, voice, mannerisms, and even your magical signature to impersonate anyone you've studied. Your disguises fool magical detection, slip past divination, and hold up in front of people who knew the original intimately. At higher levels you can throw illusory copies of yourself across distances, stand in several places at once, and build entire false environments. The Veilwalkers are desperate to recruit you. The question is whether the 'you' they're talking to is really you.
Blessing of the Mirage Weaver.traitNarrativeEffects: You see through every disguise instantly and your own face is surprisingly difficult for people to remember accurately.

Blessing of the Phantom Crown.name: Blessing of the Phantom Crown
Blessing of the Phantom Crown.description: Something, a dead god, a forgotten empire, an unkilled king, has placed a crown on you that doesn't physically exist but absolutely has weight. The Phantom Crown grants you an aura of authority that transcends social class, faction, and species. People listen when you speak. Monsters hesitate. Commands carry the force of someone who was born to rule, even if you were actually born in a ditch. The Crown doesn't make you a king. It makes everyone else treat you like one, which is either better or worse depending on how you feel about responsibility.
Blessing of the Phantom Crown.traitNarrativeEffects: A spectral crown materializes above your head during moments of authority, command, or intense emotion. It's invisible to most people. Nobles, spirits, and animals see it clearly and react accordingly.

Blessing of the Puppet Master.name: Blessing of the Puppet Master
Blessing of the Puppet Master.description: You pull the strings. The Blessing of the Puppet Master lets you build and control constructs: magical puppets, animated weapons, shadow familiars, and at higher levels enormous war-constructs that fight with borrowed skill. Your threads of mana are invisible, unbreakable, and reach across vast distances. You can run many constructs at once, coordinate them precisely, and route your senses through them. At its peak you can briefly puppet an enemy's own movements by hooking threads to their mana circuits. The Twilight Court calls this Blessing an art form. Everyone else calls it deeply unsettling.
Blessing of the Puppet Master.traitNarrativeEffects: Your fingers twitch when you see complex mechanisms and marionettes in market stalls turn their heads to look at you.

Blessing of the Silver Tongue.name: Blessing of the Silver Tongue
Blessing of the Silver Tongue.description: Your words carry divine weight. The Blessing of the Silver Tongue laces your voice with supernatural persuasion. It isn't mind control, just a resonance that makes people lean in, nod along, and fall into step behind you. You can talk a riot back down with one sentence, close deals that should be impossible, and at higher levels speak commands that reality itself feels obligated to obey. A Silver Tongue's ultimate technique is the Voice of Absolute Authority, a single spoken word that bypasses resistance entirely. The catch: the Blessing knows persuasion from manipulation, and it punishes a lie with temporary muteness.
Blessing of the Silver Tongue.traitNarrativeEffects: People agree with you slightly more than they should and you once talked a locked door into opening.

Blessing of the War God's Eye.name: Blessing of the War God's Eye
Blessing of the War God's Eye.description: You see everything that matters in combat. The Blessing of the War God's Eye grants supernatural tactical perception, you see weak points, predict attack trajectories, identify the strongest enemy in any group, and calculate the optimal counter to any technique after seeing it once. Your eye literally changes when active, glowing, marked with divine script, or shifting color depending on your emotional state. At higher levels, you see through feints perfectly, counter abilities you've never encountered before, and enter a combat trance where your body executes the perfect response faster than conscious thought. The quintessential cheat skill for a combat-focused protagonist.
Blessing of the War God's Eye.traitNarrativeEffects: You see combat openings in everyday movements and have instinctively dodged a falling apple in a way that frightened three bystanders.

Celestial Priestess Vestments.name: Celestial Priestess Vestments

Priestess's Flowing Vestments.description: Flowing white vestments with a golden sash and healer's insignia, dignified, calming, and fitted to a feminine silhouette. The kind of outfit that makes patients feel safe and enemies feel guilty.
Priestess's Flowing Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Holy Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Reincarnated Sage's Tracksuit.name: Reincarnated Sage's Tracksuit
Reincarnated Sage's Tracksuit.description: A plain track jacket and pants with a mysterious faint aura. The most unassuming outfit in the world, and somehow the strongest. Don't judge the fabric.
Reincarnated Sage's Tracksuit.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Otherworld Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Wandering Swordmaster's Haori.name: Wandering Swordmaster's Haori
Wandering Swordmaster's Haori.description: A wide-sleeved haori jacket worn open over a simple gi, with a sash-belt, sandals, and the quiet confidence of someone who carries a legendary blade and doesn't need to prove it. The fabric is travel-worn but fine, a gift from someone important, maintained with care. Wind catches the haori dramatically at all times.
Wandering Swordmaster's Haori.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Kimono and Sash; in play, describe what is worn now.

⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Mind.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Mind
⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Mind.description: A Reborn consciousness forged into both citadel and blade. Behind an iron lattice of will, mental compulsions and panic slide off you without finding purchase, while your own thoughts press outward with palpable psionic weight. You read micro-tremors of deceit in a heartbeat, hold cold clarity in the middle of slaughter, and turn sheer focus into a weapon that bends lesser wills.
⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Mind.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize the mind as fortress and psionic blade: unshakable focus, glamours and lies failing to hold, and quiet mental pressure when staring down foes.

Blessing of Nature Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Nature Sovereignty
Blessing of Nature Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over growth, beasts, roots, thorns, healing green, and ancient forest spirits. Nature doesn't simply grow near you, it picks sides. This blessing lets your nature magic race vines into motion, bloom medicinal plants, call roots to bind, thorns to defend, pollen to confuse, beasts to hesitate, and green sanctuaries to restore stamina and calm. It excels at living terrain, nonlethal control, survival, wilderness diplomacy, and the terrifying softness of a forest that loves you back.
Blessing of Nature Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Nature should feel alive, loyal, and ancient. Use leaf crowns, vine glyphs, spirit-bloom motes, thorn halos, pollen light, and animals going still in recognition. This blessing allows accelerated growth, root binding, thorn barriers, medicinal bloom, beast-calming, and living sanctuary scenes.

Blessing of Poison Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Poison Sovereignty
Blessing of Poison Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over venom, antidote, corrosion, miasma, medicine's dangerous twin, and the patience of a perfect dose. Poison becomes art instead of accident. This blessing lets your poison magic brew toxins from mana, neutralize common venoms, lace weapons or traps, shape miasma clouds, corrode armor, bring on weakness or sleep, and control exposure so allies are spared. It excels at attrition, assassination counters, battlefield denial, and knowing exactly how much is too much.
Blessing of Poison Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Poison should feel precise, elegant, and alchemical. Use jade-violet crowns, vial glyphs, serpent motifs, controlled miasma, droplet halos, and antidote/venom duality. This blessing allows toxin shaping, antidote work, miasma control, corrosion, status effects, and ally-safe dosage control.

Blessing of Shadow Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Shadow Sovereignty
Blessing of Shadow Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over concealment, silence, hidden paths, silhouettes, and the mercy of not being seen. Shadow bends around you like a cloak that knows your name. This blessing lets your shadow magic hide allies, soften footsteps, bind enemy shadows, spin decoys from darkness, slip through dim spaces, and turn cover into a tactical resource. It isn't corruption; it's the holy right to move unseen.
Blessing of Shadow Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Shadow should feel elegant, protective, and stealth-focused rather than evil. Use black-silver crowns, soft-edged halos, silhouette doubles, veil-cloaks, and quiet shadow paths. This blessing allows concealment, shadow binds, decoys, stealth movement, ally cover, and dim-space traversal.

Blessing of the Abyssal Hunger.name: Blessing of the Abyssal Hunger
Blessing of the Abyssal Hunger.description: You consume power. The Blessing of the Abyssal Hunger lets you absorb magical energy: eating spells thrown at you, draining mana from enemies on contact, and turning what you swallow into your own strength. At higher levels you can devour Blessings for a time, borrowing the abilities of anyone you've drained. The power is intoxicating and dangerous. The more you consume, the hungrier you get, and the Blessing keeps whispering that there's always more to take. Every faction is terrified of you. The Twilight Court finds you fascinating. The hunger never stops.
Blessing of the Abyssal Hunger.traitNarrativeEffects: You absorb ambient mana without trying and mages standing next to you feel faintly drained, you've been asked to 'stand over there' during group meditation.

The ponytail swings during combat with devastating visual impact. This is the hairstyle of confident fighters, athletic heroines, and anyone who wants to look powerful and beautiful simultaneously.
High Ponytail with Bangs Frame.traitNarrativeEffects: Your ponytail has a signature swing during combat that your party members have started unconsciously watching for. It means you're about to do something incredible.

Knight-Errant's Questing Armor.name: Knight-Errant's Questing Armor
