⚡ Reborn Body: Ki Furnace.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Ki Furnace
⚡ Reborn Body: Ki Furnace.description: A Reborn body where the weapon is redundant. Your fists hit like warhammers, your elbows cut like blades, and your stance is rooted like a mountain that learned to throw hands. Ki circulates through you like a banked forge, and every martial art you encounter feels like a dialect of a language you already speak. Monks want to study you. Brawlers want to avoid you. Dojos quietly update their enrollment posters.
⚡ Reborn Body: Ki Furnace.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize the body as weapon. Warhammer fists, rooted stances, ki burning in every strike, devastating unarmed technique. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Abyss.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Abyss
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Abyss.description: A Reborn soul with a mana well so deep it has a pull of its own. The bottom of it is not power but absence: other people's spells thin out near you, candles lean toward you, scrying returns static, and when you open the well on purpose, barriers and enchantments are simply gone. Your reserves eclipse war mages. Institutions will want to study you, recruit you or contain you, and the smart ones will try all three. Take it to be the one other mages are afraid to stand beside.
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Abyss.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize a depth that swallows: nearby spells thinning, light leaning in, a quiet that other mages feel. Vast reserves. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Ember.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Ember
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Ember.description: A Reborn soul with a small fire where the mana circuits should be. The reserve is modest, more than a commoner's and well short of a trained mage's, but it runs hot. Fire comes when you call it: down the length of a blade, off the end of a thrown spear, through a doorway you need cleared. You will never be the party's main caster. You are the fighter who also burns, and opponents who read you as purely physical find that out once. Take it to be the one who opens with steel and finishes with fire.
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Ember.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize a small, hot reserve: fire along a weapon, a spark in a fistfight, heat that never quite goes out. Modest volume, quick to use. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

Blessing of Crystal Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Crystal Sovereignty
Blessing of Crystal Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over crystal, resonance, facets, hard beauty, memory lattices, and refracted power. Crystal grows at your command with the elegance of a cathedral window and the cruelty of a spear. This blessing lets your crystal magic raise prism shields, store light or mana, refract hostile spells, grow bridges or cages, build singing resonance structures, and turn gems into spell foci. It excels at defense, precision, reflection, and making beauty dangerously structural.
Blessing of Crystal Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Crystal should feel beautiful, hard, resonant, and architectural. Use prism crowns, faceted halos, stained-light shards, resonance lattices, and gem-growth geometry. This blessing allows prism barriers, spell refraction, crystal cages, mana storage, bridge growth, and resonance structures.

Blessing of Gravity Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Gravity Sovereignty
Blessing of Gravity Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over weight, pressure, orbit, falling stars, and inevitable force. Gravity doesn't explode; it insists. This blessing lets your gravity magic pin enemies, lighten allies, redirect projectiles, crush armor, bend movement arcs, set stones into orbit, and turn a single step into a burden or a leap into flight. It excels at control, anti-mobility, heavy strikes, and making the battlefield remember which way down is.
Blessing of Gravity Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Gravity should feel inevitable, heavy, and cosmic. Use black-gold crowns, orbiting stones, pressure rings, lensing distortion, floating debris, and falling-star imagery. This blessing allows weight control, ally lightening, enemy pinning, projectile redirection, orbital shields, and crushing force.

Blessing of the Living Fortress.name: Blessing of the Living Fortress
Blessing of the Living Fortress.description: Your body has been blessed by something ancient and patient, a mountain spirit, a fortress that achieved divinity, a god of walls and thresholds. The Living Fortress blessing makes you supernaturally durable: not just hard to hurt, but hard to move, hard to bypass, and hard to ignore. Your defensive instincts are automatic. Your body hardens under impact. Allies behind you take reduced damage. You are, in the most literal sense, a person-shaped wall, and the wall has feelings about who gets to pass.
Blessing of the Living Fortress.traitNarrativeEffects: Your heartbeat sounds like a drum to anyone pressing their ear to your chest. Walls feel thinner when you're near them. You've accidentally reinforced a crumbling building just by leaning on it.

Isekai Hero's Otherworld Attire.name: Isekai Hero's Otherworld Attire
Isekai Hero's Otherworld Attire.description: Modern clothes mixed with fantasy armor, a hoodie under a breastplate, sneakers with greaves, and a confused but determined expression. You got isekai'd and you're making it work.
Isekai Hero's Otherworld Attire.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Breastplate and Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Looks Like They Need Protecting.name: Looks Like They Need Protecting
Looks Like They Need Protecting.description: At first glance you seem softer, younger, or less dangerous than you really are. Protective NPCs step closer and companions develop immediate guard-dog instincts. The mistake is assuming that needing protection and being capable are opposites.
Looks Like They Need Protecting.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION REFERENCE: Kind strangers and companions want to protect and fuss over the protagonist on sight. Use this as a social hook; never remove the protagonist's competence or agency.

Pirate Captain's Tricorn Attire.description: A weathered tricorn hat, long coat with brass buttons, a sash belt, and boots that have walked a hundred docks. The sea claims its own.
Pirate Captain's Tricorn Attire.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Seafarer's Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

Spellblade's Enchanted Leathers.description: Fitted leather armor with glowing enchantment lines, a paired sword harness, and boots made for lunging. For those who cast with one hand and cut with the other.
Spellblade's Enchanted Leathers.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Adventurer's Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Summoner's Spirit-Threaded Robe.description: A spirit-threaded robe woven with summoning circles and spirit-channeling runes, flowing, mystical, and the kind of outfit that makes spirits pay attention.
Summoner's Spirit-Threaded Robe.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Witch's Wide-Brim Hat and Cloak.name: Witch's Wide-Brim Hat and Cloak
Witch's Wide-Brim Hat and Cloak.description: The iconic witch silhouette, a dramatically wide-brimmed pointed hat, a long flowing cloak with celestial or botanical embroidery, a corset or structured bodice, layered skirts with hidden pockets, and boots made for walking through enchanted forests. The hat is sentient. Probably.
Witch's Wide-Brim Hat and Cloak.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now. The hat is load-bearing for the silhouette, always render it prominently.

⚡ Reborn Body: Apex Senses.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Apex Senses
⚡ Reborn Body: Apex Senses.description: A Reborn body with unnervingly sharp perception. You notice things others miss, the slight tension in a shoulder before an ambush, the hidden seam in a dungeon wall, the lie in someone's voice that their poker face almost concealed. Your senses are dialed past normal human range and your mind processes the input faster than it should, turning raw perception into tactical awareness in real time. You are the one who spots the trap, identifies the assassin in the crowd, reads the room before anyone else has finished scanning it, and casually mentions that the wine was poisoned before anyone took a second sip. Party members learn to trust your hunches. Enemies learn to hate the fact that surprise attacks simply do not work on you.
⚡ Reborn Body: Apex Senses.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize preternatural perception. Noticing tells, hidden seams, ambushes, and lies before others. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Arcane Core.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Arcane Core
⚡ Reborn Body: Arcane Core.description: A Reborn soul with a mana core that understands magic the way a mechanic understands an engine. Spell theory clicks the first time. You see how a casting is put together, where it is weak, and how to take it apart while it is still in the air; counterspells and dispels come to you before fireballs do. Other mages sense your core and get quiet. Academy examiners recalibrate the crystal twice. You are not the biggest pool in the room, only the one who knows exactly what everyone else is doing. Take it to be the one who takes other people's spells apart.
⚡ Reborn Body: Arcane Core.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize spell comprehension: reading a casting's structure at a glance, counters and dispels that come easily, arcane endurance. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Holy Vessel.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Holy Vessel
⚡ Reborn Body: Holy Vessel.description: A Reborn body that shelters. It conducts sacred energy like a living cathedral, and like a cathedral it is built to keep people safe inside. Your prayers carry weight, wards you raise hold longer than they should, and hostile magic recoils from you like flame from holy water. You are sturdier than a priest has any right to be, steady when the line breaks, and able to take a wound that was meant for someone else. You can mend, the way anyone who prays can, but that is not what this body is for. Take it to be the one standing in front.
⚡ Reborn Body: Holy Vessel.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize shelter. Prayers with weight, wards that hold, hostile magic guttering nearby, a body that stays standing between harm and the people behind it. Its healing is ordinary prayer and never the point. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Spring.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Spring
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Spring.description: A Reborn soul whose mana comes back faster than any natural mechanism should allow. The pool is large, but the recovery is what makes researchers drop their notes: what you spend now you have back in minutes, and it returns like water rising in a spring, cool and steady. Rain answers you, wounds wash clean, and you can keep a tired party on its feet through a long fight. The cost is a body that cannot take the hits your mana shrugs off. Take it to be the one who is still casting when everyone else is empty.
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Spring.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize recovery: reserves refilling between spells, cool water and rain answering, a calm that outlasts the fight. Fragile body. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Regenerator.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Regenerator
⚡ Reborn Body: Regenerator.description: A Reborn body that simply does not stop recovering. Your health regenerates at a rate that makes healers suspicious, cuts close in minutes, bruises fade before they're noticed, and you bounce back from injuries that would keep normal adventurers bedridden for weeks. You're not the toughest to hit, but you're the hardest to keep down. If the fight goes long, you win by attrition.
⚡ Reborn Body: Regenerator.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize suspicious recovery. Cuts closing in minutes, exhaustion shrugged off, healers double-checking their work. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

Blessing of Illusion Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Illusion Sovereignty
Blessing of Illusion Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over perception, glamour, decoys, false distance, and believable unreality. Illusion obeys you by turning useful instead of merely pretty. This blessing lets your illusion magic conjure convincing doubles, hide wounds or disguises, throw off enemy aim, build false terrain, cloak allies in glamour, and make opponents waste their best moves on something that was never there. It's the power to decide what the enemy thinks the scene is.
Blessing of Illusion Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Illusion should feel clever, beautiful, and tactically cruel without becoming dream magic. Use prism crowns, mirror doubles, stage-light halos, false terrain, shimmer veils, and elegant misdirection. This blessing allows decoys, glamour cloaks, aim distortion, false terrain, disguise polish, and sensory misdirection.

Blessing of the Shattered Mirror.name: Blessing of the Shattered Mirror
Blessing of the Shattered Mirror.description: Reality is your canvas and deception is your art. The Blessing of the Shattered Mirror lets you spin perfect duplicates of yourself, lay false realities over the real world, and bend perception so thoroughly that your illusions deal real damage, because the target's brain refuses to believe they aren't real. At its peak you can fracture how a person sees reality itself, showing them a world where they've already lost. The Blessing grows through creativity: the more imaginative the deception, the stronger it gets.
Blessing of the Shattered Mirror.traitNarrativeEffects: Mirrors show your reflection a half-second delayed and you occasionally see things in reflective surfaces that aren't behind you.

Elementalist's Channeling Attire.name: Elementalist's Channeling Attire
Elementalist's Channeling Attire.description: Robes or light armor themed to a single element, crystalline frost-thread for ice, ember-silk for fire, storm-blessed cloth for lightning. The element is the aesthetic.
Elementalist's Channeling Attire.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Eye Pattern - Full Heterochromia.name: Eye Pattern - Full Heterochromia
Eye Pattern - Full Heterochromia.description: Full Heterochromia as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Full Heterochromia.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply full heterochromia to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Loose Romantic Waves with Flower.name: Loose Romantic Waves with Flower
Loose Romantic Waves with Flower.description: Soft, flowing waves adorned with a single fresh flower, a blossom tucked behind one ear or pinned near the temple. Romantic, gentle, and impossibly pretty. The flower always looks freshly picked regardless of how long it's been there, because this is an isekai and beauty has a preservation enchantment.
Loose Romantic Waves with Flower.traitNarrativeEffects: The flower in your hair is always fresh. Always. Even after three days in a dungeon. Nobody questions this anymore.

Prison Tower Cell with Moon View.name: Prison Tower Cell with Moon View
Prison Tower Cell with Moon View.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A stone prison cell high in a tower, sparse furnishings, chain marks on the walls, but a single tall window that frames a stunning view of the full moon and the night sky. The contrast between captivity and the infinite sky creates something unexpectedly beautiful and dramatic.
Prison Tower Cell with Moon View.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Shrine Maiden's Ceremonial Robes.name: Shrine Maiden's Ceremonial Robes
Shrine Maiden's Ceremonial Robes.description: Traditional white kimono with crimson hakama, spirit-flowing ribbons, and a bell-adorned staff. Pure, sacred, and not to be underestimated.
Shrine Maiden's Ceremonial Robes.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Shrine Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Street Clothes: Modern Reborn.name: Street Clothes: Modern Reborn
Street Clothes: Modern Reborn.description: Modern street clothes worn by someone from another world, jeans, sneakers, a graphic tee or hoodie that doesn't belong in Luxcellia at all. The kind of outfit that makes locals stare and tailors weep.
Street Clothes: Modern Reborn.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Otherworld Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Conduit.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Conduit
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Conduit.description: A Reborn soul whose mana circuits are built like a lightning rod: clean, fast and well grounded. Power moves through you without loss and arrives exactly where you aim it, a heartbeat before anyone expected. Your reserves are solid rather than vast, but nothing is wasted, and lightning is the first thing that ever came easily. Professors call your system well architected. Combat mages call you fast. Take it to be the caster whose power lands first and lands where it was meant to.
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Conduit.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize clean, fast throughput: static at the fingertips, lightning that goes where it is aimed, no wasted mana. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Phantom Edge.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Phantom Edge
⚡ Reborn Body: Phantom Edge.description: A Reborn body wired for lethal precision. You see the gap in a guard before it opens, your blade finds the seam in armor like water finds a crack, and your strikes land where they hurt most with minimum effort. You're not the strongest fighter, you're the one who never needs to be. One clean cut is worth a hundred wild swings.
⚡ Reborn Body: Phantom Edge.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize lethal precision. Reading gaps before they open, strikes finding seams in armor, exactness over force. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Primal Blood.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Primal Blood
⚡ Reborn Body: Primal Blood.description: A body reforged around the oldest law of the wild: eat or be eaten. Where Beast Blood lends animal senses, Primal Blood remakes you as an apex hunter whose hands and jaws know how to tear through hide and bone before thought catches up. Your stride is silent, your stomach turns raw meat and bitter roots into iron endurance, and lesser predators yield the trail when they catch your wind.
⚡ Reborn Body: Primal Blood.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize apex-hunter physicality: tearing close-quarters violence, weathered wilderness endurance, and lesser beasts yielding the path. No unstated active powers.

Blessing of Lightning Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Lightning Sovereignty
Blessing of Lightning Sovereignty.description: Divine mastery over speed, judgment, nerves, brilliance, and sudden impact. Lightning doesn't merely strike for you, it reaches the guilty first. This blessing lets your lightning magic flash-step across short openings, stun nerves without killing, chain between marked targets, overload constructs, sharpen reaction time, and land judgment-bolt finishers that arrive before witnesses finish gasping. It's the element of decisive action, not weather.
Blessing of Lightning Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Lightning should feel fast, bright, judgmental, and exact. Use blue-white crowns, branching halos, crisp sparks, nerve-flash imagery, and judgment bolts. This blessing allows flash movement, stunning, chain arcs, reaction acceleration, construct overload, and single-target divine impact.

Chuunibyou's Dark Ceremonial Garb.name: Chuunibyou's Dark Ceremonial Garb
Chuunibyou's Dark Ceremonial Garb.description: An eyepatch, bandaged arm, a flowing black coat covered in self-applied seals, and a gauntlet on the "cursed" hand. The darkness is real to you and that's what matters.
Chuunibyou's Dark Ceremonial Garb.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Occult Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Eye Pattern - Alien Compound Eyes.name: Eye Pattern - Alien Compound Eyes
Eye Pattern - Alien Compound Eyes.description: Alien Compound Eyes as a fantasy eye detail that adds identity without muddying the gaze. Keep the pattern crisp, symmetrical where appropriate, and readable in close-up portrait art.
Eye Pattern - Alien Compound Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: PORTRAIT DETAIL ONLY: Apply alien compound eyes to the eyes. Use primary and secondary eye colors if selected. Do not turn this into active power use unless Glowing Eyes or the typed appearance explicitly calls for a permanent glow.

Long Hair with Single Front Braid.name: Long Hair with Single Front Braid
Long Hair with Single Front Braid.description: Long flowing hair with one thin braid hanging in front of the ear or along the face, a subtle, distinctive detail that catches the eye. Common in fantasy cultures as a mark of coming-of-age, a warrior's oath, or a promise to someone. The braid means something, and the right people know what.
Long Hair with Single Front Braid.traitNarrativeEffects: People from certain cultures notice your braid immediately and treat you differently. You've never explained why to your party members.

Night Market Under Paper Lanterns.name: Night Market Under Paper Lanterns
Night Market Under Paper Lanterns.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A vibrant night market illuminated by hundreds of paper lanterns in warm colors, food stalls with fragrant steam rising, trinket vendors, fortune tellers, street performers, crowds of happy people from every race, and the magical atmosphere of a festival evening where anything feels possible.
Night Market Under Paper Lanterns.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

Royal Knight Captain's Ceremonial.name: Royal Knight Captain's Ceremonial
Royal Knight Captain's Ceremonial.description: Immaculate white-and-gold plate armor polished to a mirror shine, with a full-length cape bearing the royal crest, a ceremonial sword, plumed helm carried under one arm, and the ramrod posture of someone who protects the crown with their life and their wardrobe. This is armor that has never seen a speck of mud and somehow never will.
Royal Knight Captain's Ceremonial.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Knightly Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Wedding Chapel of the First Light.name: Wedding Chapel of the First Light
Wedding Chapel of the First Light.description: MUST FOLLOW DESCRIPTION, BACKGROUND IS ABSOLUTE FOR PORTRAIT GENERATION: A beautiful chapel dedicated to the Church of the First Light, white stone, golden stained glass depicting love stories, flower arrangements in the aisle, warm candlelight, and an altar beneath an arched window that catches the setting sun. Designed for vows, confessions, and the kind of moments that change lives.
Wedding Chapel of the First Light.traitNarrativeEffects: BACKGROUND STYLE LOCK: portrait background only, no stats.

⚡ Reborn Body: Blade Prodigy.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Blade Prodigy
⚡ Reborn Body: Blade Prodigy.description: A Reborn body that understands blades rather than merely swinging them. Your hands find the perfect grip instinctively, your stance self-corrects before your conscious mind catches up, and every weapon you pick up feels made for your reach. You don't overpower opponents, you out-technique them. A duel is a conversation, and your body speaks every dialect.
⚡ Reborn Body: Blade Prodigy.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize instinctive blade mastery. Perfect grip, self-correcting stance, muscle memory that precedes thought. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Fortress.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Fortress
⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Fortress.description: A Reborn body that simply refuses to go down. Your constitution borders on mythical, you shrug off blows that would flatten veteran knights, recover from injuries at alarming speed, and treat poison as a mild inconvenience that ruins lunch but not the rest of your day. Healers love you because you're easy to patch up and never complain. Enemies hate you because nothing seems to work, not the big hits, not the poison, not the attrition, not the finishing blow they were absolutely certain was going to land this time. You're the protagonist who stands in the middle of the blast zone, dusts off, and asks if there's more. Your hit points are less a number and more a philosophical statement about your refusal to acknowledge mortality.
⚡ Reborn Body: Iron Fortress.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize durability, stamina, and refusal to drop. Still narrate pain, stakes, and consequences.

⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Overflow.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Overflow
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Overflow.description: A Reborn soul carrying more mana than one body is built to hold, and it spills. Fire, frost, wind and stone leak out of you when you stop holding them in, and when you let go on purpose they arrive in torrents. Instruments made for ley lines register you. You can power rituals alone, run enchanted devices that need a dedicated source, and push a spell past what it was designed to carry. Every faction in Luxcellia knows what a living battery is worth. Take it to be the one with more power than sense, and the elements to prove it.
⚡ Reborn Body: Mana Overflow.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize vast reserves that spill into the elements: frost on the cup, sparks in the hair, the air heavy with mana. Still deduct mana costs and respect exhaustion after extreme use.

⚡ Reborn Body: Silver Tongue.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Silver Tongue
⚡ Reborn Body: Silver Tongue.description: A Reborn presence that makes people listen, trust, and remember you. Your voice carries natural authority that transcends language barriers, your expressions read as genuine even when calculated, and your social instincts translate flawlessly across cultural divides that trip up veteran diplomats. Nobles find you interesting without knowing why. Merchants cut you deals and feel good about it. Enemies hesitate before attacking someone this likeable, and that hesitation is usually all you need. Guild receptionists give you better quest recommendations. Interrogation targets start talking before you ask. You're the protagonist whose greatest weapon isn't in a sheath, it's the fact that everyone you meet wants to be on your side, and the ones who don't can't quite articulate their objection.
⚡ Reborn Body: Silver Tongue.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize memorable presence, social magnetism, and smooth communication. No mind control beyond listed abilities.

⚡ Reborn Body: Speed Phantom.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Speed Phantom
⚡ Reborn Body: Speed Phantom.description: A Reborn body wired for speed, reflexes, and precision. Your reaction time borders on precognitive, you see the attack coming before the attacker has committed to it, and your body is already somewhere else. Your joints bend further than they should, your footwork makes trained duelists look like they're wading through honey, and at full sprint you leave afterimages that confuse tracking spells. Assassins, scouts, and acrobats would kill for your natural agility, and some of them might try. The first time someone swings at you and hits nothing but air, they assume luck. The third time, they start sweating. You're the protagonist who doesn't need to be the strongest person in the fight, just the one nobody can touch.
⚡ Reborn Body: Speed Phantom.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize speed, reflexes, balance, and blur-like motion. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

Blessing of the Absolute Territory.name: Blessing of the Absolute Territory
Blessing of the Absolute Territory.description: Space belongs to you. The Blessing of the Absolute Territory grants dominion over a defined area, and inside your territory you own distance, direction, and dimension. You can stretch corridors, crush rooms smaller, send projectiles back the way they came, and at higher levels carve pocket dimensions that run on rules you set. Your ultimate technique raises a Domain, a bounded space where physics answers to your will instead of nature's. Inside it, you're effectively omnipotent. Outside it, you're an extremely talented spatial mage. The bigger the Domain, the more mana it drinks, and holding it demands concentration that leaves you open to disruption. The highest ceiling. The most dramatic fights.
Blessing of the Absolute Territory.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively know the exact dimensions of any room you enter and nothing enters your personal space unless you allow it.

⚡ Reborn Body: Living Arsenal.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Living Arsenal
⚡ Reborn Body: Living Arsenal.description: A Reborn body that treats every weapon like an old friend. Sword, spear, bow, bare knuckles, it doesn't matter. The moment you grip something designed to hurt people, your body knows what to do with it. You're not the best with any single weapon. You're dangerously competent with all of them. Specialists beat you in their domain. Outside of it, you're the nightmare.
⚡ Reborn Body: Living Arsenal.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize universal weapon fluency. Any armament feels familiar the moment it's gripped. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Warrior Vessel.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Warrior Vessel
⚡ Reborn Body: Warrior Vessel.description: A Reborn body built for hitting hard and standing tall. Your muscles carry otherworldly density, your bones resist impacts that would flatten veteran knights, and your physical presence makes sparring partners reconsider their life choices. When you grip a weapon, the weight feels right in a way that experienced soldiers spend years chasing. Your endurance outlasts opponents who rely on speed, you don't tire, you don't flinch, and when you plant your feet, the ground seems to agree with your decision to stay. Trainers see your form and assume you've been drilling since childhood. Veterans see your durability and stop asking questions. Pair this with a narrative cheat skill for the full isekai protagonist experience, or double down on a second stat package for raw physical dominance that makes the local adventurer guild recalibrate their ranking exam.
⚡ Reborn Body: Warrior Vessel.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize raw strength, impact resistance, and heroic physical presence. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Battle Instinct.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Battle Instinct
⚡ Reborn Body: Battle Instinct.description: A Reborn body tuned for combat versatility. Strength and speed in equal measure, reflexes that adapt mid-fight, and the durability to survive mistakes while you learn from them. You're equally comfortable with a blade, a bow, or your fists, your body doesn't specialize because it doesn't need to. Combat instructors call you a natural. Combat veterans call you dangerous.
⚡ Reborn Body: Battle Instinct.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize combat adaptation, weapon comfort, and fast learning under pressure. Do not grant automatic victory.

Guild Receptionist's Pressed Uniform.description: A clean, polished receptionist uniform with premium fantasy-office appeal: neat tailoring, subtle elegance, and the exact sort of look that says this person knows every quest in town and is somehow still hotter than necessary.

⚡ Reborn Body: Balanced Prodigy.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Balanced Prodigy
⚡ Reborn Body: Balanced Prodigy.description: A Reborn body that's good at everything and terrible at nothing. You're not the strongest, fastest, or smartest person in any room, but you're always second or third, and that consistency is its own kind of terrifying. Versatility is your weapon, adaptability is your armor, and specialists who try to exploit your weakness discover you don't have one worth targeting. Swordsmen can't out-technique you long enough to land a decisive blow. Mages can't outlast your mixed defenses. Tanks can't ignore your damage output. You're the protagonist who wins by refusing to play anyone else's game, and your party members keep forgetting to worry about you because you never seem to need help, which is either reassuring or deeply suspicious, depending on who you ask. Jack of every trade: on top of the even attributes it carries a working grounding in six everyday skills (survival, investigation, Insight, persuasion, Stealth and Focus) that no specialist body bothers with.

Cheat Heal EX.name: Cheat Heal EX
Cheat Heal EX.description: You heal injuries that should be permanent. Severed limbs reattach. Curses unravel. Diseases that shrugged off every known remedy surrender to your touch. Cheat Heal EX is the divine-tier support skill that makes the Church want to canonize you or brand you a heretical anomaly, sometimes both in the same meeting. At higher levels you can heal emotional trauma, purify spiritual corruption, mend broken magical circuits, and drag someone back from the edge of death with enough determination and a dramatic enough speech. Healers who spent decades mastering Divinity watch you casually fix something they couldn't and feel a very specific emotion. Your companions have stopped being careful because 'the protagonist will just heal it' is now a viable combat strategy, and you find this both flattering and deeply concerning.
Cheat Heal EX.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hands glow faintly warm when anyone nearby is injured, including strangers across the room. You've instinctively caught falling children, bandaged paper cuts mid-conversation, and once healed a stray cat's broken leg before you realized you were doing it.

Summon Sovereign.name: Summon Sovereign
Summon Sovereign.description: You summon entities that shouldn't be summonable. While normal summoners call wisps and minor elementals and feel accomplished, you accidentally called a dragon on your first attempt and had to talk it into going back. Summon Sovereign is the cheat skill for summoners who skip the tutorial and go straight to the endgame catalog. Your summoned entities are too powerful, too loyal, and too suspiciously willing to follow your orders. At higher levels, you can summon conceptual entities: embodiments of flame, fragments of sealed gods, echoes of ancient heroes, and things from between dimensions that scholars insist shouldn't exist. The entities you call tend to become attached, which means your summon roster reads less like a combat tool and more like a collection of overpowered friends who happen to live in another dimension.
Summon Sovereign.traitNarrativeEffects: Small spirits and minor creatures appear around you uninvited, as if drawn to your presence. You've woken up surrounded by fairy lights, found a phoenix nesting in your bag, and had a shadow elemental follow you home like a stray dog.

Forbidden Resonance.name: Forbidden Resonance
Forbidden Resonance.description: You have a natural affinity for magic that's been banned, sealed, or deliberately forgotten. Forbidden grimoires open for you. Sealed techniques activate when you're in danger. Ancient prohibited spell circles complete themselves when you stand inside them. The world has very specific rules about what magic you're not supposed to use, and your soul didn't get the memo. Forbidden Resonance isn't evil, it's amoral. The magic itself doesn't care about classifications. Fire magic isn't 'darker' than blood magic to your cheat skill; they're all just tools. This makes the Church nervous, the Academy fascinated, and the Twilight Court very interested in offering you a research position. At higher levels, you can sense and unravel magical seals, access restricted knowledge by proximity, and combine forbidden techniques in ways that make magical theorists rewrite their textbooks.
Forbidden Resonance.traitNarrativeEffects: Sealed doors crack open when you lean against them. Restricted sections of libraries somehow fail to notice you walking in. Ancient wards flicker and let you pass while flagging everyone else. Librarians have started watching you with suspicious intensity.

Beast Sovereign.name: Beast Sovereign
Beast Sovereign.description: Animals, monsters, and magical creatures recognize you as something above them in the hierarchy: not a tamer, not a trainer, but a sovereign. Hostile creatures lower their aggression when you make eye contact. Wild beasts approach voluntarily and form bonds without the usual taming rituals. Even dungeon monsters hesitate. Beast Sovereign isn't mind control, it's recognition. Something in your aura speaks authority in a language that predates speech. At higher levels, apex predators show deference, bonded creatures evolve faster than their species normally allows, and you can communicate complex intentions to any creature through emotional resonance. Monster girl companions find this ability extremely attractive for reasons they refuse to articulate. Beast tamers who spent years training their partners watch a dragon nuzzle your hand on first meeting and experience professional crisis.
Beast Sovereign.traitNarrativeEffects: Every animal you've ever encountered has either tried to follow you home or fallen asleep in your lap. Birds land on your shoulders. Cats appear from nowhere and demand attention. You once made accidental eye contact with a dungeon boss and it sat down.

Shadow System.name: Shadow System
Shadow System.description: You have a second set of stats that activates when you're unseen. In darkness, in ambush, or when attacking from stealth, your combat parameters don't just gain a bonus, they multiply. You're a competent fighter in the open and an absolute nightmare in the shadows. Shadow System is the cheat skill for the protagonist who prefers the anime moment where the villain monologues about victory and then the hero's voice comes from behind them saying 'are you sure?' Your stealth attacks deal damage that makes assassin guilds reconsider their recruitment standards. At higher levels, you can carry the shadow-state into brief bursts of open combat, creating flickering moments where you seem to exist in two places, visible and invisible, at once. Enemies who survive fighting you in the dark develop a very reasonable phobia.
Shadow System.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively step into shadows without realizing it. People lose track of you mid-conversation when you stand near a pillar. You've accidentally frightened companions by being 'suddenly there' when you were there the entire time.

Encore Performance.name: Encore Performance
Encore Performance.description: You can replay your best moments. Land a perfect combo? Your body remembers and can reproduce it on demand. Execute a critical dodge that saved your life? It's now in your permanent repertoire. Encore Performance records your peak moments, combat, social, magical, athletic, and lets you call them back with perfect fidelity. Your fighting style is a highlight reel that keeps growing. At higher levels, you can 'replay' entire combat sequences, stack multiple recorded performances into impossible combination attacks, and even replay the emotional intensity of a breakthrough moment to re-trigger abilities that activated during it. The more dramatic your life gets, the stronger your library becomes. Rivals who beat you once discover that the rematch is against every version of you that has ever existed.
Encore Performance.traitNarrativeEffects: You occasionally repeat a perfect movement from a previous fight without meaning to, catching a falling cup with the exact motion you used to parry a blade, or dodging a playful shove with the footwork you used to evade an assassination attempt. Companions find this alternately impressive and startling.

Unbreakable Vanguard.name: Unbreakable Vanguard
Unbreakable Vanguard.description: You can't be moved, can't be knocked down, can't be pushed back, and anything standing behind you is safe. Unbreakable Vanguard is the cheat skill for the tank protagonist, the one who walks into the dragon's breath and asks 'is that it?' while the party attacks from safety. Your defense isn't just high, it's conceptual. Knockback fails. Grapple attempts bounce. Displacement magic fizzles against your position. You refuse to yield and reality goes along with it. At higher levels you can extend an absolute defensive zone around nearby allies, not a barrier, but an area where your 'I will not be moved' aura radiates outward and makes everything around you harder to displace. Enemies who specialize in scattering formations discover that you are the line and you are not being moved. Healers love you. Party members feel invincible behind you. Siege weapons look at you and feel inadequate.
Unbreakable Vanguard.traitNarrativeEffects: You have never been knocked over. Not once. Not by surprise attacks, not by explosions, not by that time the floor collapsed. People have started trying as a game and you've become a minor tavern legend for it.

Resonance Bard.name: Resonance Bard
Resonance Bard.description: Your music carries supernatural weight. Songs buff allies beyond what enhancement magic should allow. Ballads debilitate enemies who hear them. Your performances stir emotional responses so intense they border on mind control, but they're not. They're just that good. Resonance Bard is the cheat skill for the protagonist who fights with a lute and somehow wins. Your battle anthems make allies fight like legends. Your dirges drain enemy morale until they reconsider their life choices. Your love songs make entire taverns cry, and your victory themes have set off spontaneous celebrations in people who weren't even watching the fight. At higher levels, your music can heal wounds, break enchantments, shatter magical barriers, and briefly rewrite the emotional state of an entire battlefield. You are the walking soundtrack of your own adventure, and the universe has decided to let that be a weapon.
Resonance Bard.traitNarrativeEffects: You hum without realizing it, and the hum matches the mood of whatever's about to happen with suspicious accuracy. People near you have started using your unconscious humming as an early warning system.

⚡ Reborn Body: Healer's Vessel.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Healer's Vessel
⚡ Reborn Body: Healer's Vessel.description: A Reborn body that mends. Restorative energy moves through you like breath, and your hands run warm before you have cast anything. You feel an injury in the room the way other people hear a shout. Wounds you touch close cleaner than potions manage, and you know which root draws a poison and which only tastes like it should. Temple healers assume decades of training, then go quiet when they learn there were none. This is not a sturdy body. It was made for the minute after the blow, when someone has to still be breathing and you are the reason they are. Take it to be the one who brings people back.
⚡ Reborn Body: Healer's Vessel.traitNarrativeEffects: CHEAT BODY RULE: Emphasize mending. Hands that glow faintly near an injury, wounds closing clean, poisons named and drawn, a calm that slows panic, hurt animals seeking this person out. This body is not sturdy: it works behind the line and after the blow. No new active powers beyond listed stats/resources.

⚡ Reborn Body: Shadow Vessel.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Shadow Vessel
⚡ Reborn Body: Shadow Vessel.description: A Reborn body built for silence, speed, and the kind of precision that makes assassination look like an art form. Your footsteps don't make sound unless you want them to. Your reflexes respond to threats your conscious mind hasn't processed yet. You move through shadows like you were born in them, which, in a sense, you were. This body doesn't fight fair and it doesn't apologize. Your perception catches details that scouts miss, your dexterity lets you navigate spaces that shouldn't fit a human body, and your presence is forgettable in exactly the way an assassin's should be. You're the protagonist who was put into a body designed for the shadows, and the shadows seem grateful.
⚡ Reborn Body: Shadow Vessel.traitNarrativeEffects: You move silently by default and have to consciously make noise so you don't accidentally frighten people. Shadows seem to lean toward you.

⚡ Reborn Body: Beast Blood.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Beast Blood
⚡ Reborn Body: Beast Blood.description: A Reborn body that runs closer to the wild than civilization, but deeper. Your instincts don't just match a predator's; they exceed them. You smell emotions, hear heartbeats through walls, and feel the shift in air pressure when something is about to move. Creatures recognize you as kin in a way that unsettles professional beast tamers. Your body is built for endurance, pursuit, and the kind of patient resilience that lets you outlast anything in the wild. You heal faster outdoors, sleep lighter without losing rest quality, and your bond with animals and magical creatures forms at a speed that makes taming rituals look like red tape. This is the body of a protagonist who belongs to the wilds, and the wilds know it.
⚡ Reborn Body: Beast Blood.traitNarrativeEffects: Animals treat you like one of them. Dogs follow you unprompted. Cats bring you gifts. Wild creatures don't flee your approach. Beastkin give you curious looks and can't quite explain why.

⚡ Reborn Body: Enchanter's Frame.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Enchanter's Frame
⚡ Reborn Body: Enchanter's Frame.description: A Reborn body attuned to the act of creation itself. Your mana circuits are wired for precision rather than volume, every drop of magical energy you channel into a crafted item lands exactly where it should. Materials respond to your touch with unusual cooperativeness. Enchantments you lay down are cleaner, stronger, and more stable than your experience level should produce. This is the body of a protagonist whose power fantasy isn't about swinging a sword, it's about forging the sword that everyone else wants to swing. Your hands are steady, your mind sees material compositions intuitively, and when you finish crafting something, even the item seems slightly surprised at how well it turned out.
⚡ Reborn Body: Enchanter's Frame.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hands are always slightly warm and impossibly steady. You instinctively know when a piece of equipment is poorly made by touching it. Crafting merchants feel an inexplicable urge to show you their best work.

Blessing of the Unerring Arrow.name: Blessing of the Unerring Arrow
Blessing of the Unerring Arrow.description: Your arrows don't miss. Not because you aim well, because the arrow knows where it's going. The Blessing of the Unerring Arrow grants supernatural archery that ignores physics: shots that curve around obstacles, arrows that pick up speed after release, volleys that single out targets in a crowd. At higher levels you can loose conceptual arrows, a shot that hits 'the leader,' 'the lie,' or 'the weak point' without your needing to spot the target yourself. Your bow becomes an extension of your intent, and your intent has never needed a clear line of sight. Rangers envy your accuracy. Assassins envy your range. Everyone envies the fact that you once pinned a fly to a wall at sixty paces and looked bored doing it.
Blessing of the Unerring Arrow.traitNarrativeEffects: Your eyes track moving targets with unsettling precision and your hands are always impossibly steady, even in chaos.

Blessing of the Spirit Covenant.name: Blessing of the Spirit Covenant
Blessing of the Spirit Covenant.description: You don't summon spirits. You befriend them, and they come because they want to. The Blessing of the Spirit Covenant grants a natural bond with entities from other planes: elemental spirits, ancestral echoes, fey fragments, sealed demigods, and things that exist between dimensions. Your summons are stronger, last longer, and act with a mind of their own, because they aren't bound servants; they're allies who chose you. At higher levels you can keep several summons active at once, fuse with a bonded spirit for a temporary power spike, and call entities other summoners can't reach because those entities simply refuse anyone else. Summoning academies call your technique 'theoretically impossible.' Your spirits call it 'friendship.' The distinction matters to them more than you'd expect.
Blessing of the Spirit Covenant.traitNarrativeEffects: Faint spirit-light clings to you in dim places, and people near you occasionally hear whispered voices that aren't there, your bonded spirits checking in.

Blessing of the Iron Lotus.name: Blessing of the Iron Lotus
Blessing of the Iron Lotus.description: Your body is the weapon, and the weapon is perfect. The Blessing of the Iron Lotus grants martial mastery beyond anything training alone can reach: your strikes flow with supernatural precision, your forms adapt mid-fight to counter any style, and your unarmed blows carry force that rivals enchanted weapons. Where the Titan's Grip is raw power, the Iron Lotus is refined technique raised to divine art. Every movement is efficient, beautiful, and devastating. At higher levels you can channel ki through your strikes for elemental effects without magic, read an opponent's style and build a perfect counter on the spot, and drop into a flow state where your body moves faster than conscious thought. Monks who trained for decades watch you fight and see the peak of a martial tradition that hasn't been invented yet.
Blessing of the Iron Lotus.traitNarrativeEffects: Your posture is always perfectly centered, your footwork is silent, and even casual gestures carry the economy of motion that only lifelong martial artists usually develop.

Blessing of the Siren's Melody.name: Blessing of the Siren's Melody
Blessing of the Siren's Melody.description: Your voice rewrites emotional reality. The Blessing of the Siren's Melody grants supernatural power through music, song, and spoken word: your battle hymns push allies past their limits, your lullabies drop rampaging monsters into sleep, and your dirges bleed the will to fight out of whole formations. This isn't enchantment magic in a musical costume; it's something older, a Blessing that works through beauty and emotional truth rather than mana manipulation. At higher levels your songs can close wounds, break curses, shatter magical barriers tuned to specific frequencies, and swing battlefield-wide morale hard enough to turn retreats into charges. Bards who hear you perform suffer professional devastation. The Church can't decide whether to file your singing as divine miracle or controlled emotional weapon. Neither can you, but the crowd is crying and you haven't even reached the chorus.
Blessing of the Siren's Melody.traitNarrativeEffects: Your voice carries a natural resonance that makes every word feel significant, and people lean in when you speak regardless of volume.

Pocket Powerhouse.name: Pocket Powerhouse
Pocket Powerhouse.description: Short and densely muscled, dense legs, toned arms, and a core built for leverage, all packed into a low frame. A weightlifter's build, scaled down.
Pocket Powerhouse.traitNarrativeEffects: Taller sparring partners learn very quickly that your center of gravity is an actual combat advantage.

Slender Sylph.name: Slender Sylph
Slender Sylph.description: Willowy and light with a narrow frame, long limbs, and an almost weightless quality to your movement. Your silhouette is clean, elegant, and flows like calligraphy, the kind of body that makes simple robes look like couture.
Slender Sylph.traitNarrativeEffects: You move through crowded spaces without touching anyone and your shadow looks like a brushstroke.

Elegant Hourglass.name: Elegant Hourglass
Elegant Hourglass.description: The classic balanced figure - a clearly defined waist curving out to proportional hips and shoulders, with smooth symmetrical lines. Nothing excessive, nothing understated.
Elegant Hourglass.traitNarrativeEffects: Tailors measure you once and remember the numbers forever because they're annoyingly perfect.

Glamorous Curves.name: Glamorous Curves
Glamorous Curves.description: Full-figured with a dramatic silhouette - wide hips, cinched waist, and strong contrast between waist and shoulder line. Bold proportions, elegantly balanced.
Glamorous Curves.traitNarrativeEffects: You have never entered a ballroom without someone walking into a pillar. This has happened at least four times.

Full-Figured Goddess.name: Full-Figured Goddess
Full-Figured Goddess.description: A full, softly rounded build with wide hips, a defined waist, and substantial proportions. Carries herself with grounded, confident posture.
Full-Figured Goddess.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been the subject of at least three tavern songs, none of which you authorized and all of which are embarrassingly accurate.

Dancer's Grace.name: Dancer's Grace
Dancer's Grace.description: Long-limbed and exquisitely toned with a lean, flexible frame shaped by constant movement, visible muscle in the legs and core, graceful arms, and a posture that makes every casual gesture look choreographed. You don't walk; you glide.
Dancer's Grace.traitNarrativeEffects: You stretch in public without thinking about it and people stop to watch because it looks like performance art.

Fit and Feminine.name: Fit and Feminine
Fit and Feminine.description: Toned and athletic - visible abdominal definition, narrow waist, sculpted arms, strong shoulders, and well-defined legs. Built by training, not by accident.
Fit and Feminine.traitNarrativeEffects: People who see you in armor assume you're tough. People who see you out of armor realize they were underestimating.

Battle Beauty.name: Battle Beauty
Battle Beauty.description: Muscular, powerful, and strikingly feminine, broad shoulders tapering to a defined waist, strong arms, thick athletic thighs, and the kind of sculpted physique that looks equally at home in plate armor or a formal gown. You are visibly strong and visibly beautiful and see no contradiction in being both.
Battle Beauty.traitNarrativeEffects: You flex absentmindedly while thinking and nearby people lose their train of thought.

Amazonian Goddess.name: Amazonian Goddess
Amazonian Goddess.description: Tall, powerful, and breathtaking, a body built for war and worship in equal measure. Long strong legs, broad shoulders, visible muscle mass, a commanding height that puts you above most people in any room, and a presence that makes crowds part instinctively.
Amazonian Goddess.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been mistaken for a minor deity twice and corrected them only once.

Statuesque Elegance.name: Statuesque Elegance
Statuesque Elegance.description: Tall and striking with long legs, an elegant neck, and the kind of commanding vertical presence that makes you the natural center of any room. Your proportions are runway-perfect, everything elongated, everything balanced, everything designed to make people look up.
Statuesque Elegance.traitNarrativeEffects: You rest your chin on shorter friends' heads without bending and have accepted this as a personality trait.

Noble Silhouette.name: Noble Silhouette
Noble Silhouette.description: Refined, poised, and impeccably proportioned with the kind of body that looks expensive, narrow waist, elegant shoulders, graceful neck, perfect posture, and a silhouette that suggests generations of excellent breeding. You look like you were born to wear silk and give orders.
Noble Silhouette.traitNarrativeEffects: Your posture alone has ended arguments. You've never slouched and at this point you're not sure you physically can.

Idol Physique.name: Idol Physique
Idol Physique.description: Trim and camera-ready, lightly toned with a narrow waist, balanced proportions, and stage-trained posture that reads cleanly from any angle.
Idol Physique.traitNarrativeEffects: People assume you practice your expressions in mirrors. You do, but that's not the point.

Lush and Radiant.name: Lush and Radiant
Lush and Radiant.description: Softly rounded build with a healthy complexion - full cheeks, warm skin, and rounded proportions throughout. Reads as vitality, comfort, and ease.
Lush and Radiant.traitNarrativeEffects: You look remarkable in candlelight, and you have been told so at every dinner party you have ever attended.

Long-Legged Grace.name: Long-Legged Grace
Long-Legged Grace.description: Defined by unusually long legs that account for most of the height - lean thighs, elegant calves, and a high leg-to-torso ratio that makes every silhouette read tall.
Long-Legged Grace.traitNarrativeEffects: Standard-issue greaves have never once fit you. Every set you own is custom, and every armorer has complained about it.

Lean and Defined.name: Lean and Defined
Lean and Defined.description: A swimmer's build, long, clean muscle with no excess, visible definition from shoulders to calves, a tapered waist, and the kind of efficient physique that's built for speed and endurance rather than raw mass. Every line of your body says 'fast and dangerous.'
Lean and Defined.traitNarrativeEffects: You look like a blade someone forgot to put in a sheath. People instinctively give you room.

Athletic Hero Build.name: Athletic Hero Build
Athletic Hero Build.description: The classic protagonist frame, broad shoulders, defined chest, strong arms, a tapered waist, and long legs built for running, fighting, and looking excellent while doing both. Not too bulky, not too lean. The kind of body that armor was designed to flatter.
Athletic Hero Build.traitNarrativeEffects: You look exactly like the person on recruitment posters and this has caused awkward recognition moments.

Rugged Warrior Frame.name: Rugged Warrior Frame
Rugged Warrior Frame.description: Built by combat rather than training, thick shoulders, heavy arms, a barrel chest, and the kind of raw physical presence that comes from years of real fighting. Your body reads as experienced, powerful, and slightly dangerous even at rest.
Rugged Warrior Frame.traitNarrativeEffects: Bartenders serve you first and strangers don't argue with you about seating. This saves considerable time.

Swordsman's Grace.name: Swordsman's Grace
Swordsman's Grace.description: Lean, precise, and built for speed, a body honed by bladework with toned arms, a strong core, flexible shoulders, and an economy of movement that makes every gesture look deliberate. You carry no unnecessary weight and waste no unnecessary motion.
Swordsman's Grace.traitNarrativeEffects: You catch falling objects without looking and people find this deeply unsettling.

Prince Charming Build.name: Prince Charming Build
Prince Charming Build.description: Refined, well-proportioned, and classically handsome in frame, broad enough to be masculine, lean enough to be elegant, with the kind of perfectly balanced physique that looks equally natural in court finery or light armor. Everything about your body suggests good breeding and better posture.
Prince Charming Build.traitNarrativeEffects: You accidentally make every outfit look formal and have never successfully dressed casually.

Pretty Boy.name: Pretty Boy
Pretty Boy.description: Slender, refined, and beautiful rather than handsome, a lean frame with narrow shoulders, fine features, graceful hands, and the kind of elegant physicality that blurs the line between striking and pretty. You're the type that makes people do a double-take and then quietly reevaluate their preferences.
Pretty Boy.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been mistaken for a noble, an elf, and someone's extremely attractive older sister, sometimes in the same day.

Tall Dark and Devastating.name: Tall Dark and Devastating
Tall Dark and Devastating.description: Tall, striking, and commanding with long lines, dramatic presence, and the kind of silhouette that makes people notice before they mean to.
Tall Dark and Devastating.traitNarrativeEffects: Your shadow alone has intimidated a pickpocket into returning a wallet. You didn't even notice it happening.

Compact Striker Build.name: Compact Striker Build
Compact Striker Build.description: Short and densely muscled, a body packed with explosive power in a smaller frame. Thick arms, strong legs, a solid core, and the kind of low center of gravity that makes you incredibly hard to knock down and incredibly dangerous up close.
Compact Striker Build.traitNarrativeEffects: Taller fighters consistently underestimate your reach right up until they don't.

Broad and Gentle Giant.name: Broad and Gentle Giant
Broad and Gentle Giant.description: Big, warm, and built like a fortress made of hugs, wide shoulders, large hands, a barrel chest, and the kind of massive frame that's somehow more comforting than intimidating. You could break someone in half but everything about your body language says you'd rather make them soup.
Broad and Gentle Giant.traitNarrativeEffects: Children climb you like playground equipment and you've given up trying to prevent it.

Sculpted Titan.name: Sculpted Titan
Sculpted Titan.description: Massive, defined, and carved from what appears to be marble, a bodybuilder's frame taken to fantasy extremes with visible muscle groups, prominent veins, a powerful neck, and the kind of sheer physical mass that warps the air around you with implied force.
Sculpted Titan.traitNarrativeEffects: You've accidentally broken three chairs this month by sitting down normally. Normal chairs fear you.

Wolf-Lean Predator.name: Wolf-Lean Predator
Wolf-Lean Predator.description: Rangy, sharp, and built to hunt, a predator's body with long limbs, wiry muscle, a narrow waist, and the kind of lean intensity that makes you look hungry even when you're not. You're never fully relaxed and your body always reads as one heartbeat from explosive motion.
Wolf-Lean Predator.traitNarrativeEffects: People instinctively avoid blocking your line of sight and can't explain why.

Forge-Built Powerhouse.name: Forge-Built Powerhouse
Forge-Built Powerhouse.description: Stocky, dense, and built like a living anvil, thick everywhere, with heavy arms, a broad chest, solid legs, and the kind of immovable physical presence that comes from a body designed to absorb and deliver tremendous force. Short in height, enormous in impact.
Forge-Built Powerhouse.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been used as a windbreak by camping companions more than once and you find this deeply flattering.

Knight-Commander Frame.name: Knight-Commander Frame
Knight-Commander Frame.description: Tall, broad, and built for authority, the body of someone born to wear heavy armor and give orders from the front line. Powerful shoulders, a deep chest, strong legs, and the kind of upright, squared physicality that makes people salute before they've processed why.
Knight-Commander Frame.traitNarrativeEffects: You fill a doorway completely and have developed a habit of turning slightly sideways that you refuse to acknowledge as necessary.

Roguish Agility.name: Roguish Agility
Roguish Agility.description: Quick, lean, and built for trouble, a body designed for climbing, dodging, and getting into places you shouldn't be. Flexible shoulders, strong hands, a wiry core, and the kind of restless physicality that looks like you're always calculating your next exit route.
Roguish Agility.traitNarrativeEffects: You sit on the backs of chairs, the arms of couches, and the edges of tables, and have never used furniture correctly in your life.

Sun-Kissed Adventurer.name: Sun-Kissed Adventurer
Sun-Kissed Adventurer.description: Naturally fit with the kind of tan, toned body that comes from living outdoors, defined arms, strong legs, a lean torso, and the healthy, wind-touched physicality of someone who gets their exercise from actual adventure rather than training halls.
Sun-Kissed Adventurer.traitNarrativeEffects: You look permanently like you just came back from something exciting, which is usually accurate.

Androgynous Beauty.name: Androgynous Beauty
Androgynous Beauty.description: Impossible to categorize and stunning because of it, a body that blends masculine and feminine proportions into something entirely its own. Lean, graceful, with elegant bone structure and the kind of ambiguous silhouette that makes everyone attracted and no one certain why.
Androgynous Beauty.traitNarrativeEffects: People use the wrong pronoun, correct themselves, use the other one, and then give up and just stare respectfully.

Fey-Touched Elegance.name: Fey-Touched Elegance
Fey-Touched Elegance.description: Otherworldly, elongated, and hauntingly beautiful, a body that doesn't quite follow human proportions. Slightly too long in the limbs, slightly too graceful in motion, with an ethereal quality that makes you look like you wandered out of a fairy tale and forgot to go back.
Fey-Touched Elegance.traitNarrativeEffects: Mirrors sometimes show you differently than people see you, and both versions are uncomfortably attractive.

Lithe Enigma.name: Lithe Enigma
Lithe Enigma.description: Lean, flexible, and deliberately unreadable, a body that moves like water and refuses to be pinned down to any single aesthetic. Not quite masculine, not quite feminine, perfectly balanced in a way that keeps people guessing and looking longer than they intended to.
Lithe Enigma.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been hit on in five different ways by five different people in a single tavern evening and found all of them reasonable.

Moonlit Waif.name: Moonlit Waif
Moonlit Waif.description: Slender, ethereal, and softly luminous with visible delicacy, elegant lines, and a fragile-looking beauty that hides more resilience than people expect.
Moonlit Waif.traitNarrativeEffects: People write poetry about you without asking permission and you've stopped trying to collect royalties.

Sleek and Sharp.name: Sleek and Sharp
Sleek and Sharp.description: Angular, precise, and cutting, a body defined by clean lines, sharp cheekbones, a narrow waist, and the kind of crisp physical definition that makes you look like a weapon someone polished to a mirror finish. Nothing soft, nothing wasted, everything intentional.
Sleek and Sharp.traitNarrativeEffects: You accidentally look like you're judging everyone's outfit at all times. You usually are.

Velvet Strength.name: Velvet Strength
Velvet Strength.description: Deceptively powerful beneath a soft exterior, a body with gentle curves and smooth proportions that hides real muscle underneath. You look approachable and unthreatening right up until you lift something that weighs more than most people, and then everyone recalibrates.
Velvet Strength.traitNarrativeEffects: You arm-wrestle people for drinks and have never paid for your own in three cities.

Celestial Proportions.name: Celestial Proportions
Celestial Proportions.description: Divinely balanced with proportions that seem mathematically perfect, as if someone used a golden ratio to design a body. Neither exaggerated nor understated in any dimension, with a symmetry and grace that reads as supernatural rather than natural. People don't just find you attractive; they find you aesthetically correct.
Celestial Proportions.traitNarrativeEffects: Artists ask to sketch you and then get frustrated because you look 'too perfect to draw convincingly.'

Wild and Free.name: Wild and Free
Wild and Free.description: Untamed physicality with a body built by instinct rather than discipline, lean muscle, sun-touched skin, natural flexibility, and the kind of raw, organic beauty that comes from living closer to nature than civilization. You move like something that was never domesticated.
Wild and Free.traitNarrativeEffects: You've been offered jobs by three different beast-taming guilds based solely on how you walk.

Smoldering Intensity.name: Smoldering Intensity
Smoldering Intensity.description: Medium frame with coiled energy visible in every muscle, not especially tall or broad, but with a physical tension and presence that makes you feel larger and more dangerous than your dimensions suggest. Your body radiates contained heat like a banked fire.
Smoldering Intensity.traitNarrativeEffects: People describe you as 'intense' before they describe any physical feature, which is accurate.

Gentle Strength.name: Gentle Strength
Gentle Strength.description: Visibly strong but with rounded, approachable proportions, muscular arms and shoulders with soft hands, a powerful frame that somehow reads as protective rather than threatening. The body of someone who could crush you but is clearly more interested in giving you a reassuring pat on the back.
Gentle Strength.traitNarrativeEffects: You carry injured companions with suspicious ease and tenderness that makes healers trust you on instinct.

Willowy and Tall.name: Willowy and Tall
Willowy and Tall.description: Tall, narrow, and flowing, a reed-like body with long limbs, a slender torso, and the kind of vertical elegance that makes you sway gracefully in wind. You take up very little horizontal space and a remarkable amount of vertical space.
Willowy and Tall.traitNarrativeEffects: You're always visible in crowds and have been used as a meeting landmark by friends who refuse to admit it.

Quicksilver Build.name: Quicksilver Build
Quicksilver Build.description: Fast-looking even when standing still, a lean, reactive body with coiled muscles, light frame, and the kind of restless energy that makes you look like you're vibrating at a slightly higher frequency than everyone around you. Built for speed, evasion, and dramatic last-second escapes.
Quicksilver Build.traitNarrativeEffects: You fidget constantly and every fidget looks like the start of a combat technique, which keeps nearby people on edge.

Enchantress Frame.name: Enchantress Frame
Enchantress Frame.description: Built for magic in ways that are visible, a body with elegant, flowing proportions, long fingers made for gestures, a slender torso with just enough curve to be distracting, and the kind of poised, magnetic physicality that makes every spell look like a performance. Mages with this build are dangerous for multiple reasons.
Enchantress Frame.traitNarrativeEffects: You've caused mana interference in someone else's spell by walking past them. It's happened more than once.

Warlord's Physique.name: Warlord's Physique
Warlord's Physique.description: The body of someone who commands armies by looking like they could replace the army if necessary, tall, massively built, with powerful musculature, wide shoulders, a thick neck, and the kind of physical authority that makes strategy meetings shorter because nobody wants to argue.
Warlord's Physique.traitNarrativeEffects: You've ended a siege negotiation by standing up. The opposing commander accepted terms immediately.

Sacred Vessel.name: Sacred Vessel
Sacred Vessel.description: Luminous, pristine, and built with the ethereal beauty of someone touched by divine power, a body that seems to glow faintly in the right light, with immaculate proportions, unblemished skin, and a serene physicality that makes people feel calmer just by standing near you.
Sacred Vessel.traitNarrativeEffects: Wounded people feel slightly better when you touch them and this happens whether you're using healing magic or not.

Shadow-Dancer Build.name: Shadow-Dancer Build
Shadow-Dancer Build.description: Dark, lithe, and built to disappear, a body optimized for stealth and seduction in equal measure. Lean muscle, flexible joints, a narrow silhouette, and the kind of sinuous grace that makes you equally effective in a fight, on a dance floor, or slipping through a window at midnight.
Shadow-Dancer Build.traitNarrativeEffects: You move so quietly that you've started coughing before entering rooms so companions don't panic.

Beast-Blood Physique.name: Beast-Blood Physique
Beast-Blood Physique.description: Raw, primal, and built closer to a predator than a person, heavy muscle, a thick torso, powerful legs, and the kind of aggressive physicality that makes you look like you could chase down prey across open terrain. There's nothing civilized about your body and nothing apologetic about how you carry it.
Beast-Blood Physique.traitNarrativeEffects: Wild animals show you instinctive respect and domesticated ones get nervous. Both reactions are appropriate.

Royal Perfection.name: Royal Perfection
Royal Perfection.description: Exceptionally well-balanced, poised, and polished in a way that suggests someone designed for portraits, ceremonies, and making eye contact feel politically significant.
Royal Perfection.traitNarrativeEffects: Your bone structure alone has been appraised at a value higher than most houses.

Berserker Build.name: Berserker Build
Berserker Build.description: Massive, raw, and built for destruction, heavy muscle layered over a powerful frame with thick limbs, a wide chest, and the kind of overwhelming physical presence that makes you look like you could rip a door off its hinges. Which you can. And have.
Berserker Build.traitNarrativeEffects: Furniture manufacturers see you as both their greatest fear and their most reliable source of repeat business.

Desert Rose.name: Desert Rose
Desert Rose.description: Toned, sun-warm, and beautifully lean with the kind of sculpted endurance physique built by heat and hardship, defined arms, strong legs, a narrow waist, and the graceful economy of someone who wastes nothing, not even a gesture. You're beautiful in the way that surviving harsh conditions makes everything more vivid.
Desert Rose.traitNarrativeEffects: You make drinking water look elegant and sweating look attractive, which annoys everyone who can do neither.

Frost-Kissed Elegance.name: Frost-Kissed Elegance
Frost-Kissed Elegance.description: Cool, pristine, and sharply beautiful, a body with pale, luminous proportions, clean lines, slender limbs, and the kind of crystalline beauty that looks like it was carved from ice by someone who understood aesthetics at a mathematical level. You look untouchable, and that's part of the appeal.
Frost-Kissed Elegance.traitNarrativeEffects: Your skin always feels slightly cool to the touch and people who shake your hand remember it for days.

High Elf.name: High Elf
High Elf.description:
Ancient, graceful, and completely aware of how unfairly pretty that makes them. High Elves are the classic long-lived mana aristocrats of Luxcellia: refined, sharp-eared, elegant, and raised on equal parts artistry, etiquette, and magical education. They excel at precision, patience, and quietly making everyone else feel rushed.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid elf with humanlike skin, pointed ears, refined features, and elegant fantasy presence; no animal anatomy, no plant body, no extreme monster proportions.

RACE REFERENCE: High Elf is a classic humanoid elf with pointed ears, refined facial structure, long-lived poise, and a cultured magical upbringing. Use ancient lineages, libraries, archery, moonlit terraces, and quiet superiority as background hooks.
High Elf.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Use grace, polish, magical literacy, old family expectations, and centuries of tradition without making the race emotionally flat.

Moon Elf.name: Moon Elf
Moon Elf.description:
Moon Elves are a serene nocturnal elven lineage shaped by silver groves, moonlit shrines, mirrored lakes, and the quiet hours when the world is finally willing to whisper. They have the classic pointed ears and refined beauty of elves, but their presence feels softer, dreamier, and more intuitive than their sun-proud cousins. Moon Elves are drawn to reflection, subtle magic, secret paths, and the strange honesty people reveal after sunset.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid elf with humanlike skin, pointed ears, luminous or gentle eyes, and a moon-kissed fantasy elegance; no feral body, no abstract spirit-body, no extreme monster anatomy.

RACE REFERENCE: Moon Elf is a graceful humanoid elf associated with moonlight, intuition, hidden glades, dreamlike calm, and silver-blue nocturnal beauty. Use quiet observation, soft mysticism, and night-travel instincts as background hooks.
Moon Elf.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Use moonlight, intuition, soft mysticism, hidden paths, night-blooming flowers, and quiet emotional insight. This is ancestry flavor and roleplay texture, not a free unique ability.

Wood Elf.name: Wood Elf
Wood Elf.description:
Quiet-footed, green-cloaked, and usually aware of you three trees before you are aware of them. Wood Elves are the elves of the Verdania enclaves: canopy cities woven into living trees, where spirit magic is taught like a language, the forest is guarded like family, and outsiders are welcomed slowly, if at all. They are patient trackers, careful archers and good listeners, to people and to the woods alike.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: Humanoid elf with humanlike skin, pointed ears, and a natural woodland grace; no plant body, no bark skin, no animal anatomy, no extreme monster proportions.

RACE REFERENCE: Wood Elf is a humanoid elf of the Verdania canopy enclaves, raised on spirit magic, archery, forest guardianship and a guarded distance from outsiders. Use living-tree homes, elder councils, old spirit bargains and the cost of outliving short-lived friends as background hooks.
Wood Elf.traitNarrativeEffects: RACE REFERENCE: Use forest stillness, spirit-sense, careful archery, enclave loyalty and slow-earned trust toward outsiders. This is ancestry flavor and roleplay texture, not a free unique ability.

Battle Sovereign.name: Battle Sovereign
Battle Sovereign.description:
Everyone fights better when you're here, and you make sure of it. Battle Sovereigns command from the front: reading formations, issuing clean orders, turning chaos into structure through sheer presence. Your Royal Command moves the battle like a chess piece with a voice. You are not a noble with a sword. You are the reason the line held, and everyone on it knows it.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Battle Sovereign.traitNarrativeEffects: You rearrange tavern furniture into better defensive formations without noticing, address groups in the plural, and people keep following your casual suggestions like direct orders, which, historically, they were.

Arcane Sword Saint.name: Arcane Sword Saint
Arcane Sword Saint.description:
The sword is also the spell. Arcane Sword Saints fuse blade forms and casting into one elegant language, mana-loaded cuts, enchanted footwork, glowing arcs that academy rivals hate on sight.
