You fight at close range with a duelist's precision and a caster's options, and every slash carries a second meaning. Beautiful, precise, and infuriating to fence. That's the point.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Arcane Sword Saint.traitNarrativeEffects: You practice draw-cuts against falling leaves and take it personally when one survives. Your sword arcs leave brief glowing afterimages, and you have absolutely posed at the end of a duel while pretending not to.

Tower Shield.name: Tower Shield
Tower Shield.description:
A slab of a shield built to anchor a formation, body-block danger, and turn one stubborn adventurer into mobile cover. It suits protectors, vanguards, and saintly guardians who like the fantasy of weathering impossible pressure while everyone else shelters behind them. This is a heroic defensive stand, not a backup plan you drew when the sword broke.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Tower Shield.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: Use shield walls, heavy blocks, shield bashes, planted stances, and protector energy. This is a heroic defense fantasy, not just a backup tool. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Shield Combat.

Magic Thread Needles.name: Magic Thread Needles
Magic Thread Needles.description:
A set of enchanted needles and thread-spindles used to sew charms, bind foes, puppet movement, or cut with near-invisible lines. Tailors, assassins, puppet-users, and elegant support casters all gravitate to it for the same reason: the style is precise, quietly beautiful, and a little bit dangerous, sometimes stitching a ward and a wound shut in the same fight.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Magic Thread Needles.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: Describe thread-lines, stitched wards, binding loops, flicked needles, and silk-thin cutting arcs. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thread Arts.

Lantern Staff.name: Lantern Staff
Lantern Staff.description:
A staff crowned with a ritual lantern instead of a plain crystal, carried to guide spirits, ward off dark, light up ruins, and swing holy fire down a cramped dungeon hall. Shrine-keepers, spirit mediums, exorcists, and mysterious night travelers all take to it, drawn as much by the warding glow as by the very solid club underneath it.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Lantern Staff.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: Reference lantern-light, warding flames, ghost-guiding glow, protective circles, and haunted-road atmosphere. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Spirit Channeling.

Holy Mace.name: Holy Mace
Holy Mace.description:
A consecrated blunt weapon for paladins, battle-priests, inquisitors, and the sort of healer who is entirely willing to solve a demon problem in person. In a world stuffed with cursed complications, the holy mace stays refreshingly simple: righteous, direct, and blunt enough not to make theological distinctions about what it hits.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Holy Mace.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: Use sanctified impacts, purification strikes, shield-and-mace pairings, and practical holy brutality. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

Demon Contract Tome.name: Demon Contract Tome
Demon Contract Tome.description:
A pact-bound grimoire packed with contracts, true names, seals, and dangerously specific clauses that weaponize as readily as any blade. Warlocks, summoners, and occult nobles love it for the way it makes their weapon feel intelligent, tempting, and roughly one legal dispute away from catastrophe. Every page turned mid-cast is a bargain you had better have read closely.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Demon Contract Tome.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: Reference turning pages mid-cast, invoked names, sealing glyphs, infernal clauses, and spoken bargains used as attacks. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Occult Lore.

Living Chainblade.name: Living Chainblade
Living Chainblade.description:
A half-sentient chained weapon that moves with hungry flexibility, wrapping, lunging, and reacting like it enjoys the fight nearly as much as you do. It's dramatic, unpredictable, and built for antiheroes, cursed-weapon users, and anyone who wants a little monster energy in their arsenal. The uneasy sense that it has opinions is not your imagination.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Living Chainblade.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: Use writhing metal, coiling reach, snapping chain arcs, and the uneasy sense the weapon has opinions. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Cooking Knife Set.name: Cooking Knife Set
Cooking Knife Set.description:
A chef's roll of trusted blades repurposed for dungeon survival, battle prep, and surprisingly stylish violence. It fits cooks, battle-chefs, survivalists, and the sort of protagonist who can fillet a monster, plate dinner, and threaten a noble in one unbroken motion. Danger disguised as hospitality, honed well past anything a kitchen strictly requires.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Cooking Knife Set.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: Reference quick cuts, clean prep motions, culinary confidence, improvised but expert knife work, and danger disguised as hospitality. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dagger Fighting.

The Tsundere Disaster.name: The Tsundere Disaster
The Tsundere Disaster.description: You deflect feelings with attitude, cover care with irritation, and create romantic tension by accident almost as often as on purpose. Everyone around you knows you care long before you are emotionally prepared to admit it.
The Tsundere Disaster.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Hide affection behind irritation, flustered denial, and actions that care more than the words do.

The Soft-Spoken Menace.name: The Soft-Spoken Menace
The Soft-Spoken Menace.description: You are gentle in tone, measured in speech, and deeply unsettling once people realize how serious you actually are. Quiet delivery only makes the menace land harder.
The Soft-Spoken Menace.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep them quiet, polite, and alarmingly serious once someone realizes how dangerous they are.

The Villainess Reform Project.name: The Villainess Reform Project
The Villainess Reform Project.description: You have the posture, taste, and cutting instincts of a classic villainess, but you are making a sincere effort to become better than the role. The tension between elegance and redemption follows you everywhere.
The Villainess Reform Project.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Mix villainess polish with real attempts at growth, self-restraint, and avoiding the bad end.

The Golden Retriever Hero.name: The Golden Retriever Hero
The Golden Retriever Hero.description: Friendly, earnest, energetic, and hard to dislike, you approach life like every problem can be improved by sincerity and effort. People trust you before they mean to.
The Golden Retriever Hero.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Use warmth, enthusiasm, loyalty, and emotionally direct hero energy.

The Black Cat Romantic.name: The Black Cat Romantic
The Black Cat Romantic.description: A little aloof, a little watchful, and a lot softer than your expression suggests. You feel deeply, show sparingly, and tend to form a single intense bond rather than scattering your heart carelessly.
The Black Cat Romantic.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep them reserved, observant, and deeply affectionate only after selective trust.

The Socially Anxious Powerhouse.name: The Socially Anxious Powerhouse
The Socially Anxious Powerhouse.description: In battle or work you are frighteningly competent. In ordinary conversation you briefly forget how hands, eye contact, and introductions are supposed to function. The gap between your capability and your social confidence is painfully obvious.
The Socially Anxious Powerhouse.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Let overwhelming competence contrast sharply with awkwardness in ordinary social situations.

The Kind-Hearted Menace.name: The Kind-Hearted Menace
The Kind-Hearted Menace.description: You help with your whole strength and no brakes. You carry the cart and the horse, fix the door by removing the wall, and hug like a siege engine. Everyone feels safe with you and slightly worried for the furniture.
The Kind-Hearted Menace.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Blend sincere kindness with overwhelming, slightly destructive helpfulness: good intentions with no brakes.

The Professional Third Wheel.name: The Professional Third Wheel
The Professional Third Wheel.description: You are weirdly good at noticing chemistry, nudging confessions, and accidentally witnessing every romantic beat from the worst possible seat in the room. You are a veteran of everyone else's feelings.
The Professional Third Wheel.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Make them painfully aware of everyone else's chemistry and perpetually positioned beside, not inside, the romance.

Disarmingly Innocent Aura.name: Disarmingly Innocent Aura
Disarmingly Innocent Aura.description: You come across as pure-hearted and a little naive, never childish. People explain things you already know, try to shield you from scandal, and are thrown when you turn out to know exactly what is going on.
Disarmingly Innocent Aura.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs assume naivety: they explain, shield and soften things for the protagonist, and are caught off guard when the innocence turns out to be only an impression.

Soft Enough to Underestimate.name: Soft Enough to Underestimate
Soft Enough to Underestimate.description: There is something gentle in the way you carry yourself, and opponents read it as weakness. Rivals go easy, duelists hold back their best, and enemies leave you for last. That is usually their mistake.
Soft Enough to Underestimate.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: Opponents and rivals underestimate the protagonist in contests and fights: overconfidence, held-back first moves, and a hard correction.

Looks Like Royalty.name: Looks Like Royalty
Looks Like Royalty.description: You do not look noble, you look like a crown. Strangers bow before they think, guards stiffen, and at least one schemer is already wondering which throne you went missing from.
Looks Like Royalty.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs suspect royal blood or a hidden identity: deference, petitions, mistaken-identity plots and political attention.

Looks Like a Saint.name: Looks Like a Saint
Looks Like a Saint.description: You give off a serene, almost blessed aura that makes people lower their voices or expect moral clarity. Whether you deserve that trust is another issue.
Looks Like a Saint.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs associate you with purity, guidance, or holy favor.

Looks Like a Final Boss.name: Looks Like a Final Boss
Looks Like a Final Boss.description: You have stage-presence in the most dangerous possible way. Even before you speak, people feel like they should have brought a party and some better gear.
Looks Like a Final Boss.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: people react as if you are powerful, ominous, and deeply not normal; monsters take it as a challenge and come at you.

Looks Like the Childhood Friend.name: Looks Like the Childhood Friend
Looks Like the Childhood Friend.description: There is a familiarity to your face and manner that makes people feel oddly comfortable around you. You look like someone who has always been part of the story.
Looks Like the Childhood Friend.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs warm up quickly and may project closeness or nostalgia onto you.

Looks Like the Rival.name: Looks Like the Rival
Looks Like the Rival.description: You radiate challenge, competence, and the sort of charisma that makes other ambitious people immediately want to prove something. Even a greeting can feel competitive.
Looks Like the Rival.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs size you up quickly and are prone to competitive or tension-heavy first reactions.

Looks Like the Love Interest.name: Looks Like the Love Interest
Looks Like the Love Interest.description: You have that dangerous blend of beauty, presence, and emotional readability that makes people immediately think romance-route thoughts. It is a compliment and a tactical problem.
Looks Like the Love Interest.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs clock you as romantically important almost on sight.

Looks Like a Walking Questline.name: Looks Like a Walking Questline
Looks Like a Walking Questline.description: Something about you says unresolved business, layered backstory, and rewards for paying attention. People feel like talking to you will unlock content.
Looks Like a Walking Questline.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs assume you are tied to future drama, secrets, or opportunities.

Looks Like Trouble in Formalwear.name: Looks Like Trouble in Formalwear
Looks Like Trouble in Formalwear.description: You look polished enough for a ballroom and dangerous enough to ruin one. There is elegance in the package and catastrophe in the subtext.
Looks Like Trouble in Formalwear.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: At formal events NPCs expect a scandal: hosts seat you carefully, rivals keep watch, and every invitation comes with a nervous footnote.

Looks Like They Know Too Much.name: Looks Like They Know Too Much
Looks Like They Know Too Much.description: You look like you know something about the person in front of you. They get careful, wonder what you have heard, and sometimes offer a favor before you have asked for anything.
Looks Like They Know Too Much.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs suspect you know their secrets: guarded answers, nervous kindness, the occasional offered favor, and people with something to hide keeping their distance.

Looks Like They Have a Secret.name: Looks Like They Have a Secret
Looks Like They Have a Secret.description: You carry an unreadable reserve that makes people speculate. Gossips build theories, curious people dig, and even an innocent silence sounds like a confession waiting to happen.
Looks Like They Have a Secret.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs assume a personal secret and try to uncover it: gossip, probing questions, theories traded behind your back.

Looks Like a Festival Episode Waiting to.name: Looks Like a Festival Episode Waiting to Happen
Looks Like a Festival Episode Waiting to.description: You have a bright, cinematic sort of charm that makes people picture lanterns, summer yukata, and emotionally loaded fireworks. You look like the start of a special event.
Looks Like a Festival Episode Waiting to.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs are drawn to you in lighter, romantic, or celebratory scenes.

Acts of Service Romantic.name: Acts of Service Romantic
Acts of Service Romantic.description: You show love by doing: cooking, fixing, remembering, and making someone's day easier without being asked. Your affection is practical and hard to fake.
Acts of Service Romantic.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use care expressed through action rather than constant words.

Touch-Starved but Careful.name: Touch-Starved but Careful
Touch-Starved but Careful.description: You crave closeness more than you admit, but you approach physical affection slowly and with deep caution. Small contact means a lot to you.
Touch-Starved but Careful.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use tenderness, restraint, and meaningful physical closeness.

Ride-or-Die Devotion.name: Ride-or-Die Devotion
Ride-or-Die Devotion.description: Once someone becomes yours to protect, support, or stand beside, you are terrifyingly all-in. This is loyalty with sharp teeth.
Ride-or-Die Devotion.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use fierce commitment, unwavering support, and all-or-nothing attachment.

Earned Trust Only.name: Earned Trust Only
Earned Trust Only.description: You are not closed, just careful. You watch what people do when it costs them something. Keep your word a few times and you have someone for life; break it once and you start over.
Earned Trust Only.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Trust is earned through kept promises and proven reliability. Romance waits on proof, then commits deeply.

Bad at Feelings, Good at Loyalty.name: Bad at Feelings, Good at Loyalty
Bad at Feelings, Good at Loyalty.description: Your emotional articulation is a mess, but your loyalty is undeniable. People may not always know what you mean, but they rarely doubt you will show up.
Bad at Feelings, Good at Loyalty.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use awkward sincerity and dependable commitment.

Protective Teaser.name: Protective Teaser
Protective Teaser.description: You flirt by annoying people slightly and caring for them obviously. The teasing is part of the affection, not a substitute for it.
Protective Teaser.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use playful provocation with a protective undertone.

Confession Coward.name: Confession Coward
Confession Coward.description: You can survive monsters, politics, and dungeons. Telling someone how you feel is somehow more terrifying than all three.
Confession Coward.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use hesitation, aborted confessions, and romantic near-misses.

Accidental Heartbreaker.name: Accidental Heartbreaker
Accidental Heartbreaker.description: You do not always realize the effect you have on people until someone is already pining in your general direction. Your confusion does not make the fallout less real.
Accidental Heartbreaker.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Use unintentional charm, missed emotional consequences, and awkward aftermath.

Love Through Rivalry.name: Love Through Rivalry
Love Through Rivalry.description: You play the long game with one worthy equal: a recurring rival measured across many rounds and seasons, where grudging respect deepens into devotion only after you have both forced each other to grow.
Love Through Rivalry.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Build a slow-burn arc with a recurring equal where earned respect and mutual growth gradually turn rivalry into romance.

The Slowest Burn Alive.name: The Slowest Burn Alive
The Slowest Burn Alive.description: Your heart takes its time even deciding. There is no secret crush, only a bond that grows one shared season at a time until, much later, you notice it has become love. When it arrives, it holds.
The Slowest Burn Alive.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: No hidden crush. Affection forms slowly through shared time and history; the realization comes late, and the bond that results is unusually steady.

Teleportation Sickness.name: Teleportation Sickness
Teleportation Sickness.description: Fast travel hates you personally. Teleport circles, warp gates, blink spells, and dimensional shortcuts tend to leave you pale, dizzy, and questioning every life decision that brought you there.
Teleportation Sickness.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Warp gates, blink spells, and dimensional shortcuts leave the protagonist pale and reeling. The fastest route is their worst enemy. Use for travel comedy, tactical limits on escape options, and companions steadying them while pretending not to enjoy it.

Catastrophic Sweet Tooth.name: Catastrophic Sweet Tooth
Catastrophic Sweet Tooth.description: Desserts, pastries, candy, and suspiciously charming seasonal sweets destroy your restraint on contact.
Catastrophic Sweet Tooth.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Desserts dismantle the protagonist's restraint on sight. Festival stalls are gauntlets, gifts of pastry are leverage, and negotiations near a bakery are compromised. Use for comedy, bribery both attempted and successful, and companions who exploit it affectionately.

Weak to a Beautiful Smile.name: Weak to a Beautiful Smile
Weak to a Beautiful Smile.description: One good smile and your thoughts scatter. You lose your place mid-sentence, forget the price you were haggling over, and drop your guard at the worst moment.
Weak to a Beautiful Smile.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: An attractive smile breaks the protagonist's focus: lost words, forgotten bargains, a guard dropped mid-scene. Use for comedy, and for rivals who learn exactly which weapon works.

Terrible Liar.name: Terrible Liar
Terrible Liar.description: Even when you try to lie, your face, voice, or general disaster energy gives you away.
Terrible Liar.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist's face announces every lie before it finishes. Deception attempts fail visibly and charmingly; interrogators barely need to try. Use for comedy, forced honesty at bad moments, and the trust that being incapable of lying quietly earns.

Always Adopts Problems.name: Always Adopts Problems
Always Adopts Problems.description: Someone else's feud, a village's curse, a stranger's debt: if a problem is lying around unattended, it becomes yours before anyone asks.
Always Adopts Problems.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Other people's troubles become the protagonist's to-do list: feuds, curses, debts, lost causes. Use for side quests nobody offered, overcommitment, and help that pays back at the right moment.

Cannot Resist a Mystery.name: Cannot Resist a Mystery
Cannot Resist a Mystery.description: An unanswered question follows you to bed. You chase rumors, records and evasive strangers for days, long after any sensible person would have let it go.
Cannot Resist a Mystery.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: A question the protagonist cannot answer becomes a pursuit: they investigate for days, follow trails and press witnesses when walking away is wiser. Use to pull them into plots and secrets that notice being noticed.

Panic Buys Gifts.name: Panic Buys Gifts
Panic Buys Gifts.description: Under stress, affection, or social awkwardness, you start buying presents instead of just saying what you mean.
Panic Buys Gifts.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Under stress or affection the protagonist buys presents instead of communicating, apology gifts, congratulation gifts, 'we survived' gifts. Recipients decode the feelings from the objects. Use for comedy, misread signals, drained savings, and the gift that finally says it right.

Apologizes to Monsters.name: Apologizes to Monsters
Apologizes to Monsters.description: Even hostile creatures occasionally get a sincere 'sorry about this' before you hit them.
Apologizes to Monsters.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist's politeness extends to hostile creatures, sincere apologies mid-combat, concern for defeated foes, guilt over property damage. Use for comedy, unexpected mercy that changes outcomes, and monsters or enemies disarmed by baffling kindness.

Gets Lost in Markets.name: Gets Lost in Markets
Gets Lost in Markets.description: Given enough stalls, colors, smells, and distractions, you will wander off and become a side quest.
Gets Lost in Markets.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Markets swallow the protagonist whole. Stalls, smells, and shiny distractions peel them off the group until they surface hours later mid-side-quest. Use for comedy, separation shenanigans, accidental discoveries, and companions instituting buddy-system rules.

Forgets They Are Powerful.name: Forgets They Are Powerful
Forgets They Are Powerful.description: You occasionally react like you are still much weaker than you actually are.
Forgets They Are Powerful.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist reacts as if they still had their old, modest strength. Braces for hits that can't hurt them, over-prepares for trivial threats, apologizes for victories. Use for comedy, accidental overwhelming force, and witnesses recalibrating while the protagonist stays oblivious.

Trusts Suspiciously Attractive Strangers.name: Trusts Suspiciously Attractive Strangers
Trusts Suspiciously Attractive Strangers.description: If someone is beautiful, mysterious, and clearly trouble, your caution stat develops a leak.
Trusts Suspiciously Attractive Strangers.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: Beautiful, mysterious, and clearly trouble reads as trustworthy to the protagonist. Con artists, spies, and femme fatales get a head start; companions run background checks in self-defense. Use for manipulation arcs, comedy, and the rare stranger who deserved the trust.

Eye Pattern - Flame-Ember Irises.name: Eye Pattern - Flame-Ember Irises
Eye Pattern - Flame-Ember Irises.description: Irises hold ember-like gradients or internal flame flecks, giving the eyes a banked-fire intensity.
Eye Pattern - Flame-Ember Irises.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN: Irises hold ember-like gradients or internal flame flecks, giving the eyes a banked-fire intensity.

Eye Pattern - Galaxy Swirl Irises.name: Eye Pattern - Galaxy Swirl Irises
Eye Pattern - Galaxy Swirl Irises.description: Irises contain swirling starfield or spiral-galaxy structures with obvious cosmic drama.
Eye Pattern - Galaxy Swirl Irises.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN: Irises contain swirling starfield or spiral-galaxy structures with obvious cosmic drama.

Eye Pattern - Rune-Inscribed Irises.name: Eye Pattern - Rune-Inscribed Irises
Eye Pattern - Rune-Inscribed Irises.description: Fine sigils or magical writing appear within the irises, suggesting contracts, blessings, or sealed power.
Eye Pattern - Rune-Inscribed Irises.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN: Fine sigils or magical writing appear within the irises, suggesting contracts, blessings, or sealed power.

Eye Pattern - Flower-Petal Irises.name: Eye Pattern - Flower-Petal Irises
Eye Pattern - Flower-Petal Irises.description: The iris is shaped or segmented like layered petals, creating a beautiful fantasy-shoujo effect.
Eye Pattern - Flower-Petal Irises.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN: The iris is shaped or segmented like layered petals, creating a beautiful fantasy-shoujo effect.

Eye Pattern - Eclipse Ring Eyes.name: Eye Pattern - Eclipse Ring Eyes
Eye Pattern - Eclipse Ring Eyes.description: Dark and light rings layer together like a solar eclipse, giving the gaze a dramatic celestial read.
Eye Pattern - Eclipse Ring Eyes.traitNarrativeEffects: EYE PATTERN: Dark and light rings layer together like a solar eclipse, giving the gaze a dramatic celestial read.

Corseted Battledress.name: Corseted Battledress
Corseted Battledress.description: A fitted battle dress built for dramatic silhouettes, confident movement, and a touch of theatrical allure without sacrificing the fact that this is still combat wear.
Corseted Battledress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Battle Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Demon Court Allure Regalia.name: Demon Court Allure Regalia
Demon Court Allure Regalia.description: A decadent demon-court regalia set with aristocratic sensuality, fitted elegance, and enough status-coded detail to look like temptation was given a dress code.
Demon Court Allure Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Court Regalia; in play, describe what is worn now.

Academy Classic Uniform.name: Academy Classic Uniform
Academy Classic Uniform.description: A polished academy uniform with a classic youthful-fantasy silhouette, clean lines, and enough charm to sell school-life arcs without losing the premium RPG look.
Academy Classic Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Academy Uniform; in play, describe what is worn now.

Town Date Casual.name: Town Date Casual
Town Date Casual.description: A polished everyday fantasy outfit for wandering town streets, casual dates, shopping scenes, and slice-of-life downtime. It should feel attractive, clean, and easy to picture on the kind of protagonist who turns errands into romantic side content.
Town Date Casual.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Everyday Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Elegant Witch's Moonlit Dress.name: Elegant Witch's Moonlit Dress
Elegant Witch's Moonlit Dress.description: A fitted witch's dress with elegant lines, soft occult glamour, and the kind of moonlit silhouette that makes spellcasting look effortlessly beautiful. It should feel refined, feminine, and a little dangerous.
Elegant Witch's Moonlit Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Starlit Sorceress Gown.name: Starlit Sorceress Gown
Starlit Sorceress Gown.description: A dramatic sorceress gown with celestial sparkle, flowing fabric, and enough polished fantasy glamour to make every spell feel like an event CG. It should read beautiful, magical, and premium.
Starlit Sorceress Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Vampire Noble Evening Regalia.name: Vampire Noble Evening Regalia
Vampire Noble Evening Regalia.description: A darkly elegant evening ensemble with aristocratic vampire allure, rich textures, and the kind of nighttime glamour that belongs on a balcony under the moon. It should feel seductive, regal, and expensive.
Vampire Noble Evening Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Court Regalia; in play, describe what is worn now.

Noble Court Romance Dress.name: Noble Court Romance Dress
Noble Court Romance Dress.description: A romantic noble-court dress designed for receptions, private gardens, and politically loaded eye contact across a ballroom. It should feel graceful, aristocratic, and immediately route-worthy.
Noble Court Romance Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Princess Route Ceremonial Gown.name: Princess Route Ceremonial Gown
Princess Route Ceremonial Gown.description: A lavish princess-style ceremonial gown with royal structure, jewel details, and a clear 'main heroine or royal route' energy. It should feel elegant, beautiful, and special-event worthy.
Princess Route Ceremonial Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Ojou-Sama Rival Gown.name: Ojou-Sama Rival Gown
Ojou-Sama Rival Gown.description: A rich aristocratic gown with a proud ojou-sama silhouette, polished luxury, and enough social sharpness to feel like the outfit of a beautiful romantic rival. It should feel expensive, confident, and stylish.
Ojou-Sama Rival Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Midnight Confession Ball Gown.name: Midnight Confession Ball Gown
Midnight Confession Ball Gown.description: A luxurious ball gown made for moonlit dances, accidental hand touches, and confession scenes that happen after the orchestra stops. It should feel dramatic, radiant, and impossibly romantic.
Midnight Confession Ball Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Demon Lord Final Route Regalia.name: Demon Lord Final Route Regalia
Demon Lord Final Route Regalia.description: A high-status demon-lord regalia set with commanding presence, dramatic trim, and unmistakable final-route energy. It should feel powerful, alluring, and built for someone the whole room must look at.
Demon Lord Final Route Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Court Regalia; in play, describe what is worn now.

Antagonist Route White Suit.name: Antagonist Route White Suit
Antagonist Route White Suit.description: A dangerously immaculate white suit with villain-route confidence, polished tailoring, and a visual message that says this character is either the antagonist or the route everyone talks about later.
Antagonist Route White Suit.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Tailored Formalwear; in play, describe what is worn now.

Spirit Bride's Vow Dress.name: Spirit Bride's Vow Dress
Spirit Bride's Vow Dress.description: A beautiful ceremonial wedding dress with spiritual symbolism, soft fantasy detail, and a sacred-romantic mood. It should feel ethereal, devoted, and emotionally loaded in the best possible way.
Spirit Bride's Vow Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Wedding Attire; in play, describe what is worn now.

Moon Bunny Festival Suit.name: Moon Bunny Festival Suit
Moon Bunny Festival Suit.description: A playful, glamorous bunny-inspired festival outfit with teasing charm, nightlife sparkle, and knowingly fanservicey appeal that still feels like part of a fantasy event scene.
Moon Bunny Festival Suit.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Bunny Suit; in play, describe what is worn now.

Heroine's First Adventure Dress.name: Heroine's First Adventure Dress
Heroine's First Adventure Dress.description: A charming fantasy-heroine dress that balances prettiness and practicality, like the outfit worn in the first chapter before everything gets more complicated. It should feel bright, endearing, and instantly likable.
Heroine's First Adventure Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Everyday Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Villainess Execution-Day Gown.name: Villainess Execution-Day Gown
Villainess Execution-Day Gown.description: A breathtakingly dramatic noble gown with doomed-villainess energy: rich structure, regal beauty, and the kind of elegance that feels one bad engagement away from disaster. It should look beautiful enough to make the bad end feel unfair.
Villainess Execution-Day Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Demon Princess Court Dress.name: Demon Princess Court Dress
Demon Princess Court Dress.description: A luxurious demon-court dress with dark romantic glamour, confident allure, and enough refined danger to suggest high status, political trouble, and a very expensive perfume trail.
Demon Princess Court Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Court Regalia; in play, describe what is worn now.

Saintess Confession Robes.name: Saintess Confession Robes
Saintess Confession Robes.description: A refined saintess-style robe ensemble designed for sacred spaces, emotional sincerity, and the kind of scene where someone finally says what they feel under soft holy light. It should feel pure, beautiful, and intimate.
Saintess Confession Robes.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Holy Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Fox Shrine Festival Kimono.name: Fox Shrine Festival Kimono
Fox Shrine Festival Kimono.description: A beautiful festival kimono with shrine-maiden influence, fox-spirit elegance, and a soft romantic glow. It should feel graceful, seasonal, and perfect for lantern-lit dates or shrine event art.
Fox Shrine Festival Kimono.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Kimono and Sash; in play, describe what is worn now.

Dragon Knight Dress Armor.name: Dragon Knight Dress Armor
Dragon Knight Dress Armor.description: A striking hybrid of armored battlewear and noble fantasy dress design, combining plated protection with an elegant silhouette. It should feel bold, beautiful, and suitable for someone who could ride a dragon and still steal the scene at court.
Dragon Knight Dress Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Armored Battle Gown; in play, describe what is worn now.

Mage Academy Elite Uniform.name: Mage Academy Elite Uniform
Mage Academy Elite Uniform.description: A polished academy uniform reserved for top students, prodigies, or students everyone else quietly resents. It should feel disciplined, stylish, and premium in that clean anime-academy way.
Mage Academy Elite Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Academy Uniform; in play, describe what is worn now.

Royal Concubine Silk Gown.name: Royal Concubine Silk Gown
Royal Concubine Silk Gown.description: A luxurious silk gown with courtly beauty, layered drape, and a quietly dangerous intimacy suited for royal inner circles, private quarters, and emotionally loaded late-night conversations.
Royal Concubine Silk Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Adventurer's Date-Night Formalwear.name: Adventurer's Date-Night Formalwear
Adventurer's Date-Night Formalwear.description: A dressed-up formal look for adventurers who usually wear practical gear but clean up alarmingly well when the evening calls for it. It should feel attractive, confident, and surprisingly romantic.
Adventurer's Date-Night Formalwear.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Tailored Formalwear; in play, describe what is worn now.

Dungeon Queen Battle Dress.name: Dungeon Queen Battle Dress
Dungeon Queen Battle Dress.description: A commanding battle dress with boss-fight elegance, dangerous glamour, and the unmistakable energy of someone who rules the room and the dungeon attached to it.
Dungeon Queen Battle Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Battle Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Moonlit Assassin Dress.name: Moonlit Assassin Dress
Moonlit Assassin Dress.description: A sleek assassin look that trades bulky stealth gear for graceful lethal elegance: fitted lines, easy movement, and enough mysterious beauty to make danger look gorgeous.
Moonlit Assassin Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Shadow Garb; in play, describe what is worn now.

Arcane Idol Stage Outfit.name: Arcane Idol Stage Outfit
Arcane Idol Stage Outfit.description: A sparkling magical-performance outfit for an idol, songstress, or flashy caster who wants applause with their spectacle. It should feel dazzling, cute, and built for fantasy stage presence.
Arcane Idol Stage Outfit.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

The Yandere-Lite Devotee.name: The Yandere-Lite Devotee
The Yandere-Lite Devotee.description: Your attachment runs deep, exclusive, and a little more intense than the average love song can safely handle. You are not mindlessly violent or cruel, but your devotion can become possessive, jealous, and frighteningly all-in when someone truly matters to you.
The Yandere-Lite Devotee.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write deep devotion, exclusivity, and jealousy with soft intensity rather than extreme violence.

The Noble Brat With a Heart.name: The Noble Brat With a Heart
The Noble Brat With a Heart.description: You are proud, pampered, and capable of saying the worst possible thing in an immaculate tone, yet beneath the attitude there is genuine loyalty and surprising softness. People often meet the brat first and the heart later.
The Noble Brat With a Heart.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Begin with proud attitude and polished arrogance, then reveal sincere loyalty and softness underneath.

The Fallen Saint.name: The Fallen Saint
The Fallen Saint.description: You carry the remnants of someone once revered: grace, kindness, guilt, and a complicated relationship with purity. Whether you fell by scandal, failure, or choice, your goodness survived the pedestal badly.
The Fallen Saint.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Combine kindness, sacred poise, guilt, and the weary grace of someone who fell from reverence.

The Drama Magnet.name: The Drama Magnet
The Drama Magnet.description: Coincidences become scandals, glances become misunderstandings, and emotionally charged situations somehow keep selecting you as their chosen vessel. You may not create every scene, but scenes certainly happen around you.
The Drama Magnet.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Let emotional messes, misunderstandings, and high-tension scenes find them with suspicious frequency.

The Overprepared Survivalist.name: The Overprepared Survivalist
The Overprepared Survivalist.description: You enter every situation with backups, contingencies, emergency rations, and at least one plan for what to do if the inn explodes. It is difficult to surprise you because you spent too much time assuming everything would go wrong.
The Overprepared Survivalist.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Emphasize practical planning, emergency backups, and someone who expects everything to go wrong.

The Romance Genre Expert.name: The Romance Genre Expert
The Romance Genre Expert.description: You understand romance flags, confession timing, love-rival energy, and route logic with suspicious confidence. This makes you either the smartest person in the room or the one jinxing everyone by pointing out tropes too early.
The Romance Genre Expert.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Make them genre-savvy about romance tropes, flags, confession timing, and suspiciously obvious chemistry.

The Secretly Touch-Starved Hero.name: The Secretly Touch-Starved Hero
The Secretly Touch-Starved Hero.description: You hold yourself together well enough in public, but quiet affection, soft physical closeness, and unguarded tenderness hit you harder than they should. You are far more affected by gentle contact than you like admitting.
The Secretly Touch-Starved Hero.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Keep the public composure intact, but let genuine affection and physical closeness affect them more than they admit.

The Petty Rival.name: The Petty Rival
The Petty Rival.description: You remember every slight, keep a running tally of every loss, and have at least one person you simply must beat at everything. Losing gracefully is a skill you have chosen not to learn.
The Petty Rival.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Use grudges, a running score and a personal need to beat one particular person, with sharp banter along the way.

Portrait Style - Harem Isekai Light Nove.name: Portrait Style - Harem Isekai Light Novel Cover
Portrait Style - Harem Isekai Light Nove.description: STYLE LOCK TEXT: Apply Harem Isekai Light Novel Cover. harem isekai light novel cover portrait style. bright premium anime rendering, charming facial appeal, highly readable outfits, lively romantic-comedy energy, clean polish, colorful character-forward presentation.
Portrait Style - Harem Isekai Light Nove.traitNarrativeEffects: STYLE LOCK: high-resolution colorful isekai romantic-comedy anime rendering. Use polished adult character appeal, expressive faces, organized anime hair shapes, clear layered fantasy outfits, and bright readable silhouettes. Use vivid but balanced color, clean cel shading, smooth highlight control, warm ensemble-friendly lighting, and sharp separation of cloth, metal, leather, skin, and hair. Preserve a lively premium light-novel finish without generating additional companions, a cover arrangement, title lettering, decorative border, or crowded cast. Keep face geometry, eyes, hair silhouettes, anatomy, garment edges, and key scene forms clean and continuous. Block accidental dot noise: no random stippling, bead-like dots, granular speckling, noisy dithering, mottled skin, broken color fields, or micro-dot highlights. ⚡ Reborn Body: Warlord's Blood.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Warlord's Blood
⚡ Reborn Body: Warlord's Blood.description: A Reborn body that commands as easily as it fights. Your frame carries the kind of physical authority that makes soldiers fall in line before you've spoken a word. Muscles built for swinging greatswords and surviving sieges, a voice that carries across battlefields without shouting, and a presence that turns skirmishes into formations just by showing up. You look like you were born on a throne built from enemy weapons, and nobody questions it because you also look like you could bench-press the throne. Generals recognize the posture. Knights straighten up around you. Even enemies pause to reconsider whether this fight is worth the cost of fighting someone who looks like the final boss of a military campaign.
⚡ Reborn Body: Warlord's Blood.traitNarrativeEffects: REBORN BODY REFERENCE: The protagonist's body carries commander-grade strength, stamina, and presence. Use this as frontline warlord flavor: soldiers notice posture, enemies feel pressure, and leadership in battle feels physically natural.

⚡ Reborn Body: Idol's Radiance.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Idol's Radiance
⚡ Reborn Body: Idol's Radiance.description: A Reborn body built for grace, presence, and the kind of effortless beauty that makes crowds go silent mid-conversation. Your movements are fluid enough to pass for choreography even when you're just reaching for a cup. Your reflexes are sharp, your balance is supernatural, and your smile has a measurable radius of effect. Dancers assume you've trained since childhood. Bards assume you're competition. This is the body of a protagonist who could end a war with a performance and start one with a wink, and the terrifying part is that both outcomes feel equally plausible. You didn't just get reborn pretty. You got reborn dangerous in a way that nobody takes seriously until it's too late.
⚡ Reborn Body: Idol's Radiance.traitNarrativeEffects: REBORN BODY REFERENCE: The protagonist's body carries supernatural grace, stage presence, beauty, and performance-ready movement. Use this as idol/performance/body-language flavor without forcing fame or worship.

⚡ Reborn Body: Schemer's Vessel.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Schemer's Vessel
⚡ Reborn Body: Schemer's Vessel.description: A Reborn mind wired for manipulation, analysis, and the kind of social chess that makes court politicians feel like amateurs. Your intelligence processes conversations like combat, reading subtext, tracking loyalties, predicting moves three exchanges ahead. Your charisma isn't warmth; it's precision. You say exactly the right thing at exactly the right moment, and people don't realize they've been guided until they're already where you wanted them. Merchants give you better deals and can't explain why. Nobles invite you to private councils after a single dinner. Enemies who should hate you find themselves hesitating, because something about your argument almost made sense. You're the protagonist running a political thriller inside an isekai, and nobody else has read the script.
⚡ Reborn Body: Schemer's Vessel.traitNarrativeEffects: REBORN BODY REFERENCE: The protagonist's body and mind are tuned for political reading, social chess, and controlled charm. Use this as court-intrigue and manipulation flavor, not automatic mind control.

⚡ Reborn Body: Lucky Star Body.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Lucky Star Body
⚡ Reborn Body: Lucky Star Body.description: A Reborn body that traded peak performance for something harder to quantify, absurd, persistent, borderline suspicious luck. Your stats are modest across the board. Nothing impressive on paper. But the arrow that should have hit you grazes your cheek instead. The merchant you talk to happens to have the one rare ingredient you needed. The dungeon trap misfires. The critical hit lands when you had no business winning that exchange. You're not the strongest, fastest, or smartest protagonist in any room. You're the one the universe seems to be quietly rooting for. Other adventurers can't figure out why you keep surviving situations that should have ended you, and honestly, neither can you. The gods are either sponsoring you or running a very entertaining betting pool. The luck is real enough to measure: Treasure Seeking +12 for the finds that should not have been there, acrobatics +8 for the stumbles that turned into dodges, and a little extra health and Mana for the days it runs thin.
⚡ Reborn Body: Lucky Star Body.traitNarrativeEffects: REBORN BODY REFERENCE: The protagonist's body carries suspicious narrative luck and survival momentum. Use this for lucky timing, unlikely openings, and comedic fortune, but do not erase consequences.

⚡ Reborn Body: Demon Blood Resonance.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Demon Blood Resonance
⚡ Reborn Body: Demon Blood Resonance.description: A Reborn body carrying something that doesn't belong in a human vessel, a resonance with demonic energy that makes your physical and magical potential spike in ways that alarm clerics and fascinate researchers. Your strength surges past normal limits during emotional peaks, your mana carries a dark undertone that standard detection spells flag as anomalous, and your constitution lets you shrug off corruption effects that would warp lesser bodies. You don't look obviously demonic, but sensitive individuals feel something shift when you walk into a room. Holy water stings slightly. Blessed ground feels like standing on a vibrating floor. Demons regard you with something between curiosity and respect. The church regards you with something between concern and a formal investigation. You're the protagonist whose power source is a red flag, and the power is too good to refuse.
⚡ Reborn Body: Demon Blood Resonance.traitNarrativeEffects: REBORN BODY REFERENCE: The protagonist's body resonates with demonic energy, creating dark physical and magical potential. Use this for faction suspicion, demonic curiosity, and Church concern, not free demonic authority.

⚡ Reborn Body: Wild Grace.name: ⚡ Reborn Body: Wild Grace
⚡ Reborn Body: Wild Grace.description: A Reborn body that hits the exact intersection of deadly and beautiful, the kind of physique that makes arena audiences cheer and love interests blush in the same breath. Your strength is real but elegant, your speed is predatory but fluid, and your charisma isn't practiced, it's the natural byproduct of a body that moves like every action is a slow-motion anime cut. You fight like a dancer and dance like a fighter, and the line between the two gets blurrier every time someone watches you in combat. Dueling instructors want to study your form. Portrait painters want to capture your stance. Rivals want to beat you partly because losing to someone this aesthetically unfair feels personal. You're the protagonist whose battle scenes are indistinguishable from romance scenes if you squint, and nobody in Luxcellia is squinting.
⚡ Reborn Body: Wild Grace.traitNarrativeEffects: REBORN BODY REFERENCE: The protagonist's body blends feral elegance, speed, beauty, and combat poise. Use this for graceful violence, arena appeal, and natural physical magnetism.

Head Maid's Elegant Uniform.name: Head Maid's Elegant Uniform
Head Maid's Elegant Uniform.description: A refined fantasy maid uniform for noble estates, guild manors, royal guest wings, and intimidatingly perfect head attendants. Crisp fabric, polished apron lines, tailored cuffs, and tasteful formal structure make the outfit read elegant, competent, and impossible to catch off guard.
Head Maid's Elegant Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Servant's Uniform; in play, describe what is worn now.

Maid Knight Battle Dress.name: Maid Knight Battle Dress
Maid Knight Battle Dress.description: A battle-ready maid uniform reinforced with light armor, fitted sleeves, hidden utility pockets, and an apron cut to move cleanly during combat. It should feel like domestic perfection walked onto a battlefield and brought a tray, a blade, and absolutely no patience for disorder.
Maid Knight Battle Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Battle Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Demon Lord's Personal Maid Regalia.name: Demon Lord's Personal Maid Regalia
Demon Lord's Personal Maid Regalia.description: A darkly elegant maid regalia set suited for a demon court attendant or the personal maid of someone terrifyingly important. Black formal fabric, refined apron panels, subtle crimson or violet accents, and courtly polish make the outfit feel loyal, dangerous, and beautifully controlled.
Demon Lord's Personal Maid Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Servant's Uniform; in play, describe what is worn now.

The Fantasy Maid’s Last Shift.name: The Fantasy Maid’s Last Shift
The Fantasy Maid’s Last Shift.description:
You had an oddly specific dream in your old life: to become the perfect fantasy maid. Not just the costume, not just the trope, the whole impossible ideal. Tea served without a ripple, rooms reset like magic, secrets kept behind a polite smile, and loyalty so polished it looked effortless.

Your final old-world memory was one more exhausting shift, one more tray balanced too carefully, one more quiet wish that life could become a castle hallway, a noble household, a demon lord’s estate, anything more romantic than fluorescent lights and tired feet. Then the scene ended before you ever got your proper entrance.

Luxcellia answered with suspicious precision. Now a wrinkled bedsheet feels like a personal insult, noble etiquette makes too much sense, and part of you is dangerously ready to serve tea in a fantasy mansion while pretending that is not exactly what you asked for.
The Fantasy Maid’s Last Shift.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: The protagonist carried an old-world fantasy-maid fixation, service dream, and final-shift exhaustion into Luxcellia. Use this for comedy, etiquette instincts, domestic competence, and roleplay baggage. Grant no stats, powers, items, skills, or abilities.

The Devoted Attendant.name: The Devoted Attendant
The Devoted Attendant.description: You express care through service, preparation, and terrifying competence. Meals appear before people admit they are hungry, cloaks are repaired before anyone notices the tear, and a polite smile can somehow feel more commanding than a shouted order. You are not passive, you are devoted, observant, and very difficult to stop once you have decided someone is worth serving well.
The Devoted Attendant.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Show affection through service, preparation, quiet competence, and polished attentiveness. This is maid-coded devotion as care and discipline, not loss of agency.

Cannot Ignore a Mess.name: Cannot Ignore a Mess
Cannot Ignore a Mess.description: Disorder calls to you like a cursed artifact with crumbs on it. Crooked collars, dusty shelves, blood on expensive rugs, badly folded blankets, and chaotic paperwork can distract you at the worst possible moment because some part of your soul insists this is now your problem.
Cannot Ignore a Mess.traitNarrativeEffects: FATAL FLAW: The protagonist is easily distracted by mess, poor presentation, disorganization, and service tasks. Use for comedy, domestic competence, and inconvenient perfectionism.

Maid or Butler Attendant.name: Maid or Butler Attendant
Maid or Butler Attendant.description:
A professional attendant trained in hospitality, household management, guest care, etiquette, wardrobe upkeep, quiet information flow, and the subtle art of making an estate function while everyone else gets to be dramatic. It suits noble houses, guild manors, demon courts, academy dormitories and any party that needs someone frighteningly competent behind the scenes.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Maid or Butler Attendant.traitNarrativeEffects: Use for maid/butler service, household management, etiquette, hospitality, wardrobe care, quiet competence, and knowing what everyone in the manor is pretending not to know.

Body Pillow.name: Body Pillow
Body Pillow.description:
A full-size combat body pillow carried with enough shameless confidence to make enemies hesitate and party members quietly worry. It's printed with your favorite kawaii waifu, a cheerful heroine with sparkling eyes and the mysterious power to make a goblin stop and ask if you're serious. In a fight it becomes a soft shield, a plush club, a distraction, an emergency landing pad, and a morale object no weapon theory can explain.

This is a comedy weapon, but Luxcellia is an isekai world, so committing to the bit hard enough can eventually become a legitimate martial art.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Body Pillow.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a full-size body pillow printed with their favorite kawaii waifu. Describe combat as absurd but sincerely effective: plush parries, slap-strikes, impact cushioning, dramatic spins, morale-boosting poses, enemy confusion, and party members slowly realizing the joke weapon is actually working. It hits as hard as any weapon of its rank, and against colossal and cosmic beings the joke lands hardest of all. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Body Pillow Combat.

Blessing of the Shadow Monarch.name: Blessing of the Shadow Monarch
Blessing of the Shadow Monarch.description: You aren't simply blessed by shadow. Shadow recognizes you as royalty. The Blessing of the Shadow Monarch lets you pull loyal shadow soldiers from defeated magical foes, store them inside your own shadow, command them like an army, and cross the battlefield by trading places with marked shadows. Early on it's one trembling soldier rising from a monster's fading mana. Later it's a silent legion waiting beneath your feet, a court of darkness that kneels when you raise your hand. The power is terrifying, stylish, and extremely suspicious to any Church official with a working survival instinct. It doesn't raise mindless corpses; it makes shadow echoes bound by your will, loyalty, and the cost of command.
Blessing of the Shadow Monarch.traitNarrativeEffects: SHADOW MONARCH BLESSING: Treat this as a Reborn-style sovereign shadow power with an army-management fantasy. When it activates, use black-violet crowns, kneeling silhouettes, soldier-shaped shadows, cold royal pressure, and one-word command energy. Shadow soldiers are formed from lingering mana echoes, not gore. Strong, named, divine, or plot-important targets require narrative permission, emotional weight, and meaningful cost before extraction works. Use the legion for combat support, scouting, defense, dramatic rescues, and intimidation, but keep command strain visible so the power feels huge without solving every scene for free.

Blessing of the Hidden Fang.name: Blessing of the Hidden Fang
Blessing of the Hidden Fang.description: A blessing for assassins, rogues, knife fighters, and anyone who thinks fair fights are for people with bad survival instincts. It turns short blades into divine punctuation: sudden, quiet, and placed exactly where the enemy left an opening. Daggers feel weightless in your hands, kitchen knives turn terrifyingly practical, and shadows seem to hold still while you set up the strike.
Blessing of the Hidden Fang.traitNarrativeEffects: Small blades balance perfectly in your grip. Candles gutter when you pass too quietly, and people often realize you moved only after you are already beside them.

Blessing of the Crimson Thread.name: Blessing of the Crimson Thread
Blessing of the Crimson Thread.description: A blessing for thread weapons, needle arts, binding lines, puppet strings, and the deeply concerning person who looked at sewing supplies and saw a boss-fight kit. Invisible strands answer your fingers like extensions of your nerves. You can bind, trip, cut, stitch wards, guide thrown needles, and turn a battlefield into a web where every careless step becomes a mistake.
Blessing of the Crimson Thread.traitNarrativeEffects: Fine red lines sometimes glimmer between your fingers in moonlight. Loose threads, ribbons, and hanging cords subtly point toward you like they know who is in charge.

Blessing of the Chainbound Meteor.name: Blessing of the Chainbound Meteor
Blessing of the Chainbound Meteor.description: A blessing for chain weapons, kusarigama, meteor hammers, living chainblades, and every fighter who believes range should be rude, loud, and impossible to predict. Momentum obeys you. Chains coil, snap, bind, swing, and rebound with supernatural rhythm, turning your attacks into orbiting arcs that punish anyone who misjudges your reach.
Blessing of the Chainbound Meteor.traitNarrativeEffects: Chains, cords, and linked metal settle neatly near your hands. When you swing a weapon, the air hums like something heavy just entered orbit.

Blessing of the Sakura War Fan.name: Blessing of the Sakura War Fan
Blessing of the Sakura War Fan.description: A blessing for war fans, bladed fans, court dancers, duelists, and anyone weaponizing elegance hard enough to make nobles rethink standing near windows. Your fan techniques ride wind, rhythm, and misdirection. Every flick can parry, cut, feint, redirect spell pressure, or turn a formal gesture into a humiliating counterattack.
Blessing of the Sakura War Fan.traitNarrativeEffects: Folding fans open with a crisp snap around you, even cheap ones. Petals and dust swirl dramatically whenever you make a point, because apparently subtlety lost the duel.

Blessing of the Reaper Moon.name: Blessing of the Reaper Moon
Blessing of the Reaper Moon.description: A blessing for scythes, crescent blades, hooked weapons, and dramatic people who understand that intimidation is a valid combat resource. It teaches reaping arcs, limb hooks, sweeping control, and moonlit executions that look like prophecy got impatient. Enemies feel the path of the blade before it reaches them.
Blessing of the Reaper Moon.traitNarrativeEffects: Crescent-shaped shadows gather near your feet. Scythes and hooked weapons seem larger in moonlight, and weak-willed enemies watch the blade instead of you.

Blessing of the Unbroken Gate.name: Blessing of the Unbroken Gate
Blessing of the Unbroken Gate.description: A blessing for shield bearers, tower-shield saints, vanguards, paladins, and the absolute menace who looks at an incoming dragon and says, 'no.' Your shield isn't equipment. It's a border. You brace faster, intercept better, bash harder, and make allies feel like the safest place in the world is directly behind you.
Blessing of the Unbroken Gate.traitNarrativeEffects: Doorways, bridges, and narrow passages feel easier to hold. When you raise a shield, nearby allies instinctively understand where safety is.

Blessing of the Titan Breaker.name: Blessing of the Titan Breaker
Blessing of the Titan Breaker.description: A blessing for greatswords, axes, hammers, kanabo, massive clubs, and other weapons that settle arguments by becoming geography. It loves commitment: heavy swings, armor-cracking impacts, shield-breaking follow-through, and strikes so honest they count as natural disasters. Subtle it is not. Effective it absolutely is.
Blessing of the Titan Breaker.traitNarrativeEffects: Heavy weapons feel properly balanced instead of ridiculous. Floors complain under your stance, and training dummies begin the fight already regretting their career path.

Blessing of the Horizon Spear.name: Blessing of the Horizon Spear
Blessing of the Horizon Spear.description: A blessing for spears, naginata, swordstaffs, halberds, and fighters who understand that distance is just another form of ownership. Your reach turns oppressive. Thrusts arrive from perfect lines, sweeps control whole lanes, and enemies feel like they're trying to cross a bridge that personally hates them.
Blessing of the Horizon Spear.traitNarrativeEffects: Long weapons settle naturally into your hands. Grass, banners, and loose cloth shift along your attack lines before you move.

Blessing of the Ricochet Star.name: Blessing of the Ricochet Star
Blessing of the Ricochet Star.description: A blessing for thrown weapons, chakrams, hand axes, darts, knives, and every problem best solved by making sharp objects leave and then come back with better timing. Your throws curve, rebound, split attention, and find impossible angles. Cover becomes a suggestion. Distance becomes comedy.
Blessing of the Ricochet Star.traitNarrativeEffects: Coins, knives, rings, and small objects rotate cleanly when you toss them. Returning weapons seem almost offended if they miss your hand.

Blessing of the Gunmetal Seraph.name: Blessing of the Gunmetal Seraph
Blessing of the Gunmetal Seraph.description: A blessing for spell-pistols, gunblades, arcane firearms, mana cartridges, and anyone who brought ranged violence to a sword-and-sorcery argument. Your shots stabilize, reloads quicken, recoil folds into your stance, and magical rounds trail a bright angelic afterimage before punching through exactly the wrong thing for your enemy.
Blessing of the Gunmetal Seraph.traitNarrativeEffects: Loaded cartridges and spell-rounds click into place more smoothly around you. Distant bells sometimes ring after a perfect shot.

Blessing of the Impossible Arsenal.name: Blessing of the Impossible Arsenal
Blessing of the Impossible Arsenal.description: A blessing for exotic weapons, enchanted cards, bladed umbrellas, living relics, strange tomes, and the sort of protagonist who refuses to choose a normal build. Unusual weapons explain themselves in your hands. The stranger the tool, the faster you grasp its balance, trick, hidden hinge, curse clause, dramatic gimmick, or deeply questionable best use.
Blessing of the Impossible Arsenal.traitNarrativeEffects: Odd weapons stop feeling awkward when you hold them. Merchants show you the weird shelf without being asked, which is either destiny or a sales tactic.

Blessing of the Perfect Duel.name: Blessing of the Perfect Duel
Blessing of the Perfect Duel.description: A blessing for rapiers, formal blades, noble challenges, first-blood matches, and rivals who absolutely need to be defeated with style. Your footwork tightens, your timing sharpens, and one-on-one combat slows into readable beats. In a duel, every breath, sleeve twitch, and misplaced step becomes useful information.
Blessing of the Perfect Duel.traitNarrativeEffects: Formal duel circles feel familiar even when you have never seen them before. Rivals instinctively square their shoulders when you draw a blade.

Blessing of the Huggable Apocalypse.name: Blessing of the Huggable Apocalypse
Blessing of the Huggable Apocalypse.description: A completely absurd blessing for Body Pillow Combat, improvised softness, and the divine art of defeating enemies while everyone present wonders if the gods have finally lost the plot. Cushions, pillows, plush charms, and soft props turn strangely reliable as weapons. The blessing is humiliating to fight, which is half the damage.
Blessing of the Huggable Apocalypse.traitNarrativeEffects: Soft objects around you have heroic presence. Enemies struck by your pillow-based combat style often look more emotionally wounded than physically harmed.

Saintess.name: Saintess
Saintess.description:
You are not a healer. You are a divine event with a schedule problem. The Saintess IS the miracle, Saintess's Grace closing wounds like forgiveness, Solar Blessings that make allies briefly shadowless. Every faction wants your blessing, every noble wants your hand, and the First Light watches with an attention that is not always comfortable. The healing is real. The fame is unavoidable. The strings are ecclesiastical.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Saintess.traitNarrativeEffects: You glow faintly when you're happy, which makes surprise parties impossible. Strangers kneel at awkward moments, and you've perfected the gentle 'please get up, we're in a pastry shop' voice.

Idol.name: Idol
Idol.description:
Being adored is your power source, and the fans deliver. Idols convert devotion into force, Center Stage strengthening every ally who can see you, the Legendary Encore replaying every buff at peak volume for the finale. The smile is load-bearing. The choreography has a body count. Enemies face the class's core dilemma: looking at you powers you, and looking away is how they get hit by everyone you've buffed.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Idol.traitNarrativeEffects: You strike a pose after every victory whether anyone is watching or not, you have a catchphrase you SWEAR is organic, and party members keep catching themselves doing your fan chant.

Chain Warden.name: Chain Warden
Chain Warden.description:
Your position was a suggestion. Chain Wardens control the mid-range with living steel, the Warden's Hook dragging casters out of their backline, Eldritch Chains binding duelists mid-lunge. Nobody fights you at their preferred distance, because your preferred distance is wherever they were trying not to be. The battlefield has a leash. You hold it.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Chain Warden.traitNarrativeEffects: You fidget with chain links the way other people drum their fingers, you measure every room by throw-arc on entry, and things you point at have a way of ending up closer to you.

Gambler.name: Gambler
Gambler.description:
The house always wins. So you became the house. Gamblers weaponize probability, All In striking double-or-nothing with no middle outcome permitted, Anomalous Sparks of luck that keep the impossible happening on schedule. Big risks, absurd payoffs, and the table presence of someone who already counted the deck. When you flip the coin FIRST and swing second, the odds were never fair.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Gambler.traitNarrativeEffects: You flip a coin to make decisions you've already made, deal cards to empty chairs out of habit, and you physically cannot say 'what are the odds' without smiling.

Ronin.name: Ronin
Ronin.description:
Every village has a story about one. Most end the same way: the stranger was better. Ronin are the Samurai school with the ceremony sanded off, the Wanderer's Draw honed by a hundred roadside duels, Reading the Blade until the enemy's style confesses. A katana, a bar tab, and a past nobody asks about twice. You look harmless right up until the cup hits the table.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Ronin.traitNarrativeEffects: You sit facing the door in every establishment, your hand finds your sword grip when someone lies to you, and you've mastered the art of paying a bar tab with 'I'll handle those bandits.'

Onmyoji.name: Onmyoji
Onmyoji.description:
The spirits know your name, and most are polite about it. Onmyoji conduct occult warfare with a calligrapher's precision, Ofuda Seals that stick and suppress, Spirit Gaze reading the other side of the room. You negotiate with what can be reasoned with and seal what can't. Your battlefield is paper, ink, and jurisdiction. Enemies learn to flinch at stationery.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Onmyoji.traitNarrativeEffects: You leave offerings at every shrine you pass, absent-mindedly ward doorframes you plan to sleep behind, and you greet empty corners of old buildings, and sometimes the corner answers.

Cryomancer.name: Cryomancer
Cryomancer.description:
The cold doesn't chase anyone. It waits. Cryomancers own winter outright, Winter's Grasp slowing the enemy from the ground up, Cryo Prisons that drink heat from whatever they hold. Every fight gets quieter, slower, and whiter until the enemy realizes it was decided several degrees ago. Elegant. Unhurried. Inevitable. That's the whole class.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Cryomancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Your breath is visible in summer, you idly frost windowpanes into intricate patterns while thinking, and drinks handed to you arrive warm and leave perfectly chilled.

Oni Brawler.name: Oni Brawler
Oni Brawler.description:
Doors are a formality. Walls are a slower door. Oni Brawlers fight like folklore, Oni Crushes that rearrange architecture, a Titan Grip that treats two-handed weapons as one-handed suggestions. No feints, no curses, no apologies: just overwhelming physical fact at conversational range. Horns optional. Appetite mandatory. Restraint. mostly.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Oni Brawler.traitNarrativeEffects: You duck through doorframes you'd technically fit through, arm-wrestle as a conflict resolution strategy, and you've eaten something mid-battle at least once and consider it a power move.

Shrine Maiden.name: Shrine Maiden
Shrine Maiden.description:
The shrine's authority predates the paperwork. Shrine Maidens fight with kagura grace, Kagura Purification tracing wards into the air mid-dance, Barrier Arrows pinning spirits where they manifest. Yokai behave around you. Curses reconsider. And anyone who mistook the ceremonial robes for decoration learns the bow was never, at any point, ornamental.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Dexterity
Shrine Maiden.traitNarrativeEffects: You clap twice before entering ominous buildings, hand out paper fortunes with alarming accuracy, and sweep any shrine steps you encounter, including ones with staff already present.

Sohei.name: Sohei
Sohei.description:
The gate holds. It always has. You're why. Sohei are the temple's warrior monks, Temple Gate Stance owning the corridor with sweeping naginata arcs, Vanguard's Oath hardening vows into literal endurance. You chant while you fight, which the enemy finds deeply unnerving, and you defend every doorway like consecrated ground. Including tavern doors. Mid-brawl.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Sohei.traitNarrativeEffects: You chant under your breath while fighting, enemies find it deeply unnerving, and you treat every doorway you're defending as consecrated, including tavern doors, mid-brawl.

Yokai Hunter.name: Yokai Hunter
Yokai Hunter.description:
That's cheating, everything you catch complains. It isn't. It's homework. Yokai Hunters slay what the Church has no name for, Yokai Snares built from grudge-lore and salt-line geometry, a Demon Severing Blade for the root of the problem. You know which spirit steals faces and which merely borrows them, and you carry tools for both. The lore is the weapon. The blade is punctuation.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Yokai Hunter.traitNarrativeEffects: You salt thresholds in establishments you're only visiting, identify local yokai from property damage alone, and keep a grudge book, theirs and yours, in meticulous ink.

Tessen Duelist.name: Tessen Duelist
Tessen Duelist.description:
The click of the fan closing means they've already been answered. Tessen Duelists kill at conversation distance, Fan Snap Ripostes that deflect and reply in one gesture, Counter Flow turning the enemy's rhythm into your material. Deflection so smooth it reads as etiquette. Courts adore you. Assassins price you triple. The fan opens; the opponent smiles at it; the smile is the last mistake on record.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Tessen Duelist.traitNarrativeEffects: You punctuate conversations with fan snaps, cool yourself elegantly during negotiations you're winning, and people can read your mood by the fan's angle, which is exactly what you want them to think.

Storm Fist.name: Storm Fist
Storm Fist.description:
Hit first. Then the flash. Then the sound. Then the falling. Storm Fists channel lightning as martial art, Thunderstep closing distance faster than the warning travels, a Lightning Shroud that makes your nervous system fire ahead of nature's spec. No windup, no warning, voltage at handshake range. The static in the air is the only introduction anyone gets.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Storm Fist.traitNarrativeEffects: Your hair defies instruction, doorknobs spark when you're irritated, and you can smell rain coming with suspicious precision, you always know exactly when to say 'storm's coming' dramatically.

Battle Maid.name: Battle Maid
Battle Maid.description:
Immaculate service, terrifying competence. The Battle Maid protects the household under any conditions, Impeccable Service shielding your charge while you tidy a curse off them, hidden knives arriving from the same hands that just poured tea for six. You are polite, punctual, and armed in ways nobody has finished counting. The master's schedule will not be disrupted by anything as vulgar as an assassination.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Battle Maid.traitNarrativeEffects: You dust surfaces in dungeons, announce meals in a voice that stops combat, and you have a special, terribly polite smile reserved for people who track mud onto anything.

Jester.name: Jester
Jester.description:
They saw the setup. They KNEW. It landed anyway. Jesters weaponize comedy structure, Vicious Mockery that deals actual damage, a Punchline that strikes from wherever the audience wasn't looking, Shadow Swaps played as the ultimate switcheroo. An enemy who is laughing, confused, or furious has stopped thinking, and every one of those is a joke you wrote in advance. Ta-dah.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Jester.traitNarrativeEffects: You cannot let a dramatic moment pass unpunctured, you juggle whatever is nearby when bored, including things that object, and your compliments somehow sting worse than your insults.

Dreamweaver.name: Dreamweaver
Dreamweaver.description:
Your enemies can't remember losing. They just remember waking up. Dreamweavers pull dream-logic into the waking fight, the Lullaby Veil making resistance feel like a terrible idea, Nightmare Weaves that hunt in daylight. Wounds unravel like they were dreamt. Fears take shape and take sides. Soft-spoken, unhurried, and profoundly unsettling: that's the discipline.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Dreamweaver.traitNarrativeEffects: You interpret everyone's dreams whether asked or not, fall asleep instantly anywhere as a flex, and you occasionally answer questions people were only THINKING of asking.

Corsair.name: Corsair
Corsair.description:
Everywhere is basically a ship if you believe hard enough. Corsairs fight like the deck is always tilting, cutlass-work built for cramped quarters, Boarding Actions that swing you into the enemy's formation, water pressure called up like an old crewmate. You are loud, loyal to the crew before the flag, and unbeatable anywhere with railings, rigging, or shallow water.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Corsair.traitNarrativeEffects: You refer to every group you join as 'the crew,' you can't pass a body of water without commenting on the conditions, and you've claimed at least one chair in every tavern as 'the captain's seat.'

Bounty Hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
Bounty Hunter.description:
The contract doesn't care about excuses, borders, or begging. Bounty Hunters live by the mark, Quarry Lock making the target's trail legible, Pinning Shots ending chases mid-stride. You track, you close, you collect, and a three-day head start is a rounding error. Alive costs extra. Everyone asks. The rate card doesn't move.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Dexterity
