Bounty Hunter.traitNarrativeEffects: You appraise everyone you meet for a hypothetical bounty value, and it shows on your face, you keep old wanted posters like trophies, and you never sit with your back to a door twice.

Parasol Duelist.name: Parasol Duelist
Parasol Duelist.description:
Nothing is more demoralizing than an opponent deflecting your best attack while checking the weather. Parasol Duelists fight beneath the bladed umbrella, Parasol Guard shedding arrows like rain, Riposte Flourishes delivered from polite shade. Strolling pace, perfect posture, and the little *click* of the canopy closing that has ended more arguments than the blade has.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Parasol Duelist.traitNarrativeEffects: You check the weather purely for dramatic staging, offer your parasol's shade to allies mid-battle like it's a picnic, and the little *click* of it closing has ended more arguments than your blade has.

Gunblade Duelist.name: Gunblade Duelist
Gunblade Duelist.description:
The parry felt normal. Then it went off. Gunblade Duelists fight inside everyone's comfortable range at once, Trigger Parries that answer a blade-lock with a muzzle flash, Spell Triggers fired at zero range. Nobody trains against a sword that reloads. Duelists call it vulgar. Gunslingers call it excessive. Both keep losing to it.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Gunblade Duelist.traitNarrativeEffects: You spin the gunblade after victories despite knowing better, you count your remaining shots out loud to unsettle people, and every duel you win ends with the same smoking-blade pose.

Tidecaller.name: Tidecaller
Tidecaller.description:
They've been fighting at sea this whole time. Nobody told them. Tidecallers carry the ocean into melee, Riptide Sweeps that drag footing sideways, Leviathan's Maw when the deep answers in the shape of jaws. Three exchanges in, the ground is wet, the current is yours, and the enemy is drowning on dry land in every sense that matters. The tide doesn't argue. It arrives.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Tidecaller.traitNarrativeEffects: Puddles are deeper near you than physics suggests, you taste the air and announce the tide schedule of oceans that are nowhere nearby, and your hair is always slightly, inexplicably damp.

Mirage Blade.name: Mirage Blade
Mirage Blade.description:
Witnesses swear they fought two of you. Or five. Or none. Mirage Blades duel wrapped in desert heat-shimmer, Heat Haze Feints that sell a sword made of air, Phantom Rushes arriving from the wrong direction on purpose. Every strike is a question about which of you is real, and it's answered in blood before they finish asking. You sign no confirmations.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Mirage Blade.traitNarrativeEffects: You shimmer faintly at the edges when standing still too long, you answer 'which one of me' to direct questions as a joke that is only mostly a joke, and mirrors take a half-second to catch up to you.

Aurora Sentinel.name: Aurora Sentinel
Aurora Sentinel.description:
The dawn, standing guard. Aurora Sentinels defend with living light, the Aurora Ward catching attacks in prismatic bands, Refraction bending enemy magic into harmless color. You hold the line and make it gorgeous: everything aimed at your allies arrives at you instead, and leaves as a light show. Enemies aim worse at something beautiful. You know this. You use it.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Aurora Sentinel.traitNarrativeEffects: You are incapable of standing anywhere that isn't dramatically backlit, your barriers are unnecessarily color-coordinated, and you describe every defensive success in terms of the light conditions.

Vampire Hunter.name: Vampire Hunter
Vampire Hunter.description:
You've never once been invited in. You keep count. Vampire Hunters track the fanged aristocracy, Silver Stakes that pin what refuses to stay down, a Holy Avenger that suspends regeneration like an injunction. You know the sunset time to the minute in every region, you test doorways with the back of your hand, and you drink your coffee at dusk, facing west, out of professionalism.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Vampire Hunter.traitNarrativeEffects: You know the sunset time to the minute in every region without checking, you test doorways with the back of your hand out of habit, and you've never once been invited in, you keep count.

Plague Doctor.name: Plague Doctor
Plague Doctor.description:
The mask has watched a thousand triages without blinking. Plague Doctors hold both levers of battlefield medicine, Triage Protocol stabilizing allies in a held breath, Plague Touch making enemy formations regret standing together. Precise, calm, faintly herbal, and terrifying at the bedside. The patients who recover stop asking what's under the mask. The enemies never get the chance.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Plague Doctor.traitNarrativeEffects: You diagnose strangers on sight and tell them, you carry remedies for ailments nobody present has yet, and the head-tilt of your mask communicates more than most people's entire faces.

Curse Eater.name: Curse Eater
Curse Eater.description:
You swallow what's killing your friends. Curse Eaters are the hex lanes' only true predator, Devour Hex pulling maledictions off allies like drawing poison, Hex of Unraveling spitting them back at whoever sent them, unraveled and angry. Every curse eaten is carried. Every carrying costs. Hexers fear you the way arsonists fear rain. The appetite is real. So is the aftertaste.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Curse Eater.traitNarrativeEffects: You describe curses by flavor, 'jealousy, oversteeped', you get visibly hungry around cursed artifacts in a way that alarms everyone, and you've said 'I've eaten worse' about things that were actively on fire.

Riftblade.name: Riftblade
Riftblade.description:
The parry was correct. You were simply elsewhere, and armed, and behind them. Riftblades learned swordwork inside the Riftmaw, where space stopped being polite, Seamstep Cuts through gaps that exist for you alone, Rift Slashes from angles geometry disputes. Broken ground is your footing. Unstable rooms are your home field. The dungeon remembers its graduates. Both of you are proud.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Riftblade.traitNarrativeEffects: You step around corners that aren't there, unsettle people by knowing a room's dimensions are 'slightly wrong,' and you can't stop rating dungeon architecture like a returning alumnus.

Lunar Oracle.name: Lunar Oracle
Lunar Oracle.description:
Lunar Oracles read the moon's book mid-combat, Moonlit Omens delivering the enemy's next move a heartbeat early, so by the time the blow arrives, you were already finished dodging. Fallen Star Strikes land like verdicts. Your power waxes and wanes with the phase, and at night you are simply, insufferably correct. Ask about tomorrow at your own risk. You'll be right. You're always right at night.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Lunar Oracle.traitNarrativeEffects: You schedule everything by moon phase and are insufferable about being correct, you make pronouncements in a special Oracle Voice you deny having, and moonlight follows you indoors just slightly.

Relic Knight.name: Relic Knight
Relic Knight.description:
Your weapon has opinions, and today it agrees with you. Relic Knights bond with awakened artifacts, Awaken Relic rousing centuries of borrowed technique, the Blade of the Ancestors striking with every wielder it remembers. The weapon is a partner, an heirloom, and a critic. It is polished nightly. It notices when it isn't. Together, every duel you enter is outnumbered.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Relic Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: You introduce your weapon by name before yourself, consult it before major decisions, it answers, you insist, and you take criticism of it far more personally than criticism of you.

Rose Knight.name: Rose Knight
Rose Knight.description:
One rose, left on every defeated opponent. Chivalry or the most elegant taunt in Luxcellia, you've never clarified. Rose Knights duel in the high romantic style: Duels of Roses formally declared, a Thousand Cherry Blossoms delivered as the closing argument. Courts sponsor you. Rivals court you. Every fight is theater with consequences, and you have never once missed a curtain.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Rose Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: You leave a rose at the scene of every victory, you buy them in bulk, you cannot decline a formal challenge without physical discomfort, and you bow to worthy opponents mid-combat.

Starfall Archer.name: Starfall Archer
Starfall Archer.description:
You refuse to loose your finest arrow until the sky is watching. Starfall Archers fire like heavens fall, Starshots trailing comet-light that marks the target for everyone, Heavensfall arriving with the weight of something that was always going to land there. Your duels are visible from the next town over. This is a feature. Cloudy days genuinely offend you.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Starfall Archer.traitNarrativeEffects: You navigate exclusively by stars even indoors, name your best shots after constellations, and you refuse to loose your finest arrow until the sky is watching, cloudy days genuinely offend you.

Crystalsinger.name: Crystalsinger
Crystalsinger.description:
You sing to stone, and stone grows to listen. Crystalsingers work magic as music, the Resonant Aria humming barriers into existence facet by facet, a Song of Rebirth that reaches where medicine can't. Your battles leave glittering evidence that catches light for years. The Crystal-Born treat you as family. Caverns answer you by name. Your high C shatters what refuses to harmonize.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Crystalsinger.traitNarrativeEffects: You hum constantly and things around you faintly chime along, you tap crystals and announce their notes to no one, and you take a shattered gemstone as a personal review of your pitch.

Cinder Knight.name: Cinder Knight
Cinder Knight.description:
The fire that endures, not the blaze that spends itself. Cinder Knights carry banked embers into battle, armor seams glowing like a forge at rest, the Cinder Brand leaving coals in every wound that smolder long after the blade leaves. Heat is loyalty, kept faithfully, paid out precisely. You are the last one cold in winter and the first one armed in a crisis.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Intelligence
Cinder Knight.traitNarrativeEffects: You bank campfires with religious care and take improperly extinguished ones as personal insults, you radiate warmth people gravitate to on cold nights, and you smell faintly, permanently, of woodsmoke.

Golemancer.name: Golemancer
Golemancer.description:
Siegecraft that walks, and it likes you. Golemancers raise stone giants as partners, Earthen Golems that hold lines with mineral patience, Golem Commands that turn HOLD into architecture and ADVANCE into a landslide. Your constructs are signed, named, and thanked out loud, because the stone remembers being appreciated. It stands accordingly.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Golemancer.traitNarrativeEffects: You pat walls appreciatively and mutter about load-bearing quality, you name every golem before the mortar sets, and you've argued with masons about technique, and won, in three provinces.

Songblade.name: Songblade
Songblade.description:
Duels against you are lost, and then stuck in the loser's head for weeks. Songblades compose their swordsmanship, the Opening Refrain parrying on the beat, an Anthem of War that syncs the whole party to your tempo. Every fight is a piece, every opponent a movement, every victory a resolved chord witnesses feel in their teeth. Three exchanges in, they're fighting to YOUR rhythm. They never notice. That's the composition.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Songblade.traitNarrativeEffects: You fight audibly on-beat and enemies who notice can't stop noticing, you hum your opponent's tempo to steal it, and you end victories on a held note with your blade as the tuning fork.

Hero.name: Hero
Hero.description:
The class itself. Not a swordsman who acts heroically, THE Hero, played completely straight, with everything it costs. Hero's Challenge drags every enemy eye onto the one person built to carry it while your allies rally in your shadow; the Meteor Slash falls when destiny does. Kingdoms requisition you. Demon Lords keep files. Your real weapon was never the steel. It was the refusal.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Hero.traitNarrativeEffects: You give short inspiring speeches reflexively, including to shopkeepers; you physically cannot walk past someone in trouble, your party budgets time for it, and dramatic wind finds your hair indoors.

Demon Lord.name: Demon Lord
Demon Lord.description:
The room gets heavier when you enter, and everyone knows whose. The Demon Lord is overwhelming presence as a class, the Overlord's Decree buckling enemy resolve in a conversational tone, Demonic Gates opening on your authority alone. You don't borrow power from a patron. You ARE the patron. Conquest optional. Menace complimentary. Positions in your organization available, with benefits.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Demon Lord.traitNarrativeEffects: You cannot enter a room without it becoming YOUR room, you laugh in three escalating stages and deny rehearsing them, and you keep offering defeated enemies positions in your organization, with benefits.

Dungeon Lord.name: Dungeon Lord
Dungeon Lord.description:
Why delve dungeons when you can BE one? Dungeon Lords claim battlefields as personal architecture, Claim Domain marking the room as yours, Trap Setting renovating it mid-combat, minions on retainer. Every fight relocates, corridor by corridor, into ground you already finished designing. The dungeon didn't get harder. It got motivated. Your Dungeon Breaker rivalry remains the most professionally cordial blood feud in Luxcellia.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Dungeon Lord.traitNarrativeEffects: You assess every room's trap potential out loud, you refer to any space you've occupied for ten minutes as 'my domain,' and you take dungeon fatalities personally, as critiques of the layout.

Chain Warden's Bound Harness.name: Chain Warden's Bound Harness
Chain Warden's Bound Harness.description: A dark fitted combat harness wrapped in coiled chains across the chest and forearms, with a heavy belt of hanging hooks and links. It should feel dangerous, industrial, and elegantly restrained, chains as both armor and fashion statement.
Chain Warden's Bound Harness.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Adventurer's Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Gambler's Lucky Vest.name: Gambler's Lucky Vest
Gambler's Lucky Vest.description: A sharp waistcoat over a rolled-sleeve shirt, playing cards tucked into the band, dice charms on a chain, and a coin always between the fingers. It should feel roguish, confident, and dressed for a game the house is about to lose.
Gambler's Lucky Vest.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Tailored Formalwear; in play, describe what is worn now.

Ronin's Road-Worn Kimono.name: Ronin's Road-Worn Kimono
Ronin's Road-Worn Kimono.description: A faded, travel-stained kimono worn loose off one shoulder, a katana through a simple sash, straw sandals and road dust. It should feel weathered, dangerous, and effortlessly cool, nobility long since traded for freedom.
Ronin's Road-Worn Kimono.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Kimono and Sash; in play, describe what is worn now.

Onmyoji's Ceremonial Court Robes.name: Onmyoji's Ceremonial Court Robes
Onmyoji's Ceremonial Court Robes.description: Layered white-and-violet court robes with wide sleeves, paper talismans hanging from the sash, and a tall ceremonial cap. It should feel scholarly, mystical, and quietly authoritative, the occult given official dress code.
Onmyoji's Ceremonial Court Robes.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Shrine Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Cryomancer's Frostweave Mantle.name: Cryomancer's Frostweave Mantle
Cryomancer's Frostweave Mantle.description: A pale blue mantle laced with frost-crystal patterns that never melt, fur-lined collar dusted with permanent snow, breath visible in any weather. It should feel elegant, cold, and serenely untouchable, winter tailored to fit.
Cryomancer's Frostweave Mantle.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Sohei's Temple War Vestments.name: Sohei's Temple War Vestments
Sohei's Temple War Vestments.description: Monastic robes in white and saffron worn under lacquered chest armor, a prayer-bead strap across the torso, head wrapped in a warrior's cowl. It should feel disciplined, devout, and immovably solid, the monastery dressed for a siege.
Sohei's Temple War Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Breastplate and Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Yokai Hunter's Talisman Coat.name: Yokai Hunter's Talisman Coat
Yokai Hunter's Talisman Coat.description: A long dark hunting coat lined with paper wards and stitched charms, salt pouches on the belt, and a wide-brimmed hat shadowing watchful eyes. It should feel practical, occult, and quietly menacing, folklore turned field gear.
Yokai Hunter's Talisman Coat.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Traveling Cloak and Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Tessen Duelist's Court Silks.name: Tessen Duelist's Court Silks
Tessen Duelist's Court Silks.description: Refined courtly silks with fitted sleeves for fan-work, an iron tessen at the sash, and jewelry chosen to distract from footwork. It should feel graceful, aristocratic, and subtly lethal, a dress code that conceals a duel.
Tessen Duelist's Court Silks.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Storm Fist's Charged Wraps.name: Storm Fist's Charged Wraps
Storm Fist's Charged Wraps.description: Sleeveless martial garb with lightning-scorched hand and forearm wraps, hair perpetually wind-tossed, faint static sparking at the knuckles. It should feel kinetic, athletic, and barely contained, a storm doing warm-up stretches.
Storm Fist's Charged Wraps.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Training Gi; in play, describe what is worn now.

Jester's Motley Regalia.name: Jester's Motley Regalia
Jester's Motley Regalia.description: Vivid asymmetric motley in clashing colors, a belled cap at a defiant angle, face paint framing an unreadable grin, juggling knives at the belt. It should feel chaotic, theatrical, and unsettlingly deliberate, comedy with an edge.
Jester's Motley Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Dreamweaver's Slumber Veils.name: Dreamweaver's Slumber Veils
Dreamweaver's Slumber Veils.description: Flowing layered veils in twilight purples that drift as if underwater, tiny silver moths embroidered throughout, eyes half-lidded and knowing. It should feel dreamlike, soft, and faintly uncanny, bedtime as high fashion.
Dreamweaver's Slumber Veils.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Corsair's Boarding Jacket.name: Corsair's Boarding Jacket
Corsair's Boarding Jacket.description: An open sea-captain's jacket over a loose shirt, tricorn or bandana, cutlass at the hip, boots made for rigging and railings. It should feel swashbuckling, salt-worn, and irrepressibly confident, the deck follows this person around.
Corsair's Boarding Jacket.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Seafarer's Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

Bounty Hunter's Pursuit Gear.name: Bounty Hunter's Pursuit Gear
Bounty Hunter's Pursuit Gear.description: A rugged long duster over reinforced leathers, wanted posters folded in a chest pocket, shackles and rope coiled at the belt, eyes that appraise. It should feel road-hardened, professional, and quietly relentless, the contract, dressed.
Bounty Hunter's Pursuit Gear.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Long Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

Parasol Duelist's Promenade Dress.name: Parasol Duelist's Promenade Dress
Parasol Duelist's Promenade Dress.description: An immaculate walking dress or suit with gloves and polished boots, a bladed parasol resting on one shoulder like a rifle at parade. It should feel elegant, composed, and faintly ominous, a stroll that everyone clears a path for.
Parasol Duelist's Promenade Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Gunblade Duelist's Academy Leathers.name: Gunblade Duelist's Academy Leathers
Gunblade Duelist's Academy Leathers.description: A fitted duelist's jacket with a gunbelt of shells across the chest, sword-grip gloves, and powder burns worn like medals. It should feel sharp, modern, and defiantly stylish, the newest school on the dueling circuit, dressed loud.
Gunblade Duelist's Academy Leathers.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Reinforced Long Coat; in play, describe what is worn now.

Tidecaller's Depth Armor.name: Tidecaller's Depth Armor
Tidecaller's Depth Armor.description: Scaled blue-green armor that gleams wet in any light, coral and pearl accents, a spear hafted in driftwood, hair perpetually damp. It should feel oceanic, imposing, and quietly inevitable, the tide given a uniform.
Tidecaller's Depth Armor.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Scale Battle Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Mirage Blade's Desert Shroud.name: Mirage Blade's Desert Shroud
Mirage Blade's Desert Shroud.description: Sun-bleached desert wraps and a flowing half-cloak that shimmers at the edges like heat haze, twin blades at the hips, features half-veiled. It should feel elusive, sun-scorched, and impossible to focus on, an outfit the eye slides off.
Mirage Blade's Desert Shroud.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Traveling Cloak and Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Aurora Sentinel's Prism Plate.name: Aurora Sentinel's Prism Plate
Aurora Sentinel's Prism Plate.description: Polished white armor with prismatic edges that catch light in bands of dawn color, a tower shield etched with sunrise motifs. It should feel radiant, protective, and dramatically backlit at all times, the dawn on guard duty.
Aurora Sentinel's Prism Plate.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Knightly Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Plague Doctor's Beaked Vestments.name: Plague Doctor's Beaked Vestments
Plague Doctor's Beaked Vestments.description: A long dark oilcloth coat buttoned to the throat, gloves to the elbow, and the iconic beaked mask with round glass eyes, herbs at the belt. It should feel clinical, ominous, and strangely reassuring, medicine that has seen everything.
Plague Doctor's Beaked Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Traveling Cloak and Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Curse Eater's Sin-Stitched Garb.name: Curse Eater's Sin-Stitched Garb
Curse Eater's Sin-Stitched Garb.description: Heavy layered robes covered in stitched-shut sigils and swallowed-curse marks that faintly writhe, chained clasps, tired knowing eyes. It should feel burdened, resilient, and quietly heroic, every stitch a doom someone else didn't carry.
Curse Eater's Sin-Stitched Garb.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Occult Vestments; in play, describe what is worn now.

Riftblade's Seamstep Gear.name: Riftblade's Seamstep Gear
Riftblade's Seamstep Gear.description: A close-fitting duelist's outfit with edges that fray into faint violet static, asymmetric armor plates, a dagger that blurs at rest. It should feel unstable, sharp, and dimensionally suspicious, clothing that clips through geometry politely.
Riftblade's Seamstep Gear.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Adventurer's Leathers; in play, describe what is worn now.

Lunar Oracle's Moonlit Vestments.name: Lunar Oracle's Moonlit Vestments
Lunar Oracle's Moonlit Vestments.description: Silver-white robes with a crescent-phase diadem, constellation embroidery that shifts with the hour, moonlight pooling unnaturally in the fabric. It should feel serene, prophetic, and gently luminous, the night sky in formal wear.
Lunar Oracle's Moonlit Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Relic Knight's Heirloom Panoply.name: Relic Knight's Heirloom Panoply
Relic Knight's Heirloom Panoply.description: Mismatched but magnificent armor assembled from awakened relics of different eras, each piece faintly glowing with its own opinion, an ancient blade at rest. It should feel storied, noble, and slightly haunted, a museum that fights back.
Relic Knight's Heirloom Panoply.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Knightly Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Rose Knight's Dueling Regalia.name: Rose Knight's Dueling Regalia
Rose Knight's Dueling Regalia.description: An immaculate white-and-crimson dueling uniform with rose embroidery, a caped shoulder, spotless gloves, and a single fresh rose at the lapel. It should feel romantic, chivalrous, and theatrically flawless, every duel a gala.
Rose Knight's Dueling Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Tailored Formalwear; in play, describe what is worn now.

Starfall Archer's Comet Cloak.name: Starfall Archer's Comet Cloak
Starfall Archer's Comet Cloak.description: A midnight-blue cloak trailing faint stardust, silver constellation clasps, a bow of pale wood strung with light, arrows fletched in falling-star white. It should feel celestial, poised, and quietly spectacular, archery the sky approves of.
Starfall Archer's Comet Cloak.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Traveling Cloak and Clothes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Crystalsinger's Resonant Gown.name: Crystalsinger's Resonant Gown
Crystalsinger's Resonant Gown.description: A flowing gown grown with living crystal at the shoulders and hem, facets that chime softly with movement, light refracting with every step. It should feel melodic, luminous, and gently otherworldly, a song you can see.
Crystalsinger's Resonant Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Cinder Knight's Emberbanked Plate.name: Cinder Knight's Emberbanked Plate
Cinder Knight's Emberbanked Plate.description: Dark iron armor with seams that glow like banked coals, heat-shimmer rising from the pauldrons, a faint scent of woodsmoke. It should feel warm, enduring, and quietly dangerous, a hearth that decided to stand up and fight.
Cinder Knight's Emberbanked Plate.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Blackened Plate Armor; in play, describe what is worn now.

Golemancer's Mason Vestments.name: Golemancer's Mason Vestments
Golemancer's Mason Vestments.description: Sturdy earth-toned work robes over a stonemason's apron, rune-carved bracers, clay dust on the hands, a small golem core at the belt. It should feel grounded, craftsmanlike, and dependable, architecture's favorite person.
Golemancer's Mason Vestments.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Mage's Robes; in play, describe what is worn now.

Songblade's Concert Uniform.name: Songblade's Concert Uniform
Songblade's Concert Uniform.description: A performer's fitted longcoat with sheet-music embroidery along the sleeves, a sword worn like an instrument case, one glove fingerless for the strings. It should feel musical, dashing, and rhythmically precise, a duel dressed as a recital.
Songblade's Concert Uniform.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Reborn Vigor.name: Reborn Vigor
Reborn Vigor.description: The second life settles deeper into the bones. You tire a breath later than you used to, and the cold bothers you a little less each season.

Ember of Resolve.name: Ember of Resolve
Ember of Resolve.description: There is a heat in you that answers when things get hard. It was always there, banked and waiting. This life finally learned how to reach it.

Nimble Rebirth.name: Nimble Rebirth
Nimble Rebirth.description: You move like you already know how the fall ends. Reborn reflexes, or perhaps borrowed ones, but they answer to you now.

Sharpened Recall.name: Sharpened Recall
Sharpened Recall.description: Fragments of a life you did not live surface at useful moments. You call it instinct. It is closer to memory, and it is rarely wrong.

Spirit-Attuned.name: Spirit-Attuned
Spirit-Attuned.description: The unseen half of Luxcellia has started nodding at you as you pass. You nod back. It seems only polite, given the circumstances.

Temptation's Poise.name: Temptation's Poise
Temptation's Poise.description: You have learned what it looks like to be offered everything and consider it. That composure reads as power, and rooms adjust to it.

Warrior's Ascension.name: Warrior's Ascension
Warrior's Ascension.description: Every fight left something behind in your hands. You are simply better at this than you were, and it shows before you ever draw.

Scholar's Ascension.name: Scholar's Ascension
Scholar's Ascension.description: The reborn mind keeps sorting the world into patterns. Insight and intuition arrive together now, each one sharpening the other.

Blessing Echo.name: Blessing Echo
Blessing Echo.description: Something divine brushed you once and left a resonance. Your mana pool rings a little wider, as if borrowing space from wherever it came from.

Wanderer's Endurance.name: Wanderer's Endurance
Wanderer's Endurance.description: Every road you have walked is still in your legs. The body that came back keeps quietly proving it can go one more mile.

Deepening Well.name: Deepening Well
Deepening Well.description: The magic settles further in each time you use it. What used to be a shallow puddle is slowly, surely becoming a spring.

Iron Constitution.name: Iron Constitution
Iron Constitution.description: You have been hurt enough times that your body treats it as tuition. It has learned the lessons. It keeps right on learning.

Rising Legend.name: Rising Legend
Rising Legend.description: Word travels. The tavern version of you is slightly more impressive than the real one, and the gap is closing in your favor.

Battle-Read.name: Battle-Read
Battle-Read.description: You have watched enough violence to see it coming. The read arrives before the blow does, more often than not these days.

Silver Tongue Ascendant.name: Silver Tongue Ascendant
Silver Tongue Ascendant.description: Every negotiation you survived left you sharper. You have started winning arguments you have not even finished having yet.

Wilds-Wise.name: Wilds-Wise
Wilds-Wise.description: The road taught you things no academy covers. You read weather, tracks, and danger like a second language you never studied.

Warded Heart.name: Warded Heart
Warded Heart.description: Too many demon contracts have been dangled in front of you. You have built calluses exactly where the temptation tends to land.

Second Wind.name: Second Wind
Second Wind.description: The reborn body has one more gear than it admits to. When you are certain you are finished, you discover that you are not.

Dungeon-Forged.name: Dungeon-Forged
Dungeon-Forged.description: The deep floors rewired something in you. Danger feels like home now, and home has started to feel a little boring.

Cheat-Touched.name: Cheat-Touched
Cheat-Touched.description: The system, or whatever it is, has started rounding in your favor. Nobody else notices. You have stopped questioning it. Mostly.

Demon-Bargained Strength.name: Demon-Bargained Strength
Demon-Bargained Strength.description: You signed something, once, in a moment you do not fully remember. The strength is entirely real. So, unfortunately, is the signature.

Blessing Overdraw.name: Blessing Overdraw
Blessing Overdraw.description: You reached deeper into the divine than you were ever offered. It answered you. It will, in time, want to discuss the overage.

◈ Minor Boon: Toughened Hide.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Toughened Hide
◈ Minor Boon: Toughened Hide.description: Your skin has stopped bruising like it used to. The reborn body is quietly reinforcing itself, one small hardship at a time.

◈ Minor Boon: Quick Hands.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Quick Hands
◈ Minor Boon: Quick Hands.description: Your fingers have learned to move a fraction ahead of thought. Small things, caught before they fall.

◈ Minor Boon: Steady Arm.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Steady Arm
◈ Minor Boon: Steady Arm.description: There is a little more push behind everything you lift, carry, and swing than there was last season.

◈ Minor Boon: Clear Thought.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Clear Thought
◈ Minor Boon: Clear Thought.description: The fog lifts a shade earlier each morning. Your reasoning has picked up a half-step of speed.

◈ Minor Boon: Open Senses.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Open Senses
◈ Minor Boon: Open Senses.description: You notice the room before you enter it now. Nothing dramatic, just a little more of the world reaching you.

◈ Minor Boon: Easy Smile.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Easy Smile
◈ Minor Boon: Easy Smile.description: People warm to you a beat faster than they used to. You have stopped noticing you are doing it.

◈ Minor Boon: Small Reserve.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Small Reserve
◈ Minor Boon: Small Reserve.description: There is a little more left in the tank at the end of hard days. Not much. Enough. A gift of the reborn life, small but real.

◈ Minor Boon: Trickle of Mana.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Trickle of Mana
◈ Minor Boon: Trickle of Mana.description: The magic refills a shade faster than it drains, on good days. The well is learning your shape.

◈ Minor Boon: Sure Feet.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Sure Feet
◈ Minor Boon: Sure Feet.description: You have stopped slipping on the paths that used to catch you. The ground and you have reached an understanding.

◈ Minor Boon: Watchful Eye.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Watchful Eye
◈ Minor Boon: Watchful Eye.description: Details that once slid past you now snag your attention. You are becoming hard to sneak up on.

◈ Minor Boon: Kind Word.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Kind Word
◈ Minor Boon: Kind Word.description: You have found the knack of saying the thing that helps. People remember it, and remember you.

◈ Minor Boon: Road Legs.name: ◈ Minor Boon: Road Legs
◈ Minor Boon: Road Legs.description: Long walks cost you less than they did. The distance has stopped being an argument. A gift of the reborn life, small but real.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Bulwark Body.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Bulwark Body
◈◈ Notable Boon: Bulwark Body.description: You have started taking hits that would have folded you a year ago, and walking them off. The frame holds.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Duelist's Edge.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Duelist's Edge
◈◈ Notable Boon: Duelist's Edge.description: Your hands know the work now. The blade, the trigger, the parry, all a little sharper than trained.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Powerhouse.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Powerhouse
◈◈ Notable Boon: Powerhouse.description: There is real force in you now, the kind that ends arguments before they start. People feel it across a room.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Keen Mind.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Keen Mind
◈◈ Notable Boon: Keen Mind.description: Problems unfold for you faster than they used to. You see two moves ahead where you once saw one.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Deep Insight.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Deep Insight
◈◈ Notable Boon: Deep Insight.description: You read intentions like weather now. What people mean arrives a moment before what they say.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Magnetic Presence.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Magnetic Presence
◈◈ Notable Boon: Magnetic Presence.description: Rooms tilt toward you when you speak. You have grown into a gravity that people orbit without deciding to.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Battle Conditioning.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Battle Conditioning
◈◈ Notable Boon: Battle Conditioning.description: Fights last longer than your enemies expect, because you do. The reborn body has learned to pace itself for war.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Widening Well.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Widening Well
◈◈ Notable Boon: Widening Well.description: The magic runs deeper in you now, a reservoir where there was once a stream. Bigger workings come within reach.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Weaponmaster's Start.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Weaponmaster's Start
◈◈ Notable Boon: Weaponmaster's Start.description: Every weapon feels a little more like an old friend now. The fundamentals have set deep. A gift of the reborn life, small but real.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Arcane Fundamentals.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Arcane Fundamentals
◈◈ Notable Boon: Arcane Fundamentals.description: The base grammar of magic has clicked into place. Whatever school you favor, the roots run deeper.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Courtier's Craft.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Courtier's Craft
◈◈ Notable Boon: Courtier's Craft.description: You have learned which fork, which bow, and which silence. Doors that check for breeding open for you now.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Shadow Training.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Shadow Training
◈◈ Notable Boon: Shadow Training.description: You have learned to be where eyes are not. Rooms hold fewer secrets from you, and you hold more from them.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Field Medic.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Field Medic
◈◈ Notable Boon: Field Medic.description: You have patched enough wounds under pressure that your hands no longer shake. Allies live a little longer near you.

◈◈ Notable Boon: Intimidating Aura.name: ◈◈ Notable Boon: Intimidating Aura
◈◈ Notable Boon: Intimidating Aura.description: You have grown into something people step back from. The threat lands before you say a word.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Titan's Frame.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Titan's Frame
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Titan's Frame.description: Your body has crossed a threshold. Blows that felled you once now barely register, and the ground respects your weight.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Sovereign Strength.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Sovereign Strength
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Sovereign Strength.description: The strength in you has stopped being notable and started being dangerous. Doors, chains, and doubters all give way.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Blur.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Blur
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Blur.description: You move between one instant and the next in a way people find hard to follow. The reborn body has learned real speed.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Genius Awakened.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Genius Awakened
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Genius Awakened.description: Your mind runs several conversations ahead of everyone else's now. Plans assemble themselves while others are still listening.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Oracle's Clarity.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Oracle's Clarity
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Oracle's Clarity.description: You see the shape of things before they finish becoming. Intuition has sharpened into something close to foresight.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Irresistible.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Irresistible
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Irresistible.description: You have become the kind of presence legends form around. People believe you, follow you, and fall for you, sometimes all at once.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Undying Constitution.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Undying Constitution
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Undying Constitution.description: You have been to the edge enough times to memorize the way back. The reborn body simply refuses to stay down.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Ocean of Mana.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Ocean of Mana
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Ocean of Mana.description: The magic in you has become a sea. Workings that would drain lesser casters barely lower your tide.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Killer Instinct.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Killer Instinct
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Killer Instinct.description: You have learned to find the gap, the tendon, the fatal half-second. Your strikes land where they end things.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Bloodthirst.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Bloodthirst
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Bloodthirst.description: There is a hunger in your fighting now. Each blow you land feeds something, and it feeds you back.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Ironskin.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Ironskin
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Ironskin.description: Your body has learned to turn edges. Blades that should bite instead skid, and impacts spread across a frame that has learned to endure.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Riposte Reflex.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Riposte Reflex
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Riposte Reflex.description: You have stopped merely blocking. Now the block IS the counter, and enemies flinch from committing to you.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Second Heart.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Second Heart
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Second Heart.description: Something beats in you that did not before. When the killing blow comes, once, it finds a body that will not accept it.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Flamebound.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Flamebound
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Flamebound.description: Fire leans toward you now, warms to your hand, answers a little louder when you call. The affinity has taken root.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Frostbound.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Frostbound
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Frostbound.description: Cold gathers where you will it. The frost knows your name and comes when called, patient and total.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Stormbound.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Stormbound
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Stormbound.description: The air charges around you before a working. Thunder and wind have started treating you as one of their own.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Shadowbound.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Shadowbound
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Shadowbound.description: The dark pools toward you, hides what you wish hidden, carries what you send. You and the shadow have an understanding.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Lightbound.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Lightbound
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Lightbound.description: A radiance answers you now, gentle or searing as you choose. The light has decided you are worth shining through.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Divine Conduit.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Divine Conduit
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Divine Conduit.description: Something above has started returning your calls. Your prayers land with weight, and the answers arrive clearer.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Heartbreaker.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Heartbreaker
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Heartbreaker.description: You have grown into someone people fall for, hard and often. It is a power, and like all power here it complicates things.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Renowned.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Renowned
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Renowned.description: Your name arrives before you do now, in songs, rumors, and wanted posters. The world has an opinion of you, and it is loud.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Silver Crown.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Silver Crown
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Silver Crown.description: Nobles have started treating you as one of their own, or as a threat worth courting. Either way, the high table has a seat.

◈◈◈ Major Boon: Beloved of the People.name: ◈◈◈ Major Boon: Beloved of the People
◈◈◈ Major Boon: Beloved of the People.description: The common folk have chosen you. Taverns quiet when you enter and roar when you speak. A reputation no coin can buy.

★ Legendary Boon: Body of the Reborn God.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Body of the Reborn God
★ Legendary Boon: Body of the Reborn God.description: Your flesh has finished remembering what it could be. You are, quietly, no longer entirely mortal, and everyone can feel it.

★ Legendary Boon: Mind of a Thousand Liv.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Mind of a Thousand Lives
★ Legendary Boon: Mind of a Thousand Liv.description: The reborn mind has stopped pretending it is only this one life. Knowledge you never earned surfaces on command now.

★ Legendary Boon: Sovereign of Hearts.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Sovereign of Hearts
★ Legendary Boon: Sovereign of Hearts.description: You have become someone history will fall in love with. Rooms, armies, and rivals bend toward you, and it costs them nothing to want to.

★ Legendary Boon: Archmage's Wellspring.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Archmage's Wellspring
★ Legendary Boon: Archmage's Wellspring.description: The magic in you has become a landscape others could drown in. There is almost nothing you cannot afford to attempt.

★ Legendary Boon: The Unkillable.name: ★ Legendary Boon: The Unkillable
★ Legendary Boon: The Unkillable.description: You have died before. You remember disliking it. The reborn body has decided, with finality, that it will not happen easily again.

★ Legendary Boon: Demon Lord's Endowment.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Demon Lord's Endowment
★ Legendary Boon: Demon Lord's Endowment.description: You accepted the fuller offer. The power is vast and immediate and entirely real. So is the throne now expecting you to sit in it.

★ Legendary Boon: Stolen Divinity.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Stolen Divinity
★ Legendary Boon: Stolen Divinity.description: You reached into the divine and took what was not offered. It works flawlessly. The theft did not go unnoticed, and Heaven keeps books.

★ Legendary Boon: The Cheat That Woke Up.name: ★ Legendary Boon: The Cheat That Woke Up
★ Legendary Boon: The Cheat That Woke Up.description: The system rounding in your favor has become the system openly working for you. It is glorious. It has also started asking, faintly, what you intend to do with it.

★ Legendary Boon: Bargain With the Deep.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Bargain With the Deep Floor
★ Legendary Boon: Bargain With the Deep.description: Something at the bottom of the Riftmaw offered you a promotion. You took it. You are stronger. You are also, now, expected downstairs eventually.

★ Legendary Boon: Beloved of a Dead God.name: ★ Legendary Boon: Beloved of a Dead God
★ Legendary Boon: Beloved of a Dead God.description: A god nobody worships anymore chose you as its last champion. The power is real and lonely. Its enemies are old, and they remember.

Actor.name: Actor
Actor.description:
A trained performer of the dramatic arts, stage plays, court performances, and the occasional con that is technically also a performance. Actors read rooms, hold audiences, and disappear into roles so completely that Deception checks start feeling like method work.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Actor.traitNarrativeEffects: You have never once said a sentence without knowing which act of the play it belongs to, and you quote roles you've played as though they were people you've met.

Troupe Performer.name: Troupe Performer
Troupe Performer.description:
A member of a traveling performance troupe, part acrobat, part storyteller, part rigger of stage effects. Troupe Performers know how shows are built from the inside: timing, spectacle, crowd work, and how to strike a set and leave town in one night.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Secondary Attribute: Dexterity
Troupe Performer.traitNarrativeEffects: You instinctively check every room for sightlines, exits, and where the audience would sit, and you cannot watch someone else's show without silently critiquing the blocking.

Opera Singer.name: Opera Singer
Opera Singer.description:
A classically trained vocalist of the grand stages, opera houses, royal courts, festival amphitheaters. Opera Singers carry presence the way knights carry swords: projection that fills a hall, breath control that outlasts arguments, and a reputation that arrives before they do.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Opera Singer.traitNarrativeEffects: Your speaking voice makes strangers turn around in the street, and you have strong, immediate, unconcealable opinions about anyone else's breath support.

Playwright.name: Playwright
Playwright.description:
A writer of dramas, comedies, and the plays everyone in the capital pretends they haven't cried at. Playwrights understand story structure the way generals understand terrain, which makes them alarmingly good at predicting how real events will unfold.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Playwright.traitNarrativeEffects: You narrate life events in your head as stage directions, and you can tell within five minutes of meeting someone which archetype they'd be cast as, and you're usually right.

Phantom's Half-Mask Formalwear.name: Phantom's Half-Mask Formalwear
Phantom's Half-Mask Formalwear.description: Immaculate dark evening formalwear beneath a sweeping floor-length cape, one side of the face concealed by a polished porcelain half-mask. It should feel elegant, haunted, and magnetic, the figure at the opera everyone watches and no one approaches.
Phantom's Half-Mask Formalwear.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Tailored Formalwear; in play, describe what is worn now.

Grand Stage Lead's Caped Costume.name: Grand Stage Lead's Caped Costume
Grand Stage Lead's Caped Costume.description: A resplendent theatrical costume built for the leading role: a dramatic high-collared cape lined in rich color, gleaming buttons, and tailoring designed to be seen from the last row. It should feel heroic, deliberate, and one bow away from applause.
Grand Stage Lead's Caped Costume.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Masquerade Domino and Opera Cape.name: Masquerade Domino and Opera Cape
Masquerade Domino and Opera Cape.description: A silk domino half-mask with an elegant opera cape over refined formal dress, made for masquerade balls and identities that are officially a secret. It should feel mysterious, flirtatious, and expensive, anonymity as a fashion statement.
Masquerade Domino and Opera Cape.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Tailored Formalwear; in play, describe what is worn now.

Stage Magician's Top Hat and Tails.name: Stage Magician's Top Hat and Tails
Stage Magician's Top Hat and Tails.description: A crisp tailcoat, white gloves, and a tall top hat with a suspicious amount of interior room, finished with a short scarlet-lined cape. It should feel showy, precise, and delightfully suspect, every gesture looks like the start of a trick.
Stage Magician's Top Hat and Tails.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Opera Diva's Curtain-Call Gown.name: Opera Diva's Curtain-Call Gown
Opera Diva's Curtain-Call Gown.description: A magnificent performance gown of cascading fabric and dramatic jewelry, built for the moment the curtain rises, and engineered to survive three encores. It should feel commanding, glamorous, and impossible to upstage.
Opera Diva's Curtain-Call Gown.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Ringmaster's Grand Regalia.name: Ringmaster's Grand Regalia
Ringmaster's Grand Regalia.description: A bold ringmaster's ensemble: long tailored coat in striking color, gleaming boots, an ornate cane or baton, and a hat that constitutes a declaration. It should feel commanding and festive, the person the entire spectacle organizes itself around.
Ringmaster's Grand Regalia.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Tragedian's Mourning Drama Attire.name: Tragedian's Mourning Drama Attire
Tragedian's Mourning Drama Attire.description: Elegant dark theatrical dress with dramatic draped sleeves, a gauzy half-veil, and silver accents, grief as a costume, sorrow as a performance. It should feel beautiful, melancholic, and staged within an inch of its life.
Tragedian's Mourning Drama Attire.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Stage Costume; in play, describe what is worn now.

Compact and Curvy.name: Compact and Curvy
Compact and Curvy.description: Short and full-figured, a low frame with a clearly defined waist, wide hips, and soft rounded lines throughout. Small in height, substantial in silhouette.
Compact and Curvy.traitNarrativeEffects: Armor that fits your height never fits your proportions. Tailors charge extra and sigh a lot.

Porcelain Figure.name: Porcelain Figure
Porcelain Figure.description: Short and finely made, a slim frame with narrow shoulders, neat proportions, and clean ornamental lines. Small in scale, exact in construction.
Porcelain Figure.traitNarrativeEffects: People instinctively want to protect you, which is either endearing or deeply annoying depending on whether you just killed something.

Sunlit Grace.name: Sunlit Grace
Sunlit Grace.description: Slender and naturally striking, a light frame with smooth skin, gently rounded proportions, and an unstyled ease that needs no enhancement.
Sunlit Grace.traitNarrativeEffects: Older adventurers feel an irrational urge to make sure you're eating enough and sleeping properly. You are thirty-one and you run a mercenary company.

Warm and Soft.name: Warm and Soft
Warm and Soft.description: Gently rounded and approachable, soft proportions, easy lines, and an unguarded presence. Nothing sharp or angular anywhere.
Warm and Soft.traitNarrativeEffects: Strangers tell you their life stories unprompted. Animals gravitate to you. You have never once looked intimidating on purpose.

Sweet Ribbon Dress.name: Sweet Ribbon Dress
Sweet Ribbon Dress.description: A frilly ribbon-heavy dress with soft lace detail and an ornamental fantasy-idol silhouette. Intended for adult characters in a sweet, decorative style.
Sweet Ribbon Dress.traitNarrativeEffects: OUTFIT STYLE LOCK: look as described. Its garment is the starting item Fine Dress; in play, describe what is worn now.

Slime-Born.name: Slime-Born
Slime-Born.description:
At some point, a slime didn't just touch your bloodline, it moved in. Maybe an ancestor merged with a sentient slime queen. Maybe you fell into a dungeon slime pit and came out. different. Maybe you were born in a mana-saturated zone where biology took suggestions rather than orders. Your body is humanoid but not entirely solid: your joints bend in directions that make healers uncomfortable, minor wounds seal themselves with a faint gel-like sheen, and you can squeeze through spaces that should be structurally impossible. You're adaptable, surprisingly durable, and the subject of more academic papers than you'd prefer.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: A human figure whose skin carries glossy translucent depth, with gel-bright highlights at the joints and a liquid sheen through the hair. Human face, human proportions, human silhouette.

RACE REFERENCE: Slime-Born is a person with translucent skin accents, soft gel-like markings, and a liquid hair sheen. Use adaptability, strange biology, and alchemical curiosity as background hooks.
Slime-Born.traitNarrativeEffects: Parts of you are slightly translucent in certain light, you absorb small objects by accident when you're not paying attention, and you have a compulsive need to taste things that aren't food. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: A human figure whose skin carries glossy translucent depth, gel-bright joints, and a liquid sheen through the hair. Human face, human proportions, human silhouette.

Wraithkin.name: Wraithkin
Wraithkin.description:
Part of you is immaterial. You were born with a connection to the spirit realm that goes deeper than magic, it's in your blood, your bones, the faintly translucent quality at the edges of your skin when the light hits right. You see spirits, hear echoes of the dead, sense wards and curses like pressure changes in the air. Living people sometimes feel a chill when you walk past. Objects you hold occasionally phase through your fingers when you lose focus. You exist in two worlds at once, and neither one fully claims you.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: A solid human figure with ethereal accents. Faint translucence at the edges of the skin, cool spirit markings, and an unusual quality to the light around them. Human face, human proportions, fully present and opaque at the core.

RACE REFERENCE: Wraithkin is a person with ethereal accents such as faint edge translucence, spirit markings, a cool aura, or unusual reflections. Use ghost-sight, spirit pressure, and two-world perception as background hooks.
Wraithkin.traitNarrativeEffects: You casually greet ghosts that nobody else can see, which makes walking through old buildings a very one-sided social experience for your companions. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: A solid human figure with ethereal accents, faint edge translucence, cool spirit markings, unusual light. Human face, human proportions, opaque at the core.

Demon-Blooded.name: Demon-Blooded
Demon-Blooded.description:
A trace of demon blood runs through your veins, maybe from an ancestor, maybe from a pact, maybe from something nobody talks about at family dinners. You have subtly inhuman features: unusual eye color, faint horn nubs, sharpened canines, or skin that runs a few degrees too warm. Demon-blooded individuals have natural dark magic affinity and an unsettling charisma that makes people simultaneously attracted and nervous. The church watches you. The Twilight Dominion considers you family.

IMAGE GENERATION RULE: A human figure with elegant tapering horns, unusual eye color, sharp canines, and dark skin markings. Human face, human proportions, human legs and feet.

RACE REFERENCE: Demon-Blooded is a human-bodied person with elegant horns, unusual eyes, sharp canines and dark skin markings; a tail or small wings only if selected. Use pact culture, temptation, social suspicion, and disciplined self-control as background hooks.
Demon-Blooded.traitNarrativeEffects: Shadows seem to lean toward you when you stand still, and cold rooms feel comfortably warm to you. IMAGE GENERATION RULE: A human figure with elegant tapering horns, unusual eye color, sharp canines, and dark markings. Human face, human proportions, human legs.

Pyromancer.name: Pyromancer
Pyromancer.description:
To a Pyromancer, fire is an argument, and they always speak last. Flame Lances punch through a guard before the target finishes raising it; Fire Eruptions turn a held position into a reason to run. The whole style is momentum: pressure that builds until something breaks, and it is rarely the Pyromancer. Loud, bright, and impossible to ignore, they fight the way a wildfire spreads, on their own terms and in every direction at once.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Pyromancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Candles lean toward you when you enter a room, your fingertips are always a little too warm to hold for long, and cold food served to you is somehow steaming by the second bite.

Hydromancer.name: Hydromancer
Hydromancer.description:
Water yields to everything and is stopped by nothing, and a Hydromancer fights the same way. Tidal Surges sweep a battlefield off its feet while Healing Rain quietly mends the people who matter; the class flows between offense and mercy without ever changing shape. Patient where a Pyromancer is loud, a Hydromancer wins by being everywhere the enemy is not, until the current they never noticed rising is already over their head.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Hydromancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Still water ripples faintly when you pass, your voice carries a hush like rain on a far roof, and you never quite need to wring out your sleeves no matter the weather.

Aeromancer.name: Aeromancer
Aeromancer.description:
An Aeromancer is the fight the enemy cannot pin down. Wind Barriers turn arrows and spells aside like leaves; Vacuum Blades cut from angles that shouldn't exist, carried on air that answers before the thought finishes. The style is freedom made lethal, never where the blow lands, always where the opening opens. Fighting an Aeromancer feels like swinging at weather, and losing to one feels like the sky simply decided you were done.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Aeromancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Loose papers drift toward you as if curious, your hair moves in a breeze no one else can feel, and closed doors sigh open a moment before you reach them.

Electromancer.name: Electromancer
Electromancer.description:
Speed is the entire thesis. An Electromancer acts in the gap between an enemy's decision and its execution, Chain Lightning leaping through a formation before the front rank has fallen, Thunder Claps that scatter a charge into stunned confusion. There is no grinding attrition here, only the instant where everything happens at once. Blink and the fight is decided; blink again and you missed the part where you lost.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Electromancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Static clings to you and everyone who stands too close, small devices misbehave at your touch, and your hair lifts faintly whenever your temper does.

Toxomancer.name: Toxomancer
Toxomancer.description:
A Toxomancer does not win the fight in front of them, they win the one three turns from now. Plague Touch plants a wound that only worsens; the Poison Crown makes their very presence a slow verdict on everyone nearby. Patient, clinical, and quietly frightening, this is the class for players who understand that the deadliest attack is the one the enemy already took and hasn't noticed yet. Time is the weapon. Poison is only the delivery.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Toxomancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Cut flowers wilt a day early in your presence, insects give you a wide and respectful berth, and you have never in your life been troubled by a bad reaction to anything you ate.

Voidmancer.name: Voidmancer
Voidmancer.description:
The Voidmancer wields absence as a weapon. Devour eats a spell, a strike, or a stretch of the world itself; the Demonic Gate opens a mouth in reality that gives nothing back. Where other casters add, heat, force, light, a Voidmancer subtracts, unmaking the enemy's options one by one until nothing is left to try. Unsettling to fight and unsettling to be, it is the rare class the Church watches, and the rare player who wants to be watched.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Charisma
Voidmancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Small sounds go quiet around you as if swallowed, shadows pool a shade too deep at your feet, and people forget the exact moment you entered a room even as they look right at you.

Spatiomancer.name: Spatiomancer
Spatiomancer.description:
For a Spatiomancer, the battlefield is a suggestion. Distortion Fields bend distance so attacks fall short and the enemy's footing lies to them; Spatial Anchors nail a foe in place or pull an ally out of danger in a blink. This is a control class of the purest kind, not stronger than the enemy, simply operating in a geometry the enemy doesn't have access to. Win the shape of the fight, and the fight is already won.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Spatiomancer.traitNarrativeEffects: Rooms feel a little larger or smaller than their walls allow when you concentrate, you never misjudge a doorway or a leap, and things you set down are always exactly where you left them, even when they shouldn't be.

Qi Cultivator.name: Qi Cultivator
Qi Cultivator.description:
The body is the technique. A Qi Cultivator spends years refining flesh into a vessel that circulates force instead of breaking under it, and the result is a fighter who takes the hit on purpose to prove the hit does not matter. Golden Bell wards ring off incoming steel, meridians open one breakthrough at a time, and the patient work of a decade answers in a single exchange. Others train to strike harder. This one trains to be unbreakable.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Qi Cultivator.traitNarrativeEffects: You breathe on a slow deliberate count even at rest, cold water does not make you flinch, and small bruises fade from your skin faster than anyone thinks to mention.

Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
Juggernaut.description:
Momentum with a pulse. A Juggernaut walks into the part of the battlefield everyone else is retreating from and keeps walking, absorbing hits that would drop a line and answering with a weapon heavy enough to make the answer final. Every blow taken feeds the next swing. The strategy is not subtle and it does not need to be, because stopping a Juggernaut requires something the enemy usually does not have.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Juggernaut.traitNarrativeEffects: Doorways are a suggestion you barely acknowledge, furniture creaks when you lean on it, and people instinctively step aside in crowded halls without deciding to.

Grappler.name: Grappler
Grappler.description:
The fight goes where a Grappler decides it goes. Close the distance, take the clinch, and suddenly the opponent's reach, weapon, and stance are all irrelevant problems happening somewhere they no longer are. Throws end exchanges, locks end arguments, and a pin ends the whole conversation. Against anything that relies on space, this is the least fair style in Luxcellia.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Grappler.traitNarrativeEffects: You judge the weight of everything you pick up without meaning to, your grip leaves marks on doorframes and railings, and you sit with your feet planted like you might need them.

Bulwark Monk.name: Bulwark Monk
Bulwark Monk.description:
A monastery answer to violence. The Bulwark Monk carries no shield because the body already is one, hardened through conditioning that turns forearms into guard rails and a braced stance into a wall an ally can stand behind. They strike when striking is the merciful option and absorb when it is not. Serenity here is not a mood; it is a load-bearing structure.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Bulwark Monk.traitNarrativeEffects: You stand with your weight evenly set even while chatting, your knuckles and forearms are marked with old conditioning, and you never quite lose your balance.

Ironblood Sentinel.name: Ironblood Sentinel
Ironblood Sentinel.description:
A guardian who mends faster than the enemy can break. The Ironblood Sentinel pairs a shield wall with internal circulation, closing wounds mid-fight and holding a line long past the point where the line should have collapsed. Attrition is their weapon: let the enemy spend everything on a position that keeps repairing itself, then step forward.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Ironblood Sentinel.traitNarrativeEffects: Old scars on you have healed suspiciously clean, you run warm to the touch, and you plant yourself between people and open doorways without noticing.

Siegebreaker.name: Siegebreaker
Siegebreaker.description:
Fortifications are temporary. A Siegebreaker does the ugly, grinding work of taking a defended position: soaking the volley on the approach, weathering the choke point, and putting a heavy weapon through whatever the defenders thought would hold. They fight on a longer clock than anyone shooting at them, and that clock is the whole plan.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Strength
Siegebreaker.traitNarrativeEffects: You size up walls and gates the way others size up people, your hands are permanently rough, and loud noises do not startle you in the slightest.

Plague Bearer.name: Plague Bearer
Plague Bearer.description:
A carrier who survived what they now carry. The Plague Bearer studies toxin and contagion from the inside, having tempered their own body into a host for what kills everyone else. They fight patiently, letting a wound do its slow work while their own arsenal leaves them untouched. Frightening to face and, to the Church, far more frightening to leave alive.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Plague Bearer.traitNarrativeEffects: Insects avoid your skin, cut flowers wilt early nearby, and you have never once been troubled by anything you ate or drank.

Unbroken.name: Unbroken
Unbroken.description:
Willpower with a body attached. The Unbroken have no signature weapon and no elegant style, only a flat refusal to stop that has outlasted better fighters, worse odds, and several people's entire notion of what a person can walk away from. They win late. They win by still being there. Nobody recommends it as a strategy and it keeps working anyway.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Secondary Attribute: Wisdom
Unbroken.traitNarrativeEffects: You hold eye contact a beat longer than is comfortable, you do not fidget, and people who have seen you fight tend to describe it quietly.

Beastblood Berserker.name: Beastblood Berserker
Beastblood Berserker.description:
Something older than technique lives in the blood. The Beastblood Berserker channels internal force into a rage that closes wounds as fast as they open, trading precision for a forward pressure that does not tire and does not negotiate. The transformation is partial, controlled on a good day, and genuinely alarming to be near on a bad one.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Secondary Attribute: Constitution
Beastblood Berserker.traitNarrativeEffects: Your canines are a little too sharp, wounds on you scab within the hour, and your temper has a physical presence that animals notice before people do.

Qi Affinity.name: Qi Affinity
Qi Affinity.description:
Qi answers you as a physical discipline rather than a spoken one. Where other affinities reach into an element, this one turns inward: circulation, tempering, and the slow conversion of a body into a vessel that carries force without breaking. It specializes in self-hardening, internal healing, and enduring what should not be endurable.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Qi Affinity.traitNarrativeEffects: MAGIC AFFINITY REFERENCE: Use qi for internal circulation, body tempering, iron-body defense, and self-repair. Keep it distinct from Divinity (external blessing) and Blood Magic (paid in vitality). Qi is earned through training, not granted.

Grappling Gauntlets.name: Grappling Gauntlets
Grappling Gauntlets.description:
Reinforced fingerless gauntlets built for gripping rather than striking, with textured palms and wrist bracing that turn a hold into a decision the other person does not get to make.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Grappling Gauntlets.traitNarrativeEffects: Signature weapon: Grappling Gauntlets. Render its use through Grappling.

Siege Bulwark.name: Siege Bulwark
Siege Bulwark.description:
A tower shield built for advancing into fire rather than hiding behind it, heavy enough to brace a doorway and wide enough that an ally can live behind it.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Siege Bulwark.traitNarrativeEffects: Signature weapon: Siege Bulwark. Render its use through Shield Combat.
