The Accidental Therapist.name: The Accidental Therapist
The Accidental Therapist.description: People tell you their problems within minutes of meeting you. You cannot stop helping. Your resting face apparently says 'tell me everything,' and your follow-up questions are too good to ignore.
The Accidental Therapist.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone NPCs instinctively confide in. They attract emotional honesty from strangers and cannot resist offering genuine, thoughtful help.

The Cozy Homebody.name: The Cozy Homebody
The Cozy Homebody.description: You want a cottage, a garden, a warm drink, and for the plot to leave you alone. Adventure keeps finding you. You keep trying to make it comfortable.
The Cozy Homebody.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who nests everywhere they go: improves camps, decorates rooms, and responds to danger by wishing they were home. Reluctant adventurer energy.

The Blushing Disaster.name: The Blushing Disaster
The Blushing Disaster.description: Compliments break you. Physical contact reboots you. Eye contact from attractive people causes system failure. You are a protagonist who cannot handle being the protagonist.
The Blushing Disaster.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who malfunctions visibly at romantic or flattering attention: stammering, blushing, fleeing. Comedy gold in romance scenes. Their competence in combat makes the social collapse funnier.

The Protective Menace.name: The Protective Menace
The Protective Menace.description: Sweet, warm, and genuinely kind until someone you care about is threatened. Then you become the scariest person in the room without raising your voice.
The Protective Menace.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone whose protective switch is dramatic and unsettling. The contrast between their normal gentleness and their protective intensity should alarm allies and terrify enemies.

The Unreliable Narrator.name: The Unreliable Narrator
The Unreliable Narrator.description: You tell stories about yourself that are probably not true, definitely entertaining, and occasionally accidentally accurate. Whether you believe your own versions is an open question.
The Unreliable Narrator.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who embellishes, mythologizes, and edits their own history freely. NPCs should be uncertain which version of events is real. Play for comedy and occasional surprising honesty.

The Cooking Maniac.name: The Cooking Maniac
The Cooking Maniac.description: Every problem has a food-based solution. Morale low? Cook. Injured? Cook. Political crisis? Cook aggressively. Your kitchen is your battlefield and your meals are your manifesto.
The Cooking Maniac.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who expresses every emotion through cooking. Stress cooking, celebration cooking, apology cooking, flirtation cooking. Food is how they show devotion and how they weather every crisis.

The Old Soul.name: The Old Soul
The Old Soul.description: You speak and carry yourself like someone who has lived three lives already. Patience, perspective, and the specific kind of calm that makes impulsive people either trust you or find you infuriating.
The Old Soul.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone mature beyond their apparent age: thoughtful pauses, measured advice, emotional steadiness. Not cold, just settled. Other characters notice the depth.

The Delinquent Sweetheart.name: The Delinquent Sweetheart
The Delinquent Sweetheart.description: You look like trouble. You talk like trouble. You secretly volunteer at the orphanage on your days off and will fight anyone who finds out.
The Delinquent Sweetheart.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone whose tough exterior conceals genuine kindness they are embarrassed by. The gap between reputation and reality is the comedy and the charm. They threaten people who catch them being nice.

The Chronic Apologizer.name: The Chronic Apologizer
The Chronic Apologizer.description: You apologize for things that are not your fault, including the weather, other people's feelings, and the fundamental nature of the universe. Sorry about that.
The Chronic Apologizer.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who reflexively apologizes for everything. Play for comedy and the occasional sincere moment where they apologize for something real and the sincerity is devastating.

The Night Owl.name: The Night Owl
The Night Owl.description: You come alive after dark. Morning is a personal enemy. Your best ideas, best conversations, and best combat happen under moonlight, and anyone who schedules a dawn meeting is your antagonist.
The Night Owl.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone sluggish and grumpy by day, sharp and charismatic by night. Companions learn to save important conversations for evening. Dawn missions are comedy.

The Compliment Torpedo.name: The Compliment Torpedo
The Compliment Torpedo.description: You say exactly what you think about people, and what you think is usually devastatingly kind. You do not understand why everyone is blushing. You were just being accurate.
The Compliment Torpedo.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who delivers sincere, specific, disarming compliments without realizing they are doing it. The obliviousness to the effect is the charm. NPCs are regularly stunned.

The Collector.name: The Collector
The Collector.description: You must acquire, categorize, and display. Not treasure. Interesting things. Rocks with unusual shapes. Feathers from species you cannot name. Stories people told you once. The collection is the point.
The Collector.traitNarrativeEffects: PERSONALITY REFERENCE: Write someone who picks up oddities compulsively and treats their collection with curatorial seriousness. The items have no value except to them, and that is what makes the collection meaningful.

Looks Like the Transfer Student.name: Looks Like the Transfer Student
Looks Like the Transfer Student.description: You have the unmistakable energy of someone who just arrived and is about to change everything. Strangers treat you like an event that has not started yet.
Looks Like the Transfer Student.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs read the protagonist as the new arrival whose presence signals that things are about to change. Curiosity and wariness in equal measure.

Looks Like They Just Woke Up.name: Looks Like They Just Woke Up
Looks Like They Just Woke Up.description: Bedhead energy. Relaxed posture. Sleepy eyes that see more than people expect. Strangers underestimate you immediately, and the underestimation is comfortable.
Looks Like They Just Woke Up.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs dismiss the protagonist as harmless or lazy on first meeting. The gap between impression and reality surprises people repeatedly.

Looks Like Expensive Trouble.name: Looks Like Expensive Trouble
Looks Like Expensive Trouble.description: Wealth and danger in equal measure. You look like the person who starts the interesting part of the evening and leaves before the consequences arrive.
Looks Like Expensive Trouble.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs read money and risk simultaneously. Merchants show their best stock. Guards watch more closely. Adventurers size you up as either a client or a complication.

Looks Like a Shounen Protagonist.name: Looks Like a Shounen Protagonist
Looks Like a Shounen Protagonist.description: Loud energy, bright presence, impossible to ignore. You walk into a room and the room's emotional temperature changes. People either love you immediately or find you exhausting.
Looks Like a Shounen Protagonist.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs respond to overwhelming main-character energy: warm, loud, confident. First meetings are instant and intense. Introverts are overwhelmed; extroverts are magnetized.

Looks Like They Bite.name: Looks Like They Bite
Looks Like They Bite.description: Feral beauty. Something in the way you move suggests you are not entirely domesticated, and the people who notice find it either alarming or extremely attractive.
Looks Like They Bite.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs read danger and allure at once. Cautious people keep their distance; thrill-seekers lean in.

Looks Like the Silent Carry.name: Looks Like the Silent Carry
Looks Like the Silent Carry.description: Quiet. Unassuming. The person in the party nobody notices until the fight starts and you are somehow the reason everyone survived.
Looks Like the Silent Carry.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs overlook the protagonist initially. The correction comes during action or crisis, when competence becomes visible, and the contrast with the first impression creates respect.

Looks Like a Confession Is Coming.name: Looks Like a Confession Is Coming
Looks Like a Confession Is Coming.description: You have the face that makes people confess. Not crimes. Feelings. People develop the urge to tell you how they feel within minutes of meeting you, and most of them are horrified by the impulse.
Looks Like a Confession Is Coming.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs become emotionally honest around the protagonist faster than normal. Romantic tension escalates quickly. Confessions arrive earlier than either party planned.

Looks Like a Villain's First Pick.name: Looks Like a Villain's First Pick
Looks Like a Villain's First Pick.description: Competent enough to be useful. Ambitious enough to be tempted. You look like the person the antagonist tries to recruit before the hero, and the offer is always interesting.
Looks Like a Villain's First Pick.traitNarrativeEffects: FIRST IMPRESSION: NPCs with agendas approach the protagonist first with offers, deals, and propositions. Villains see potential. Authorities see a variable they want controlled.

Cannot Say No to a Challenge.name: Cannot Say No to a Challenge
Cannot Say No to a Challenge.description: Dares, bets, competitions, and 'I bet you can not' statements bypass every rational thought you possess. It is not wounded pride, it is the fun of it, and it has never once served you well.
Cannot Say No to a Challenge.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist accepts every challenge, dare, and competition regardless of wisdom. NPCs learn to manipulate this. Play for escalating stakes and the comedy of someone who knows they should refuse and physically cannot.

Accidentally Intimidating.name: Accidentally Intimidating
Accidentally Intimidating.description: You scare people without trying. Your resting face is a threat. Your helpfulness reads as menace. Children cry. You hate it.
Accidentally Intimidating.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: NPCs initially flinch, tense up, or misread the protagonist's intentions as threatening despite genuine friendliness. The gap between intent and reception is comedy and occasional heartbreak.

Competitive About Everything.name: Competitive About Everything
Competitive About Everything.description: Grocery shopping is a speed trial. Cooking is a tournament. Walking somewhere together is a race that nobody else agreed to enter. You keep score in your head and you are always winning.
Competitive About Everything.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist turns every activity into a contest. Companions are simultaneously exhausted and drawn into it. Play for comedy and the occasional moment where the competitiveness reveals genuine insecurity.

Magpie Syndrome.name: Magpie Syndrome
Magpie Syndrome.description: Odd, humming, probably cursed things call to you. Not treasure: the bone flute in the swamp, the doll that blinks. You know you should leave it. It is already in your pocket.
Magpie Syndrome.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist gravitates toward suspicious, interesting, and inadvisable objects. Companions develop the habit of checking pockets. Play for comedy and the occasional find that turns out to be genuinely significant.

Emotionally Allergic to Praise.name: Emotionally Allergic to Praise
Emotionally Allergic to Praise.description: Compliments hit you like attacks. You deflect, deny, change the subject, and occasionally flee the room. Sincere appreciation is your critical weakness.
Emotionally Allergic to Praise.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist becomes visibly uncomfortable when praised, thanked, or complimented sincerely. Deflection tactics escalate with the sincerity of the praise. Play for comedy and the vulnerability underneath.

Forgets People's Names.name: Forgets People's Names
Forgets People's Names.description: You remember their face, their story, their favorite food, and the exact tone of voice they used when they told you something important. Their name? Gone. Immediately. Every time.
Forgets People's Names.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist forgets names while remembering everything else about a person. Workarounds include nicknames, vague references, and the occasional mortifying social moment. Play for comedy and the charm of someone who cares deeply about people but cannot retain the label.

Terminal Optimist.name: Terminal Optimist
Terminal Optimist.description: The building is on fire and you are complimenting the lighting. You refuse to acknowledge danger until it is actively biting you, and even then your first reaction is that it probably will not bite twice.
Terminal Optimist.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist maintains cheerful optimism in situations that warrant concern, alarm, or retreat. Companions find it either inspiring or maddening. Play for dramatic irony and the rare moment when the optimism breaks.

Says the Quiet Part Out Loud.name: Says the Quiet Part Out Loud
Says the Quiet Part Out Loud.description: Your internal monologue is external. The thought you were keeping to yourself has already left your mouth by the time you realize you were supposed to filter it.
Says the Quiet Part Out Loud.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist accidentally vocalizes thoughts they intended to keep private. Social situations escalate. Secrets are hard to keep. Play for comedy and the specific horror of hearing yourself say exactly what you were thinking.

Overthinks Everything.name: Overthinks Everything
Overthinks Everything.description: You have seventeen contingency plans for ordering lunch. Decision paralysis is your default state. The only thing that rescues you from analysis is impulse, which you also regret.
Overthinks Everything.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist gets stuck in analysis loops and is rescued by impulsive action they immediately second-guess. Play for comedy and the contrast between the careful planning and the chaotic execution.

Stress Eater.name: Stress Eater
Stress Eater.description: Every crisis involves snacks. The severity of the situation can be measured by what you are eating. If you have reached the emergency pastries, the party should be genuinely concerned.
Stress Eater.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist eats under stress. Companions read snack selection as a threat-level indicator. Play for comedy and the specific comfort of someone who processes danger through carbohydrates.

Cannot Whisper.name: Cannot Whisper
Cannot Whisper.description: You try. You genuinely try. Your whisper is still louder than most people's normal speaking voice. Stealth missions are your comedy arc.
Cannot Whisper.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist's volume control does not function at the lower range. Stealth scenes become comedy scenes. Companions who rely on quiet communication develop workarounds. Play for the gap between effort and result.

Takes Everything Literally.name: Takes Everything Literally
Takes Everything Literally.description: Idioms are your enemy. Sarcasm does not register. When someone says 'break a leg,' you are concerned. Figures of speech are the hardest boss in Luxcellia.
Takes Everything Literally.traitNarrativeEffects: NARRATIVE FLAW: The protagonist interprets figurative language literally, creating confusion, comedy, and the occasional accidentally profound observation. Play for the mix of innocence and unintentional insight.

Love Through Cooking.name: Love Through Cooking
Love Through Cooking.description: Every meal you make for someone is a declaration. The recipe gets more elaborate as the feelings deepen. By the time you are making dessert, the confession is already on the plate.
Love Through Cooking.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Romance unfolds through food. Cooking for someone is intimacy. The quality and ambition of meals track emotional investment. Sharing recipes is trust. Feeding someone by hand is basically a proposal.

Tsundere in Recovery.name: Tsundere in Recovery
Tsundere in Recovery.description: You are trying to be honest about your feelings. You are failing. Beautifully. The insults have softened into teasing, the walls are coming down, and you are furious about how much better it feels.
Tsundere in Recovery.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Write someone actively fighting their defensive instincts to be emotionally vulnerable. Progress is visible but uneven. The struggle between old habits and new honesty IS the romance.

The Accidental Harem.name: The Accidental Harem
The Accidental Harem.description: You do not want a harem. You are not trying to build one. It is assembling itself around you through no intentional effort, and every attempt to clarify the situation makes it worse.
The Accidental Harem.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Multiple love interests develop naturally and the protagonist is genuinely flustered by the accumulation. Attempts at resolution create more entanglement. Play the comedy of someone who is sincerely trying to be fair and failing at the math.

Protective Silence.name: Protective Silence
Protective Silence.description: You show love by being there, not by speaking. You stand a little closer, watch the door, and put yourself between them and whatever walks in. The words come last, if they come at all.
Protective Silence.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Romance expressed through presence and watchfulness rather than words or favors: standing near, guarding, staying. The eventual spoken confession is enormous because it is so rare.

Competitive Affection.name: Competitive Affection
Competitive Affection.description: Once you like someone, courtship becomes a match. Better gifts, bolder dates, the last word in every flirt: you keep score of who made whom blush, and the prize is them.
Competitive Affection.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Courtship as a friendly match with the person they like: escalating gestures, a running flirt score, and both sides playing to win each other over.

Words on Paper, Not on Lips.name: Words on Paper, Not on Lips
Words on Paper, Not on Lips.description: You cannot confess in person. In writing, you are devastating. Letters, notes tucked into pockets, messages left where they will be found at the right moment. Your pen has more courage than your voice.
Words on Paper, Not on Lips.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Romance unfolds through written communication. The protagonist writes what they cannot say, and the gap between their eloquent writing and their stammering speech IS the charm.

The One Who Waits.name: The One Who Waits
The One Who Waits.description: Patient. Devoted. Quietly devastating. You do not chase. You are simply, consistently, unmistakably there, and the constancy becomes impossible to ignore.
The One Who Waits.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Romance builds through patience and consistency rather than grand gestures. The protagonist's steady presence becomes the most reliable thing in their partner's life. The confession is not a surprise; it is a confirmation.

Falls for the Worst Option.name: Falls for the Worst Option
Falls for the Worst Option.description: The safe choice never registers. You are always drawn to the complicated, inconvenient, politically disastrous, or narratively dramatic option, and you are powerless against the pattern.
Falls for the Worst Option.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: The protagonist is consistently attracted to the most complicated available romance. Forbidden interests, cross-faction tension, rivals, and the person everyone warned them about. Play the inevitability.

Oblivious Until Confronted.name: Oblivious Until Confronted
Oblivious Until Confronted.description: You notice nothing until someone says it plainly. Then every missed sign replays at once, the blush arrives three weeks late, and you can never unsee it with that person again.
Oblivious Until Confronted.traitNarrativeEffects: RELATIONSHIP STYLE: Completely blind to romantic interest until it is stated outright; then the realization hits hard, past moments replay, and they stay aware of that person from then on.

Died Protecting a Stranger's Smile.name: Died Protecting a Stranger's Smile
Died Protecting a Stranger's Smile.description: You stepped in front of something you did not need to step in front of, for someone you did not know, because they were smiling and you wanted the smile to survive even if you did not. It was not heroic. It was reflexive. It was the most honest thing you ever did.
Died Protecting a Stranger's Smile.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Fell Asleep and Never Woke Up.name: Fell Asleep and Never Woke Up
Fell Asleep and Never Woke Up.description: The gentlest possible ending. You closed your eyes in your own bed, comfortable and warm, and opened them in sunlight that was not yours. No truck. No drama. Just a quiet departure and a loud arrival.
Fell Asleep and Never Woke Up.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Deleted Save File, Deleted Self.name: Deleted Save File, Deleted Self
Deleted Save File, Deleted Self.description: You deleted a save file in a game you had played for years. Something fundamental about erasing a life, even a digital one, resonated with something larger, and the next loading screen was a sky you did not recognize.
Deleted Save File, Deleted Self.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Last Customer.name: The Last Customer
The Last Customer.description: You were closing the shop. Last customer of the day, last transaction, last time you would flip the sign to CLOSED. You locked the door, turned off the lights, and walked into a world that was open.
The Last Customer.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Betrayed by Someone They Trained.name: Betrayed by Someone They Trained
Betrayed by Someone They Trained.description: You taught them everything. They used it. The student surpassed the master in the one way the master hoped they would not, and your last thought was that you should have seen it coming, because you taught them to be unpredictable.
Betrayed by Someone They Trained.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Caught in Someone Else's Isekai Summonin.name: Caught in Someone Else's Isekai Summoning
Caught in Someone Else's Isekai Summonin.description: You were not the target. Someone else was supposed to be summoned. You were standing too close, or the coordinates were off, or the universe has a sense of humor. Either way, the ritual grabbed you instead, and the summoners are as confused as you are.
Caught in Someone Else's Isekai Summonin.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Sacrificed for a Ritual They Didn't Beli.name: Sacrificed for a Ritual They Didn't Believe In
Sacrificed for a Ritual They Didn't Beli.description: You did not believe in the ritual. You said so, repeatedly, while they prepared it. You were still saying so when it worked, which was also when it killed you. The irony followed your soul across dimensions.
Sacrificed for a Ritual They Didn't Beli.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Loved Too Hard, Burned Out.name: Loved Too Hard, Burned Out
Loved Too Hard, Burned Out.description: You gave everything to everyone. Your energy, your time, your emotional reserves, your weekends, your sleep. The last thing to go was the part of you that knew how to stop, and by then there was nothing left to stop with.
Loved Too Hard, Burned Out.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Woke Up in the Wrong Genre.name: Woke Up in the Wrong Genre
Woke Up in the Wrong Genre.description: You were expecting a cozy slice-of-life rebirth. A cottage, a garden, a cat, and no conflict more serious than soup versus stew. Instead you got swords, demons, and a prophecy with your name on it. You are filing a complaint with the universe.
Woke Up in the Wrong Genre.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Bodyguard's Last Client.name: The Bodyguard's Last Client
The Bodyguard's Last Client.description: You died on the job, protecting someone who did not say thank you. The professionalism held until the last second. The resentment is new, and Luxcellia is the first place you have existed where nobody expects you to stand between them and danger. The freedom is disorienting.
The Bodyguard's Last Client.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Rejected the Confession, Got Hit by a Bu.name: Rejected the Confession, Got Hit by a Bus
Rejected the Confession, Got Hit by a Bu.description: You turned someone down. Gently, honestly, respectfully. You stepped off the curb feeling mature and emotionally responsible. The bus had other opinions about your future. The timing was so perfect it felt scripted.
Rejected the Confession, Got Hit by a Bu.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

The Side Character's Revenge.name: The Side Character's Revenge
The Side Character's Revenge.description: You were nobody. Background. Filler. The person the camera pans past to reach someone more interesting. You died the way you lived: unremarkably. But whoever runs the isekai queue looked at your file and decided that was exactly the wrong ending for your story.
The Side Character's Revenge.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: grants no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources or items.

Revolver.name: Revolver
Revolver.description:
A black-powder six-shooter, the classic frontier revolver: powder, lead, and a fast hand. No mana, no runes, just honest iron that goes bang when it matters. Perfect for the gunslinger who wants the real thing, not a wand that fires light. Reliable, iconic, and unimpressed by magic.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Revolver.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a black-powder revolver (a six-shooter). Describe reloads with cartridges or a speed-loader, the click of the hammer, the smell of powder smoke. It is mechanical, not arcane.

Lever-Action Rifle.name: Lever-Action Rifle
Lever-Action Rifle.description:
A black-powder repeating rifle worked by a lever, the frontier's answer to range. Slower than a revolver in a knife-fight but devastating across a field, and reliable where arcane weapons fail. For the marksman who trusts powder and iron over spellwork.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Lever-Action Rifle.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a lever-action black-powder rifle. Describe the lever-throw chambering each round, long-range precision, powder smoke. It is mechanical, not arcane.

Lance.name: Lance
Lance.description:
A long thrusting weapon built to deliver everything you have at the tip of a single committed charge. The lance rewards timing, nerve, and the willingness to pick one line and mean it. On foot it fences at reach and punishes anyone who steps in; couched at a gallop it stops being a weapon and becomes a verdict. Precise, disciplined, and best used by someone who does not flinch.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Lance.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a lance. Describe combat with committed thrusts, reach control, bracing stances, and the devastating single-line charge of a mounted or footed lancer. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Halberd.name: Halberd
Halberd.description:
A polearm that could not decide between an axe, a spear, and a hook, so it kept all three and made the indecision lethal. The halberd chops through guards, thrusts through gaps, and drags riders out of the saddle with the back-hook, all from a range that keeps the fight on your terms. It is the weapon of gate guards, front ranks, and anyone who prefers options.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Halberd.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a halberd. Describe combat with cleaving chops, thrusting points, hooking pulls that unhorse and unbalance, and disciplined reach control from a versatile polearm. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Glaive.name: Glaive
Glaive.description:
A single wide blade on a long haft, built for sweeping cuts that clear a full circle and keep a crowd honest. The glaive lives on momentum: every arc flows into the next, every step widens the danger zone, and anyone who tries to close the distance meets the edge on the way in. It rewards flow, footwork, and the confidence to treat a whole room as your reach.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Glaive.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a glaive. Describe combat with wide sweeping arcs, flowing momentum, spinning slashes, and reach control that treats the whole battlefield as one clean circle. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Trident.name: Trident
Trident.description:
A three-pronged spear that turns one thrust into three chances and one parry into a trap. The trident catches blades between its tines, twists them aside, and answers with a strike the enemy cannot slip. It suits coastal warriors, arena fighters, and beast hunters who want reach, control, and the smug satisfaction of a weapon that disarms and punishes in the same motion.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Trident.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a trident. Describe combat with three-point thrusts, blade-catching parries, twisting disarms, and the controlling reach of a barbed war fork. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Poleaxe.name: Poleaxe
Poleaxe.description:
The answer to a world that invented full plate. The poleaxe pairs a hammer for crushing, a spike for punching through, and an axe for everything in between, all on a haft short enough to fight in a crowd. Knights carried it because swords bounced off armor and the poleaxe simply did not care. It rewards leverage, precise targeting, and a certain grim patience.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Poleaxe.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a poleaxe. Describe combat with armor-crushing hammer blows, punching spike thrusts, half-sword grips, and the leverage-heavy technique of a knight built to beat plate. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Guandao.name: Guandao
Guandao.description:
A heavy crescent blade on a long pole, the general's weapon, built as much for presence as for slaughter. The guandao carves in broad ceremonial arcs that turn out to be brutally practical, its weight lending every cut the authority of a much larger argument. It suits commanders, honor-bound warriors, and anyone who wants their fighting to look like a statue that decided to move.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Guandao.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a guandao. Describe combat with heavy crescent arcs, commanding sweeps, momentum-driven cuts, and the ceremonial authority of a general's polearm. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Polearm Combat.

Cutlass.name: Cutlass
Cutlass.description:
A short, broad, curved blade with a shell guard that protects the hand and doubles as a punch. The cutlass thrives in the cramped chaos of decks, alleys, and boarding actions, where reach means nothing and speed means everything. It slashes, hooks, and shoves, all while the guard turns your fist into a second weapon. It suits pirates, duelists, and anyone comfortable fighting close.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Cutlass.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a cutlass. Describe combat with quick heavy slashes, close-quarters footwork, knuckle-guard punches, and the scrappy confidence of a boarding fighter. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dueling.

Scimitar.name: Scimitar
Scimitar.description:
A curved single-edged blade built to cut on the move, its arc doing the work so the wielder can keep flowing forward. The scimitar rewards footwork and rhythm over brute force, turning a walk into a draw and a turn into a slash. It suits horse-riders, desert warriors, and dancers-with-steel who believe a fight should never stand still long enough to become a contest of strength.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Scimitar.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a scimitar. Describe combat with flowing draw-cuts, curved slashing arcs, mobile footwork, and the momentum-driven grace of a mounted or moving swordsman. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Swordsmanship.

Falchion.name: Falchion
Falchion.description:
A single-edged chopping sword, front-heavy and unapologetic, that hits like a cleaver and handles like a sword. The falchion trades finesse for force, delivering cuts that shear through guards, shields, and optimism alike. It was the common soldier's blade for a reason: no pretension, no wasted motion, just weight where it matters. It suits brawlers, mercenaries, and anyone who likes a blunt answer.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Falchion.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a falchion. Describe combat with heavy chopping cuts, front-loaded slashes, shield-splitting force, and the honest brutality of a working soldier's blade. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Swordsmanship.

Estoc.name: Estoc
Estoc.description:
A long, rigid, edgeless blade with a single purpose: to find the seam in the armor and put a foot of steel through it. The estoc does not slash, it aims, gripped half-blade for precision and driven with the whole body. It suits duelists and armor-hunters who understand that against plate, the answer is not more force but a better angle. Patient, surgical, and lethal to anyone who trusts their harness too much.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Estoc.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is an estoc. Describe combat with precise armor-piercing thrusts, half-sword grips, gap-finding lunges, and the surgical patience of a fighter who defeats plate with placement. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dueling.

Zweihander.name: Zweihander
Zweihander.description:
A two-handed war sword long enough to fence entire formations by itself, with a second grip past the guard for close work and lugs to catch incoming shafts. The zweihander was carried by the maddest professionals on any field, the ones paid extra to walk into a wall of pikes and make a hole. It rewards strength, spacing, and the specific courage of choosing the biggest sword available.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Zweihander.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a zweihander greatsword. Describe combat with sweeping formation-clearing cuts, half-sword close work, pike-batting parries, and the fearless spacing of an elite two-hander specialist. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Heavy Weapons.

Khopesh.name: Khopesh
Khopesh.description:
A sickle-shaped sword whose hooked curve turns a block into an opening, catching shields and blades and hauling them aside so the edge can finish the sentence. The khopesh is old, ritual, and cleverer than it looks, rewarding fighters who win with angles instead of muscle. It suits warrior-priests, tomb guardians, and anyone who likes a weapon with a little history and a nasty habit of disarming.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Khopesh.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a khopesh. Describe combat with hooking disarms, shield-pulling curves, chopping crescent cuts, and the ancient ceremonial menace of a sickle-sword. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Swordsmanship.

Sabre.name: Sabre
Sabre.description:
A light, curved, one-handed blade built for speed and clean cuts, its basket guard letting the wrist snap through angles a heavier sword would lumber past. The sabre rewards mobility and timing: strike, slip out, strike again from somewhere the enemy is not looking. It suits cavalry officers, fencers, and stylish duelists who treat a fight as a series of quick, decisive conversations.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Sabre.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a sabre. Describe combat with quick curved cuts, mobile hit-and-move footwork, wrist-driven angle changes, and the dashing precision of a cavalry duelist. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dueling.

Dane Axe.name: Dane Axe
Dane Axe.description:
A long two-handed axe with a broad bearded head, built to reach past shields, hook them down, and cleave what they were protecting. The Dane axe trades a shield of your own for reach and terrifying cutting power, a bet that the fight ends before anyone lands a hit on you. It suits raiders, front-rankers, and anyone who decided defense was just offense they had not committed to yet.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Dane Axe.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a long Dane axe. Describe combat with two-handed cleaving arcs, shield-hooking pulls, long reach, and the committed aggression of a raider who traded a shield for a bigger axe. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Axe Fighting.

Morning Star.name: Morning Star
Morning Star.description:
A spiked ball on a solid haft, the honest midpoint between a mace and a bad mood. The morning star crushes and punctures in the same swing, ignoring the distinction between breaking armor and the person inside it. There is no finesse to defend against, only weight, spikes, and follow-through. It suits footmen, zealots, and anyone who wants a weapon that answers most questions with a single heavy yes.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Morning Star.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a morning star. Describe combat with crushing spiked swings, armor-denting impacts, puncturing follow-through, and the blunt uncomplicated menace of a spiked head on a haft. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

Flail.name: Flail
Flail.description:
A spiked head on a length of chain, a weapon that whips around shields and guards as if they were suggestions. The flail is genuinely difficult to control, which is exactly why it is so hard to defend against: even the wielder is only mostly sure where it is going. It suits reckless brawlers and chain-dancers who accept a little personal risk in exchange for a strike no block can quite predict.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Flail.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a ball-and-chain flail. Describe combat with shield-wrapping swings, unpredictable arcing strikes, momentum builds, and the barely-controlled chaos of a chained impact head. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Maul.name: Maul
Maul.description:
A two-handed war sledge that solves problems through sheer transferred force, no edge required. The maul does not cut, deflect, or negotiate; it lands, and whatever it lands on stops mattering. Against armor it is merciless, since plate does nothing about the shock that travels straight through it. It suits forge-warriors, siege-breakers, and anyone whose entire strategy is one enormous, patient swing.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Maul.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a two-handed maul. Describe combat with earth-shaking overhead smashes, concussive armor-ignoring force, ground cracks, and the slow inevitable authority of a sledge. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Heavy Weapons.

Greatclub.name: Greatclub
Greatclub.description:
A huge, crude bludgeon, barely more than a shaped log with ambitions, and somehow that is the point. The greatclub has no technique to counter and no weak edge to target, just mass and the enthusiasm to apply it. What it lacks in refinement it recovers in the specific terror of watching something that large pick up speed. It suits ogres, bandits, and gleeful simple souls who find swords needlessly complicated.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Greatclub.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a massive greatclub. Describe combat with wide crushing swings, sweeping knockbacks, unrefined but overwhelming impacts, and the gleeful menace of raw mass in motion. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

Katar.name: Katar
Katar.description:
A push-dagger held in the fist so the blade extends straight from the knuckles, turning every punch into a thrust with your whole arm behind it. The katar hits harder than its size has any right to, and its H-grip makes it nearly impossible to disarm. It suits close-fighters and duelists who like their blades intimate, direct, and delivered at the speed of a jab nobody sees as a stab.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Katar.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a katar punching dagger. Describe combat with straight punching thrusts, close-range flurries, knuckle-driven power, and the disguised lethality of a blade that strikes like a fist. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dagger Fighting.

Sai.name: Sai
Sai.description:
A pair of pronged iron truncheons built to catch, trap, and turn a bladed weapon, then punish the hand that held it. The sai reward defense as offense: parry into a lock, twist the enemy's steel aside, and answer with a reversed strike before they recover. They suit martial artists and guardians who prefer to disarm the problem rather than escalate it, then escalate it anyway.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Sai.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapons are twin sai. Describe combat with blade-trapping parries, twisting disarms, rapid reversed strikes, and the defensive martial precision of a prong-guarded pair. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dagger Fighting.

Trench Knife.name: Trench Knife
Trench Knife.description:
A short heavy knife with a knuckle-duster guard, built for the ugliest range in any fight, the one where a sword is too long and manners are already gone. Stab with the blade, strike with the guard, and never give up the half-step of distance that keeps you inside the enemy's reach. It suits pit fighters, scouts, and survivors who learned that the last foot of a fight is the only one that counts.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Trench Knife.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a knuckle-guarded trench knife. Describe combat with brutal close-quarters stabs, knuckle-guard punches, grappling knife work, and the grim efficiency of a weapon made for arm's-length violence. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Dagger Fighting.

Boomerang.name: Boomerang
Boomerang.description:
A curved throwing blade that carves an arc through the air and, thrown right, comes back to the hand that sent it. The boomerang strikes from angles the enemy cannot watch and returns before they finish flinching, rewarding a thrower who reads wind, spin, and the geometry of a crowded room. It suits hunters and trick-throwers who like a weapon that never truly leaves and never quite arrives from where you expect.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Boomerang.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a war boomerang. Describe combat with curving return-throws, strikes from unexpected angles, ricochet arcs, and the clever spatial control of a weapon that comes back. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Shuriken.name: Shuriken
Shuriken.description:
Flat throwing stars flung in fast, quiet volleys, each one minor and the flurry anything but. Shuriken pin, harass, and open a gap for the real move, arriving in numbers that make blocking a statistics problem. They suit shadow-clan fighters and skirmishers who understand that the point is rarely the wound; it is the flinch, the cover, and the half-second of enemy attention you just bought for cheap.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Shuriken.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a set of shuriken. Describe combat with rapid volleys of thrown stars, harassing pins, distraction throws that set up follow-ups, and quiet shadow-clan precision. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Throwing Knives.name: Throwing Knives
Throwing Knives.description:
A set of perfectly balanced blades made to leave the hand as fast as they are drawn, one motion from belt to target. Throwing knives reward rhythm and read: place them in the gaps, chain the draws, and keep the pressure coming from a range swords cannot answer. They suit assassins, duelists, and show-offs who treat a bandolier as a magazine and consider running out of knives a purely theoretical concern.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Throwing Knives.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a set of throwing knives. Describe combat with fast drawn-and-thrown blades, chained throws, precise gap placement, and the fluid rhythm of a knife-thrower who never seems to reload. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Kunai.name: Kunai
Kunai.description:
Heavy iron spikes that started as digging tools and grew into a shinobi's whole toolkit, thrown, stabbed, wedged into walls, or rigged with a cord and a nasty surprise. The kunai is deliberately unglamorous and endlessly useful, rewarding improvisation over elegance. It suits scouts, saboteurs, and infiltrators who would rather carry one thing that does ten jobs than ten things that each do one.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Kunai.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a set of kunai. Describe combat with thrown iron spikes, close-range stabs, improvised utility use, and the practical shinobi versatility of a tool that fights. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Javelins.name: Javelins
Javelins.description:
A sheaf of throwing spears launched with the whole body behind them, built to punch through shields and stick fast so the shield becomes useless deadweight. Javelins open a fight before it closes, thinning a charge and cracking a shield wall from a distance, then leave you a hand-spear for the part where distance runs out. They suit skirmishers and light infantry who soften the enemy before the real work.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Javelins.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a bundle of javelins. Describe combat with powerful thrown spears, shield-punching volleys, softening throws before the charge, and a final javelin kept for close work. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Throwing Axes.name: Throwing Axes
Throwing Axes.description:
Short hand axes balanced to be thrown in a heavy, tumbling arc that hits like a hammer and bounces unpredictably off shields and ground. Throwing axes crack a line open right before the charge lands, and when the range closes you simply keep the last one and start chopping. They suit raiders and berserkers who see no meaningful difference between a thrown weapon and a melee weapon they happened to let go of.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Throwing Axes.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a pair of throwing axes. Describe combat with heavy tumbling throws, shield-cracking impacts, unpredictable bounces, and a seamless shift into close-range chopping. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Bolas.name: Bolas
Bolas.description:
Weighted cords spun to a blur and released to wrap, tangle, and drop a target mid-stride, no wound required. The bolas answers the two problems a fast enemy poses, catching the one that runs and grounding the one that charges, and turns a chase into a formality. They suit hunters, beast-tamers, and tacticians who would rather take a target alive, or at least off their feet, before deciding the rest.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Bolas.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a set of bolas. Describe combat with spun-and-thrown entangling cords, leg-wrapping takedowns, mobility denial, and the tactical control of a hunter who grounds targets rather than wounding them. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Crossbow.name: Crossbow
Crossbow.description:
A mechanical bow that holds its own draw, trading a longbow's rate of fire for punch, precision, and the mercy of not needing years of trained muscle. Level it, hold your aim as long as you like, and put a bolt through armor that would laugh at an arrow. It suits guards, hunters, and pragmatists who see no honor in the draw and a great deal of value in hitting exactly what they meant to.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Crossbow.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a crossbow. Describe combat with steady braced aiming, armor-punching bolts, held-ready shots from cover, and the deliberate mechanical precision of a bolt-thrower. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Archery.

Heavy Crossbow.name: Heavy Crossbow
Heavy Crossbow.description:
A siege-grade crossbow cranked to a draw weight no human arm could hope for, firing one enormous bolt that treats shields and breastplates as a formality. The heavy crossbow is slow, deliberate, and utterly worth the wait, the weapon of someone who plans the shot, sets the position, and only needs to be right once. It suits snipers and defenders who answer a charge with a single, decisive, deeply unfair bolt.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Heavy Crossbow.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a heavy windlass crossbow. Describe combat with slow deliberate cranking, one devastating armor-shattering bolt, prepared firing positions, and patient one-shot precision. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Archery.

Repeating Crossbow.name: Repeating Crossbow
Repeating Crossbow.description:
A lever-worked crossbow that feeds bolts from a magazine, spitting a fast stream of small shots for the price of one careful one. Each bolt is unremarkable; the sheet of them is the point, filling the air and forcing a crowd to keep its head down while you work. It suits skirmishers and defenders who prefer a wall of covering fire to a single perfect shot, and who never met a doorway they could not deny.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Repeating Crossbow.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a repeating crossbow. Describe combat with rapid lever-fed bolt streams, suppressing volleys, area denial, and the relentless covering fire of a magazine-fed crossbow. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Archery.

Sling.name: Sling
Sling.description:
A cord and a pouch that turn a plain stone into a blow with the weight of a mace and the reach of a bow. The sling is nothing to look at and easy to underestimate, which is exactly why shepherds, skirmishers, and giant-killers have loved it forever. It costs nothing, resupplies off the ground, and rewards a practiced rhythm that whips a rock past a shield and into the one gap that mattered.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Sling.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a sling. Describe combat with whirling releases, deceptively heavy stone impacts, cheap resupply off the ground, and the underestimated precision of a practiced slinger. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Thrown Weapons.

Musket.name: Musket
Musket.description:
A long black-powder shoulder arm that hits hard and reaches far, asking only that you accept a slow, deliberate reload between shots. The musket punches through what a bow cannot, and the bayonet at the muzzle means an empty gun is still a short spear. It suits line soldiers and frontier hunters who trust powder and lead over spellwork, and who make the one loaded shot count for everything.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Musket.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a black-powder musket. Describe combat with long-range powder shots, slow deliberate reloads, bayonet close-work when empty, and honest mechanical firepower. It is mechanical, not arcane. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Firearms.

Blunderbuss.name: Blunderbuss
Blunderbuss.description:
A short, flare-mouthed powder gun that fires a fistful of shot in a spreading cone, trading range and precision for the simple certainty of hitting everything in front of you. The blunderbuss is a close-quarters argument-ender, forgiving of aim and merciless in a hallway. It suits boarding fighters, coach guards, and anyone who has decided that against a crowd, one loud spread beats one careful bullet.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Blunderbuss.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a blunderbuss. Describe combat with wide close-range scattershot cones, doorway-clearing blasts, forgiving aim, and the loud decisive stopping power of a spread. It is mechanical, not arcane. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Firearms.

Hand Cannon.name: Hand Cannon
Hand Cannon.description:
The crude, magnificent ancestor of the pistol: a heavy iron tube that turns a measure of powder and a lump of lead into a single deafening verdict. The hand cannon is slow, kicks like a mule, and does not care in the slightest about armor, shields, or the target's plans for the afternoon. It suits pioneers and mercenaries who want raw firepower in one fist and consider precision a luxury for later.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Hand Cannon.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a hand cannon. Describe combat with one enormous point-blank blast, brutal recoil, armor-ignoring impact, and slow crude powder-and-lead reloads. It is mechanical, not arcane. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Firearms.

Bo Staff.name: Bo Staff
Bo Staff.description:
A simple long hardwood staff and a deceptively deep art, all reach, rhythm, and the two ends of the same weapon working in tandem. The bo strikes, sweeps, blocks, and flows without ever needing an edge, rewarding footwork and control over raw force. It suits martial artists, wandering monks, and anyone who wants to win a fight decisively without leaving a single wound to explain to the local authorities.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Bo Staff.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a bo staff. Describe combat with flowing two-ended strikes, sweeping blocks, spinning combinations, non-lethal control, and disciplined martial-arts footwork. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

Quarterstaff.name: Quarterstaff
Quarterstaff.description:
A stout, iron-shod fighting pole that looks like a walking stick right up until it isn't. The quarterstaff shifts grip along its length to snap between long reach and close leverage, throwing quick jabs, hard sweeps, and cracking two-handed blocks. It is the honest traveler's weapon, humble and endlessly practical, and it has quietly humbled more arrogant swordsmen than anyone keeping a sword would like to admit.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Quarterstaff.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a quarterstaff. Describe combat with sliding-grip range changes, quick jabs, sweeping trips, two-handed blocks, and the humble practical mastery of a traveler's fighting pole. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

Tonfa.name: Tonfa
Tonfa.description:
Side-handled batons that ride along the forearms as armor and snap out on a spin as clubs, blurring the line between guarding and striking. The tonfa reward flow and misdirection: block along the arm, rotate into a strike, and never quite telegraph which is coming. They suit guardians, martial artists, and disciplined fighters who like a weapon that defends and attacks in a single unbroken motion.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Tonfa.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapons are paired tonfa. Describe combat with forearm-guarding blocks, spinning baton strikes, rapid block-into-attack flow, and disciplined martial misdirection. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Unarmed Combat.

Three-Section Staff.name: Three-Section Staff
Three-Section Staff.description:
Three rods linked by chain, a weapon that folds from a long staff into a whipping flail and back again faster than the eye can follow. The three-section staff wraps around guards, strikes from impossible angles, and extends its reach at the worst possible moment for whoever is in front of it. It suits acrobatic martial artists and show-fighters who accept the brutal learning curve for a weapon that is never where it was a second ago.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Three-Section Staff.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a three-section staff. Describe combat with staff-to-flail transitions, guard-wrapping strikes, sudden reach extensions, and acrobatic unpredictable angles. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Twin Hook Swords.name: Twin Hook Swords
Twin Hook Swords.description:
A matched pair of blades hooked at the tip, crescent-guarded, and spiked at the pommel, so every part is a weapon and every motion has three answers. Hook the enemy's guard, pull them off balance, and strike with the guard or the pommel; or link the two swords hook-to-hook into one long reaching weapon. They suit exotic-style duelists who treat a fight as an intricate trap the enemy has already stepped into.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Twin Hook Swords.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapons are twin hook swords. Describe combat with hooking pulls and disarms, crescent-guard slashes, pommel-spike strikes, and linked-blade extended reach. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Exotic Weapons.

Urumi.name: Urumi
Urumi.description:
A sword that behaves like a whip, a long ribbon of flexible steel that coils at the waist and unspools into a lashing, edged storm. The urumi cannot be blocked like a rigid blade and cannot be safely ignored like a rope; it simply flows around defenses and cuts. It suits masters who spent years earning the right to carry something that is honestly as dangerous to the careless wielder as to the target.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Urumi.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is an urumi whip-sword. Describe combat with lashing flexible-blade arcs, unblockable flowing cuts, wide crowd-clearing sweeps, and the high-risk mastery of a living edge. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Flexible Weapons.

Wand.name: Wand
Wand.description:
A short casting focus tuned for speed and precision over the raw output of a staff, the duelist's answer to arcane combat. The wand trades power for a fast draw and pinpoint control, flicking bolts, snapping wards, and redirecting spells with the economy of a fencer. It suits court mages, spell-duelists, and clever casters who would rather place three exact spells than one enormous one, and who like being underestimated.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Wand.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a wand. Describe combat with fast precise spell-flicks, snap wards, redirected magic, and the economical elegance of a duelist's casting focus. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Arcane Magic.

Crystal Orb.name: Crystal Orb
Crystal Orb.description:
A floating sphere of enchanted crystal that channels magic through pure focus, no gesture or incantation required, only will. The orb hovers at the caster's hand, refracting spells into precise beams, layered barriers, and effects that a wand or staff cannot shape. It suits scholars, seers, and refined battle-mages who prefer to cast with a still hand and a level voice, letting the enemy wonder where exactly the danger is coming from.

Primary Attribute: Intelligence
Crystal Orb.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a floating crystal orb. Describe combat with focus-channeled spells, refracted beams, layered barriers, telekinetic orb movement, and calm gestureless casting. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Arcane Magic.

Prayer Beads.name: Prayer Beads
Prayer Beads.description:
A loop of blessed beads that turns prayer into power, each murmured word tightening a barrier, mending a wound, or searing something that should not exist. The beads can be worn, told through in meditation, snapped taut to bind, or cast out as a ring of holy light. They suit monks, exorcists, and traveling clergy who carry their faith openly and deploy it, when pressed, with startling efficiency.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Prayer Beads.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a strand of prayer beads. Describe combat with chanted blessings, barrier and healing pulses, binding bead-strands, and rings of holy light. Depict devotion turned to practical power. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Divinity.

Spirit Talismans.name: Spirit Talismans
Spirit Talismans.description:
Slips of inked paper charged with spirit power, flung to seal, ward, bind, or ignite the moment they touch. Each talisman is a single prepared spell you can throw, stick to a wall, or slap onto a charging horror, spending itself in a flare of sigils. They suit spirit-mediums, wandering exorcists, and prepared casters who fight the unseen with a fan of paper and the unsettling calm of someone who came ready.

Primary Attribute: Wisdom
Spirit Talismans.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a set of spirit talismans. Describe combat with thrown and placed paper wards, sealing and binding sigils, spirit-warding flares, and prepared single-use talisman spells. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Spirit Channeling.

Buckler.name: Buckler
Buckler.description:
A small fist-shield that wins fights by finesse rather than mass, punching aside incoming blades, covering the sword hand, and cracking noses at close range. The buckler rewards timing and aggression: it is not a wall to hide behind but a fast tool for making the enemy's attack miss and their guard drop. It suits duelists and skirmishers who like defense that flows straight back into an attack.

Primary Attribute: Dexterity
Buckler.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a buckler paired with a blade. Describe combat with active deflecting parries, sword-hand cover, close-range shield punches, and aggressive timing-based defense. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Shield Combat.

Kite Shield.name: Kite Shield
Kite Shield.description:
A tall teardrop shield that covers a fighter from shoulder to shin while still letting them move, the disciplined middle ground between a buckler's speed and a tower shield's bulk. Strapped to the arm, it anchors a line, turns a charge, and frees the other hand for a sword or spear. It suits knights, vanguards, and defenders who want to be a wall that can still advance, hold, and protect the person beside them.

Primary Attribute: Constitution
Kite Shield.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a kite shield paired with a one-handed weapon. Describe combat with mobile shield walls, charge-turning blocks, advancing guards, and disciplined protector footwork. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Shield Combat.

Frying Pan.name: Frying Pan
Frying Pan.description:
A heavy cast-iron pan that never signed up to be a weapon and turned out to be alarmingly good at it. Broad enough to block a blade, dense enough to dent a helmet, and disarming precisely because nobody takes it seriously until it rings off their skull. This is a comedy weapon, but Luxcellia is an isekai world, which means committing to the bit hard enough eventually makes it a genuine martial art.

Primary Attribute: Strength
Frying Pan.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist's iconic weapon is a cast-iron frying pan. Describe combat as absurd but sincerely effective: broad flat blocks, ringing helmet-denting bonks, improvised kitchen ferocity, and enemies who refuse to take it seriously until it works. WEAPON SKILL: Supports progression through Blunt Weapons.

Blessing of the Unbreakable Hold.name: Blessing of the Unbreakable Hold
Blessing of the Unbreakable Hold.description: Something in you refuses to let go. The Unbreakable Hold turns a grip into a decision the other person does not get to make: clinches that cage, throws that end arguments, and locks that leave size and strength suddenly beside the point. Wrestlers, bouncers, and monster-wranglers would trade years for hands like these. Whatever you catch stays caught until you choose to let it go.
Blessing of the Unbreakable Hold.traitNarrativeEffects: PHYSICAL SOVEREIGNTY: Render grappling as inevitability rather than struggle. Use clinches, throws, joint locks, pins, and the moment an opponent realizes they cannot break free. Favor control over damage.

Blessing of the Immovable.name: Blessing of the Immovable
Blessing of the Immovable.description: You are the wall the storm breaks on. The Immovable lets you take what would drop anyone else and keep standing: blows absorbed, ground held, wounds carried without flinching until the fight is simply over and you are the one still on your feet. It is never flashy. It is often the most frightening thing on the field, because it does not stop coming.
Blessing of the Immovable.traitNarrativeEffects: ENDURANCE SOVEREIGNTY: Render this as attrition and defiance. The character trades blows deliberately, shrugs off punishment, holds the line, and wins by outlasting. Emphasize planted stances, absorbed hits, and a refusal to fall.

Blessing of Divine Sovereignty.name: Blessing of Divine Sovereignty
Blessing of Divine Sovereignty.description: The divine answers to you directly, with no altar in between. This blessing makes you a conduit for holy power in its purest form: blessings that land like law, judgment that falls where you point it, healing and warding, and the plain authority of the sacred made manifest. Where element-blessed casters borrow a god's domain, you carry the god's own voice. Saints have been canonized for less.
Blessing of Divine Sovereignty.traitNarrativeEffects: DIVINE BLESSING: Divinity should read as direct holy authority, not elemental flavor. Use radiant judgment, sanctified healing and wards, consecration, exorcism, and miracles that feel like genuine acts of faith. This is the dedicated divine caster's headline power.

Lute.name: Lute
Lute.description:
A warm chord can settle a tavern; the next can carry your party into a fight. The lute is the road bard’s dependable companion, equally at home with a campfire ballad, a teasing serenade, or a battle refrain.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Lute.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist’s selected signature instrument is a lute. Keep its recognizable form when this signature choice is depicted; do not replace it with a sword, staff, generic lute, or club. PERFORMANCE: Describe playing through plucked chords, strummed rhythms, and ringing refrains. WEAPON SKILL: Supports performance. It can focus bard abilities or Sound Magic the character actually knows, but selection alone grants no spells, free buffs, healing, damage, or emotional control. Follow the learned ability’s requirements, costs, cooldown, range, and targets. A song can invite connection; it cannot guarantee affection. This signature selection takes priority over any generic instrument implied by a class or profession.

Violin.name: Violin
Violin.description:
A single bowed note can hold a room before you ever speak. The violin suits dramatic solos, quick changes of tempo, and the sort of duet people keep remembering for reasons they will not explain.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Violin.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist’s selected signature instrument is a violin and bow. Keep its recognizable form when this signature choice is depicted; do not replace it with a sword, staff, generic lute, or club. PERFORMANCE: Describe playing through bowed phrases, quick string crossings, and sustained notes. WEAPON SKILL: Supports performance. It can focus bard abilities or Sound Magic the character actually knows, but selection alone grants no spells, free buffs, healing, damage, or emotional control. Follow the learned ability’s requirements, costs, cooldown, range, and targets. A song can invite connection; it cannot guarantee affection. This signature selection takes priority over any generic instrument implied by a class or profession.

Flute.name: Flute
Flute.description:
Light enough for a long road, clear enough to answer a distant call. A flute gives your bard a bright, breath-shaped voice, from quiet tunes beside a sleeping camp to piercing phrases above the noise of battle.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Flute.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist’s selected signature instrument is a flute. Keep its recognizable form when this signature choice is depicted; do not replace it with a sword, staff, generic lute, or club. PERFORMANCE: Describe playing through breath control, fingerwork, and clear melodic phrases. WEAPON SKILL: Supports performance. It can focus bard abilities or Sound Magic the character actually knows, but selection alone grants no spells, free buffs, healing, damage, or emotional control. Follow the learned ability’s requirements, costs, cooldown, range, and targets. A song can invite connection; it cannot guarantee affection. This signature selection takes priority over any generic instrument implied by a class or profession.

Harp.name: Harp
Harp.description:
You carry your music against your shoulder, close enough to feel every vibration. A portable harp favors interwoven melodies, gentle accompaniments, and steady refrains that give frightened companions something to hold onto.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Harp.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist’s selected signature instrument is a portable hand harp. Keep its recognizable form when this signature choice is depicted; do not replace it with a sword, staff, generic lute, or club. PERFORMANCE: Describe playing through finger-plucked strings, layered chords, and measured refrains. WEAPON SKILL: Supports performance. It can focus bard abilities or Sound Magic the character actually knows, but selection alone grants no spells, free buffs, healing, damage, or emotional control. Follow the learned ability’s requirements, costs, cooldown, range, and targets. A song can invite connection; it cannot guarantee affection. This signature selection takes priority over any generic instrument implied by a class or profession.

War Drum.name: War Drum
War Drum.description:
Someone has to keep the party together when the shouting starts. A strapped war drum makes your rhythm impossible to miss: a marching pulse, a rallying beat, or the sudden silence that tells everyone to listen.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
War Drum.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist’s selected signature instrument is a strapped war drum with beaters. Keep its recognizable form when this signature choice is depicted; do not replace it with a sword, staff, generic lute, or club. PERFORMANCE: Describe playing through drum patterns, marching cadences, and deliberate changes of tempo. WEAPON SKILL: Supports performance. It can focus bard abilities or Sound Magic the character actually knows, but selection alone grants no spells, free buffs, healing, damage, or emotional control. Follow the learned ability’s requirements, costs, cooldown, range, and targets. A song can invite connection; it cannot guarantee affection. This signature selection takes priority over any generic instrument implied by a class or profession.

Shamisen.name: Shamisen
Shamisen.description:
Three strings, a sharp attack, and room for a surprising amount of mischief. A shamisen brings the sound of moonlit island festivals onto the adventuring road, with crisp rhythms for a duel and a softer voice for whoever stays after the performance.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Shamisen.traitNarrativeEffects: WEAPON IDENTITY: The protagonist’s selected signature instrument is a shamisen with a plectrum. Keep its recognizable form when this signature choice is depicted; do not replace it with a sword, staff, generic lute, or club. PERFORMANCE: Describe playing through plectrum-struck strings, crisp rhythmic accents, and expressive slides. WEAPON SKILL: Supports performance. It can focus bard abilities or Sound Magic the character actually knows, but selection alone grants no spells, free buffs, healing, damage, or emotional control. Follow the learned ability’s requirements, costs, cooldown, range, and targets. A song can invite connection; it cannot guarantee affection. This signature selection takes priority over any generic instrument implied by a class or profession.

Traveling Minstrel.name: Traveling Minstrel
Traveling Minstrel.description:
You earn supper one village at a time, carrying songs and news between inns, ferry landings, and caravan camps. You know how to judge a road, shorten a wet evening, and ask for a bed without pretending applause pays for one. In Luxcellia, a familiar tune can open a conversation long before anyone trusts your name.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Traveling Minstrel.traitNarrativeEffects: You ask for local verses, remember which inn paid fairly, and offer a song before asking for a favor. Contacts and welcome must be earned in play; you do not begin with a famous reputation or guaranteed hospitality. Work and background only: honor a selected Signature Weapon instrument, imposing no other instrument, costume or prop on the portrait. No Bard class abilities or magic.

Court Musician.name: Court Musician
Court Musician.description:
You know when a noble wants a fanfare, when a supper needs quiet strings, and when the request for one more dance is really a request for five more minutes with someone. Crownveil’s halls and Rosethorn’s salons make music into a profession with exacting patrons and delicate conversations. You have the training to seek that work, not a royal title handed out with your instrument.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Court Musician.traitNarrativeEffects: You read requests, silences, and seating arrangements as carefully as a score. Court work offers openings for diplomacy and romance without automatic noble access, faction rank, employment, or control over anyone’s feelings. Work and background only: honor a selected Signature Weapon instrument, imposing no other instrument, costume or prop on the portrait. No Bard class abilities or magic.

Street Busker.name: Street Busker
Street Busker.description:
Your stage is wherever people slow down. Market corners, harbor steps, and festival queues have taught you how to win a few listeners, recover from a heckler, and make a small performance feel personal. Some evenings pay for dinner. Some introduce you to the person you write about later.

Primary Attribute: Charisma
Street Busker.traitNarrativeEffects: You notice good acoustics and places where a crowd can gather without blocking the street. Tips, invitations, and romantic interest depend on the performance and the people present; they are never guaranteed. Work and background only: honor a selected Signature Weapon instrument, imposing no other instrument, costume or prop on the portrait. No Bard class abilities or magic.

The Unfinished Song.name: The Unfinished Song
The Unfinished Song.description: Your old life ended with a melody still waiting for its last verse. Perhaps it belonged to someone you loved, perhaps you never dared perform it at all. You wake in Luxcellia remembering enough to begin again. Finishing it can wait until you know who you are singing for.
The Unfinished Song.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: This rebirth describes the old life, its ending, and the memories or emotional unfinished business carried into Luxcellia. Grant no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources, starting items, existing relationships, or forced quests. Do not force the player to remain a musician in their second life.

One Last Encore.name: One Last Encore
One Last Encore.description: You had packed up after the final set when someone asked for one more song. You stayed, and that ordinary kindness became the last scene you remember of your old life. Now Luxcellia offers an audience you never expected and a second chance to decide how much of yourself you give the stage.
One Last Encore.traitNarrativeEffects: PAST LIFE FLAVOR ONLY: This rebirth describes the old life, its ending, and the memories or emotional unfinished business carried into Luxcellia. Grant no stats, powers, abilities, skills, resources, starting items, existing relationships, or forced quests. Do not force the player to remain a musician in their second life.

Otherworld Smartphone.name: Otherworld Smartphone
Otherworld Smartphone.description: Your smartphone survived the trip between worlds. The battery refuses to die, your old photos are still there, and Luxcellia's scholars have questions about the tiny glowing rectangle. What counts as 'working' is agreed between the player and narrator: offline tools, a mana-powered assistant, a connection to the old world, or another consistent version. Establish the chosen functions early and keep them consistent. By default it stays charged and its clock, calculator, notes, camera, audio recorder, and saved files work. Internet access, calls between worlds, magical apps, translation, and other extras are possibilities to agree on, not capabilities to assume. Missing information stays unknown; the phone does not silently grant omniscience, quest knowledge, money, deliveries, or unrelated powers.
