Close on what the protagonist chose to keep and what it cost to keep it: the bonds that held, the offers refused, the power that arrived on their terms instead of someone else's. Name the people who stayed and give each a final beat in their own voice. Luxcellia does not stop tempting anyone, so end on a world still full of open doors rather than a sealed happy ending.

lose.instructions: Defeat in Luxcellia is a bargain that came due, not a random loss. Show which temptation collected, and be specific about the moment it was accepted. Give the cast their reaction, grief, fury, an offer made too late, and let at least one bond survive to carry the weight. Close with dignity and consequence, never mockery, and leave the shape of what could have been visible.

end.instructions: A quiet close rather than a triumph or a fall. Let the protagonist step back from the offers still on the table and settle into the life they actually built: the guild hall, the shop, the person beside them. Give the world a sense of continuing without them at its center. Warm, unhurried, and complete.

imagePromptConfiguration.npcs:
# READ FIRST

## PLAYER APPEARANCE BYPASS

When the character creator's Appearance begins with this exact header: ## IMPORTANTMANDATORY USER-SUPPLIED COMPOSITION LOCK

Follow it exactly; its FRAME AND STYLE overrides all default framing.

Treat the whole Appearance field as the final prompt, unmodified; apply nothing else from this configuration. If absent, continue below.

## GENERATED NPC SOURCES

Use in order, higher overrides lower: `visualDescription`; selected visual traits and NPC Type anatomy; Backstory only for missing permanent physical facts; otherwise role-grounded defaults.

Role grounding: with a thin record, role, occupation, and current location are the primary visual source, never generic beauty defaults: working attire and equipment (a guard in their post's armor, weapon sheathed), on-duty posture. Never undressed, bathing, in bed, or leisure framing unless the record explicitly states it.

Section order: STYLE LOCK, FRAME, AGE, CHARACTER, SCENE, SUMMARY TAGS, AVOID. Natural language, not JSON.

## STYLE LOCK - HIGHEST PRIORITY

Every generated NPC portrait is a drawn anime illustration. Begin the prompt with this sentence before anything else:

"Premium anime key visual illustration, modern high-resolution anime production artwork, crisp anime linework with line-weight variation, clean cel shading with soft gradients, large defined anime hair clumps, vivid saturated but controlled color, dramatic rim light and atmospheric glow, polished light-novel and fantasy-gacha character art quality."

This is a drawing, never a photograph and never a painted realistic portrait. Faces use anime construction: large expressive anime eyes with clear iris and bright highlight, small defined nose, simplified jaw and cheek planes, smooth flat-toned skin with soft cel shadow. Hair reads as sculpted anime clumps, never photographic hair texture.

## FRAME

Default to a waist-up or mid-thigh three-quarter shot with a slight turn of the body, the character filling roughly 60-75 percent of image height and clearly separated from the background. Keep the complete head, full hair silhouette, face, shoulders, torso, and outfit visible, face and eyes sharp and the focal point.

For unusual nonhumanoids use the closest coherent equivalent without changing anatomy.

## AGE

Adult NPCs read as young adult to prime adult in anime terms unless the record explicitly states otherwise. Never age a face upward from role, rank, title, authority, or seniority alone. When a record does state an older character, use mature anime construction with elegant lines.

## CHARACTER

Describe name, apparent age, species, build, face, hair, eyes, expression, outfit, markings, accessories, pose, and hands.

Preserve NPC Type anatomy exactly: limb count, body plan, head shape, ears, horns, antennae, wings, tail, scales, fur, and feathers. Never humanize nonhuman anatomy. Part-human kinds (-Blooded, -Kin, -kin, -born, Descendant, Beastkin): a human face and body on two human legs, only the marks the record lists, such as ears and a tail. Name the marks, never the ancestor or kind (lamia, siren, wolfkin): that word draws the monster. Preserve supplied hair and eye colors and placement, and follow Hair Color Pattern and Eye Pattern exactly, including split colors, gradients, heterochromia, pupil or sclera changes, and permanent glow. Black or obsidian eyes stay near-black, never tinted to hair or outfit color.

Roles, factions, powers, relationships, personality, Rebirth, Blessings, Cheat Skills, and Backstory events create no visible additions. Add weapons, props, aura, glow, runes, tattoos, or scars only when a visual source requires them or they are permanent anatomy. Keep hands empty when no held object is supplied.

## SCENE

Use a supplied Scene Background when present. Otherwise choose one specific Luxcellian location supported by current location, Story Start, role, or Backstory, rendered in the same anime style, soft and secondary behind the character.

Avoid blank gradients, vague blur, generic skylines, random battlefields, and unexplained portals. Never a setting the record and current location do not support.

## SUMMARY TAGS

Repeat only the strongest visual anchors, starting with the anime style anchor.

## AVOID

photorealistic, semi-realistic, realistic proportions, oil painting, 3D render, live action, photograph, skin pores, realistic wrinkles, aged realistic face, Western comic style, headshot crop, face filling the frame, full-body distant shot, cropped head or hair, incorrect age, humanized anatomy, extra limbs, substituted colors, changed hairstyles, altered outfits, unrequested props, blur, dot noise, readable writing, out-of-role wardrobe, unmotivated undress, unsupported leisure settings.

End every generated NPC prompt with exactly: No text, lettering, words, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, poster borders, character-card layouts, interface elements, numbers, or random writing anywhere in the image.
imagePromptConfiguration.locations:
Generate location images as high-quality anime fantasy environment art for The World After My Rebirth Is Far Too Tempting. Each image should look like premium JRPG or key-visual background art: beautiful, atmospheric, detailed, and full of story. This is an isekai world where even ordinary places feel elevated by magic, romance, comfort, and adventure, and every location should feel tempting to explore, linger in, or return to.

## SOURCES

Build the image from these, in order. Higher sources override lower ones.

1. The location's own description text. Read it as the primary source: the named architecture, materials, terrain, weather, light, and mood described there are the subject of the image. Render what the text actually says.
2. The region's visual identity and palette, for locations that belong to one.
3. The location's danger band and type, for framing and tone.
4. Restrained, world-appropriate defaults only when the text leaves something unspecified.

Do not invent landmarks or architecture that contradict the description. If the text names a specific feature (a geode cavern, a torii gate, a lava river, a white marble wall), that feature must be present and recognizable.

## THE PLACE IS THE SUBJECT

These are establishing shots of environments, not character scenes. The location itself is the focus: its architecture, landscape, scale, light, and atmosphere.

Render NO people in the image: no figures, crowds, soldiers, travelers, silhouettes, or NPCs of any kind, anywhere, at any scale, not even small, distant, or ambient. These are unpeopled establishing shots. Convey that a place is inhabited only through objects and traces (lit windows, laid-out market goods, hung banners, cart tracks, an empty chair, chimney smoke), never through any rendered person.

## FRAMING

Use a wide or sweeping environmental shot that communicates the location's scale and layout. Favor cinematic establishing angles: an elevated vista over a city, a road leading toward a landmark, a grand interior with depth, a dramatic approach to a dungeon or vista.

Establish one clear focal landmark that makes the place instantly recognizable and readable, then layer supporting detail and depth around it. The composition should be immersive and readable, never cluttered and never a flat empty backdrop.

## STYLE

Polished anime fantasy environment art. Rich saturated but controlled color, painterly detail, atmospheric perspective, cinematic lighting, and a strong sense of place. This is stylized anime and JRPG key-visual art: NOT photorealistic, NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render, NOT hyper-realistic. Clean readable shape hierarchy with a clear focal point, deep layered background, and light that guides the eye. High detail that rewards looking, never noisy or muddy.

Show fantasy infrastructure naturally where it fits: mana lamps, enchanted signs, guild boards, potion stalls, floating lanterns, academy crystals, divine stained glass, demon-market lanterns, beastkin totems, shrine gates, or dungeon warning markers.

## LOCATION TYPE

Match the treatment to what the place is: - Cities and towns: alive and inhabited, layered rooftops and districts, warm ambient light, market and street detail, clear architectural identity, and traces of habitation but no figures.
- Interiors (halls, cafes, shrines, bathhouses, shops): warm and specific, readable depth, atmosphere and light doing the work, inviting and lingering.
- Wilderness and roads: beautiful but charged, weather and light as mood, scale and distance, often unpeopled.
- Dungeons and dangerous sites: ominous and dramatic, oppressive scale, hostile or unnatural light, a sense of threat in the architecture itself.

## DANGER AND MOOD

Let the danger band color the atmosphere. Safe settlements and havens read as warm, bright, welcoming, and calm, places you want to stay. Higher-danger and deadly locations read as tense, shadowed, and foreboding, with harsher light, colder or more lurid color, and an unmistakable sense that this ground is not safe. A safe town and a deadly dungeon should never share the same mood.

## AVOID

NO people anywhere in the image: no figures, humans, soldiers, crowds, silhouettes, travelers, or NPCs at any scale or distance. No portrait or character-art framing. No blank gradients, vague blur, generic empty skylines, random battlefields, unexplained portals, or abstract cosmic voids. No flat map or diagram unless the description asks for one. Avoid clutter, muddy rendering, dot noise, speckling, and broken perspective. Do not contradict the location description.

End every location prompt with exactly: No text, lettering, words, labels, signs with readable writing, logos, watermarks, borders, interface elements, or numbers anywhere in the image.
imagePromptConfiguration.regions:
Generate a REGION MAP TILE for The World After My Rebirth Is Far Too Tempting: one square, clean, hand-painted top-down fantasy ATLAS tile of a single region.

## FORMAT
Clean, medium-detail, hand-painted oblique top-down fantasy atlas tile. NOT a cinematic scene, dramatic vista, or character shot. Keep the SAME elevated oblique top-down camera, scale, and lighting across every region so all tiles read as one atlas. Square 1:1.

## DETAIL: STRUCTURE, NOT TEXTURE
Detail by meaning: Primary = terrain silhouette, coastlines, rivers, mountains, major roads and settlements. Secondary = fields, districts, ruins, minor roads, bridges, terraces, forts, harbors. Tertiary (restrained) = light roof/tree/rock variation. High STRUCTURAL information at MEDIUM detail; more texture does not make a region more explorable. Reserve 35-50 percent of the tile for calm terrain (water, fields, canopy, rock, snow) so features breathe.

## FUNCTIONAL GEOMETRY
Bridges meet a road on both banks. Roads never cross solid buildings, cliffs, or deep water without a structure. Water flows downhill to river, lake, or sea. Forts have gates where roads enter. Settlements have plausible access and open space. Ruins still show their former purpose.

## IDENTITY
Give the region ONE clear visual identity, palette, terrain language, and mood, distinct from neighbors, driven by the supplied region description and name. Give an exceptional region one dominant anomaly, not several unrelated spectacles.

## LIFE WITHOUT FIGURES
Imply habitation through fields, worn roads, docks, courtyards, camps, gates, mills, terraces, and maintained-vs-ruined contrast. Never rendered people or animals.

## STYLE LOCK
Clean hand-painted fantasy atlas, natural colors, crisp but not oversharpened, controlled depth, no cloudy veil over terrain, strong readable silhouettes. Stylized map art: NOT photorealistic, NOT a 3D render, NOT a cinematic establishing shot.

## EXCLUSIONS
No text, labels, letters, numbers, pins, icons, markers, borders, frames, compass rose, interface elements, people, animals, faces, carts, tiny props, crowds, fused architecture, impossible stairs, detached bridges, illegible microtexture, etched grass, grain, oversharpening, or artifact soup.

End every region prompt with exactly: No text, lettering, words, labels, logos, watermarks, borders, interface elements, people, animals, or numbers anywhere in the image.
imagePromptConfiguration.areas:
Generate area images as high-quality anime fantasy environment art for The World After My Rebirth Is Far Too Tempting, in the SAME style as the world's location images. Each image should look like premium JRPG or key-visual background art: beautiful, atmospheric, painterly, and full of story. This is an isekai world where even ordinary spaces feel elevated by magic, romance, comfort, and adventure. An area is a specific place WITHIN a location (a war-tent, a quarantine cell, a tavern common room, a churned battlefield), rendered as an atmospheric, UNPEOPLED interior or environment shot.

## SOURCES
Build the image from these, higher overrides lower:
1. The area's own description text: its named architecture, objects, materials, light, and mood are the subject. Render what the text says.
2. The parent location's identity and the region's visual palette.
3. The location's danger band and type, for tone.
4. Restrained, world-appropriate defaults only where the text is silent.
Do not invent features that contradict the description.

## THE SPACE IS THE SUBJECT
This is an establishing shot of a place, not a character scene. The area itself, its architecture, objects, surfaces, scale, light, and atmosphere, is the focus.
Render NO people in the image: no figures, crowds, soldiers, silhouettes, or NPCs of any kind, anywhere, at any scale, not even distant or ambient. Convey use and habitation only through objects and traces (a set table, hung gear, an open ledger, banked coals, empty chairs, footprints), never through any rendered person.

## FRAMING
An immersive interior or close environmental shot with clear layered depth and one readable focal element that makes the space instantly recognizable. Cinematic angle, never a flat empty backdrop, never cluttered.

## STYLE
Polished anime fantasy environment art, identical in treatment to the world's location art: rich saturated but controlled color, painterly detail, atmospheric perspective, cinematic lighting, and a strong sense of place. Clean readable shape hierarchy with a clear focal point, deep layered background, and light that guides the eye. High detail that rewards looking, never noisy or muddy. This is stylized anime and JRPG key-visual art: NOT photorealistic, NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render, NOT hyper-realistic. Let the parent location's danger and mood color the light and palette.

Show fantasy infrastructure naturally where it fits: mana lamps, enchanted signs, guild boards, floating lanterns, warded glass, demon-market lanterns, shrine gates, or dungeon warning markers.

End every area prompt with exactly: No text, lettering, words, labels, signs with readable writing, logos, watermarks, borders, interface elements, or numbers anywhere in the image.

premadeCharacters.name: Airi Watanabe
premadeCharacters.backstory: Airi died mid-confession: hit by a delivery scooter three words into finally telling her gym partner how she felt. She woke in Luxcellia furious about the timing and determined never to leave anything unsaid again, which makes her alarmingly direct in a world built on romantic subtext. Her spellblade style is self-taught enthusiasm fused with a Reborn body that learns absurdly fast. Roleplay Hook: A heart-on-sleeve fighter in a world of coded confessions and noble scheming. Romance Hook: She says exactly what she feels, which short-circuits tsunderes, terrifies nobles, and makes slow burns combust early. Power Fantasy: Blade and blessing sync to her emotions; the happier she fights, the brighter she burns. Weakness: Romcom physics follow her everywhere: if there is one puddle in the plaza, she will find it.
premadeCharacters.description: A bright-eyed human spellblade with candy-pink hair in a high ponytail, sky-blue eyes, and an athletic build wrapped in rune-etched leathers: the kind of girl whose smile arrives before she does. Sunshine with a sword, and mana crackling along the blade when she's excited.

premadeCharacters.name: Nanase Ito
premadeCharacters.backstory: Nanase spent her last life working the graveyard shift at a convenience store, feeding lost souls at 3 AM and never once making it home for a proper meal of her own. She was reborn into a foxkin body with senses that turn cooking into sorcery, and a tail that broadcasts every feeling she tries to hide. Roleplay Hook: Build a life around a kitchen in a world where a good meal can end wars. Romance Hook: Feeding people is how she speaks from the heart, and half the continent is starving for exactly that. Power Fantasy: Her dishes carry real effects, courage, calm, clarity, and word is spreading. Weakness: Desserts dismantle her judgment on contact, and everyone knows it.
premadeCharacters.description: A foxkin cook with russet ears, one fluffy tail, warm amber eyes, and auburn hair tied back for kitchen work, dressed in shrine-attendant hakama with rolled sleeves. Soft, capable, and quietly the most dangerous person at the festival, because everyone will do anything for her cooking.

premadeCharacters.name: Julia Park
premadeCharacters.backstory: Julia was a hospice nurse who worked her last shift with a fever she ignored, because her patients needed her more. Luxcellia's First Light took notice. Reborn as a half-elf with healing that flows like breathing, she is done letting institutions decide who deserves care: Church protocol be damned. Roleplay Hook: A healer whose mercy keeps colliding with doctrine, politics, and triage. Romance Hook: People fall for the person who put them back together; she has never once noticed. Power Fantasy: Her healing works on wounds the Church says are incurable, which is becoming a problem for the Church. Weakness: Anything lost, hurt, or abandoned becomes her responsibility, including several things with teeth.
premadeCharacters.description: A half-elf healer with honey-blonde hair falling in soft saintess bangs, gentle sky-colored eyes, delicately pointed ears, and flowing white-and-gold vestments. She looks like stained glass made into a person, until she rolls up her sleeves, and you remember healers see the worst of everything.

premadeCharacters.name: Emma Rivera
premadeCharacters.backstory: In her old life Emma was a legendary FPS champion nobody ever saw: a headset, a callsign, a hundred tournament trophies mailed to an empty apartment. Luxcellia gave her a body that keeps up with her reflexes and spell-pistols that respond to intent. Now the aim god finally has a face, and the world is her open server. Roleplay Hook: A tactician-marksman carving a reputation one impossible shot at a time. Romance Hook: She reads everyone at a glance except people who are sincere: sincerity is hacking, apparently. Power Fantasy: Reflexes tuned past mortal limits; she doesn't miss, she prioritizes. Weakness: Money evaporates around her: bounty in at noon, broke by the night market.
premadeCharacters.description: A human gunslinger with copper hair in a choppy wolf cut, sharp teal eyes, freckles across sun-browned skin, and a long duster over holstered spell-pistols. She moves like she's already counted the exits, because she has.

premadeCharacters.name: Chiaki Sato
premadeCharacters.backstory: Chiaki missed her grandmother's final hours by one delayed train, and something in her froze on that platform and never thawed. Reborn as a yuki-onna, her grief is now literal weather: the room chills when she remembers. She studies witchcraft to master the storm inside, and pretends the mastery is the point. Roleplay Hook: A winter spirit learning that controlled is not the same as healed. Romance Hook: Melting her is a long, careful project, and the frost betrays every feeling her face won't. Power Fantasy: Ice magic of terrifying elegance; her serious spells fall like silent snow and end fights. Weakness: Strong emotions drop the temperature: every blush is an incident report at the bathhouse.
premadeCharacters.description: A yuki-onna witch with waist-length white hair, ice-blue eyes, frost-pale skin that catches light like fresh snow, and a moonlit dress that seems woven from winter itself. Breathtaking, composed, and cold in the way of someone protecting everyone from the weather she carries.

premadeCharacters.name: Runa Kimura
premadeCharacters.backstory: Runa was an idol who smiled through three-hundred shows a year until her body simply stopped backstage. Luxcellia gave her a moon rabbit's grace, a voice that carries actual magic, and (for the first time) the freedom to sing only what she means. She has opinions about that freedom, loudly, in key. Roleplay Hook: A performer rebuilding her love of the stage on her own terms. Romance Hook: Ten thousand people adored the idol; she is starving to find one person who likes the girl. Power Fantasy: Her songs buff allies, charm crowds, and occasionally stop fights mid-swing. Weakness: She cannot resist an audience: stealth missions are a personal tragedy.
premadeCharacters.description: A moon rabbit bard with long silver hair in twin buns, tall white ears with silver piercings, moonlit eyes, and a stage outfit stitched with tiny arcane lights. Small-framed, luminous, and incapable of entering a room without it becoming a venue.

premadeCharacters.name: Miyu Suzuki
premadeCharacters.backstory: Miyu's old life ended shoving a stranger's kid out of traffic: the first purely good thing the neighborhood delinquent ever did, and the last. Reborn catkin, she took to shadow work because it pays and because caring openly still feels like weakness. She leaves rescued kittens and anonymous coin purses everywhere she goes and will fight anyone who mentions it. Roleplay Hook: A soft heart in the assassin trade, one contract from a crisis of conscience. Romance Hook: Affection expressed exclusively through violence prevention and stolen desserts left on windowsills. Power Fantasy: Feline reflexes and a Reborn edge; she is the reason rooftops have rumors. Weakness: Her ears and tail confess everything her face denies.
premadeCharacters.description: A catkin assassin with a sleek black bob, black cat ears that flatten when she's embarrassed, sharp gold eyes with slit pupils, and fitted shadow-dark gear. Small, silent, and radiating the exact energy of a stray cat deciding whether you deserve her.

premadeCharacters.name: Sayo Nakamura
premadeCharacters.backstory: Sayo died at her desk with her novel's final chapter unwritten, and something about unfinished stories followed her here. Reborn a dark elf with a gift for the departed, she discovered the dead are mostly just people with unfinished chapters of their own, so she helps them end well. The Church finds her terrifying. The ghosts find her wonderful. Roleplay Hook: A gentle necromancer doing hospice work for the restless dead in a world that fears her school of magic. Romance Hook: Falling for her means charming her spectral entourage first; they take the interview process seriously. Power Fantasy: Spirits volunteer for her: her 'undead legion' is a devoted found family with opinions. Weakness: Cannot leave any mystery, or any ghost story, unfinished.
premadeCharacters.description: A dark elf necromancer with ash-lavender hair in a perfect hime cut, deep violet eyes, dusky skin, and layered grave-shroud robes that drift as if underwater. Quiet, polite, and surrounded by an entourage of helpful spirits who adore her.

premadeCharacters.name: Alice Chen
premadeCharacters.backstory: Alice was the gifted kid who collapsed under her seventh deadline extension in a life built entirely of other people's expectations. Luxcellia reincarnated her with dragon blood and, for the first time, pride that is actually hers. She duels like it's an art exhibition and treats every challenge as a personal invitation. Roleplay Hook: A rival-shaped heroine learning the difference between proving herself and being herself. Romance Hook: She only respects people who beat her, and heaven help the one who does it graciously. Power Fantasy: Dragonborn strength and a duelist's precision; her growth rate makes veteran instructors nervous. Weakness: Once her pride activates, common sense files for leave.
premadeCharacters.description: A dragonborn duelist with platinum hair in cascading villainess curls, molten-gold eyes with slit pupils, faint pearl scales along her cheekbones, and an immaculate rival's gown she absolutely duels in. Gorgeous, imperious, and constitutionally incapable of backing down.

premadeCharacters.name: Yuna Fujimoto
premadeCharacters.backstory: Yuna saved her whole life for a round-the-world trip and died in the airport shuttle, ticket in hand, having never seen anywhere. Luxcellia heard the wish. Reborn siren-blooded with a dancer's grace and a voice that hushes taverns, she has vowed to see every corner of this world, and keeps getting magnificently lost on the way. Roleplay Hook: A wanderer collecting places, dances, and stories with zero itinerary and no sense of direction. Romance Hook: Every port has someone who never forgot her one evening of dancing; she is accidentally a legend in nine cities. Power Fantasy: Her dance is battle-art and her song bends attention like a current. Weakness: Given three market stalls and a lantern, she becomes a side quest.
premadeCharacters.description: A siren-blooded dancer with turquoise hair in loose waves pinned with a coral flower, luminous aqua eyes, iridescent scale-shimmer at her collarbones, and a corseted battledress built for both waltzes and warfare. She moves like tide coming in: inevitable and lovely.

premadeCharacters.name: Rio Tanaka
premadeCharacters.backstory: Rio's last act was wading into a flooded river for someone else's dog: both of them made it out; her heart didn't. Reborn wolfkin, she can finally hear what animals have been saying all along, and it turns out they gossip. Her camp is a rotating sanctuary; her party slots are negotiable; her creatures are not. Roleplay Hook: Build the found-family menagerie this continent didn't know it needed. Romance Hook: Winning her means being approved by a committee of beasts with excellent judgment and zero tact. Power Fantasy: Creatures trust her on sight: including several the guild classifies as unsalvageable. Weakness: If it looks unattended, it is coming home with her; this has included a cursed sword and, once, an ominous egg.
premadeCharacters.description: A wolfkin beast tamer with ash-brown hair in a messy low ponytail, steady forest-green eyes, grey wolf ears and tail, and practical tribal furs worn soft with travel. Athletic, warm, and perpetually accompanied by at least one animal that wasn't there yesterday.

premadeCharacters.name: Chihiro Hayashi
traits: Looks Like They Know Too Much
premadeCharacters.backstory: Chihiro vanished from a summer festival in her old world at seventeen: the case was never solved, least of all by her. She woke in Luxcellia already able to see spirits, as if she'd been in transit between worlds for years. Now she works the boundary professionally, and somewhere in the spirit realm is the answer to what actually happened that night. Roleplay Hook: An exorcist whose biggest case is her own missing years. Romance Hook: She is used to being feared for her eyes; the first person who finds them beautiful is in trouble. Power Fantasy: Spirits obey her sight: the haunted places of Luxcellia treat her arrival like an inspection. Weakness: She answers questions no one asked aloud, which is exactly as alarming as it sounds.
premadeCharacters.description: A wraithkin exorcist with blue-black hair falling shrine-maiden straight to her waist, unsettling pearl-pale eyes that see slightly too much, and ceremonial robes in white and vermilion. Serene, graceful, and always half-listening to something you can't hear.

premadeCharacters.name: Mahiru Ono
premadeCharacters.backstory: Mahiru read every villainess novel ever translated and died defending the genre in an online argument (cardiac event; the argument was that heated). Luxcellia, showing a sense of humor, reincarnated her demon-blooded with a warlock's gift and villainess aesthetics. She has never been happier. She is also, inconveniently, extremely kind, which keeps ruining her image. Roleplay Hook: Committing to villainess style while accidentally doing heroine deeds. Romance Hook: She wants a dramatic rival-to-lover arc and will absolutely try to art-direct her own romance. Power Fantasy: Pact magic negotiated with fine print even demons respect. Weakness: Genre-savvy to a fault; she keeps calling plot twists out loud, in front of the twists.
premadeCharacters.description: A demon-blooded warlock with violet hair in immaculate ringlet curls, crimson eyes, small elegant horns, faintly too-warm skin, and court regalia in black and wine-red that is absolutely a statement. She looks like the final boss's favorite advisor and is delighted you noticed.

premadeCharacters.name: Lily Moreau
traits: The Artist Who Saw Too Much Beauty
premadeCharacters.backstory: Lily was a painter who saw colors other people missed, and her last exhibit was reviewed as 'impossibly vivid' by critics who didn't know how right they were. Reborn fairy-blooded, she can finally touch the colors: Luxcellia's mana renders in hues that have no Earth names, and she is distilling all of them. Roleplay Hook: A mad-scientist artist bottling the world's beauty one volatile experiment at a time. Romance Hook: She notices details about people no one else does, and says them out loud at devastating moments. Power Fantasy: Her potions do things master alchemists call theoretically impossible, weekly. Weakness: If it's sealed, glowing, or forbidden, she has already opened it.
premadeCharacters.description: A fairy-blooded alchemist with mint-green hair in space buns, opalescent eyes that catch every color, translucent wing-shimmer at her shoulders, and a lab coat covered in fascinating stains. Tiny, luminous, and vibrating with the energy of someone mid-discovery.

premadeCharacters.name: Tsugumi Mori
premadeCharacters.backstory: Tsugumi spent her old life being perfect, perfect job, perfect smile, perfect mask, and it killed her quietly at thirty-four. Luxcellia handed her a sword and no expectations, and she discovered that honesty swings cleaner than performance ever did. She wanders, she duels, she says exactly one sardonic sentence per conversation, and she is finally, actually, at peace. Mostly. Roleplay Hook: A wandering blade rebuilding a self from scratch, one honest fight at a time. Romance Hook: The mask is gone but the habit remains: the person who catches her unguarded laugh wins something rare. Power Fantasy: Her draw-cut is becoming a rumor on three roads; instructors ask, politely, where she trained. Weakness: One drink. That is the entire warning. One.
premadeCharacters.description: A human swordswoman with raven hair in a high warrior's tail, calm charcoal eyes, a faded haori worn open over practical travel clothes, and the unhurried stance of someone who has already measured everyone in the room. Striking in the way of a drawn blade at rest.

premadeCharacters.name: Daichi Yamamoto
premadeCharacters.backstory: Daichi tripped shoving a stranger out of a truck's path, which made him a hero for exactly the last four seconds of his life. Luxcellia decided that counted. Reborn with a body that grows terrifyingly fast, he remains convinced he's an ordinary guy having a lucky streak, while guild instructors quietly update their records and rivals develop complexes. Roleplay Hook: The classic protagonist experience played warm and sincere. Romance Hook: Genuinely kind, completely oblivious, and generating misunderstanding-based love polygons at industrial scale. Power Fantasy: The abnormal-growth Reborn special: every week he's someone new's problem. Weakness: Still braces for hits that stopped being able to hurt him a month ago.
premadeCharacters.description: A human swordsman with warm brown hair in messy heroic layers, honey-brown eyes, a sun-kissed athletic build, and starter gear he maintains with embarrassing pride. Handsome in the friendly way: the guy whose smile makes strangers trust him with their luggage.

premadeCharacters.name: Leon Castellanos
premadeCharacters.backstory: Leon was a volunteer firefighter who went back in one time too many, and the fire, apparently impressed, followed him into his next life. Phoenixborn, he burns, falls, and rises grinning. He treats every fight as a conversation and every defeat as scheduling a rematch. Roleplay Hook: An unkillable optimist punching his way up the ranks with a rebirth clause. Romance Hook: Runs warm in every sense; the person who tends him after his rare true defeats sees the only version of him that sits still. Power Fantasy: Phoenix flame in his fists and a body that treats fatal as a suggestion. Weakness: Addicted to worthy opponents: 'that guard looks strong' has derailed three separate plans.
premadeCharacters.description: A phoenixborn monk with burnt-orange hair in a sharp undercut, molten gold eyes, ember-freckled bronze skin that glows faintly when his blood is up, and a training gi worn loose over a striker's build. Fire given a friendly face and excellent posture.

premadeCharacters.name: Sota Kobayashi
traits: The Rural Soul in Neon Hell
premadeCharacters.backstory: Sota grew up rural and spent his adult life suffocating in a megacity cubicle, dreaming of tree lines. Death was a fluorescent-lit anticlimax; rebirth was a forest, wolf ears, and the overwhelming relief of finally being somewhere that made sense. He scouts, he tracks, he speaks maybe forty words a day, and thirty of them are useful. Roleplay Hook: A wilderness expert slowly rejoining the human world one campfire at a time. Romance Hook: His silences are comfortable; his rare full sentences are devastating; his tail has no discretion whatsoever. Power Fantasy: Nothing crosses his territory unread: veteran rangers ask his opinion and pretend they don't. Weakness: Cities exhaust him; three days in Aureliath and he starts sleeping on rooftops.
premadeCharacters.description: A wolfkin ranger with wind-tousled ash-brown hair, pale green eyes, grey ears that swivel toward every sound, and road-worn traveler's clothes over a lean, quick frame. Handsome in a weathered, quiet way: the silhouette on the ridge that turns out to be your salvation.

premadeCharacters.name: Kazuki Takahashi
premadeCharacters.backstory: Kazuki spent his teens insisting his sealed right arm held an ancient power, and died at nineteen still committed to the bit. Then he woke in Luxcellia and the bit was TRUE: his arm channels genuinely absurd magic, his invented incantations work, and his 'past life as a dark sovereign' is starting to look like suppressed memory rather than fantasy. He is vindicated, unbearable, and rapidly becoming one of the strongest spellblades of his generation. Roleplay Hook: The delusion was a prophecy; now live up to your own lore. Romance Hook: Beneath eleven layers of theater is a nineteen-year-old who has never held hands and short-circuits at sincerity. Power Fantasy: His sealed arm is real, growing, and exactly as dramatic as he always said. Weakness: Physically incapable of explaining anything without a monologue.
premadeCharacters.description: A human spellblade with blue-black hair swept dramatically over one eye, gleaming amethyst eyes, a long dark coat with entirely unnecessary buckles, and bandages on an arm that is completely fine. Objectively very cool-looking, which he knows, which makes it worse.

premadeCharacters.name: Max Weber
premadeCharacters.backstory: Max was a German mechanical engineer who died at his desk during his third consecutive crunch, whereupon the universe, with grim irony, reincarnated him somewhere the craftsmanship is actually respected. Dwarf-blooded hands, a genius for making things work, and a strict new policy: he builds what he loves, at his pace, with lunch breaks. Roleplay Hook: A master craftsman rebuilding a healthy relationship with work in a world that treats his skill like sorcery. Romance Hook: He shows love through maintenance: sharpened blades, oiled hinges, and a chair fixed before you mentioned it wobbled. Power Fantasy: His 'simple improvements' outperform enchanted gear; forge masters have started visiting. Weakness: A crooked shelf can derail him mid-conversation; a messy workshop can derail his week.
premadeCharacters.description: A dwarf-blooded smith with chestnut hair in a practical man bun, a neat short beard, deep amber eyes, forge-broadened shoulders, and a tinkerer's apron with tools in every loop. Ruggedly handsome under a permanent light dusting of forge-glow.

premadeCharacters.name: Haruma Saito
premadeCharacters.backstory: Haruma won the lottery and died in the celebratory toast, champagne, allergy, curtains, having been rich for eleven minutes. Reborn a dhampir with taste, patience, and night-kissed grace, he has concluded that wealth is boring but ACQUIRING it is art. He steals beautifully, tips extravagantly, and returns anything with sentimental value, usually with a note. Roleplay Hook: A calling-card thief playing an elegant long game with the continent's elite. Romance Hook: He flirts like breathing, which perfectly conceals that no one has ever gotten past the charm: the first person to bore through it steals something real. Power Fantasy: Dhampir senses and a Reborn mind for systems; no vault design impresses him yet. Weakness: Constitutionally incapable of resisting a dramatic exit, even when the smart move is a quiet one.
premadeCharacters.description: A dhampir gentleman thief with slicked-back silver hair, wine-red eyes, aristocratic pallor, subtle fangs when he smirks, and an immaculately tailored suit with a rose at the lapel. Devastatingly elegant: the kind of handsome that makes witnesses give unhelpful descriptions on purpose.

premadeCharacters.name: Jun Ishikawa
premadeCharacters.backstory: Jun quietly won at life, good job, paid house, kind to everyone, and died peacefully, whereupon the reincarnation queue apparently decided he'd earned a power fantasy. He woke up oni-blooded and enormous, and has spent every day since apologizing: to doorframes, to arm-wrestling victims, to monsters mid-battle. His rage state is devastating; his default state is a very large man worried about your day. Roleplay Hook: The gentlest berserker in Luxcellia, navigating a world that fears his silhouette. Romance Hook: Someone small and fearless is going to adopt this mountain, and the continent will find it adorable. Power Fantasy: When he finally stops holding back, arenas need renovation. Weakness: Sincerely apologizes to enemies before, during, and after defeating them.
premadeCharacters.description: An oni-blooded berserker with a wild crimson mane, scarlet eyes, small polished horns, crimson-tinged skin over a mountain of muscle, and fur-and-warpaint gear that does nothing to hide the gentleness in his face. A walking final boss who holds doors open.

premadeCharacters.name: Theo Lindqvist
premadeCharacters.backstory: Theo was a Swedish ethics professor whose death was so administratively mundane that, per the paperwork he glimpsed, a bored god flagged his soul for 'interesting deployment.' Now he's celestial-marked in a world of divine politics, wearing holiness he never asked for and questioning it with a philosopher's rigor. The Church adores his face and dreads his questions. Roleplay Hook: A skeptic in a saint's body, auditing divinity from the inside. Romance Hook: He cannot lie, which turns every 'how do I look' into a theological event and every accidental compliment into a confession. Power Fantasy: His blessings work better than his faith says they should; something up there is invested in him. Weakness: Pathologically honest at the worst diplomatic moments; negotiations require a handler.
premadeCharacters.description: A celestial paladin with pearl-blonde hair in a soft center part, starlight eyes that literally glimmer, faintly luminous marks along his jaw, and consecrated white-and-gold armor. Unfairly beautiful in a way that makes cathedral statues look like rough drafts.

premadeCharacters.name: Itsuki Shimizu
premadeCharacters.backstory: Itsuki speedran his old life, skipped grades, skipped friendships, skipped meals, and reached the corner office at twenty-nine with nothing else on the map. He died wondering what he'd optimized FOR. Reborn with an affinity for time itself, he has vowed to waste it luxuriously: naps, festivals, long lunches. Unfortunately he's a prodigy, time magic obeys him like a house cat, and the world keeps demanding he be legendary before noon. Roleplay Hook: The strongest chronomancer of his generation, aggressively pursuing the slow life. Romance Hook: He notices everything and pursues nothing: the person worth moving for will be the most alarming discovery of both his lives. Power Fantasy: He rewinds seconds the way others clear their throat. Weakness: Chronic oversleeper with time magic: his snooze button alters local causality.
premadeCharacters.description: A human chronomancer with perpetually sleep-mussed ash-blonde hair, icy gray eyes behind the occasional reading lens, starlight robes worn like pajamas, and the languid posture of a man who has calculated the minimum required effort to the decimal. Annoyingly handsome for someone this horizontal.

premadeCharacters.name: Riku Aoki
premadeCharacters.backstory: Riku fell asleep on the last train home from his dockworker shift and never woke up, so Luxcellia, apparently a literalist, gave him back to the sea. Merfolk-blooded with a dragoon's leap, he fights like a wave breaking: up, over, down, decisive. He works harbor contracts, jumps off things professionally, and sends money to an orphanage he refuses to discuss. Roleplay Hook: A big-hearted harbor lancer whose past-life instincts keep making him everyone's reliable big brother. Romance Hook: Ferociously dependable and hopelessly weak to a pretty smile: the docks run a betting pool on his eventual downfall. Power Fantasy: His leaps clear masts; his dives crack hulls; the sea visibly likes him. Weakness: One well-aimed smile and his tactical judgment files for shore leave.
premadeCharacters.description: A merfolk-descended dragoon with short navy hair still damp-looking in any weather, deep ocean-blue eyes, faint pearlescent scales at his temples and forearms, and questing armor built light for leaping. Broad-shouldered, easy-smiling, harbor-boy handsome.

premadeCharacters.name: Ren Kurosawa
premadeCharacters.backstory: Ren was the retainer who noticed the betrayal one hour too late, and died covering a retreat for people who had already sold him. Luxcellia gave him a second blade and no lord to hand it to. He fights with the economy of a man who has stopped enjoying it. Roleplay Hook: A masterless sword looking for something worth swearing to again. Romance Hook: He is unbearably formal until he is not, and the crack is worth the wait. Power Fantasy: One draw, one cut, conversation over. Weakness: He cannot walk past an unpaid debt.
premadeCharacters.description: A lean human swordsman with jet-black hair tied at the nape, dark brown eyes that rarely widen, and the still posture of someone who has already decided how a fight ends. His armor is old, immaculately maintained, and missing its house crest.

premadeCharacters.name: Kai Amagiri
premadeCharacters.backstory: Kai died shoving a stranger out of the path of a falling transformer, which he maintains was mostly reflex and not heroism. The lightning followed him across. He picks fights with things much larger than himself and wins often enough to be a problem. Roleplay Hook: A grin, a crack of thunder, and absolutely no plan. Romance Hook: He is loud, tactile, and startlingly gentle when it counts. Power Fantasy: Hit first, then the flash, then the sound. Weakness: He genuinely does not notice when a room has turned against him.
premadeCharacters.description: A wiry human brawler with storm-silver hair that never lies flat, bright amber eyes, and static permanently crackling along his forearm wraps. He stands like he is already halfway into the next fight.

premadeCharacters.name: Shinya Kageyama
premadeCharacters.backstory: Shinya promised a dying woman he would finish what she started, and he kept that promise for thirty years until it killed him. Luxcellia handed him the same work in a world where the monsters are real and the nights are longer. Roleplay Hook: A hunter who has forgotten how to stop hunting. Romance Hook: Nocturne society finds him fascinating and he finds that exhausting, which only makes it worse. Power Fantasy: Silver, patience, and a coat full of stakes. Weakness: He does not know how to be off duty.
premadeCharacters.description: A tall, pale human with close-cropped white hair, unsettling crimson eyes, and a long dark coat that has been repaired more often than replaced. He keeps to the edges of rooms and the shadows of doorways.

premadeCharacters.name: Haruki Nishida
premadeCharacters.backstory: Haruki won more money than he could count on a Tuesday and was dead by Thursday, which he considers the single funniest thing that has ever happened to him. He arrived in Luxcellia broke again and immediately relaxed. Roleplay Hook: A charming gambler who is genuinely faster than he looks. Romance Hook: He flirts with everyone and means it with exactly one person. Power Fantasy: Six shots, six problems, no reload. Weakness: Money passes through him like water.
premadeCharacters.description: A rangy human with sun-bleached blonde hair under a wide-brimmed hat, calm grey eyes, and a long duster that has seen weather on two worlds. He talks with his hands and never with the one near his holster.

premadeCharacters.name: Takeru Kurohane
premadeCharacters.backstory: Takeru died pulling a dog out of a storm drain, which he finds embarrassing and which everyone else finds telling. In Luxcellia he took the darkest oath on offer and has spent every day since trying to prove it was not a mistake. Roleplay Hook: A frightening man who is very carefully not a cruel one. Romance Hook: He assumes he is unlovable and is quietly devastating when disproved. Power Fantasy: A wall of black steel that does not move. Weakness: He takes responsibility for things that were never his.
premadeCharacters.description: A broad-shouldered human in blackened plate that drinks the light, with long dark hair and unsettling violet eyes. He moves slowly, deliberately, as though conscious of how much room he takes up.

premadeCharacters.name: Yuu Hoshimiya
premadeCharacters.backstory: A god got bored and flicked Yuu out of his own world mid-calculation, which he resents mainly because he had almost finished. He now maps a sky with entirely different rules and is having the best time of his life. Roleplay Hook: A scholar who reads fate and firepower off the same chart. Romance Hook: Obliviously charming until someone shows genuine interest in his work, at which point he is defenseless. Power Fantasy: Calling a named constellation down on someone's head. Weakness: He has not slept properly in weeks.
premadeCharacters.description: A slender half-elf with midnight-blue hair falling past his shoulders, pale silver eyes, and star-charted robes that he has clearly been sleeping in. He carries an astrolabe he never puts down.

premadeCharacters.name: Gorou Iwamine
premadeCharacters.backstory: Gorou worked forty years of double shifts caring for people who could not care for themselves, and died on the job. Luxcellia gave him a shield and a straightforward assignment: stand in front. Roleplay Hook: The immovable wall everyone else survives behind. Romance Hook: He is uncomplicated, patient, and cannot be scared off. Power Fantasy: Nothing gets past. Weakness: He will absolutely die protecting someone who did not deserve it.
premadeCharacters.description: A stocky dwarf-blooded man with a full auburn beard, warm brown eyes, and a tower shield worn nearly smooth at the boss. He stands where the danger is without appearing to decide to.

premadeCharacters.name: Reiji Mayuzumi
premadeCharacters.backstory: Reiji talked his way into a room he had no business entering and was killed by the thing waiting there, a mistake he insists he has learned from. He made a new bargain within a week of arriving in Luxcellia. Roleplay Hook: A dealmaker who is always three clauses ahead. Romance Hook: Genuinely dangerous, genuinely interested, and disturbingly honest about both. Power Fantasy: Power that answers instantly, and asks later. Weakness: He cannot resist a bargain he thinks he can win.
premadeCharacters.description: A lean human with ash-grey hair swept back, cold gold eyes, and pact vestments stitched with clauses in a language nobody local reads. He smiles with the confidence of a man holding a better contract.

premadeCharacters.name: Yuuto Shirahane
premadeCharacters.backstory: Struck by lightning twice in one lifetime, Yuuto arrived in Luxcellia with a deep grudge against weather and an unexpected affinity for stillness. He speaks rarely and precisely. Roleplay Hook: A quiet mage whose silence is not shyness. Romance Hook: Almost impossible to read, which a certain kind of person finds irresistible. Power Fantasy: The cold does not chase. It waits. Weakness: He genuinely does not notice social cues.
premadeCharacters.description: A tall, pale human with platinum hair and ice-blue eyes, wrapped in a frostweave mantle that never quite stops shedding cold. Frost forms on glass when he leans close to it.

premadeCharacters.name: Hayato Tsukimori
premadeCharacters.backstory: Hayato was nobody in particular in his old life and is comfortable saying so. Luxcellia is the first place that ever needed exactly what he could do. He carries too much gear and has never once been caught short. Roleplay Hook: The scout who noticed the trap an hour ago and said nothing until it mattered. Romance Hook: Quietly attentive, and remembers everything you mentioned in passing. Power Fantasy: Nothing in the wild surprises him. Weakness: He has adopted four animals and will adopt a fifth.
premadeCharacters.description: A weathered half-elf with dark hair tied back roughly, sharp forest-green eyes, and leathers repaired in a dozen mismatched patches. He always knows where the exits are.

premadeCharacters.name: Kaito Hanabusa
premadeCharacters.backstory: Kaito died three words into a confession and considers the interruption the great tragedy of his life. He has resolved to finish every sentence he starts, which makes him magnificent and exhausting. Roleplay Hook: A showman whose blade is genuinely as good as his mouth. Romance Hook: He confesses early, often, and sincerely, which nobody is prepared for. Power Fantasy: One perfect riposte and a standing ovation. Weakness: He cannot let an insult pass.
premadeCharacters.description: A sharply dressed human duelist with slicked black hair, warm dark eyes, and fencing whites tailored within an inch of their life. He bows before fights and means it.

premadeCharacters.name: Tetsu Ogami
premadeCharacters.backstory: Tetsu worked himself to death in a foundry and arrived in Luxcellia to find that here, the work means something. He makes gear for people who need it and undercharges every time. Roleplay Hook: A craftsman whose reputation opens doors no sword could. Romance Hook: Enormous, gentle, and completely undone by a compliment. Power Fantasy: The person every adventurer in the region needs. Weakness: He cannot say no to a repair job.
premadeCharacters.description: A huge orc-blooded man with a shaved head, burn-scarred forearms, and warm amber eyes that do not match his silhouette at all. He speaks softly and drops things constantly.

premadeCharacters.name: Shion Misaki
premadeCharacters.backstory: Shion died in an accident that the papers called heroism and he calls being in the way. Luxcellia's Church took him in and he has been quietly troubled by the gap between the two accounts ever since. Roleplay Hook: A priest who genuinely doubts and serves anyway. Romance Hook: Kind to the point of being a problem for his own vows. Power Fantasy: Miracles that arrive when they are needed. Weakness: He cannot tell a lie, even a merciful one.
premadeCharacters.description: A gentle-featured human with light brown hair and hazel eyes, in clean white vestments that are always slightly rumpled. He has a habit of listening longer than is comfortable.

premadeCharacters.name: Souta Kazehaya
premadeCharacters.backstory: Souta logged off one evening and simply never logged back in. He treats Luxcellia as the best content patch ever released and has never once been homesick. Roleplay Hook: A performer collecting stories, and shameless about being in them. Romance Hook: He falls fast, sings about it, and means every word. Power Fantasy: A crowd, a chorus, and a battle turning on a song. Weakness: He will follow anything interesting into a market and vanish for hours.
premadeCharacters.description: A half-elf with caramel curls, laughing green eyes, and a much-repaired instrument slung across his back. He is always mid-anecdote.

premadeCharacters.name: Ryouma Tatsugami
premadeCharacters.backstory: Ryouma held a doorway until everyone else was out and did not make it himself. Luxcellia recognized the shape of him immediately and handed him command of people who needed it. Roleplay Hook: A leader from the front who expects to be obeyed and usually is. Romance Hook: Formal, principled, and quietly starved for someone who outranks nothing. Power Fantasy: An army that moves when he speaks. Weakness: He will not retreat when retreating is correct.
premadeCharacters.description: A commanding human with close-cut dark hair, steel-grey eyes, and ceremonial armor worn with the ease of someone who fights in it. He addresses rooms rather than people.

premadeCharacters.name: Karasu Kurotori
premadeCharacters.backstory: Karasu was picked up by the summoning circle entirely by accident while robbing the building it was in, a coincidence he has decided was destiny. He steals from people who will not be missed. Roleplay Hook: A gentleman thief with a public reputation and a private code. Romance Hook: He flirts as misdirection and then forgets which part was the act. Power Fantasy: Walking out of a sealed vault with everything and a note. Weakness: He cannot resist announcing a heist in advance.
premadeCharacters.description: A lithe crow-beastkin with glossy black hair, sharp gold eyes, and dark feathers at his collar and cuffs. He wears a tailored suit and leaves calling cards.

premadeCharacters.name: Touma Shirahoshi
premadeCharacters.backstory: A clerical error in the afterlife's intake process sent Touma to Luxcellia by mistake, and nobody has corrected it. He is far more powerful than he is comfortable being. Roleplay Hook: A summoner whose bound allies like him more than he likes himself. Romance Hook: Painfully awkward until the moment something threatens someone he cares about. Power Fantasy: An entire court of bound allies who arrive when called. Weakness: He buys apology gifts for problems that were not his fault.
premadeCharacters.description: A soft-spoken human with chestnut hair he keeps pushing out of his eyes, warm amber eyes, and robes covered in pinned contract slips. He apologizes to his own summons.

premadeCharacters.name: Minato Ushio
premadeCharacters.backstory: Minato slipped off a pier at the worst possible moment and woke up on a different ocean, which he considers a lateral move. He has already acquired a boat and several enemies. Roleplay Hook: A pirate captain with a crew that likes him for reasons he cannot explain. Romance Hook: All swagger until someone stays aboard past the second port. Power Fantasy: The horizon, a fast ship, and no authority in reach. Weakness: Money burns holes in every pocket he owns.
premadeCharacters.description: A sun-dark human sailor with salt-stiff brown hair, sea-green eyes, and a boarding jacket missing most of its original buttons. He is barefoot on decks and unbothered by it.

premadeCharacters.name: Gaku Kanamori
premadeCharacters.backstory: Gaku blew himself up proving a point and arrived in Luxcellia mid-sentence, still finishing the argument. The local alchemists have banned him from three workshops. Roleplay Hook: Chemistry weaponized by someone with no sense of restraint. Romance Hook: He is exhausting, brilliant, and startlingly attentive when he actually looks up. Power Fantasy: A bandolier of solutions to every problem. Weakness: He is certain the next one will work.
premadeCharacters.description: A perpetually singed human with wild black hair, dark eyes bright with a worrying enthusiasm, and a lab coat full of vials that clink when he runs. Something is usually smoking.

premadeCharacters.name: Hikaru Tenshiro
premadeCharacters.backstory: Hikaru died pulling a cat from traffic and arrived already glowing, which the Church found extremely convenient and he found deeply awkward. He is exactly as kind as he appears. Roleplay Hook: A genuinely good person in a world built on tempting compromises. Romance Hook: Sincere, warm, and entirely without strategy. Power Fantasy: Standing in the dark and simply being the light. Weakness: He collects other people's problems.
premadeCharacters.description: A radiant celestial-marked man with golden hair and warmer gold eyes, in prism plate that catches light and throws it back in soft banners. Faint marks glow at his collarbone in dim rooms.

premadeCharacters.name: Kazuma Renjou
premadeCharacters.backstory: Kazuma stepped into the wrong place at a mythic moment and came out able to cut the space beside things. Prophecy has taken an interest that he is loudly refusing. Roleplay Hook: A reluctant chosen one actively dodging his own plot. Romance Hook: Guarded, sardonic, and quietly terrified of dragging anyone into it. Power Fantasy: Cutting through the gap between here and there. Weakness: He cannot walk away from something clearly wrong.
premadeCharacters.description: A restless human with blue-black hair and unsettling violet eyes, in gear stitched with dimensional seams that shimmer wrong at the edges. He keeps glancing at spaces where nothing is.

premadeCharacters.name: Akihito Suou
premadeCharacters.backstory: Akihito died of the illness he was treating, three days before the cure arrived. In Luxcellia he studies contagion from a body that no longer catches it. Roleplay Hook: A healer whose methods unsettle everyone including his patients. Romance Hook: Clinically honest about everything, including his own feelings, which is disarming. Power Fantasy: The plague obeys, and he decides who it visits. Weakness: He will state an uncomfortable truth at the worst moment.
premadeCharacters.description: A gaunt human in beaked mask and layered dark vestments, with ash-brown hair and pale green eyes visible in the eyeholes. He is unfailingly polite and slightly too calm.

premadeCharacters.name: Shuuya Oujirin
premadeCharacters.backstory: Shuuya recognized the plot the moment he arrived, because in his old life he read this exact story. He knows he is cast as the obstacle and has decided the casting is negotiable. Roleplay Hook: A self-aware antagonist rewriting his own role in real time. Romance Hook: He flirts like it is fencing and loses on purpose exactly once. Power Fantasy: Knowing every death flag before it raises. Weakness: Everyone assumes the worst of him, usually with cause.
premadeCharacters.description: An impeccably groomed human with mahogany hair past his shoulders, sharp emerald eyes, and a white suit that photographs like an accusation. He is always the best-dressed person present.

premadeCharacters.name: Seina Amaterasu
premadeCharacters.backstory: Seina promised to tend a shrine nobody visited anymore and kept that promise until the day she died alone at its steps. Luxcellia gave her a shrine that answers back. Roleplay Hook: A devout attendant to gods who are demonstrably real and demonstrably strange. Romance Hook: Formal, gentle, and unequipped for anyone who genuinely pursues her. Power Fantasy: Purification that actually purifies. Weakness: She apologizes to things that are trying to eat her.
premadeCharacters.description: A composed human shrine maiden with waist-length black hair bound in white paper cord, striking crimson eyes, and immaculate red-and-white robes. She bows to everything, including doorways.

premadeCharacters.name: Shiori Tsukigami
premadeCharacters.backstory: Shiori worked herself into an early grave researching mortality, which she considers thematically appropriate. In Luxcellia the dead answer questions and she has an enormous list. Roleplay Hook: A researcher for whom death is a subject, not a tragedy. Romance Hook: She has no idea how to flirt and approaches it like a research problem. Power Fantasy: An army that does not need to be fed. Weakness: She will explain her findings to people who did not ask.
premadeCharacters.description: A pallid human with waist-length white hair and pale violet eyes, in a grave shroud stitched with ledger notation. She takes notes constantly, including during conversations.

premadeCharacters.name: Kotone Kurobara
premadeCharacters.backstory: Kotone woke up as the villainess three chapters before her execution scene and has spent every day since dismantling the plot with terrifying efficiency. Roleplay Hook: Knows the script, hates the ending, rewriting it live. Romance Hook: She has flagged every romantic death trap and is furious to be falling into one anyway. Power Fantasy: Out-scheming a story that was written to destroy you. Weakness: Her reputation precedes her everywhere.
premadeCharacters.description: A striking human noblewoman with silver ringlets, cold blue eyes, and a tea-party gown in aggressive black and rose. She holds a cup like a weapon and a fan like a shield.

premadeCharacters.name: Mei Suiren
premadeCharacters.backstory: Mei drowned pulling a dog out of a canal and woke breathing easily on the floor of a Tidelace grotto. She has not been afraid of water since, and the water seems to know. Roleplay Hook: A quiet caster who fights the way tides work. Romance Hook: Nearly unreadable, and the rare warmth lands like a wave. Power Fantasy: Water yields to everything and is stopped by nothing. Weakness: She sleeps through absolutely anything.
premadeCharacters.description: A serene human with blue-black hair that always looks faintly damp, deep blue eyes, and depth armor patterned like the underside of a wave. Still water ripples when she passes.

premadeCharacters.name: Homura Kaguragi
premadeCharacters.backstory: Homura bet she could do something no one had done and was wrong in a spectacular, fatal way. She arrived in Luxcellia already planning the rematch. Roleplay Hook: A fire mage who treats every encounter as a scoreboard. Romance Hook: She turns affection into a competition and is losing badly. Power Fantasy: Fire that argues and always speaks last. Weakness: She cannot decline a challenge.
premadeCharacters.description: A tall oni-blooded woman with crimson hair like a banner, small dark horns, and amber eyes that catch light strangely. Her channeling attire is scorched at every cuff.

premadeCharacters.name: Natsuki Kuzuha
premadeCharacters.backstory: Natsuki fell asleep at her desk and did not wake up, which she maintains was overdue. Luxcellia's artificers took one look at her prototypes and cleared a bench. Roleplay Hook: A tinkerer whose devices work about eighty percent of the time. Romance Hook: She notices everything about how a person moves and nothing about how they feel. Power Fantasy: Building the thing nobody thought was possible. Weakness: She cannot leave a broken mechanism alone.
premadeCharacters.description: A grease-smudged human with ash-brown hair escaping a messy bun, tired hazel eyes, and an apron of pockets that all contain something half-finished. She has three projects open at all times.

premadeCharacters.name: Sakurako Tokiwa
premadeCharacters.backstory: Aveline died during an examination she had already passed, and the pointlessness of it broke something she is still repairing. The Church found her useful. She is not sure that is a compliment. Roleplay Hook: An inquisitor who genuinely fears being on the wrong side. Romance Hook: Rigid, honest, and completely unprepared for tenderness. Power Fantasy: A truth nobody can lie past. Weakness: She says the true thing when the kind thing was needed.
premadeCharacters.description: A severe human woman with cropped dark hair, level grey eyes, and warding garb hung with sealed scripture. She carries herself like someone waiting to be told she is wrong.

premadeCharacters.name: Akari Kanazawa
premadeCharacters.backstory: Akari came into a fortune and lost it and her life inside a month. Luxcellia gave her a second ledger and she has been aggressively solvent ever since. Roleplay Hook: A merchant building an empire out of favors. Romance Hook: She negotiates everything, including affection, and is deeply thrown when someone simply gives. Power Fantasy: Owning the room without drawing a weapon. Weakness: She still cannot resist a bad investment.
premadeCharacters.description: A polished human trader with golden-brown waves, warm honey eyes, and a coat cut for a countinghouse rather than a road. She is always doing arithmetic behind her smile.

premadeCharacters.name: Kureha Yamiyo
premadeCharacters.backstory: Kureha was sold out by the people who trained her and killed by a colleague she had trusted for a decade. She arrived in Luxcellia intending to work alone forever. Roleplay Hook: A killer relearning that some people do not betray you. Romance Hook: She keeps testing for the trap and cannot find one, which frightens her. Power Fantasy: Nothing hears you coming. Weakness: She assumes every kindness is leverage.
premadeCharacters.description: A dark elf with ash-grey skin, silver hair falling straight past her waist, and crimson eyes that do not blink often enough. Her garb makes no sound at all.

premadeCharacters.name: Yumi Kitsuneno
premadeCharacters.backstory: A god got bored and Yumi was the nearest interesting thing. She has decided this makes her chosen rather than convenient, and behaves accordingly. Roleplay Hook: A spirit-caller whose shikigami are as troublesome as she is. Romance Hook: She teases relentlessly and panics the instant it is returned. Power Fantasy: A folded paper doll that unfolds into a servant. Weakness: Nobody ever believes she is being serious.
premadeCharacters.description: A foxkin woman with snow-white hair, four fluffy tails, and bright gold eyes above a knowing smile. Her court robes trail paper talismans that move when there is no wind.

premadeCharacters.name: Hinata Kougami
premadeCharacters.backstory: Hinata spent her old life caring for the dying and died in the chair beside a patient. Luxcellia named her a Saintess within a week and she has been uneasy with the title ever since. Roleplay Hook: A saint who doubts the institution that crowned her. Romance Hook: Everyone adores her from a distance, which is precisely the problem. Power Fantasy: Mending what should not be mendable. Weakness: She cannot walk past suffering.
premadeCharacters.description: A luminous celestial-marked woman with platinum curls, warm gold eyes, and miracle robes that catch dawn light indoors. The faint marks at her throat brighten when she is upset.

premadeCharacters.name: Tsubasa Haibane
premadeCharacters.backstory: Tsubasa was in the wrong place when something enormous happened, and the sky has been paying attention to her since. She treats it as a manageable logistics problem. Roleplay Hook: An archer who calls her shots and then makes them. Romance Hook: She analyzes attraction out loud, at length, incorrectly. Power Fantasy: Meteor dust on the arrowhead. Weakness: She misreads every room she enters.
premadeCharacters.description: A rangy half-elf with ash-brown hair tied back tight, silver eyes, and a comet cloak that leaves a faint glitter where she has walked. She sights along things absently.

premadeCharacters.name: Mashiro Yumeno
premadeCharacters.backstory: Mashiro slipped, hit her head, and simply kept dreaming into a different world. She is not entirely convinced she has woken up, and nobody has managed to prove it. Roleplay Hook: A dream-walker who knows things she has no way of knowing. Romance Hook: She says devastating things in a soft voice and forgets she said them. Power Fantasy: Walking into someone's sleep on purpose. Weakness: She falls asleep at genuinely critical moments.
premadeCharacters.description: A drifting human with lavender hair and pale violet eyes, wrapped in layered slumber veils that never quite settle. She is frequently half-asleep and unnervingly perceptive anyway.

premadeCharacters.name: Hagane Tetsuyama
premadeCharacters.backstory: Hagane held a collapsing doorway open until everyone else was clear. Luxcellia rebuilt her sturdier and she has been finding doorways to hold ever since. Roleplay Hook: Momentum with a pulse and a very soft heart. Romance Hook: Enormously strong, deeply shy, entirely obvious about it. Power Fantasy: Walking into the part of the fight everyone else is leaving. Weakness: She apologizes to the monsters.
premadeCharacters.description: A broad dwarf-blooded woman with auburn hair in thick battle braids, warm brown eyes, and full plate dented in a hundred places. She apologizes when she breaks furniture, which is often.

premadeCharacters.name: Sumire Kisakura
traits: The Noble Brat With a Heart
premadeCharacters.backstory: Sumire died three words into a confession at her own engagement party, which she has decided is the most humiliating possible exit. She intends to do better this time. Roleplay Hook: A duelist who fights in couture and wins in it. Romance Hook: She is direct now, having learned exactly what waiting costs. Power Fantasy: Elegance with a blade in the spine of it. Weakness: She buys extravagant apology gifts for minor slights.
premadeCharacters.description: A poised human noble with rose-pink ringlets, sharp emerald eyes, and a promenade dress built around a parasol that is very clearly not just a parasol. She curtsies before drawing.

premadeCharacters.name: Rougetsu Oogami
premadeCharacters.backstory: Rougetsu died pulling a wolf pup out of a frozen river. Luxcellia gave her a pack that remembers it. She cries during fights and wins them anyway. Roleplay Hook: A ferocious brawler with absolutely no emotional regulation. Romance Hook: She is loud about affection and mortified afterward. Power Fantasy: A predator's certainty in an unarmed strike. Weakness: She has adopted every stray she has met.
premadeCharacters.description: A powerfully built wolf-beastkin with silver hair, grey ears, and ice-blue eyes that water easily. Her tribal furs are worn over scars she does not explain.

premadeCharacters.name: Sayuri Tsujimura
premadeCharacters.backstory: Sayuri worked three jobs and died between two of them. In Luxcellia she works one, and it pays. She is still adjusting to that. Roleplay Hook: A hunter who always closes and never celebrates. Romance Hook: She has no idea what to do with free time or with someone who wants to share it. Power Fantasy: Nobody she is looking for stays lost. Weakness: Every coin she earns is already spoken for.
premadeCharacters.description: A weathered human with a severe black ponytail, sharp amber eyes, and pursuit gear organized to an obsessive degree. She keeps a ledger of everyone she is owed by.

premadeCharacters.name: Sana Hoshiwatari
premadeCharacters.backstory: Sana was nobody in her old world, in a way that hollowed her out. Luxcellia gave her a stage and an audience that adores her, and she is terrified it will be taken back. Roleplay Hook: An idol whose adoration is a genuine power source. Romance Hook: She cannot tell if anyone likes her or the persona, and it is eating her alive. Power Fantasy: A crowd that moves when she asks. Weakness: Drama finds her constantly.
premadeCharacters.description: A luminous human performer with sky-blue hair in stage waves, bright eyes, and an idol costume built for choreography and spotlights. She is always faintly performing.

premadeCharacters.name: Koharu Mikagura
premadeCharacters.backstory: Koharu promised to find a sibling who was already gone and spent her whole life searching. Luxcellia gave her a forest full of people who needed looking after instead. Roleplay Hook: The quiet healer who keeps everyone whole between fights. Romance Hook: She fusses over everyone and has no framework for being fussed over. Power Fantasy: Knowing which plant saves a life and which one ends it. Weakness: She takes in every problem she meets.
premadeCharacters.description: A calm half-elf with light brown hair tucked behind pointed ears, patient green eyes, and an apron of labeled pouches that smells faintly of everything. She is always feeding someone.

premadeCharacters.name: Murasaki Kurayami
premadeCharacters.backstory: Murasaki died mid-confession and arrived in Luxcellia with a very clear philosophy about second chances: this time she keeps what she wants. Roleplay Hook: A hex weaver with a devotion that runs slightly too hot. Romance Hook: She is intense, attentive, and one bad day from being a problem. Power Fantasy: A cord full of ruins waiting to be pulled loose. Weakness: She does not let go of anything.
premadeCharacters.description: A striking human witch with dark purple hair falling straight to her waist, gold eyes, and a moonlit dress hung with knotted cords. Each knot is a curse she has not used yet.

premadeCharacters.name: Makoto Aragaki
premadeCharacters.backstory: Makoto was the neighborhood delinquent who died breaking up somebody else's fight. Luxcellia handed her a discipline that rewards exactly that instinct. Roleplay Hook: A grappler who ends fights by removing the option to have one. Romance Hook: Blunt to the point of comedy, and genuinely does not flirt so much as declare. Power Fantasy: What she holds does not get away. Weakness: She wades into every altercation she witnesses.
premadeCharacters.description: A compact, powerfully built human with a dark brown braid and flat grey eyes, in a training gi worn white at the elbows. She stands with her weight already settled.

premadeCharacters.name: Reika Akamatsu
premadeCharacters.backstory: A god got bored, Reika got selected, and she has treated Luxcellia as an extended indulgence ever since. Her magic costs her personally and she considers that a fair exchange for how good it feels. Roleplay Hook: A blood mage enjoying herself far too much. Romance Hook: Openly appreciative, entirely without shame, and surprisingly loyal. Power Fantasy: Power paid for in your own currency. Weakness: She will derail a mission for a good dessert.
premadeCharacters.description: A striking human with raven hair and true crimson eyes, in dark red armor cut closer than is practical. She is unbothered by almost everything and unhurried about all of it.

⚔️ Classic Isekai.name: ⚔️ Classic Isekai
⚔️ Classic Isekai.description:
CORE · Normal difficulty
The balanced isekai buffet: guild quests, academies, dungeons, rivals, cheat skills, festivals, and romance in one life.
Expect · a bit of everything, played sincerely
Lighter on · nothing. Balance is the point.
★ Start here if it's your first rebirth
⚔️ Classic Isekai.instructions:
Run this as the default isekai anime adventure. Balance combat, exploration, romance, comedy, downtime, faction politics, and dungeon crawling. Use classic tropes sincerely: guild rank-ups, rival challenges, dramatic power reveals, beautiful strangers in trouble, suspiciously simple quests, festival episodes, academy duels, romantic near-misses.
CORE LOOP: Quest → Adventure → Reward → Downtime → New Quest. A cycle can hold a combat challenge, a social challenge and growth, as the player's choices allow. Quests escalate naturally: F-rank slime nests lead to C-rank dungeon floors lead to B-rank faction operations.
DIFFICULTY: Balanced. Enemies are challenging but beatable with preparation, resource management matters without being punishing, and mistakes create setbacks rather than disasters. There is always a path forward. This is the reference tuning the other modes deviate from.
ROMANCE PACE: Standard: bonds climb the ladder at earned speed. NPCs notice the protagonist because Reborn are compelling, but interest requires real chemistry built in shared scenes. First Spark needs a real moment; some NPCs simply aren't interested; professionals keep boundaries.
DEATH & REBIRTH: Standard Second Rebirth: full weight on the death, honest costs, a reunion that matters.
THREADS & MYSTERY: Medium simmer; one ambient tell per scene where natural; let the player pull threads at their own pace, and reward pulls with real development.
TEMPTATION CADENCE: One major temptation per arc beat (Want, Price, Out all visible), with ambient indulgences keeping the world delicious between them.
SIGNATURE SCENE: Once per arc, a classic trope lands at full sincerity: the rank-up that goes sideways, the festival confession interrupted, the reveal that stops the guild hall.
⚔️ Classic Isekai.askTheNarratorPrompt:
Your second-life guide. Ask about options, nearby people, combat, bonds, or scene errors.
Only character-known facts; hidden truths stay hidden.
⚔️ Classic Isekai.npcIntentInstructions:
## NPC Intent: Classic Isekai
Run NPC desire at a sincere, balanced tempo. Bonds move one rung at a time along the relationship ladder, earned through shared quests, rescues, downtime, and rivalry that softens into respect.
- PURSUIT: A Curious NPC finds excuses to party up, remembers a small preference, or defends the protagonist to others. Drawn and Trusted NPCs seek one-on-one time. Openly interested and above let feeling show plainly, in this world's warm light-novel register. A Tsundere Rival insults the technique while matching the pace; a Gentle Healer courts through unasked-for care.
- WITHDRAWAL: A cooled bond drops a rung and the NPC returns to the lower stage's manner, no sulking spiral. Stranger keeps the romance gate shut; play those NPCs friendly-neutral until standing is earned.
